source_text: and the one went out from me, and i said, surely he is torn to pieces; and i saw him not ad-hennah until now;
target_text: ana uuru èèna, aad'o heka. ele boe badha hui na'e aa'i le. nèti èèna ka, ja'a kèdhi heka rèhu na toke d'ai sange ne'e.

source_text: and if ye take this also from me, and ason evil, harm befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hair in ra'ah misery to sheol.
target_text: ladhe miu mèti hari ana limuri ne, ho sèmi na abhu j'aj'èra, èèna miu paj'èra ja'a dhèu heka ne'e. ladhe sèmi èèna na, ja'a madhe dènge kèna. '

source_text: now therefore when i come to thy eved avi, and the na'ar be not with us; seeing that his nefesh is bound up in the nefesh of the na'ar; it shall come to pass, when he seeth that the na'ar is not with us, that he will die; and thy avadim shall bring down the gray hair of thy eved avinu with yagon sorrow to sheol,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama, ladhe ja'a lèpa kèti boe dènge ari ji'i ne, ama ji'i madhe dènge kèna. te samanga na dhu pa'èki dènge ana ne'e di. dènge ètu d'ara haheka na ne'e, ladhe ji'i tao ne tabha j'èra, tatu na madhe dènge kèna.

source_text: for thy eved became surety for the na'ar unto avi, saying, if i bring him not unto thee, then i shall bear the blame before avi kol hayamim.
target_text: ngaa hari, ja'a moa le mi ama ku, peka na, ‘ja'a ka dhu tago ana ne'e. ladhe ja'a kèti heka ana ne'e mai sa madha ama, ja'a ka tago sasala na, toke d'ai ja'a madhe. '

source_text: therefore, let thy eved, now, abide instead of the na'ar, an eved to adoni; and let the na'ar go up with his achim.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e, ama wakil: hud'i laa ja'a ka pea mi ne'e gati nèngu, sèna ka ja'a j'aj'i ènu ama wakil. hia ne lèpa dènge a'a na si.

source_text: for how shall i go up to avi, and the na'ar be not with me? lest i see the rah that would overtake avi.
target_text: ladhe ana ne'e la'e boe, ja'a bisa boe lèpa kahèi. d'ara ja'a la'e boe ladhe j'aj'èra ama ji'i toke madhe.

source_text: then yosef could not control himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, cause kol ish to go out from me. and there stood no ish with him, while yosef made himself known unto his achim.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare lii yahuda na, d'ara yusuf roe bhilu, toke taha nare boe ètu madha dhèu sab'a na sèra. nèti èèna ka, na hia ra lasi asa li'u, sèna ka mesa na di, dènge a'ari na ètu d'ara èmu. dènge j'ara ne'e, nèngu bisa patadhe iisi na, mi a'ari na sèra.

source_text: and he wept aloud; and the mitzrayim and the bais pharaoh heard.
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a se'e kalua asa li'u, ka yusuf tangi dènge d'ara pèd'a. lii tangi na mèdhu, ka dhèu-dhèu masir ètu li'u sèra tadèngi kahèi. mesa boe dhèu ètu li'u sèra, te dhèu ètu èmu dhèu aae tadèngi kahèi.

source_text: and yosef said unto his achim brethren, i am yosef; doth avi yet live? and his achim could not answer him; for they were shocked with dismay at his presence.
target_text: ka yusuf peka mola-mola dènge a'ari na si, aku nèngu na, a'ari, ee! ja'a ne'e ka yusuf èèna! ama ku mamuri era, do? ropa tadèngi rare, a'a na sèra madha'u titu kèna. ra bisa heka bhoke hèb'a padhai lii ngaa èci sa.

source_text: and yosef said unto his achim, come near to me, now. and they came near. and he said, i am yosef achichem your brother, whom ye sold into mitzrayim.
target_text: hèia yusuf paroa si, peka na, mai ku padètu-dètu dènge ja'a. ka ara lasi padètu sa madha yusuf. ka na peka hari, ja'a ne, yusuf, dhu uru èèna, miu pahia eele asa masir ne'e.

source_text: now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me here; for elohim did send me before you to save life.
target_text: miu se tare'a pahie eele ja'a. te ngaa mage miu madha'u, aa baku peka cee ka dhu sala. lula ama lamatua ka dhu hia uuru ja'a mai sa ne'e. ho dènge j'ara ne'e, na pake ja'a ho hia mamuri mi dhèu ae. sèna ka baku madhe manganga.

source_text: for these two years hath the ra'av famine been in the land; and yet there are chamesh shanim five years, in the which there shall neither be plowing nor harvest.
target_text: rai manganga ne heka dua tèu kèna. lèmi tèu era. bèli-camèd'a dhèu tao heka oka-tedhe, sèla heka, aa abhu heka nganga'a hèru èj'i lai.

source_text: and elohim sent me before you to save you a she'erit remnant in the earth, and to save life for you by a peletah gedolah great deliverance, escape.
target_text: dènge j'ara dhu èdhi te'a boe ne, ama lamatua hia ja'a mai asa ne'e uru nèti miu. sèna ka, miu dènge ana-èpu miu abhu mamuri.

source_text: so now it was not you that sent me here, but haelohim; and he hath made me as an av to pharaoh, and adon of all his bais, and moshel throughout kol eretz mitzrayim.
target_text: de dhu lèke, nèti boe tatao miu ka ja'a d'ai era ne'e, te ngaa tatao ama lamatua di. nèngu ka dhu hia ja'a j'aj'i ai g'ana dhèu aae masir. ka ja'a j'aj'i mi kapala urusan ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae. abhu boe dhèu leo èci sa dhu kapai risi nèti ja'a.

source_text: haste ye, and go up to avi, and say unto him, thus saith thy ben, yosef, elohim hath made me as adon kol mitzrayim; come down unto me, tarry not;
target_text: de miu lami ka lai-lai ne, ho peka lii padhai lii ja'a ne dènge ama ku, sèmi ne'e: ‘yusuf, ana ama ku, mamuri era! nèngu j'aj'i le dhèu kapai ètu rai masir. na manèngi ama ku la'e lai-lai asa nèi.

source_text: and thou shalt dwell in eretz goshen, and thou shalt be karov near unto me, thou, and thy banim, and thy bnei banecha, and thy tzon, and thy bakar, and all that thou hast:
target_text: ho èèna na, ama pea ètu rai gosen padètu dènge nèngu. era na be'a aa taleo. sèna ka ama bisa piara kahib'i-kalèbho, kahib'i-ka'ia dènge sapi aa'i-aa'i ra. aa na manèngi kahèi ho ama la'e dènge ana-èpu, dènge isi èmu, dènge mèdha-panyau, ho pea taruu mi nèi.

source_text: and there will i nourish thee; for yet there are chamesh shanim of ra'av famine; lest thou, and thy bais, and all that thou hast, come to destitution.
target_text: ladhe ama pea ètu gosen, nèngu ladhe-leru ama ètu nèi. te rai manganga lèmi tèu era. sèna ka na tenge j'ara ho ama dènge ana-èpu, aa dènge badha-manu bisa mamuri dènge be'a. '

source_text: and, hinei, your eyes see, and the eyes of achi binyamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.
target_text: yusuf peka nare hèia, na padhai lii hari, peka na, miu unu mi mèdhi le, si? aa èu kahèi, benyamin. ja'a ne'e, tare'a-re'a yusuf.

source_text: and ye shall tell avi of kol my kavod b'mitzrayim, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down avi here.
target_text: de miu peka dènge ama èdhi, na, ja'a ne'e dènge koasa kapai titu kèna, ètu kabarai masir ne'e. aa lolo dènge ama, ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu miu mèdhi le ètu ne'e. ho èèna na, karohe mèti ama sa ne'e mai!

source_text: and he fell upon the neck of binyamin achiv, and wept; and binyamin wept upon his neck.
target_text: èle èèna ka, liku nare ari na benyamin, hèia dua ra tangi.

source_text: moreover he kissed all his achim, and wept upon them; and after that his achim talked with him.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, na liku nare a'a na si èci-èci, ka na uu si. ka heka ra bani padhai lii dènge ne kèna.

source_text: and the news thereof was heard in bais pharaoh saying, achei yosef are come; and it pleased pharaoh well, and his avadim.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae dènge dhèu-dhèu kapai na sèra, tadèngi rare a'ari yusuf mai asa masir, ra karej'e kahèi.

source_text: and pharaoh said unto yosef, say unto thy achim, this do ye; load your beasts, and go, get you unto eretz kena'an;
target_text: ka dhèu aae peka dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ari! peka dènge a'ari èu sèra, ho hua ka nganga'a asa dedha keled'ei rèngu, sèna ka rèti sa kana'an.

source_text: and take avichem and your households, and come unto me; and i will give you the best of eretz mitzrayim, ye shall eat the chelev haaretz.
target_text: aa peka dènge si, rèti ama mu dènge ana-èpu aa'i-aa'i, mai pea sa ne'e. d'ai ne'e, pe ja'a hia rèngu rai, era dhu hèu mèngi risi, sèna ka rèngu bisa mamuri nèti isi rai èèna.

source_text: now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you agalot wagons out of eretz mitzrayim for your little ones, and for your nashim, and bring avichem, and come.
target_text: aa hia rèti mema dènge kareta pèri-pèri nèti ne'e, ho sèna ka hua ana iiki-ana iiki dènge ama mu.

source_text: also regard not your kelim; for the best of kol eretz mitzrayim is yours.
target_text: baku ra pangee mèdha-panyau dhu rèngu bisa boe nedhe rèti, te, ngaa-ngaa dhu be'a ètu rai masir ne, èèna na j'aj'i unu rèngu.

source_text: and the bnei yisroel did so; and yosef gave them agalot, according to the commandment of pharaoh, and gave them provision for the derech.
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka yusuf hia si kareta pèri-pèri bua, dènge parèko ra'a j'ara, sama sèmi lii paredha dhèu aae. aa a'ari na pa'èra ka, ho lèpa madhutu lii paredha dhèu aae.

source_text: to all of them he gave each man chalifot semalot; but to binyamin he gave three hundred pieces of kesef, and chamesh chalifot semalot.
target_text: ka yusuf hia si mèdha-papake dhu hiu, ca dhèu ca pasa. te ngaa benyamin, na hia doi iia tèlu ngasu, dènge mèdha-papake dhu hiu, lèmi pasa.

source_text: and to aviv he sent after this manner; ten chamorim loaded with the best of mitzrayim, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and lechem and provision for aviv for the derech.
target_text: yusuf pa'adhu mèdha-panyau dhu be'a risi nèti masir hia ama na. rèngu hua mi dedha keled'ei canguru ngi'u. sèmi èèna kahèi, na hia are, roti, dènge nganga'a ae-ae, dhu j'aj'i parèko j'ara, lod'o dhu rèngu mulai pakèd'i nèti kana'an asa masir. nganga'a se, ra hua ètu dedha keled'ei dhu leo hari canguru ngi'u.

source_text: so he sent his achim away, and they departed; and he said unto them, see that ye not quarrel by the derech.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na hia si lèpa, aa na moa si, aku nèngu na, miu baku patao-palaha ètu talora j'ara, ee!

source_text: and they went up out of mitzrayim, and came into eretz kena'an unto ya'akov avihem,
target_text: hèia ra pakèd'i ka lasi sa ama ra ètu kana'an.

source_text: and told him, saying, yosef chai! yosef is yet alive, and he is moshel kol eretz mitzrayim. and ya'akovʼs lev fainted, for he believed them not.
target_text: d'ai nèi ka, ra lolo dènge ama ra, peka na, ama! ana mu yusuf na, dhu mamuri era di. na j'aj'i le dhèu kapai, ka na paredha ètu rai masir! yakob tadèngi hiu-hiu na, loo-loo sène, te na lèka boe.

source_text: and they told him kol divrei yosef, which he had said unto them; and when he saw the agalot which yosef had sent to carry him, the ruach ya'akov avihem revived;
target_text: te ngaa ropa na tadèngi nare lii lolo rèngu sèra, aa na ladhe nèdhi kareta dhu yusuf pa'adhu mai ho hua ne asa masir, heka na lèka kèna.

source_text: and yisroel said, it is enough; yosef beni chai! yosef beni is yet alive; i will go and see him before i die.
target_text: hèia na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, hea! de ana ja'a dhu mamuri era di! ja'a heka karej'e kèna. ja'a hud'i laku kèdhi ku ne, heka ja'a madhe dènge karej'e kèna.

source_text: and yisroel took his journey with all that he had, and came to be'er-sheva, and offered zevakhim unto elohei aviv yitzchak.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob si pa'èra ka mèdha ra, ka ra pakèd'i nèti kana'an. ropa ra d'ai rae barseba, ka na roro badha tao korban hia lamatua, dhu uru na ama na isak mangaj'i.

source_text: and elohim spoke unto yisroel in the marot halailah, and said, ya'akov, ya'akov. and he said, hineni.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka na nii. ètu d'ara nii ne'e, na tadèngi na ama lamatua paroa ne, peka na, yakob! yakob! èu kèd'i ho nanene ku la! hèia na dhaa, peka na, nga tao, ama?

source_text: and he said, i am el elohei avicha; fear not to go down to mitzrayim; for there i will make thee a goy gadol;
target_text: ka lamatua peka na, ja'a ne, ama lamatua dhu ama mu mangaj'i nèti uru ka. mage èu madha'u kahèi lamu masir. te èèna na, ja'a tao ana-èpu èu j'aj'i suku kapai ètu rai nèi.

source_text: i will go down with thee to mitzrayim; and i will also surely bring thee up again; and yosef shall put his yad upon thine eyes.
target_text: ja'a laku hèi masir sama-sama dènge èu. ho ladhe èèna na, ja'a kahèi dhu kèti hari ana-èpu èu lèpa asa rai kana'an ne'e. ropa èu madhe, na, ana mu yusuf madhèdi ètu baboa èu.

source_text: and ya'akov rose up from be'er-sheva; and the bnei yisroel carried ya'akov avihem, and their little ones, and their nashim, in the agalot which pharaoh had sent to carry him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob dènge ana-ana na sèra, lasi taruu tèke eele rae barseba. ra paca'e ne dènge bhèni-ana iiki na asa kareta sèra dhu dhèu aae masir pa'adhu hia si.

source_text: and they took their mikneh, and their possessions, which they had acquired in eretz kena'an, and came to mitzrayim, ya'akov, and all his zera with him; his banim, and his bnei banim with him, his banot, and his banot banim, and all his zera brought he with him to mitzrayim.
target_text: rèti aa'i mèu-mèu mèdha-panyau dènge badha-manu dhu j'aj'i kakaja rèngu ètu rai kana'an. hèia yakob dènge ana-èpu na, bhèni-mone aa'i-aa'i ra pakèd'i ka lasi rai masir.

source_text: and these are the shemot bnei yisroel, which came to mitzrayim: ya'akov and his banim: reuven, bechor ya'akov;
target_text: ana-èpu yakob dhu madhutu lasi asa masir, nuka se'e: ruben, ana uuru na.

source_text: and the bnei reuven: chanokh, and pallu, and chetzron, and carmi.
target_text: ana-ana na ka: henok, palu, hesron dènge karmi.

source_text: and the bnei shim'on: yemuel, and yamin, and ohad, and yachin, and tzochar, and sha'ul ben hakena'ani.
target_text: simeon, dènge ana-ana na: yemuel, yamin, ohat, yakin, dènge sohar. dènge saul kahèi, ana na nèti dhèu èmu na bhèni kana'an.

source_text: and the bnei levi: gershon, kohat, and merari.
target_text: lewi, dènge ana-ana na: gerson, kehat, dènge merari.

source_text: and the bnei yehudah: er, and onan, and shelah, and peretz, and zerach; but er and onan died in eretz kena'an. and the bnei peretz were chetzron and chamul.
target_text: yahuda, dènge ana-ana na: sela, peres, dènge sera. ana yahuda dhu leo, er dènge onan, madhe le ètu kana'an. na nèti dènge ana-ana peres, hesron dènge hamul.

source_text: and the bnei yissakhar: tola, and puvah, and yov, and shimron.
target_text: isaskar, dènge ana-ana na: tola, pua, ayub, dènge simron.

source_text: and the bnei zevulun: sered, elon, and yachle'el.
target_text: sebulon, dènge ana-ana na: seret, elon, dènge jahleel.

source_text: these are the bnei leah, which she bore unto ya'akov in paddan-aram, with his bat dinah; kol nefesh of his banim and his banot were thirty and three.
target_text: rèngu se'e, ana-ana nèti yakob dènge dhèu èmu na lea, lod'o rèngu pea ètu mesopotamia. ana bhèni rèngu èci, ngara na dina. ana-èpu nèti yakob dènge lea, aa'i-aa'i ra tèlu nguru tèlu dhèu.

source_text: and the bnei gad: tziphyon, chaggi, shuni, etzbon, eri, arodi, and areli.
target_text: aa yakob abhu ana-ana dènge dhèu èmu dhu leo hari. nuka: gad, dènge ana-ana na: sifion, hagi, suni, esbon, eri, arodi dènge areli.

source_text: and the bnei asher: yimnah, and yishvah, and yishvi, and beri'ah, and serach their achot; and the bnei beri'ah: chever, and malki'el.
target_text: aser, dènge ana-ana na: yimna, yiswa, yiswi, beria, dènge ana hèni ra èci, ngara na sera. beria, dènge ana le kahèi: heber dènge malkiel.

source_text: these are the bnei zilpah, whom lavan gave to leah his bat, and these she bore unto ya'akov, even sixteen nefesh.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, canguru èna dhèu. ana-èpu nèti yakob dènge dhèu èmu na silpa. silpa ne'e ka dhu laban hia j'aj'i ènu nèti lea, dhèu èmu uru yakob na.

source_text: the bnei rachel eshet ya'akov: yosef, and binyamin.
target_text: aa ana-ana nèti yakob dènge dhèu èmu na bhèni leo hari, ngara na rahel, nuka: yusuf dènge benyamin.

source_text: and unto yosef in eretz mitzrayim were born menasheh and ephrayim, which asenat bat poti phera kohen of on bore unto him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yusuf leo le dènge asnat ètu masir. ama asnat èèna, ama agama ètu kota on. ngara na, potifera. ana-ana yusuf dènge asnat: efraim dènge manase.

source_text: and the bnei binyamin were bela, and becher, and ashbel, gera, and na'aman, echi, and rosh, muppim, and chuppim, and ard.
target_text: benyamin madhutu hèi lasi masir dènge ana-ana na: bela, beker, asibel, gera, naaman, ehi, ros, mupim, hupim dènge aret.

source_text: these are the bnei rachel, which were born to ya'akov; kol nefesh were fourteen.
target_text: ana-èpu yakob dènge dhèu èmu na rahel, canguru èpa dhèu.

source_text: and the bnei dan: chushim.
target_text: dhèu èmu yakob èci hari, ngara na bilha. ana-ana ra, dan, dènge naftali. ana dan, ngara na husim.

source_text: and the bnei naphtali: yachtze'el, and guni, and yetzer, and shillem.
target_text: ana nèti naftali: yasel, guni, yeser dènge silem.

source_text: these are the bnei bilhah, which lavan gave unto rachel his bat, and she bore these unto ya'akov; kol nefesh were shivah.
target_text: yakob dènge dhèu èmu na bilha, ana-èpu rèngu dhèu pidhu. bilha ne, ènu nèti rahel, dhu na abhu nèti ama na laban.

source_text: kol hanefesh that came with ya'akov to mitzrayim, which came out of his loins, apart from the nashim of the bnei ya'akov, kol nefesh were threescore and six;
target_text: de ana-èpu yakob dhu lasi masir, aa'i-aa'i ra dhèu èna nguru èna dhèu. se'e se, ige mèka dènge dhèu èmu nèti ana-ana nèngu sèra.

source_text: and the bnei yosef, which were born to him in mitzrayim, were two nefesh; kol hanefesh of bais ya'akov, which came into mitzrayim, were shivim seventy.
target_text: ladhe tabha dènge ana-ana yusuf dhu ina na nara iisi ètu masir dhèu dua, na yakob dènge ana-èpu aa'i-aa'i ra si, pidhu nguru dhèu.

source_text: and he sent yehudah before him unto yosef, to direct his face unto goshen; and they came into eretz goshen.
target_text: ropa ra dètu dènge masir, yakob pua yahuda la'e uuru, paroa yusuf ho mai paraga dènge ne ètu gosen. ropa ra d'ai gosen,

source_text: and yosef made ready his merkavah, and went up to meet yisroel aviv, to goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a long time.
target_text: yusuf ca'e nare kareta na, mai paraga dènge ama na. ropa ra paraga, liku nare ama na, ka na tangi nèbhu bia.

source_text: and yisroel said unto yosef, now let me die, since i have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.
target_text: hèia yakob padhai lii dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! ja'a unu ku kèdhi le èu. aa ja'a ke'a le èu mamuri era. de ladhe ja'a madhe èèna ka oo, ngaa-ngaa tao heka.

source_text: and yosef said unto his achim, and unto bais aviv, i will go up, and speak to pharaoh, and say unto him, my achim and bais avi, which were in eretz kena'an, are come unto me;
target_text: ka yusuf peka dènge a'ari na aa'i-aa'i, peka na, ja'a laku peka ku dènge dhèu aae, sèna ka ne'a na a'ari ja'a mai le nèti kana'an.

source_text: and the anashim are roei tzon shepherds, keepers of livestock; and they have brought their tzon, and their bakar, and all that they have.
target_text: aa, pe ja'a peka kahèi dènge ne, miu biasa ani kahib'i-kalèbho dènge sapi. nèti èèna ka, miu mèti dènge badha-manu dènge mèdha-panyau miu nèti kana'an.

source_text: and it shall come to pass, when pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, what is ma'aseichem your occupation?
target_text: de ladhe dhèu aae paroa miu, ho na karèi miu biasa sab'a ngaa,

source_text: that ye shall say, thy avadim hath been keepers of livestock from our youth even until now, both we, and also avoteinu; that ye may dwell in eretz goshen; for every ro'eh tzon is a toevat mitzrayim.
target_text: na, miu dhaa ne peka na, miu se aa'i-aa'i mi nèti ana iiki ka mai piara badha, sama sèmi bèi-baki ji'i. sèna ka na pua miu pea ètu rai gosen. yusuf peka sèmi èèna, lula dhèu masir madenge pea pa'èci dènge ana madhutu badha.

source_text: then yosef came and told pharaoh, and said, avi and my achim, and their tzon, and their bakar, and all that they have, are come out of eretz kena'an; and they are now in eretz goshen. and he took some of his achim, even five anashim, and presented them unto pharaoh.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf dènge a'ari na dhèu lèmi, lasi paraga dènge dhèu aae. d'ai madha dhèu aae, ka yusuf patadha si dènge dhèu aae, ka na peka na, ama dhèu aae! ama ku dènge a'ari ku mai le nèti kana'an. rèngu mai dènge kahib'i-kalèbho, sapi, dènge mèdha-panyau aa'i-aa'i ra. nuka ra ètu rai gosen nèi.

source_text: and pharaoh said unto his achim, what is your occupation? and they said unto pharaoh, thy avadim are roeh tzon, both we, and also avoteinu.
target_text: dhèu aae karèi si, aku nèngu na, sasab'a miu ngaa? ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i se, ana madhutu badha, sama sèmi bèi-baki ji'i sèra.

source_text: they said moreover unto pharaoh, for to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy avadim have no mireh pasture for their tzon; for the ra'av famine is heavy in eretz kena'an; now therefore, let now thy avadim dwell in eretz goshen.
target_text: limuri ne'e, ètu rai ji'i kana'an, hèru hadhu madhera, ka nganga'a dènge j'u'u tèdhi heka. nèti èèna ka, ji'i mai taha asa kabarai ne'e. ngèti dènge badha-manu ji'i. de ji'i manèngi ama dhèu aae, ho hia ji'i pea ètu rai gosen, sèna ka ji'i piara badha ji'i ètu nèi.

source_text: and pharaoh spoke unto yosef, saying, avicha and acheicha are come unto thee;
target_text: hèia dhèu aae padhai lii dènge yusuf sèmi ne'e: ama mu dènge a'ari mu ètu ne'e le.

source_text: eretz mitzrayim is before thee; in the best of the land make avicha and acheicha to dwell; in eretz goshen let them dwell; and if thou knowest any anshei chayil among them, then make them sarei mikneh royal overseers of livestock of mine.
target_text: de hud'i laa rèngu tao kabarai ne'e, sama sèmi kabarai rèngu. madhutu kake'a ja'a, gosen èèna era dhu be'a risi nèti era leo ètu rai masir ne'e. de be'a risi rèngu pea ètu èèna ka la. aa ladhe rèngu cee dhu ladhe-leru badha dènge hua iia, na ja'a hia badha ja'a ho na piara si ètu èèna.

source_text: and yosef brought in ya'akov aviv, and set him before pharaoh; and ya'akov made on pharaoh a brocha.
target_text: èle èèna hèia, yusuf patadhe ama na dènge dhèu aae. ka yakob manèngi mi ama lamatua, sèna ka hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu aae.

source_text: and pharaoh said unto ya'akov, how old art thou?
target_text: dhèu aae karèi yakob, aku nèngu na, ama umur pèri tèu kèna?

source_text: and ya'akov said unto pharaoh, the days of the shanim of my pilgrimage are a hundred and thirty shanah; few and bad have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my avot in the days of their pilgrimage.
target_text: yakob dhaa, umur ja'a cangasu tèlu nguru tèu kèna, te ngaa ja'a pea boe mi ca era sa. bèi-baki ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe pakasame dènge rèngu, na umur ja'a kura nèti rèngu. te ngaa mamuri ja'a pènu dènge j'aj'èra.

source_text: and ya'akov made a brocha on pharaoh, and went out from the presence of pharaoh.
target_text: hèia yakob manèngi parmisi neo lèpa. te ngaa kalua mèka nèti d'ara èmu, na manèngi hari ca tèka mi lamatua ho sèna ka hia berkat mi dhèu aae.

source_text: and yosef settled aviv and his achim, and gave them an achuzzah possession in eretz mitzrayim, in the best of the land, in eretz ra'meses, just as pharaoh had commanded.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf pad'elo era pea hia a'ari na si ètu gosen, madhutu lii pua dhèu aae deo na. era èèna be'a titu kèna. ra pangare era èèna ‘rameses'. ka ama na dènge a'ari na sèra pea taruu ètu èèna.

source_text: and yosef provided for aviv, and his achim, and kol bais aviv, with lechem, according to the children.
target_text: hèia yusuf sadia nganga'a hia ama na, a'ari na, dènge ana dhèu èmu ra, aa'i-aa'i ra, nèti dhèu kapai toke d'ai ana susu.

source_text: and there was no lechem in kol ha'aretz; for the ra'av was very heavy, so that eretz mitzrayim and kol eretz kena'an fainted by reason of the ra'av famine.
target_text: taa èèna, rai manganga titu kèna, tèdhi boe nganga'a ca lamusi sa ètu mia-mia. nèti masir toke kana'an, dhèu-dhèu manganga roe ca palèpa, taga nèti ra'a-rinu heka. dhèu bisa heka sab'a ngaa-ngaa, lula manganga titu kèna.

source_text: and yosef gathered up all the kesef that was found in the eretz mitzrayim, and in eretz kena'an, for the shever grain which they bought; and yosef brought the kesef into bais pharaoh pharaohʼs palace.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu nèti d'ara rae-rae ètu masir, sèmi èèna kahèi dhèu-dhèu nèti d'ara rae-rae ètu kana'an, mai hèli nganga'a ètu yusuf. doi-doi dhu na sèmi sèra, na pakaboko aa'i ka, la'e tèke asa èmu dhèu aae.

source_text: and when kesef failed in eretz mitzrayim, and in eretz kena'an, kol mitzrayim came unto yosef, and said, give us lechem; for why should we die in thy presence? for the kesef is gone.
target_text: tèu èèna, èla aa'i doi dhèu masir dènge dhèu kana'an ka ra bisa heka hèli nganga'a. hèia ra mai roma iisi mi yusuf, aku rèngu na, ama wakil! hia ku ji'i nganga'a ciki la, sèna ka ji'i baku madhe manganga. te doi ji'i, èla aa'i mèu-mèu le.

source_text: and yosef said, give your mikneh; and i will give you for your mikneh, if kesef is gone.
target_text: hèia yusuf dhaa, peka na, ladhe tare'a doi miu aad'o heka, na sèmi ne'e ka la! mèti badha miu, ho pasilu dènge nganga'a.

source_text: and they brought their mikneh unto yosef; and yosef gave them lechem in exchange for susim, and for the tzon, and for the mikneh of the bakar, and for the chamorim; and he fed them lechem for all their mikneh for that year.
target_text: ka dhèu se'e mai pasilu badha ra dènge nganga'a. badha-badha sèmi jara, kahib'i-ka'ia, kahib'i-kalèbho, sapi, dènge keled'ei. lula tèu èèna, yusuf dhu moa tèke le.

source_text: when that year was ended, they came unto him the shanah hashenit, and said unto him, we will not hide it from adoni, how that our kesef is spent; adoni also hath our mikneh of behemah; there is not ought left in the sight of adoni, but geviyyatenu our bodies, and adematenu our lands;
target_text: tèu mai na, rèngu mai hari sa madha yusuf, ka ra peka, ama wakil, ee! ji'i peka tare'a-re'a kèna. doi ji'i dènge badha ji'i ama pasilu aa'i-aa'i le. limuri ne'e, ji'i dènge heka ngaa-ngaa. dhu ètu ji'i dhodhoka ngi'u dènge rai ji'i di.

source_text: why shall we die before thine eyes, both we and adematenu? buy us and adematenu for lechem, and we and adematenu will be avadim unto pharaoh; and give us zera, that we may live, and not die, that the adamah be not desolate.
target_text: baku tèke eele ji'i madhe manganga. te ladhe ji'i madhe na, cee ka dhu sab'a oka-tedhe se'e? de hua iia, ama wakil more ji'i, ho j'aj'i ènu mu. aa more aa'i rai ji'i kahèi. pe, èèna na, ama hia hini ho ji'i sèla hia ama. gaji dènge kab'ua rai ji'i, ama pasilu dènge nganga'a. sad'i ji'i baku madhe manganga.

source_text: and yosef bought kol admat mitzrayim for pharaoh; for the mitzrayim sold every ish his sadeh, because the ra'av famine was chazak over them; so the land became pharaohʼs.
target_text: lula rai manganga ae, ka dhèu masir pahie aa'i rai rèngu. nèti èèna ka, yusuf hèli nara aa'i rai ètu masir j'aj'i mi pusaka dhèu aae.

source_text: and as for the people, he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of mitzrayim even to the other end thereof.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, dhèu masir aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i ènu nèti dhèu aae.

source_text: only the admat hakohanim bought he not; for the kohanim had a chok assigned them of pharaoh, and did eat their chok which pharaoh gave them; therefore they sold not their lands.
target_text: dhoka rai unu ama agama sèra di, yusuf hèli nare boe, te dhèu aae hia taruu dhèu se nganga'a na. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se pahie boe rai rèngu.

source_text: then yosef said unto the people, see, i have bought you this day and your land for pharaoh: lo, here is zera for you, and ye shall sow the adamah.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yusuf peka dènge ana kabarai sèra, aku nèngu na, naa! miu j'aj'i le ènu nèti dhèu aae. ja'a hèli kore aa'i le, rai miu hia dhèu aae. de mere hini se'e ho lami sèla ka mi dedha rai sèra.

source_text: and it shall come to pass in the tevu'ot, that ye shall give the fifth part unto pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for zera of the sadeh, and for your ochel, and for them of your batim, and for food for your children.
target_text: ladhe miu puu-g'ètu na, bagi mi lèmi. ho ca pala hia dhèu aae. aa èpa pala sèra, miu tao hini dènge mi pake mi'a-minu dènge a'ari miu.

source_text: and they said, thou hast saved our lives; let us find chen grace, favor in the sight of adoni, and we will be avadim to pharaoh.
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama pamamuri ji'i le, de ji'i manèngi tarima kasi. ji'i neo j'aj'i ènu nèti dhèu aae.

source_text: and yosef made it a chok over eretz mitzrayim unto this day, that pharaoh should have the fifth part, except the admat hakohanim only, which became not pharaohʼs.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yusuf tao madha j'ara ne'e, j'aj'i ad'a kabarai ètu masir. ladhe ra puru rare are na, ra bagi mi lèmi pala. ho ca pala rèngu hia mi dhèu aae. aa èpa pala rèngu abhu. te ngaa rai ama agama sèra, dhèu aae hèli boe. ad'a èèna, ra pake taruu.

source_text: and yisroel settled in eretz mitzrayim, in eretz goshen; and they acquired property therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.
target_text: karèi nèti lod'o èèna, dhèu isra'el pea taruu ka ètu masir, ètu rai gosen. ra j'aj'i dhèu kaja, aa ana-èpu rèngu asa tabha ae.

source_text: and ya'akov lived in eretz mitzrayim seventeen shanah; so the whole age of ya'akov was a hundred forty and seven shanah.
target_text: ètu masir, yakob mamuri hari canguru pidhu tèu era. j'aj'i umur yakob aa'i-aa'i ra, cangasu èpa nguru pidhu tèu.

source_text: and the time drew near that yisroel must die; and he called bno yosef, and said unto him, if now i have found chen in thy sight, put, now, thy yad under my thigh, and do chesed and emes with me; bury me not, now, in mitzrayim;
target_text: lod'o dètu na madhe èèna, na paroa yusuf, ka na padhai lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, ana yusuf! ja'a rasa na, mamuri ja'a madhera heka. nèbhu heka, lamatua paroa ja'a lèpa kèna. èèna ka ja'a manèngi sèna ka ladhe èu sue ja'a, èu subha sèna ka baku padhane ja'a ètu rai masir ne'e.

source_text: but i will lie with my avot, and thou shalt carry me out of mitzrayim, and bury me in their kever. and he said, i will do as thou hast said.
target_text: èu hud'i mèti ngi'u aae ja'a, ho padhane asa era ro'a bèi-baki èdhi. ho èu padhane ja'a ètu èèna. ne'e ne, dad'èi d'ara ama. ka yusuf dhaa ne, aku nèngu na, be'a ama! ladhe dad'èi ama ku kèna, na ja'a madhutu.

source_text: and he said, swear unto me. and he swore unto him. and yisroel prostrated toward the rosh hamittah.
target_text: ka yakob padhai lii hari, peka na, de ladhe sèmi èèna, èu hud'i subha uuru ku, ho ke'a na èu madhutu dad'èi ama. hèia yusuf subha madhutu dad'èi yakob. ka yakob patitu kètu urutuu ètu dedha era j'unu na, ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: and it came to pass after these things, that one told yosef, hinei, avicha is choleh ill; and he took with him his two banim, menasheh and ephrayim.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu lasi peka dènge yusuf na, ama na pèd'a aae. hèia la'e nèti dènge ana na, efraim dènge manase, sèna ka lasi ladhe baki ra yakob.

source_text: and one told ya'akov, and said, hinei, the ben of thee yosef cometh unto thee; and yisroel strengthened himself, and sat up upon the mittah bed.
target_text: ropa yakob tadèngi yusuf si mai le, ka na pakaseti madhèdi.

source_text: and ya'akov said unto yosef, el shaddai appeared unto me at luz in eretz kena'an, and made on me a brocha,
target_text: hèia na padhai lii dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ana yusuf, ee! ama lamatua dhu dènge koasa kapai risi na, uru èèna, na pad'elo le iisi na dènge ja'a ètu rae lus, ètu rai kana'an. ètu nèi, na moa tèke mi ja'a.

source_text: and said unto me, hineni, i will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and i will make of thee a kehal of ammim; and will give haaretz hazot to thy zera after thee for an achuzzat olam everlasting possession.
target_text: na padhai lii, peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia ana-èpu èu j'aj'i ae, ho rèngu j'aj'i suku dhu kapai. rai ne'e ne, ja'a hia j'aj'i unu rèngu, ho j'aj'i pusaka ra toke d'ai rai-haha èle. '

source_text: and now thy two banim, ephrayim and menasheh, which were born unto thee in eretz mitzrayim before i came unto thee into mitzrayim, are mine; like reuven and shim'on, they shall be mine.
target_text: aa ana èu efraim dènge manase èèna, hak rèngu sèmi ne'e ka: lod'o dhu ja'a d'ai masir na, mere iisi le rèngu dua ra. masi ka sèmi èèna, ja'a tao rèngu sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a, sama sèmi ruben dènge simeon.

source_text: and thy moledet, which are born to thee after them, shall be thine, and shall be called after the shem of their achim in their nachalah.
target_text: aa ladhe bèli-camèd'a èu abhu hari ana, na èèna di unu èu kèna. ja'a tao boe rèngu sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a. pe pusaka ra, rèngu abhu nèti a'a ra, efraim dènge manase.

source_text: and as for me, when i came from paddan, rachel died by me in eretz kena'an in the way, when there was yet but a space of land to go unto ephratah; and i buried her there by the derech ephrat; the same is beit-lechem.
target_text: ja'a tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka èdhi sanèd'e ina mu rahel. lod'o ji'i mai nèti mesopotamia asa kana'an, d'ai talora j'ara, ina mu madhe ropa nara iisi aa'i. èèna na, ji'i dètu rae efrata ètu rai kana'an. lod'o èèna, ja'a susa d'ai seli. ka ja'a padhane ne ètu sebhe j'ara la'e asa rae efrata. limuri ne, rae èèna ra gati ngara na betlehem.

source_text: and yisroel beheld bnei yosef, and said, who are these?
target_text: ropa yakob padhai lii nare sèmi èèna hèia, na boti kètu na, ladhe nèdhi ana-ana yusuf ètu èèna. hèia na karèi yusuf, aku nèngu na, se'e se, ana cee?

source_text: and yosef said unto aviv, they are my banim, whom elohim hath given me in this place. and he said, bring them, now, unto me, and i will make upon them a brocha.
target_text: ka yusuf dhaa, se'e, ana dhu ama lamatua hia ja'a ètu masir. yakob peka hari, ladhe sèmi èèna, na hia ra mai padètu dènge ja'a, ho ja'a manèngi ama lamatua hia si mèngi-nale.

source_text: now the eyes of yisroel were dim from age, so that he could not see. and he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.
target_text: yakob heka le, aa musi madha na ahu le. na ladhe nèdhi be'a heka. hèia yusuf nèti ana na sèra padètu asa madha yakob, ka na liku nare si, aa na uu si dua ra.

source_text: and yisroel said unto yosef, i never expected to see thy face; and, hinei, elohim hath showed me also thy zera.
target_text: ka na peka dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a pangee na, ja'a bisa heka kèdhi rèhu èu. te ngaa ama lamatua, tao risi eele nèti ngaa dhu ja'a ngee, toke ja'a bisa kèdhi ana-ana èu kahèi.

source_text: and yosef brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the ground.
target_text: hèia yusuf hari eele ana na dhèu dua sèra nèti madha yakob, ka na patitu kètu urutuu na, aa na pacud'u rèhu na d'ai rai, ètu madha ama na.

source_text: and yosef took them both, ephrayim in his yamin toward smol yisroel, and menasheh on his smol toward yamin yisroel, and brought them near unto him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf kèd'i. na nare ana na dhèu dua sèra, ka na hia ra titu padètu-dètu dènge ama na. na patitu ana uuru na manase, re bèka g'ana yakob. aa ana ka dua, efraim, re bèka kariu yakob.

source_text: and yisroel stretched out his yamin, and laid it upon rosh ephrayim, who was the younger, and his smol upon rosh menasheh, guiding his hands intentionally; for menasheh was the bechor.
target_text: te ngaa ropa yakob soro ai na neo manèngi mèngi-nale hia ana dua sèra, na soro ai g'ana na mi kètu efraim, aa ai kariu mi kètu manase.

source_text: and he made on yosef a brocha, and said, haelohim, before whom my avot avraham and yitzchak did walk, haelohim who was roeh to me all my life long unto this day,
target_text: ka na manèngi ama lamatua hia berkat mi yusuf, peka na, baki mu isak, dènge ama na abraham, dua ra madhutu taruu dad'èi ama lamatua. ama lamatua ladhe-leru ja'a kahèi, nèti ana ngèru toke d'ai deo ne'e ne.

source_text: the malach which redeemed me from kol rah, may he make a brocha on the ne'arim, and let my shem be named on them, and the shem of my avot avraham and yitzchak; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of ha'aretz.
target_text: na pakaj'èu ja'a nèti rupa-rupa sasusa. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka na hia mèngi-nale mi ana èu se'e, dènge ana-èpu ra. aa ladhe ra manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, ra bhèlu boe ale kolongara baki abraham, kolongara isak, aa kolongara ja'a, sèna ka ana-èpu rèngu asa bèba-kacanga, ho j'aj'i kapai ètu rai-haha ne'e.

source_text: and when yosef saw that aviv laid his yamin upon the rosh ephrayim, it displeased him; and he took hold of yad aviv, to remove it from rosh ephrayim unto rosh menasheh.
target_text: te ngaa ropa yusuf ladhe nèdhi ama na tao ai g'ana na mi kètu efraim, hèia kèpe nare ai ama na, ho tao sa kètu a'a na manase.

source_text: and yosef said unto aviv, not so, avi; for this is the bechor; put thy yamin upon his rosh.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ama na, ama, ee! baku tao sèmi èèna. nèngu ne, ari efraim. nèngu ana limuri. de ai g'ana ama hud'i tao sa kètu a'a na manase. lula èèna hak ana uuru.

source_text: and aviv refused, and said, i know it, beni my son, i know it; he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great; but truly achiv hakaton shall be greater than he, and his zera shall become a multitude of goyim.
target_text: te ngaa ama na yakob d'èi boe. ka na peka na, ana, ee! ja'a ke'a. ladhe èèna na, manase j'aj'i èra, aa ana-èpu na tabha ae, ho j'aj'i suku kapai. te ngaa ari na efraim èèna, bèli-camèd'a kapai risi hari nèti nèngu. sèmi èèna kahèi ana-èpu na ae risi eele hari, ho ladhe èèna na, rèngu j'aj'i suku-suku dhu kapai aae.

source_text: and he made a brocha on them that day, saying, in thee shall yisroel bless, saying, elohim make thee like ephrayim and like menasheh; and he set ephrayim before menasheh.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ana se dua ra, ladhe dhèu isra'el manèngi ama lamatua ho hia mamèngi-nale mi dhèu, rèngu ale ngara miu dua mi hèi. ladhe èèna na, ra peka sèmi ne'e: ‘ji'i sanao sèna ka ama lamatua hia mamèngi-nale mi èu, sama sèmi na hia mi efraim dènge manase. source_text: then yehoshua comes from the galil to the yarden to yochanan, to submit to yochananʼs tevilah.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus puru mai nèti galilea, la'e asa loko yarden. na mai sèna ka manèngi yohanis sarani ne.

source_text: but yochanan would have deterred him, saying, i have need to submit to your tevilah, and yet you come to me?
target_text: te ngaa yohanis no'o boe. na pab'ala peka na, tasamia ka ja'a sarani èu? sale ne, sina ma? hud'i èu ku dhu sarani ja'a. te èèna ka dhu ja'a parluu!

source_text: but answering him, yehoshua said, permit it now, for thus it is proper to fulfill all tzidkat hashem.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, pangee ia ka. te ngaa doe ne'e, hud'i laa èu di dhu sarani ja'a. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, èdhi tao madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. ropa tadèngi nare, ka yohanis b'ala, aku nèngu na, sad'i aku èu hèia yohanis sarani yesus.

source_text: and having received the tevilah in the yardenʼs mikveh mayim, rebbe, melech hamoshiach immediately came up. and, hinei! the shomayim were opened to him, and he saw the ruach hakodesh of hashem descending like a yonah dove and coming upon him.
target_text: ropa sarani èle, ka yesus kalua nèti d'ara loko. cag'ag'a laa, liru bhoke eele. hèia ladhe nèdhi roh ama lamatua puru mai, nuka sèmi koro j'aha dhu mai tèka mi nèngu.

source_text: and, hinei, a bat kol a voice from heaven came out of shomayim, saying, zeh bni ahuvi asher bo chafatzti this is my son, the beloved, with whom i am well pleased.
target_text: hèia ra tadèngi lii ama lamatua nèti dedha-liru, peka na, nèngu ne, ana pasue ja'a. nèngu pakarej'e taruu d'ara ja'a.

source_text: then rebbe, melech hamoshiach was led up into the midbar by the ruach hakodesh of hashem to undergo nisyonos temptations by hasatan.
target_text: èle ka, roh ama lamatua nèti yesus asa d'ara mamoo, sèna ka dhèu aae nidhu sèku ne.

source_text: and, having undergone a tzom fast for arba'im yom varbaim lailah forty days and forty nights, afterward rebbe, melech hamoshiach was famished.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, yesus na'a-ninu boe èpa nguru lod'o mèu-mèda. hèia na manganga titu kèna.

source_text: and the tempter came to him and said to him, if you are the ben haelohim, then speak the command that these avanim stones become lechem bread.
target_text: ropa na manganga sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu aae nidhu mai sèku ne, peka na, èu ne tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, do? ladhe tare'a, na, paredha hadhu se, ho j'aj'i nganga'a.

source_text: but rebbe, melech hamoshiach answered, katuv it is written, lo al halechem lvadoh ycheyeh haadam, ki al kol motzah fi hashemman does not live on bread alone but on every word that comes from the mouth of hashem.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, na, dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na: ‘dhèu rai-haha mamuri mesa boe nèti nganga'a di. te ngaa rèngu hud'i nanene ku lii holo-nori ama lamatua, aa tao madhutu dad'èi na kahèi. '

source_text: then hasatan takes rebbe, melech hamoshiach to the ir hakodesh the holy city and sets him atop the pinnacle of the beis hamikdash,
target_text: ka dhèu aae nidhu nèti yesus asa kota yerusalem, kota lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna. èle ka, na nèti yesus asa era dhu dedha risi ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and says to rebbe, melech hamoshiach, if you are the ben haelohim, then throw yourself down, for katuv it is written, malachav ytzav-veh lach his angels he will command concerning you and upon their hands they will lift you up lest you strike your foot against a stone.
target_text: hèia nidhu ne, peka, ladhe èu ne tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, èu ridhu sèku asa haha nèi. te dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na, ‘pe ama lamatua pua ana pajuu nèti sorga, sèna ka j'aga èu. ' aa ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, dhu suri kahèi, ‘pe ra kanata ai ra, ho sibhe èu, sèna ka ngi'u èu pèd'a boe, aa haga èu goi lèke boe hadhu sa hèi. '

source_text: rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to hasatan, again, it is written, lo tenassu es hashem eloheichemdo not test hashem your g-d.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, abhu kahèi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, dhu peka na, ‘ama lamatua èèna, lamatua èu. de èu baku pua ne pake koasa na, sèna ka pad'elo bukti, peka na, nèngu èèna, tare'a-re'a ama lamatua. '

source_text: again, hasatan takes rebbe, melech hamoshiach to a very high mountain and shows him all the mamlechot kingdoms of the olam hazeh and the kavod glory of them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae nidhu ne nèti hari yesus asa kolo ledhe dhu dedha aae. hèia na pad'elo aa'i saraga dènge babe'a negara aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and hasatan said to rebbe, melech hamoshiach, all these things i will give to you, if you will fall down vtishtachaveh and you will bow down to me.
target_text: ropa na pad'elo nare, hèia dhèu aae nidhu ne peka, aku nèngu na, sad'i èu patitu kètu urutuu, sèna ka pahaha iisi mi ja'a, pe ja'a hia aa'i se'e se mi èu.

source_text: then rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to him, depart, hasatan! for katuv it is written, es hashem eloheicha tira voto taavodthe l-rd your g-d you shall fear and him you shall worship.
target_text: te ngaa yesus jèke ne, peka na, he, nidhu! pakaj'èu nèti era ne'e ne! te sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, suri na, ‘èu hud'i pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, aa èu ne hud'i sab'a ku dhoka hia nèngu di. '

source_text: then hasatan leaves him, and, hinei, malachim came and attended to rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae nidhu tadèngi lii ne, hèia na tèke eele yesus. te ngaa ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga mai uri ne.

source_text: now, having heard that yochanan was arrested, rebbe, melech hamoshiach departed into the galil.
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu aae herodes pamaso yohanis tuka sarani asa d'ara èmu bèdho. ropa yesus tadèngi, hèia na lèpa asa galilea.

source_text: and having left behind natzeret, rebbe, melech hamoshiach headquartered in k'far-nachum by the sea, in the environs of zevulun and naphtali.
target_text: la'e asa rae na nasaret, èle ka la'e taruu pea ètu rae kapernaum. rae èèna ètu sebhe dano galilea, ètu rai sebulon dènge naftali.

source_text: this was to fulfill what was spoken through yeshayah hanavi,
target_text: dènge j'ara ne, na tao madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya, suri tèke, peka na,

source_text: artzah zevulun vartzah naphtali to the land of zevulun and to the land of naphtali, the way to the sea beyond the yarden, galil hagoyim,
target_text: rai sebulon dènge rai naftali dhu padètu dènge dano galilea ètu sebhe haa loko yarden. dhèu yahudi boe pea ètu era sèra kahèi.

source_text: the people sitting in choshech rau ohr gadol darkness saw a great light, yoshvei v'eretz tzalmavet the ones living in the land of the shadow of death, a light has dawned among them.
target_text: rèngu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga, te ngaa limuri ne, rèdhi le saraa. aa saraa ne heo le palème mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadhe mèka ama lamatua.

source_text: from then rebbe, melech hamoshiach began to proclaim, saying, lalter liteshuvah immediate repentance, for the malchut hashomayim has come near.
target_text: karèi nèti lod'o èèna, yesus mulai aj'a-nori dhèu, peka na, miu hud'i soro kabodho aa tèke eele sasala-sasigo miu, ho mamuri ka dènge mola-mèci! te limuri ne dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa le j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: and walking beside sea of galilee lake kinneret, rebbe, melech hamoshiach saw two achim, shim'on, the one being called kefa petros, and his brother andrew, casting a net into the sea, for they were daiyagim fishermen.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus kako re sebhe dano galilea. na paraga dènge dhèu dua dhu pa'a'ari. èci ngara na simon, dhu tema paroa ne, petrus. aa ari na, anderias. dua ra dhu pèku i'a ètu dano galilea, lula dua ra dhèu sab'a dhasi.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach says, come, follow me, and i will make you daiyagei adam fishers of men.
target_text: hèia yesus paroa si, aku nèngu na, mai ku madhutu ja'a! miu biasa tenge i'a, te ngaa limuri ne ja'a neo aj'a miu ho j'aj'i tuka tenge dhèu.

source_text: and immediately, leaving their nets, they followed rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare, hèia dua ra tèke eele dènge ka pèku ra, lasi madhutu yesus.

source_text: and having gone on from there, he saw two other achim, ya'akov ben zavdai and yochanan his brother, in the sirah boat with zavdai their father, repairing their nets, and he summoned them.
target_text: èle ka, yesus kako hari ciki, hèia ladhe nèdhi ana sabadeus, dhèu dua. a'a, ngara na yakobis, aa ari na, yohanis. dua ra dhu lalau paie pèku ètu dedha koha sama-sama dènge ama ra. hèia yesus paroa dua ra, sèna ka madhutu ne.

source_text: immediately, leaving the sirah boat and their father, they followed rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare, hèia ra tèke eele ama dènge koha ra, lasi madhutu ne.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach went about in all the galil, exercising the ministry of moreh teacher in their shuls and of darshan preacher of the besuroh tovoh good tiding of a joyous event, the besuras hageulah the good news of redemption of the malchut hashem, and rebbe, melech hamoshiach went about bringing refuah healing to every disease and every illness of the people.
target_text: èle ka, yesus si kako palème propensi galilea, ho na aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a dhèu yahudi. na aj'a lii lolo be'a ama lamatua, aa na peka j'ara-j'ara tasamia, sèna ka dhèu bisa madhutu paredha ama lamatua. aa na puri-pa'èle kahèi dhèu nèti rupa-rupa papèd'a-tarègu.

source_text: and the report went out about rebbe, melech hamoshiach throughout all syria; and they brought to him all the cholim sick with various illnesses and machalot, demoniacs, epileptics, and paralytics; and rebbe, melech hamoshiach brought them refuah.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, tatao yesus ne dhèu lolo palème toke d'ai propensi siria aa'i-aa'i. hèia dhèu rèti dhèu ra dhu lèke rupa-rupa papèd'a asa yesus. dhèu se rèti kahèi dhèu dhu nidhu tao, dhu huj'u kahib'i, dènge dhu karuku. ka na puri-pa'èle aa'i si.

source_text: and from the galil, the decapolis, yerushalayim, yehudah, and ever-hayarden, from all these places great multitudes followed him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae-ae mai madhutu ne. dhèu se mai nèti propensi galilea, aa nèti rai canguru kota, dhu ra peka na, dekapolis. dhèu cahag'e mai nèti kota yerusalem, nèti propensi yudea, aa nèti cabèka dhimu loko yarden.

source_text: when rebbe, melech hamoshiach saw the multitudes, he alah haharwent up the mountain and when he sat down, his talmidim came to him.
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe nèdhi dhèu ae-ae mai madhutu ne, hèia na ca'e la'e asa ledhe iiki cue, ka na madhèdi ètu èèna. ana-ana madhutu dhu na hag'e nare sèra, mai padètu sèna ka nanene ne.

source_text: then rebbe, melech hamoshiach began to speak, and gave them this torah teaching, saying,
target_text: hèia na aj'a-nori si, peka na,

source_text: ashrey aniyei haruachblessed, happy are the poor in spirit for theirs is the malchut hashomayim.
target_text: dhèu kasia, rèngu oto, lula ama lamatua mesa na, ka dhèu aae rèngu dhu hua iia.

source_text: ashrey are the avelimthe ones mourning, for they will be comforted.
target_text: dhèu dhu ètu d'ara sasusa, rèngu oto, lula ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu pamaho'o d'ara si.

source_text: ashrey are the anavimhumble, for yireshu aretzthey will inherit the land.
target_text: dhèu haha oto, lula rèngu ka dhu bèli-camèd'a sèmi rare mèngi-nale aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua moa tèke.

source_text: ashrey are the ones hungering and thirsting for tzidkat hashemtzedek olamim, everlasting righteousness, for they will be satisfied.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'ara kateme dènge ama lamatua, rèngu oto, lula èèna na, nèngu ka dhu hia si ngaa dhu ra neo.

source_text: ashrey are the merciful, for they will be shown rachamim mercy.
target_text: dhèu dhu pad'elo rasa kasia mi dhèu leo, rèngu oto, lula èèna na, ama lamatua kasia rèngu kahèi.

source_text: ashrey are those of lev tahorpure heart, for they will see hashem.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'ara mola-mèci, rèngu oto, lula èèna na, rèngu unu ra ladhe rèdhi ama lamatua.

source_text: ashrey are the peace-makers, for they will be called bnei haelohim sons of g-d.
target_text: dhèu dhu tema padame dhèu, rèngu oto, lula èèna na ama lamatua ka dhu peka na, ‘rèngu se'e ka, ana ja'a. '

source_text: ashrey are the ones being persecuted because of tzidkat hashemrighteousness of hashem, for theirs is the malchut hashomayim.
target_text: dhèu dhu pasae j'aj'èra, lula ra madhutu ama lamatua, rèngu oto, lula lamatua mesa na ka, dhèu aae rèngu dhu hua iia.

source_text: ashrey are you when they reproach you and persecute you and speak all kinds of lashon horah against you, speaking sheker falsehood, lies because of me.
target_text: ladhe dhèu leo paj'èra miu, lula miu madhutu ja'a, miu oto kahèi. ladhe dhèu padhai kaked'u miu, aa lole pa'ele iie kolongara miu, miu oto kahèi.

source_text: have simcha joy and lev sameach glad heart, for your sachar reward is great in shomayim, for thus they persecuted the neviim before you.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu hud'i pakasee iisi aa pakarej'e d'ara, lula ama lamatua dhu sadia nare le pala dhu ae hia miu ètu sorga. te ngaa sanèd'e! mesa boe miu di dhu dui j'aj'èra sèmi èèna, te lod'o uru sèra dhèu dhu paj'èra le kahèi dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: you are the melach haaretz salt of the earth, but if the salt becomes tasteless, in what way will it become salty again? it is no longer good for anything, but is thrown out and trampled by men.
target_text: ladhe èdhi d'èi sèna ka nganga'a j'aj'i be'a, na, èdhi tao ku masi. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha ne, rèngu parluu miu. te ngaa ladhe masi sèro heka, gaguna na, ngaa? dhoka core eele di ètu j'ara, ho dhèu j'èli ne.

source_text: you are the ohr haolam the light of the world. a city lying on a mountaintop cannot be nistar hidden.
target_text: miu hud'i mamuri ku sèmi labhu kahèi, sèna ka dhèu ae bisa ladhe rèdhi miu dènge be'a. miu hud'i heo lo'a-lo'a ku, nuka sèmi kota ètu kolo ledhe, dhu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi ne.

source_text: no one, after lighting a menorah, places it under a measuring basket, but on the shulchan table, and it gives ohr light to kol anshei habais all in the house.
target_text: ladhe dhèu paheo labhu iiki, ra saguru boe ne dènge èru rai, te ngaa ra padhèdi labhu ne ètu era dedha, ho pasaraa aa'i d'ara èmu.

source_text: in like manner, let your light so shine before bnei adam, that they may see your ma'asim tovim good works and give kavod glory to your av sh'ba'shomayim father in heaven.
target_text: miu hud'i mamuri ku sèmi èèna. mamuri miu hud'i saraa ku, sèna ka dhèu leo ladhe rèdhi mamuri miu dhu be'a. ropa dhèu ladhe rèdhi mamuri miu sèmi èèna, ra ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua, peka na, ‘ira ii! ama miu ètu sorga, kapai titu kèna, nga! '

source_text: do not think that i came to abolish the torah or the neviim. i did not come to abolish but to complete.
target_text: mage miu pangee na, mamai ja'a asa rai-haha ne, sèna ka tao eele atora ama lamatua dhu pangèd'u mi musa. aa baku pangee na, ja'a pusi-pahae boe dènge ngaa dhu uru èèna, dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua peka tèke le. te mamai ja'a ne, sèna ka pamèci j'ara aa'i-aa'i, nuka sèmi mia dhu ra peka tèke.

source_text: for, omein, truly i say to you, until shomayim and haaretz pass away, not one yod, not one tag ornamental flourish, will pass from the torah until everything is accomplished.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, nanene paie-iie! liru dènge rai-haha bisa mèka laho aa'i, ladhe aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i mèka madhutu atora ama lamatua. masi ka ca katèd'a èèna ka, bisa boe ele nèti atora se.

source_text: therefore, whoever annuls one of the least of these mitzvot divine commandments given by hashemto moshe rabbenu and so teaches bnei adam, shall be called katon least in the malchut hashomayim; but whoever practices and teaches them, this one will be called gadol great in the malchut hashomayim.
target_text: nèti dhèu unu ama lamatua aa'i-aa'i, ladhe abhu dhu sisu atora ama lamatua, lula na pangee, na, ‘atora ne, ana iiki-iiki di, de gaguna na aad'o! ' hèia na aj'a sèmi èèna kahèi mi dhèu leo, pe ama lamatua ètu sorga, tao ne j'aj'i mi ca dhèu ana iiki. te ngaa bagi mi dhèu dhu tao madhutu aa'i atora ama lamatua, hèia na aj'a-nori dhèu leo sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua pakab'ua ne.

source_text: for i say unto you that unless the tzedek righteousness of you exceeds that of the sofrim and perushim, you will certainly not enter the malchut hashomayim.
target_text: parcaya la ja'a! miu hud'i mamuri mola, risi nèti mese agama dènge dhèu partei agama parisi sèra. ladhe aad'o, na, miu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: you have heard that it was said to the ancients, lo tirtzachdo not murder, and every rotzeach murderer shall be liable before the bet din court.
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa dhu hia mi bèi-baki èdhi, peka na, ‘baku pamadhe dhèu, te dhèu cee dhu pamadhe dhèu nèngu lèke huku. '

source_text: but i say to you, that everyone who harbors kaas anger against his ach, his chaver, shall be subject to mishpat judgment; and whoever shall say to his ach, reyka! good for nothing! will be subject to the sanhedrin; and whoever shall say shoteh! fool shall be subject to eish gehinnom fire of hell.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: baku panasa, te dhèu cee dhu nasa dènge a'ari na, èèna na nèngu lèke huku. dhèu dhu jèke a'ari na, ka peka na, ‘èu bod'o kabao! ' pe nèngu la'e dhaa asa dhèu heka-dhèu heka agama. aa dhèu cee dhu jèke a'ari na, ‘goa, ee! ' nèngu lèke huku ètu ai naraka.

source_text: therefore, if you bring your korban sacrifice to the mizbeach altar, and there you remember that your ach has something against you,
target_text: de ladhe èu dhu mèti mèdha persembahan hia ama lamatua, te ngaa èu sanèd'e, na, abhu a'ari dhu nasa era dènge èu,

source_text: leave your korban there before the mizbeach, and go and first be reconciled to your ach; and then come offer your korban.
target_text: tèke eele uuru ku mèdha persembahan sèra. hèia lamu padame ku dènge a'ari mu, èle, na heka mai hia persembahan se asa ama lamatua kèna.

source_text: come to terms quickly with your ish riv opponent in a lawsuit, while you are a fellow-traveler on the derech eretz, lest the ish riv might deliver you to the shofet judge, and the shofet might deliver you to the shoter law official, and the shoter might deliver you to the beit hasohar prison house.
target_text: ladhe ca dhèu neo tao lii langu dènge èu, be'a risi lamu lai-lai ho padame dènge ne. ladhe aad'o, dhèu ne nèti èu asa hakim. hèia hakim saraka èu sa polisi, ka ra pamaso èu asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: for, omein, truly i say to you, you may never come out from there until you repay the last peruta small coin.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e tare'a-re'a mi èu ne! èèna na èu pea taruu ètu d'ara bèdho, toke b'ae aa'i mèu-mèu kèlu-g'ètu èu sèra.

source_text: you have heard that it was said, lo tinafdo not commit adultery.
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa, dhu peka na, ‘baku bersina. '

source_text: but i say to you that everyone looking upon a woman with taavah lust for her has already committed niuf adultery with her in his heart.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a neo peka na, sèmi ne'e: dhèu dhu ladhe nèdhi dhèu bhèni èci, hèia d'ara na neo j'unu pa'èci dènge ne, na, dhèu mone ne bersina le dènge bhèni ne ètu d'ara na.

source_text: and if your right eye causes you to commit chet sin, tear it out and throw it from you, for it is better for you that one of your evarim members be lost and not your whole basar body, flesh be thrown into gehinnom.
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala pake musi madha g'ana èu, na, ed'o eele ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge musi madha cabèka di, aa baku ra pèci mu asa d'ara ai naraka dènge musi madha dua-dua.

source_text: and if your right hand causes you to commit chet, cut it off and throw it from you, for it is better for you that one of your evarim members be lost and not that your whole basar may go into gehinnom.
target_text: aa ladhe èu tao sala dènge kacui-aai g'ana èu, poro eele kacui-aai ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge kacui-aai cabèka di, aa baku ra pèci mu asa d'ara ai naraka dènge kacui-aai dhu kateme iisi.

source_text: it was also said, whoever divorces his wife, let him give to her a get, a sefer keritutbill of divorce.
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa, na, ‘dhèu dhu pa'ia dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na, nèngu hud'i hia ku sasuri pa'ia mi bhèni èèna. '

source_text: but i say to you that everyone divorcing his wife, except for the dvarindecent thing of zenut fornication, makes her become a noefet adulteress, and whoever marries a gerusha divorcee commits niuf adultery.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka sèmi ne'e: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu ia eele dhèu èmu na, te ngaa bhèni ne tao nèdhi boe j'ara makae, hèia bhèni ne leo hari èmu, na, dhèu èmu uuru èèna ka dhu tao nèngu j'aj'i bersina. aa ladhe abhu dhèu mone dhu leo nare bhèni dhu dhèu èmu na ia eele, na, rèngu dua ra bersina kahèi.

source_text: again, you have heard that it was said to the ancients, you shall not break your nederim vows, but you shall repay your vows to hashem.
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa dhu na hia mi bèi-baki èdhi, peka na, ‘ladhe èu pajaji pake lii soo-subha, dhu ale kolongara ama lamatua, na, èu dhu pa'èki le dènge soo-subha èèna. '

source_text: but i say to you, do not swear shevuot oaths at all, neither by shomayim, for it is the kes malchut of hashemthrone of g-d,
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka sèmi ne'e: ladhe èu neo pajaji, na, mage mu j'oka subha. baku subha dènge ngara sorga, lula sorga èèna era pea ama lamatua.

source_text: nor by haaretz, for it is the hadom footstool of his feet, nor by yerushalayim, for it is the kiryat melech ravcity of the great king.
target_text: mage subha pake ngara rai-haha, lula rai-haha ne, era bane haga ama lamatua. aa mage subha pake ngara yerusalem, lula yerusalem èèna, kota nèti dhèu aae kapai.

source_text: neither are you to swear by your rosh, for you are not able to make one hair turn white or black.
target_text: baku subha pake ngara kab'a kètu miu. te miu dènge boe koasa ho paredha rèu kètu miu, sèna ka ca loa sa j'aj'i mèdhi do j'aj'i pudhi.

source_text: but let your word be ken, ken yes, yes or lo, lo no, no, but anything beyond this is lashon horah.
target_text: de ladhe miu neo pajaji, dhu peka oo, na, peka la ‘oo' di. te ngaa ladhe aad'o, na, peka la, ‘aad'o' di. ladhe miu peka risi nèti èèna, sèra sa j'aj'aj'i nèti nidhu.

source_text: you have heard that it was said, ayin takhat ayin, shen takhat shenan eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa, dhu peka na, ‘ladhe dhèu cee dhu pa'ele iie musi madha miu, na, pa'ele iie kahèi musi madha na. aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pakabhui eele ngutu èu, na, pakabhui eele ngutu na kahèi. '

source_text: but i say to you, do not set yourself against the rasha evil person, but whoever hits you on your right cheek, turn to him also the other cheek.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: baku b'ala bhabhelu dènge bhabhelu. ladhe dhèu tèb'e ripi èu cabèka, na hud'i laa, na tèb'e hari ripi dhu leo.

source_text: and the one wishing to sue you and take your tunic, give to him also your kaftan.
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo tenge lii langu dènge èu, ho neo nare kodho èu, na, hia ne kodho pana èu kahèi.

source_text: and whoever will force you to go one mile, go with him two.
target_text: ladhe sordad'u ca dhèu laka-seti èu ho pasae mèdha na kako d'ai ca kilometer, na, èu pasae mèti kaj'èu na toke dua kilometer.

source_text: and the one asking you to give and the one wishing to borrow from you, from these do not turn away.
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo manèngi nare mèdha èu èci, na, hia la. aa ladhe dhèu neo pija mèdha èu, na, hia la.

source_text: you have heard that it was said, v'ahavta l'reachayou shall love your neighbor, and you shall hate your oyev enemy.
target_text: miu tadèngi le, dhu peka na, ‘sue la a'ari èu, aa nasa la dènge dhèu dhu nasa dènge èu. '

source_text: but i say to you, love your enemies, and offer tefillos prayers for the ones bringing redifah persecution upon you.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka sèmi ne'e: èu hud'i sue ku dhèu dhu nasa dènge èu, aa manèngi ho lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu dhu paj'èra èu.

source_text: do this so that you may become banim of your av sh'ba'shomayim, for his shemesh sun he makes to rise on the ra'im evil ones and the tovim good ones, and he sends his geshem rain upon the tzaddikim righteous ones and the resha'im unrighteous ones.
target_text: ladhe èu tao sèmi èèna, èu pad'elo, na, èu ana ama ètu sorga. lula nèngu ka tao madha lod'o hia dhèu dhu be'a, dènge dhèu dhu bhelu. na papuru èj'i hia dhèu dhu tao madhutu paredha na, aa mi dhèu dhu lab'a paredha na kahèi.

source_text: for if you have ahavah love for the ones who have ahavah for you, what sachar reward do you have? even the mochesim tax collectors do that, don't they?
target_text: de ladhe èu sue dhoka dhèu dhu sue èu, èu ngee na ama lamatua hud'i b'ala hia èu mèngi-nale, do? aad'o! te dhèu bhelu kahèi ne'a sue angalai na, dhu sue nèngu.

source_text: and if you give drishat shalom greetings only to your achim, what extraordinary thing are you doing? don't even the goyim do the same?
target_text: de ladhe èu me'a dhoka hia lii maho'o mi angalai èu, na, kolo-karisi na ngaa? te dhèu dhu parcaya boe ama lamatua, re'a ad'u-ue j'ara sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: therefore, be shlemim complete, even as is your av sh'ba'shomayim.
target_text: de sanèd'e, ee! ama mu ètu sorga sue dhèu aa'i-aa'i. de èu hud'i tao madhutu ku sèmi èèna kahèi!

source_text: be careful that you don't practice your tzedakah charity giving before bnei adam in order to varf show off, flaunt to be seen by bnei adam; for then you have no sachar reward with your av sh'ba'shomayim.
target_text: yesus aj'a taruu, peka na, sanèd'e! mage mi madhutu atora agama di, sèna ka dhèu pad'iri miu. te ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, ama miu ètu sorga b'ala boe rui-j'aj'èra miu.

source_text: therefore, whenever you contribute tzedakah, don't blow the shofar before you, as the tzevuim hypocrites do in the shuls and in the streets, in order that they may receive kavod glory from bnei adam. omein, truly i say to you, they have their sachar reward.
target_text: ladhe miu neo soru-bara dhèu kasia, mage lami palolo asa mia-mia. te ladhe miu se tao sèmi èèna, miu ca ropa dènge dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo. dhèu sèmi sèra, d'èi lasi karihu asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a ho dhèu koa si, peka na, ‘ira ii! dhèu ne maj'èni madhutu atora agama, nga! ' ja'a peka mola-mola kèna! dhèu dhu tema sèmi rare lii koa-kad'iri nèti dhèu, rèngu se abhu le pala ra.

source_text: but when you contribute tzedakah, do not let your left hand have da'as knowledge of what your right hand is doing,
target_text: de ladhe miu neo soru-bara dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, mage mi palolo kahèi!

source_text: so that your tzedakah may be nistar hidden, in secret, and your av haroeh b'seter father, the one seeing in secret sachar reward will give you.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu ètu rai-haha ne re'a boe. te ngaa ama miu ètu sorga dhu ne'a ngaa dhu miu tao pahuni. pe nèngu ka dhu b'ala hia miu berkat ae-ae.

source_text: and whenever you daven pray, do not be as the tzevuim hypocrites; for they love to stand and daven in the shuls and on the street corners so that they may be seen by an audience. omein, truly i say to you, they have their sachar.
target_text: lod'o miu sabaj'a, miu baku tao nuka sèmi dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo. dhèu se d'èi lasi asa j'ara dhu dhèu ae-ae, aa titu ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ho dhèu koa-kad'iri si, peka na, ‘dhèu se, dhèu mola-mèci! ' te ngaa nanene pabe'a-be'a! dènge rèngu abhu koa sèmi èèna, rèngu sèmi rare le pala ra.

source_text: but you, whenever you daven, enter into the secret place, your secret cheder, and, having shut your door, offer tefillos to your av asher b'seter father who is in secret, and your av haroeh b'seter father, the one seeing in secret sachar will give you.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku sèmi èèna. ladhe miu manèngi-mangaj'i, lami asa d'ara kama ho bèdho babèdho na. èle èèna, heka mi sabaj'a mau-mau hia ama mi ètu sorga. masi ka dhèu leo rèdhi boe, te ngaa ama miu ladhe nèdhi. bèli-camèd'a na b'ala hia miu berkat ae-ae.

source_text: but when you daven, do not babble on and on maarich extended, long winded and vacuously and without kavvanah heartfelt direction, intention like the goyim. for the goyim think that in their verbosity their techinnah will be heard.
target_text: ladhe miu sabaj'a, baku padhai lii dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. te dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua sabaj'a sèmi èèna ka. rèngu pangee, na, ama lamatua d'èi nanene lii manèngi ra dhu madhera lola-lola èèna.

source_text: therefore, nisht azoi not so! be different, for your av has daas knowledge of what things you have need before you ask him.
target_text: mage mi madhutu j'ara rèngu sèra! te masi ka miu dhae manèngi mèka ngaa-ngaa nèti ama mi ètu sorga, te ngaa nèngu dhu ne'a mema le, ngaa dhu miu parluu.

source_text: therefore, when you offer tefillos, daven like this, in this manner: avinu sh'ba'shomayim our father in heaven, yitkadash shmecha hallowed be your name.
target_text: de ladhe sabaj'a, na, madhutu la conto sèmi ne'e: ‘ama ètu sorga! kolongara ama dhu mola-mèci. hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i, ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama dhu kapai èèna.

source_text: tavo malchutechah thy kingdom come ye'aseh rtzonechah thy will be done kmoh vashomayim ken ba'aretz on earth as it is in heaven.
target_text: hud'i laa ama j'aj'i dhèu aae mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i! hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i, tao madhutu paredha ama ètu rai-haha ne, nuka sèmi ana pajuu ama, tao madhutu paredha ama ètu sorga.

source_text: es lechem chukeinu ten lanu hayom give us today our daily bread,
target_text: ama, hia la ji'i nganga'a-nganginu dhu d'ai bèli-bèli.

source_text: u-slach lanu es chovoteinu kaasher salachnu and forgive us our debts as we forgive gam anachnu lachayaveinu also our debtors.
target_text: ji'i manèngi, ho ama saku eele aa'i sasala-sasigo ji'i, nuka sèmi ji'i kahèi pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu dhu ra tao mi ji'i.

source_text: v'al tvi'einu lidey nisayon and lead us not into temptation, ki im chaltzeinu min harah but deliver us from evil.
target_text: ama, j'aga la ji'i, sèna ka ji'i baku tao bhabhelu. aa pakaj'èu la ji'i nèti koasa nidhu, te ama ka dhèu aae dhu koasa kapai risi eele. aa ama ka dhu mèd'u paredha, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e. sabaj'a ji'i d'ai sange ne'e ka, ama. amin. '

source_text: for if you give men mechila pardon, forgiveness for their chattaim sins, so also your av sh'ba'shomayim will give selicha forgiveness to you.
target_text: te ngaa sanèd'e, ee! ladhe miu pabhèlu eele sasala dhu dhèu tao mi miu, èèna na ama mi ètu sorga saku eele sasala-sasigo miu kahèi.

source_text: but if you do not give men mechila forgiveness, neither will your chattaim receive selicha from your av.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu mo'o boe pabhèlu eele sasala dhu dhèu tao mi miu, bèli-camèd'a ama mi bhèlu boe sasala miu kahèi.

source_text: and whenever you undergo a tzom fast, don't be like the sullen tzevuim hypocrites, for they disfigure their faces to parade their tzom fast. omein, truly i say to you, they have received their sachar reward.
target_text: ladhe miu manèngi-mangaj'i aa puasa, mage mi tao rèhu susa, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo. te ra ad'u-ue j'ara èèna, ho dhèu pad'iri si, peka na, ‘dhèu se'e se, dhèu mola-mèci! ' te ngaa sanèd'e, ee! dènge sèmi rare koa-kad'iri sèmi èèna, na, rèngu abhu le pala ra.

source_text: but when you undergo a tzom, anoint your rosh with shemen and wash your face,
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu puasa, lèu pamèu-mèu rèhu mi, aa sageri paie kètu miu!

source_text: so that your tzom is concealed from bnei adam but not from your av asher b'seter father who is in secret. and your av haroeh b'seter father the one seeing in secret will give you sachar.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu rèdhi miu, re'a boe na, miu dhu puasa. te ngaa ama miu ne'a. pe na pala hia miu mèngi-nale ae-ae.

source_text: do not store up for yourselves otzarot treasures on haaretz, where moth and rust destroy and where ganavim thieves break in and steal.
target_text: miu baku sab'a taruu, ho dhodhoka pakaboko mèdha-panyau ae-ae ètu rai-haha ne di. te hub'u dènge rutu pa'ele iie aa'i si. aa dhèu mana'u mai pa'ele iie era tatèka mèdha-panyau, aa mana'u rèti si.

source_text: but zahmlet aich collect for yourselves otzarot treasures in shomayim, where neither moth nor rust destroys; neither do ganavim break in and steal.
target_text: te ngaa be'a risi miu maj'èni sab'a, sèna ka pakaboko mèdha-panyau ae-ae ètu sorga. te ètu era nèi, abhu boe hub'u dènge rutu dhu pa'ele iie si, aa abhu boe dhèu mana'u, ho mai mana'u rèti.

source_text: for where your otzar is, there also will be your lev.
target_text: te ladhe miu tèka mèdha-panyau miu ètu era mia, na, tatu d'ara miu ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: the eye is the menorah of the basar. therefore, if your eye is unblurred, then your whole basar will be lighted.
target_text: musi madha dhèu, nuka sèmi labhu dhu pasaraa d'ara ra. ladhe musi madha na mèu, nèngu madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu hua iia, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu kako ètu d'ara saraa.

source_text: but if yours is the ayin horo, your kol basar is choshech; if ohr choshech, great choshech!
target_text: te ngaa ladhe musi madha na ahu, nèngu bisa boe kako madhutu madha j'ara mola, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu gogo ai lae-lae ètu d'ara maroga. de ladhe saraa ètu d'ara miu j'aj'i maroga, na miu mamuri d'ara maroga kahèi.

source_text: no one is able to serve two adonim masters. for either he will have sinah hatred for the one and ahavah love for the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. you cannot serve hashem and mammon money.
target_text: dhèu bisa boe sab'a hia dua lamatua, lula èèna na nèngu d'èi risi ca dhèu di. bisa kahèi nèngu madhutu lamatua èci, aa pusi-pahae boe dhu leo. nèti èèna ka, èu bisa boe peka na, ‘ama lamatua èèna, lamatua ja'a, ' ladhe èu tao doi-dhari j'aj'i mi lamatua èu.

source_text: therefore, i say to you, do not have a lev rogezanxious heart about your life, what you might wear or what you might drink, nor for your basar, what you might put on. is not life more than okhel food and basar more than malbush clothing?
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: baku bhute pangee, na, ja'a mamuri tasa mera mia, ku'a-kinu ngaa, pake ngaa? miu pangee na, mamuri ne dhoka ta'a-tinu, di? aa ngi'u ne, dhoka pake mèdha-papake, di? aad'o sèmi èèna.

source_text: look to the oph hashomayimbirds of heaven, for they do not sow nor reap nor gather into storehouses, and your av sh'ba'shomayim feeds them. are you yourselves not worth more than they?
target_text: ladhe ku manu-bhui dhu lela ètu talora liru. rèngu bhute rèdhi boe sèla hini, dènge puu-g'ètu, ho tèka nganga'a ètu d'ara soka. te ngaa ama miu ètu sorga piara manu-bhui sèra taruu. tatu nèngu kab'oi miu risi eele nèti rèngu. de ngee pabe'a-be'a. te ama lamatua pakab'ua miu risi nèti manu-bhui sèra.

source_text: and who among you by a lev rogez is able to add to his life span one cubit?
target_text: ladhe dhèu titu ètu madha tèru, ho na bhute dènge lalau ngi'u na, nèngu bisa pamadhera hari ngi'u na, do? bisa boe!

source_text: and why have a lev rogez anxious heart about malbush clothing? observe the lilies of the field, how they grow. they do not labor nor spin.
target_text: ladhe bisa boe, na, nga tao ka miu bhute dènge pangee hari mèdha-papake? lami ladhe ku hela bunga dhu muri tab'a ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a. rèngu manyèru boe hèngu, aa manènu boe sig'i sa hèi.

source_text: but i say to you that not even sh'lomo hamelech in all his kavod glory was clothed as one of these.
target_text: te ngaa sanèd'e ku la! mèdha-papake dhèu aae soleman dhu kab'ua risi, saraga na bisa boe segi saraga hela bunga ne.

source_text: and if hashem thus clothes the grass of the field that exists today and tomorrow is thrown into a furnace, how much more will he clothe you, you ones of little emunah?
target_text: te ama lamatua taru kira mi bunga dhu muri dhoka doe ne'e, aa bèli madhe, ho dhèu core asa d'ara ai. ladhe na tao sèmi èèna, tatu nèngu papake miu risi eele nèti hela bunga sèra. de tasamia ka miu parcaya pa'èra boe mi nèngu?

source_text: therefore, do not have a lev rogez, saying, what might we eat? or what might we drink? or with what might we clothe ourselves?
target_text: de baku mi pangee na, ‘ji'i neo nga'a ngaa? ' do, ‘neo nginu ngaa? ' do, ‘neo pake ngaa? '

source_text: for all these things the goyim strive. for your av sh'ba'shomayim bavorn anticipates that you need all these things.
target_text: dhèu dhu parcaya boe ama lamatua, rèngu sab'a loe boe ho neo abhu aa'i-aa'i se. te ngaa miu baku tao sèmi èèna, te ama miu ètu sorga dhu ne'a aa'i le, ngaa-ngaa dhu miu parluu.

source_text: but seek first the malchut hashem and the tzidkat hashem, and all these things will be added to you.
target_text: te ngaa miu hud'i pakako uuru ku sasab'a na, aa hud'i madhutu ku paredha na, heka na hia miu aa'i-aa'i dhu miu parluu.

source_text: therefore, do not have a lev rogez for tomorrow, for makhar tomorrow will care for itself. each day has enough tzoros of its own.
target_text: de baku bhute pangee, na, bèli miu parluu ngaa. te bèli èèna dènge bhabhute unu na. sasusa lod'o doe ne'e, èle ètu doe ne'e kahèi.

source_text: judge not lest you be judged.
target_text: miu baku galaa dhèu, sèna ka ama lamatua baku pasala miu kahèi.

source_text: for with what gezar din verdict you judge, you will be judged, and with what measure you measure, it will be measured to you.
target_text: ladhe miu nile dhèu sèmi mia, pe ama lamatua nile miu sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe miu ige sasala dhèu sèmi mia, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua ige sasala miu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: and why do you see the speck in the eye of your ach, but you do not consider the beam in your own eye.
target_text: masi ka sasala dhèu ciki oo'e èèna ka, èu bhèlu boe. te ngaa sasala èu dhu kapai, èu pame'a boe ciki sa. èci èèna ka dènge èu ladhe mèdhi ahu ca katèd'a ètu d'ara madha angalai èu, te ngaa abhu agarii aae ca laa dhu pa'abhe nare musi madha èu, dhu èu me'a more boe.

source_text: or how will you say to your ach, let me take the speck out from your eye! and, hinei! the beam is in your own eye!
target_text: nga tao ka èu bani peka na, ‘angalai! mai ho ja'a tiu eele ahu nèti d'ara madha èu'. aa te ngaa èu mesa mu bisa boe mèdhi ngaa-ngaa, lula agarii aae dhu hutu nare musi madha mu.

source_text: tzevua hypocrite, first take the beam out of your eye, and then you will see clearly enough to take out the speck from the eye of your ach.
target_text: heeh! èu ne, mema dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo! tao eele uuru ku agarii nèti musi madha èu, heka ladhe mèdhi ahu ca katèd'a ètu d'ara madha angalai mu, sèna ka èu bisa tiu eele ahu ne kèna.

source_text: do not give the kodesh to kelevim nor throw your pearls before chazirim, lest they will trample them with their feet and turn around and tear you into pieces.
target_text: baku aj'a j'ara lamatua dhu mola-mèci mi dhèu dhu d'èi pahahe dhèu. lula dhèu sèra nuka sèmi busa pakadhi, dhu ra kabèli mai kadhi hari miu. rèngu sèra goa sama sèmi hahi kahèi. ladhe dhèu hia ne mutiara dhu kab'ua, na pusi boe! te ne'a dhoka j'èli palaho di.

source_text: keep asking and it shall be given to you; keep searching and you shall find; keep knocking and the delet shall be opened to you.
target_text: ladhe miu sabaj'a, baku loe manèngi mi lamatua; te èèna na, na hia. ladhe patangi-tenge; pe na pad'elo j'ara. ladhe kad'eu taruu babèdho; pe na bhoke.

source_text: for everyone asking receives, and the one searching finds, and to the one knocking the delet will be opened.
target_text: te dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu loe boe manèngi mi lamatua, èèna na ra sèmi rare. dhu patangi-tenge, pe ra abhu. dhu kad'eu taruu, pe na bhoke èmu.

source_text: or what man is there among you the ben of whom will ask for lechem bread, and he will give him a stone.

source_text: but tzar narrow is the delet and constricted is the derech way that leads to chayyim life and few are the ones finding it.

target_text: aj'u dhu hua na karehe, tatu ra patue eele, ho core asa d'ara ai.

source_text: therefore, by their perot fruits you shall have da'as of them.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge rèngu dhu rèti lii padhai kapod'e-kabèli sèra. miu tadhe si nèti tatao ra.

source_text: many will say to me on that day, adoneinu, adoneinu, did we not speak as neviim in your name? did we not cast out shedim evil spirits, demons in your name? did we not accomplish many niflaot miracles in your name?

source_text: and then i will tell them to their face, i never had da'as of you. depart from me, you workers of mufkarut lawlessness.
