source_text: therefore, everyone who hears these devarim words of mine and does them, is like a chacham wise man who built his bais house upon the tzur rock.
target_text: dhèu dhu mai nanene ja'a, hèia ra tao madhutu lii padhai ja'a, rèngu se nuka sèmi dhèu dhu d'èlu-mèu, dhu patitu èmu ra ètu dedha hadhu kapua.

source_text: and the geshem rain came down, the floods arrived, and the winds blew and beat against that bais, and it did not fall, for it had been founded upon the tzur rock.
target_text: nèbhu boe, ka èj'i aae mai toke èi lala, aa ngèlu aae lèke èmu ne. te ngaa èmu ne guri boe, lula patitu ètu dedha hadhu kapua.

target_text: dhèu dhu mai nanene ja'a, te ngaa tao boe madhutu lii padhai ja'a, nèngu ne èci èèna ka dènge dhèu goa dhu patitu èmu na ètu dedha salae.

source_text: and the geshem rain came down, and the floods arrived, and the winds blew and beat against that bais, and it fell, and gadolah was the mapalah fall, downfall, defeat of it.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to him, see that you tell no one, but go and show yourself to the kohen and offer the korban about which moshe gave mitzvah as an edut to them.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ne, sanèd'e paie! èu èle le nèti papèd'a-tarègu, te ngaa baku èu lolo dènge dhèu èci sa. aa èu hud'i madhutu ku atora musa. de lamu asa ama agama ho na parisa ngi'u èu, sèna ka ne'a na èi papèd'a mu ele le, tare'a, do dhae. èle na, èu hia persembahan tadha makasi, sèna ka dhèu re'a, na, èu ne èle tare'a-re'a le nèti papèd'a.

target_text: èle èèna, hèia yesus maso asa d'ara rae kapernaum. ètu era ne'e, komedhaa sordad'u roma ca dhèu, mai manèngi ho yesus soru-bara ne, aku nèngu na,

source_text: and when rebbe, melech hamoshiach came to the other side of the lake, in the land of the people of gadara, he was met by two men possessed by shedim demons; these men were coming out of the kevarim tombs of the burial caves and were so dangerous no one could pass by on that road.

source_text: and the herdsmen of the chazirim fled, and, having gone away into the town, they told the whole story of what had happened to the men possessed by shedim.

target_text: ètu era ne'e dhèu j'èru rèti angalai ra dhu karuku asa yesus. ropa ladhe nèdhi, yesus ne'a le, na, rèngu parcaya ne, peka na, nèngu bisa puri-pa'èle angalai ra. hèia na peka dènge dhèu karuku ne, aku nèngu na, ana! pa'èra d'ara èu! te ja'a saku eele le sasala èu.

target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a d'ara rèngu. nèti èèna ka na lii, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu se pangee, na, ja'a ne pahaha ama lamatua?

source_text: for which is easier to say, selicha is granted on your averos! or…arise and walk! ?
target_text: mia ka dhu mud'a risi? ladhe ja'a peka dènge dhèu karuku ne, ‘ja'a saku eele le sasala èu, ' do, ja'a peka na, ‘kèd'i, ho lèpa ka. '

source_text: but in order that you may have da'as that the bar enosh has samchut authority on earth to pronounce selicha forgiveness on chattaim sins - moshiach then declared to the paralytic, arise, take up your mat and go to your bais house.
target_text: ladhe na kèd'i dènge ka, miu heka mèdhi, na, ja'a ne dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. te ja'a dènge hak ho abho sasala dhèu. hèia yesus paredha dhèu karuku ne, peka na, kèd'i ka! ded'e mèti ka karad'a èu, ho lèpa ka!

source_text: and arising, he went away to his bais.
target_text: ka dhèu karuku ne kèd'i, hèia na lèpa dènge ka.

source_text: and having witnessed this, the multitudes experienced yirat shomayim and gave kavod to hashem, who had given such samchut to men.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi, hèia rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra malaa-maloha. hèia ra ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua, peka na, ama lamatua, kapai risi eele! na hia koasa kapai sèmi ne'e, hia mi dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: and going away from there, rebbe, melech hamoshiach saw a man called mattityahu sitting in the tax office. and rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to him, follow me. and mattityahu arose and followed him.
target_text: èle ka yesus la'e nèti era èèna, hèia ladhe nèdhi ca dhèu roro doi bea dhu sab'a ètu kantor bea. ngara dhèu ne, mateos. hèia yesus gale ne, peka na, mai madhutu ja'a! ropa tadèngi nare, hèia mateos kèd'i dènge ka, la'e madhutu yesus.

source_text: and it came about that while rebbe, melech hamoshiach was sitting bimesibba reclining at tish table in the bais, hinei! many mochesim tax collectors and chote'im sinners came and were sitting bimesibba reclining at tish table with rebbe, melech hamoshiach and his talmidim.
target_text: ka mateos nèru yesus si lasi ra'a-rinu asa èmu na. na nèru kahèi mone aanga-angalai na dhèu roro bea sèra, aa tamu dhu leo kahèi, ho ra'a-rinu dènge rèngu.

source_text: when the perushim saw this, they were saying to moshiachʼs talmidim, why does your rebbe eat with the mochesim and the chote'im?
target_text: te ngaa abhu pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei parisi, mai ka'ugu ètu madha ana-ana madhutu yesus, peka na, nga tao ka mese miu madhèdi na'a-ninu dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu guna boe se, nuka sèmi dhèu roro bea dènge angalai ra dhu bhelu-katub'a sèra?

source_text: but when rebbe, melech hamoshiach heard this, he said, it is not the bariim healthy ones who have need of a rofeh physician, but the cholim.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge rèngu, aku nèngu na, dhèu pèd'a parluu dote-matarii, te ngaa dhèu dhu pèd'a boe parluu boe.

source_text: go and learn what this means: chesed chafatzti vlo zevachi desire loving kindness and not sacrifice, for i have not come to call the tzaddikim but the chote'im sinners.
target_text: be'a risi lami parisa paie-iie lii holo-nori ama lamatua. te uru èèna, na pua hosea, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai na, dhu suri peka na, ‘dad'èi ja'a nuka, dhèu-dhèu ja'a hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci, aa pad'elo rasa kasia. ladhe ra tao boe madhutu sèmi èèna, na, badha korban rèngu dhu rèti hia ja'a, dènge boe kab'ua. ' ne'e ne ka dhu ama lamatua peka tèke le. nèti èèna ka, ja'a mai boe ho uri dhèu dhu pangee na, rèngu dhèu mola, te ngaa ja'a mai sèna ka ladhe-leru dhèu dhu laku-laku boe.

source_text: then yochananʼs talmidim approached rebbe, melech hamoshiach, saying, why do we and the perushim often undergo tzomot fasts, but your talmidim do not undergo tzomot?
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu yohanis tuka sarani sèra, mai sa yesus. dhèu se karèi, aku rèngu na, ji'i dhu madhutu yohanis tema puasa. aa dhèu parisi puasa kahèi. te ngaa tasamia ka ana madhutu ama sèra loe boe ra'a-rinu? rèngu re'a boe puasa, do?

source_text: and moshiach said to them, surely the bnei hachuppah wedding invitees are not able to act as avelim mourners as long as the choson bridegroom, is with them. but the days will come when the choson is taken away from them, and then they will undergo tzomot.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa dènge lii pakasame, na, sèmi ne'e: ladhe pesta kab'i, tamu sèra puasa boe, te ngaa ra'a toke bècu. ladhe pengantin mone dènge rèngu era, aa'i-aa'i ra ra'a-rinu palere-lere. te ngaa ladhe dhèu leo rai rèti ka pengantin mone ne, hèia mone aanga-angalai na, d'ara ra susa, de heka ra puasa kèna.

source_text: no one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, for the patch pulls away from the garment, and a worse tear results.
target_text: dhèu bisa boe rare bèla hiu ca èta, ho kalape mi kodho dhui dhu mae. te ropa base kodho ne, bèla hiu dhu kalape la'a deo na karuku, na kodho deo na asa mae aae.

source_text: neither do men put yayin chadash new wine into old wineskins; otherwise, the wineskins burst, and the wine is spilled, and the wineskins are ruined. but they pour yayin chadash into new wineskins, and both are preserved.
target_text: j'ara sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge dhua dhu heka rèti mai nèti kapua, bisa boe bhori asa d'ara sabha dhui. te aad'o na sabha ne madhore, hèia dhua bhori eele asa rai la'e. de dhua dhu hiu hud'i bhori ku asa d'ara sabha hiu, sèna ka dua ra be'a taruu! dènge sèmi ne'e, yesus nori si, peka na, a'aj'a na dhu hiu, baku pakihu dènge a'aj'a dhu dhui.

source_text: while rebbe, melech hamoshiach was speaking these things to them one of the nichbadim dignitaries came and fell down before rebbe, melech hamoshiach, saying, the bat daughter of me has just become niftar passed away, but come lay your hand upon her and she will live.
target_text: ètu d'ara yesus padhai lii era dènge ana madhutu yohanis sèra, hèia kapala nèti èmu manèngi-mangaj'i mai paraga dènge ne. ka na patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus. hèia na manèngi, aku nèngu na, ama, ee! sue ku ja'a la! te ana bhèni ja'a heka madhe kèna. de lati ho ama bane ai mi ana ne, sèna ka na mamuri hari.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach got up and, with his talmidim, followed him.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi, hèia yesus dènge ana madhutu na, madhutu dènge ka dhèu deo na.

source_text: and hinei! an isha woman hemorrhaging twelve years approached him from behind and touched the garment of rebbe, melech hamoshiachʼs tzitzit. for she was saying to herself, if only i might touch his garment, i will receive refuah healing.
target_text: ètu talora j'ara, ca dhèu ina kako la'e madhutu si. bhèni ne lèke papèd'a bhèni, dhu loe boe ciki sa d'ai canguru dua tèu kèna. na pangee, na, sad'i ja'a gai lèke kodho yesus di, tatu èi papèd'a ja'a ne èle. nèti èèna ka, na ara padètu la'e, hèia na gai lèke suu kodho yesus.

source_text: turning and seeing her, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said, chazak, bat daughter of me! your emunah has brought you refuah. and the isha was healed from that hour.
target_text: yesus dhu ne'a, hèia na kabib'a, ladhe sa ina ne. ka na lii, peka na, ina, ee! pa'èra la d'ara èu. te, lula èu parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a, nèti èèna ka èu èle nèti papèd'a. hèia bhèni ne èle dènge ka.

source_text: and having come into the bais house of the nichbad dignitary, and having seen the flute players and the unruly crowd,
target_text: èle ka, yesus si lasi taruu asa èmu nèti kapala èmu manèngi-mangaj'i èèna. d'ai era nèi, maso la'e asa d'ara, hèia na ladhe nèdhi dhèu dhu tema karihu musiik mamadhe, dènge dhèu ae dhu tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: rebbe, melech hamoshiach was saying, go away! for the yaldah is not among the mesim - she sleeps! and they were making leitzonus mockery, fun of rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ae eele ka tangi, aa lami ka èmu miu! te ana ne madhe boe, dhoka na bhèj'i di. te ngaa dhèu se mari dènge pakapengo hèb'a mi yesus.

source_text: but when the crowd had been put outside, rebbe, melech hamoshiach went in and took the yaldah by the hand and the yaldah was made to stand up alive.
target_text: èle ka, dhèu se aa'i-aa'i lasi asa li'u. ka yesus maso asa d'ara kama ana bhèni ne. na kèpe ai ana ne, hèia ana ne mamuri dènge ka.

source_text: and this report went out into all that region.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi j'ara ne, ka dhèu mulai palolo lème ètu kabarai ra, lula-nèti ngaa dhu yesus tao ne.

source_text: and as rebbe, melech hamoshiach went on from there, two ivrim blind men followed him, shouting loudly, chaneinu, ben dovid!
target_text: èle, hèia yesus kako taruu. ètu talora j'ara, abhu dhèu bèdhu dhèu dua dhu madhutu ne. dua ra rodhe, peka na, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud! sue ku ji'i la!

source_text: and when rebbe, melech hamoshiach entered the bais house, the ivrim blind men approached him, and he says to them, do you have emunah that i am able to do this? they say to rebbe, melech hamoshiach, ken, adoneinu.
target_text: ropa yesus maso asa d'ara èmu cue, dhèu bèdhu se lasi paraga dènge ne. ka yesus karèi dua ra, peka na, miu se lèka tare'a-re'a, na, ja'a ne dènge koasa ho puri-pa'èle miu, sèna ka bisa ladhe mèdhi, do? hèia dua ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama karèi ia ka, te ji'i dhu lèka mema-mema le.

source_text: then rebbe, melech hamoshiach touched their eyes, saying, according to your emunah, let it be done for you.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii dhaa dua ra, hèia yesus g'ag'e musi madha ra, ka na peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, j'aj'i ka madhutu parcaya miu.

source_text: and their eyes were opened. rebbe, melech hamoshiach sternly warned them, saying, see to it that no one knows!
target_text: yesus padhai lii èle, hèia dua ra ladhe rèdhi dènge ka. te ngaa yesus pasanèd'e si, peka na, baku miu peka dènge ca dhèu sa, ngaa dhu j'aj'i le!

source_text: but having gone out, they made him known in that entire district.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu se taha rare boe d'ara ra. ka ra kako palème kabarai èèna, lole dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i, tatao yesus mi rèngu dua ra.

source_text: after they had departed, the people brought to him a mute man who was possessed by shedim.
target_text: ropa dhèu bèdhu se lasi, dhèu rèti dhèu leo hari èci asa yesus. dhèu ne bisa boe padhai lii, lula nidhu tao ne.

source_text: and when the shedim had been cast out by rebbe, melech hamoshiach, the mute man spoke. and the multitudes marveled, saying, never was anything like this seen in eretz yisroel!
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi, hèia yesus paredha nidhu kalua nèti dhèu lii aad'o ne. nidhu èèna kalua, ka dhèu ne padhai lii dènge ka. hèia dhèu ae ètu era èèna malaa, ka ra peka na, ira ii! èdhi dhèu yahudi paraga tèdhi mèka madha j'ara sèmi ne'e ne!

source_text: but the perushim said, it was by the sar hashedim the prince of demons that this man casts out shedim!
target_text: te ngaa dhèu parisi ka'uu, peka na, dhèu aae nidhu ka dhu hia ne koasa, sèna ka na bisa babège eela nidhu.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach went about all the shtetlach and villages exercising the ministry of moreh teacher in their shuls and of darshan preacher of the besuras hageulah of the malchut hashem and bringing refuah to all the cholim, every machla disease and every illness.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus kako palème kota-kota dènge rae-rae, sèna ka aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a sèra. na aj'a dhèu nèti lii holo-nori ama lamatua, aa j'ara tasamia rèngu bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. na puri-pa'èle kahèi dhèu nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: and looking out on the multitudes, rebbe, melech hamoshiach felt rachmei shomayim heavenly compassion and mercy for his people, for they were distressed and weary katzon asher ein lahem roehlike sheep without a shepherd.
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe nèdhi dhèu ae se, hèia na taha nare boe d'ara, lula dhèu se re'a heka tao sèmi ngaa sa. te rèngu nuka sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho dhu dènge boe dhèu madhenga.

source_text: then rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to his talmidim, the katzir harvest is indeed great but the kotzerim harvesters are few.
target_text: èle ka, yesus padhai lii dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, dhèu ae se, nuka sèmi nganga'a ae-ae ètu d'ara oka-tedhe. masi ka nganga'a ae titu kèna, te ngaa dhèu sab'a d'ai boe ho puu-g'ètu, sèna ka tèke asa d'ara gud'a.

source_text: therefore, offer tefillos to the adon hakatzir the l-rd of the harvest that he may send out kotzerim into his katzir.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i manèngi ku mi lamatua oka, sèna ka na tabha hari dhèu sab'a, ho lasi puu-g'ètu isi oka se.

source_text: and summoning his shneym asar twelve talmidim, rebbe, melech hamoshiach gave to them samchut authority over shedim unclean spirits, so as to cast them out, and samchut authority to call forth refuah for every machla and every illness.
target_text: èle ka, yesus paroa ana madhutu na, sèna ka mai pakaboko. hèia na hia si koasa ho babège eele nidhu aa puri-pa'èle dhèu nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: now of the shneym asar shlichim, the names are these: first, shim'on, the one being called kefa, and andrew his brother, ya'akov ben zavdai and yochanan his brother,
target_text: ana madhutu na dhu na pua sèra, dhèu canguru dua, nuka: partama, ngara na simon dhu dhèu tema paroa ne, ‘petrus', dènge ari na, anderias, yakobis, dènge ari na, yohanis dua ra ana sabadeus,

source_text: philippos and bar-talmai, t'oma and mattityahu the moches, ya'akov ben-chalfai and taddai,
target_text: pelipus, bertolomeos, tomas, mateos dhèu roro doi bea, yakobis dhu leo nuka ana alpius, tadius,

source_text: shim'on the zealot and yehudah from k'riot, who betrayed rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: simon nèti partei politik selot, dènge yudas iskariot dhu èèna na pahie yesus.

source_text: these shneym asar twelve did rebbe, melech hamoshiach send out with the following directives, saying: in the derech hagoyim way of the gentiles, gentile territory do not go, and do not enter into any shomron town, but go rather to the seh oveid beis yisroel the lost sheep of the house of israel.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus pua ana madhutu na canguru dua dhèu sèra, aa paredha si, peka na, ja'a pua miu lami asa dhèu èdhi dhèu yahudi sèra, lula ae nèti rèngu dhu madhutu boe j'ara mamuri ama lamatua dènge mola. rèngu cakaraa kahib'i-kalèbho dhu sala j'ara. nèti èèna ka, baku lami asa dhèu yahudi boe, nuka sèmi dhèu samaria.

source_text: and, while going, preach that the malchut hashomayim is imminent and miyad.
target_text: lami peka dènge dhèu isra'el èdhi sèra, na, ‘ne'e ne, d'ai lod'o kèna, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. '

source_text: heal the cholim, raise the mesim, cleanse the metzoraim lepers, cast out the shedim; freely you received, freely give.
target_text: aa lami puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a, pamamuri hari dhèu madhe, pa'èle dhèu kusta, aa babège eele nidhu. ama lamatua hia le miu ae-ae, te ngaa na manèngi hari boe ca ana maa sa. de lami ka ho pala pa'ae-ae mi dhèu leo, te ngaa mage mi manèngi hari ngaa-ngaa kahèi.

source_text: take neither gold nor silver nor copper for your money belts,
target_text: pakèd'i dènge ai hua. baku mèti doi,

source_text: nor a schnorrerʼs beggarʼs bag for the road, nor two bekishe, nor sandals, nor a staff, for the oseh hamelachah the one doing the work is worthy of his lechem.
target_text: gee j'ara, mèdha silu, salapa, do tatea. te dhèu hud'i hia ku dhèu sab'a, ngaa dhu pantas ho ra bisa mamuri.

source_text: and into whichever town or shtetl you enter, inquire who in it is a ben chayil son of worthiness, and there remain until you leave.
target_text: ladhe miu maso asa d'ara kota do rae èci, na, miu hud'i tenge ku dhèu dhu neo sèmi rare miu. hèia miu pea ètu èmu èèna, toke miu pakèd'i tèke eele era èèna.

source_text: and when you enter into the bais house, give that household your shalom!
target_text: ladhe miu maso asa d'ara èmu dhèu, peka la dènge rèngu, ‘saloom! lamatua hia miu mèngi-nale. '

source_text: and if indeed the bais is a bais chayil a house of worthiness, let your shalom come upon it; but if it is not a bais chayil, let your shalom return to you.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ètu d'ara èmu ne, sèmi rare miu dènge be'a, na, miu manèngi sèna ka lamatua hia si berkat. te ngaa ladhe ra ro'o boe sèmi rare miu, na, lamatua hia boe rèngu berkat.

source_text: and whoever neither receives you nor listens to your divrei, as you are leaving and as you go outside of that bais house or city, then let it be nier chatzno shake out the fold of the robe, shake off the dust of your feet.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ro'o boe nanene lii padhai miu, mi kalua nèti èmu èèna, do kota èèna, hèia miu caro eele ahu nèti haga miu, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, ladhe ro'o boe nanene, pe rèngu d'ui rare pala ra.

source_text: omein, i say to you, it will be more tolerable on yom hadin the day of judgment for s'dom and amora than for that shtetl.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, lod'o ama lamatua huku dhèu ètu rai-haha ne'e, tatu na pabia mi dhèu sodom dènge gomora dhu uru èèna bhelu titu kèna. te ngaa sanèd'e! èèna na, nèngu huku bia risi hari mi dhèu dhu ro'o boe sèmi rare miu!

source_text: hinei! i send you as kevesim sheep in the midst of ze'evim; therefore, have the seichel wisdom of nachashim serpents and be tamim faultless as yonim doves.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! te ja'a pua miu ne, èci èèna ka ja'a patabuli kahib'i-kalèbho asa talora aae busa hui. nèti èèna ka, ngangee miu hud'i sèmi mege dhu d'èlu-mèu. aa d'ara mi hud'i mola ku nuka sèmi koro j'aha dhu ne'a boe tenge lii langu.

source_text: and beware of bnei adam, for they will deliver you up to the sanhedriyot local councils, bet din courts and in their shuls they will subject you to the shot whip.
target_text: te ngaa baku pamud'e! te bèli-camèd'a dhèu paj'èra miu, sama sèmi busa hui kadhi pamadhe kahib'i-kalèbho. èèna na, rèngu nuni rèti miu asa era parisa lii langu agama. aa dhèu hake paparu miu ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a.

source_text: and before moshelim governors and also melachim kings you will be led for my sake, for an edut testimony to them and to the goyim.
target_text: pe rèngu ère rèti miu asa madha gubernur dènge dhèu aae, lula miu madhutu ja'a. te ngaa miu hud'i pake lod'o sèra, ho peka-padhai dènge ra lii lolo be'a nèti ja'a. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua tadèngi kahèi kolongara ja'a ne.

source_text: but when they deliver you up, do not be of a lev rogezanxious heart worried about how or what you are to say; for it will be given to you in that hour what you are to speak.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe rèngu nuni rèti miu sèmi èèna, mage miu madha'u, peka na, ‘èèna na, ja'a peka tasamia? ' do, ‘ja'a neo dhaa peka sèmi ngaa? ' baku j'aj'i mi ngangee, te ladhe d'ai lod'o na, ama mi ètu sorga ka dhu peka dènge miu, nèti j'ara mia ka dhu miu hud'i peka-padhai.

source_text: for you are not the ones speaking, but the ruach avichem the spirit of your father is the one speaking in you.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ngaa dhu miu padhai, mai boe nèti d'ara miu unu mi, te roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna ka dhu aj'a-nori ètu d'ara miu, sèna ka miu padhai sèmi ngaa sa.

source_text: and brother will deliver up to death his own brother, even an abba his own yeled. and yeladim will stand up against their horim parents and put them to death.
target_text: sanèd'e, te bèli-camèd'a ètu d'ara èmu cue, ladhe abhu ca dhèu parcaya ja'a, èèna na a'ari nèngu mesa na, ka dhu tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ne. aa ladhe ana ka dhu parcaya, èèna na ama na ka dhu pamadhe ne. ladhe ina-ama ka dhu parcaya, bèli-camèd'a ana-ana ra ka dhu pamadhe si.

source_text: and you will be under the sinas chinom baseless hatred of kol bnei adam on account of my name; but the one enduring ad es haketz until the end will receive the yeshu'at eloheinu the salvation of our g-d.
target_text: sanèd'e! te bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i tèka d'ara dènge miu, lula miu parcaya ja'a ne. te ngaa dhèu dhu taha taruu, èèna na ama lamatua hia ne mamuri.

source_text: but when they persecute you in one shtetl, flee to the other; for, omein, i say to you, by no means will you complete the shtetlach of eretz yisroel until the bias hamoshiachcoming of the moshiach, the bar enosh.
target_text: ladhe dhèu paj'èra miu ètu d'ara kota cue, rai lami asa kota leo! lèke kèna! ja'a ne dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. bèli-camèd'a ropa miu palème aa'i mèka kota-kota ètu isra'el, te ngaa ja'a dhu lèpa hari mai le èèna.

source_text: a talmid is not above his rebbe nor an eved servant above his baal bayit master.
target_text: biasa dhèu pakab'ua ca dhèu mese risi nèti ana sakola na sèra. aa dhèu pakab'ua ca dhèu lamatua risi nèti ènu na sèra.

source_text: it is enough for the talmid that he be like his rebbe, and the eved like his baal bayit. if they called the baal bayit baal-zibbul, how much more the anashim men in his bais.
target_text: ladhe ana sakola mèu sama sèmi mese na, nèngu pangee na d'ai le. aa ladhe ènu d'èlu-mèu sama sèmi lamatua na, nèngu ngee na d'ai le. de sanèd'e paie! ladhe dhèu paroa lamatua èmu, peka na, ‘èu ne, baalsebul, dhèu aae nidhu! ' tatu isi èmu na abhu kolongara dhu karehe risi hari.

source_text: therefore, do not fear them; for nothing has been veiled which will not be unveiled; and nothing has been nistar hidden which will not be made known.
target_text: de miu baku madha'u dènge dhèu dhu lab'a miu. te, ngaa dhu dhèu tao pahuni, bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi.

source_text: what i say to you in the choshech darkness, you declare in the ohr light; and what you hear whispered into your ears, shout, preach, from the rooftops.
target_text: ngaa dhu ja'a aj'a-nori le miu mesa mi, miu hud'i lami lole ku mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. aa ngaa dhu ja'a paholo le dènge miu, miu se hud'i lami peka ku palème era.

source_text: and do not fear those who kill the basar flesh, but are unable to kill the nefesh soul; but rather fear the one who is able to destroy both basar and nefesh in gehinnom.
target_text: baku madha'u dènge dhèu rai-haha, te rèngu bisa dhoka pamadhe ngi'u aae dhèu di, te ngaa bisa boe pa'ele iie samanga. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i madha'u ku dènge ama lamatua, te dhoka nèngu di dhu dènge koasa ho pamaso ngi'u aae dhèu dènge samanga kateme, asa d'ara dhasi ai dhu heo na loe boe ciki sa.

source_text: are not two sparrows sold for the least valuable copper coin? and yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from avichem!
target_text: de pa'èra d'ara miu. dhèu pahie ana mangungu ètu d'ara pasa dènge kab'ua ciki oo'e di. te ngaa ci'u sa bisa boe madhe, ladhe ama mi ètu sorga no'o mèka.

source_text: but, as far as you are concerned, even the hairs of your rosh have been inventoried.
target_text: ama miu ètu sorga dhu loe boe ladhe-leru miu, toke j'ara-j'ara dhu ana iiki-iiki. d'ai rèu kètu ètu kab'a kètu miu, na ige nare aa'i hèi.

source_text: therefore, al taarotz do not be afraid! you are of more value than many sparrows!
target_text: de baku madha'u! lula ama lamatua pakab'ua miu risi nèti ana mangungu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: therefore, everyone who shall declare publicly the ani maamin hoda'ah of me, before bnei haadam, i will make hoda'ah acknowledgment of him before avi sh'ba'shomayim.
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, dhèu dhu bani mangaku ja'a ètu madha dhèu ae ètu rai-haha ne, pe ja'a kahèi mangaku nèngu ètu katanga madha ama ku ètu sorga, peka na, ‘nèngu ne dhèu ja'a. '

source_text: but everyone who makes hakhchashah denial of me, i also will make hakhchashah denial of him before avi sh'ba'shomayim.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu pasili ja'a ètu madha dhèu ae, peka na nèngu tadhe boe ja'a, bèli-camèd'a ja'a peka dènge ama ku ètu sorga kahèi, na, ‘ja'a tadhe boe dhèu ne'e. '

source_text: do not think that i have come to bring shalom al haaretz peace on the earth; i have not come to bring shalom but a cherev sword.
target_text: mage mi pangee na, ja'a ne mai kèti dame asa rai-haha ne. te mamai ja'a ne, sèna ka dhèu rai-haha ne èci lab'a èci.

source_text: for i came to divide a man against his av, and a bat against her em, and a kallah bride against her chamot mother-in-law, shviger.
target_text: ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne, madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua peka tèke èèna, ‘èèna na, ana mone lab'a ama na, ana bhèni lab'a ina na, aa bhèni dhèu èmu ana na, lab'a ina nèti dhèu èmu na,

source_text: and the oiyvei ish anshei veitothe enemies of a man will be the members of his own household.
target_text: te isi èmu mae-manyèla, lula èci lab'a èci. '

source_text: the one who has more ahavah love for a tata papa or a mama than for me is not worthy of me, and the one who has more ahavah love for a ben or a bat than me is not worthy of me.
target_text: de dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a tare'a-re'a, nèngu hud'i sue ku ja'a, risi nèti aa'i-aa'i, risi nèti ina-ama na, aa risi nèti ana niki na. ladhe aad'o, na, nèngu nia boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a.

source_text: the one who does not take up his etz shel mesiros nefesh tree of self-sacrifice and follow after me, is not worthy of me.
target_text: te dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a, te ngaa d'èi boe pasae j'aj'èra, nèngu nia boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a.

source_text: the one who has found his nefesh will lose it; the one who has lost his nefesh for my sake will find it.
target_text: dhèu dhu sadia madhe lula na madhutu ja'a, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu dhoka neo mamuri hia ngi'u nèngu unu na, èèna na, mamuri na ele iia d'ara!

source_text: the one who gives the kabbalat panim welcome to you gives the baruch habah welcome to me, and the one who gives the baruch habah to me gives the baruch habah to the one who sent me.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèmi nare miu dènge be'a, nèngu sèmi nare ja'a kahèi. aa dhèu dhu sèmi nare ja'a, nèngu kahèi sèmi nare ama lamatua dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: the one who gives the baruch habah to a navi prophet in the name of a navi will receive the sachar reward of a navi, and the one who gives the baruch habah to a tzaddik righteous man in the name of a tzaddik will receive the sachar of a tzaddik.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèmi nare dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, lula na padhue-padhai lii holo-nori ama lamatua, pe lamatua b'ala nèngu sama sèmi na b'ala mi ca dhèu nèti lii padhai nèngu. aa dhèu dhu sèmi nare ca dhèu d'ara mola, lula dhèu èèna madhutu tare'a-re'a dad'èi ama lamatua, pe lamatua b'ala nèngu sama sèmi na b'ala mi ca dhèu d'ara mola.

source_text: and whoever in the name of a talmid gives only a cup of cold water to one of these little ones, omein, i say to you, he will by no means lose his sachar.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèmi nare ca dhèu dhu haha d'ai seli, lula nèngu madhutu ja'a, tatu ama lamatua b'ala ne. masi ka dhèu hia èi hua ca galaa di, tatu ama lamatua bhèlu boe ne.

source_text: and it came about when he finished giving directives to his shneym asar talmidim, he moved on from there, exercising the ministry of moreh teacher and darshan preacher, maggid in their shtetlach.
target_text: ropa yesus hia nare lii moa mi canguru dua ana madhutu na, hèia na la'e kako palème rae-rae ètu rai èèna, sèna ka aj'a dhèu ètu sèra. aa na peka-padhai lii lolo be'a ama lamatua.

source_text: now when yochanan, in the beit hasohor prison, heard of the maasei hamoshiach works of moshiach, he sent his talmidim to rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yohanis ètu d'ara bèdho. ropa na tadèngi j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu yesus tao, hèia na pua ana madhutu na ho lasi karèi yesus, peka na,

source_text: they asked him, tell us. are you hu habah he who comes or is our chikiah wait to be for the bias coming of another?
target_text: ama lamatua dhu pajaji tèke le karèi nèti uru ka, na, nèngu neo pua kristus mai, sèna ka pala mamuri mi èdhi dhèu yahudi. ama ne, kristus, do? do, èdhi hud'i mate hari ku dhèu leo? ka lasi karèi yesus.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach answered them, saying, go give the report of what you see and hear to yochanan:
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, miu se tadèngi le, aa mèdhi unu mi dènge madha. de lèpa ho lami peka dènge yohanis, aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i, nuka sèmi ngaa dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, yesaya, suri tèke le, peka na:

source_text: the ivrim blind people see, the pisechim lame people walk, the metzoraim lepers are cleansed, the chereshim deaf people hear, the mesim are made to stand up alive, and the aniyim poor have the besuras hageulah preached to them.
target_text: dhèu bèdhu, ladhe rèdhi. dhèu karuku, kèd'i kako. dhèu pèd'a kusta, ka'uri ra milu hari. dhèu katele-katipa, bisa tadèngi. dhèu madhe, mamuri hari. dhèu unu aad'o, nanene lii lolo be'a.

source_text: ashrey happy is the one who does not find a cause of michshol falling, stumbling in me.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e: lami peka dènge yohanis, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu a'oto, ladhe na parcaya ja'a taruu. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a pa'èra-èra!

source_text: as they were leaving, he began to speak to the multitudes about yochanan, what did you go out into the midbar wilderness to see? a reed being shaken by the wind?
target_text: ropa ana madhutu yohanis se lèpa, hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu ae se, lula-nèti yohanis ne, aku nèngu na, lod'o miu neo paraga dènge yohanis ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a, miu pangee, na, neo paraga dènge dhèu dhu sèmi ngaa sa? tatu boe, miu paraga dènge dhèu dhu roe aala-aala, nuka sèmi kalai èèu dhu bhabheu madhutu ngèlu di!

source_text: what did you go out to see? someone shtats imposing, impressive in appearance, attired in soft raiment? hinei, the ones wearing soft raiment are in houses of melachim kings.
target_text: aa tatu boe miu mèdhi dhèu dhu pake mèdha-papake dhu kab'ua aae, te dhèu sèmi èèna era pea na dhodhoka ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae di!

source_text: but what did you go out to see? a navi? ken, i tell you. and one greater than a navi.
target_text: de lami ladhe dhèu sèmi ngaa sa ètu nèi? mi pangee na, miu lami tenge dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua! tare'a! te nèngu ne, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua dhu kapai risi.

source_text: this is he about whom it has been written, hinneni sholeiach malachi behold, i will send my messenger before your face, upinnah derech lefanai and he will prepare the way before me.
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna, dhu suri tèke le lula-nèti yohanis ne, peka na, ‘nanene! ja'a pua dhèu ja'a, sèna ka bhoke j'ara hia èu. '

source_text: omein, i say to you, of those born of women, there has not appeared one greater than yochanan of the tevilah of teshuva, yet the person with the least chashivut in the malchut hashomayim is greater than he.
target_text: nanene paie! ètu rai-haha ne, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu kapai risi nèti yohanis ne. te ngaa nèti dhèu rai-haha aa'i-aa'i dhu mangaku ama lamatua sama sèmi dhèu aae, dhèu dhu haha d'ai seli èèna ka, nèngu dhu kapai risi nèti yohanis.

source_text: from the days of yochanan of the tevilah of teshuva until now, the malchut hashomayim has been under violent attack and the violent seize it with coercion.
target_text: karèi nèti yohanis pakako sasab'a na, d'ai sange ne'e ne, abhu dhèu ae-ae dhu j'aj'i le dhèu unu ama lamatua. te ngaa abhu dhèu leo dhu pangee sala, peka na rèngu hud'i pamusu ku, sèna ka laka-seti dhèu ho j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: for all the neviim and the torah prophesied until yochanan.
target_text: toke d'ai lod'o mamai yohanis tuka sarani, èdhi dhèu yahudi dhu tema madhutu atora musa, dènge atora dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua leo sèra.

source_text: and, if you are willing it to be mekabel accept, receive, he is the eliyahu, who is to come.
target_text: de parcaya la ja'a! yohanis ne, nuka elia, dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, peka mema le lula-nèti mamai na.

source_text: the one having ears, let him hear.
target_text: de dhu neo me'a mèu, hud'i nanene ku paie-iie!

source_text: but to what will i compare this generation? it is like yeladim sitting in the marketplaces, calling out to one another,
target_text: ja'a neo hia lii pakasame, sèna ka miu me'a, rupa sèmi mia ka dhèu taa limuri ne. te rèngu se cakaraa dènge ana-ana dhu madhèdi ètu d'ara pasa. rèngu dhu pa'oo-parodha dènge angalai ra, peka na,

source_text: we played the chalil flute for you, but you did not dance; we sang a kina lament, funeral dirge for you, and you did not mourn.
target_text: ‘ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi tiu sakino dènge karej'e-karae, te ngaa miu roge-ledho boe. hèia ji'i sod'a lii beke dhèu madhe, te ngaa miu tangi boe. '

source_text: for yochanan came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, he has a shed.
target_text: miu se sama sèmi ana iiki dhu re'a boe roca. lod'o yohanis mai, nèngu d'èi puasa, aa ninu boe èi anggor. te ngaa dhèu peka na, ‘nèngu, nidhu tao! '

source_text: the bar enosh came eating and drinking, and they say, hinei! a zolel glutton and a shikkor drunkard, a friend of mochesim tax collectors and chote'im sinners. yet, chochmah wisdom is vindicated by her ma'asim.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, mai le. ja'a puasa boe, aa kinu èi anggor. te ngaa dhèu peka na, ‘nèngu èèna, dhèu gagoo-gagehu! dhèu tema mahu bia! la'e pa'angalai dènge dhèu roro bea! pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu laku-laku boe. nèngu dhu ne'a boe makae! ' te ngaa mi patadhe lii padhai ja'a ne! mamèu ama lamatua èèna, cèu ètu d'ara mamuri dhèu unu na.

source_text: then he began to reproach the shtetlach villages in which were accomplished most of his gevurot mighty deeds, because they did not make teshuva.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua yesus pasanèd'e dhèu-dhèu dhu pea ètu pèri-pèri rae. na tao le tadha-tadha malaa ae risi ètu nèi, te ngaa ro'o boe ae eele nèti sasala ra, ho madhutu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua dhu mola.

source_text: oy l'chah woe to you, korazin! oy l'chah, beit-tzaidah! for if in tzor and tzidon were accomplished the gevurot that were accomplished among you, they would have made teshuva long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
target_text: yesus jèke si, peka na, heh! miu dhèu korasin, aa miu dhèu betsaida! mate unu miu! bèli-camèd'a pasae mere mamadhe-mamopo! ja'a tao le rupa-rupa tadha malaa ètu katanga madha miu, te ngaa miu mo'o boe parcaya ama lamatua. masi ka miu dhèu yahudi dhu peka na, miu tadhe lamatua, te ngaa ladhe sèmi tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao se'e ètu kota tirus dènge kota sidon, tatu nèbhu nare sange ne'e, dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra èle le ho'a, aa tèke eele le sasala-sasigo ra ho madhutu ama lamatua. aa tatu ra pake le bèla mèdhi, dènge tao ahu mi kètu ho j'aj'i mi tadha, na, rèngu manyasa nèti sasala ra. masi ka dhèu tirus dènge dhèu sidon sèra dhèu yahudi boe, dhu mangaku na, tadhe lamatua.

source_text: nevertheless, i say to you, it will be more bearable for tzor and tzidon than for you on yom hadin.
target_text: ja'a monya boe! bèli-camèd'a mèdhi unu mi! d'ai lod'o dhu ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, hahuku dhèu tirus dènge dhèu sidon samaa risi nèti hahuku miu.

source_text: and you, k'far-nachum, were you lifted up as far as shomayim? you shall be brought down as far as sheol. for if in s'dom were accomplished the gevurot that were accomplished among you, s'dom would have a sheerit remnant today!
target_text: miu dhèu kapernaum! mage-mage, ee! mage mi pangee, na, ama lamatua paca'e miu lami asa sorga. aad'o! èèna na lamatua pèci mi asa d'ara naraka! ladhe sèmi tadha-tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao ètu rae miu dhu j'aj'i uuru le ètu kota sodom, tatu ama lamatua parluu boe labhu pakèpu kota èèna. te ladhe dhèu sodom rèdhi tadha malaa se, tatu ra rai eele le nèti bhabhelu-katub'a ra.

source_text: nevertheless, i say to you, it will be more bearable for the land of s'dom on yom hadin than for you.
target_text: tare'a! pe mèdhi unu mi! ladhe d'ai ka lod'o ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i, hahuku dhèu sodom samaa risi nèti hahuku miu se!

source_text: at that time, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said, modeh ani, avi, adon hashomayim v'haaretz, i thank you, father, l-rd of heaven and earth, because you hid these things from the chachamim wise and those with seichel, and to them they are nistar hidden, esoteric, and you made a hisgalus revelation of them unto ollelim infants.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare, hèia yesus sabaj'a, peka na, ama! ama dhu j'aj'i lamatua ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha. ja'a manèngi makasi ae-ae, lula ama pahuni pamèno-mèno j'ara-j'ara dhu ama hia huku mi dhèu-dhèu dhu pangee na, rèngu d'èlu-mèu, aa dhu padedha iisi ra. te ngaa ama bhoke patalele j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i mi dhèu haha dènge dhu pahaha iisi ra.

source_text: ken, avi, for thus it was pleasing in your sight.
target_text: tare'a, ama! te sèmi èèna ka, dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama!

source_text: all things were given to me by avi, and no one has daas knowledge of haben except haav, nor does anyone have daas of haav, except haben, and anyone to whom haben chooses to unveil him.
target_text: ropa sabaj'a nare, hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra, na, nanene paie-iie! ama ku ètu sorga pangèd'u le koasa aa'i-aa'i mi ja'a ne. dhu tadhe mèu ja'a, dhoka ama ku di. aa dhu tadhe mèu ama, dhoka ana na, nuka ja'a ne. aa ja'a hag'e kore dhèu leo, sèna ka peka dènge ra, ho rèngu tadhe mèu ne kahèi.

source_text: come to me, all you who are burden-weary and heavy laden, and i will give you shabbos menuchah.
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu roe lula sab'a bia, mai madhutu ja'a! aa miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu pasae bia, mai la asa ja'a!

source_text: take my ol yoke upon you and learn from me, for i am anav humble and have shiflut lowliness in lev heart, and you will find menuchah rest, security for your nefashot souls.
target_text: ladhe miu sèmi mere a'aj'a ja'a, ho kako palere-lere dènge ja'a, na, èdhi ca ropa dènge sapi dua ngi'u dhu nuni kataka pare rai èci. te ja'a ne, d'ara hua iia, aa lii mako. ladhe miu madhutu ja'a, miu j'aj'i èra hari.

source_text: for my ol yoke is easy and my burden is light.
target_text: lula a'aj'a ja'a, carui boe. aa paredha ja'a, bia boe kahèi.

source_text: at that time rebbe, melech hamoshiach went on shabbos through the grainfields. and his talmidim were hungry and began to pick the heads of wheat and to eat them.
target_text: ca lod'o, lèke dènge ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi, yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na dhu kako re karasa oka dhèu. ana madhutu na manganga, hèia ra g'ètu are-gandum ka ra'a noo-noo.

source_text: but the perushim, seeing this, said to moshiach: hinei! your talmidim are doing what is asur on shabbos!
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama parisi dhu madhutu pa'èra ad'a dhèu yahudi ra. ropa ladhe rèdhi ana madhutu yesus se tao sèmi èèna, hèia ra kai ne, peka na, ana madhutu mu, g'ètu gandum lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a-la'a! rèngu baku tao sèmi ne'e! te tatao ne sisu atora èdhi.

source_text: but moshiach said to them, have you not read what dovid hamelech did when he and those with him were hungry, how he entered into the beis hashem and ate the lechem hapanim the bread of the presence, which was not mutar permissible for him to eat nor the ones with him, but only the kohanim?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ee? miu teko bhèlu lii lolo daud, si? daud dènge ana-ana madhutu na dhu manganga titu kèna. hèia na maso asa d'ara paleo manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, ka nare roti dhu ama agama hia le mi lamatua, ka rèngu ra'a. te ngaa dhu bisa ra'e roti se dhodhoka ama agama sèra. dhèu leo bisa boe. èle ka daud si ra'a, te ngaa ca dhèu sa pasala boe si. miu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu baca mèdhi boe sasuri lii holo-nori ama lamatua!

source_text: or have you not read in the torah that on shabbos the kohanim are mechallel shabbos in the beis hamikdash and yet are blameless?
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri èèna, suri kahèi nèti sasab'a ama agama yahudi sèra, ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a. te ngaa rèngu sala boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: but i say to you that something greater than the beis hamikdash is here.
target_text: nanene! uru èèna, èmu sabaj'a ka dhu kab'ua, te ngaa limuri ne abhu dhu kab'ua risi, nuka ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a.

source_text: but if you'd had daas what this means, chesed chafatzti vlo zevachi desire mercy and not sacrifice, you would not have condemned the innocent.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na peka na, ‘dad'èi ja'a sèmi ne'e: dhèu ja'a sèra hud'i pad'elo ku rasa kasia èci dènge èci. ladhe ra tao boe madhutu j'ara ne, na, badha korban dhu rèngu rèti hia ja'a, dènge boe kab'ua. ' de ladhe miu me'a mèu sasoa nèti lii padhai lamatua ne, tatu miu pasala boe ana madhutu ja'a se. te ra tao boe sala ngaa-ngaa!

source_text: for the bar enosh moshiach is adon hashabbos.
target_text: te ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a ka dhu dènge hak ho pama'ète, peka na, dhèu bisa sab'a ngaa, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a.

source_text: and having gone from there, he went into their shul.
target_text: èle ka yesus tèke eele era èèna, la'e asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a ra.

source_text: and hinei! there was a man with a withered hand. and they questioned rebbe, melech hamoshiach, asking, is it mutar permissible to bring refuah healing on shabbos? they did this in order to bring accusation against him.
target_text: ètu ne'e, abhu mone ca dhèu dhu kacui-aai madhe cabèka. dhèu parisi sèra dhu tenge-tenge j'ara ho pasala yesus, ladhe sèmi na puri-pa'èle dhèu dhu kacui-aai madhe cabèka ne, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a. hèia ra karèi ne, peka na, madhutu atora agama èdhi, dhèu bisa puri-pa'èle dhèu, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a-la'a, do aad'o?

source_text: but rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, what man will there be among you, who owns a keves lamb, and if it falls into a pit on shabbos, will not take hold of it and lift it out?
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ladhe kahib'i-kalèbho ci'u manahu asa d'ara ro'a, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a, dhèu unu na mai name nare, sina ma?

source_text: therefore, how much more valuable is a man than a keves. for this reason, it is mutar permissible on shabbos to do hatov.
target_text: de ama lamatua sue dhèu rai-haha, risi nèti dhèu unu kahib'i-kalèbho deo na. nèti èèna ka, dhèu bisa tao j'ara dhu be'a lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a.

source_text: then rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to the man, stretch out your hand. and the man stretched out his hand. and it was restored to health, as sound as the other hand.
target_text: ka na lii dènge dhèu dhu ai madhe cabèka na, j'ole kacui-aai èu mai! hèia, na j'ole kacui-aai dhu madhe èèna, kaca'a la èle dènge ka, sama dènge kacui-aai dhu iia èèna.

source_text: but the perushim went out and took counsel against rebbe, melech hamoshiach so that they might destroy him.
target_text: ropa dhèu parisi se rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ra nasa titu kèna. èle ka ra kalua tèke eele èmu sabaj'a ne, hèia lasi pare'a, aku rèngu na, èdhi hud'i tenge ku j'ara, sèna ka pamadhe ne!

source_text: but rebbe, melech hamoshiach, having da'as of this, departed from there. and many multitudes followed rebbe, melech hamoshiach, and he brought refuah to them all.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a ngangee rèngu dhu karehe ne, nèti èèna ka la'e asa era leo. dhèu ae madhutu ne, hèia na puri-pa'èle dhèu dhu pèd'a aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach warned them that they should not make him manifest.
target_text: te ngaa na kai si, peka na, mage lami palolo kahèi dènge dhèu leo lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: this was to fulfill what was spoken through yeshayah hanavi, saying,
target_text: nèngu tao sèmi èèna, madhutu sèmi lii padhai ama lamatua dhu peka le mi dhèu nèti lii padhai na, ngara na yesaya, dhu suri tèke, na,

source_text: hen avdi etmach bo, bechiri ratztah nafshi, natati ruchi alav, mishpat lagoyim yotzi, here is my servant, whom i uphold, my chosen one in whom my soul delights, i will put my spirit on him, he will bring justice to the nations,
target_text: ladhe ku laa! nèngu ne, dhèu pajuu-paleha ja'a, dhu ja'a hag'e kore le. ja'a sue ne, aa d'ara ja'a karej'e taruu dènge ne. èèna na, ja'a pangèd'u ne roh ja'a, ho la'e aj'a-nori dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti j'ara mamuri ja'a dhu mola.

source_text: lo yitzak vlo yissah vlo yashmia bachutz kolo he will not shout nor cry out nor raise the sound of his voice in the street.
target_text: nèngu ne, ne'a boe tèb'a kakara. nèngu ne, ne'a boe padedha iisi.

source_text: kaneh ratzutz lo yishbor ufishtah chehah lo yechabenah le-emet yotzi mishpat a bruised reed he will not break nor a smoldering wick will he snuff out until rebbe, melech hamoshiach leads mishpat justice to victory.
target_text: d'ara na hua iia. dhu ne'a boe paj'èra dhèu. aj'u dhu oe padhe, na lèku eele boe. labhu dhu saruru, na tiu pamadhe boe. na loe boe aj'a-nori dhèu, toke dhèu aa'i-aa'i tao madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu mola nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: and in his name, hagoyim will put their tikvah hope.
target_text: dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i èèna na parcaya ne, lula re'a na, nèngu ne, cee.

source_text: then a man, blind and mute, who was possessed by shedim, was brought to rebbe, melech hamoshiach, and he brought refuah to him, so that the mute man was able to speak and to see.
target_text: ca tèka, rèti asa yesus ca dhèu dhu nidhu tao toke bèdhu aa ele lii. hèia yesus pa'èle ne dènge babège eele nidhu nèti dhèu ne'e. ka dhèu ne bisa nèdhi, aa bisa padhai lii.

source_text: and all the multitudes were amazed and they were saying, surely this is not the ben dovid, is he?
target_text: dhèu ae se, ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ra malaa-maloha. ra papeka na, nèngu ne'e, ele boe ana-èpu daud, dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua suri tèke karèi nèti uru ka! nèngu ne'e, tatu dhèu dhu èdhi mate tae-tae èèna!

source_text: but, having heard this, the perushim said, this one does not cast out shedim except by baal-zibbul, the sar hashedim the prince of demons.
target_text: te ngaa ropa dhèu parisi tadèngi rare, hèia ra ro'o boe parcaya. ka ra papeka, na, wee! dhèu ne bisa babège nidhu, lula dhèu aae nidhu baalsebul ka dhu pangèd'u na koasa.

source_text: but having daas of their thoughts, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, every malchut that is divided against itself is made desolate, and every ir city and bais house that is divided against itself will not stand.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a lii padhai dhèu parisi se. hèia na peka dènge dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, lii padhai miu ne, lèke boe! ladhe ètu d'ara rai cue, ana kabarai na patao-palaha, tasa mera mia ho rai ne bisa taha! sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe dhèu ètu d'ara kota èci, do d'ara èmu cue, èci patao dènge èci, tatu ra mae-manyèla, toke laho mae-mae, si!

source_text: and if hasatan casts out hasatan, he is divided against himself. how, therefore, will the malchut hasatan stand?
target_text: de ladhe nidhu pamusu dènge nidhu, aa palab'a èci dènge èci, tatu dhèu aae ra nèd'u paredha nèbhu boe!

source_text: and if by baal-zibbul i cast out the shedim, by whom do your banim sons cast them out? therefore, they will be your shofetim judges.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! dhèu miu re'a kahèi babège eele nidhu. ra pake koasa nèti nidhu, do? aad'o! de miu baku padhai lii ore dhu peka na, ja'a pake koasa nidhu, ho babège eele nidhu. pe dhèu miu unu mi ka dhu pama'ète, peka na, ngaa dhu miu galaa ne, lèke boe j'ara.

source_text: but if by the ruach hakodesh i cast out the shedim, then upon you the malchut hashem has arrived.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ja'a tare'a-re'a babège eele nidhu pake koasa nèti roh ama lamatua, èèna pad'elo na, lamatua èèna tare'a-re'a dhèu aae dhu ètu le katanga madha miu.

source_text: or how is someone able to enter the bayit hagibbor and confiscate his furnishings unless he binds the gibbor first. then he will plunder the bayit hagibbor.
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo lasi mana'u èmu dhèu èci dhu èra, nèngu hud'i èki-karadhe uuru ku dhèu lamatua èmu ne. heka na mana'u nèti mèdha-panyau na sèra.

source_text: the one not with me is against me. and the one not gathering with me scatters.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! te dhèu dhu pa'èci boe dènge ja'a, nèngu pamusu dènge ja'a. aa dhèu dhu soru-bara boe ja'a ètu d'ara sab'a-la'a, nèngu ne'a dhoka pa'iu dhèu di.

source_text: therefore, i say to you, every chet sin and gidduf blasphemy will be forgiven men, but whoever commits chillul hashem against the ruach hakodesh will not be forgiven.
target_text: de nanene paie-iie lii padhai ja'a ne! ama lamatua dhu sadia saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu. ladhe dhèu padhai lii pakarehe kolongara dhèu leo, ama lamatua sadia abho ne era. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu bani padhai pakarehe roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci, ama lamatua saku eele boe sasala na èèna.

source_text: and whoever speaks a word against the bar enosh will be granted selicha forgiveness, but whoever speaks against the ruach hakodesh, selicha will not be granted him either in the olam hazeh or in the olam habah.
target_text: ladhe dhèu pakarehe ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, ama lamatua sadia saku eele sasala na. te ngaa cee ka dhu bani padhai lii pahahe roh ama lamatua, te ngaa ama lamatua saku eele boe sasala na, masi ka toke dai mia-mia la'e!

source_text: either make the etz tree tov good and its pri fruit will be tov, or make the etz nishchat corrupt and its pri will be rah; for by its pri the etz is known.
target_text: hèia yesus padhai lii taruu dènge dhèu parisi se, peka na, ngee paie-iie! aj'u dhu be'a, hia hua dhu be'a. te ngaa aj'u dhu karehe, hia hua dhu karehe. nèti hua na, dhèu bisa tadhe aj'u ne, be'a do karehe.

source_text: you banim of nechashim sons of snakes, how are you able to speak tovot good things, for out of the abundance of the lev heart the mouth speaks.
target_text: te ngaa miu se ca ropa dènge mege, dhu ne'a dhoka kapod'e-kabèli di! miu me'a boe padhai lii dhu be'a. lula ngaa dhu tèke ètu d'ara, èèna ka dhu kalua mai nèti d'ara hèb'a na.

source_text: the ish tov good man out of the good otzar treasure brings forth good; and the ish rah out of the evil otzar brings forth evil.
target_text: dhèu be'a, tatu lii padhai na be'a, lula ètu d'ara na abhu j'ara dhu be'a. te ngaa dhèu bhelu, tatu lii padhai na karehe, lula ètu d'ara na dhu pènu dènge bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: but i say to you, that for every careless lashon horah evil speech that men speak, they will be called to account on the yom hadin the day of judgment.
target_text: lèka la lii ja'a ne! te bèli-camèd'a lod'o èle rai-haha, ama lamatua parisa lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i. lod'o èèna, dhèu èci-èci ka hud'i dhaa lii-lii nèngu dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua.

source_text: for by your devarim you will be pronounced tzodek righteous, and by your devarim you will be charged with guilt.
target_text: de mage-mage! te bèli-camèd'a èèna, ama lamatua dadoo lii-lii miu sèra, aa pama'ète peka na, miu lèke huku do, aad'o.

source_text: then some of the sofrim and perushim answered rebbe, melech hamoshiach, saying, rabbi, we desire to see an ot miraculous sign from you.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai yesus sèmi èèna, hèia pèri-pèri mese agama dènge dhèu parisi, peka dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, ama mese! ji'i neo ngèdhi tadha malaa èci, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, koasa ama, tare'a nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: but rebbe, melech hamoshiach answered them, dor rah umnaef an evil and adulterous generation seeks for an ot miraculous sign, but no ot will be given it except the ot of yonah hanavi.
target_text: te ngaa yesus jèke si, peka na, weh! miu dhèu taa limuri ne, mo'o boe madhutu ama lamatua! miu se me'a dhodhoka ad'u-ue bhelu-katub'a di! masi ka miu manèngi tadha malaa, te ngaa ja'a tao boe. lula uru èèna, lamatua hia le tadha malaa re yunus, dhèu nèti lii padhai na. èèna d'ai le!

source_text: for just as yonah was in the belly of the great fish shloshah yamim ushloshah lailahthree days and three nights, so will be the bar enosh moshiach in the heart of the earth shloshah yamim ushloshah lailot three days and three nights.
target_text: yunus pea tèlu mèu-tèlu mèda ètu d'ara kabake i'a aae ci'u. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. bèli-camèd'a ja'a kahèi ètu d'ara ro'a dhèu madhe, tèlu mèu-tèlu mèda.

source_text: the men of nineveh will stand up at the yom hadin with this generation and they will condemn it, for the men of nineveh made teshuva at the darshenen preaching of yonah, and, hinei, something much greater than yonah is here.
target_text: ladhe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, lamatua j'aj'i hakim. aa dhèu niniwe se titu j'aj'i sakasii ho galaa miu, peka na, ‘miu aa'i-aa'i se, goa! ' uru èèna, ropa dhèu niniwe sèra tadèngi lii padhai yunus, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, hèia ra tèke eele sasala ra. te ngaa miu sèmi boe èèna. masi ka limuri ne, abhu le dhèu ètu talora aae miu, dhu kapai risi nèti yunus, nuka ja'a ne. te ngaa miu se pusi-pahae boe ja'a ciki sa hèi.

source_text: the queen of the south will be made to stand up alive at the yom hadin with this generation and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to listen to the chochmah of sh'lomo and, hinei, something much greater than sh'lomo is here.
target_text: pe, ètu d'ara lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ladhe lamatua j'aj'i hakim, bhèni aae syeba nèti balèu, j'aj'i sakasii kahèi. na paj'uj'u ai na mi miu, ho na galaa miu aa'i-aa'i dhu ana loo-limuri ne, peka na, ‘miu aa'i-aa'i mi, goa! ' uru èèna, bhèni aae ne mai nèti rai kaj'èu ho neo nèdhi unu na mamèu dhèu aae soleman. te ngaa limuri ne, abhu ca dhèu ètu talora aae miu dhu kapai risi nèti dhèu aae soleman, nuka ja'a ne. te ngaa miu pusi-pahae boe ja'a ciki sa hèi.

source_text: now when the ruach hatameh unclean spirit goes out from the man, it goes through dry places seeking a manoach resting place and it does not find one.
target_text: ladhe babège eele nidhu nèti ca dhèu, nidhu ne la'e pea asa era dhu kaliu, ho j'aj'i mi era ae iisi na. te ngaa abhu boe era dhu mèci ho na pea kalili.

source_text: then it says, into my haunt i will return from where i came out. and having come out, it finds the bais standing empty, having been swept and having been put beseder in order.
target_text: hèia na pangee, peka na, ‘abhu boe era dhu be'a sèmi nèi, hua iia ja'a lèpa hari asa dhèu dhu uru èèna ja'a pea. ' ka la'e hari asa era nèngu uru èèna. na ladhe na, era ne mèu bia, aa dhu lalau rare pabe'a-be'a.

source_text: then it goes and takes along with itself seven other ruchot more evil than itself and, having entered the residence, it sets up house there, and the last state of that man has become worse than the first. thus it will be with this evil generation also.
target_text: hèia nidhu ne la'e paroa nare angalai na dhèu pidhu dhu bhabhelu ra risi nèti nèngu. ka lasi pea ètu d'ara dhèu ne, hèia aa'i-aa'i ra kakeho ne. de limuri ne, mamuri dhèu ne asa ele iie-iie. sèmi èèna kahèi lèke mi dhèu bhelu-katub'a taa limuri ne.

source_text: while he was still speaking to the multitudes, hinei, moshiachʼs em and achim stood outside, seeking to speak with him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus padhai lii era dènge dhèu ae. hèia ina dènge ari na sèra, mai neo paraga dènge ne. rèngu titu ètu li'u, ka ra pua dhèu lasi paroa ne.

source_text: and someone said to rebbe, melech hamoshiach, hinei! your em and your achim have stood outside seeking to speak with you.
target_text: hèia dhèu mai peka dènge ne, aku rèngu na, ama! ina dènge ari ama ètu li'u nèi. rèngu neo paraga dènge ama.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said in reply to the one speaking with him, who is my em and who are my achim?
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, cee ka ina ku, aa cee ka a'ari ja'a dhu tare'a-re'a?

source_text: and stretching out his hand upon his talmidim, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said, hinei, my em and my achim.
target_text: hèia na paj'uj'u asa dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu ne, ka na lii, aku nèngu na, rèngu se'e se ka, ina dènge a'ari ja'a.

source_text: for whoever does the ratzon will of avi sh'ba'shomayim, he is my ach brother and achot sister and em mother.
target_text: te dhèu dhu tao madhutu dad'èi ama ku ètu sorga, rèngu ka ina ku aa a'ari ja'a dhu tare'a-re'a.

source_text: on that day, having gone out of the bais, rebbe, melech hamoshiach sat beside the lake.
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, yesus kalua nèti èmu èèna, la'e madhèdi asa sebhe dano galilea.

source_text: and many multitudes gathered together to him so that he got into a sirah boat to sit down, and the entire multitude stood along the shore.
target_text: hèia dhèu ae-ae mai lingu rare ne. ka la'e madhèdi asa dedha koha cue, dhu panahu ètu era èèna, ho aj'a dhèu sèra. dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu dae sèra nanene ne.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach told them many things in meshalim parables, saying hinei! the sower went out to sow.
target_text: hèia na aj'a madha j'ara ae-ae mi rèngu pake lii pakasame. na lole, peka na, abhu ca dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe, dhu ceb'e hini ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: and while he sowed, on the one hand, this fell along the road, and the birds having come, devoured them.
target_text: ropa na ceb'e hini se, abhu dhu lèke ètu j'ara. hèia manu-bhui mai, ka tutu ra'e aa'i hini se.

source_text: and others fell upon the rocky places, where there is not much soil, and immediately it sprouts on account of the lack of the soilʼs depth.
target_text: te ngaa hini cahag'e lèke ètu rai dhu dènge hadhu. hini se muri malai, lula abhu rai ciki di.

source_text: and when the shemesh sun arose, the zera seed was scorched, and because it did not have a root, it withered.
target_text: te ngaa ropa lod'o rea, hèia ana aaj'u se kamale, ka mango eele si. te amo ra marèma boe ètu d'ara rai.

source_text: and others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked them.
target_text: abhu hini cahag'e dhu lèke ètu era j'u'u padhudhu. hèia j'u'u padhudhu se hèlu pamadhe aa'i si.

source_text: but others fell on the adamah tovah good ground, and they yielded fruit: the one, one hundred, the other, sixty, the other, thirty.
target_text: te ngaa abhu hini cahag'e lèke ètu rai isi. hini se muri, ka ra kapai toke hua-hela. abhu dhu tèlu nguru hari, abhu dhu èna nguru hari, aa abhu dhu d'ai cangasu hari.

source_text: the one having oznayim spiritual ears, let him hear!
target_text: cee dhu dènge ro'a dhilu, na nanene paie-iie!

source_text: and, approaching, the talmidim said to rebbe, melech hamoshiach, why in meshalim parables are you speaking to them?
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu yesus mai karèi ne, aku rèngu na, nga tao ka ama aj'a dhèu ae pake lii pakasame?

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach answered them, because to you it has been granted to have daas of the razim mysteries of the malchut hashomayim, but to those it has not been granted.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, lula miu se neo me'a tare'a-re'a paredha ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka ja'a peka mema sasoa nèti lii pakasame ne. te ngaa mi dhèu leo, ja'a aj'a pake lii pakasame.

source_text: for whoever has, will be given to him, and he will have an abundance. but whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken from him.
target_text: te dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a neo re'a dad'èi ama lamatua, pe lamatua hia ne asa ne'a ae. te ngaa dhèu dhu pusi-pahae boe dad'èi lamatua, pe lamatua tao ne asa tabha goa.

source_text: for this reason in meshalim i am speaking to them, for while seeing they do not see, and hearing they do not hear, nor do they have binah understanding.
target_text: ja'a aj'a-nori si pake dhoka lii pakasame di, lula: ‘rèngu rèdhi le, te ngaa ro'o boe re'a. rèngu tadèngi le, te ngaa ra pusi-pahae boe. '

source_text: and in them is fulfilled the nevuah prophecy of yeshayah hanavi, saying, shimu shamoa val tavinu ureu rao val teidau in hearing you will hear and by no means understand, and seeing you will see and by no means perceive.
target_text: rèngu se cakaraa dènge dhèu dhu yesaya suri mema le. yesaya èèna, nuka dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, dhu suri, na, ‘miu èèna na tadèngi, te ngaa miu pakatele dhilu. miu èèna na ladhe mèdhi, te ngaa mo'o boe pame'a ngaa dhu j'aj'i le.

source_text: hashmein lev haam hazeh vaznav hachbeid veinav hasha, pen yireh veinav uveaznav yishmah ulevavo yavin, vshav nrafah loh. for the heart of this people has been made dull, and their ears are hard of hearing, and their eyes are shut, lest they see with the their eyes and with their ears they hear, and with the lev heart they understand and they turn and i will give them refuah healing.
target_text: lula d'ara dhèu se'e adhu sèmi hadhu, ra pakatele dhilu ra, aa ra pabèdhu musi madha ra. de hud'i rèngu sène, sèna ka ro'a dhilu ra katele-katipa, aa soro tèke si, sèna ka musi madha ra bèdhu sèmi èèna. hud'i laa, ho ja'a puri-pa'èle ia ka si, lula rèngu pusi-pahae boe ja'a. '

source_text: but ashrey are your eyes, for they see, and your ears, for they hear.
target_text: te ngaa miu se, oto! lula miu ladhe mèdhi dènge musi madha, aa tadèngi dènge ro'a dhilu miu unu mi.

source_text: for truly i say to you that many neviim and tzaddikim desired to see what you see, and they did not see, and to hear what you hear, and they did not hear it.
target_text: parcaya la ja'a! uru èèna, dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, dènge dhèu dhu d'ara mola, d'ara ra neo rèdhi ngaa dhu limuri ne miu ladhe mèdhi, te ngaa bisa boe. d'ara ra neo kahèi tadèngi ngaa dhu limuri ne miu tadèngi le, te ngaa bisa boe.

source_text: you, therefore, listen to the mashal of the sower.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare, hèia yesus peka dènge ra, de mi nanene ka sasoa nèti lii pakasame deo na.

source_text: when anyone hears the dvar hamalchut and does not have binah, harah the evil one comes and seizes that which was sown in his lev heart. this is the zera seed sown along the path.
target_text: hini dhu lèke ètu j'ara, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori nèti ama lamatua nèd'u paredha, te ngaa nèngu ne'a iia boe. hèia dhèu aae nidhu mai parame nare lii holo-nori nèti d'ara dhèu ne.

source_text: and the zera sown upon the rocky places is the person listening to the dvar hashem and immediately with simcha receives it.
target_text: hini dhu ceb'e lèke ètu rai dhu pènu dènge hadhu, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua, hèia na sèmi nare dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: yet he has no root in himself but is short-lived, and when es tzarah comes or persecution on account of the dvar hashem, immediately he ceases being a maamin meshichi messianic believer and becomes meshummad apostate, falling away and giving up the faith.
target_text: te ngaa lii holo-nori ne, amo na marèma boe. nèti èèna ka, nare boe nèbhu ètu d'ara dhèu ne. ropa dhèu leo paj'èra ne lula na sèmi nare lii holo-nori ne, ka dhèu ne kèpe pa'èra heka a'aj'a sèra.

source_text: and the sown among the thorns is the one hearing the dvar word, and the rogez haolam hazehthe anxiety of this age and the mirmah deceit of riches, choke the dvar hashem and it becomes unfruitful.
target_text: aa hini dhu lèke ètu talora aae j'u'u padhudhu, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori. te ngaa nèngu bhute dènge rupa-rupa j'ara, ho pakarej'e mamuri na. hèia bhabhute se'e ka seti eele lii holo-nori ne nèti d'ara nèngu, toke dènge heka kab'ua.

source_text: and the zera sown upon the adamah tovah the good ground, this is the one who hears the dvar hashem and, understanding, indeed bears pri and, one produces a hundred, the other sixty, the other thirty.
target_text: te ngaa hini dhu lèke ètu rai isi, nuka dhèu dhu pasa paie dhilu na, sèna ka sèmi nare lii holo-nori, aa tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua. hèia na tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, sama sèmi hini dhu muri toke kapai, ka na hua ae-ae. abhu dhu tèlu nguru hari, abhu kahèi èna nguru hari, aa abhu dhu d'ai cangasu hari.

source_text: another mashal rebbe, melech hamoshiach placed before them, saying, the malchut hashomayim is like a man sowing zera tov good seed in his field.
target_text: yesus lolo hari lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na, paredha ama lamatua ne, nuka sèmi abhu ca dhèu la'e ceb'e hini dhu be'a ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: but while men slept, his oyev enemy came and oversowed weeds in between the wheat and went away.
target_text: d'ara mèda èèna, ropa dhèu aa'i-aa'i bhèj'i luu, hèia dhèu bhelu mai, ka na ceb'e lamusi j'u'u ètu d'ara oka ne.

source_text: but when the wheat sprouted and produced pri, then the weeds also appeared.
target_text: ropa hini ètu d'ara oka ne d'ai hua-hela, hèia dhèu sab'a se, ladhe rèdhi j'u'u dhu muri palere-lere dènge hini se.

source_text: so the servants of the baal bayit said to him, adoneinu, did you not sow zera tov good seed in your field? how then does it have weeds?
target_text: ka lasi peka dènge lamatua oka ne, aku rèngu na, ‘ama! ca hari ni ji'i sèle hini dhu be'a ètu d'ara oka ama, si? nga tao ka muri mai pab'ali dènge j'u'u ae-ae? '

source_text: and he said to them, an oyev did this. so the servants say to him, do you want us to go and pull them all?
target_text: lamatua oka ne dhaa, peka na, ‘èèna tatao nèti dhèu bhelu. ' hèia dhèu sab'a se peka, aku rèngu na, ‘ama, ji'i la'a ko'o eele j'u'u sèi, do? '

source_text: but he says, no, lest gathering the weeds you should uproot the wheat together with them.
target_text: te ngaa na b'ala, peka na, ‘hud'i laa, te ladhe miu ko'o eele j'u'u se, ana nganga'a èdhi se lèke bete kahèi.

source_text: permit both to grow together until the katzir harvest; and in time of the katzir, i will say to the kotzerim, collect first the weeds, and bind them into bundles to burn them. but the wheat gather into my storehouse.
target_text: hud'i rèngu sène ra muri palere-lere toke hèru puu-g'ètu. pe d'ai lod'o na, ja'a peka dènge dhèu sab'a se, na, miu pakaboko uru ku j'u'u sèra. hèia èki si ca èki-ca èki ho tunu eele si. èle ku, heka ta pakaboko isi oka kèna, sèna ka pamaso asa d'ara babesi. '

source_text: another mashal rebbe, melech hamoshiach placed before them, saying, the malchut hashomayim is like a mustard seed, which a man took and sowed in his field.
target_text: èle, ka yesus peka hari, na, ja'a pake hari lii pakasame èci, sèna ka miu me'a tasamia ama lamatua j'aj'i dhèu aae mi dhèu ae-ae. dhèu unu na sèra, mulai nuka sèmi lamusi dhu ana iiki titu kèna, dhu dhèu sèle ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: this that is indeed less than all the zeraim seeds, but when it grows, it is larger than the garden vegetables and it becomes an etz tree, so that the oph hashomayim come and dwell in its branches.
target_text: masi ka lamusi ne ana iiki d'ai seli, te ngaa ladhe na muri mai, j'aj'i aj'u dhu kapai aae ètu d'ara oka ne. toke manu-bhui tao rèd'a ètu dadana-dadana na.

source_text: another mashal rebbe, melech hamoshiach spoke to them. the malchut hashomayim is like seor leaven, which having taken, a woman hid in three satas of wheat flour until the whole was leavened.
target_text: yesus peka hari lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na, dhèu-dhèu unu ama lamatua, èci èèna ka dènge ragi dhu bhèni èci nare, pab'ali dènge tarigu ca sak. hèia roti ne ca'e toke kapai, lula ragi dhu ciki oo'e deo na.

source_text: all these things rebbe, melech hamoshiach spoke in meshalim to the multitudes. and apart from meshalim rebbe, melech hamoshiach did not speak to them:
target_text: yesus aj'a dhèu ae dènge lii lolo rupa-rupa. lii padhai na, aa'i-aa'i se, dhodhoka pake lii pakasame di.

source_text: so that might be fulfilled what was spoken through the navi, saying, eftcha vmashal pi aviah chidot i will open my mouth with parables, i will utter things having been hidden from the foundation of the world.
target_text: na aj'a sèmi èèna, sèna ka madhutu sèmi lii nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu suri tèke, peka na, pe ja'a aj'a-nori pake lii pakasame. pe ja'a lole j'ara-j'ara dhu dhèu tadèngi rèdhi mèka, karèi nèti lamatua paj'aj'i rai-haha toke d'ai sange ne'e.

source_text: then having sent away the multitudes, rebbe, melech hamoshiach came into the bais house. and moshiachʼs talmidim approached him, saying, explain to us the mashal of the weeds of the field.
target_text: èle ka, yesus lèpa èmu tèke eele dhèu ae sèra. hèia ana madhutu na sèra mai manèngi, na, ama! peka ku dènge ji'i sasoa nèti lii pakasame j'u'u deo sa!

source_text: and answering, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said, the sower of the zera tov is the bar enosh moshiach.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, dhèu dhu ceb'e hini dhu be'a èèna, nuka ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne.

source_text: the field is haolam hazeh. and the zera tov, the good seed, these are the bnei hamalchut, and the weeds, these are the bnei harahsons of the evil one.
target_text: aa oka èèna, nuka rai-haha ne. hini dhu be'a èèna, nuka dhèu-dhèu dhu j'aj'i le ana-èpu ama lamatua. aa j'u'u sèra, nuka ana pajuu nèti dhèu aae nidhu.

source_text: and the oyev the enemy sowing them is hasatan. and the katzir harvest, this is haketz haolam the end of the age. and the kotzerim reapers, harvesters are malachim angels.
target_text: aa dhèu bhelu dhu mai ceb'e lamusi j'u'u, nuka dhèu aae nidhu. aa lod'o puu-g'ètu èèna, nuka d'ai èle rai-haha ne. dhèu sab'a dhu pakaboko isi oka se, nuka ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga.

source_text: as the weeds are pulled up and gathered and are consumed with eish fire, so also it will be at the ketz haolam.
target_text: ropa d'ai èle rai-haha ne, ra oru rare j'u'u se ho tunu pakèpu si.

source_text: the bar enosh will send forth his malachim, and they will pull up and gather out of the moshiachʼs malchut all the things making meshummad apostate and the ones who are without gezetz law and antinomian.
target_text: te ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, bèli-camèd'a pua ana pajuu nèti sorga mai. rèngu èèna na pakaboko dhèu-dhèu dhu pusi-pahae boe madhutu paredha ama lamatua. aa rèngu oru rare kahèi dhèu-dhèu dhu dadugu-rariu dhèu leo, sèna ka baku madhutu paredha lamatua.

source_text: and moshiachʼs malachim will throw them into the furnace of eish; there will be weeping and grinding of teeth.
target_text: èèna na ra core dhèu bhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i se asa d'ara ai naraka, nuka sèmi j'u'u dhu ai na'e pakèpu si. ètu nèi, dhèu se rasa j'èra titu kèna, aa tangi d'ara ma'ète mae-mae loe boe ciki sa.

source_text: then the tzaddikim will shine as the shemesh sun in the malchut of their father. the one having oznayim spiritual ears, let him hear.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri mola madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, rèngu pea taruu dènge ama dhèu aae ra ètu sorga. ètu nèi, dhèu se ha'a-ha'a, hèti-hèti, nuka sèmi madha lod'o. de dhèu dhu neo tadhe mèu ja'a, pasa dhilu paie-iie!

source_text: the malchut hashomayim is like otzar treasure hidden in the field, which, having found, a man hid. and from the simcha he experienced, he goes away and sells everything he has and buys that field.
target_text: yesus tabha hari lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu neo tadhe mèu ama lamatua nèd'u paredha, rèngu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu neo abhu mèdha kab'ua aae, dhu dhèu huni tèke ètu d'ara rai cakasib'i. ka dhèu ne la'e kèi, hèia na abhu mèdha ne, nèti èèna ka na karej'e-karae. èle èèna ka, na dhènu hari mèdha deo na. hèia na lèpa hari lai-lai, la'e pahia aa'i mèdha-panyau na. ka la'e hèli nare rai ne, sèna ka na unu mèdha dhu kab'ua aae deo na.

source_text: again, the malchut hashomayim is like a merchant searching for fine pearls.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii pakasame, peka na, dhèu dhu neo tadhe mèu ama lamatua nèd'u paredha, èci èèna kahèi dènge dhèu d'aga ca dhèu dhu d'ara na neo abhu mutiara dhu kab'ua aae titu kèna. èle ka, na patangi-tenge mutiara ho neo hèli.

source_text: and having found one precious peninah pearl, he went away and liquidated everything he had and acquired it.
target_text: ropa na rage mutiara cue dhu be'a titu kèna, hèia na lèpa lai-lai, sèna ka pahia aa'i mèdha-panyau na. hèia la'e tihe mutiara ne, sèna ka j'aj'i mi unu na.

source_text: again, the malchut hashomayim is like a reshet net having been cast into the lake, a reshet collecting and gathering dagim fish of all descriptions,
target_text: yesus peka hari, na, paredha ama lamatua, nuka sèmi pèku èci dhu dhèu sab'a dhasi lasi lolo ètu d'ara dano. ka pèku ne lèke rupa-rupa i'a.

source_text: which, when this reshet net was filled, they hoisted it upon the shore, sat down, collected the tov good into a creel, and the rah evil, they threw out.
target_text: ropa pèku ne pènu dènge i'a, dhèu pèku se ded'e rèti asa dedha nebhe. hèia ra madhèdi kabhili i'a nèti pèku ne. i'a dhu be'a, ra tao asa d'ara kalera. te ngaa i'a dhu karehe, ra core eele.

source_text: thus it will be at haketz haolam hazeh the end of this world. the malachim will go out and they will separate the resha'im from among the tzaddikim.
target_text: èci èèna ka, ladhe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne. èèna na ana pajuu lamatua mai nèti sorga, sèna ka hag'e eele dhèu dhu d'ara mola nèti dhèu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: and they will throw the resha'im into the furnace of eish. in that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
target_text: dhèu dhu bhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i ra, core si asa d'ara ai naraka. ètu nèi, rèngu heka re'a j'aj'èra, aa loe boe tangi roma iisi.

source_text: did you have binah of all these things? they say to rebbe, melech hamoshiach, ken.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare, hèia yesus karèi ra, aku nèngu na, miu me'a aa'i ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai se, do? ra dhaa peka na, nge'a, ama!

source_text: so rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, therefore, every sofer scribe, torah teacher, rabbi who becomes a talmid of the malchut hashomayim is like a man a baal bayit, who takes out of his otzar treasure, chadashot new things and also yeshanot old things.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, peka na, be'a! te mese agama aa'i-aa'i dhu re'a tare'a-re'a lii holo-nori lamatua dhu suri tèke karèi nèti uru èèna, ka ra kèpe pa'èra a'aj'a ja'a, na, rèngu ca ropa dènge lamatua èmu dhu d'èi bhoke gud'a na, ho pad'elo mèdha-panyau na dhu dhui, dènge mèdha-panyau na dhu hiu.

source_text: and it came about when rebbe, melech hamoshiach finished these meshalim, that he went away from there.
target_text: ropa yesus aj'a nare dhèu ae sèra, pake lii pakasame, hèia la'e, tèke eele era èèna,

source_text: and having come into moshiachʼs shtetl, he began ministering as a moreh teacher in their shul, so that they were amazed and said, from where did this chochmah come to this one, this chochmah and these moftim miracles, wonders, omens?
target_text: ho lèpa asa rae na. d'ai nèi, maso la'e asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a, ho aj'a-nori dhèu. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadèngi lii padhai na malaa-maloha. ka ra papeka, aku rèngu na, ira ii! dhèu ne d'èlu-mèu titu kèna, nga! na sakola ètu mia ne? tasamia ka na bisa tao tadha malaa se'e?

source_text: is this not the ben hanaggar the carpenterʼs son? is not his em called miryam? and are not his achim ya'akov, yosef, shim'on and yehuda?
target_text: nèngu ne dhoka ana nèti ca dhèu tuka aj'u di. èdhi patadha be'a dènge ina na maria; aa dènge ari na aa'i-aa'i, nuka yakobis, yusuf, yudas dènge simon.

source_text: and are not his achayot sisters with us? from where, therefore, came to this one all these things?
target_text: èdhi tadhe ana hèni na kahèi, te èdhi pea ètu d'ara rae cue! de na abhu mamèu na nèti mia? aa na abhu koasa kapai ne nèti cee hari?

source_text: and they were taking offense at rebbe, melech hamoshiach. but rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, a navi prophet is not without honor except in his hometown and in his bais.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu se kacèki, toke ra ro'o heka nanene lii padhai na. te ngaa yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a! dhèu d'èi risi pakab'ua dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu mai nèti era leo, te ngaa ra pakab'ua boe dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu mai nèti rae rèngu unu ra.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach did not accomplish in that place many moftim, because of their lack of emunah faith and bitachon trust.
target_text: lula d'ara ra adhu, toke ra parcaya boe yesus, nèti èèna ka na tao tadha malaa ae boe ètu d'ara rae na.

source_text: at that time reports about rebbe, melech hamoshiach came to the oznayim ears of herod the tetrarch.
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu aae herodes nèd'u paredha ètu propensi galilea. nèngu ne dhu tadèngi le kahèi rupa-rupa j'ara lula-nèti yesus.

source_text: and he said to his servants, this one is yochanan of the tevilah of teshuva. he has had his techiyah resurrection from hamesim the dead and for this reason the moftim wonders are working in him.
target_text: na peka dènge dhèu sab'a na sèra, aku nèngu na, ele boe yesus ne, nuka yohanis tuka sarani, dhu ca hari ni ja'a pua dhèu poro rare kètu na. limuri ne, na mamuri hari le! nèti èèna ka, na abhu koasa, tao tadha-tadha malaa sèra.

source_text: for herod had yochanan arrested and bound him and threw him into the beit hasohar prison, on account of herodias, the wife of his brother philippos.
target_text: dhèu aae herodes peka sèmi èèna, lula uru èèna nèngu dhu tao lii langu dènge yohanis, toke na kèpe yohanis aa pamaso asa d'ara bèdho. j'aj'aj'i lii langu ne, sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu aae herodes leo nare dhèu èmu ari na pelipus, ngara na herodias. aa te ngaa pelipus dènge herodias dhae pa'ia-pa'ela mèka.

source_text: for yochanan kept on saying to him, it is asur for you to have her.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yohanis kai ne pahari-pahari, peka na, ama dhèu aae, baku paleo èmu dènge dhèu èmu ari mu. te j'ara ne, pamèci boe dènge ad'a èdhi dhèu yahudi!

source_text: and although herod was desiring to kill yochanan, he feared the crowd, because they considered yochanan a navi.
