target_text: ropa yudas d'ai dhèu se'e, hèia na karèi, peka na, ama-ama! ladhe ja'a bhoke j'ara ho miu bisa kèpe yesus, miu hia ja'a ngaa? hèia dhèu se dhaa, peka na, ladhe èu neo pahie ne dènge ji'i, na ji'i b'ae. ka ra ige rare tèlu nguru doi iia, aa ra j'ole asa yudas.

source_text: and from then on he was seeking an opportunity that he might hand rebbe, melech hamoshiach over.
target_text: èle, ka yudas li'u ka la'e, hèia na tenge j'ara ho saraka yesus asa d'ara adhe-aai rèngu.

source_text: but at the onset of chag hamatzot, moshiachʼs talmidim approached him, saying, where do you wish we should prepare for you your seder?
target_text: d'ara tèu mai-tèu mai, abhu lod'o babe'a dhèu yahudi dhu nanèbhu na pidhu lod'o. ra pangare lod'o babe'a se, na, ‘pesta roti dhu pake boe ragi'. ropa pesta èèna neo mulai, ana madhutu yesus se mai karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ama! mèda ne'e, èdhi bhoke lod'o babe'a èdhi. de ama neo sèna ka ji'i la'a roro kahib'i-kalèbho, aa lalau era pesta paska ètu mia?

source_text: and he said, go into the city to such and such person and say to him, our rebbe says, my time is at hand. with you i am observing pesach with my talmidim.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, peka na, lami asa d'ara kota, pe mi paraga dènge ama ca dhèu. miu peka dènge ne sèmi ne'e, ‘ama! ama mese rasa lod'o mamadhe na nèbhu heka. hèia na manèngi era èci ètu d'ara èmu ama, sèna ka na tao kalela paska dènge ana-ana madhutu na. '

source_text: and the talmidim did as rebbe, melech hamoshiach commanded them, and they prepared the seder.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare, hèia ana-ana madhutu na, tao sèmi dhu na peka. ka ra lalau nganga'a kalela paska ètu era èèna.

source_text: when erev came, rebbe, melech hamoshiach was sitting bimesibba reclining at tish with the shneym asar talmidim.
target_text: ropa d'ai mèda, hèia yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na, dhèu canguru dua sèra, madhèdi ra'a-rinu.

source_text: and as they were eating with their rebbe, he said, omein, i say to you that one of you will be my betrayer.
target_text: ropa dhu ra'a era, hèia na lii, peka na, mi nanene! ca dhèu nèti miu se, èèna na pahie ja'a asa adhe-aai dhèu leo kara.

source_text: and much distressed, each one began to say to him, surely i am not the one, adoni?
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, d'ara rèngu roe-bhilu. ka rèngu èci-èci karèi yesus, peka na, dhèu dhu ama peka deo na, ja'a aad'o, sina ma?

source_text: but, in reply, he said, the one having dipped the hand into the bowl with me, this one is my betrayer.
target_text: hèia na peka, na, dhèu dhu cèb'u roti na palere-lere dènge ja'a asa d'ara mago ne, nèngu ka dhu pahie ja'a.

source_text: indeed the bar enosh goes as it was written concerning him, but oy to that man through whom the bar enosh is betrayed. it would have been better for that man if he had not been born.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, hud'i madhe ku, nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua. te ngaa mate unu na! dhèu dhu neo pahie ja'a, bèli-camèd'a pasae nare pala na! hua iia risi, ina na baku nara iisi ne!

source_text: and, in reply, yehudah the betrayer of rebbe, melech hamoshiach, said, surely i am not the one, rabbi? moshiach says to yehudah, you have said it.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yudas karèi kahèi, peka na, tatu dhèu dhu ama peka deo na, ja'a aad'o, sina ma? hèia yesus b'ala ne, mema tare'a èu unu mu ka dhu peka lii èèna. de cee hari?

source_text: and at the seudah, rebbe, melech hamoshiach, having taken matzah, having made hamotzi, he broke the matzah, giving the afikoman to the talmidim, and said, take and eat, this is my basar.
target_text: rèngu dhu ra'a era, hèia yesus ded'e nare roti cue, aa na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka na pamae roti ne, hèia j'ole asa ana-ana madhutu na, aa na peka, roti ne'e ne, ngi'u ja'a. mere ho mi'e ka!

source_text: and having taken the cup of redemption and having made the bracha, he gave it to them, saying, drink from it, all of you.
target_text: èle ka, yesus nare galaa dhu pènu dènge èi anggor, ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. hèia na j'ole asa ana-ana madhutu na, aa na lii, peka na, miu aa'i-aa'i mi, mere ho minu.

source_text: for this is my dahm habrit hachadasha, which is poured out larabbimfor many for the selicha forgiveness of chattaim sins.
target_text: te èi anggor ne'e ne, raa ja'a kèna. èèna na ja'a madhe, te ngaa raa ja'a suti, sèna ka sui kore dhèu ae nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. raa ne'e j'aj'i mi tadha ho pasanèd'e dhèu, peka na, ngaa dhu ama lamatua pajaji èèna, mema limuri ne j'aj'i le. de mere ho minu ka!

source_text: and i say to you, i will by no means drink from now on of this pri hagefen fruit of the vine until that day when i drink it with you chadash new in the malchut avi.
target_text: te ngaa nanene paie-iie! mulai nèti mèda ne, ja'a kinu heka èi anggor. pe ja'a dènge ama ku madhèdi ngèd'u paredha sama-sama ètu sorga, heka ja'a kinu hari kèna dènge miu.

source_text: and having sung the hallel, they went out to the har hazeytim.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia rèngu sod'a lii sod'a èci, ho koa-kio ama lamatua. ka mèda èèna kahèi, rèngu lasi dènge ka asa ledhe saitun.

source_text: then rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to them, all of you will be offended at me during this night, for it has been written, hach es haroeh utefutsen hatsonstrike the shepherd and the sheep will be scattered.
target_text: ropa ètu d'ara kakako rèngu, yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, ciki hari ètu d'ara mèda ne'e kahèi, miu aa'i-aa'i mi rai tèke eele ja'a mesa-mesa ku. te dhu suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, ‘èèna na, ama lamatua pamadhe ana madhenga badha, ka kahib'i-kalèbho na rai paj'ala. '

source_text: but after i undergo techiyas hamoshiach i will go ahead of you to the galil.
target_text: ja'a madhe tare'a, te ngaa ladhe ja'a mamuri hari, laku mate miu ètu propensi galilea.

source_text: and, in reply, kefa said to him, if everyone will be offended at you, i never will be offended.
target_text: te ngaa petrus d'èi boe nanene lii na, ka na peka, ama! masi ka dhèu leo rai tèke eele ama, te ngaa ja'a rai boe!

source_text: he said to him, omein, i say to you that balailah hazeh during this night, before a tarnegol cock crows, you will make hakhchashah denial of me shalosh pe'amim three times.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala aku nèngu na, petrus! sèmi èèna, do? lèka la lii ja'a ne! ètu d'ara mèda ne'e ne kahèi, manu dhae kokotoo mèka, te èu dhu pasili le tèlu hari, peka na, èu tadhe boe ja'a!

source_text: kefa says to him, even if it is necessary for me to die al kiddush ha-shem with you, by no means will i deny you. likewise all the talmidim spoke also.
target_text: te ngaa petrus no'o boe sèmi. ka na peka, aad'o, ama! ladhe ama madhe, ja'a madhe kahèi. te ja'a rai boe, tèke eele ama! angalai petrus se, peka sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: then rebbe, melech hamoshiach comes with them to a place being called gat-shmanim, and rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to the talmidim, sit here until i go over there and daven.
target_text: ka yesus si kako taruu asa ledhe saitun, d'ai d'ara oka cue, ngara na getsemani. ètu era ne'e yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na, miu madhèdi uuru ku mi ne'e, te ja'a neo laku manèngi-mangaj'i asa nèi.

source_text: and having taken kefa and the two sons of zavdai, rebbe, melech hamoshiach began to be sorrowful and distressed with agmat nefesh grief.
target_text: te ngaa na paroa nare petrus, yakobis dènge yohanis, ho lasi palere-lere dènge ne. mulai nèti èèna ka, d'ara na ma'ète laho mae-mae, aa roe-bhilu.

source_text: then he says to them, my nefesh is deadly grieved, even to the point of mavet. remain here and stay awake with me.
target_text: rèngu kako kaj'èu mèka, te na peka dènge rèngu, aku nèngu na, d'ara ja'a susa titu kèna! ja'a nuka sèmi oe madhe sa. miu madhèdi, mate ja'a mi ne'e.

source_text: and having gone forward a short distance, rebbe, melech hamoshiach fell upon his face, davening and saying, avi, if it is possible, let this kos pass from me. but not as i will, but as you will.
target_text: ka la'e ako kaj'èu ciki, hèia na patitu kètu urutuu ho sabaj'a, aku nèngu na, ama pasue! ladhe ama d'èi na, ja'a baku pasae j'aj'èra ne'e. te ngaa baku madhutu dad'èi ja'a, hud'i laa madhutu dad'èi ama di.

source_text: then he comes to the talmidim and finds them sleeping, and he says to kefa, so were you not strong enough to be awake for one hour with me?
target_text: sabaj'a nare, hèia lèpa la'e asa era ana madhutu na dhèu tèlu sèra. te ngaa rèngu dhu bhèj'i luu. ka yesus parèi si, hèia na lii dènge petrus, peka na, hee, petrus! nga tao ka miu se bhèj'i? ja'a ètu nèi nèbhu boe, te ngaa miu lake mere boe beke ciki sa mate ja'a!

source_text: stay awake and offer tefillos, lest you enter lidey nisayon. indeed the ruach is willing but the basar is weak.
target_text: ruri pamako musi madha miu. kèd'i ho beke dènge ja'a. te d'ara miu mema d'èi tao dhu be'a, te ngaa ngi'u miu èra boe. de hua iia miu sabaj'a, sèna ka ladhe lèke dadugu-rariu miu bisa taha.

source_text: again, for a second time, having left, he davened, saying, avi, if it is not possible for this to pass by except i drink it, let yeaseh rtzonechah your will be done.
target_text: ka yesus la'e hari sabaj'a, peka na, ama! ladhe ja'a hud'i pasae ku j'aj'èra ne'e, hud'i laa madhutu dad'èi ama di.

source_text: and having come again, rebbe, melech hamoshiach found the talmidim sleeping, for their eyes were too heavy to stay open.
target_text: sabaj'a nare, hèia na mai hari asa era ana madhutu na dhèu tèlu se. te ngaa dhu ra bhèj'i hari, lula musi madha ra sakaa titu kèna.

source_text: and having left them again and having gone away, he was davening for the shlishit third time, saying the same words.
target_text: ka na tèke eele si, la'e hari manèngi-mangaj'i catèka. na manèngi-mangaj'i hari mi ama, sèna ka baku soro tèke nèngu pasae j'aj'èra èèna, te ngaa hud'i laa madhutu dhoka dad'èi ama di.

source_text: then he comes to the talmidim and says to them, sleep on now and take your rest. hinei! the hour is at hand, and the bar enosh is being betrayed into the hands of chote'im sinners.
target_text: sabaj'a nare ka, na lèpa hari, la'e parèi ana madhutu na, peka na, miu se bhèj'i taruu, do? kèd'i ka! te dhèu dhu neo pahie ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, dètu le. dhèu se mai ho kèpe ja'a kèna, ho saraka asa adhe-aai dhèu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: arise, and let us go. hinei! my betrayer has drawn near.
target_text: wee, kèd'i ka! bhoke musi madha miu, ladhe ku asa nèi. te dhèu dhu pahie ja'a, nuka mai nèi.

source_text: and while he was still speaking hinei! yehudah, one of the shneym asar, came and with him came a great multitude with swords and clubs from the rashei hakohanim chief priests and the ziknei haam the elders of the people.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii era, yudas dhu nare le era èèna dènge dhèu ae-ae. dhèu se mai rèti hela dènge aj'u cèki ho neo kèpe ne. rèngu tao sèmi ne'e, lula madhutu paredha nèti kètu agama yahudi, dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra.

source_text: now the betrayer had given them a signal, saying, whomever i may give the neshikah kiss, he is the one. chap grab him!
target_text: yudas dhu peka mema le mi dhèu se'e, na, miu ladhe paie-iie! dhèu dhu ja'a uu, nèngu ka dhu miu kèpe! te nèngu ka dhu miu tenge!

source_text: and immediately, he approached rebbe, melech hamoshiach, and said, shalom, rebbe. and he gave him the neshikah.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai madha yesus, hèia yudas lii dènge ka, saloom, ama mese! hèia yudas uu yesus.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to him, chaver, do what you came for. then, having approached, they laid hands on rebbe, melech hamoshiach and arrested him.
target_text: èle ka, yesus peka dènge ne, hee, yudas! tao ka laa, madhutu dad'èi èu. ka dhèu ae sèra ara lasi neo kèpe ne.

source_text: and hinei! one of the ones with him stretched out his hand, drew his cherev, and struck the servant of the kohen gadol, cutting off his ear.
target_text: te ngaa dhu re'a boe, na, dhèu unu yesus ca dhèu dhu bete hela na, ka seru pama'ète rèu dhilu dhèu èci. dhèu dhu nu'a ne, nuka ca dhèu ènu nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: then rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to him, return your cherev into its place; for all who take the sword will die by the sword.
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia yesus lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, pasaluu hela èu èèna asa d'ara sope na. te dhèu dhu pake rèka ho neo uri pamere lii langu, èèna na nèngu madhe dènge rèka kahèi.

source_text: or do you think that i am not able to call upon avi, and he will provide me now more than shneym asar legions of malachim?
target_text: èu me'a boe, do? ja'a bisa manèngi ama ku, ho na hia ana pajuu na d'ai nguru riho mai nèti sorga, sèna ka soru-bara ja'a.

source_text: but how then may the kitvei hakodesh be fulfilled that say it must happen thus?
target_text: te ngaa hud'i laa, ra kèpe ja'a. te aa'i-aa'i dhu suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua lula-nèti ja'a ne, hud'i j'aj'i ku.

source_text: at that moment, he said to the crowd, do you have the chutzpah nerve to come out, as against a revolutionary, with swords and clubs to arrest me? daily in the beis hamikdash i was sitting saying my shiurim and you did not arrest me.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu mai kèpe ne, aku nèngu na, madhutu miu, ja'a ne dhèu bhelu, do? nga tao ka miu mai kèpe ja'a ne, mèti dènge hela dènge aj'u cèki? bèli-bèli ja'a aj'a miu ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, te ngaa dhèu èci sa tao boe ngaa-ngaa mi ja'a.

source_text: but this all happened that the kitvei hakodesh of the neviim might be fulfilled. then the talmidim deserted rebbe, melech hamoshiach and fled.
target_text: te ngaa hud'i laa! mai ka, kèpe ja'a! te j'ara ne'e ne, dhu suri tèke le karèi nèti uru ka, ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua. ropa ana madhutu yesus rèdhi sèmi èèna, ra madha'u titu kèna. hèia ra rai tèke eele ne mesa-mesa.

source_text: but the ones having arrested rebbe, melech hamoshiach led him away to caiapha the kohen gadol, where the sofrim and the zekenim elders were gathered together.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia dhèu dhu kèpe yesus, rèti ne asa èmu kètu kapai risi agama yahudi dhu ngara na, kayafas, lula dhèu kapai sèra dhu pakaboko le ètu era èèna. dhèu se nuka, kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, aa dhèu heka ad'a sèra.

source_text: and kefa was following rebbe, melech hamoshiach from far away. he followed him as far as the courtyard of the kohen gadol and, having gone inside it, kefa was sitting down with the servants to see the maskana outcome.
target_text: ropa ra rèti yesus, petrus madhutu nèti limuri, toke d'ai èmu kètu kapai risi agama yahudi èèna. petrus la'e kahèi asa madha èmu, ho madhèdi dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu ètu sèra. te neo ne'a, ngaa ka dhu j'aj'i.

source_text: and the rashei hakohanim and the sanhedrin all were seeking edut sheker false testimony of false witnesses against yehoshua so that they might put him to death.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu ne, kètu agama yahudi sèra dhu padhue-padhai dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu madhèdi uri lii langu agama. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra tenge j'ara, sèna ka pamanahu yesus, lula ra neo huku pamadhe ne.

source_text: and they found none, though many shakranim liars came forward. at last, two came forward
target_text: masi ka rèngu hia sakasii monya ae kahèi, te ngaa rèngu abhu boe sasala èci sa dhu rèngu bisa pake. nèbhu boe ka, rèngu abhu sakasii dhèu dua.

source_text: and said, this one said, i am able to bring about a churban destruction of the beis hamikdash of hashem and within shloshah yamim to rebuild it.
target_text: dhèu dua se, peka na, ji'i tadèngi le kahèi, dhèu ne peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a ja'a paguri eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. te ngaa ètu d'ara tèlu lod'o, ja'a patitu kore hari. '

source_text: and having got up, the kohen gadol said to rebbe, melech hamoshiach, do you answer nothing? for what do these men give edut testimony against you?
target_text: ka kètu kapai risi agama yahudi, kèd'i titu ètu madha dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhèdi ètu era èèna. hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, èu tadèngi le lii galaa dhèu se'e dhu ra galaa èu. nga tao ka èu b'ala boe ca hèb'a sa?

source_text: but rebbe, melech hamoshiach was silent. and the kohen gadol said to him, i adjure you by hashem, elohim chayyim, to tell us if you are the rebbe, melech hamoshiach ben haelohim.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa boe ngaa-ngaa. hèia kètu kapai ne karèi hari, na, ja'a neo karèi! te ngaa èu hud'i dhaa tare'a-re'a ku, nuka sèmi èu dhaa mi ama lamatua dhu mamuri ètu sorga. abhu dhèu dhu peka na, èu ne, kristus, ana ama lamatua dhu na moa tèke karèi nèti uru ka. tare'a sèmi èèna, do?

source_text: rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to him, you said it. but i say to you, from now on you will see the bar enosh sitting at the right hand of gevurah power and his bias coming will be with anenei hashomayimclouds of heaven.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, peka na, tare'a, nuka sèmi lii ama èèna. te ngaa sanèd'e! te bèli-camèd'a miu mèdhi ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. pe ja'a madhèdi ètu baboa g'ana ama lamatua ètu sorga, sèna ka kèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge ne, dhu koasa na kapai risi eele èèna. èle na, ja'a puru mai hari ètu dedha ra'i-liru.

source_text: then the kohen gadol made the keriah rending, tearing of his garments, saying, he has committed chillul hashem. what further need do we have of edut? hinei! now you have heard the chillul hashem.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi nare yesus peka sèmi èèna, hèia kètu kapai ne nasa bia, toke na ciu pamae kodho madhera na. hèia na pa'oo mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhèdi ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, èdhi parluu sakasii tao ngaa hari era! miu unu mi tadèngi le dènge ro'a dhilu miu, lii padhai na. nèngu tao iisi na j'aj'i ana ama lamatua. ne'e ne pahaha ama lamatua! miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a le, na, madhutu atora agama èdhi, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tao iisi na nuka sèmi ama lamatua, na, dhèu ne hud'i madhe ku!

source_text: what does it seem to you? and, in reply, they said, he is deserving of mishpat mavet, the death penalty.
target_text: de miu neo pama'ète sèmi mia hari? hèia aa'i-aa'i ra parodha, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne mema sala tare'a! de hud'i huku pamadhe ne!

source_text: then they spat into his face and they struck him and they slapped him,
target_text: ka dhèu pèri-pèri lasi sabhuu ilu mi yesus. hèia ra hake-paru, aa tèb'e pa'oke ne.

source_text: saying, give us a dvar nevuah, rebbe, melech hamoshiach. who is the one who hit you?
target_text: èle ka, ra lalangu ne, peka na, wee! èu ne'e ka kristus, si? èu peka sèku! dhèu cee ka dhu j'ubhu èu?

source_text: now kefa was sitting outside in the courtyard. and one maid approached kefa, saying, and you were with yehoshua of the galil!
target_text: lod'o èèna, petrus madhèdi era ètu madha èmu. ka ènu bhèni ca dhèu mai lii dènge ne, peka na, deo na, èu kahèi palere-lere dènge yesus, dhèu nasaret èèna, si?

source_text: but kefa denied it before everyone, saying, i do not have daas of what you are saying.
target_text: te ngaa na pasili ètu madha dhèu ae sèra, peka na, aad'o! nga tao ka èu karèi sèmi èèna! ja'a tadhe boe ne.

source_text: and having gone out to the gate, another saw kefa and says to the bystanders, there! this one was with yehoshua of natzeret!
target_text: ka petrus kalua la'e titu ètu hèb'a oka. hèia bhèni leo hari èci ladhe nèdhi ne ètu èèna. ka bhèni ne peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, deo na ja'a kèdhi dhèu ne'e ne palere-lere dènge yesus, dhèu nasaret èèna.

source_text: and again kefa denied it with a shevuah oath, i do not know the man!
target_text: hèia petrus jèke ne, peka na, èu ne tao-tao huj'u! ja'a bani subha! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu nèi!

source_text: and after a little while the bystanders came and said to kefa, truly also you are one of them, for even your accent gives you away!
target_text: nèbhu boe ka dhèu leo ètu sèra sa peka dènge ne, hee! èu ne baku kapod'e-kabèli d'ara lii, dhu peka na, èu kako palere boe dènge dhèu ne! te nèti lii padhai èu, èci èèna ka dènge laloe lii dhèu galilea!

source_text: then kefa began to curse and swear, i do not know the man! and immediately a tarnegol cock crowed.
target_text: te ngaa na padhèd'a, ka b'ala, aku nèngu na, wee! ja'a subha dènge kolongara ama lamatua! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu ne'e ne! ropa na peka nare sèmi èèna, hèia manu kokotoo dènge.

source_text: and kefa remembered the word which rebbe, melech hamoshiach had said: before a tarnegol cock crows, you will deny me shalosh pe'amim three times. and kefa went out and wept bitterly.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi lii kokotoo manu, hèia petrus ngee nèdhi lii yesus, dhu peka na, manu dhae kokotoo mèka, te èu dhu pasili le tèlu hari, peka na, èu tadhe boe ja'a. sanèd'e nare lii ne'e, hèia la'e asa li'u ka tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: now when boker had come, all the rashei hakohenim and the ziknei haam took counsel together against yehoshua to put him to death.
target_text: mad'ae aae era, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu uri lii langu agama sèra, rare lii èci sèna ka neo pamadhe yesus.

source_text: and having performed the akedah binding, they led him away, and delivered him up to pilate the governor.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ra èki ne rèti asa madha gubernur pilatus. te rèngu d'èi sèna ka gubernur huku pamadhe ne.

source_text: then when yehudah, who had betrayed moshiach, saw that yehoshua had been condemned, he felt remorse and returned the sheloshim shiklei kesef thirty pieces of silver to the rashei hakohanim and the zekenim,
target_text: ropa yudas tadèngi na, yesus abhu hahuku madhe, hèia na manyasa, lula nèngu ka dhu pahie yesus. ka la'e hari asa kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra, ho neo hia hari la'a doi iia tèlu nguru bua sèra.

source_text: saying chatati i have sinned. i have betrayed dahm naki innocent blood. but they said, what is that to us? see to that yourself!
target_text: na peka na, ja'a tao le sasala-sasigo, lula ja'a pahie le dhèu dhu dènge boe sasala. te ngaa dhèu se b'ala, aku rèngu na, wee! ji'i se pusi-pahae heka èu ne! èu mesa mu ka dhu d'ui more sasala èèna.

source_text: and yehudah threw the shiklei kesef pieces of silver into the beis hamikdash and departed; and, having gone away, yehudah hanged himself.
target_text: ka yudas ceb'e eele doi sèra asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. hèia la'e kadhoe iisi na, toke na madhe aapa.

source_text: and the rashei hakohanim took the shiklei kesef and said, it is asur forbidden to put these into the beis hamikdash otzar treasury, vi-bahlt since it is blood money.
target_text: hèia kètu agama yahudi sèra kaboko rare doi dhu na ceb'e eele sèra. ra padhue, aku rèngu na, doi se'e mage èdhi tao asa d'ara boaraka doi, lula doi se doi kaj'alu.

source_text: and they took counsel together and they bought the potterʼs field as a beis hakevoros cemetery for zarim foreigners.
target_text: de be'a risi èdhi hèli tare rai ca kasib'i nèti dhèu tao èru rai sèi. ladhe dhèu mai nèti rai leo, do, dhèu dhu èdhi tadhe boe madhe, èdhi padhane si ètu era ne'e ne.

source_text: for this reason that field has been called the sadeh hadahm field of blood to this day.
target_text: ka ra hèli rai ne, kab'ua na nèti doi deo sa. nèti èèna ka, rai ne, toke d'ai sange ne'e, dhèu pangare na, ‘rai raa'.

source_text: then that which was spoken through yirmeyah hanavi was fulfilled, saying, and they took the sheloshim kasef thirty pieces of silver, hayekar the price of the one whose price had been set by the bnei yisroel.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu madhutu lii nèti ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yermia, dhu suri tèke na, rèngu pake doi iia tèlu nguru bua ho hèli rai. rèngu pake doi se, lula doi se kab'ua nèti hèli dhèu, madhutu sèmi dhu dhèu isra'el pama'ète rare le.

source_text: and they gave them for the potters field as hashem directed me.
target_text: rai ne, rèngu hèli nèti dhèu tao èru rai, madhutu lii paredha dhu ama lamatua hia mi ja'a.

source_text: now rebbe, melech hamoshiach stood before the governor, and the governor questioned rebbe, melech hamoshiach saying, are you the melech hayehudim? and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to him, it is as you say.
target_text: ropa dhèu se rèti yesus d'ai gubernur, hèia na karèi yesus, tasamia? èu ne, tare'a-re'a dhèu aae dhèu yahudi, do? na dhaa, peka na, tare'a. ama peka lèke kèna.

source_text: and while rebbe, melech hamoshiach was being accused by the rashei hakohanim and the zekenim, he answered nothing.
target_text: te ngaa ropa kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra galaa ne dènge lii langu ae-ae, na dhaa boe ca hèb'a sa hèi.

source_text: then pilate said to rebbe, melech hamoshiach do you not hear how many things they give edut against you?
target_text: ka gubernur karèi hari ne, peka na, èu tadèngi boe lii padhai lii rèngu, do? dhèu se hia sasala ae-ae mi dedha èu. te ngaa tasamia ka èu b'ala boe si hèi? !

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach did not answer him with even one word, so that the governor was quite amazed.
target_text: te ngaa na dhaa boe ca hèb'a sa hèi, toke gubernur malaa.

source_text: now at the chag festival, pesach the governor was accustomed to release for the multitude any one prisoner they wanted.
target_text: tèu mai-tèu mai, dhu tema le, ladhe d'ai ka lod'o kalela paska, dhèu yahudi hag'e rare ana bèdho ca dhèu, sèna ka gubernur patabuli ne.

source_text: and they were holding at the time a notorious prisoner, called bar-abba.
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu bèdho ca dhèu, ngara na barabas. dhèu aa'i-aa'i tadhe le nèngu ne, lula nèngu ca dhèu bhelu-katub'a titu kèna.

source_text: when, therefore, they were gathered together, pilate said to them, whom do you want me to release for you, bar-abba or yehoshua called moshiach?
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, dhèu ae lasi asa gubernur pilatus ho manèngi, sèna ka patabuli dhèu bèdho èci, sèmi biasa. hèia pilatus karèi si, aku nèngu na, be'a. de ja'a patabuli cee? ètu ne'e barabas, aa abhu kahèi yesus, dhu dhèu paroa ne, kristus. mia ka dhu ja'a patabuli? miu ka dhu pama'ète.

source_text: for pilate knew that because of kinah envy they had delivered yehoshua up.
target_text: gubernur peka sèmi èèna, te ne'a na kètu agama yahudi rèti yesus asa nèngu, lula rèngu se tèka d'ara dènge yesus.

source_text: and while pilate was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, have nothing to do with that tzaddik; for last night i suffered greatly in a chalom dream because of yehoshua.
target_text: gubernur ètu d'ara uri lii langu ne era, dhèu èmu na moa lii, peka na, ama! mage-mage, oo! te yesus ne dhu dènge boe sasala. lula nèngu ne'e ka, mèda deo na, ja'a nii aapa. toke d'ai sange ne'e, d'ara ja'a dhae tèka mèka.

source_text: however, the rashei hakohanim and the zekenim persuaded the multitudes to ask for bar-abba, but yehoshua they should destroy.
target_text: te ngaa kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra, dadugu dhèu ae ètu èèna, ho ra manèngi gubernur patabuli barabas, aa huku pamadhe yesus.

source_text: but the governor answered, saying to them, which of the two do you want me to release for you? and they said, bar-abba.
target_text: ka na karèi hari si, aku nèngu na, nèti dhèu dua se, mia ka dhu ja'a patabuli? hèia aa'i-aa'i ra dhaa, peka na, barabas! patabuli barabas di!

source_text: in reply, pilate says to them, what, therefore, may i do with yehoshua, the one called the rebbe, melech hamoshiach? everyone says, let him be made talui al haetz being hanged on the tree! be hanged on haetz!
target_text: èle ka na karèi si, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a tao tasa mera mia mi yesus, dhu ra peka na kristus ne? hèia aa'i-aa'i ra pa'oo-parodha peka na, paku pamadhe ne asa aj'u palolo-palèbha!

source_text: but pilate said, why? what rah evil has he done? but they kept shouting all the more, saying, let him be hanged on haetz!
target_text: èle èèna ka, gubernur karèi hari, peka na, te sala na, ngaa? ja'a parisa le, te ngaa abhu boe sasala na èci sa! te ngaa ra asa pa'oo-parodha, aku rèngu na, pamadhe ne! paku ne asa aj'u palolo-palèbha!

source_text: and when pilate saw that he was accomplishing nothing, but rather that a riot was starting, he took water and washed his hands in front of the multitude, saying, i am innocent of this manʼs blood; see to that yourselves.
target_text: nèbhu boe, na ne'a heka tao tasamia hari, lula dhèu se'e asa ka ra hino neo patao. nèti èèna ka, nare èi ho j'amo ai ètu madha dhèu ae-ae sèra, aa na peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ja'a tago boe mamadhe dhèu ne'e ne! miu aa'i-aa'i mi ka dhu hud'i pasae mere mamadhe na!

source_text: and, in reply, all the people said, his dahm be on us and on our yeladim.
target_text: hèia dhèu se'e dhaa dènge lii pa'oo-parodha peka na, oo, hud'i laa! hud'i laa ji'i dènge ana-èpu ji'i tago ngare raa na!

source_text: then pilate released bar-abba to them. but after having rebbe, melech hamoshiach scourged, he handed him over to be hanged on haetz.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia na peka, la'a, sina ma. hèia na patabuli barabas madhutu dad'èi ra. èle èèna ka, na pua dhèu j'aga, lasi kalabhe yesus pake gui. game rare, ka sordad'u rèti yesus, sèna ka neo paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: then the soldiers of the governor took him into the praetorium and gathered the whole cohort against rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: èle èèna ka, sordad'u ère rèti yesus asa tana lapa ètu d'ara benteng rèngu. d'ai nèi, rèngu paroa rare angalai ra ca batalion.

source_text: and they stripped him and put a royal scarlet robe on him, and,
target_text: hèia ra papake ne kodho madhera èci dhu mea aae.

source_text: after weaving a keter of thorns, they placed it on his head and put a reed in his right hand, and they fell down before him and mocked him saying, hail, melech hayehudim!
target_text: ka rare loro aj'u padhudhu ra ènyu tao sèmi solo. hèia ra ènyi solo ne mi kètu yesus, ho ra sasei ne, tao nuka sèmi rèngu ded'e dhèu aae hiu, dhu pake solo dhèu aae. èle èèna ka, ra j'ole hia ne aj'u ca'èta asa ai g'ana na, nuka sèmi tatea paredha. hèia ra patitu kètu urutuu ra, patangara dènge yesus, aa ra pamakae ne, peka na, pakab'ua dhèu aae dhèu yahudi.

source_text: and they spat on rebbe, melech hamoshiach and took the reed and began to beat him on the head.
target_text: hèia ra sabhuu ne ilu, aa rare aj'u ca'èta dhu na kèpe deo na, ka ra d'eu kètu na.

source_text: and after they had made leitzonus mockery of rebbe, melech hamoshiach, they took off his robe and put his garments on him, and led him away to hang him on haetz.
target_text: ropa ra sasei rare ne, hèia ra bhoke eele kodho madhera. èle èèna ka, ra papake hari mèdha-papake na. ka rèti ne asa li'u kota yerusalem, ho neo paku ne mi aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: and as they were coming out, they found a man from cyrene named shim'on, whom they pressed into service to bear moshiachʼs etz.
target_text: ropa ra ère rèti yesus, d'ai talora j'ara paraga dènge dhèu kota kirene èci dhu neo la'e asa d'ara kota. ngara na, simon. dhèu se laka-seti ne, sèna ka pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha gati yesus.

source_text: and when they had come to a place called gulgolta, which means place of a skull,
target_text: ka ra d'ai era èci, ngara na golgota. ètu d'ara lii aram, sasoa na, era rui kètu.

source_text: they gave him wine to drink mingled with gall. and, after tasting it, he was unwilling to drink.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, dhèu se'e hia yesus ninu èi anggor dhu pab'ali rare le dènge èi na'i dhu pèd'u, sèna ka bisa taha rarii. ka yesus camuci, hèia juku eele.

source_text: when they had hanged rebbe, melech hamoshiach on haetz, they divided up moshiachʼs garments among themselves, casting lots;
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu se'e paku yesus asa aj'u palolo-palèbha. hèia sordad'u se ère lot, sèna ka nèti rèngu, cee ka dhu abhu mèdha-papake na.

source_text: and, sitting down, they began to keep watch over him there.
target_text: ka ra madhèdi madhenge yesus ètu era ne'e.

source_text: they put up above his head the charge against him which read, this is yehoshua, melech hayehudim.
target_text: ra suri kahèi ètu papa èci, peka na, ne'e ne yesus, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi ka ra paku papa ne re dedha kètu yesus, sèna ka dhèu re'a nga tao ka rèngu huku ne.

source_text: at that time, two shodedim were each hanged on his own etz with rebbe, melech hamoshiach, one on the right and one on the left.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, ra paku pamadhe parapo dhèu dua kahèi. ca dhèu re bèka g'ana yesus, aa èci hari re bèka kariu na.

source_text: and those passing by were hurling insults at rebbe, melech hamoshiach, wagging their heads,
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu kako re sèra, laladhe ne. hèia ra pakapengo hèb'a ra, ho lalangu ne.

source_text: and saying, you who are going to cause the churban destruction of the beis hamikdash and rebuild it in shloshah yamim three days, save yourself! if you are the ben haelohim, come down from haetz the tree.
target_text: dhèu se'e rodhe ne, peka na, eeh! èu peka na, èu bisa paguri eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, ho èèna na patitu hari ètu d'ara tèlu lod'o, si? ladhe èu tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, na, papuru ngi'u mu nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna.

source_text: likewise, also the rashei hakohanim along with the sofrim and zekenim, were mocking him, and saying,
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra. ra pahahe yesus, aku rèngu na,

source_text: he saved others; yet himself he is not able to save. he is melech yisroel? let him now come down from the etz, and we shall have emunah in him.
target_text: nèngu ne pamamuri le dhèu leo, te ngaa na bisa boe patabuli eele ngi'u nèngu unu na. nèngu mesa na peka na, nèngu dhèu aae isra'el! ladhe sèmi èèna, be'a risi na puru ka nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna. ladhe ji'i ngèdhi ka j'aj'i sèmi èèna, ji'i heka parcaya nèngu kèna.

source_text: he trusts in hashem; let hashem be his moshi'a deliverer and deliver him now, if hashem takes pleasure in him, for this one said, ben haelohim ani!
target_text: ladhe nèngu ne tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, hud'i laa, ‘na maena mi ama lamatua. de ladhe lamatua d'èi ne, hud'i laa lamatua ka dhu pamamuri ne. '

source_text: and the shodedim robbers, hanging, each on his etz, with him, were casting similar insults at rebbe, melech hamoshiach, reproaching him.
target_text: dhèu parapo dhèu dua se, pahahe ne sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: now, from the sixth hour, choshech fell upon all the land until the ninth hour.
target_text: èle èèna ka, maroga kiu-kiu saguru nare era ne'e, karèi nèti lod'o titu mera toke d'ai hake tèlu nihia.

source_text: and about the ninth hour, rebbe, melech hamoshiach cried out with a kol gadol, saying eli, eli, lemah sabachthani! that is, my g-d, my g-d, why hast thou forsaken me? 1.
target_text: d'ai hake tèlu, hèia yesus pa'oo pake lii aram, na, eli! eli! lema sabaktani? sasoa na, ama lamatua ja'a! lamatua ja'a! nga tao ka ama soro kabodho ho tèke eele ja'a mesa-mesa ku sèmi ne'e ne?

source_text: and some of those who were standing there, when they heard, began saying, this one calls for eliyahu hanavi.
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu dhu dètu ètu sèra, tadèngi lii na sèmi èèna, hèia ra papeka, mi nanene ku laa. na paroa elia, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu uru sèra!

source_text: and immediately one of them ran and, taking a sponge, filled it with sour wine and put it on a reed and gave him a drink.
target_text: ka ca dhèu rai la'e nare ula, cèb'u asa d'ara èi anggor manyilu. hèia na èki mi suu tatea èci, ka j'ole asa hèb'a yesus sèna ka na camuci.

source_text: but the rest of them said, wait. we will see whether eliyahu hanavi will come to save him.
target_text: te ngaa cahag'e hari peka na, èdhi ladhe sèku, teko-teko elia mai pamamuri ne, do aad'o?

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach cried out again with a loud voice, and dismissed his ruach.
target_text: ka yesus pa'oo hari dènge lii mèdhu, hèia na madhe.

source_text: and hinei! the parochet of the beis hamikdash was torn in two from top to bottom, and the earth shook; and the rocks were split,
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, abhu bèla dhu bhèla aae kadhoe pa'abhe kama luri mola-mèci ama lamatua. lèke dènge yesus ma'ète a'ae èèna, bèla dhu bhèla aae ne mae, cèri mi dua, nèti dedha toke haha. hèia rai opo, toke hadhu aae-hadhu aae mae sèg'i bagi mi dua.

source_text: and the kevarim graves were opened, and many gufot bodies of the kedoshim who had fallen asleep were made to stand up alive.
target_text: ro'a-ro'a dhèu madhe bhoke kahèi. aa dhèu unu ama lamatua dhu madhe le, abhu dhu na pamamuri hari.

source_text: and coming out of the kevarim after the techiyas hamoshiach, they entered the ir hakodesh holy city and appeared to many.
target_text: ropa yesus mamuri hari le nèti mamadhe na, hèia dhèu madhe sèra bhodho mai nèti d'ara ro'a, ka lasi asa yerusalem. ètu era ne'e dhèu ae rèdhi si.

source_text: now when the centurion, and those who were with him keeping shomer guard over rebbe, melech hamoshiach, saw the earthquake and the things that were happening, they became very frightened and said, truly this was the ben haelohim.
target_text: ètu golgota, abhu komedhaa dènge sordad'u na dhu j'aga ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha yesus èèna. ropa ladhe rèdhi rai opo, dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i se'e, rèngu madha'u titu kèna. ka ra papeka, na, ira ii! dhèu ne'e ne, tare'a-re'a ana lamatua!

source_text: and many nashim were there, looking on from a distance, who had followed rebbe, melech hamoshiach from the galil and had ministered to him.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu bhèni pèri-pèri dhèu dhu laladhe mamadhe yesus nèti kaj'èu. rèngu se'e ka dhu madhutu ne nèti galilea, te rèngu ka dhu lalau-lalo'o ne karèi nèti uru.

source_text: among them was miryam of magdala, miryam the em of ya'akov and yosef, and the em of zavdaiʼs sons.
target_text: dhèu bhèni se'e, nuka maria nèti rae magdala, maria èci hari nuka ina yakobis dènge yusuf, aa dènge dhèu èmu sabadeus nuka ina nèti yakobis dènge yohanis.

source_text: and when it was erev, there came an oisher rich man from ramatayim named yosef who himself had also become a talmid of rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu kaja èci nèti rae arimatea, ngara na yusuf. nèngu ne dhu nèbhu le madhutu a'aj'a yesus. lod'o mamadhe yesus lèke hari jumat. asa bèli èèna, lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi. nèti èèna ka, ropa lod'o oe cèna, hèia yusuf tenge j'ara ho neo papuru ngi'u aae yesus nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: this man went to pilate and asked for the gufat yehoshua. then pilate ordered it to be given over to yosef.
target_text: hèia la'e asa gubernur pilatus, sèna ka manèngi papuru ngi'u aae yesus. ka gubernur paredha, sèna ka ngi'u aae yesus saraka mi yusuf.

source_text: and yosef took the gufat yehoshua, and wrapped it in the tachrichim,
target_text: ka yusuf la'e asa golgota, hèia na papuru ngi'u aae yesus nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha. hèia na hutu pabe'a-be'a ngi'u aae ne dènge bèla hiu dhu kab'ua.

source_text: and laid it in yosefʼs own new kever, which he had hewn out in the rock; and he rolled a large stone against the entrance of the kever tomb and went away.
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu heka pae rare ro'a èci ètu ledhe hadhu, sèna ka tao tèke ro'a hia yusuf dènge a'ari na, ladhe d'ai lod'o rèngu madhe. de yusuf si nedhe rèti ngi'u aae yesus ne, lasi paj'unu asa ro'a deo na. ka ètu hèb'a ro'a ne, ra saguru dènge hadhu kabela aae cue, ho ra bèdho pabe'a-be'a hèb'a ro'a ne. èle èèna ka yusuf si lèpa.

source_text: and miryam of magdala, and the other miryam, stayed there, sitting opposite the kever.
target_text: lod'o èèna, maria nèti magdala, dènge maria dhu leo èci madhutu d'ai era èèna kahèi. ra madhèdi patangara dènge ro'a ne.

source_text: now on the next day, which is the one after the preparation, the rashei hakohanim and the perushim gathered together with pilate
target_text: asa bèli èèna, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi. hèia kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu parisi lasi paraga dènge gubernur.

source_text: and said, sir, we remember that when he was still alive that mateh deceiver said, after shloshah yamim i am to stand up alive.
target_text: ra peka, ama. ji'i sanèd'e era, lod'o dhèu kapod'e-kabèli èèna mamuri era, na peka, na, ‘ja'a madhe tare'a, te ngaa èle tèlu lod'o, ja'a mamuri hari. '

source_text: therefore, give orders for the kever to be made secure until the yom hashlishi the third day, lest his talmidim come and steal him away and say to the people, he has stood up alive from the mesim. and the last deception will be worse than the first.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama paredha ku sordad'u sèra, ho ra j'aga paie-iie ro'a èèna d'ai tèlu lod'o. dènge j'ara ne'e, ana madhutu na bani boe mana'u rèti ngi'u aae na, sèna ka ra monya peka na, nèngu mamuri hari. te ladhe rèngu kapod'e-kabèli sèmi èèna, risi eele nèti mamonya rèngu uru sèra, lod'o dhu ra peka na, nèngu ne nuka kristus.

source_text: pilate said to them, you have a guard, go make the kever as secure as you know how.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia gubernur dhaa, aku nèngu na, be'a kahèi! te ngaa miu dènge dhèu madhenga kahèi. be'a risi miu pua si, ho lasi j'aga paie-iie ro'a nèi.

source_text: and they went and made the kever secure, and, along with the guard, they set a seal on the stone.
target_text: èle ka lasi asa era èèna, rèti dènge dhèu madhenga ra. d'ai era ne'e, ra segel madhe babèdho ro'a ne. hèia ra pua dhèu sèra madhenga, sèna ka dhèu leo baku mai rare ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: now after shabbos, at the time of shacharis on yom rishon the first day of the week, miryam of magdala and the other miryam came to look at the kever.
target_text: ka ètu d'ara hari migu mad'ae aae era, maria nèti magdala, dènge maria dhu leo èci, lasi asa ro'a yesus.

source_text: and hinei! a great earthquake had occurred, for a malach adonoi an angel of hashem descended from shomayim and came and rolled away the stone and sat upon it.
target_text: kaca'a la rai opo kapai titu kèna. ana pajuu ama lamatua ca dhèu puru mai nèti sorga, hèia na loli eele hadhu aae dhu saguru ro'a. ka na madhèdi ètu dedha hadhu ne.

source_text: and his appearance was like lightning and his garment as white as snow.
target_text: rèhu ana pajuu ne kale'e sèmi kaha'a bela, aa mèdha-papake na pudhi mèu.

source_text: and the shomrim guards shook for fear of him and became like dead men.
target_text: dhèu madhenga se, madha'u bia toke ra karèbha, ka rèngu bisa boe kalau-karèto, nuka sèmi dhèu madhe sa.

source_text: and the malach, in reply, said to the nashim, do not be afraid, for i know that you are seeking yehoshua, who has been hanged on haetz.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu nèti sorga ne, lii dènge dhèu bhèni se'e, aku nèngu na, miu baku madha'u! ja'a ke'a miu se mai tenge yesus, dhèu dhu ra paku pamadhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna.

source_text: he is not here. to him has come the techiyas hamesim, just as he said. come, see the place where haadon was lying.
target_text: te ngaa nèngu aad'o heka ètu era ne'e. te na mamuri hari le, sama sèmi dhu na peka le uru èèna. maso mai, sèna ka mèdhi unu mi era dhu ra paj'unu ngi'u aae na. era ne ngaa-ngaa aad'o heka!

source_text: and go quickly, tell his talmidim about the techiyas hamoshiach from hamesim. and, hinei! he is going ahead of you into the galil. there you will see him. hinei! i have told you!
target_text: de pamèri lèpa ka! lami lolo dènge ana madhutu na, peka na, yesus mamuri hari le. la'e uuru le asa galilea. rèngu hud'i lasi paraga uuru ku dènge ne ètu nèi, sèmi dhu uru èèna, na moa mema mi rèngu. parcaya la. lèpa ka, lami lole ngaa dhu ja'a peka ne!

source_text: and they departed quickly from the kever with fear and great simcha and ran to report everything to moshiachʼs talmidim.
target_text: hèia bhèni se rai li'u lasi, tèke eele era ne'e. ra madha'u, te ngaa ra karej'e-karae kahèi. ka ra pamèri-mèri lèpa, lasi peka j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra mi ana madhutu yesus.

source_text: and hinei! moshiach met them, saying shalom aleichem. and they came up and took hold of his feet and fell prostrate before him.
target_text: te ngaa ropa d'ai talora j'ara, kabèdhi la yesus mai paraga dènge ra. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, saloom! ropa ladhe rèdhi, hèia lasi padètu-dètu, liku rare haga na, dènge pahaha iisi ra mi yesus.

source_text: then he said to them, do not be afraid; go and take word to my achim that they may go away to the galil, and there they shall see me.
target_text: hèia na padhai lii, peka na, baku madha'u! lami peka dènge ana madhutu ja'a, sèna ka ra lasi mate ja'a ètu galilea nèi.

source_text: now while they were on their way, hinei! some of the shomrim came into the city and reported to the rashei hakohanim all the things that had happened.
target_text: lod'o dhèu bhèni se ètu talora j'ara era, dhèu madhenga se lèpa le asa kota. rèngu lasi lole ngaa dhu j'aj'i se mi kètu agama yahudi sèra.

source_text: and when they had assembled with the zekenim and counseled together, they gave a large sum of money to the soldiers,
target_text: hèia kètu agama yahudi rare lii èci dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra, sèna ka b'ae doi ae-ae mi dhèu j'aga ho ra hutu hèb'a.

source_text: and said, you are to say, his talmidim came by night and stole him away while we were asleep.
target_text: kètu agama yahudi sèra peka, na, ladhe dhèu karèi miu, dhaa sèmi ne'e: d'ara mèda, ropa ji'i bhèj'i luu, nge'a boe, na, ana madhutu na mai mana'u rèti ngi'u aae na.

source_text: and if this should come to the governorʼs ears, we will win him over and keep you out of trouble.
target_text: aa ladhe gubernur tadèngi, mage miu madha'u, te ji'i ka dhu ator dènge ne.

source_text: and the ones who took the kesef did as they had been instructed and this story was widely spread among the yehudim to this day.
target_text: hèia dhèu madhenga se rare doi. aa ra tao madhutu dad'èi kètu agama se'e. nèti èèna ka, toke d'ai sange ne'e dhèu-dhèu yahudi parcaya era lii lolo kapod'e-kabèli ne.

source_text: but the achad asar talmidim proceeded to the galil, to the mountain which rebbe, melech hamoshiach had designated.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii lolo nèti dhèu bhèni se'e, hèia ana madhutu yesus dhèu canguru èci, lasi paraga dènge yesus asa propensi galilea, ètu ledhe èci, madhutu lii moa na.

source_text: and when they saw him, they prostrated themselves before him, but some were doubtful.
target_text: ropa ra ladhe rèdhi ne, ka ra pahaha iisi mi nèngu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu kahèi dhu d'ara ra kajari era.

source_text: and he came up and spoke to them, saying, all samchut authority has been given to me in shomayim and on haaretz.
target_text: hèia na ara mai padètu-dètu dènge ra, ka na lii, ama lamatua pangèd'u le koasa mi ja'a, sèna ka ja'a paredha aa'i-aa'i ètu sorga, aa dènge aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: go, therefore, make talmidim for rebbe, melech hamoshiach of all the nations, giving them a tevilah in a mikveh mayim in hashem, in the name of haav, and haben, and haruach hakodesh,
target_text: de miu lami asa mia-mia, miu hud'i peka-padhai ku dènge dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i ra, lii lolo be'a ja'a ne. aa miu hud'i aj'a si paie-iie, ho sèna ka rèngu j'aj'i ana madhutu ja'a. aa miu hud'i sarani si ho j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, rèngu dhu pa'èki le dènge ama, dènge ana, aa dènge roh na dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: teaching them to observe all that i have commanded you. and hinei! i am with you always, even unto the ketz haolam hazeh.
target_text: aa nori si sèna ka ra tao madhutu paredha aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a peka tèke le dènge miu. sanèd'e, ee! ja'a bera-bera dènge miu toke èle rai-haha ne.

source_text: the beginning of the besuras hageulah the good news of redemption of yehoshua, rebbe melech hamoshiach the ben haelohim.
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lolo be'a lula-nèti ana ama lamatua. ngara na yesus kristus, dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru ka mai. lii lolo na mulai sèmi ne'e:

source_text: just as it has been written in yeshayah hanavi, hinneni sholeiach malachi behold, i send my messenger before your face, upinnah derech lefanai and he will prepare the way before me, he will prepare your way.
target_text: lod'o yesus sab'a mèka sasab'a na, ama lamatua pua uru dhèu èci, ngara na yohanis, la'e tao tèke j'ara hia yesus dhu mai bèli-camèd'a. lula uru èèna, ama lamatua peka le dènge dhèu nèti lii padhai na, ngara na yesaya. na suri tèke, peka na, nanene! ja'a pua le dhèu èci, ho bhoke j'ara hia èu.

source_text: kol korey bamidbara voice of one shouting in the wilderness: prepare the derech hashemthe way of the l-rd. make his paths yashar straight!
target_text: dhèu èèna la'e asa d'ara mamoo, ho na rodhe, peka na, ‘miu aa'i-aa'i mi tao pabe'a ku j'ara, sèna ka sèmi mere mamai lamatua! pamera j'ara ho soru mamai na. '

source_text: yochanan came with a mikveh mayim in the midbar, preaching a tevilah of teshuva for the selichat avon. and all yehudah and all yerushalayim were going out to him, and they were submitted to a tevilah using the yarden river as a mikveh mayim, making vidduy of their averos sins. and yochanan had camel hair clothing and a leather belt around his waist, and his food was arbe and devash.
target_text: ra pangare dhèu ne'e, yohanis, tuka sarani dhèu. era pea nèngu ètu d'ara mamoo. kodho na tao nèti rèu badha onta, dhara hake na, tao nèti ka'uri badha. nganga'a nèngu kabara dènge dhua nasu oni. lod'o èèna, dhèu ae nèti kota yerusalem dènge propensi yudea, mai paraga dènge yohanis ètu era pea na. dhèu se mai neo rèdhi yohanis, aa nanene lii holo-nori na. na peka, hua iia miu ele-ho'a nèti tatao karehe, sèna ka ama lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo miu. èle èèna miu sarani uuru ku j'aj'i mi tadha, na, miu be'a le dènge lamatua. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se'e bhoka sasala rèngu, ka yohanis sarani si ètu loko yarden.

source_text: and he was preaching, crying out as a maggid, saying, hu habah he who comes after me has more chozek strength than me. i am not worthy to stoop down and remove his sandals.
target_text: ka na peka hari, bèli-camèd'a dhèu èci mai, dhu kapai risi nèti ja'a. lula ja'a ne haha d'ai seli, neo j'aj'i ana pua-paleha èèna ka, lèke boe sa hèi.

source_text: i give you a tevilah in a mikveh mayim, but he will give you a tevilah in the ruach hakodesh.
target_text: ja'a ne dhodhoka sarani miu dènge èi di, te ngaa nèngu tao risi eele nèti ja'a. te na papènu d'ara miu dènge roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: and it was during that period that yehoshua from natzeret of the galil came and submitted to yochananʼs tevilah in the mikveh mayim of the yarden.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, yesus la'e nèti rae nasaret ètu rai galilea, ka na paraga dènge yohanis. èle èèna ka yohanis sarani ne ètu loko yarden.

source_text: and ofen ort rebbe, melech hamoshiach came up out of the mikveh mayim, and he saw shomayim being torn open, the ruach hakodesh of hashem descending like a yonah on him.
target_text: ropa yesus bhodho nèti d'ara èi mai, na ladhe, na, liru bhoke eele, ka roh ama lamatua puru mai sama sèmi koro j'aha ci'u, puru mai asa yesus.

source_text: and there was a bat kol out of shomayim, atah bni ahuvi asher bcha chafatsti you are my son, the beloved, with whom i am well pleased.
target_text: kaca'a la, ra tadèngi lii ama lamatua nèti dedha-liru, peka na, èu ne, ana pasue ja'a, èu pakarej'e taruu d'ara ja'a.

source_text: then the ruach hakodesh ofen ort thrusts him out into the midbar.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, roh ama lamatua jajuku yesus asa d'ara mamoo la'e.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was in the midbar arba'im yom varbaim lailah, undergoing nisyonos by hasatan; and he was with the chayyat hassadehwild beasts, and the malachim were the meshartei hashem ministering to moshiach.
target_text: na pea dènge badha hui ètu èèna, èpa nguru lod'o. ka dhèu aae nidhu mai dadugu tenge j'ara sèna ka yesus madhutu nèngu, te ngaa tao nare boe. èle èèna ka, ana pajuu nèti ama lamatua puru mai lalau-lalo'o ne.

source_text: now after yochanan was arrested, rebbe, melech hamoshiach came to the galil, darshenen preaching the besuras hageulah of hashem,
target_text: lod'o dhu kèpe rare yohanis tuka sarani pamaso asa d'ara bèdho, nèbhu boe ka yesus pakèd'i la'e propensi galilea. la'e lole lii lolo be'a nèti ama lamatua ètu nèi.

source_text: and saying, the appointed time has been fulfilled and the malchut hashem has come near. make teshuva, and have emunah in the besuras hageulah.
target_text: ka na peka, mi nanene! lod'o ama lamatua d'ai kèna! limuri ne, dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a, na, ama lamatua nèd'u le paredha karèi nèti uru ka. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i tèke eele ka tatao karehe sèra, ho lèpa madhutu ama lamatua. hèia parcaya ka lii holo-nori nèngu kahèi.

source_text: and passing along beside sea of galilee, rebbe, melech hamoshiach saw shim'on and andrew, the brother of shim'on, casting a reshet into the sea, for they were daiyagim fishermen.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, yesus kako re sebhe dano galilea, ka nèdhi dhèu dua, ngara ra simon dènge ari na anderias. sasab'a rèngu bèli-bèli èèna, j'ala i'a.

source_text: and he said to them, come, follow me, and i will make you to become daiyagei adam.
target_text: ka yesus paroa nare dua ra, peka na, we! mai madhutu ja'a! miu tema tenge i'a, te ngaa ja'a neo aj'a miu, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu tenge samanga.

source_text: and ofen ort, leaving their nets, they followed moshiach.
target_text: ropa ra nanene rare, hèia ra tèke eele j'ala rèngu, ka lasi dènge madhutu ne.

source_text: and going on a little, he saw ya'akov ben zavdai and yochanan his brother, who were also in the sirah boat repairing the nets.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus kako hari ciki, ka nèdhi ana-ana sabadeus, a'a ngara na yakobis, aa ari ngara na yohanis. dua ra lalau paie pèku ètu dedha koha.

source_text: and ofen ort he summoned them; and, leaving zavdai their father in the sirah with the sachirim hired workers, they went away to follow moshiach.
target_text: ka yesus paroa dua ra, peka na, mai we! madhutu ja'a! ropa ra tadèngi rare lii yesus, ka dua ra tèke eele ama ra, dènge dhèu sab'a sa ètu dedha koha, lasi dènge ka madhutu yesus.

source_text: and they enter into k'far-nachum, and ofen ort on shabbos, entering into the shul, rebbe, melech hamoshiach exercised the ministry of moreh teacher.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na dhèu èpa sèra lasi d'ai kota kapernaum. lod'o èèna, lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi. ka yesus la'e asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, ka na lole lii holo-nori ama lamatua ètu èèna.

source_text: and they were astounded at moshiachʼs torah teaching, for he was teaching them as one having samchut, and not as the sofrim.
target_text: dhèu ae sèra malaa, nanene lii padhai na, lula nèngu ne'a mèu lii dhu nèngu lole, risi nèti mese-mese agama yahudi.

source_text: and, ofen ort, there was in their shul a man with a ruach hatameh, and he shouted,
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu èci dhu nidhu tao. dhèu ne'e la'e asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i kahèi. kaca'a laa na pakèce, peka na,

source_text: saying, yehoshua of natzeret, mah lanu vlach? what to us and to you? have you come to bring us churban destruction? i have daas who you are, hakadosh of hashemthe holy one of g-d.
target_text: we! yesus, dhèu nasaret! ngaa unu èu dènge ji'i! èu mai ho pa'ele iie ji'i, do? ji'i tadhe èu. èu ne'e ka dhu mai nèti ama lamatua. èu ne'e dhèu dhu dènge boe sasala-sasigo.

source_text: but he rebuked the shed, saying, shekit! gey zich! and come out of him.
target_text: ka yesus jèke ne, hutu hèb'a èu na! rai eele nèti dhèu ne'e!

source_text: and, the ruach hatumah, throwing him into convulsions, let out a shrai and came out of him.
target_text: kaca'a laa nidhu tèku ngi'u dhèu ne'e, sama sèmi dhèu dhu pèd'a rèdha. ka na rai eele nèti dhèu ne'e, dènge lii pakèce.

source_text: and all were astounded so that they began to discuss with each other, saying, what is this? torah chadasha with samchut? he gives orders to the shedim and they obey him?
target_text: hèia dhèu ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i sèra, malaa-maloha. ka ra padhue èci dènge èci, eea! ngaa ka ne'e? ne'e ne, lii holo-nori dhu hiu, do? lii padhai lii mone heka ne, ele madha, nga! na paredha nidhu se, ka ra kalua kahèi, madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: and the besuroh news of rebbe, melech hamoshiach ofen ort immediately went forth everywhere into the surrounding region of the galil.
target_text: hèia dhèu palolo lème era, ètu d'ara rae-rae propensi galilea.

source_text: and ofen ort immediately, coming out of shul, they went into the bais house of shim'on and andrew with ya'akov and yochanan.
target_text: lod'o rèngu lèpa nèti d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, hèia yesus dènge ana madhutu na, lasi asa èmu simon dènge anderias.

source_text: and the chamot shviger, mother-in-law of shim'on was bedridden and fever-stricken, and ofen ort immediately they tell rebbe, melech hamoshiach about her.
target_text: ina dhèu èmu simon pèd'a maringi-sagoro, ka dhu j'unu. ropa yesus dènge ana madhutu na d'ai d'ara èmu èèna, dhèu mai peka dènge ne, bhèni heka ne, pèd'a.

source_text: and approaching, holding her hand, rebbe, melech hamoshiach lifted her up, and the kaddachatfever left her, and she then began functioning as their mesharetet servant, keli kodesh, lady minister, waiting on them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yesus la'e ladhe bhèni heka ne. hèia na kèpe kacui-aai na, ho pamadhèdi ne. kaca'a laa papèd'a maringi-sagoro èèna èle dènge. hèia bhèni heka ne kèd'i la'e lalau nganga'a-nganginu hia si.

source_text: when erev evening came, with the setting of the shemesh sun, they brought to rebbe, melech hamoshiach all the cholim sick persons and all those possessed by shedim demons.
target_text: ropa lod'o cèna, dhèu pakako rèti asa yesus a'ari rèngu dhu pèd'a, dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu nidhu tao, sèna ka na puri-pa'èle si.

source_text: and the whole shtetl gathered together at the delet door.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ca kabarai mai pakaboko pènu tao cèci ètu madha èmu èèna.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach administered refuah healing to many cholim sick persons suffering from various machlot illnessess, and he cast out many shedim demons. and he did not permit the shedim to give utterance, for the shedim knew the raz mystery, secret of his identity, that he was the rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: èi papèd'a ra rupa-rupa, te ngaa yesus puri-pa'èle aa'i mèu-mèu si. hèia na lalèta eele nidhu ae nèti dhèu sèra. yesus hia boe tebho nidhu se'e padhai lii, lula ra tadhe ne.

source_text: and very early, while it was still dark, having got up, rebbe, melech hamoshiach went out and away to a desolate place, and was davening shacharis there.
target_text: bèli èèna mad'ae aae era, ako maroga, yesus kèd'i ka la'e asa era èci dhu nee-nee, ka na manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua.

source_text: and shim'on and those with him searched for rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: ropa simon si kèd'i, rèdhi heka yesus, ka lasi tenge ne.

source_text: and they found rebbe, melech hamoshiach and they say to him, everyone is seeking you.
target_text: ra paraga dènge yesus, ka ra peka, ama, dhèu canau mai tenge ama ku.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to them, let us go elsewhere into the neighboring shtetlach, so that also there i may preach. for it was for this purpose, tachlis i came.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa lii rèngu, aku nèngu na, èèna be'a kahèi. te ngaa be'a risi lati uru asa rae-rae leo, ho ja'a aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua. te èèna sasab'a-la'a ja'a na.

source_text: and he came preaching in their shuls synagogues and casting out shedim in the whole region of the galil.
target_text: èle èèna ka, rèngu kako palème era ètu propensi galilea, ho lole lii lolo be'a ama lamatua. ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, na babège-lalèta eele nidhu nèti dhèu sèra.

source_text: and an ish metzorah leper comes to rebbe, melech hamoshiach begging him and kneeling down and saying, if you are willing, you are able to make me tahor clean.
target_text: dhèu èci dhu lèke papèd'a kusta mai paraga dènge yesus, ka na patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus. na manèngi, aku nèngu na, ama, ee! sue ku ja'a laa. tao pa'èle ku papèd'a ja'a ne. ja'a ke'a, na, ama bisa pa'èle papèd'a ja'a ne, sèna ka dhèu madenge heka dènge ja'a.

source_text: and being filled with rachmei shomayim and stretching out his hand, rebbe, melech hamoshiach touched the man and says to him, i am willing. be made tahor.
target_text: nèti lii roma iisi na, ka d'ara yesus roe, ka na j'ole kacui-aai ho kèpe ne. hèia na peka, tare'a! ja'a bisa! èu èle kèna!

source_text: and ofen ort immediately the ish metzorah leper went away from rebbe, melech hamoshiach and he was made tahor.
target_text: kaca'a laa, papèd'a èèna ele dènge. ka dhèu èèna pèd'a heka.

source_text: and having sternly warned him, ofen ort immediately rebbe, melech hamoshiach sent him away.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus pua dhèu èèna lèpa dènge pasanèd'e ne, peka na,

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to him, see that you say nothing to anyone, but rather go show yourself to the kohen and offer the korban for the tohorah purification of you which moshe rabbeinu gave mitzvah, for an edut testimony to them.
target_text: mu nanene! èu èle le, te ngaa baku lole dènge cee-cee! èu hud'i madhutu ku lii paredha musa uru èèna. de lamu uru ku asa ama agama, ho na parisa ngi'u mu. sèna ka ne'a èi papèd'a èu na ele le, do dhae. èle èèna ka, heka èu hia mèdha èci sèmi tadha makasi, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a èu èle le tare'a-re'a.

source_text: but the one having gone out began to preach many things and to spread the dvar, so that no longer was rebbe melech hamoshiach able to openly enter into a shtetl, but he was outside in desolate places. and they were coming to rebbe, melech hamoshiach from every direction.
target_text: masi ka yesus kai baku peka dènge cee-cee, te ngaa ropa la'e d'ai li'u, ka na lolo lème dènge dhèu. èle èèna ka, dhèu ae neo paraga dènge yesus. te ngaa, lula lii dhèu èèna, ka yesus bisa boe pad'elo iisi na asa d'ara kota. nèti èèna ka, yesus pea dhoka ètu era mau èci ètu li'u kota. te ngaa dhèu mai paraga dènge ne nèti mia-mia.

source_text: and having entered again into k'far-nachum, it was heard after some yamim, that rebbe, melech hamoshiach is at home.
target_text: èle pèri-pèri lod'o, hèia yesus lèpa hari asa kapernaum. ka ra papeka d'ai mia-mia, peka na, yesus d'ai le èmu.

source_text: and many were gathered together so that there was no longer any room at the delet, and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was speaking the dvar hashem to them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu mai nèti mia-mia. lula dhèu ae seli, ka ètu d'ara èmu pènu risi, toke d'ai hèb'a èmu. èle èèna ka, yesus lole dènge ra dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: and they come bringing to rebbe, melech hamoshiach a paralytic being carried along by arba'a anashim four men.
target_text: ètu talora na padhai lii era, dhèu èpa jèru dhèu karuku èci neo asa madha yesus.

source_text: and not being able to bring the paralytic to rebbe, melech hamoshiach on account of the multitude, they removed the roof where rebbe, melech hamoshiach was, and having made an opening, they lowered the mat upon which the paralytic was lying.
target_text: te ngaa, lula dhèu ae d'ai seli, ka rèngu abhu boe sasanga ho rèti dhèu èèna asa madha yesus. hèia ca'e lasi asa kolo èmu, bhoke eele rèu èmu re dedha kètu yesus. ropa ra bhoke rare rèu èmu, hèia ra papuru dhèu karuku èena dènge dhèpi na.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach, having seen the emunah of them, says to the paralytic, beni, your averos are granted selicha.
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe nèdhi si, nèngu ne'a le dhèu se'e parcaya tare'a-re'a nèngu. ka na padhai lii dènge dhèu karuku ne, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! ja'a saku eele le sasala èu!

source_text: and there were some of the sofrim scribes sitting there and thinking about these things in their levavot hearts,
target_text: ètu èèna kahèi, abhu pèri-pèri mese agama yahudi. ropa ra tadèngi rare lii padhai lii yesus, ka d'ara ngangee rèngu be'a boe.

source_text: why is this one speaking thus? he is guilty of chillul hashem gidduf desecration of the name, blasphemy. who is able to grant selicha forgiveness to averos sins except hashem?
target_text: hèia ra papeka, boo! dhèu ne'e bani titu kèna, padhai lii sèmi nèi! dhodhoka ama lamatua di, dhu dènge hak ho saku eele sasala dhèu. te ngaa dhèu ne'e tao ngi'u na èci èèna ka dènge ama lamatua. nèngu pakarehe kolongara ama lamatua!

source_text: and, ofen ort immediately, having had daas in his ruach that in this way they were thinking, rebbe melech hamoshiach says to them, why are you considering such things in your levavot?
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a le ngangee rèngu. hèia na peka, heh! miu baku pangee sèmi èèna.

source_text: which is easier? to say to the paralytic, your averos are granted selicha, or to say, stand and pick up your mat and walk? but in order that you may have daas that the bar enosh has samchut authority on haaretz to grant that averos receive selicha, rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to the paralytic,
target_text: mia dhu be'a risi? ladhe ja'a peka mi dhèu karuku ne, ‘sasala èu saku eele le, ' miu me'a boe, na, j'aj'i do aad'o. te ngaa ladhe ja'a peka, ‘kèd'i ka! nedhe dhèpi èu, ho lèpa ka. ' ladhe na kèd'i ho miu ladhe mèdhi kahèi, heka miu me'a kèna, ja'a ne dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. aa ja'a dènge koasa kahèi, ho saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu! èle èèna ka, yesus padhai lii dènge dhèu karuku èèna, peka na,

source_text: to you i say, stand, pick up your mat, and go to your bais.
target_text: èu nanene, ee! èu èle le ne! kèd'i ka, nedhe dhèpi èu ho lamu ka.

source_text: and the man arose, and, ofen ort immediately, in front of everyone, taking the mat, he went outside. so everyone was astonished and gave kavod to hashem saying, never have we seen anything like this!
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, cag'ag'a laa dhèu ne kèd'i titu. na nedhe dhèpi na, hèia la'e ka asa li'u. dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra rèdhi dènge musi madha ra. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra malaa-maloha, ka ra peka, ira ii! èdhi heka tèdhi ka! ama lamatua tare'a-re'a kapai d'ai seli!

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach went out again beside the lake; and all the multitude was coming to him, and he was teaching them torah.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus la'e hari asa sebhe dano galilea. ka dhèu ae titu kèna mai paraga dènge ne, hèia na lole dad'èi ama lamatua mi rèngu.

source_text: and as he was passing by, he saw levi ben-chalfai sitting in the tax office, and rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to him, follow me. and, getting up, levi mattityahu followed rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu èci ngara na lewi, ana nèti alpius. sasab'a na roro doi bea. lod'o yesus kako re èèna ka ladhe nèdhi lewi. ka na peka dènge ne, wee! mai madhutu ja'a! ropa tadèngi lii yesus ne, lewi kèd'i dènge ka la'e madhutu ne.

source_text: and it came to pass that rebbe, melech hamoshiach reclined at tish in leviʼs house, and many mochesim tax collectors and chote'im sinners were reclining at tish with rebbe, melech hamoshiach and with his talmidim. for there were many, and they were following him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si ra'a ètu d'ara èmu lewi, pa'èci dènge angalai lewi dhèu roro doi bea sèra. abhu kahèi dhèu-dhèu leo madhèdi ra'a dènge rèngu. madhutu ngangee dhèu yahudi, dhèu se'e dhèu karehe. nèti dhèu-dhèu dhu madhèdi ra'a se abhu dhèu ae kahèi dhu d'èi nanene lii padhai lii yesus.

source_text: and the sofrim scribes of the perushim, seeing that rebbe melech hamoshiach eats with chote'im sinners and mochesim tax collectors, were saying to his talmidim, with mochesim tax collectors and chote'im sinners does he eat?
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu pèri-pèri mese agama nèti partei parisi dhu rèdhi yesus madhèdi na'a-ninu dènge tuka roro doi bea, dènge dhèu karehe sèra. ka ra karèi ana madhutu yesus, peka na, nga tao ka mese miu madhèdi na'a-ninu dènge dhèu roro doi bea dènge dhèu dhu laku-laku boe sèra?

source_text: and having heard this, rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to them, itʼs not the strong ones that have need of a rofeh physician but rather the cholim sick persons. i did not come to call the tzaddikim righteous ones but the chote'im sinners to teshuva.
target_text: yesus tadèngi lii karèi rèngu èèna, ka na dhaa, peka na, dhèu pèd'a mema parluu dote, te ngaa dhèu dhu pèd'a boe, parluu boe dote. mamai ja'a ne sèna ka lalau dhèu dhu laku-laku boe. te ja'a mai boe ho uri dhèu dhu rasa ngi'u na mola.

source_text: and the talmidim of yochanan and the perushim came with tzomot fasts. and they come and say to rebbe, melech hamoshiach, why do the talmidim of the perushim and the talmidim of yochanan come with tzomot, but your talmidim do not?
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu nèti partei agama parisi puasa. rèngu rèdhi ana madhutu yohanis tuka sarani, puasa kahèi. te ngaa rèdhi boe ana madhutu yesus puasa sèmi rèngu. hèia dhèu rèngu mai paraga dènge yesus, ka ra karèi, aku rèngu na, ama. ji'i puasa sama sèmi ana madhutu yohanis kahèi. te, nga tao ka, ana madhutu ama puasa boe?

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach, said to them, surely the bnei hachuppah of the choson bridegroom are not able to undergo tzomot as long as they have the choson with them, nu? as long as they have the choson with them, they are not able to undergo tzomot.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, mema miu me'a le, ladhe abhu pesta kab'i, dhèu dhu abhu nèru sèra puasa boe, ka ra'a toke bècu. ladhe mone dhu kab'i èèna era, dhèu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra'a-rinu.

source_text: but yamim days will come when the choson is taken away from them, and then they will undergo tzomot hayom hahu.
target_text: te ladhe d'ai lod'o ho ra kèpe rèti dhèu mone dhu kab'i èèna, ka mone aanga-angalai na sèra d'ara susa, heka ra puasa kèna.

source_text: no one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; otherwise, the patch will pull away from it, the new from the old, and a worse tear results.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, bèla hiu baku kalape mi kodho dhui. te ladhe base, na, bèla hiu èèna karuku, hèia kodho èèna asa ka mae aae.

source_text: and no one puts yayin chadash new wine into old wineskins; otherwise, the yayin will burst the wineskins and the yayin is lost and so are the wineskins. instead yayin chadash new wine is put into new wineskins.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, miu baku edhe dhua pèd'u ètu d'ara sabha dhui. te aad'o na, sabha èèna mae, aa dhua pèd'u na bhori eele asa rai. nèti èèna ka yesus peka dènge si, baku pakihu-kee lii holo-nori nèngu dhu hiu, dènge lii holo-nori dhèu parisi dhu dhui.

source_text: and it came about that on shabbos, rebbe, melech hamoshiach was passing through the grainfields, and his talmidim began to make their way picking the heads of grain.
target_text: ca tèka, lèke lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi, yesus si kako re j'ara ètu d'ara oka. ka ana madhutu na g'ètu rèti are gandum.

source_text: and the perushim said to him, look, why are they engaging in what is not mutar permissible in the torah on shabbos?
target_text: ropa dhèu parisi ladhe rèdhi, ka ra karèi yesus, tasamia ka, ana madhutu èu madhutu boe j'ara-j'ara agama èdhi? rèngu se g'ètu are gandum lèke lod'o a'oro sasab'a. miu baku tao sèmi èèna!

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to them, have you never read in the tanakh what dovid hamelech did when he was in need and he was hungry, he and the ones with him? how he entered into the beis hashem during the yamim of evyatar the kohen gadol and the lechem hapanim he ate, which to be eaten it is not mutar permissible except by the kohanim, and he gave some also to the ones with him.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, samia, ee? miu sanèd'e heka lii lolo daud. tèu èèna, abyatar j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. lod'o èèna, daud dènge dhèu madhutu na aa'i-aa'i ra manganga bia. ka ra maso asa d'ara paleo ama lamatua, hèia ra'a roti dhu ama agama hia le mi lamatua. madhutu atora agama èdhi, dhèu dhu bisa ra'a roti èèna, dhoka ama-ama agama di; dhèu leo bisa boe. daud dènge ana madhutu na sèra, ra'e rare roti èèna, te ngaa dhèu èci sa peka boe, na, daud si sala.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, shabbos was created for the sake of man and not man for the sake of shabbos.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lole hari dènge rèngu, miu baku bhèlu! lamatua hia lod'o a'oro sasab'a hia èdhi dhèu rai-haha. lamatua paj'aj'i boe èdhi dhèu rai-haha, ho madhutu dhoka atora lod'o a'oro sasab'a di.

source_text: therefore, the bar enosh is even adon hashabbos.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a ne ka dhu peka ho dhèu sab'a, do aad'o, lèke dènge lod'o a'oro sasab'a.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach entered again into the shul. and there was there a man having a withered hand.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lèpa hari la'e asa èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. d'ai nèi, ka yesus paraga dènge dhèu èci dhu ai na roe cabèka.

source_text: and they were watching rebbe, melech hamoshiach to see if on shabbos he will heal him, in order that they might accuse him.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu dhu patangi-tenge sasala yesus. ra ma'u yesus, neo re'a na puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a lèke lod'o a'oro sasab'a, do aad'o.

source_text: and he says to the man, the one with the withered hand, stand up here in the center.
target_text: hèia yesus paroa dhèu dhu ai roe cabèka èèna, aku nèngu na, mai ku! titu ku mi madha ja'a ne.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to them, is it mutar permissible on shabbos to do tov or rah, to restore nefesh or to destroy it? but they were silent.
target_text: ka na karèi dhèu ae ètu sèra sa, aku nèngu na, madhutu atora agama èdhi, èdhi bisa tao ngaa lod'o a'oro sasab'a? tao madha j'ara dhu be'a, do karehe? tao pabe'a dhèu, do pamadhe dhèu? te ngaa dhèu sèra èci sa bani boe bhoke hèb'a.

source_text: and having looked at them with ka'as and having agmat nefesh grief at the stubborn hardness of their levavot, rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to the man, stretch out your hand. and the man stretched it out, and his hand was restored.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yesus d'ara pèd'a, lula rèngu madhutu dhoka ad'a di, tao boe madha-dhilu mi dhèu ai roe cabèka ne. yesus nasa, ka na ladhe lème dhèu sèra. hèia na peka mi dhèu ai roe cabèka, aku nèngu na, j'ole kacui-aai èu mai sa ne'e! ka dhèu èèna soro kacui-aai asa yesus la'e. kabèdhi laa, èle dènge papèd'a na.

source_text: and ofen ort immediately the perushim went out and held consultation with the party of herod against him, as to how they might destroy him.
target_text: ropa dhèu parisi ladhe rèdhi yesus pa'èle kacui-aai dhèu èèna lèke lod'o a'oro sasab'a, aa'i-aa'i ra kalua nèti d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. ka lasi padhue dènge dhèu partei politik herodes, ho tenge j'ara neo pamadhe yesus.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach with his talmidim went away to the lake, and a great multitude from the galil and also from yehudah followed rebbe, melech hamoshiach. and from yerushalayim and from idumea and from the other side of the yarden and from around tzor-tzidon area, a great multitude followed, hearing everything that he was doing, and they came to rebbe melech hamoshiach.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi asa sebhe dano galilea. te ngaa, lula dhèu ae sèra re'a le ngaa dhu nèngu tao, ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i mai nèti rae-rae ho madhutu ne. rèngu mai nèti propensi galilea, propensi yudea, aa propensi idumea. abhu kahèi dhu mai nèti kota yerusalem, kota sidon dènge kota tirus. abhu kahèi cahag'e dhu mai nèti cabèka dhimu loko yarden. aa'i-aa'i sèra neo mai paraga dènge ne.

source_text: and he said to his talmidim that a sirah boat should stand ready for him, lest the multitude might crush him.
target_text: taga dhèu dhu mai sèra ae seli, ka yesus pua ana madhutu na lasi tenge koha cue hia nèngu. na neo padhai lii dènge dhèu ae sèra nèti dedha koha, sèna ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa ladhe rèdhi rèhu na, aa tadèngi lii padhai lii na hèi.

source_text: for he had brought refuah to many, with the result that as many as had afflictions pressed in on him in order to touch him.
target_text: ca hari ni, na puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a ae titu kèna. nèti èèna ka, dhèu ae mai paseti èci dènge èci, neo g'ag'e yesus.

source_text: and the ruchot hatemeiot unclean spirits, whenever they saw rebbe, melech hamoshiach, were falling before him and were crying out, saying, you are the ben haelohim!
target_text: ropa dhèu dhu nidhu tao sa ladhe rèdhi yesus, ka ra bèbha d'ai rai ètu madha yesus. hèia ra taraa, aku rèngu na, èu ne mema tare'a ana ama lamatua!

source_text: and he sternly rebuked them, lest they should make him known.
target_text: te ngaa yesus kai rèngu, aku nèngu na, miu baku ale dènge dhèu èci sa hèi, ja'a ne cee!

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach goes up to the mountain and summons those whom he wanted, and they came to him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus kako la'e asa kolo ledhe èci. na paroa pèri-pèri dhèu dhu nèngu d'èi. ka dhèu se mai madhutu ne.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach appointed and gave smichah to shneym asar twelve, whom also he designated shlichim, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out as his shlichim to preach,
target_text: èle èèna ka, na hag'e nare dhèu canguru dua. ka na peka, ja'a pili miu ho madhutu taruu ja'a, j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha ja'a. ja'a neo pua miu, lami lole lii lolo be'a ama lamatua mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and to have samchut authority to cast out shedim.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi ja'a neo hia miu koasa, sèna ka miu bisa babège-lalèta nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach appointed the shneym asar: shim'on, to whom he gave the name kefa, and ya'akov ben zavdai and yochanan, ya'akovʼs brother. he gave to them the name bnei regesh, sons of thunder. and andrew and philippos and bar-talmai, and mattityahu, and t'oma, and ya'akov ben-chalfai, and taddai, and shim'on the zealot, and yehudah from k'riot, the one who betrayed rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: ngara dhèu canguru dua sa, nuka: simon dhu yesus pangare na, petrus, yakobis, yohanis, yakobis dènge ari na, yohanis ne, dua ra ana sabadeus. yesus pangare rèngu dua ra, ngara na ‘boanerges', dhu sasoa na ‘sama sèmi d'oro'. anderias, pelipus, bertolomeos, mateos, tomas, yakobis ana alpius, tadius, simon dhu madhutu partei politik selot, dènge yudas iskariot dhu èèna na pahie eele yesus.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach goes to his home shtetl; and again the multitude assembles, with the result that they were not able to have okhel food.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra puru hari nèti kolo ledhe deo na. ka lasi asa d'ara èmu èci. dhèu ae titu kèna mai oke rare ne, ka na bisa boe na'a-ninu.

source_text: and when his own mishpochah heard of this, they went out to constrain him. for they were saying, he is meshuga.
target_text: rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ra papeka, aku rèngu na, miu ladhe ku yesus! ne'a heka lalau iisi na. ropa a'ari na tadèngi lii palolo dhèu, ka ra mai neo rare ne.

source_text: and the sofrim scribes, the ones coming down from yerushalayim, were saying, he is possessed by baal-zibbul and by the sar hashedim he casts out shedim.
target_text: lod'o èèna, mese-mese agama nèti yerusalem mai peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, aku rèngu na, heh! pasa dhilu miu! baku madhutu yesus. te dhèu aae nidhu, dhu ra paroa ngara na baalsebul, maso asa d'ara yesus, ka hia ne koasa, ho bata-magèla nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu.

source_text: but having called them, rebbe, melech hamoshiach was speaking to them in meshalim: how can hasatan cast out hasatan?
