target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi nare lii padhue rèngu èèna, heia na paroa nare rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, ka na peka, lèke boe dènge ngangee dhèu! tasamia ka dhèu aae nidhu bisa babège ngi'u mesa na! ?

source_text: and if a malchut is divided against itself, it is not possible for that malchut to stand.
target_text: ladhe ètu d'ara paredha dhèu aae èci, ana kabarai sèra èci patao-palaha dènge èci, paredha dhèu aae èèna taha nèbhu boe.

source_text: and if a bais is divided against itself, it will not be possible for that bais to stand.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi ètu d'ara èmu, ladhe isi èmu èci patao dènge èci, isi èmu èèna mae-manyèla!

source_text: and if hasatan has risen up against himself and is divided, it is not possible for him to stand, but his end has arrived.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge nidhu. ladhe èci pamusu dènge èci, rèngu mae-manyèla kahèi. sèmi èèna na, heka rèngu laho kao-kao.

source_text: but no one is able, having entered into the house of the gibbor to plunder his possessions, unless first, he binds hagibbor, and then he will plunder the bayit hagibbor.
target_text: ladhe dhèu parapo neo mai parapo èmu dhèu èra èci, na hud'i èki-karadhe uuru ku lamatua èmu na, heka bau nèti mèdha-panyau kèna.

source_text: omein, i say to you that for everything - for the averos sins and the chillul hashemdesecration of the name, whatever blasphemies they may utter - the bnei adam will be granted selicha.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka mema dènge miu: ama lamatua sadia saku eele sasala dhèu. ladhe dhèu padhai lii karehe mi dedha dhèu leo, ama lamatua bisa saku eele sasala na era.

source_text: but whoever commits chillul hashem gidduf against the ruach hakodesh, can never have selicha, but is guilty of a chet olam.
target_text: te ngaa lii padhai lii karehe mi dedha roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci, ama lamatua saku eele boe sasala nèngu, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e!

source_text: for they were saying, he has a ruach hatumah an unclean spirit.
target_text: yesus peka sèmi èèna, lula dhèu sèra peka na, dhèu èèna, nidhu tao.

source_text: and the em mother of rebbe, melech hamoshiach and his achim come and stand outside and they sent word to him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ina dènge ari yesus sèra mai tenge ne. d'ai èmu dhu yesus madhèdi ètu d'ara na, rèngu lasi boe asa d'ara, te ngaa ra titu ètu li'u, ka ra hia dhèu lasi paroa yesus.

source_text: and a multitude was sitting around him, and they are saying to him, hinei! your em mother! and your achim brothers! and your achayot sisters are outside looking for you.
target_text: lasi, na, yesus madhèdi padhai lii dènge dhèu ae. ka dhèu sèra peka dènge ne, ama, ee! ina mu dènge a'ari mu nuka ètu li'u si. ra neo paraga dènge ama.

source_text: and in reply to them, rebbe, melech hamoshiach says, who is immi? and my achim brothers?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, cee ka dhu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i ina dènge a'ari ja'a?

source_text: and having looked around at the ones sitting around him, rebbe, melech hamoshiach says, hinei! immi and my achim!
target_text: hèia na ladhe palème asa dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu sèra, ka na peka, miu se'e se ka dhu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i ina dènge a'ari ja'a.

source_text: for whoever does the ratzon hashem, this one is my brother and my sister and mother.
target_text: te cee ka dhu madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, rèngu sèra ka dhu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i ina dènge a'ari ja'a.

source_text: and again rebbe melech hamoshiach began to say shiurim torah talks beside the lake. and a huge multitude gathered together to him so that he got into a sirah boat on the lake and sat down. the whole multitude was by the lake on the shore.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus la'e hari asa dano galilea. d'ai nèi dhèu ae mai oke rare ne. ka yesus ca'e la'e madhèdi asa dedha koha cue dhu panahu. na aj'a dhèu sèra dènge lii pakasame. dhèu dhu titu ètu dedha salae sèra aa'i-aa'i nanene yesus aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua.

source_text: and rebbe melech hamoshiach was giving them torah with many meshalim parables and in the shiurim he said, he was saying to them:
target_text: na aj'a si lii holo-nori rupa-rupa pake lii pakasame. aku nèngu sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: listen. hinei! the sower went out to sow seeds.
target_text: nanene paie-iie! dhèu èci la'e ceb'e hini ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: and it came about that when he went to sow, that some seeds fell beside the road. and the birds came and devoured it.
target_text: ropa na ceb'e hini sèra, cahag'e lèke ètu sebhe j'ara. kabèdhi laa, manu-bhui mai ka ra'a aa'i.

source_text: and other seeds fell upon the rocky places where it did not have much soil, and ofen ort immediately it sprang up because it did not have depth of soil.
target_text: cahag'e hari lèke ètu era rai dhu pènu dènge hadhu. hini sèra muri, te ngaa rai isi dhoka ciki oo'e di.

source_text: and when the shemesh rose, it was scorched and, because it did not have a shoresh root, it withered.
target_text: ropa lod'o rea mai, ana nganga'a sèra kamale eele hèia madhe aa'i si, lula amo d'ai boe d'ara rai.

source_text: and other seed fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked them, and it did not yield pri.
target_text: hini cahag'e lèke ètu dedha rai dhu pènu dènge j'u'u padhudhu. ropa j'u'u sèra muri, hèlu rare ana nganga'a sèra, ka j'aj'i boe hua-hela.

source_text: and other seed fell into the adamah tovah good ground and it was giving pri fruit, rising up and growing, thirty, sixty, and one hundredfold.
target_text: te ngaa hini cahag'e lèke ètu dedha rai hèu mèngi. hini sèra muri dènge sega. hua ae titu kèna. cahag'e dhu abhu d'ai tèlu nguru hari, cahag'e èna nguru hari, aa cahag'e d'ai cangasu hari.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was saying, he who has ears to hear, let him hear.
target_text: de ladhe cee dènge ro'a dhilu, na, nanene paie!

source_text: and when he was alone, the shneym asar were asking him for a hezber explanation of the meshalim parables.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus mesa na. hèia ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua dènge pèri-pèri dhèu dhu tadèngi le lii holo-nori na, mai paraga dènge ne. ka ra karèi sasoa nèti lii pakasame èèna.

source_text: and he was saying to them, to you the raz secret of the malchut hashem has been given. but to the outsiders, everything remains in meshalim,
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, lula miu tare'a-re'a neo me'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua, ja'a neo peka dènge miu. te ngaa mi dhèu leo, ja'a pake lii pakasame.

source_text: in order that yiru they may see and not have daas, vshimu they may hear and not have binah, lest they should turn and they should receive refuah and selicha.
target_text: tatao dhèu leo sèra sama sèmi dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua suri tèke, peka na, ‘rèngu rèdhi le, te ngaa ro'o boe re'a. rèngu tadèngi le, te ngaa ro'o boe tèke ètu d'ara. ladhe sèmi èèna, hud'i rèngu sène. ra parcaya ia ka lamatua, sèna ka lamatua saku eele ia ka sasala ra. '

source_text: and rebbe melech hamoshiach says to them, do you not have daas of the meaning of this mashal? then how will you have binah of all the meshalim?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka dènge dhèu sèra sasoa lii pakasame hini èèna, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu me'a boe sasoa nèti lii upama deo na, carui risi hari miu me'a sasoa lii pakasame dhu leo.

source_text: the one sowing sows the dvar hashem.
target_text: de sasoa na sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu dhu ceb'e hini èèna, nuka dhèu dhu lole lii holo-nori ama lamatua.

source_text: and these are the ones beside the road where the dvar hashem is sown. and when they hear it, ofen ort hasatan comes and takes the dvar that has been sown in them.
target_text: hini dhu lèke ètu sebhe j'ara ka manu-bhui mai ra'a aa'i, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua. te ngaa nèbhu boe, dhèu aae nidhu mai parame rare lii holo-nori nèti d'ara dhèu èèna.

source_text: and these are the ones sown upon the rocky places: when they hear the dvar, ofen ort with simcha they receive it.
target_text: aa hini dhu lèke ètu dedha hadhu, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu nanene, ka na sèmi nare lii holo-nori èèna dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: yet they do not have a shoresh root in themselves but are transitory; then when es tzarah comes or redifah persecution on account of the dvar, ofen ort they fall away, they become shmad.
target_text: te ngaa lii holo-nori ne, taha nèbhu boe ètu d'ara dhèu èèna. ropa nèngu paraga j'aj'èra lula na sèmi nare lii ne'e, na tèke eele.

source_text: and others are the ones sown among thorns. these are the ones having heard the dvar,
target_text: aa hini dhu lèke ètu talora j'u'u dhu padudhu, èci èèna ka dènge lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu dhèu nanene.

source_text: and the worries of the olam hazeh and the seduction of ashires riches and the desires for other things come in and choke the dvar hashem and it does not bear pri.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu èèna bhute dhoka dènge rupa-rupa madha j'ara rai-haha dhu pakarej'e ngi'u na. nèti èèna ka, j'ara se'e seti eele lii holo-nori ama lamatua nèti d'ara nèngu, ka j'aj'i heka ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: and these are the ones sown upon adamah tovah: they hear the dvar hashem and are mekabel receive the dvar hashem and bear pri, thirty, sixty and one hundredfold.
target_text: te ngaa hini dhu lèke ètu dedha rai hèu mèngi, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu pasa dhilu ho nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua dènge karej'e-karae. tatao nèngu madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua dènge d'ara kateme. dhèu ne'e tao j'ara-j'ara dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua, sama sèmi hini dhu nèti hua-hela. abhu kahèi d'ai tèlu nguru hari, cahag'e d'ai èna nguru hari, aa abhu kahèi dhu d'ai cangasu hari.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was saying to them, surely a menorah is not brought out in order that it may be put under a measuring bucket or under the couch? rather, is it not brought out that it may be placed on the shulchan?
target_text: nèti dedha koha, yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na. na peka hari lii upama èci, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ee! miu mèdhi le, do dhae? dhèu suru rare labhu, ka saguru eele hari dènge soe! ka ra tèke asa ro'a koi la'e! aad'o, sina ma? te ladhe sèmi èèna, tèdhi boe saraa nèngu. dhèu hud'i tao labhu ètu era dhu dedha, sèna ka dhèu rèdhi saraa nèngu.

source_text: for there is not anything nistar except that it may be made nikar nor has it become concealed but that it may come into the open.
target_text: ngaa dhu dhèu pahuni deo ne'e, bèli-camèd'a dhèu rèdhi aa'i. te ngaa dhu dhèu re'a boe lod'o deo ne'e, bèli-camèd'a dhèu re'a aa'i.

source_text: if anyone has ears to hear, let him hear.
target_text: de ladhe cee dhu dènge ro'a dhilu, na, nanene paie!

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was saying to them, pay attention! by what measure you measure, it will be measured to you, and still more will be added to you.
target_text: nanene paie-iie! ladhe miu tenge sasala dhèu, na, dhèu leo tenge sasala miu kahèi. sèmi èèna kahèi, ama lamatua tenge sasala miu. te ngaa na tao bia risi hari nèti èèna.

source_text: for whoever has, it will be given to him, and whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
target_text: ladhe dhèu èci neo tenge tare'a-re'a dad'èi lamatua, nèngu asa d'èlu-mèu. te ngaa ladhe dhèu pusi-pahae boe dad'èi lamatua, nèngu j'aj'i asa goa.

source_text: and he was saying, thus is the malchut hashem: like a man who casts seed upon the soil,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, paredha ama lamatua asa tabha kapai, sama sèmi hini dhu dhèu ceb'e ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: and goes to sleep blailah at night and arises byom at day, and the seed sprouts up and grows in such a way that he does not have daas of how it does so.
target_text: nèngu ceb'e nare, ka la'e bhèj'i. tao heka ai hèb'a mi hini sèra. te ngaa hini sèra muri, ka asa kapai.

source_text: on its own, the soil bears pri: first the blade, then a head of grain, then full wheat in the head.
target_text: hini se muri unu ra. mulai ti rèu, hela, toke d'ai huri.

source_text: but when the crop is ripe, ofen ort immediately he puts forth the maggal, ki vashal katzir sickle, for the harvest is ripe.
target_text: ropa kasere nare nganga'a dhu ètu d'ara oka mami, dhèu unu oka heka la'e puu-g'ètu kèna. sèmi èèna kahèi, paredha ama lamatua. lamatua ka dhu ad'u-ue aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was saying, to what should we compare the malchut hashem or by what mashal parable may we present it?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus padhai lii hari, ja'a peka hari lii upama èci sèmi ne'e ka: miu ladhe sèku, dhèu dhu j'aj'i unu lamatua sèra. uru èèna ciki di, nèbhu-nèbhu j'aj'i ae.

source_text: the malchut hashem is like a mustard seed, which, when it is sown on the soil, is smaller than all the seeds on the earth:
target_text: èèna sama sèmi lamusi aj'u dhu ana iiki-iiki.

source_text: but when it is sown, it grows up and becomes greater than all the plants of the garden and puts forth large branches, so that the oph hashomayim can nest under its shade.
target_text: ladhe èdhi sèla lamusi èèna, na muri mai, j'aj'i aj'u dhu kapai aae. manu-bhui nèti mia-mia mai tèka tenge mamaho, dènge tao rèd'a ètu kolo aj'u èèna.

source_text: and with many such meshalim, rebbe, melech hamoshiach was speaking to them the dvar hashem as they were able to hear.
target_text: j'ara-j'ara a'aj'a yesus madhutu rare'a dhèu.

source_text: but apart from meshalim, rebbe, melech hamoshiach was not speaking to them. only privately, in a yechidus, was rebbe melech hamoshiach explaining everything to his own talmidim.
target_text: ladhe na aj'a dhèu leo, na pake lii pakasame. te ngaa ladhe na aj'a ana madhutu na, nèngu peka aa'i-aa'i sasoa lii pakasame sèra.

source_text: and on that day, when erev had come, rebbe melech hamoshiach says to them, let us go over to the other side of the lake.
target_text: d'ai lod'o nihia na, yesus aj'a dhèu nèti dedha koha era. hèia na pua ana madhutu na sèra, peka na, mai èdhi pakèd'i lati asa cabèka dano.

source_text: and leaving the multitude, they took rebbe, melech hamoshiach, just as he was, in the sirah boat, and other sirot boats were with him.
target_text: ka ra ca'e koha èci dènge yesus. ra pakèd'i tèke eele dhèu ae sèra ètu èèna. te ngaa dhèu cahag'e ca'e koha leo madhutu yesus si.

source_text: and there arose a fierce gale of wind and the waves were beating against the sirah boat, so that it was already filling up. and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was in the stern on the cushion sleeping, and they woke him up, and they say to him, rebbe, does it not matter to you that we are perishing?
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus pasaluu kètu na mi nanèlu, ka bhèj'i luu ètu hui koha. nèbhu boe ka, ngèlu aae mai. naha kapai, ka èi tao sabhori oe pènu koha yesus si. nèti èèna ka, ana madhutu yesus sèra madha'u bia. hèia ra parèi ne, ama! kèd'i ku laa! èdhi oe molo kèna! te ngaa ama pusi-pahae boe!

source_text: and having been awakened, rebbe melech hamoshiach rebuked the wind, and he spoke to the lake, sha! be still! and there was a great calm.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii parèi ra, ka na kèd'i, hèia na kai ngèlu, peka na, mau ka! ka na paredha naha, aku nèngu na, mera ka! hèia ngèlu mau, aa naha mera dènge ka.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, why do you have morech lev cowardliness? do you still not have emunah?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus jèke ana madhutu na, peka na, nga tao ka miu madha'u sèmi èèna? miu parcaya ja'a, do aad'o?

source_text: and they were afraid with a terrible pachad terror, and they were saying to one another, who then is this that even the wind and the sea obey him?
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra madha'u dènge malaa, ka èci peka dènge èci, te dhèu ngaa ne? ka bisa ngèlu dènge naha, madhutu lii paredha nèngu?

source_text: and they came to the other side of the lake, to the country of the gerasenes.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra d'ai cabèka dano galilea. era èèna, ngara na garasa.

source_text: and as soon as rebbe melech hamoshiach stepped out of the sirah boat, ofen ort immediately, a man with a ruach hatumah from the kevarim tombs of the burial caves met him. this man had his dwelling among the kevarim. and no one could keep him tied any longer, even with sharsherot chains, fetters; because often he had been bound with shackles and the shackles had been torn apart by him, and no one had the koach power to subdue him. and constantly, yomam valailah day and night, among the kevarim and in the mountains, he was crying out and beating himself with stones. and, having seen rebbe, melech hamoshiach from afar, he ran and fell down before him.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu mone èci dhu nidhu tao, ka na huj'u. dhèu huj'u ne pea ètu era padhane dhèu madhe. mèu-mèda na kako ca'e-puru ledhe ètu èèna, dènge pake boe mèdha-papake. na pa'oo-parodha ma'ète boe, aa na nare hadhu ho tuku iisi na toke d'ai nu'a. na èra titu kèna. nèti èèna ka, dhèu èci sa bisa boe èki ne. masi ka ra èki dènge rate bèsi èèna ka, bisa boe kahèi. pèri-pèri hari, dhèu uj'u haga-ai na kahèi, pake rate dènge kanau bèsi, te ngaa na pama'ète aa'i si. dhèu ne èra bia, nèti èèna ka, èci sa taha boe ne. ropa yesus dènge ana madhutu na puru nèti dedha koha, dhèu huj'u èèna ladhe nèdhi rèngu nèti kaj'èu. hèia na kalua nèti era padhane dhèu madhe, ka na mai patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus.

source_text: and having cried out with a kol gadol loud voice, he says, mah lanu valach, yehoshua, ben haelohim haelyon? i implore you by hashem, do not torment me. for rebbe, melech hamoshiach had been saying to him, come out of the man, ruach hatumah unclean spirit!
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi rèhu dhèu ne'e, hèia yesus peka, na, hee, nidhu bhelu! kalua pakaj'èu nèti dhèu ne'e. èle èèna ka, dhèu èèna pajèka, aku nèngu na, weh! èu neo tao ngaa mi ja'a? ja'a ke'a èu ne yesus, ana nèti ama lamatua dhu koasa risi eele. ja'a manèngi èu baku paj'èra ja'a!

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was questioning him, saying, what is your name? and he says to him, legion is my name, for we are many!
target_text: hèia yesus karèi ne, ngara èu cee? na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ngara ja'a legion, lula ji'i ae titu kèna, sama sèmi ca kaboko sordad'u!

source_text: and he begged rebbe melech hamoshiach again and again not to exorcise him and banish him from that place.
target_text: èle èèna ka, nidhu sèra peka re dhèu huj'u èèna, ho manèngi yesus, sèna ka baku pua rèngu kalua nèti d'ara rae ne.

source_text: now there was a large herd of chazirim feeding nearby on the hillside.
target_text: kaj'èu boe nèti èèna, abhu hahi ca oka dhu dhèu madhenge. ele boe hahi sèra dua riho ngi'u. dhu tenge nganga'a ètu sebhe ledhe.

source_text: and they the ruchot hatemeiot, the shedim implored rebbe, melech hamoshiach, saying, send us into the chazirim, so that we may go into them.
target_text: ka nidhu sèra manèngi yesus, aku rèngu na, hia ji'i maso asa d'ara hahi sèra.

source_text: and he permitted them. and having come out, the ruchot hatemeiot entered into the chazirim. and the herd of chazirim rushed down the slope into the lake, and there were about two thousand of them, and they were drowned in the lake.
target_text: tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, hèia yesus d'èi kahèi. ka nidhu sèra kalua nèti d'ara dhèu èèna, ka lasi asa d'ara hahi sèra. hèia hahi sèra rai paj'ala, ka lasi asa sebhe tèbhi, ka ra manahu asa d'ara dano, hèia madhe aa'i si.

source_text: and the herdsmen feeding them fled and reported it in the village and in the sadot fields, and the people came to see what had come to pass.
target_text: ropa dhèu j'aga hahi sèra ladhe rèdhi madha j'ara dhu j'aj'i èèna, ra madha'u titu kèna. ka rai lasi peka palème dènge dhèu ètu d'ara rae-rae dhu dètu ètu era èèna. nèbhu boe dhèu canau-kateme mai neo re'a.

source_text: and they come to yehoshua, and they see the one that had been possessed by the shed sitting, clothed and in his right mind the very one having had the legion! and they were afraid.
target_text: dhèu sèra mai paraga dènge yesus, ka ra ladhe la'a, na, dhèu dhu nidhu tao èèna, madhèdi ètu èèna kahèi. dhèu èèna pake le mèdha-papake. kahadhu na mase'a le. rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu sèra madha'u. lula rèngu re'a le, ladhe dhèu cee dhu bisa babège eele nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu huj'u èèna, nèngu tare'a-re'a dhèu èra risi.

source_text: and the edei reiyah eyewitnesses of what had happened to the man possessed by shedim and of what had happened to the chazirim reported it.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra lasi peka palème ètu mia-mia, aku rèngu na, ji'i ngèdhi le dènge madha, dhèu huj'u ne èle le. sèmi èèna kahèi hahi dhu madhe ètu d'ara dano.

source_text: then they began to implore rebbe, melech hamoshiach to depart from their region.
target_text: ka dhèu kabarai èèna mai manèngi ho yesus tèke eele ka rai rèngu.

source_text: and as rebbe melech hamoshiach was stepping into the sirah boat, the one who had been possessed by shedim was imploring him that he might accompany him.
target_text: ropa yesus neo ca'e hari asa dedha koha, ka dhèu dhu èle nèti huj'u dhu nidhu tao èèna manèngi yesus, sèna ka nèngu madhutu ne kahèi.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach did not permit him, but says to him, go home to your people and report to them everything that hashem has done for you and that hashem had rachamim mercy upon you.
target_text: te ngaa yesus kai. ka na peka dènge dhèu èèna, aku nèngu na, be'a risi èu lèpa ka asa èmu, ho peka dènge a'ari èu, ngaa dhu ama lamatua tao le mi dedha èu. peka dènge si, mema ama lamatua sue èu titu kèna.

source_text: and the man left and began to preach in the decapolis everything that rebbe, melech hamoshiach had done for him, and everyone was amazed.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia dhèu èèna pakèd'i la'e palème rae-rae nèti canguru kota, dhu ngara na ‘dekapolis'. na lole ngaa dhu yesus tao le mi dedha nèngu. dhèu-dhèu dhu tadèngi lii lolo na, malaa aa'i mèu-mèu, aku rèngu na, mema lèke tare'a!

source_text: and when he had crossed over again in the sirah boat to the other side, a large multitude gathered together to him, and he was beside the lake.
target_text: èle ka, yesus si pakèd'i hari dènge koha asa cabèka dano. ropa ra puru nèti dedha koha, dhèu ae mai lingu rare yesus.

source_text: and one of the roshei beit haknesset comes name of ya'ir and, having seen rebbe, melech hamoshiach, he falls down at his feet,
target_text: dhèu èci mai, ngara na yairus. nèngu ne, kètu èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi ètu kota èèna. ropa nèngu nèdhi yesus, ka mai patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus.

source_text: and he begs him earnestly saying, biti my daughter is at the point of mavet. come and put your hand on her that she may receive refuah and may live.
target_text: ka na pamako, peka na, ama, ee! ana bhèni ja'a, heka canguru dua tèu, pèd'a oe madhe. mai lati ku asa èmu ja'a, sèna ka puri-pa'èle ne nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: and moshiach went with yair. and a large multitude were following him and they were pressing against moshiach.
target_text: hèia yesus la'e dènge ka, madhutu yairus asa èmu na. te ngaa ètu d'ara kakako rèngu, dhèu ae titu kèna, ka ra seti ne nèti haa, nèti dhimu.

source_text: and there was an isha having a flow of dahm for twelve years.
target_text: ètu talora dhèu ae sèra, abhu dhèu bhèni èci dhu pèd'a dhèu bhèni. papèd'a ne loe boe canguru dua tèu kèna.

source_text: and having suffered much by many rofim physicians and having spent everything she had, instead of recovering, her condition deteriorated.
target_text: mèdha-panyau dènge doi-dhari dhèu bhèni ne'e, èle aa'i mèu-mèu ho b'ae dote. te ngaa papèd'a na èle boe, asa na hoe.

source_text: and having heard about rebbe, melech hamoshiach, she came up behind him in the multitude, and touched his garment. for she was saying, if i may touch even the garment of rebbe, melech hamoshiach, i will receive refuah. and ofen ort the flow of her dahm was dried up and she felt in her basar that she has been given refuah from the shrekliche terrible machla illness.
target_text: bhèni ne tadèngi ae le dhèu palolo ngaa dhu yesus tao. nèti èèna ka, na mai pasuki asa talora dhèu ae sèra, ho na padètu dènge yesus. na pangee, na, sad'i ja'a gai lèke sebhe kodho na di, tatu papèd'a ja'a èle. ropa na gai lèke sebhe kodho yesus, kabèdhi laa raa bhèni ne tèja eele dènge. hèia na rasa, na be'a le.

source_text: and ofen ort rebbe, melech hamoshiach, having perceived within himself that gevurah miraculous power had gone forth from him, turned around in the crowd and said, who touched my garments?
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, yesus rasa a'èra kalua nèti d'ara ngi'u na. ka na kabib'a asa kabodho, ho ladhe asa dhèu ae sèra, ka na karèi, peka na, nèti miu se, cee ka dhu gai lèke kodho ja'a?

source_text: and the talmidim of rebbe melech hamoshiach were saying to him, you see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, who touched me?
target_text: ka ana madhutu na dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama, ladhe ku laa. dhèu ae paseti sèmi ne'e. nga tao ka ama karèi, peka na, ‘cee ka dhu gai kodho ja'a? '

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was looking around to see the one having done this.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ladhe pala-lème, neo ne'a cee ka dhu gai lèke sebhe kodho na.

source_text: now the isha, byirah with fear and biradah trembling, aware of what had happened to her, came and fell down before him and told him the emes truth.
target_text: ropa yesus karèi sèmi èèna, hèia bhèni èèna madha'u bia. èle èèna ka, na mai patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus, ka na mangaku, ama! ja'a ka dhu gai lèke sebhe kodho ama ku deo na.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to her, bat daughter, your emunah has brought you refuah healing. go in shalom and receive refuah from your machla.
target_text: hèia yesus peka mi bhèni ne, aku nèngu na, lula èu parcaya ja'a dènge d'ara kateme, nèti èèna ka, èu èle le. lamu ka èmu, dènge d'ara karej'e-karae.

source_text: while rebbe melech hamoshiach was still speaking, some came from the rosh beit haknesset, saying, your yaldah is a nifteret deceased person; are you still causing a shter bother for the rabbi?
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii era, hèia dhèu èci mai nèti èmu yairus, aku nèngu na, ira ii! ana mu madhe le. de baku paj'èra ia ka ama mese. nèngu la'e ia ka sa nèi.

source_text: but rebbe, melech hamoshiach, having overheard what was being spoken, says to the rosh beit haknesset, do not be afraid; only have emunah.
target_text: te ngaa yesus pusi boe dènge lii padhai lii dhèu ne'e. ka na peka dènge yairus, èu baku madha'u, ee! parcaya mi ama lamatua di.

source_text: and rebbe melech hamoshiach did not permit anyone to follow after him, except kefa and ya'akov and yochanan, the brother of ya'akov.
target_text: hèia yesus la'e dènge ka, tèke eele ana madhutu na cahag'e. nèti dhoka petrus, yakobis dènge yohanis.

source_text: and they come into the bais of the rosh beit haknesset, and rebbe, melech hamoshiach beheld much commotion and weeping and loud wailing.
target_text: ropa d'ai èmu yairus, rèngu rèdhi dhèu jau oob'a-jau oob'a, aa tadèngi cahag'e tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: and having entered, he says to them, why are you distressed and weeping? the yaldah is not a nifteret but is only sleeping.
target_text: yesus maso asa d'ara, ka na karèi si, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu maruru dènge tangi sèmi ne'e? ana ne'e madhe boe! nèngu dhoka bhèj'i di.

source_text: and they began making leitzonus mockery, fun of him. but having put everyone out, rebbe melech hamoshiach takes the abba of the naarah girl and the em and the ones with him, and goes into where the naarah was.
target_text: dhèu ètu sèra tadèngi yesus peka sèmi èèna, ka ra mari pakapengo hèb'a dènge ne. hèia na pua dhèu sèra kalua aa'i nèti d'ara kama ana dhu madhe èèna. ka na paroa ina-ama ana bhèni ne, dènge ana madhutu na dhèu tèlu sèra, maso asa d'ara.

source_text: and having grasped the hand of the naarah, moshiach says to her, talitha koum, which, being translated, means little girl, to you i say, arise!
target_text: hèia yesus kèpe kacui-aai ana dhu madhe ne, ka na padhai lii pake lii rèngu, lii aram, aku nèngu na, talita kum! sasoa na, ana bhèni! kèd'i ka!

source_text: and ofen ort the naarah got up and she was walking around. she was twelve years old. and ofen ort they were amazed with great wonder. and he gave orders to them earnestly that no one should have daas of this. and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to give her some okhel food.
target_text: kabèdhi laa, ana dhu madhe èèna mamuri hari. hèia na kèd'i titu, ka na kako. hèia yesus peka dènge ina na, aku nèngu na, hia ana ne'e na'a-ninu! dhèu ae ètu sèra dhu rèdhi j'ara dhu j'aj'i ne, ra malaa titu kèna. hèia yesus kai si, peka na, mage mi peka dènge dhèu èci sa, ja'a ka dhu pamamuri hari ana ne.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach came out from there and comes into his shtetl and his talmidim follow him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, lèpa hari asa rae na, nasaret.

source_text: and shabbos having come, rebbe, melech hamoshiach began to say shiurim in the shul, and many, listening, were amazed, saying, from where did this one get lernen torah learning, and what is the chochmah wisdom that has been given to this one? and what gevurot mighty deeds are being done by his hands?
target_text: lod'o èèna lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi. hèia yesus la'e asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ho na aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua ètu èèna. lod'o èèna, dhèu ae lasi manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa ra tadèngi yesus aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua, hèia dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra malaa, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne mèu samia ne! na dènge koasa kahèi! tasamia ka na sèmi èèna, ee?

source_text: is not this one the naggar carpenter, ben miryam? the brother of ya'akov, yosi, yehuda and shim'on? and, are not his achayot here with us? and they were taking offense at rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: nèngu ne'e dhoka tuka aj'u di. èdhi tadhe ina na, maria. sèmi èèna kahèi ari na, yakobis, yoses, yudas dènge simon, dènge ari na dhèu bhèni sèra. rèngu dènge èdhi pea ca rae. dhèu se'e ngee ètu d'ara rèngu na, rèngu mèu risi nèti yesus. nèti èèna ka, ra d'èi heka nanene ne.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was saying to them, a navi is not without his kavod, except in his own shtetl and among his own mishpochah and in his own bais.
target_text: ka yesus peka, mema tare'a! dhèu pakab'ua risi dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua nèti rae leo. te ngaa ra pakab'ua boe dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu nèti rae nèngu.

source_text: and he was not able there to do many nissim miracles, except on a few cholim sick people he laid his hands and administered refuah healing to them.
target_text: d'ara dhèu sèra adhu sèmi hadhu, ka ra parcaya boe lii padhai lii yesus. nèti èèna ka, na malaa, hèia na pake boe koasa na. ka na puri-pa'èle dhoka dhèu pèri di, ètu èèna.

source_text: and he wondered on account of their lack of emunah. and he was going around the shtetlach in a circuit, saying shiurim.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus kako palème asa rae-rae dhu padètu ètu sèra, ho aj'a dhèu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua.

source_text: and rebbe melech hamoshiach summons the shneym asar, and he began to send them out two by two, and he was giving to them samchut over the ruchot hatumah.
target_text: na paroa nare ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua sèra, ka na pua rèngu lasi dua-dua ho lole lii lolo be'a nèti ama lamatua. na hia si koasa kahèi, ho babège eele nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach gave directives to them that they should take nothing on the derech except a mere walking stick, not lechem, not a schnorrerʼs sack, nor a money belt; but instead, to wear sandals, and not to take an extra bekishe.
target_text: na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, miu baku mèti mèdha ae ètu d'ara kakako miu. baku mèti nganga'a, doi, dènge tas. mèti dhoka tatea, salapa ètu haga, dènge kodho ètu ua di.

source_text: and he was saying to them, wherever you enter into a bais, stay there until you leave that area.
target_text: ladhe cee dhu sèmi rare miu ètu èmu ra, miu pea dhoka ètu èèna di, toke d'ai pakèd'i hari.

source_text: and whatever place does not give you the kabbalat panim welcome, and does not listen to you, then, as you are leaving there, let it be nier chatzno, shake off the dust of your feet, for an edut to them.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu lami asa era èci, hèia dhèu ètu sèra sèmi rare boe miu, aa ra d'èi boe nanene lii padhai lii miu, tèke eele era èèna. aa peka mi dhèu sèra, na, ‘miu mo'o boe nanene, si! de bèli-camèd'a sèmi mere pala mi! '

source_text: and having gone out, they preached that bnei adam should make teshuva.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra lasi lole lii lolo be'a. ra peka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i ele ho'a nèti sasala-sasigo ra, ka lèpa ho mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: and many shedim they were casting out, and they were anointing with shemen many cholim, and they were administering refuah to them.
target_text: ka ra babège eele nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu. ra pasuti èi lèngi mi kètu dhèu pèd'a, aa sabaj'a ho pa'èle si nèti papèd'a. ka ra èle dènge.

source_text: and herod the king heard of it, for the name of yehoshua had become bavust famous, and some were saying, yochanan of the tevilah of teshuva has been made to stand up alive from the mesim, and for this reason the nissim miracles are at work in him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ètu mia-mia tadhe aa'i le yesus. dhèu aae herodes tadèngi le lii lolo lula-nèti koasa yesus kahèi. dhèu palolo ètu mia-mia, aku rèngu na, yohanis tuka sarani èèna, mamuri hari le ètu d'ara ngi'u yesus! nèti èèna ka, na bisa tao tadha malaa sèra.

source_text: but others were saying, it is eliyahu hanavi. still others were saying, he is a navi, like one of the neviim of old.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu cahag'e hari peka, aku rèngu na, aad'o! ne'e ne, elia dhu mamuri hari d'ara ngi'u yesus. aa dhèu cahag'e hari, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu leo hari nèti uru sèra.

source_text: but when herod heard of it, he kept saying, yochanan whom i beheaded has stood up alive from the mesim!
target_text: ropa dhèu aae herodes tadèngi nare lii lolo dhèu se'e lula-nèti yesus, ka na dhaa, peka na, èèna yohanis tuka sarani, dhu ca hari ni ja'a hia dhèu pare pamadhe le, te ngaa na mamuri hari!

source_text: for herod himself had sent and had yochanan arrested and bound in the beis hasohar, on account of herodias, the wife of his brother, philippos, for he had married her. but yochanan was saying to herod, it is not mutar according to the torah for you to have your brotherʼs wife.
target_text: dhèu aae herodes pua sèmi èèna, lula nèngu lii langu dènge yohanis. lii lolo na sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu aae herodes leo nare dhèu èmu ari na, pelipus, ngara na herodias. aa te ngaa pelipus dènge herodias dhae pa'ia mèka. nèti èèna ka, yohanis kai pahari-pahari, peka na, ama dhèu aae baku leo dènge dhèu èmu ari mu. te èèna sisu ad'a èdhi dhèu yahudi. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa herodes leo nare bhèni ne'e kahèi. hèia na pua dhèu lasi kèpe rare yohanis, ho pamaso ne asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: and herodias bore a grudge against yochanan and desired to kill him. but she could not.
target_text: lula yohanis kai pèri hari le, hèia bhèni ne tèka d'ara dènge ne, ka na neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa lake nare mèka, te herodes dhu pamaso le yohanis asa d'ara bèdho la'e.

source_text: for herod feared yochanan, knowing him to be a tzaddik and kadosh, and herod was protecting yochanan. and when herod heard yochanan, he was greatly disturbed, and yet gladly herod was listening to yochanan.
target_text: ka na pua sordad'u sèra madhenge paie ne ètu d'ara bèdho. herodes madha'u dènge yohanis. na ne'a tare'a, yohanis ne dhèu dhu ama lamatua pua mai. aa yohanis ne dhèu d'ara mola. herodes d'èi nanene lii padhai lii yohanis kahèi. te ngaa stèka-stèka, d'ara na pèd'a nanene lii padhai lii yohanis.

source_text: and, an opportune day having come, when herod, on his yom huledet birthday, gave a mishteh for the court of his nobles, and the military commanders, and those of chashivut prominence of the galil,
target_text: ka ca tèka, herodias abhu lod'o dhu be'a, sèna ka na b'ala d'ara pèd'a na. lod'o èèna, lèke dènge hari jadi herodes. ka ra nèru dhèu aae-dhèu kapai mai ra'a-sisi hari jad'i. dhèu dhu mai sèra, ama-ama dhu paredha, ama-ama sordad'u, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a ètu galilea.

source_text: and when his daughter entered and danced, she pleased herod and the ones reclining at the seudah with him. and the king said to the girl, ask me whatever you wish and i will give it to you.
target_text: ètu d'ara talora tatao èèna, ana bhèni herodias la'e roge. na roge be'a risi eele, ka d'ara herodes dènge dhèu dhu nèru sèra karej'e bia. nèti èèna ka, herodes paroa ne mai asa madha, ka na karèi, aku nèngu na, èu neo manèngi ngaa? èu peka ho ja'a hia.

source_text: and he made a shevuah oath to her solemnly, whatever you ask me, i will give you, up to half of my malchut.
target_text: èu manèngi era paredha ja'a ne bagi dua, hia èu cabèka èèna ka, ja'a ko'o kahèi. ja'a subha dènge ngara ama lamatua!

source_text: and having gone out, she said to her mother, what should i ask for? and her mother said, the rosh yochanan of the tevilah of teshuva.
target_text: ka ana bhèni èèna la'e karèi ina na, aku nèngu na, ina, ee! madhutu ngangee ina ku, na, ja'a manèngi ngaa dhu be'a risi nèti ama ku? ka ina na dhaa, aku nèngu na, lamu asa madha ama mu ho peka dènge ne, ja'a manèngi dhoka kètu yohanis di.

source_text: and having entered, ofen ort, with haste before the king, she made a request, saying, you may give to me upon a platter the rosh yochanan of the tevilah of teshuva.
target_text: ka ana bhèni ne la'e asa madha herodes, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ama! ja'a manèngi kètu yohanis, tao ètu d'ara dula èci hia ja'a. deo ne'e ne, kahèi!

source_text: and having become very sad, the king, on account of his shevuah and on account of the ones reclining at the seudah with him, was unwilling to refuse her.
target_text: ropa herodes tadèngi nare lii manèngi ana bhèni na, ka d'ara na cag'ag'a. te ngaa nèngu bisa heka ère hari lii subha nèngu deo na, lula dhèu ètu sèra tadèngi aa'i le.

source_text: and, ofen ort, the king sent an executioner and commanded him to bring the rosh yochanan. and having left, the executioner beheaded yochanan of the tevilah of teshuva in the beit hasohar.
target_text: èle èèna ka, herodes paredha komedhaa sordad'u lasi poro rare kètu yohanis nèti d'ara bèdho.

source_text: and he brought the rosh yochanan upon a platter and gave it to the young girl, and the young girl gave it to her mother.
target_text: ropa ra poro rare, ra tao asa d'ara dula èci, ka rèti la'a asa ana bhèni èèna. na sèmi nare, hèia nèti asa ina na la'e.

source_text: and, having heard this, yochananʼs talmidim came and carried away his geviyah body and placed it in a kever grave.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu yohanis sèra tadèngi ra poro rèti le kètu yohanis, rèngu mai nedhe rèti ngi'u nèngu lasi padhane. d'ai sange ne'e ka, lii lolo mamadhe yohanis.

source_text: and the shlichim gathered together with rebbe, melech hamoshiach and reported to him everything which they did and the torah which they had taught.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, ana madhutu yesus dhu na pua lasi asa rae-rae ho aj'a dhèu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua sèra, lèpa hari mai, ka ra pakaboko hari dènge ne. ra lolo dènge yesus ngaa dhu rèngu tao dènge aj'a mi dhèu.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to them, come away a while, you yourselves, for a yechidus in a quiet place for a shabbaton rest from work. for there were many coming and going, and they did not even have time for okhel food.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae mai patangi-tenge yesus. lula dhèu ae seli eele, ka yesus dènge ana madhutu na abhu boe tebho ra'a-rinu hèi. nèti èèna ka, yesus ale dènge ana madhutu sèra, peka na, be'a risi èdhi pakèd'i nèti era ne'e lati tenge era èci dhu mau, sèna ka èdhi ae tara ciki.

source_text: and they departed in the sirah boat to a secluded place for a yechidus.
target_text: ka ra ca'e koha cue lasi asa era dhu mau, kaj'èu nèti d'ara rae.

source_text: and the people, recognizing them, saw them departing, and from all the shtetlach they ran there and arrived ahead of them.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae ètu sèra sa, ladhe rèdhi koha rèngu kako re sebhe dano. hèia ra kalua nèti rae ka kako pamèri madhutu re dedha rai. nèti èèna ka, rèngu d'ai uuru yesus si.

source_text: and having gotten out of the sirah boat, rebbe, melech hamoshiach saw a large multitude and he had rachmei shomayim heavenly mercy on them, for they were katson asher ain lahem roeh like sheep without a shepherd, and he began with his torah to teach them many things.
target_text: ropa yesus puru nèti dedha koha, ladhe laa, na, dhèu ae dhu mate ne. dhèu se'e re'a heka tao iisi ra tasamia. nèti èèna ka, d'ara yesus sue si, te rèngu sama sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho dhu dènge boe ana madhenga. èle èèna ka, na aj'a si j'ara mamuri ama lamatua.

source_text: and when it was already a late hour, his talmidim came up to him and were saying, this place is desolate and already it is late. send them away, that, having departed to the surrounding farms and shtetlach, they may buy for themselves okhel food they may eat.
target_text: na aj'a nèti loo nètu, toke d'ai nihia la'e. hèia ana madhutu na sèra mai padhue dènge ne, aku rèngu na, ama! hua iia ama ku pua si lasi hèli nganga'a ètu rae dhu dètu ètu era se'e. te oe mèda kèna, aa ètu era ne'e nganga'a aad'o.

source_text: but in reply, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, you yourselves give them to eat. and they say to him, shall we go and spend two hundred denarii for lechem and give to them to eat something?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala lii rèngu, aku nèngu na, baku tao sèmi èèna! hud'i laa, pe miu panga'a si. hèia ra karèi hari ne, ira, ee! ladhe èdhi panga'a dhèu ae sèmi ne'e, èdhi kalua doi ae bia, nga. sama sèmi gaji tuka ca tèu kateme, nga! aa èdhi tare doi sèra, nèti mia hua kèna!

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to them, how much lechem do you have? go and see. and knowing, the talmidim of rebbe, melech hamoshiach say, chamesh five, and dagim, shenayim two.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, miu lami karèi sèku dhèu sèra, teko cee dhu nèti nganga'a mèra. hèia ra lasi karèi, ka mai peka dènge ne, abhu dhoka roti lèmi bua, dènge i'a dua ngi'u di.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach commanded them to recline at tish, as it were, everyone group by group, on the green grass.
target_text: hèia yesus pua dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra ho madhèdi cakaboko-cakaboko ètu dedha j'u'u.

source_text: and they reclined, group by group, in hundreds and in fifties.
target_text: dhèu se'e madhèdi sèmi dhu yesus pua. abhu kaboko dhu dhèu cangasu-cangasu, aa abhu kaboko dhu dhèu lèmi nguru-lèmi nguru.

source_text: and, having taken the chamesh loaves and the shnei hadagim two fish and looking up to shomayim, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said a bracha. and having offered the betziat halechem, moshiach was giving to his talmidim in order that they might set them before the people. and moshiach divided the shnei hadagim two fish among them all.
target_text: hèia yesus nare roti lèmi bua dènge i'a dua ngi'u sèra, ka na ladhe asa dedha. na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. èle èèna ka, nare roti lèmi bua, ka na ku'u pamae ca'èta-'èta. hèia na hia mi ana madhutu na, ho lasi papala hia dhèu dhu madhèdi sèra. na pala-bagi i'a dua ngi'u sèra kahèi.

source_text: and everyone ate, and they were satisfied.
target_text: ka dhèu sèra ra'a toke bècu.

source_text: and they picked up shirayim rebbeʼs remainders, shneym asar twelve baskets full, and from the dagim.
target_text: ra'a èle, hèia ana madhutu na sèra lasi pakaboko nganga'a dhu risi eele sèra, pènu canguru dua soe.

source_text: and those who had eaten the loaves numbered chamesh elafim five thousand.
target_text: dhèu dhu ra'a sèra, dhèu mone di, lèmi riho dhèu, ige mèka bhèni dènge ana iiki.

source_text: and ofen ort rebbe, melech hamoshiach compelled his talmidim to embark into the sirah boat and to go before him to the other side to beit-tzaidah, while he dismisses the multitude.
target_text: èle ka, yesus pua ana madhutu sèra pakèd'i uuru dènge koha asa rae betsaida ètu cabèka dano. te nèngu dhae la'e mèka, ho na pua dhèu ae sèra lèpa.

source_text: and with a shalom farewell to them, rebbe melech hamoshiach departed to the mountain to daven.
target_text: ropa dhèu sèra lèpa, na la'e asa ledhe èci ètu èèna, ho na manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and erev having come, the sirah boat was in the middle of the lake, and rebbe melech hamoshiach was alone on shore. and having seen them laboring at the oars, for the wind was against them, about the fourth watch of halailah, he comes to them, walking on the lake. and he wanted to go by them. but having seen him on the lake, they thought that it is a ruach refaim an apparition. and they cried out; for everyone saw him. and ofen ort he spoke with them, and they were filled with pachad terror. moshiach says to them, chazak! be strong! ani hu. i am he. do not be afraid.
target_text: lod'o mèda le, ka yesus puru mai. na ladhe nèdhi ana madhutu na sèra dènge koha lasi d'ai talora dano le. lula ngèlu madha mèdhu ae, ka ra tuku koha d'ai madhe. d'ara oe mèu sa, yesus heka la'e madhutu si kèna. te ngaa na kako re dedha èi. ropa na kako oe seli koha ra, ana madhutu sèra ladhe rèdhi ne, ka ra madha'u titu kèna. hèia èci karèi èci, aku rèngu na, irii! ngaa nèi? nidhu, do? hèia yesus lii dènge si, aku nèngu na, we! miu baku madha'u! te ja'a ne!

source_text: and he got into the sirah boat with them. and the wind died down. and in themselves they were exceedingly amazed.
target_text: ropa yesus ca'e la'e asa dedha koha, kabèdhi laa, ngèlu mau dènge. ana madhutu na sèra malaa bia.

source_text: for they did not have binah concerning the loaves, but their levavot hearts had been hardened.
target_text: rèngu heka rèdhi kèna, yesus pake koasa na, lod'o panga'a lèmi riho dhèu èèna. te ngaa rèngu re'a iia boe koasa yesus, lula d'ara rèngu adhu sèmi hadhu.

source_text: and having crossed over onto the land, they came to gennesaret and anchored.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai cabèka dano, ra panahu koha ètu dae genesaret.

source_text: and when they disembark from the sirah boat, the people ofen ort recognized rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: ropa ra puru nèti dedha koha, dhèu ae ladhe rèdhi si. ka ra rodhe lème, aku rèngu na, ee! yesus mai le!

source_text: and the people rushed everywhere in that region, and they began carrying about on their mats cholim where they heard he was. and wherever rebbe, melech hamoshiach was entering into the shtetlach or into towns or into the countryside, thy laid the cholim in the marketplaces, entreating him that they might just touch moshiachʼs tzitzit. and as many as touched it were receiving refuah healing.
target_text: dhèu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra lasi peka palème rae, nèti èèna ka, dhèu mai nèti mia-mia, jèru rèti a'ari rèngu dhu pèd'a asa yesus. sad'i ra tadèngi yesus ètu era èci, na, rame-rame nedhe rèti dhèu pèd'a mai. ra paj'unu si ètu d'ara tana lapa ètu èèna. te ra pangee, na, sad'i dhèu pèd'a sèra goi lèke sebhe kodho yesus di, èle dènge nèti papèd'a ra. ka dhèu goi lèke kodho na, hèia èle nèti papèd'a ra.

source_text: and, when they had come down from yerushalayim, the perushim and some of the sofrim come together around rebbe, melech hamoshiach,
target_text: ca lod'o, dhèu partei agama parisi canau dènge mese-mese agama mai nèti kota yerusalem neo paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: and they had observed that some of his talmidim were eating their lechem with yadayim temeiot, that is, hands ritually unclean. for the perushim, and indeed this was the jewish minhag, do not eat without doing netilat yadayim ritual of the washing of the hands and also observing the masoret hazekenimthe torah shebal peh, oral torah. and when they come from the marketplace, unless they do so, they do not eat. and there are many other things which they have received in order to observe, such as the tevilah of cups and pitchers and copper pots. and the perushim and the sofrim question rebbe, melech hamoshiach, why do your talmidim not follow the halakhah according to the masoret hazekenim, but eat their lechem with yadayim temeiot?
target_text: dhèu parisi kèpe pa'èra ad'a yahudi. nuka sèmi, dhèu neo ra'a-rinu hud'i j'amo uuru ku kacui-aai madhutu atora ad'a. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe lèpa nèti d'ara pasa, hud'i diu uuru ku èi. toke mèdha dapu rèngu sèmi èru-pangala, pega, curu, galaa, cere, hud'i rase uuru ku madhutu atora ad'a, heka bisa pake ra'a-rinu kèna. ladhe dhèu yahudi cahag'e madhutu boe ad'a rèngu sèmi èèna, dhèu parisi nasa. nèti èèna ka, ra nasa ropa rèdhi ana madhutu yesus sèra ra'a-rinu j'amo boe kacui-aai madhutu atora ad'a rèngu. ka rèngu mai pasala yesus, peka na, nga tao ka ana madhutu èu se ra'a-rinu j'amo uuru boe kacui-aai? sèra sa, pasala dènge ad'a nèti bèi-baki èdhi!

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, yeshayah rightly gave a dvar nevuah of you tzevuim, as it has been written, haam hazeh bisfatav kibduni vlibo rikhak mimeni this people with their lips honor me, but their heart is removed far away from me. vatehi yiratam oti mitzvat anashim melummadah and in vain do they worship me, teaching as doctrines the mitzvot of men.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, miu se mema padhai lii leo, tao leo! nèti uru nèka mai yesaya suri tèke le, lii padhai lii ama lamatua sèmi ne'e, ‘abhu dhèu dhu koa-kio kolongara ja'a, dhoka dènge hèb'a di, te ngaa nèti boe d'ara. tatao rèngu sèmi èèna na, lèke boe. rèngu pusi-pahae boe dad'èi ja'a, te ngaa rèngu madhutu dhoka atora dhèu rai-haha di. ' miu èci èèna kahèi.

source_text: abandoning the mitzvat hashem, you are holding to the masoret habnei adam. and he was saying to them, you have a fine knack for setting aside the mitzvat hashem in order that your own masorot might stand undisturbed.
target_text: miu tèke eele le paredha ama lamatua, ho madhutu atora dhèu rai-haha. tatao miu ne, d'èlu-mèu bia!

source_text: for moshe said, kabed es avicha ves immecha honor your father and your mother, and, the one reviling aviv vimmo mot yumat father or mother let him be put to death.
target_text: karèi nèti uuru èèna, musa peka le lii paredha ama lamatua sèmi ne'e ka, ‘pakab'ua ina-ama miu. ' aa tabha hari, peka na, ‘ladhe ana èci padhèda ama na, do ina na, hud'i ra huku pamadhe ne. '

source_text: but you say, if a man says to his abba or to his em, whatever by me you might have benefited is korban, then no longer do you permit him to do anything for his abba or his em.
target_text: ama lamatua aj'a sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu aj'a leo. miu peka na, ‘ladhe dhèu èci pamoa le neo hia ngaa èci mi ama lamatua, masi ka ina dènge ama na j'èra oe madhe èèna ka, te ngaa pake boe mèdha èèna ho soru-bara si, lula nèngu moa le neo hia mi lamatua. '

source_text: you nullify and make void the dvar hashem by means of your masoret you received. and you do many similar things.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, deo na ja'a peka le, miu pake heka dad'èi ama lamatua, te ngaa miu gati eele dènge atora miu dhu hiu. atora ae le dhu miu gati eele sèmi èèna.

source_text: and having summoned again the multitude, he was saying to them, give ear to me and have binah understanding.
target_text: hèia yesus paroa hari dhèu leo ètu sèra, ka na peka na, pasa dhilu ho nanene paie, sèna ka miu me'a.

source_text: there is nothing outside of a ben adam human being entering into him which is able to make him tameh, but it is the things coming out from the ben adam that make him tameh.
target_text: ngaa dhu maso asa d'ara d'èlu, pakaj'alu boe. te ngaa dhu kalua mai nèti d'ara, èèna ka dhu pakaj'alu dhèu.

source_text: he who has oznayim to hear, let him hear.
target_text: cee dènge ro'a dhilu, na, nanene.

source_text: and when he left the multitude and entered a bais, his talmidim were asking him about the mashal.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na tèke eele dhèu sèra, ka lasi asa d'ara èmu èci. ka ana madhutu sèra karèi sasoa nèti lii pakasame deo na.

source_text: and he says to them, are you so lacking in binah also? do you not have binah that it is not what is outside and entering into the ben adam that is able to make him tameh unclean? because it does not enter into his lev, but into his stomach and goes out into the latrine, making all the okhel tohar.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, miu me'a boe kahèi? sasoa na sèmi ne'e ka: ngaa dhu dhèu ra'a, èèna be'a. te ngaa dhu kalua mai, karehe. èèna be'a boe. ngaa dhu èdhi ta'a, maso asa d'ara d'èlu, ho èèna na kalua hari asa li'u la'e. lii yesus èèna neo peka mi èdhi, nganga'a aa'i-aa'i, èci sa dhu luri boe.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was saying, it is the thing proceeding out of the ben adam that makes him tameh.
target_text: ngaa dhu mai nèti d'ara, èèna ka dhu pa'ele iie dhèu, nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua d'èi boe pa'èci dènge ne.

source_text: for from within the lev of the ben adam comes evil cravings and machshavot: then zenunim fornications, gneyvot thefts, retzichot murders,
target_text: te j'ara bhelu-katub'a ae ka dhu kalua nèti d'ara dhèu! nuka sèmi: ngangee karehe, tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu boe nèngu, mana'u, pamadhe dhèu,

source_text: niufim adulteries, chamdanut greediness, rishah wickedness, nechalim scheming deceitfulness, zimmah lewdness, sensuality, an ayin horo or roah ayin an envious evil eye, lashon hora, gaavah pride, and ivvelet foolishness.
target_text: gagoo-gagehu, bersina, bhelu-katub'a, leko-monya, dhèu dhu taha nare boe d'ara, d'èi boe dhèu risi nèngu, padhai lii pamanahu dhèu, padedha iisi, tatao dhu lèke boe, dènge kètu hadhu.

source_text: all these evil things proceed from within and make the ben adam tameh.
target_text: j'ara karehe aa'i-aa'i sèra mai nèti d'ara dhèu. sèra ka dhu pa'ele iie dhèu. ama lamatua d'èi boe dènge dhèu sèmi èèna.

source_text: and from there he got up and departed to the district of tzor and tzidon. and having entered into a bais he wanted no one to know yet, he was not able to escape notice.
target_text: èle ka, yesus tèke eele era èèna, ka la'e asa kota èci, ngara na tirus. d'ai nèi, lasi asa d'ara èmu èci, lula yesus d'èi boe dhèu re'a nèngu ètu èèna. te ngaa nèngu bisa boe pahuni ngi'u.

source_text: but, after hearing about him, ofen ort, an isha, whose yaldah was having a ruach temeiah, came and fell down at his feet. now the woman was a yevanit greek, by birth a syrophoenician, and she was asking him to cast the shed out of her bat daughter.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu bhèni dintiu èci dhu nèti rai finisia ètu propensi siria. ropa na tadèngi yesus ètu èèna, na mai manèngi yesus babège eele nidhu nèti ana bhèni na.

source_text: and he was saying to her, rishonah allow the banim to be satisfied, for it is not tov to take the lechem of the yeladim and throw it to kelevim dogs.
target_text: te ngaa yesus core lii èci, peka na, ana-ana hud'i ra'a uuru ku, ho sisa na, ra core hia busa kèna. dènge lii pacele èèna, yesus hud'i soru-bara uuru ku dhèu yahudi nèngu, heka dhèu leo kèna.

source_text: but she replied, saying, ken, adoni, but even the kelevim under the shulchan eat from the crumbs of the yeladim.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni èèna b'ala, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a ama. te ngaa busa mate le ètu ro'a mei. nèngu abhu kahèi nganga'a dhu bèbhe nèti d'ara pega ana iiki sèra. madhutu bhèni èèna, lod'o ana ra'a, na, busa na'a kahèi. masi ka yesus soru-bara dhèu unu na, te ngaa nèngu hud'i soru-bara dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: and he said to her, because of this answer, go your way, the shed has gone out from the bat of you.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii dhaa bhèni ne, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, tare'a! lii padhai lii èu èèna, mola-mola na kèna! lèpa ka! te nidhu rai le nèti ana èu.

source_text: and having departed to her bais, she found the yaldah lying on the bed, the shed having gone out.
target_text: hèia bhèni ne la'e ka. na d'ai èmu, ana na dhu bhèj'i luu. nidhu kalua le.

source_text: when he returned from the region of tzor, and then went through tzidon to lake kinneret within the region of the decapolis,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si pakèd'i nèti kota tirus, kako lasi madhutu nebhe dhasi re kota sidon. nèti era èèna, rèngu lasi taruu d'ai dano galilea. hèia ra lasi asa rai èci dhu dènge canguru kota, dhu ra biasa pangare na, ‘dekapolis'.

source_text: they bring to him a man who was cheresh illem deaf and mute, and they entreated him to lay hands on him.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu èci dhu lii aad'o aa katele-katipa. angalai na lere rèti ne asa yesus. ra manèngi sèna ka yesus tao ai mi kètu na, sèna ka na èle.

source_text: and he took him aside from the multitude by himself and put his fingers into his ears, and spat, and with that touched the tongue of the mute man;
target_text: hèia yesus tèke eele dhèu ae sèra, ka la'e mesa na dènge dhèu èèna. yesus pamaso kacui-aai na asa ro'a dhilu dhèu eèna dua-dua. èle èèna ka, na tao ilu ètu kacui-aai na, ka na g'ag'e he'o dhèu ne'e.

source_text: and, looking up to shomayim with a deep sigh, he says to him, ephphatha, which means, be opened! .
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe asa dedha, na ère a'ae madhera, ka na paredha, aku nèngu na, efata. sasoa na, bhoke ka!

source_text: ofen ort his ears were opened, and the impediment of his lashon tongue was loosed and he was speaking properly.
target_text: na peka dhoka sèmi èèna di, kabèdhi laa, dhilu dhèu èèna tadèngi dènge. sèmi èèna kahèi, he'o dhu sakaa èèna, mako ka na padhai lii dènge.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was directing them not to tell anyone. but as much as he ordered them, they were proclaiming it all the more.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dua ra lasi asa era dhèu ae sèra. ka yesus kai si, aku nèngu na, nanene, ee! baku lolo dènge dhèu, peka na, ja'a ka dhu pa'èle dhèu ne'e ne. masi ka na kai si, te ngaa dhèu se'e lasi lolo palème d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and they were all astonished beyond all measure, saying, he has done all things tov meod very well, and he makes even the chereshim deaf people to hear and the illemim mute to speak.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu tadèngi lii lolo èèna, malaa bia. ra papeka isi-aanga ra, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne'e, dhèu di, nga! nèngu tao pabe'a aa'i mèu-mèu. dhèu katele bisa tadèngi, aa dhèu lii aad'o bisa padhai lii.

source_text: in yamim hahem those days, again, when there was a great multitude and they had no okhel food, rebbe, melech hamoshiach called his talmidim, and says to them, i have rachmei shomayim heavenly mercy, compassion on the multitude, because they already shlosha yamim three days have remained with me and they do not have anything they may eat; and if i send them away hungry to their batim houses, they will give out on the way; and some of them have come from far away.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, dhèu ae mai kamue rare yesus neo nanene lii holo-nori na. dhèu sèra tèlu lod'o kèna ètu era èèna dènge yesus. nèti èèna ka, gee ra èle aa'i le. hèia yesus paroa ana madhutu na, ka na peka, ja'a rasa kasia dènge dhèu ae se'e. cahag'e mai nèti rae kaj'èu, ètu era ne'e d'ai tèlu lod'o kèna, ka nganga'a rèngu aad'o heka ciki sa. baku hia ra lèpa dènge kabake manganga. mage dhoka ra mad'ea ho bèbha ètu j'ara.

source_text: and his talmidim answered him, from where will anyone be able to find enough lechem to feed these ones here in the midbar?
target_text: ka ana madhutu yesus sèra dhaa, peka na, ama. era ne kaj'èu nèti rae. èdhi panga'a tare boe dhèu ae sèmi ne'e!

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was asking them, how many loaves do you have? and they said, shevah.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi si, peka na, roti miu pèri bua era? ka ra dhaa peka na, ama. roti ji'i ate dhoka pidhu bua di.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach directed the multitude to recline at tish, as it were, on the ground. and having taken the sheva kikrot loaves, he made a bracha, saying the ha-motzi, and offered the betziat halechem the breaking of the bread and was giving them to his talmidim to serve to them, and they served the multitude.
target_text: ropa nanene nare, hèia na pua dhèu ae sèra madhèdi ètu rai. ka nare roti pidhu bua sèra, hèia na sabaj'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. sabaj'a nare, hèia na pamae roti pidhu bua sèra. ka na hia ana madhutu na papala mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: and they also had a few small dagim. and after he had made the bracha over them, he directed these to be served as well.
target_text: rèngu dènge i'a pèri ngi'u kahèi. ka yesus sabaj'a hari manèngi makasi. èle èèna ka, na hia ana madhutu na papala hari mi dhèu ae sèra.

source_text: and they ate and were satisfied. and there was an abundance of shirayim rebbeʼs remainders, sheva baskets full. and there were approximately arbaat elafim four thousand people. and rebbe, melech hamoshiach sent them away.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra ele boe d'ai èpa riho sa. ra ra'a toke bècu. ra'a rare, hèia ana madhutu yesus pakaboko nganga'a sisa, ka ra ige pidhu soe hahake. èle èèna ka, yesus pua dhèu se lèpa.

source_text: and ofen ort immediately, having embarked onto the sirah boat with his talmidim, rebbe, melech hamoshiach came into the region of dalmanutha.
target_text: ropa dhèu se lèpa, yesus dènge ana madhutu na ca'e koha pakèd'i asa rae èci, ngara na dalmanuta.

source_text: and the perushim came out and began to argue with him, seeking from him an ot min hashomayim a sign from heaven, testing him.
target_text: lod'o yesus si d'ai dalmanuta, dhèu partei parisi pèri-pèri mai paraga dènge yesus. ra tenge j'ara neo pamanahu ne. ra manèngi, peka na, ama. pad'elo tadha malaa, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha, peka na, èu tare'a-re'a abhu koasa nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: and sighing deeply in his ruach, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said, why does hador hazeh this generation seek for an ot? omein, i say to you, no ot shall be given to hador hazeh this generation.
target_text: hèia yesus ère a'ae madhera, ka na dhaa si, peka na, ladhe ja'a madhutu lii padhai lii miu ne, ja'a manyasa! nga tao ka miu manèngi tadha malaa? baku sèmi èèna. ja'a bisa tao tadha malaa. te ngaa ja'a parluu boe pad'elo mi miu.

source_text: and having left them, moshiach again embarked and departed to the other side.
target_text: hèia yesus tèke eele dhèu parisi sèra, la'e hari asa dedha koha. ka na pakèd'i dènge ana madhutu na sèra asa cabèka dano.

source_text: and his talmidim had forgotten to take lechem and did not have anything except one kikar loaf in the sirah boat with them.
target_text: ropa yesus si d'ai talora dano, hèia ana madhutu na sèra heka sanèd'e kèna, na, rèngu rèti boe nganga'a leo, dhoka roti cue di.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was giving orders to them, saying, take care! beware of the chametz leaven of the perushim and the chametz of herod.
target_text: tadèngi ra ale roti, hèia yesus peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, miu mage-mage ku! baku lèke pangaru karehe nèti dhèu aae herodes dènge dhèu parisi. pangaru rèngu, sama sèmi ragi dhu dhèu pakihu tao roti.

source_text: and the talmidim were beginning to discuss among themselves that they do not have any kikrot loaves.
target_text: ra tadèngi na padhai lii sèmi èèna, ka ana madhutu sèra malaa. ka ra papeka isi-aanga si, peka na, mone heka nèi, peka ngaa ne? tao-tao èdhi tèti boe roti, ka na lii sèmi èèna.

source_text: and aware of this, rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to them, why are you discussing that you do not have kikrot? do you not yet have binah understanding nor comprehend? have your levavot fallen into timtum halev hardening of the heart, keshihardness, stubbornness?
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a lii padhai rèngu. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu padhue dhoka roti di! miu me'a mere boe ngaa dhu ja'a peka na, do? mema kahadhu miu kateme.

source_text: einayim lakhem vlo tiru voznayim lakhem vlo tishmau? having eyes, do you not see? and having ears, do you not hear? and do you not remember,
target_text: miu mèdhi dènge madha le, te ngaa mo'o boe me'a! èci èèna ka dènge miu mèdhi mèka. miu tadèngi dènge ro'a dhilu le, te ngaa mo'o boe nanene. èci èèna ka dènge miu tadèngi mèka. miu bhèlu le, do?

source_text: when i offered the beziat halechem with the chamesh kikrot five loaves for the chameshet elafim five thousand, how many baskets of shirayim you picked up? and they say to him, shneym asar.
target_text: roti lèmi bua dhu ja'a pamae kore ka hia dhèu lèmi riho sèra ra'a, si? ca hari ni, miu pakaboko mere roti dhu risi sèra pèri soe? ka ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, canguru dua soe, ama.

source_text: and when i offered the beziat halechem over the shevah seven for the arbaat haalafim four thousand, how many baskets full of shirayim did you pick up? and they say to him, shiva.
target_text: ka na karèi hari, aku nèngu na, miu sanèd'e era lod'o ja'a pamae kore roti pèri bua sèra, ka hia dhèu èpa riho ra'a sa, do aad'o? miu pakaboko mere sisa pèri soe hahake? ka ra dhaa, na, pidhu, ama.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was saying to them, do you not yet have binah?
target_text: hèia na peka, na, mema tare'a! miu mèdhi dènge madha le. te ngaa, nga tao ka miu me'a mèka koasa ja'a kapua nèti mia?

source_text: and they come to beit-tzaidah. and they bring to him an ivver blind man, and entreated him to touch him.
target_text: ropa yesus si d'ai rae betsaida, dhèu rèti dhèu bèdhu èci mai asa yesus. ra manèngi sèna ka yesus pa'èle musi madha dhèu bèdhu ne.

source_text: and having grasped the hand of the ivver, he took him outside the shtetl; and, having put spittle on his eyes, and having laid hands upon him, he was questioning him, do you see anything?
target_text: ka yesus kadhèi nare kacui-aai dhèu ne, ka dua ra lasi asa li'u rae. èle èèna ka, yesus sabhuu ilu mi musi madha dhèu ne, hèia na g'ag'e. ka na karèi, peka na, samia? èu mèdhi le, do dhae?

source_text: and after looking up, the ivver was saying, i see bnei adam - they look like trees walking!
target_text: ka dhèu èèna padoa kètu, ka na ladhe sa g'ana-kariu, hèia na dhaa, peka na, oo! ja'a kèdhi dhèu kako rango-rango era, nuka sèmi ana aaj'u dhu kako.

source_text: then again rebbe, melech hamoshiach placed his hands upon his eyes; and the man looked intently and was restored, and was seeing everything clearly.
target_text: hèia yesus caro hari kacui-aai na ca tèka mi musi madha dhèu ne'e. ka na ladhe patae hari, ho neo ne'a, na, musi madha na be'a le, do dhae. ne'e ne, heka nèdhi dènge mèu kèna.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach sent the man to his bais, saying, do not even enter the shtetl.
target_text: ka yesus pua na lèpa, te ngaa pasanèd'e ne, aku nèngu na, èu lamu ka, te ngaa madhutu j'ara leo. re ia ka betsaida.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach went out along with his talmidim, to the shtetlach of caesarea philippi; and on the way he was questioning his talmidim, saying to them, who do bnei adam say that i am?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si kako palème rae-rae ètu kaisarea pilipi. ètu talora j'ara, yesus karèi ana madhutu na, peka na, madhutu lii lolo dhèu, na, ja'a ne, cee?

source_text: and the talmidim spoke to him, saying, yochanan of the tevilah of teshuva; and others say, eliyahu hanavi; but others, one of the neviim.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, dhèu cahag'e peka, na, èu ne, yohanis tuka sarani dhu madhe le, te ngaa mamuri hari. abhu cahag'e peka na, èu ne, elia, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru sèra. aa abhu cahag'e hari peka na, ama ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu leo.

source_text: and he continued questioning them, but who do you say that i am? in reply, kefa says to him, you are the rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: ka yesus karèi hari rèngu, madhutu a'abhu miu, ja'a ne, cee? petrus dhaa, peka na, ama ne, kristus, dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u nèti uru ka.

source_text: and he warned them to tell no one about him.
target_text: hèia yesus pasanèd'e si, aku nèngu na, baku lolo mi cee-cee kahèi, ee!

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach began to teach them that it is necessary for the bar enosh to suffer many things and to be rejected by the zekenim and the rashei hakohanim the chief priests and the sofrim scribes, and to be killed and after his histalkus passing after shlosha yamim three days to undergo the techiyas hamoshiach.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus mulai peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. bèli-camèd'a ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae titu kèna, lula dhèu heka-dhèu heka yahudi, kètu agama yahudi, dènge mese agama sèra, aa'i-aa'i ra sèmi rare boe ja'a. ho èèna na, ra pamadhe ja'a, te ngaa d'ai camèd'a, na, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was speaking about the matter plainly. and shim'on kefa took him aside and began to rebuke him.
target_text: yesus peka boe dènge pahuni, hèia petrus ère ne asa karasa na, ka na kai, aku nèngu na, ama, baku padhai lii sèmi èèna! ja'a ko'o boe dhèu tao ama ku sèmi èèna.

source_text: but having turned around and having looked at his talmidim, rebbe, melech hamoshiach rebuked kefa, and says, get behind me, hasatan; for you are not putting your machshavot thoughts on the interests of hashem but on that of bnei adam.
target_text: lii padhai lii petrus èèna, madhutu boe dad'èi ama lamatua. hèia yesus kabib'a, ka ladhe asa ana madhutu dhu leo sèra. ka na nasa dènge petrus, aku nèngu na, weh! èèna lii dhèu aae nidhu! èu pakaj'èu nèti ne'e! èu madhutu dhoka dad'èi dhèu rai-haha di. madhutu boe dad'èi ama lamatua!

source_text: and having summoned the multitude along with his talmidim, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, if anyone wishes to follow after me, let him make denial of himself, and take up his etz shel mesiros nefesh tree of self-sacrifice, and follow me.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus paroa dhèu ae sèra ho mai pakaboko dènge ana madhutu na. ka na aj'a si, peka na, dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a, hud'i taha taruu bèli-bèli. nèngu hud'i tèke eele dad'èi na, ho madhutu dad'èi lamatua di. masi ka dhèu neo pamadhe ne, te ngaa nèngu hud'i taha taruu kahèi, nuka sèmi dhèu pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha nèngu unu na ho la'e asa era ra pamadhe ne.

source_text: for whoever wishes to save his nefesh will lose it; but whoever loses his nefesh for my sake and for the sake of the besuras hageulah will save it.
target_text: te dhèu dhu mamuri dhoka lalau ngi'u aae na di, bèli-camèd'a mamuri nèngu ele iie d'ara! te ngaa dhèu dhu sadia madhe lula madhutu ja'a, aa lula na peka-padhai j'ara mamuri ama lamatua, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu mamuri dhu ma'ète boe dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: for how is the ben adam human being benefited if he gain the kol haolam, and forfeit his neshamah?
target_text: mi nanene, ee! ladhe èu abhu aa'i isi rai-haha ne, te ngaa ama lamatua core eele èu, a'oto na ngaa?

source_text: for what shall a ben adam give in exchange for his neshamah?
target_text: masi ka èu bau mèti aa'i kakaja rai-haha ne, te ngaa bisa boe pasilu dènge samanga èu.

source_text: for whoever feels bushah shame regarding me and my devarim in this dor rah umnaef evil and adulterous generation, the bar enosh will also be ashamed of him, when moshiach comes in the kavod of his av with the malachim hakedoshim.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! dhèu ètu rai-haha limuri ne, bhelu-katub'a rupa-rupa. rèngu pusi-pahae boe madhutu ama lamatua. de cee dhu makae madhutu ja'a, do makae madhutu lii holo-nori ja'a, bèli-camèd'a ja'a makae kahèi mangaku nèngu ètu madha ama lamatua. te ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, bèli-camèd'a mai hari nèti sorga, palere dènge ana pajuu ama lamatua sèra. ji'i puru mai dènge dadedha ama ku, heka dhèu re'a mèu kèna, ja'a ne cee.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was saying to them, omein, i say to you, there are some of those standing here who shall not taste mavet death until they see that the malchut hashem has come in gevurah.
target_text: miu baku bhèlu lii padhai lii ja'a ne. abhu nèti miu cahag'e dhu madhe mèka, pe mèdhi ama lamatua nèd'u paredha dènge koasa kapai.

source_text: and after shishah yamim rebbe, melech hamoshiach takes kefa and ya'akov and yochanan, and brought them up a high mountain by themselves. and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was transfigured before them;
target_text: èle èna lod'o, hèia yesus gale nèti petrus, yakobis, yohanis, lasi asa ledhe èci dhu dhèu pea boe. ropa d'ai ledhe èèna, rèngu ladhe, na, yesus leko-leo.

source_text: and his garments became like a dazzlingly brilliant kittel, gantz exceedingly white, more white than anyone on earth could bleach them.
target_text: aa mèdha-papake na pudhi kale'e. abhu mèka mèdha dhu pudhi sèmi èèna ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and eliyahu hanavi appeared to them along with moshe rabbeinu, and they were talking with rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, rèngu rèdhi yesus padhai lii dènge elia dènge musa.

source_text: and in reply, to rebbe, melech hamoshiach, kefa says: rebbe, it is tov for us to be here, and let us make shalosh sukkot, one for you and one for moshe rabbeinu and one for eliyahu hanavi. kefa did not know what he was answering, for they were tzufloigen dazed with pachad terror.
target_text: ka petrus si madha'u bia. hèia petrus malaa, ka na padhai lii ore leli. hèia na peka dènge yesus, aku nèngu na, ama! èdhi ètu era ne'e, be'a titu kèna! hua iia risi, ji'i tao paleo tèlu bua, cue hia ama, cue hia musa, aa cue hari hia elia.

source_text: and there came an anan cloud that was over-shadowing them, and there came a bat kol out of the anan, zeh beni ahuvi, elav tishmaun this is my beloved son; listen to him!
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, ra'i-liru puru mai sarimu nare si. hèia ra tadèngi lii èci nèti ra'i-liru èèna, peka na, mi nanene! yesus ne, ana pasue ja'a. miu nanene paie ne!

source_text: and suddenly, when they looked around, they saw no one in their company any more, except only rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii èèna, petrus si laladhe palème, te ngaa rèdhi heka dhèu leo ètu èèna. ate dhoka yesus mesa na.

source_text: and as they were coming down from the mountain, he gave instructions to them that they should tell no one what they saw, except when the bar enosh should stand up in his techiyas hamoshiach.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra puru nèti ledhe èèna. ka yesus kai si, peka na, ngaa dhu miu mèdhi deo na, baku lolo dènge dhèu èci sa. ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, hud'i madhe uuru ku. ho lod'o d'ai ja'a mamuri hari, na, miu heka lolo dènge dhèu leo kèna.

source_text: and they retained rebbe, melech hamoshiachʼs dvar, discussing among themselves what he might mean by the techiyas hamoshiach from hamesim.
target_text: rèngu tèke pa'èra lii moa èèna ètu d'ara ra. ra ale boe dènge dhèu èci sa. te ngaa tèlu ra pakarèi isi-aanga, na padhai lii ngaa ne, peka na, ‘nèngu mamuri hari nèti mamadhe'? tasamia, ee?

source_text: and they were questioning him, saying, why is it that the sofrim scribes say it is necessary for eliyahu hanavi to come rishonah first?
target_text: hèia ra karèi ne, peka na, mese agama sèra peka na, ‘elia hud'i mai uru ku, heka kristus mai kèna. ' te ngaa madhutu ama, tare'a, do aad'o?

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, eliyahu hanavi indeed does come rishonah and brings tikkun restoration to all things. and yet how is it written of the bar enosh that he must suffer many things and be nivzeh vachadaldespised and rejected?
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, mema tare'a. elia hud'i mai uuru ku, ho bhoke j'ara hia kristus, dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru ka. te ngaa tasamia? miu me'a mèka ngaa dhu suri rare le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, lula-nèti dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a? dhu suri rare le, peka na, ladhe lod'o na mai, dhèu paj'èra ne, toke ra pamadhe ne.

source_text: but i say to you, that eliyahu hanavi has indeed come, and they did to him whatever they pleased, just as it has been written concerning him.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu pasa paie dhilu miu! elia mai le. te ngaa dhèu paj'èra ne madhutu dad'èi rèngu. èèna lèke dènge ngaa dhu baki-baki èdhi sèra suri tèke le karèi nèti uuru ka.

source_text: and when they returned to the talmidim, they saw a great multitude around them and the sofrim scribes arguing with rebbe, melech hamoshiachʼs talmidim.
target_text: ropa yesus dènge ana madhutu na, dhèu tèlu sèra, paraga hari dènge ana madhutu leo sèra, ka ladhe rèdhi dhèu ae pakaboko ètu èèna. dhèu ae sèra mai ho ra neo nanene ana madhutu yesus dhu leo sèra pab'ala lii dènge mese agama ètu èèna.

source_text: and ofen ort, as soon as the multitude saw rebbe, melech hamoshiach, they were surprised and began running up to him with birkat shalom greetings.
target_text: ropa dhèu ae sèra ladhe rèdhi yesus, ka ra cag'ag'a, te rèngu neo laa, na, yesus ètu ledhe era. hèia ra rai mai soru ne.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach questioned them, about what are you arguing with them?
target_text: hèia yesus karèi si, peka na, miu pab'ala lii ngaa na?

source_text: and one of the multitude answered rebbe, melech hamoshiach: rabbi, i brought beni my son to you, because he has a shed that makes him illem mute.
target_text: dhèu èci nèti talora dhèu ae sèra ara sa madha, ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama, mu nanene ku laa! ja'a mai kèti ana mone ja'a dhu pèd'a, ho ama ku puri-pa'èle ne. nèngu lii aad'o, bisa boe padhai lii, lula nidhu tao ne.

source_text: and whenever it seizes him, it throws him into convulsions and he foams at the mouth, and grinds his teeth, and becomes rigid. and i told your talmidim in order that they might cast it out, and they did not have the koach.
target_text: ladhe nidhu maso asa d'ara ngi'u na, na hake ngi'u ana ne mi rai. ho hèb'a na horo karaka, na na'e ngutu na kico-kico sèna. ho ngi'u na patèku sèmi aj'u. ja'a manèngi le ana madhutu ama ku babège eele nidhu èèna. te ngaa ra bisa boe.

source_text: in reply to them, rebbe, melech hamoshiach says, o dor without emunah, how long will i be with you? how long will i put up with you? bring the bocher to me!
target_text: ropa na nanene nare, hèia yesus jèke si, peka na, heh! miu seli-kolane! ja'a aj'a miu pahari-pahari, te ngaa miu me'a boe ngaa-ngaa. miu parcaya èra boe mi ja'a! ja'a mate miu nèbhu sange mia hari ku? mèti ana èèna asa ne'e mai!

source_text: they brought the bocher to him. and when the shed saw rebbe, melech hamoshiach, it threw the bocher into convulsions, and, falling to the ground, the bocher began rolling around foaming at the mouth.
target_text: hèia ra sa'u rèti ana èèna asa madha yesus. te ngaa ropa nidhu ladhe nèdhi yesus, na kalabhe ana ne mi rai, ka ana ne bèbhe kapod'e ètu rai, aa hèb'a na horo karaka.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach questioned the bocherʼs abba, how long has this been happening to him? and he said, from kinder-yoren.
target_text: ka yesus karèi ama na, nèngu sèmi ne'e ne, pèri lod'o kèna? ka ama na dhaa, karèi nèti ana iiki ka mai.

source_text: and also it has often thrown him into the eish and into the mayim that it might destroy him. but if you can do anything, grant rachmei shomayim upon us and help us!
target_text: nidhu èèna nèbhu ae le neo pamadhe ana ne'e. na tule ne pèri-pèri hari kèna asa d'ara ai, aa na pacène le kahèi asa d'ara èi. de ama ku sue ja'a. ladhe bisa, na, ama puri-pa'èle ku ana ja'a la.

source_text: rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to him, if you can? ! all things are possible to him who has emunah!
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, nga tao ka èu peka na ‘ladhe bisa'? ja'a bisa tao aa'i mèu-mèu, te ngaa hud'i èu parcaya uuru ku!
