source_text: ofen ort immediately the abba of the bocher cried out and began saying, ani maamin i believe! help my lack of emunah!
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mone èèna dhaa dènge oe tangi, aku nèngu na, ama, mema ja'a parcaya, te ngaa pa'èra hari ku lalèka ja'a ne'e!

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach, having seen that a multitude was gathering, rebuked the ruach hatumah unclean spirit, saying to it, you cheresh-illem deaf and mute ruach hatemeiah, i command you, come out from him and do not ever enter into him again!
target_text: ropa yesus nèdhi dhèu ae mai lingu, ka na paredha nidhu èèna, aku nèngu na, heh! nidhu bhelu! kalua pakaj'èu ka nèti ana ne'e! sèna ka na bisa tadèngi aa na padhai lii kahèi. èu baku maso ia ka asa d'ara ana ne'e!

source_text: and after shrieking a shrai scream and throwing the bocher into violent seizures, the ruach hatemeiah came out. and the bocher was so like a geviyah corpse that many exclaimed he was niftar.
target_text: ropa nidhu tadèngi lii yesus, hèia na pakèce. ka na hake ana ne mi rai, ka na rèbha-rèbha sène, heka nidhu kalua nèti d'ara ana èèna kèna. ana èèna kalau heka, nuka sèmi dhu madhe le. ka dhèu ètu sèra sa peka, aku rèngu na, waa! ana ne madhe le!

source_text: but rebbe, melech hamoshiach, having grasped the hand of the bocher, lifted him up; and the bocher stood up.
target_text: te ngaa yesus kèpe kacui-aai ana ne, ka na pakèd'i ne. hèia na kèd'i dènge ka.

source_text: and, having entered into a bais, his talmidim began questioning rebbe, melech hamoshiach in a yechidus: why were we not able to perform the gerush shedim exorcism?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, tèke eele era èèna, lasi dhuli èmu cue. ètu èmu èèna, rèngu mesa ra, ka ra karèi yesus, peka na, ama! nga tao ka ji'i bisa boe babège eele nidhu èèna?

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, this kind of gerush shedim is accomplished only by davening with tzomot.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, mi nanene paie! nidhu sèra mema bhelu. de ladhe miu manèngi boe a'èra nèti lamatua, na, miu bisa boe babège eele nidhu sèmi èèna.

source_text: and from there they went forth and were passing through the galil, and rebbe, melech hamoshiach did not want anyone to have daas.
target_text: èle ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na tèke eele era èèna, lasi taruu asa propensi galilea. lod'o èèna, yesus d'èi boe dhèu re'a nèngu ètu èèna,

source_text: for rebbe, melech hamoshiach was teaching his talmidim and was saying to them, the bar enosh is to be betrayed into the hands of bnei adam, and moshiach yikaretmoshiach will be violently killed, and when he has been killed and has his histalkus passing, he will rise in his techiyas hamoshiach from hamesim on yom hashelishi the third day.
target_text: lula na neo aj'a ana madhutu na di. ka na lole dènge si, nèbhu heka dhèu pahie eele ja'a dènge dhèu leo. hèia ra pamadhe ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. mema ja'a madhe, te ngaa d'ai camèd'a, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: but they did not have binah concerning this dvar, and they were afraid to inquire further.
target_text: yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna, te ngaa ana madhutu na sèra malaa. rèngu bani heka karèi sasoa lii padhai lii nèngu.

source_text: and they came to k'far-nachum. and when rebbe, melech hamoshiach was in the bais, he began questioning them, what were you arguing about baderech on the road?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi d'ai kapernaum. ropa ra maso asa d'ara èmu èci, yesus karèi si, peka na, deo na miu pasisu ngaa ètu talora j'ara?

source_text: but they were keeping silent, for baderech they were discussing with one another which of the talmidim was hagadol.
target_text: èci sa bani boe dhaa, lula ètu talora j'ara deo na, rèngu ako pasala d'ara, nèti ra pasisu, cee ka dhu kapai risi ètu talora rèngu.

source_text: and sitting down, rebbe, melech hamoshiach called the shneym asar and says to them, if anyone wishes to be rishon first, he shall be acharon last, and mesharet minister, servant of all.
target_text: hèia yesus madhèdi, ka na holo si, peka na, cee dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai, mamuri nèngu hud'i sama sèmi dhèu haha dhu lalau-lalo'o dhèu.

source_text: and having taken a yeled, rebbe, melech hamoshiach set him in the center of them, and, having taken the yeled into his arms, he said to them,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus sa'u nare ana iiki èci, ka la'e asa talora rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na,

source_text: whoever receives one yeled such as this bishmi in my name receives me, and whoever receives me, receives not only me but the one who sent me.
target_text: dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a, ho na lalau-lalo'o dhèu sèmi ana iiki ne, èèna sama sèmi nèngu lalau-lalo'o ja'a kahèi. aa nèngu lalau-lalo'o ama ku kahèi, dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: yochanan said to him, rebbe, we saw someone performing a gerush shedim in your name, and we were trying to stop him, because he was not one of your chasidim.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu yesus dhu ngara na yohanis, peka na, ama! ca tèka ji'i ngèdhi ca dhèu pake kolongara ama ku, ho na babège eele nidhu. te ngaa ji'i kai ne, lula nèngu dhèu èdhi boe.

source_text: but rebbe, melech hamoshiach said, do not stop him, for no one who will accomplish niflaot wonders bishmi in my name will be able soon afterward to speak lashon hora about me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, baku mi kai ne! te dhèu dhu pake kolongara ja'a, ho na tao tadha malaa, nèngu pa'ele iie boe kolongara ja'a.

source_text: for the one who is not our mitnagged is for us.
target_text: ladhe nèngu palab'a boe dènge èdhi, nèngu na dhèu èdhi.

source_text: for whoever gives you to drink a kos of mayim cup of water bishmi in my name because you are talmidim of rebbe, melech hamoshiach, omein, i say to you, he shall not lose his sachar reward.
target_text: de mi sanèd'e paie! ladhe abhu dhèu ne'a, na, miu madhutu kristus, ka na soru-bara miu, tatu ama lamatua bhèlu boe rui-j'aj'èra nèngu. masi ka dhèu dhu hia miu èi iia ca galaa èèna ka, ama lamatua bhèlu boe tatao nèngu èèna.

source_text: and whoever causes a michshol stumbling block for one of these little ones, the maaminim b'moshiach who have emunah in me, it would be better for him if a heavy millstone, one turned by a donkey, were hung around his neck and he were cast into the sea.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus padhai lii hari dènge ra, peka na, mage-mage, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tao ana iiki èci kako sala j'ara, toke ana ne parcaya heka ja'a! be'a risi hia dhèu èèna, rare hadhu aae cue, ho èki mi ladha goro ne, ho pacène ne asa talora dhasi.

source_text: and if your yad causes you a michshol, cut off your yad; for it is better for you if you enter chayyei olam as an amputee, than, having both yadayim, you go away into gehinnom, into the eish lo tikhbeh fire not ever extinguished,
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala pake kacui-aai èu, na, poro eele ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge kacui-aai cabèka di. baku d'ai ra core èu asa d'ara ai heo robhe-robhe dènge kacui-aai kateme.

source_text: where their tolaat lo tamut worm does not die and eish lo tikhbeh the fire not ever extinguished.
target_text: naraka èèna, mema era j'aj'èra. ai na madhe boe. sèmi èèna kahèi, èru-èru kamoke dènge ra'a taruu ngaa-ngaa dhu hèu ètu èèna.

source_text: and if your regel foot causes you a michshol, cut off your regel; it is better for you to enter chayyei olam lame, than, having both raglayim, to be cast into gehinnom,
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala pake haga èu, na, poro eele ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge haga cabèka di. baku d'ai ra core èu asa d'ara ai heo robhe-robhe dènge haga kateme.

source_text: where their tolaat lo tamut worm does not die and eish lo tikhbeh the fire not ever extinguished.
target_text: naraka èèna, mema era j'aj'èra. ai na madhe boe. sèmi èèna kahèi, èru-èru kamoke dènge ra'a taruu ngaa-ngaa dhu hèu ètu èèna.

source_text: and if your ayin eye causes you a michshol, take it out; for it is better for you to enter the malchut hashem one-eyed, than, having both eynayim, to be cast into gehinnom,
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala pake musi madha èu, na, ed'o eele ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge musi madha cabèka di. baku d'ai ra core èu asa d'ara ai heo robhe-robhe dènge musi madha kateme.

source_text: where their tolaat lo tamut worm does not die and eish lo tikhbeh the fire not ever extinguished.
target_text: ‘naraka èèna, mema era j'aj'èra. ai na, madhe boe. sèmi èèna kahèi, èru-èru kamoke dènge ra'a taruu ngaa-ngaa dhu hèu ètu èèna. '

source_text: for everyone will have eish as his melach salt.
target_text: a'aj'a ja'a ne, mema bia. de ladhe cee dhu madhutu ja'a, nèngu hud'i taha taruu, sèmi dhèu dhu neo paga sisi hud'i masi uuru ku, sèna ka sisi paga èèna taha nèbhu.

source_text: melach is tov, but if the melach becomes unsalty, by what means will you make it salty again? have melach in yourselves. and among yourselves let there be shalom.
target_text: masi mema be'a. èdhi pake ho pasèro nganga'a. te ngaa ladhe masi sèro heka, guna na ngaa? dhoka bhori eele di. miu hud'i j'aj'i sèmi masi kahèi, sèna ka mamuri pasue dènge dhèu leo aa'i-aa'i. de mi pasisu ia ka, peka na, cee ka dhu kapai, aa cee ka dhu ana iiki.

source_text: and from there, having got up, rebbe, melech hamoshiach comes into the region of yehudah and on the other side of the yarden, and again multitudes gather to him, and as was his minhag custom, once more he was teaching them torah.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi asa propensi yudea dènge era-era ètu cabèka dhimu loko yarden. ètu mia-mia, dhèu ae mai lingu rare yesus. hèia na aj'a si, sèmi biasa.

source_text: and, having approached, the perushim, testing him, were asking him, is it mutar for a man to give a get divorce to his wife?
target_text: dhèu parisi pèri-pèri mai neo pamanahu ne. ra karèi ne sèmi ne'e ka, madhutu a'abhu agama èdhi, ladhe mone dhu dènge le d'ara èmu, bisa pa'ia hari, do aad'o?

source_text: but in reply, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, what mitzvah commandment did moshe give you?
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, miu sanèd'e, do? atora dhèu èmu-kamali dhu musa hia èdhi uru èèna, tasamia?

source_text: and they said, moshe rabbeinu made it mutar permissible for a man to write sefer keritut a get, bill of divorcement and to send her away dismiss her, divorce her.
target_text: ra dhaa, peka na, nanori musa peka, dhèu bisa pa'ia-pa'ela, sad'i dhèu mone tao uru ku sasuri pa'ia dènge dhèu èmu na.

source_text: but rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, because of the hardness of your levavot, he wrote you this mitzvah.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala si, peka na, nanene, ee! musa suri sèmi èèna, lula miu kètu hadhu.

source_text: but in the beginning of the beriah creation zachar unekevah bara otam hashem made them male and female.
target_text: baku bhèlu lii lolo dhu uru tèka, lod'o lamatua paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha! dhu suri tèke, peka na, ‘ama lamatua paj'aj'i dhèu rai-haha, mone dènge bhèni.

source_text: al ken yaazav ish es aviv v'es immo v'davak bishto because of this, a man will leave his father and his mother and he will be joined to his isha wife,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu mone tèke eele ina-ama na, ho mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu na,

source_text: v'hayu l'vasar echad, and the two will be one flesh. for this reason, they are no longer shnayim but basar echad.
target_text: sèna ka dua ra j'aj'i mi èci. '

source_text: therefore, what hashem has joined together, let no ben adam separate.
target_text: ladhe lamatua pa'èci le rèngu dua ra, dhèu rai-haha baku pacèri eele si!

source_text: and in the bais, the talmidim began to question rebbe, melech hamoshiach about this again.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi mesa ra asa d'ara èmu cue. ètu èèna, rèngu karèi ne lii aj'a deo sa.

source_text: and he says to them, whoever gives a get to his isha and marries another, commits niuf adultery against his isha.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, dhèu mone cee dhu ia eele dhèu èmu na, ho na madhèdi hari dènge dhèu bhèni leo, nèngu bersina.

source_text: and if she gets a get divorce from her baal husband and marries another, she commits niuf adultery.
target_text: èci èèna ka, dènge dhèu bhèni. ladhe nèngu ia eele dhèu èmu na, ho na leo hari dènge mone leo, nèngu bersina kahèi.

source_text: and they brought to rebbe, melech hamoshiach yeladim that he might lay his hands on them. but the talmidim rebuked them.
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu rèti ana-ana rèngu asa yesus. ra manèngi sèna ka yesus sabaj'a hia si, ho hia lii mèngi-nale. te ngaa ana madhutu yesus kai dhèu sèra.

source_text: and having seen this, he became displeased and indignant, and said to his talmidim, permit the yeladim to come to me, and do not hinder them, for of such as these is the malchut hashem.
target_text: yesus ladhe nèdhi sèmi èèna, ka na nasa dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, hud'i laa ana iiki sèra mai asa ja'a. baku magee si. te dhèu sèmi sèra ka dhu j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: omein, i say to you, whoever is not mekabel malchut hashemreceives the kingdom of g-d as a yeled would be mekabel malchut hashem, will by no means enter it.
target_text: miu sanèd'e paie! dhèu cee dhu neo mai asa katanga-madha lamatua, d'ara na kateme hud'i d'èi paraga dènge ne, èci èèna ka ana iiki dhu d'ara d'èi paraga dènge ina-ama ra. ladhe sèmi boe èèna, rèngu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: and having taken the yeladim into his arms, rebbe, melech hamoshiach laid his hands on them and made a bracha over them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus liku nare ana iiki se, ka na tao kacui-aai na mi dedha kètu ana iiki se èci-èci, ho na hia si lii mamèngi.

source_text: and as rebbe, melech hamoshiach was setting out to travel, one running and falling down before him, was asking him, rabbi hatov, what mitzvah may i do that i might inherit chayyei olam?
target_text: ropa yesus si neo pakèd'i, dhèu kaja èci rai mai neo paraga dènge ne. hèia na pacud'u ètu madha yesus, ka na karèi ne, aku nèngu na, ama mese dhu hua iia! ja'a neo karèi ciki. ja'a tao tasamia, sèna ka ja'a ke'a tare'a-re'a, na, ja'a ne maso sorga ho mamuri taruu pa'èci dènge ama lamatua?

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to him, why do you call me tov? no one tov except echad, elohim, nu?
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, nga tao ka èu ne peka na, ja'a ne ‘hua iia'? dhèu rai-haha ne èci sa dhu hua iia boe. dhoka ama lamatua di dhu hua iia.

source_text: you have daas of the mitzvot, the aseres hadibros the decalogue, lo tirtzach, lo tinaf, lo tignov, lo taaneh vreiacha ed shaker, kabeid es avicha ves immecha do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not bear false witness do not defraud, honor your father and mother.
target_text: èu me'a le, lii paredha ama lamatua sèra nèti uru ka, dhu peka na: ‘baku pamadhe dhèu; baku tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu-kamali boe èu; baku mana'u; baku j'aj'i sakasii kapod'e-kabèli; baku monya ho parame more mèdha-panyau dhèu; aa pakab'ua ina-ama èu. '

source_text: and the man was saying to him, rabbi, from kinder-yoren i have been frum and shomer mitzvot, keeping all these things.
target_text: dhèu èèna dhaa, peka na, tare'a, ama mese! nèti ana ngèru ka mai, ja'a madhutu le lii paredha sèra aa'i-aa'i si.

source_text: and looking at him and having ahavah for his neshamah, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to him, one thing you lack: go and sell all your possessions and give to the aniyim, and you will have otzar treasure in shomayim; and come, follow me.
target_text: yesus rasa kasia dènge dhèu ne'e, hèia na peka, tare'a! te ngaa j'ara èci era. lèpa ka asa èmu èu, lamu pahia aa'i su'i-kakaja èu. kab'ua na lamu pala-bagi mi dhèu dhu unu boe ngaa-ngaa. èle èèna, heka mai kèna, ho madhutu ja'a. pe bèli-camèd'a lamatua pala-bagi hia èu hari kakaja-sasu'i dhu leo ètu sorga.

source_text: but at the dvar hamoshiach, his face turned gloomy and he departed with agmat nefesh grief, for he had many possessions.
target_text: ropa dhèu ne tadèngi nare lii padhai lii yesus èèna, d'ara na laho mae-mae. la'e ka èmu dènge d'ara dhu pèd'a bia, lula nèngu dhèu kaja tare'a.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach, looking around, says to his talmidim, how difficult it will be for the oisher to enter the malchut hashem!
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe la'e-mai, aa peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, mi nanene! dhèu kaja carui titu kèna maso sorga!

source_text: and the talmidim were amazed at his devarim. but again rebbe, melech hamoshiach in reply, says to them, yeladim, how difficult it is to enter into the malchut hashem.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii padhai lii yesus èèna, ana madhutu na bingu. ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, mi nanene paie! mema carui ladhe dhèu neo j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. baku ngee èèna mud'a!

source_text: it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for an oisher rich person to enter the malchut hashem.
target_text: dhèu kaja maso sorga ho j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua, sama carui dènge badha onta ci'u dhu kapai maso asa oka na re ro'a j'aj'au.

source_text: and they were even more amazed, saying to one another, then who with the yeshu'at eloheinu is able to be saved?
target_text: lii padhai lii yesus ne asa pamalaa dhèu se'e aa'i-aa'i si. ka ra pakarèi, peka na, ladhe tare'a sèmi èèna, cee ka dhu bisa abhu mamuri dènge ama lamatua?

source_text: having looked at them, rebbe, melech hamoshiach says, with bnei adam this is impossible, but not with hashem. for all things are possible with hashem.
target_text: ka yesus ladhe si èci-èci, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, madhutu dhèu rai-haha, na, carui. te ngaa baku bhèlu, madhutu ama lamatua, aa'i-aa'i bisa j'aj'i.

source_text: shim'on kefa began to say to rebbe, melech hamoshiach, hinei! we left everything and have followed you!
target_text: èle èèna ka, petrus padhai lii, peka na, ama, ji'i tèke eele le ngaa-ngaa dhu j'aj'i unu ji'i, ho madhutu èu. de ji'i abhu bab'ala na ngaa?

source_text: yehoshua said, omein, i say to you, there is no one who left bais or achim or achayot or em or abba or banim or sadot fields for the sake of me and for the sake of the besuras hageulah, but that he shall receive a hundredfold now in the olam hazeh, batim houses and achim and achayot and imahot and banim and sadot with redifot persecutions; and in olam habah, chayyei olam.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, ja'a neo peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a, aa tèke eele ina-ama na, a'ari na, ana-èpu na, oka-tedhe na, sasab'a-la'a na, dènge isi èmu aa'i-aa'i, ho la'e peka-padhai lii lolo be'a ama lamatua mi dhèu ètu mia-mia, lèpa loo limuri, nèngu abhu hari ngaa-ngaa sèra, d'ai cangasu hari. aa'i-aa'i dhu nèngu tèke eele sèra, èèna na nèngu abhu risi hari. aa nèngu abhu j'aj'èra kahèi, lula madhutu ja'a. te ngaa ladhe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, nèngu mamuri taruu pa'èci dènge ama lamatua. bab'ala nèngu, sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: and many rishonim first ones will be acharonim last ones; and the acharonim, will be rishonim.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! dhèu dhu padedha iisi, madhutu ngangee ama lamatua, limuri mai nèngu j'aj'i dhèu haha d'ai seli. te ngaa dhèu dhu ngee, na, nèngu dhèu haha di, madhutu ngangee ama lamatua, limuri mai nèngu j'aj'i dhèu kapai.

source_text: and they were on the derech making aliyah leregel pilgrimage to yerushalayim, and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was leading out, walking ahead of them, and they were astounded, and the ones following were afraid. and again rebbe, melech hamoshiach took the shneym asar aside for a yechidus and began to tell them what was to happen to him,
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi asa kota yerusalem. yesus kako uuru. ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua dènge dhèu leo dhu kako pa'èci madhutu ne re limuri. rèngu sanèd'e lii padhai dhu yesus peka dènge rèngu uru èèna, peka na, dhèu neo pamadhe ne ètu yerusalem. nèti èèna ka, rèngu bingu dènge madha'u. hèia yesus paroa nare ana madhutu na sèra mesa ra, ho na peka hari dènge rèngu dhèu neo tao ngaa mi dedha nèngu ètu yerusalem.

source_text: saying, hinei, we are making aliyah leregel to yerushalayim, and the bar enosh will be betrayed to the rashei hakohanim and the sofrim and they will condemn him with onesh mavet death penalty and will hand him over to the goyim.
target_text: yesus peka dènge si, mi nanene! èdhi neo lati asa yerusalem. ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ètu nèi, dhèu neo pahie eele ja'a asa kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra. èle èèna, ra uku-ked'i pamadhe ja'a. ra tule eele ja'a asa dhèu leo dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua.

source_text: and they will mock him and spit on him and scourge him and will kill him, and after his histalkus passing, on yom hashlishi, he in his techiyas hamoshiach from hamesim will stand up alive again.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra padhai lii pamakae ja'a. ra paru'e ilu mi ja'a. aa ra dhedhe pamae iisi ja'a. èle èèna, heka ra pamadhe ja'a kèna. mema ja'a madhe tare'a. te ngaa d'ai camèda, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: and ya'akov and yochanan, the banim of zavdai, approached rebbe, melech hamoshiach, saying to him, rebbe, we wish that whatever bakosha we may ask you, you may do for us.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana sabadeus, nuka yakobis dènge yohanis, mai asa yesus. ka ra manèngi, peka na, ama mese! ji'i neo padhai lii dènge ama ciki.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, what do you wish me to do for you?
target_text: ka yesus karèi si, miu neo ngaa?

source_text: and they said to him, grant to us that one may sit limin at the right hand of you and one lismol at the left hand in your kavod.
target_text: ra dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama! bèli-camèd'a, ladhe ama mèd'u paredha, ji'i manèngi ama pamadhèdi ji'i dua mi, èci re sebhe g'ana, èci hari re kariu, sèna ka ji'i paredha hèi.

source_text: but he said to them, you do not have daas of what you ask. are you able to drink the kos which i drink or to undergo my mikveh?
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, miu dua mi se me'a boe lii manèngi miu èèna. èèna na, ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae. de tasamia? miu ngee, na, miu se bisa pasae j'aj'èra dènge ja'a toke madhe, do?

source_text: and they said to him, we are able. and he said to them, the kos which i drink you shall drink; and you shall have the mikveh in which i am submerged.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i bisa, ama! ka yesus b'ala, peka na, mema, èèna na, miu pasae j'aj'èra kahèi, sama sèmi ja'a.

source_text: but to sit limin or lismol of me is not mine to grant, but for the ones for whom it has been prepared.
target_text: te ngaa cee dhu madhèdi re sebhe g'ana, do sebhe kariu ja'a, èèna hak ja'a aad'o. te dhu hak ka ama lamatua dhu pama'ète mema le, na, cee-cee ka dhu madhèdi ètu era sèra.

source_text: and hearing this, the asarah ten became indignant with ya'akov and yochanan.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu dhu leo sèra tadèngi lii manèngi yakobis dènge yohanis sèmi èèna, ka ra nasa bia.

source_text: and having summoned them, rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to them, you have daas that among the goyim those whom they recognize as their moshlim rulers domineer them and their gedolim exercise authority over them.
target_text: hèia yesus paroa aa'i-aa'i si, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, miu me'a le, sina ma? dhèu-dhèu kapai dhu rèd'u paredha j'eli ana kabarai sèna ka rèngu bisa boe kalau-karèto. dhèu kapai kabarai dhu tadhe boe lamatua hia paredha risi eele, ka ana kabarai bisa heka doa kètu.

source_text: however, it is not so among you. he who wishes to become gadol among you must be your mesharet.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku tao sèmi èèna! nèti talora miu, cee dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai, nèngu hud'i j'aj'i ku ana pua-paleha ho lalau dhèu leo.

source_text: and whoever wishes to be first among you must be eved of all.
target_text: cee dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai, nèngu hud'i tao ngi'u na sama sèmi ènu.

source_text: for even the bar enosh did not come to be served but to serve and to give his nefesh as a kofer ransom, pedut larabbim for many, for the geulah redemption of many.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a mai hia boe dhèu lalau-lalo'o ja'a. te ngaa ja'a mai ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu ae, dènge hia mamuri ja'a ho sui kore dhèu ae nèti koasa sasala-sasigo rèngu.

source_text: and they come to yericho. and as rebbe, melech hamoshiach was going forth from yericho with his talmidim and a great multitude, bar-timai, an ivver, a poor betler beggar, was sitting beside the road.
target_text: yesus dènge ana madhutu na, dènge dhèu ae titu kèna kako lasi kota jeriko. ropa rèngu neo kako taruu, dhèu bèdhu èci madhèdi ètu sebhe j'ara, na kanata ai ho manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti dhèu dhu kako re èèna. ngara na bartimeos, ana nèti timeos.

source_text: and when he heard that it was yehoshua from natzeret coming, he began to cry out and to shout, ben dovid yehoshua, chaneini!
target_text: ropa na tadèngi dhèu dhu kako mai sèra, yesus nèti rae nasaret na kahèi, ka na rodhe, peka na, yesus! ana-èpu daud, ee! ji'i mate èu nèbhu ae le! sue ku ja'a laa!

source_text: and many were rebuking him that he should shekit, but he kept crying out all the more, ben dovid, chaneini!
target_text: ropa ra nanene lii rodhe na, hèia dhèu sèra jèke ne, aku rèngu na, èu mau-mau ku laa! te ngaa na rodhe asa aae, peka na, yesus! ana-èpu daud, ee! sue ku ja'a laa!

source_text: having stopped, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said, summon him here. and they called the ivver, saying to him, chazak! cheer up! he is calling you!
target_text: hèia yesus titu taha, ka na peka, mèti ku na mai sa ne'e! ka ra lasi peka dènge dhèu bèdhu èèna, peka na, èu mau-mau ka laa! te ama mese paroa èu nèi. de mai lati ka!

source_text: and having tossed aside his kaftan, and having jumped up, he came to rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: ropa nanene nare, ka bartimeos pèci eele sig'i kalolo na, hèia na kèd'i titu la'e paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: and in reply, yehoshua said, what do you wish that i may do for you? and the ivver said to rebbe, melech hamoshiach, rabboni, that i may see.
target_text: ka yesus karèi ne, peka na, èu parluu ngaa? dhèu bèdhu ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama, ee! ja'a manèngi ho ja'a bisa kèdhi.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to him, go. your emunah has brought you tikkun restored you. and ofen ort immediately he regained his sight and he began following rebbe, melech hamoshiach baderech on the road.
target_text: yesus peka hari dènge ne, lula èu parcaya, ja'a bisa tao paie musi madha èu. ne'e ne kahèi musi madha èu èle dènge! de lamu ka! ka musi madha bartimeos èle dènge. èle ka la'e madhutu yesus.

source_text: and when they draw near to yerushalayim at beit-pagey and beit-anyah near the mount of olives, rebbe, melech hamoshiach sends two of his talmidim,
target_text: ropa ra dètu dènge kota yerusalem, ka ra dhuli uuru dua rae, ngara na betfage dènge betania, ètu sebhe ledhe saitun. ètu èèna, yesus si mate ciki oo'e di. ka na pua ana madhutu na dhèu dua lasi uuru.

source_text: and says to them, go into the shtetl ahead of you, and ofen ort immediately as you enter it, you will find an ayircolt tied there, on which no one of bnei adam yet has ever sat; untie it and bring it here.
target_text: na pua si, peka na, miu dua mi lami uuru asa d'ara rae nèi. ropa miu maso lami, miu mèdhi ana badha keled'ei ci'u, dhu ra èki ètu èèna, dhu dhèu dhae manya'e mèka. lami ho lècu eele dhari a'èki na, ho ère mèti mai asa ne'e.

source_text: and if anyone says to you, why are you doing this? you say, haadon has need of it and will send it here again.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu karèi miu, ‘nga tao ka miu ère mèti ana keled'ei ne? ' mi peka dènge si, ‘lamatua ji'i neo pake ne. ladhe pake nare, na, na hia hari mai. '

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiachʼs talmidim left and found an ayircolt tied at the shaar gate outside on the rekhov street. and they untied him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu na dhèu dua sèra lasi, ka rèdhi ana keled'ei ci'u dhu èki tèke ètu madha èmu cue ètu sebhe j'ara. ra lècu eele dhari èki na, ka ra ère rèti mai.

source_text: and some by-standers were saying to them, what are you doing untying the ayir?
target_text: ka dhèu-dhèu dhu titu ètu èèna, peka na, we! nga tao ka miu pakako mèti keled'ei dhèu?

source_text: and the talmidim spoke to them just as rebbe, melech hamoshiach had instructed them. and the by-standers permitted them.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, lamatua ji'i neo pake ne. ho ladhe na pake nare, na, ji'i ngèti hari mai. ka dhèu sèra soro tèke si lasi pakako rèti ana keled'ei èèna.

source_text: and the talmidim brought the ayir to rebbe, melech hamoshiach, and they lay upon it their garments, and he sat upon it.
target_text: hèia ra rèti ana keled'ei èèna asa yesus. ka ra hèle sig'i-kalolo rèngu mi dedha keled'ei, ka yesus manya'e.

source_text: and many spread their garments on the derech, but others spread leafy branches they had cut from the sadot fields.
target_text: ropa oe maso d'ara kota, ka dhèu ae rare sig'i-kalolo, ka ra hèle mi dedha j'ara oka-hoo. dhèu cahag'e lasi para rèu palam ètu sebhe j'ara, ho ra tao mi talora j'ara oka-hoo. tatao sèmi èèna na, sama sèmi tadha èci dhu peka na, rèngu pakab'ua yesus.

source_text: and the vanguard and rearguard of the procession were crying out, hoshan nah! save now baruch habah b'shem adonoi!
target_text: dhèu cahag'e kako uru ètu madha yesus; aa cahag'e kako limuri. ka ra pa'oo, peka na, hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lamatua hia berkat mi dhèu dhu mai pake kolongara na, lula ama lamatua hia ne mai!

source_text: a bracha on the coming malchut dovid avinu! hoshan nah in the highest!
target_text: hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lula lamatua neo pakèd'i hari paredha dhèu aae daud! hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lula lamatua madhèdi nèd'u paredha ètu era dedha risi eele!

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach entered into yerushalayim into the beis hamikdash and, having looked around at everything, and, the hour now being late, he went out to beit-anyah with the shneym asar twelve.
target_text: ropa ra d'ai d'ara kota, ka yesus si maso asa madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ka yesus ladhe palème era èmu èèna. te ngaa, lula lod'o nihia ae le, ka ra lèpa hari asa rae betania.

source_text: and on the next day, when they came from beit-anyah, rebbe, melech hamoshiach was hungry.
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae aae èèna, ka rèngu kalua nèti betania lasi asa yerusalem. d'ai talora j'ara ka yesus manganga.

source_text: and having seen in the distance an etz te'enah fig tree in leaf, rebbe, melech hamoshiach approached it to see whether he might find pri fruit on it. but when he came to it, he found nothing except leaves. for it was not the te'enim season.
target_text: ka na ladhe nèdhi ana aaj'u èci ètu sebhe j'ara. hua aj'u na, dhu dhèu ra'a. yesus la'e padètu ho neo ne'a aj'u na, hua do aad'o. na ladhe aj'u èèna hua boe cue sa. te mema d'ai mèka hèru hua. rèu heka mare kèna.

source_text: and in reply, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to it, may no one ever be nourished from pri from you again! and rebbe, melech hamoshiachʼs talmidim were listening.
target_text: ka yesus peka mi aj'u èèna, lula èu hia boe ja'a hua, mulai ti deo ne'e, èu bisa heka hia hua èu asa dhèu leo! ana madhutu yesus sèra tadèngi na padhai lii dènge nasa sèmi èèna.

source_text: then they came to yerushalayim. and having entered the beis hamikdash, rebbe, melech hamoshiach began to drive out the ones buying and selling in the beis hamikdash, and he overturned the shulchanot tables of the machalifei hakesafim money changers and the chairs of the ones selling the yonim doves.
target_text: yesus si kako taruu asa yerusalem, d'ai nèi ka yesus maso asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ètu madha èmu èèna, dhèu tao pasa ho ra pahia koro j'aha dhu biasa dhèu pake tao korban ho ra sabaj'a. ropa yesus nèdhi sèmi èèna, ka na lalèta si asa li'u. na tule eele mei dhu ra pake ho pasilu doi sèra, aa na tule paguri eele bagu dhu ra pake pahia manu-bhui sa.

source_text: and he was not allowing anyone to carry things through the beis hamikdash.
target_text: ka yesus kai si aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka ra rèti ia ka mèdha rèngu re d'ara madha èmu èèna.

source_text: and he was teaching torah and he was saying to them, has it not been written, beiti beit tefillah yikarei lkhol haammim my house shall be called a house of prayer for all peoples, but you have made it a mearat paritzim den of robbers.
target_text: ka na aj'a si, peka na, miu me'a le lii dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua suri tèke le, peka na: ‘ja'a tao èmu ne'e, sèna ka suku aa'i-aa'i mai sabaj'a ètu ne'e. ' te ngaa miu tao èmu ne j'aj'i era pakaboko dhèu parapo.

source_text: and the rashei hakohanim the chief priests and the sofrim scribes heard this, and they were seeking how they might destroy him, for they were afraid of him, for all the multitude were amazed at his torah teaching.
target_text: ropa kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra re'a rare tatao yesus sèmi èèna, ka ra nasa dènge ne. ka ra tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa ra madha'u, lula dhèu ae dhu d'èi lii holo-nori yesus.

source_text: and when it became late, rebbe, melech hamoshiach and his talmidim went out of the city.
target_text: d'ara lod'o cèna sa, yesus si kalua hari nèti kota yerusalem lèpa lasi j'unu asa rae betania.

source_text: and in the boker morning, early, as they passed by, they saw the etz teenah fig tree having been withered from the roots. and, having remembered, shim'on kefa says to him, rebbe, look, the etz teenah fig tree which you cursed has been withered.
target_text: bèli mad'ae èèna, yesus si lasi hari asa yerusalem. d'ai talora j'ara, ka ra rèdhi aj'u dhu yesus padhai lii med'a na. ka ana madhutu yesus sèra malaa, lula rèngu rèdhi aj'u èèna mango le d'ai amo. hèia petrus sanèd'e lii padhai lii yesus med'a na. ka na peka na, ama! ladhe ku! aj'u dhu ama dhoo med'a na, madhe le!

source_text: and in reply rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to them, have emunah in hashem.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a, we! sad'i miu parcaya ama lamatua sèmi èèna, na, j'aj'i kahèi.

source_text: omein, i say to you, whoever says to this mountain, be lifted up and be thrown into the sea, and does not waver in his lev heart but has emunah that what he says happens, so it will be for him.
target_text: ladhe miu parcaya dènge d'ara kateme, miu bisa pua ledhe hia na pidha asa d'ara dhasi. pe lamatua pidha eele ledhe èèna, sad'i miu baku parcaya dènge d'ara cabèka. miu parcaya mi ama lamatua, hud'i dènge d'ara kateme ku.

source_text: for this reason, i say to you, everything for which you daven pray, everything you request in tefillos prayers, have emunah faith that you have received it, and so it will be for you.
target_text: baku bhèlu! sad'i miu parcaya dènge d'ara kateme, ngaa dhu miu manèngi, tatu ama lamatua bisa hia miu.

source_text: and when you stand davening, grant selicha forgiveness if something you hold against someone, in order that your avinu sh'ba'shomayim may grant you selicha for your peyshaim transgressions.
target_text: ladhe dhèu èci sabaj'a, aa te ngaa na tèka d'ara era dènge dhèu leo, nèngu hud'i la'e pabe'a uuru ku dènge dhèu èèna. ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, ama miu ètu sorga heka saku eele sasala miu kèna.

source_text: but if you do not give mechila forgiveness, neither will your chattaim receive selicha forgiveness from your av sh'ba'shomayim.
target_text: ladhe abhu nèti miu dhu tèka d'ara dènge dhèu, ho mo'o boe hia abho, na, tatu ama miu ètu sorga no'o boe pabhèlu eele sasala miu kahèi.

source_text: and again they come into yerushalayim. and in the beis hamikdash, when rebbe, melech hamoshiach was walking about, the rashei hakohanim the chief priests and the sofrim scribes and the zekenim come to him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi taruu. ropa d'ai yerusalem, ka ra maso hari asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa maso asa madha èmu èèna, kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka yahudi sèra mai,

source_text: and they were saying to him, by what kind of samchut do you do these things? or who gave to you this samchut that you may do these things?
target_text: ka ra karèi yesus, peka na, cee ka dhu pua èu mai tao maruru ètu ne'e med'a na? cee ka hia èu hak!

source_text: but rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, i will ask you one dvar, and you answer me and i will tell you by what kind of samchut i do these things:
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a, na, rèngu neo tenge j'ara ho pamanahu ne. ka na b'ala si, peka na, ja'a neo karèi miu kahèi. miu dhaa uuru ku ja'a, heka ja'a dhaa miu kèna.

source_text: the tevilah of teshuva of yochanan - was it from shomayim or from bnei adam? answer me!
target_text: ja'a neo karèi miu sèmi ne'e: miu aa'i-aa'i mi tadhe yohanis, tuka sarani èèna, sina ma? cee ka dhu pua nèngu la'e sarani dhèu? lamatua do, dhèu rai-haha?

source_text: and they were discussing among themselves, saying, if we say, from shomayim, he will say, why then did you not believe him?
target_text: ra pajiko la'e-mai, ka ra padhue, peka na, eea! nara èdhi le! ladhe èdhi dhaa, peka na, ‘ama lamatua ka dhu pua yohanis, ' na b'ala hari, peka na, ‘nga tao ka miu parcaya boe yohanis! '

source_text: but if we say from bnei adam, they were afraid of the multitude, for everyone was considering yochanan beemes in truth a navi.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi bisa boe peka kahèi, na, ‘dhèu rai-haha dhu pua ne. ' te aad'o na, dhèu ae tao dènge èdhi. lula dhèu ae parcaya, yohanis èèna, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: and in reply to rebbe, melech hamoshiach, they say, we do not have daas. and rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to them, neither will i tell you by what kind of samchut i do these things.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i nge'a boe! ka yesus dhaa hari si, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a ko'o boe peka kahèi, cee ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach began to speak to them in meshalim parables. a man, a baal bayit, planted a kerem vineyard, and he put around it a fence and dug a pit for the yekev winepress and built a migdal tower, and he leased it to koremim vine keepers and then the man went on a journey.
target_text: èle ka, yesus padhai lii hari dènge kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra. ka na lole pake lii upama èci, peka na, dhèu èci la'e tao oka ho neo sèla anggor ètu dedha rai na. ka na tao tedhe reo nare oka èèna, aa tao bak cue ho kanate èi anggor asa d'ara la'e kahèi. hèia na patitu èmu madhenga oka cue dhu dedha. èle èèna ka, na hia dhèu leo seb'a oka èèna, ho ra pabagi èi anggor. hèia na pakèd'i asa rai leo la'e.

source_text: and the baal bayit sent an eved to the tenants, the koremim, in the season of katzir harvest in order that from the koremim he might receive from the perot fruit of the kerem vineyard.
target_text: lod'o d'ai hèru puu-g'ètu hua anggor, ka lamatua oka pua ana paleha na èci la'e asa dhèu sab'a oka sèra, ho na manèngi pala na.

source_text: but they seized the eved and they beat him and sent him away empty.
target_text: ropa d'ai nèi, ka dhèu seb'a sèra kèpe rare, ka game ne. hèia ra pua ne lèpa dènge ai hua da'u-da'u.

source_text: and again the baal bayit sent to the tenants, the koremim, another eved; and that one they struck on the rosh and insulted.
target_text: ka lamatua oka pua hari ana paleha leo èci. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra dhedhe panu'a kètu na. ka ra pamakae ne, dènge magèle eele ne.

source_text: and the baal bayit sent another; and that one they killed, and many others, some beating, and others killing.
target_text: hèia lamatua oka èèna pua hari ana paleha leo èci la'e. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra hake pamadhe ne. ra tao samia èèna ka, lamatua oka pua taruu ana paleha na la'e. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra game cahag'e, aa pamadhe cahag'e.

source_text: still he had one ben ahuv. lemaskana finally, the baal bayit sent him to them saying, they will respect beni.
target_text: ate eele dhodhoka ana mone mesa dhu pasue nèti lamatua oka. lula na abhu heka j'ara dhu leo, ka lamatua oka na pua ana d'èlu na la'e. na pajiko, peka na, ‘sèmi ja'a pua ana d'èlu ja'a la'e, na, rèngu sèmi rare dènge be'a, aa ra nanene ne. '

source_text: but those koremim said to themselves, this one is the yoresh heir the bechor. come, let us kill him, and the nachalah, the bechorah, will be ours.
target_text: hèia na pua ana na la'e. ropa dhèu seb'a sèra rèdhi ana na mai, ka ra papeka isi-aanga ra, peka na, ‘we! mi ladhe ku laa! mone heka nèi pua ana d'èlu na mai! ladhe ama na madhe, nèngu ne'e ka dhu sèmi nare aa'i-aa'i mèdha pusaka ama na. de mai ti pamadhe ne, sèna ka èdhi tare pusaka na! '

source_text: and having seized him, they killed him and threw him out of the kerem.
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra kèpe, ka ra pamadhe ne, hèia ra core eele ngi'u aae na asa li'u tedhe la'e. lii pakasame ne, d'ai sange ne'e ka.

source_text: what then will the baal bayit of the kerem do? he will come and destroy the koremim and will give the kerem to others.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus karèi dhèu kapai sèra, peka na, madhutu ngangee miu, na, lamatua oka èèna tao dhèu seb'a sèra tasa mera mia? madhutu ngangee ja'a, tatu nèngu mai ho pamadhe aa'i dhèu seb'a sèra, sèna ka na hia dhèu leo hari seb'a oka anggor na.

source_text: have you not read the kitvei hakodesh? even maasu habonim haytah lerosh pinah the stone which the ones building rejected, this one has come to be for the chief cornerstone.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti baca le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, ‘abhu hadhu cue dhu tuka hadhu sèra core eele le, te ngaa limuri ne, j'aj'i le hadhu padhèdi.

source_text: meiet hashem haytah zot, hi niflat beineinu from adonoi this came to be and it is wonderful in our eyes.
target_text: ama lamatua mesa na dhu pili nare, ka na pamadhèdi hadhu ne. nèti èèna ka, èdhi ladhe, na, be'a titu kèna! '

source_text: and they were seeking to seize him, and they were afraid of the multitude, for they knew that against them he told the mashal. and leaving him, they went away.
target_text: dhèu kapai sèra re'a dènge, na, yesus padhai lii paraga, pake lii pakasame èèna. rèngu sèra sama sèmi dhèu seb'a oka anggor èèna. hèia ra tenge j'ara ho neo kèpe yesus. te ngaa ra madha'u dènge dhèu ae dhu d'èi lii holo-nori yesus. ka ra kako eele ne.

source_text: and they send to him some of the perushim pharisees and the herodians in order that they might catch him in a dvar.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu kapai yahudi se pua pèri-pèri dhèu parisi dènge dhèu nèti partei herodes, lasi pakarèi dènge yesus, ho ra neo sahèdhe ne.

source_text: and having come, they say to him: rabbi, we have daas that you are an ish emes and you do not show deference toward anyone. ki ein masso panim for there is no partiality with you but rather on the derech hashem you give divrei torah in emes. is it mutar to give a poll tax to caesar or not? should we give or should we not give?
target_text: ka ra karèi ne, peka na, ama mese! ji'i nge'a, na, d'ara ama ku mola, aa d'èi boe kapod'e-kabèli. ama me'a d'ara dhèu. ama peka dad'èi lamatua dènge mola-mola, lula ama pili boe rèhu dhèu. de, ji'i neo karèi ama ku ca j'ara. madhutu atora agama yahudi, èdhi bisa b'ae bea asa dhèu aae kapai dhu paredha roma, do aad'o?

source_text: but rebbe, melech hamoshiach, having seen their tzeviut hypocrisy, said to them, why are you testing me? bring me a denarius that i may look at it.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a le, na, rèngu neo sahèdhe ne, sèna ka na padhai lii lab'a paredha roma. ka yesus b'ala si, peka na, nga tao ka miu neo sahèdhe ja'a dènge lii karèi sèmi èèna! cob'a pad'elo ku mi ja'a doi pudhi cue!

source_text: and they brought one. and rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to them, whose demut is this and whose inscription? and they said to him, caesarʼs.
target_text: ka ra j'ole doi pudhi cue hia ne. hèia yesus nare, ka laladhe. ka na karèi si, peka na, rèhu dènge ngara cee ètu doi pudhi ne? ka ra dhaa, peka na, èèna dhèu aae kapai paredha roma!

source_text: and he said to them, the things of caesar, give to caesar, and the things of hashem give to hashem. and they were amazed at rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: ka yesus peka, naa, ladhe sèmi èèna, ngaa dhu unu dhèu paredha, hia asa dhèu paredha la'e. te ngaa dhu unu ama lamatua, hia asa ama lamatua la'e. ropa tadèngi rare, lii b'ala na, ka ra malaa, lula yesus peka dhu lèke. nèti èèna ka, dhèu sèra bisa heka sahèdhe ne.

source_text: and the tzedukim come to rebbe, melech hamoshiach, the ones who say that there is not to be a techiyas hamesim, and they were questioning him, saying,
target_text: abhu partei agama dhu leo èci, ngara na partei saduki. rèngu aj'a, peka na, dhèu madhe bisa heka mamuri. ca tèka, abhu dhèu saduki pèri-pèri mai neo sahèdhe yesus.

source_text: rabbi, moshe rabbeinu wrote to us that if an ach of someone should die and leave behind an isha uven ein lo and there is no son to him yevamah yavo aleiha ulekakhah lo lisha vhayah habechor asher teled yakum al shem achiv hametthe brother of her husband must come to her and he must take her to him as wife and the bechor she bears shall raise up the name of the dead brother.
target_text: ka ra padhai lii dènge yesus, peka na, ama mese! musa suri tèke le hia èdhi atora, peka na: ladhe dhèu mone èci madhe tèke eele dhèu èmu na, te ngaa rèngu dènge boe kolo, na, ari dhèu mone na bisa leo nare hari bhèni balu èèna, sèna ka abhu kolo ho baku pa'ele kolongara a'a na dhu madhe èèna.

source_text: now there were shiva achim. and the first took a wife and, dying, did not leave a descendant.
target_text: mema musa aj'a sèmi èèna. te ngaa ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: abhu dhèu pidhu dhu pa'a'ari. mone uru leo uuru èmu, te ngaa madhe, abhu mèka kolo.

source_text: and the second took her and he died, not having left behind a descendant. and the third likewise.
target_text: ka ari na leo nare bhèni balu èèna. nèbhu boe ka ari na madhe, te ngaa abhu boe kolo kahèi. ari na ka tèlu, sèmi èèna kahèi; na leo nare bhèni balu èèna, te ngaa abhu mèka kolo, nèngu madhe.

source_text: and the seven did not leave a descendant.
target_text: taruu-taruu sèmi èèna ka, d'ai ana limuri tèka madhe kahèi. nèbhu boe, hèia bhèni balu èèna madhe.

source_text: in the techiyas hamesim, when they are made to stand up alive, of which of them will she be the isha? for seven had her as wife.
target_text: naa! ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: dhèu bhèni èèna, leo le dènge mone dhèu pidhu! d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe, bhèni ne j'aj'i dhèu èmu cee, nèti dhèu pidhu sèra?

source_text: rebbe, melech hamoshiach, said to them, is not this the reason you are in error, having daas neither of the kitvei hakodesh nor of the gevurat hashem?
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, lii karèi miu sèra, tadha, na, miu me'a iia mèka isi sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua! miu me'a boe koasa lamatua kahèi. de miu sala titu kèna!

source_text: but concerning the mesim that are made to stand up alive, they do not marry nor are they given in nisuim, but are like the malachim in shomayim.
target_text: mi nanene! sèmi ne'e: ètu sorga dhèu paleo boe èmu. dhèu madhe aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua pamamuri hari, ra paleo heka èmu. sèmi èèna kahèi, ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga.

source_text: but concerning the mesim, that they are made to stand up alive, have you not read in the sefer moshe at the bush, how hashem spoke to him, saying, anochi elohei avraham elohei yitzchak velohei ya'akov, .
target_text: aa ja'a peka mi miu lula-nèti dhèu madhe mamuri hari, do aad'o. musa suri tèke lula-nèti ana aaj'u dhu ai na'e, te ngaa kèpu boe. miu sanèd'e lii lolo èèna, do aad'o? ropa ai na'e ana aaj'u èèna, ama lamatua peka dènge musa, na, ‘ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti bèi-baki èu, nuka abraham, isak, dènge yakob. toke d'ai sange ne'e, rèngu aa'i-aa'i manèngi-mangaj'i mi ja'a era. '

source_text: hashem is not the g-d of the mesim dead ones but of the chayyim living ones. you are greatly mistaken.
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, bèi-baki èdhi sèra madhe nèbhu le. te ngaa, lula ama lamatua peka nare le, na, nèngu j'aj'i lamatua rèngu era. nèti èèna ka, èdhi te'a, na, rèngu mamuri hari le. de masi ka dhèu madhe le, te ngaa ra mamuri hari. de dhèu mamuri dhu manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, te ngaa dhèu madhe aad'o, sina ma? nèti èèna ka, ladhe miu kèpe taruu a'aj'a dhu peka na, dhèu madhe mamuri heka, èèna miu sala ae!

source_text: and one of the sofrim approached and heard them debating, and seeing that rebbe, melech hamoshiach answered them well, asked him, which mitzvah is rishonah of all the mitzvot?
target_text: ètu lod'o èèna, abhu mese agama èci dhu nanene yesus padhai lii dènge dhèu nèti partei saduki sèra. madhutu a'abhu mese agama èèna, na, yesus dhaa lèke le lii karèi rèngu. hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, ama! ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: atora ad'a dènge lii paredha agama èdhi ae titu kèna. madhutu a'abhu ama, nèti lii paredha dhu mai nèti musa, mia ka dhu hua iia risi?

source_text: rebbe, melech hamoshiach answered, shema yisroel adonoi eloheinu adonoi echad is harishonah.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, lii paredha dhu hua iia risi, peka sèmi ne'e ka: ‘miu dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i mi! mi nanene paie! ama lamatua èèna, mema lamatua èdhi, aa kètu èdhi kahèi. nèngu dhoka mesa na di, lamatua leo aad'o.

source_text: v'ahavta es adonoi eloheicha b'chol levavcha uvechol nafshecha uvechol modecha.
target_text: de miu hud'i sue risi eele ne nèti aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i d'èi pa'èci dènge ne dènge d'ara kateme, aa tadhe mèu ne, dènge sab'a èra ho madhutu dad'èi na. '

source_text: and the shneyah is this, vahavta lreacha kamocha. there is not another mitzvah greater than these.
target_text: aa lii paredha ka dua peka na: ‘èu hud'i sue ku dhèu leo, sama sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu unu mu. ' dua paredha se'e ka dhu hua iia risi. abhu heka lii paredha leo dhu risi eele nèti dua paredha se'e.

source_text: and the baal torah said to him, well spoken, rabbi, beemes you have said that hashem is echadone, and ein od and there is no other except him.
target_text: ka mese agama èèna b'ala hari, peka na, tare'a! ama ku peka lèke kèna. te ama lamatua j'aj'i kètu èdhi. lamatua leo aad'o.

source_text: and to have ahavah for him b'chol levavcha with all your heart and with all your binah uvechol modechawith all your strength and l'reacha kamochayour neighbor as yourself is greater than all of the burnt offerings and sacrifices.
target_text: èdhi hud'i sue risi ne, toke d'ara d'èi ho pa'èci dènge ne, tadhe mèu ne, dènge sab'a èra ho madhutu dad'èi na. èdhi hud'i sue dhèu leo kahèi sama sèmi èdhi sue ngi'u èdhi unu ti. lamatua d'èi risi eele tatao sèmi èèna, nèti èdhi madhutu dhodhoka atora agama di. tatao sèmi èèna be'a risi, nèti èdhi tèti badha ho lati tunu hia lamatua, do tèti mèdha leo hia ne.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach, when he saw that this torah teacher answered with chochmah wisdom, said to him, you are not far from the malchut hashem. and no one was daring to put a she'elah question in front of rebbe, melech hamoshiach again.
target_text: ropa yesus nanene nare dhèu ne dhaa sèmi èèna, ka na pangee, na, mese agama ne ne'a dènge be'a le. hèia yesus peka na, èu oe j'aj'i unu ama lamatua kèna. èle èèna ka, dhèu leo sèra bani heka pakarèi dènge yesus, lula dhèu èci sa segi boe ne.

source_text: while rebbe, melech hamoshiach was saying shiurim torah talks in the beis hamikdash, he was saying: how is it that the sofrim say that moshiach is merely ben dovid?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus aj'a dhèu ae sèra ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i era. ka na karèi si, peka na, madhutu ngangee miu, na, tasamia? mese agama sèra aj'a, peka na, kristus èèna dhu lamatua paj'uj'u nèti uru ka mai. madhutu ngangee rèngu, na, kristus èèna dhoka ana-èpu daud. te ngaa a'aj'a sèmi èèna d'ai lèke mèu mèka.

source_text: dovid himself said by the ruach hakodesh, neum hashem ladoni: shev limini, ad ashit oyvecha hadom lraglecha.
target_text: lula, nèti uru ka mai, roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci pake daud ho suri, peka na, ‘ama lamatua peka le mi lamatua ja'a, na, mai ho madhèdi mi era dhu hua iia, re bab'oa g'ana ja'a. pe èèna na ja'a tao musu èu pahaha iisi, toke ra bisa boe ded'e kètu mi èu. '

source_text: dovid himself calls moshiach adon; how then is moshiach merely ben dovid? and the large multitude found it a huge oneg pleasure to listen to him.
target_text: de èdhi te'a, na, dhèu aae daud paroa kristus èèna, peka na, ‘lamatua' na. nèti èèna ka, ladhe dhèu sèra peka, na, kristus èèna dhoka ana-èpu daud di, èèna d'ai mèka. lula nèngu èèna j'aj'i lamatua nèti daud kahèi. ropa yesus peka nare sèmi èèna, dhèu ae sèra d'èi titu kèna nanene ne.

source_text: and in his torah, rebbe, melech hamoshiach was saying, beware of the sofrim scribes, torah teachers, rabbonim, the ones enamored of strutting about in extremely long kaftans and with equally lengthy birkat shalom greetings in the marketplaces,
target_text: ka yesus peka hari si, miu hud'i pajiko paie ku mese agama. rèngu d'èi pasia pake kodho madhera d'ai rai, lasi paraga dènge dhèu ae, sèna ka dhèu dhu rèdhi rèngu sèra, koa si, peka na, ‘ladhe ku laa! dhèu sèra, dhèu kapai! '

source_text: and places of honor in the shuls and places of honor at the seudot banquet dinners.
target_text: ladhe sèmi rèngu maso asa èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, do lasi ra'a-sisi, ra tenge era madhèdi dhu be'a risi, sèna ka dhèu ae rèdhi si.

source_text: beware particularly of the ones devouring the batim houses of the almanot widows and making a grand show of davening long tefillos. mishpat judgment will fall more heavily on these.
target_text: de hua iia mi pajiko paie! rèngu kapod'e-kabèli bhèni balu ho parame rare èmu bhèni balu sèra. te ngaa ètu madha dhèu ae, rèngu pahuni bhabhelu ra sèra dènge j'ara titu ho sabaj'a pamadhera aae, sèna ka dhèu peka na, rèngu se dhèu mola. te ngaa limuri mai, na, ama lamatua hia huku dhu bia risi asa rèngu.

source_text: and having sat down opposite the beis hamikdash otzar treasury, rebbe, melech hamoshiach was observing how the multitude throws copper coins into the otzar. and many ashirim rich people were throwing in much.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus la'e madhèdi patangara dènge boaraka derma ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. na ladhe dhèu mai pamaso doi kolete asa d'ara boaraka èèna. ka na ladhe dhèu kaja sèra parèu doi ae.

source_text: and a poor almanah widow came and threw in two leptas, which is a kodrantes.
target_text: te ngaa abhu bhèni balu èci dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa mai manèngi-mangaj'i, ka na pamaso dua doi asa d'ara boaraka èèna. dua doi dhu na pamaso èèna, kab'ua ciki ood'e di.

source_text: and having summoned his talmidim, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them: omein, i say to you that this poor almanah has put in more tzedakah charity contribution than all those contributing to the otzar,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus gape ana madhutu na, ka na peka, mi ladhe ku bhèni balu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa nèi. na pamaso dhoka dua doi di, te ngaa nèngu hia risi eele nèti dhèu leo sèra.

source_text: for everyone threw in from their abundance, but this almanah from her need has put in everything she had, all her michyah subsistence.
target_text: dhèu leo sèra hia kolete nèti doi sisa rèngu. te ngaa bhèni balu ne hia aa'i mèu-mèu doi nèngu asa lamatua.

source_text: and as rebbe, melech hamoshiach was going out from the beis hamikdash, one of his talmidim says to him, hinei! rebbe, what large stones and impressive binyanim buildings!
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra kalua nèti d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa rèngu d'ai li'u, hèia ana madhutu na èci paj'uj'u asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ka na peka, ama! ladhe ku èmu ne'e! ra tao rare, saraga bia. ra pagod'o rare hadhu sèra, mera titu kèna!

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to him, do you see these great binyanim? not one even stone will be left resting on another even stone. all will be thrown down!
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, èmu ne mema saraga titu kèna! te nèbhu heka, dhèu paguri eele ne. ka hadhu-hadhu sèra, èci sa pamadhèdi heka ètu dedha èci.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was sitting on the mount of olives opposite the beis hamikdash having a yechidus private meeting with kefa and ya'akov and yochanan and andrew.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi asa ledhe saitun, ka na madhèdi ètu era dhu patangara dènge èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. hèia petrus, yakobis, yohanis dènge anderias mai padhai lii dènge yesus.

source_text: tell us when these things will be and what will be the ot sign when all these things are about to be consummated?
target_text: ra karèi, aku rèngu na, ama! lole hari ku, lii dhu ama ku peka dènge ji'i deo na. lod'o mia sèra sa j'aj'i? aa tadha-tadha na, samia?

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach began to say to them, beware lest anyone deceive you.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sad'i miu pajiko paie-iie, sèna ka baku lèke tipu.

source_text: for many will come in my name saying i am here. and they will deceive many.
target_text: te ladhe èèna na, dhèu ae mai tèb'a kakara, ho ra peka na, ‘ja'a ne kristus, dhèu dhu ama lamatua moa nèti uru ka mai. ' aa ra leko-monya dhèu ae.

source_text: but when you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be troubled. it is necessary for these things to occur, but it is not yet haketz the end.
target_text: ladhe miu mèdhi dhèu pamusu, do tadèngi lii lolo dhèu papara-pakèj'i dènge pakasiro ètu mia-mia, miu baku madha'u kahèi. sèra sa hud'i j'aj'i uuru ku. te ngaa lod'o èle rai-haha èèna dhae d'ai mèka.

source_text: for there will be an intifada of ethnic group against ethnic group and malchut against malchut, there will be earthquakes in place after place, and there will be famines. these things are but the beginning of the chevlei.
target_text: dhèu nèti ca suku mai pamusu dènge suku leo, rai èci mai pamusu dènge rai leo. ètu mia-mia, j'aj'i rai opo dènge kabake-manganga. sèra sa j'aj'i tadha sama sèmi dhèu bhèni èci dhu kabake pèd'a neo nara iisi.

source_text: but as for yourselves, take heed and be careful. for they will hand you over to the sanhedrin and in the shuls you will be beaten and before moshlim governors and melachim kings you will take your stand for the sake of me as a solemn edut testimony to them.
target_text: de hua iia, na, miu mage-mage! te èèna na dhèu mai kèpa miu, ho ra nuni asa dhèu paredha agama dhu pama'ète lii agama. aa ra game miu ètu d'ara èmu-èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. ho èèna na rèti miu asa madha dhèu dhu dènge koasa, lula miu madhutu ja'a. te ngaa be'a kahèi, ne'e ne miu abhu tebho ho peka kolongara ja'a mi rèngu.

source_text: and it is necessary that the besuras hageulah first be proclaimed to all nations.
target_text: te dhèu unu ama lamatua hud'i lasi uuru ku lole lii lolo be'a ja'a mi suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, heka lod'o èle rai-haha ne d'ai kèna.

source_text: and when they arraign you and hand you over for trial, do not be worried beforehand about what you might say; but whatever is given to you in that hour, this you shall say, for it is not you yourselves who are the ones speaking, but the ruach hakodesh.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ladhe ra èki rèti miu asa era pama'ète lii langu, miu baku madha'u, peka na, ‘èèna na ja'a neo padhai lii ngaa? do, ja'a neo dhaa ngaa? ' ladhe d'ai lod'o èèna, miu padhai lii madhutu ngaa dhu roh mola-mèci ama lamatua peka dènge miu.

source_text: and ach will hand over ach to mavet, and av his own yeled, and yeladim will rise up against horim parents and cause them to be condemned with onesh mavet the death penalty.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu cue, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, èèna na a'ari nèngu tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ne. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe abhu ana dhu parcaya ja'a, èèna na ama d'èlu na tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ne. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe abhu ina-ama dhu parcaya ja'a, èèna na ana d'èlu rèngu tenge j'ara ho pamadhe si.

source_text: and everyone will hate you with sinas chinom baseless hatred because of my name. but the one having endured to haketz, this one will receive yeshu'at eloheinu.
target_text: de èèna na, dhèu d'èi boe miu, taga miu madhutu ja'a. te ngaa dhèu cee dhu bisa taha toke d'ai èle lod'o èèna, tatu ama lamatua hia mamuri mi nèngu.

source_text: and when you see the shikuts meshomemthe abomination of desolation, the abomination that causes desolation standing where it ought not - let the one reading this, take heed - then let the ones in yehudah flee to the mountains.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, èèna na, abhu dhèu èci dhu bhelu-katub'a risi eele mai. ho na mai maso ka titu ètu era laluri ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, dhu madhutu iia-iia na, nèngu bisa boe ètu era èèna, ho na pahera era èèna. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua tèke eele era èèna. ladhe miu mèdhi le sèmi èèna, na, mi pajiko paie-iie! cee dhu baca lii ne'e, pajiko paie kahèi! èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra, dètu ae le. ladhe mèdhi sèmi èèna, na, dhèu-dhèu ètu propensi yudea lega-rai asa kolo ledhe lasi.

source_text: and the one on the roof, let him not come down back inside, and let him not enter his bais to take anything away.
target_text: rèngu hud'i rai pamèri-mèri, sèna ka baku abhu j'aj'èra. ladhe dhèu mai le asa li'u, lèpa ia ka rare mèdha asa d'ara èmu.

source_text: and the one in the sadeh field let him not turn back to get his kaftan.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, dhèu ètu d'ara oka, baku lèpa èmu rare mèdha-papake.

source_text: and oy to the ones with child and the ones with nursing infants in those days.
target_text: dhu j'èra risi, dhèu bhèni dhu dènge babia, dènge ina dhu pasusu ana rara iisi hiu, lula rèngu rai rare boe.

source_text: but daven tefillos that it may not occur in khoref winter.
target_text: de hua iia risi miu sabaj'a, sèna ka lod'o j'aj'èra sèra baku lèke dènge hèru èj'i lai.

source_text: for in those days will be tzarah gedolah great tribulation of such a kind as has not happened from the reshit yedei habriah beginning of the days of creation which hashem created until now, and never again will be.
target_text: te j'aj'èra lod'o èèna, bia titu kèna! mulai nèti ama lamatua tao rai-haha, toke d'ai sange ne'e, dhèu rèdhi mèka j'aj'èra dhu bia sèmi èèna. j'aj'èra bia sèmi èèna, lod'o limuri, j'aj'i heka hari.

source_text: and unless hashem makes those yamim shortened, no one would be delivered in the yeshu'at eloheinu. but for the sake of the bechirim, whom hashem chose, he shortened the yamim.
target_text: ladhe ama lamatua pab'ab'e boe lod'o j'aj'èra sèra, abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu mamuri. te ngaa, taga ama lamatua sue dhèu dhu na hag'e nare sèra, ka na pab'ab'e lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra sèra.

source_text: and, then, if someone says to you, hinei! here is the rebbe, melech hamoshiach! hinei! there! do not have emunah in what they say.
target_text: ladhe lod'o d'ai na, miu tadèngi dhèu mai peka, aku rèngu na, ‘ladhe ku! kristus ètu ne'e! ' aa dhèu leo hari peka, aku rèngu na, ‘aad'o! kristus ètu nèi! ' miu baku nanene kahèi!

source_text: for meshichei sheker false moshiachs will arise, and neviei sheker false prophets, and they will perform otot and moftim so as to deceive and lead astray, if possible, the bechirim.
target_text: te ladhe èèna na, dhèu mai ho tèb'a kakara, peka na, ‘ja'a ne, kristus! ' aa cahag'e hari peka na, ‘ja'a ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. ' èèna na ra tao tadha malaa ae-ae dènge koasa nidhu, ho kapod'e-kabèli dhèu. rèngu patangi-tenge j'ara sèna ka dhèu unu ama lamatua lèke tipu kahèi!

source_text: but you beware. i have forewarned you concerning all things.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu pajiko paie-iie! mema lod'o j'aj'èra bia èèna d'ai mèka, te ngaa ja'a pasanèd'e uuru miu!

source_text: but after the tzarah of yamim hahem, the shemesh will be darkened, and the levanah will not give its ohr,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka hari dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, ladhe èle lod'o j'aj'èra sèra, na, ‘madha lod'o j'aj'i maroga, aa hèru heo heka.

source_text: and the kokhavim stars will be falling out of shomayim, and the kochot powers, the ones in shomayim, will be shaken.
target_text: hua hètu-hua hètu bèbha nèti dedha-liru mai, aa koasa-koasa ètu dedha-liru j'aj'i kaco-balo. '

source_text: and then you will see the bar enosh ba baananim the son of man moshiach coming in clouds with gevurah rabbah great power and kavod glory.
target_text: èle èèna, heka dhèu ladhe rèdhi ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. èèna na ja'a mai dènge ra'i-liru nèti dedha. hèia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi a'èra dènge dadedha ja'a.

source_text: and then he will send the malachim and he will gather together his bechirim from the four winds, from the ends extremities of haaretz to the ends extremities of shomayim.
target_text: ka ja'a paredha ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga, ho puru lasi oru-kaboko dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a hag'e kore nèti mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne; nèti suu haa d'ai suu dhimu, nèti suu badae toke d'ai suu balèu.

source_text: and from the etz teenah fig tree learn the mashal: when by that time its branch has become tender and it puts forth the leaves, you have daas that kayitz is near;
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, ja'a kore upama nèti ana aaj'u. ladhe rèu na mulai karara, èèna tadha hèru hadhu dètu le!

source_text: so also you, when you see these things happening, have daas that it is near, at the doors.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe miu mèdhi lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra sèra j'aj'i, sama sèmi lii peka ja'a deo na, èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, mamai ja'a dètu ae le.

source_text: omein, i say to you that by no means hador hazeh passes away until all these things take place.
target_text: ne'e ne ja'a peka dènge miu kèna! nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri se, èèna na abhu cahag'e dhu dhae madhe mèka, te lod'o-lod'o dhu pènu dènge j'aj'èra na d'ai le.

source_text: shomayim and haaretz will pass away, but the devarim of me will by no means pass away.
target_text: masi ka liru dènge rai-haha ne ele, te ngaa lii holo-nori ja'a ele boe, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: but concerning hayom hahu or the shaah, no one has daas, neither the malachim in shomayim nor haben, but only haav.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii, peka na, dhèu èci sa re'a boe lod'o do jam dhu ja'a mai hari. ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga sèra re'a boe kahèi. ja'a mesa ku, ke'a boe kahèi. dhoka ama ku mesa na di, dhu ne'a.

source_text: beware, stay shomer on guard, for you do not have daas when the time is.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu aa'i-aa'i mi hud'i pajiko paie, lula miu me'a boe lod'o d'ai na.

source_text: it is like a man, when departing on a journey and leaving his bais house and, having put his avadim servants in charge, each with his assigned avodah work, gives orders to the gatekeeper to be shomer.
target_text: nèbhu heka, ja'a laku tèke eele miu kèna, te ngaa èèna na ja'a mai hari. sama sèmi dhèu dhu la'e tèke eele èmu nèngu, ho la'e asa rai kaj'èu. na pua ana-ana nèngu j'aga paie èmu. aa na bagi hia si sasab'a. ka na paredha ana madhenga èmu, sèna ka na j'aga paie, toke d'ai nèngu lèpa hari.

source_text: therefore you be shomer, for you do not have daas when the baal bayit comes, either late in the yom or at chatzot halailah or at cockcrow or baboker,
target_text: miu hud'i j'aga mèda-mèu kahèi, lula miu me'a boe lod'o mia ja'a mai hari, sama sèmi ana madhenga èmu ne'a boe lod'o lamatua èmu na lèpa. lèpa lod'o nihia, talora mèda, oe mèu, lod'o rea, do lod'o nètu; miu me'a boe jam èèna.

source_text: lest having come pitom suddenly he finds you sleeping.
target_text: mage dhoka na mai sahèka, te abhu miu dhu bhèj'i luu era.

source_text: and what i say to you, i say to all, be shomer.
target_text: de, ngaa dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne'e, ja'a peka lème dènge dhèu leo kahèi, ‘miu hud'i pajiko paie, ho mi soru mamai ja'a. ' d'ai sange ne'e ka, lamatua yesus padhai lii lula-nèti lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra dhèu rai-haha, dènge ana madhutu na sèra ètu ledhe saitun.

source_text: now it was two days before pesach, the chag hamatzot. and the rashei hakohanim and the sofrim were seeking how they might by ormah cunning do away with rebbe, melech hamoshiach. for they were saying, not at the chag, for fear that a riot break out among the am haaretz.
target_text: èle èèna ka, kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra tenge j'ara neo kèpe yesus dènge mau-mau. te rèngu neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa ètu d'ara padhue èèna, ra peka na, taha ku! baku parai kèpe ne, lula lod'o kalela dètu le. mage dhoka dhèu ae sèra patao dènge èdhi. rèngu padhai lii sèmi èèna, lula dii dua lod'o ka, d'ai lod'o kalela dhèu yahudi, dhu biasa ra peka na, ‘paska' dènge ‘pesta roti dhu pake boe ragi'. kalela se pasanèd'e rèngu lod'o bèi-baki ra kalua nèti rai masir.

source_text: and he was in beit-anyah at the bais of shim'on the leper, reclining at tish, and an isha woman came, having an alabaster flask of costly perfume, pure nard, and having broken open the alabaster flask, she poured it on the head of rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: ètu rae betania, abhu ca dhèu ngara na simon. uru èèna, dhèu madenge dènge ne, lula nèngu pèd'a kusta. te ngaa limuri ne, èle le nèti papèd'a na. hèia lod'o kalela dhae d'ai mèka, na, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra lasi ra'a-rinu ètu èmu simon. ètu talora ra'a-rinu era, dhèu bhèni èci mai paraga yesus. nèd'u dènge boto èci dhu ra tao nèti hadhu. isi boto ne, èi hèu mèngi asli dhu kab'ua titu kèna, dhu ra tao nèti amo aaj'u hèu mèngi. hèia bhèni ne pamae hèb'a boto èèna, ka na pasuti èi hèu mèngi mi kètu yesus, ho j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, nèngu pakab'ua yesus.

source_text: now some were there who in ka'as anger said to one another, for what reason has this waste of ointment taken place?
target_text: te ngaa ètu èèna, abhu dhèu leo dhu ra'a-rinu pa'èci kahèi. ropa dhèu se rèdhi dhèu bhèni ne tao sèmi èèna, hèia ra nasa. ka ra padhai lii padedha iisi, peka na, ngaa ka unu bhèni nèi? na bhori eele èi hèu mèngi kab'ua aae èèna!

source_text: for this was able to be sold for more than three hundred denarii and to be given to the aniyim. and they were reproaching her.
target_text: be'a risi nèngu pahie èi hèu mèngi èèna, ho la'e papala doi ae sèra, mi dhèu dhu dènge boe unu. te kab'ua èi hèu mèngi ne, èci èèna ka dènge gaji tuka d'ara ca tèu. hèia ra jèke bhèni ne.

source_text: but rebbe, melech hamoshiach said, leave her alone. why are you bringing about difficulty for the isha? has she not performed one of the gemilut chasadim on me?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala lii rèngu, aku nèngu na, miu baku pasusa bhèni ne! hud'i laa! ja'a karej'e lula nèngu pasuti le ngi'u ja'a dènge èi hèu mèngi ne'e!

source_text: for always the aniyim you have with you, and when you wish you are able to do ma'asim tovim for them, but me you do not always have.
target_text: dhèu kasia sèra, bèli-bèli ètu talora miu. de lod'o mia èèna ka dhu miu lake mere, na, miu bisa soru-bara si. te ngaa nèbhu heka, ja'a pa'èci heka dènge miu.

source_text: with what she had she did all she could. she prepared ahead of time to anoint my basar for the kevurah burial.
target_text: mamuri ja'a nèbhu heka ètu rai-haha ne. dènge tatao bhèni ne, nèngu lalau ngi'u ja'a, sama sèmi nèngu pahèu mèngi mema ngi'u aae ja'a, ho padhane.

source_text: and, omein, i say to you, wherever the besuras hageulah is proclaimed in kol haaretz, also what this isha did will be spoken in her memory.
target_text: miu patadhe, ee! èèna na, ladhe dhèu lole lii lolo be'a ama lamatua ètu mia-mia, na, ra palolo kahèi tatao be'a bhèni ne'e. sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i sanèd'e nèngu.

source_text: and yehudah from k'riot, one of the shneym asar, went to the rashei hakohanim in order that he might betray him to them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, abhu ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu yesus dhèu canguru dua sèra, ngara na yudas iskariot. nèngu kalua la'e tenge kètu agama yahudi sèra ho neo pahie yesus mi rèngu. ropa na paraga dènge rèngu, ka na peka naneo na.

source_text: and there was chedvah joy, gaiety, rejoicing with the ones having heard and they gave the havtachah promise of a matnat kesef gift of money to yehudah. and he was seeking how he might conveniently betray rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: lod'o kètu agama sèra tadèngi naneo yudas, ka ra karej'e titu kèna. hèia ra jaji, peka na, ladhe èu neo pahie yesus dènge ji'i, tatu ji'i b'ae. hèia yudas kalua, ka na mulai tenge j'ara ho pahie yesus.

source_text: and at the rishon of the chag hamatzot, when it was customary to prepare the pesach korban for mo'ed zevach, his talmidim say to him, where do you wish us to go and make the preparations for you to conduct the seder?
target_text: lod'o èèna, lèke dènge lod'o partama nèti lod'o kalela dhèu yahudi. de d'ara lod'o èèna, rèngu tema tunu roti dhu dènge boe ragi, aa roro kahib'i-kalèbho kahèi. hèia ana madhutu yesus sèra mai karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ama! doe ne'e ne, lod'o kalela paska èdhi kèna. de ama neo ji'i lalau era kalela paska ètu mia?

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach sends two of his talmidim and he says to them, go into the city, and you will meet a man carrying a jar of water; follow him;
target_text: hèia yesus pua ana madhutu na dhèu dua, aku nèngu na, miu lami uuru ku asa d'ara kota. ètu nèi, miu paraga dènge dhèu mone èci, dhu pasae èi d'ara g'ala iiki cue. lami madhutu ne nèti limuri.

source_text: and wherever he enters, tell the baal bayit that the rebbe says, where is my mekom linah where i can conduct the pesach seder with my talmidim?
target_text: ladhe na maso asa èmu mia èèna ka, na, miu madhutu ne asa d'ara. hèia miu peka mi lamatua èmu èèna, sèmi ne'e, ‘ama mese ji'i manèngi kama èci, ho na neo tao kalela paska dènge ana madhutu nèngu. '

source_text: and he will show you a large aliyyah having been furnished and ready. and there prepare for us.
target_text: pe dhèu èèna paj'uj'u kama aae èci ètu èmu dedha na, dhu na sadia nare le. de miu dua mi dhoka lami lalau nganga'a di.

source_text: and the talmidim went out and they came into the city and found things just as rebbe, melech hamoshiach told them, and they made preparations for pesach.
target_text: hèia dua ra lasi ka asa d'ara kota. d'ai nèi, rèngu rèdhi tare'a, sama sèmi ngaa dhu yesus moa deo na. ka ra sadia aa'i-aa'i, ho yesus si ra'a kalela paska ètu era èèna. èle èèna ka, dua ra lasi paroa yesus si.

source_text: and erev having come, rebbe, melech hamoshiach arrives with the shneym asar.
target_text: ropa lod'o oe cèna, hèia yesus dènge ana madhutu dhèu canguru dua sèra d'ai era èèna.

source_text: and while they were at tish in a yechidus, reclining and eating, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said, omein, i say to you, that one of you will betray me, okhel lachemi the one eating my bread.
target_text: ka ra madhèdi ra'a sama-sama. ètu talora ra'a era, yesus padhai lii dènge si, aku nèngu na, miu nanene ku! èèna na dhèu èci nèti miu se pahie eele ja'a mi dhèu leo.

source_text: they began to have agmat nefesh grief, and, one by one, to say to rebbe, melech hamoshiach, surely i am not the one?
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii èèna, ana madhutu yesus sèra cag'ag'a dènge manyasa. ka rèngu èci-èci mulai karèi yesus, peka na, dhèu dhu ama peka èèna, ja'a aad'o, sina ma?

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, it is one of the shneym asar, the one dipping with me into the bowl.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu cèb'u roti palere-lere dènge ja'a asa d'ara mago ne, nèngu ka dhu pahia ja'a.

source_text: for the bar enosh goes just as it has been written concerning him, but woe to that man through whom the bar enosh is betrayed. it would have been better for him if that man had not been born.
target_text: mi sanèd'e! ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a hud'i madhe ku, sama sèmi dhu suri tèke le, ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua. te ngaa kasia, dhèu dhu neo pahia ja'a èèna, bèli-camèd'a nèngu dui nare pala na! hua iia risi, ina na baku nara iisi ne!

source_text: and at seudah, while they were eating, rebbe, melech hamoshiach, having taken the matzah, having made the hamotzi, broke the middle matzah, giving the afikoman to moshiachʼs talmidim, and said, take and eat, this is my basar.
target_text: ropa rèngu ètu talora ra'a era, yesus nare roti cue, hèia na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka na pamae roti ne, hèia na j'ole asa ana madhutu na sèra. ka na peka na, roti ne'e ne, ngi'u ja'a kèna. mere ho mi'a.

source_text: and having taken the cup of redemption and having made the bracha, he gave it to moshiachʼs talmidim, and everyone drank of it.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na nare galaa dhu isi dènge èi hua anggor. na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua kahèi. ka na j'ole galaa èèna asa ana madhutu na, sèna ka rinu.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, hinei dahm habrit, the dahm of me, which is being poured out lama'an rabbimfor the sake of many.
target_text: hèia na peka, èi anggor ne'e ne, raa ja'a kèna, dhu suti sèna ka hia mamuri mi dhèu ae. raa ne, j'aj'i mi tadha ho pasanèd'e, peka na, ngaa dhu ama lamatua moa le èèna, limuri ne j'aj'i le tare'a. mere ho minu ka!

source_text: omein, i say to you, that no longer will i by any means drink of the p'ri hagefen fruit of the vine until yom hahu when i drink it chadash new in the malchut hashem.
target_text: mi sanèd'e paie! nèti mèda ne'e ne, ja'a kinu heka èi anggor. toke d'ai ja'a dènge ama ku ngèd'u paredha sama-sama ètu sorga, heka kinu hari kèna.

source_text: and having sung the hallel, they went out to the mount of olives.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra sod'a lii sod'a èci, ho ra koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua. ka mèda èèna kahèi, lasi dènge asa ledhe saitun.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to them, all of you will fall away, for it has been written, i will strike down es haroeh utefuten hatzon the shepherd and the sheep will be scattered.
target_text: ètu d'ara kakako rèngu èèna, yesus padhai lii, peka na, d'ara mèda ne'e ne, miu aa'i-aa'i mi rai tèke eele ja'a mesa ku. sama sèmi dhu ra suri le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, ‘èèna na ama lamatua pamadhe ana madhenga badha, ka kahib'i-kalèbho na rai paj'ala asa haa, asa dhimu. '

source_text: but after i am made to stand up alive in the techiyas hamoshiach, i will go before you into the galil.
target_text: èèna na ja'a madhe tare'a. te ngaa lod'o ja'a mamuri hari, ja'a laku uru nèti miu asa propensi galilea!

source_text: but shim'on kefa said to him, even if everyone will fall away, yet i will not.
target_text: ka petrus b'ala, peka na, ama! masi ka dhèu leo rai eele ama, te ngaa ja'a rai boe!

source_text: and he says to him, omein, i say to you, that you today, balailah hazeh during this night before the tarnegol crows twice, you will make hakhchashah denial of me shalosh pe'amim three times.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, petrus! mu patadhe! mèda ne'e kahèi, manu kokotoo d'ai mèka dua hari, te ngaa èu pasili le ja'a tèlu hari, peka na, èu tadhe boe ja'a!

source_text: but kefa kept saying with vehemence, if it is necessary for me to die al kiddush ha-shem for you, by no means will i make hakhchashah of you. and so also everyone declared.
target_text: ka petrus pajèka dènge ne, peka na, aad'o sèmi èèna, ama! ladhe ama madhe, ja'a madhe dènge ama kahèi. te ngaa ja'a pasili boe ama, aa rai eele boe! angalai petrus sèra lii èci èèna kahèi.

source_text: and they come to a place of which the name was gat-shmanim and rebbe, melech hamoshiach says to his talmidim, sit down here while i daven.
