source_text: therefore, produce p'ri tov l'teshuva fruit worthy of repentance, and do not begin to presume within yourselves, saying, we have the zechut avot merit of the fathers of avraham avinu, for, i say to you, that hashem is able from these avanim stones to raise up banim to avraham avinu.
target_text: mage miu pangee na, ‘ja'a ne lèke boe huku, lula ja'a ana-èpu baki abraham. ' abhu ètu mia sèmi èèna? j'aj'i ana-èpu abraham bisa boe tao miu j'aj'i dhèu mola-mèci. lamatua bisa tao hadhu se, sèna ka j'aj'i ana-èpu abraham. ja'a peka kèna! pad'elo ètu d'ara mamuri miu, dhu peka na, miu tèke eele le sasala-sasigo miu, aa mai ho madhutu lamatua.

source_text: and already the ax is laid at the shoresh haetzim the root of the trees. therefore, every etz not producing pri tov is cut down and is thrown into the eish.
target_text: miu hud'i tao ku j'ara be'a. ladhe aad'o, na, hahuku lamatua dhu bia, bèbhe mai lèke miu, nuka sèmi dhèu pake kataka ho patue aj'u nèti amo na. nuka sèmi èèna ka! aj'u dènge boe guna, ladhe hua-hela na nèti boe babe'a! de be'a risi patue ne, aa core eele asa d'ara ai la'e.

source_text: and the multitudes were questioning him, saying, what then should we do?
target_text: hèia dhèu ae karèi yohanis, ladhe sèmi èèna, ji'i se tasamia?

source_text: and in reply, yochanan was saying to them, let the one having two kaftans share with the one having none, and let the one having okhel food do likewise.
target_text: ka na dhaa, peka na, ladhe èu dènge kodho dua bèla, hia èci sa dhèu dhu dènge boe kodho. aa ladhe èu dènge nganga'a, bagi hia dhèu dhu dènge boe nganga'a.

source_text: now came also mochesim tax collectors to receive the tevilah of teshuva, and they said to him, rabbi, what should we do?
target_text: hèia dhèu roro bea mai manèngi kahèi, sèna ka yohanis sarani si. ka ra karèi, peka na, ama mese! ji'i se hud'i tao sèmi ngaa ku?

source_text: and yochanan said to them, collect nothing more than the amount having been commanded you.
target_text: ka na dhaa, miu se d'èi kapod'e-kabèli. de nèti deo ne'e, miu hud'i sab'a ku dènge mola. baku roro bea risi nèti atora paredha. hud'i laa kabarai b'ae madhutu atora na.

source_text: and chaiyalim soldiers as well were asking him, what should we do also? and yochanan said to them, extort kesef from no one, and let there be no lashon hora, and be satisfied with your loin wages.
target_text: abhu kahèi sordad'u pèri-pèri ètu sèra. ra karèi, na, ji'i se hud'i tao ku sèmi ngaa? hèia yohanis b'ala, peka na, baku parama doi-dhari dhèu madhutu dad'èi miu. aa baku galaa leli dhèu. ladhe sèmi mere gaji, miu hud'i manèngi makasi mi lamatua, aa rasa d'ai le dènge gaji èèna.

source_text: as the am berit were filled with expectation, and all were wondering in their levavot hearts concerning yochanan, whether perhaps he might be the moshiach,
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare, dhèu se mulai pagagai aa paka'uu èci dènge èci, peka na, eeh! tao-tao yohanis ne, kristus, dhu lamatua peka karèi nèti uru ka, neo hia mai èèna!

source_text: yochanan answered everyone, saying, i give you a tevilah with a mikveh mayim, but hu habah he who comes has more chozek strength than me; i am not worthy to untie the strap of his sandals. he will give you a tevilah with the ruach hakodesh and with eish.
target_text: te ngaa yohanis b'ala si, peka na, nanene paie! bèli-camèd'a, dhèu èci mai dhu kapai risi nèti ja'a. masi ka j'aj'i ana pua-paleha na, ja'a ne bisa boe sa hèi. ja'a ne sarani miu dhoka pake èi di, te ngaa bèli-camèd'a na tao risi eele nèti ja'a, te na papènu d'ara miu dènge roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci. aa na pamèu d'ara miu nuka sèmi dhèu pake ai ho tunu maruru.

source_text: the winnowing fork is in his hand to clean out his threshing floor and to gather the wheat into his storehouse, but the motz chaff he will burn up with an eish lo tikhbeh fire not ever extinguished.
target_text: na huku dhèu dhu ad'u-ue sasala, tao si cakaraa dhèu sab'a oka, dhu patiri are ho ngèlu tiu eele kètu na. èle ku, heka soli are dhu mèu asa d'ara soka, aa kètu dènge kaj'alu are sèra, tunu pakèpu si. nuka sèmi èèna kahèi, bèli-camèd'a kristus huku dhèu dhu ad'u-ue sasala, dènge j'ara pèci si asa d'ara ai dhu heo robhe-robhe dhu madhe nèdhi boe.

source_text: therefore, with many other devarim yochanan was exhorting them, preaching the besuras hageulah to the am berit.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e yohanis pasanèd'e dhèu nèti rupa-rupa madha j'ara, aa lole dènge ra lii lolo be'a lamatua.

source_text: now herod the tetrarch, when he was reproved by yochanan about herodias, the wife of his brother, and about all resha'im evil which he did, herod added this above all: he locked up yochanan in the beit hasohar prison.
target_text: taa èèna, yohanis padhai lii pahuni heka, j'ara-j'ara dhu herodes ad'u-ue. lii langu herodes nuka sèmi ne'e ka: herodes ne, gubernur ètu propensi galilea. sasala na udhu sèmi kadhèna hèru hadhu sa. sasala na èci ka, parame nare herodias, dhèu èmu ari na, masi ka ari na mamuri era, dhu dhae pa'ia mèka. j'ara mamuri herodes sèmi ne'e, ka yohanis kai dènge madha na, toke herodes nasa dènge ne. nèti èèna ka, herodes kèpe ne, hèia pamaso asa d'ara èmu bèdho.

source_text: and it came about while all the am berit were receiving the tevilah, and when yehoshua also had been given the tevilah and was davening, shomayim was opened,
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o dhu ra kèpe mèka yohanis ne, nèngu sarani dhèu ae le. aa na sarani yesus kahèi. sarani èle, ka yesus sabaj'a, kabèdhi laa, liru bhoka eele.

source_text: and the ruach hakodesh descended in demut gashmit as a yonah upon rebbe, melech hamoshiach; and then came a bat kol out of shomayim, saying, atah bni ahuvi asher bcha chafatsti.
target_text: hèia roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci puru mai sa yesus. roh ne rupa na sèmi koro j'aha sa. hèia lii nèti dedha-liru peka na, èu ne, ana pasue ja'a. èu ne, loe boe pakarej'e d'ara ja'a.

source_text: and yehoshua himself was about shaloshim shanah, at the beginning of his avodas kodesh ministry, being the ben as it was being thought of yosef ben eli,
target_text: lod'o yesus mulai lole dènge dhèu j'ara mamuri lamatua, umur na pe d'ai tèlu nguru tèu sa. dhèu tadhe yesus ne, ana nèti yusuf. bèi-baki yusuf sèmi ne'e: yusuf, ama na, eli.

source_text: ben mattat, ben levi, ben malki, ben yannai, ben yosef,
target_text: eli, ama na, matat. matat, ama na, lewi. lewi, ama na melki. melki, ama na, yanai. yanai, ama na, yusuf.

target_text: kenan, ama na, enos. enos, ama na, set. set, ama na, adam. adam ne'e ka, pa'ue-ai ama lamatua.

source_text: now rebbe melech hamoshiach, full of the ruach hakodesh, returned from the yarden, and was being led by the ruach hakodesh bamidbar,
target_text: ropa yohanis sarani nare yesus, hèia yesus la'e, tèke eele loko yarden. roh ama lamatua bera-bera dènge ne, ka pakako ne asa d'ara mamoo èci.

source_text: where for arba'im yom rebbe, melech hamoshiach was undergoing nisayon by hasatan. and he had no okhel in those yamim. and when the yamim had been completed, he was famished.
target_text: ka yesus pea ètu èèna toke èpa nguru lod'o. ètu era ne'e, na'a-ninu boe ngaa-ngaa, ka na manganga titu kèna. aa dhèu aae nidhu mai sèku ne.

source_text: and hasatan said to rebbe melech hamoshiach, if you are the ben haelohim, command this even stone that it become lechem.
target_text: na peka dènge yesus, aku nèngu na, ladhe èu ne tare'a ana ama lamatua, èu dènge koasa. de tao hadhu se j'aj'i roti, ho mu'a si.

source_text: and rebbe melech hamoshiach answered hasatan, it has been written, lo al halechem lvadoh ycheyeh haadam, not by bread alone will man live.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala ne, peka na, èu hari! me'a boe, do? dhu suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, peka na, ‘mamuri dhèu rai-haha, mesa boe dhoka nèti nganga'a-nganginu di! '

source_text: and hasatan led rebbe melech hamoshiach up and showed him, in a moment of time, all the mamlechot kingdoms of the olam hazeh; and hasatan said to him, to you i will give all this shilton rule, this shlita control, and their kavod, because it has been given to me; and to whomever i desire, i give it.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae nidhu nèti hari yesus asa era èci dhu dedha aae, hèia na paj'uj'u dènge yesus a'èra dènge koasa paredha aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. hèia na pamako yesus, na, a'èra dènge koasa paredha aa'i-aa'i sèra, ètu d'ara kacui-aai ja'a. de ja'a dènge hak ho pangèd'u mi cee èèna ka, sad'i ja'a ko'o.

source_text: therefore, if you will be koreia umishtachavehkneeling down and worship before me, everything will be yours.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i se, ja'a neo hia mi èu. te ngaa sad'i èu tao ku ca j'ara, heka ja'a hia èu kèna. mud'a iiki-iiki! èu pahaha iisi mi ja'a! dhoka èèna di.

source_text: and in reply, he said to hasatan, it has been written, es hashem eloheicha tirah voto taavodhashem eloheicha you shall fear and him alone you shall serve.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, abhu ètu mia j'ara na sèmi èèna? te ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, dhu suri, na, ‘èu dhoka pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua di. aa èu sogo-tagu dhoka mi nèngu di. '

source_text: and hasatan led him to yerushalayim and set him atop the pinnacle of the beis hamikdash, and said to him, if you are ben haelohim, throw yourself down from here;
target_text: èle ka, dhèu aae nidhu nèti hari yesus asa kota yerusalem. d'ai era ne'e, na paca'e yesus asa era dhu dedha risi ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ka na peka, ladhe tare'a-re'a èu ne ana ama lamatua, na, ridhu asa haha nèi!

source_text: for it has been written, malachav ytzavveh lach his angels he will command concerning you to protect you,
target_text: te dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, peka na, ‘pe ama lamatua pua ana pajuu na nèti sorga, ho mai j'aga èu.

source_text: and upon their hands they will lift you up, lest you strike your foot against a stone.
target_text: èèna na ra sibhe èu, sèna ka haga èu goi lèke boe hadhu sa hèi. '

source_text: and in reply, rebbe melech hamoshiach said to hasatan, it says, lo tenassu es hashem eloheichemdo not put to the test hashem your g-d.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala lii nidhu ne, èu baku karihu kahadhu dènge ja'a ne. lula dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, na, ‘baku sèku ama lamatua. '

source_text: and after rebbe, melech hamoshiach completed all nisayonos, hasatan went away from him until an opportune time.
target_text: dhèu aae nidhu ne tenge j'ara rupa-rupa ho sèku yesus, te ngaa tao nare boe. ka la'e tèke eele yesus, na mate hari lod'o dhu be'a.

source_text: and in the gevurat haruach hakodesh, rebbe melech hamoshiach returned to the galil. and a report went out throughout all the surrounding countryside about him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lèpa hari asa propensi galilea, te roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci hia ne koasa. nèbhu boe ka dhèu-dhèu ètu d'ara rai èèna, mulai tadhe kolongara na.

source_text: and rebbe melech hamoshiach was saying shiurim in their shuls and eliciting a peledike response reaction of marveling from everyone.
target_text: na aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi ètu mia-mia. ka dhèu koa-kio ne, peka na, yesus ne dhu ele madha, nga!

source_text: and he came to natzeret, the shtetl of his guddal and he entered according to his minhag on shabbos into the shul and was given an aliyah as the baal koreh.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus mai asa rae na nasaret. lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi, dhu ra pangare na ‘sabat', hèia la'e asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a sèmi dhu tema na tao. ka na kèd'i titu ho neo baca nèti sasuri ama lamatua.

source_text: after the hagbah, he was presented with the megillat sefer yeshayah and having unrolled the megillah, he found the dvar where it had been written,
target_text: ka ra j'ole hia ne sasuri nèti baki yesaya. hèia na bhoke tenge ayat, ka na baca, peka na,

source_text: ruach adonai hashem alai yaan mashach adonai oti levaser anavim shelachani likro lishvuyim deror, the spirit of the sovereign l-rd is upon me because he anointed me to preach besuras hageulah to the poor, he has sent me to preach to the captives release, and to the blind pekach koach, vshalach retzutzim chafshim, the recovery of sight, to set the oppressed free,
target_text: koasa roh ama lamatua abhu ètu ja'a. nèti èèna ka, na paj'uj'u ja'a, ho peka-padhai lii lolo be'a ama lamatua mi dhèu-dhèu dhu unu aad'o. nèngu pua le ja'a mai, ho lole, na, dhu ana bèdho, èèna na patalala si; dhu bèdhu, èèna na bisa rèdhi hari; dhu lèke ènyi nèti dhèu, èèna na patabuli eele.

source_text: likro shenat ratzon lahashem to preach the year of hashemʼs favor.
target_text: te limuri ne d'ai le lod'o lamatua, sèna ka pala mamuri mi dhèu unu na.

source_text: and doing the glilah ceremony, he rolled up the megillah; and, having given it back to the shammash, he sat down to teach. and all the eyes in the shul were focused on him.
target_text: baca nare sasuri ne, ka yesus lulu hari, hèia na j'ole asa ama dhu nèd'u kasasi, ka na madhèdi. dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a èèna ladhe patae ne.

source_text: and rebbe melech hamoshiach began to speak to them, hayom today this dvar of the kitvei hakodesh has been fulfilled in your hearing.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge ra, dhu miu tadèngi nèti sasuri ama lamatua deo na, ne'e ne, j'aj'i le!

source_text: and everyone was speaking well of him, and they were amazed at the divrei chen coming out of his mouth and they were saying, can this be ben yosef?
target_text: ka dhèu sèra mulai padhai lii padedha yesus, aku rèngu na, waa! ngaa dhu na padhai lii deo na, be'a titu kèna! te ngaa nèngu ne ana yusuf, si? tasamia ka na bisa sèmi ne'e ne?

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, muz zain no doubt you will speak this mashal to me: rofeh, heal yourself. everything we heard that happened in k'far-nachum, do also here in your shtetl.
target_text: hèia yesus lole dènge si, tatu miu tadèngi le lii dhu peka na, ‘wee, dote! puri uuru ku ngi'u èu! ' miu neo pake lii èèna, ho kabèli hari sa ja'a, peka na, ‘nga tao ka èu tao boe tadha malaa èci hia ji'i ètu ne'e, sèmi dhu èu tao le ètu kota kapernaum nèi? '

source_text: but he said, omein, i say to you that no navi is welcome in his own shtetl, in his own eretz moledet homeland.
target_text: mamola na sèmi ne'e: dhèu ro'o boe sèmi rare dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua nèti d'ara rae unu na.

source_text: omein, i tell you, there were many almanot in yisroel in the yamim of eliyahu hanavi, when shomayim was shut up for shalosh shanim and shishah chodashim three years and six months, when a great famine occurred over all the land, and to not one of them was eliyahu hanavi sent except to tzarfat of tzidon to an isha, an almanah.
target_text: tare conto nuka sèmi baki elia, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. ca tèka, èj'i mai boe tèlu tèu catenga. taa èèna, abhu bhèni balu ae ètu isra'el. te ngaa lamatua hia boe elia ho soru-bara si ètu isra'el sèra. lamatua dhoka pua la'e asa ca dhèu bhèni balu ètu rae sarfat, dhu dètu dènge kota sidon. masi ka bhèni ne dhèu yahudi boe, te ngaa na parcaya koasa ama lamatua.

source_text: and many metzoraim lepers were in yisroel during the time of elishah hanavi, and not one of them was cleansed except naaman the syrian.
target_text: tare hari conto leo nèti elisa, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. taa èèna, dhèu yahudi ae dhu lèke èi papèd'a kusta ètu isra'el. te ngaa lamatua pa'èle boe si nèti papèd'a ra. ama lamatua dhoka pua elisa la'e puri-pa'èle dhèu kusta èci, ngara na naaman, masi ka nèngu ne dhèu siria, dhèu yahudi boe. te ngaa na parcaya koasa ama lamatua.

source_text: and hearing these things, all in the shul were filled with ka'as anger.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi lii padhai lii yesus ne, hèia aa'i-aa'i ra nasa titu kèna dènge ne.

source_text: and they got up and drove rebbe melech hamoshiach outside the shtetl; and they led him up to the top of the hill upon which the shtetl had been built, and they were intending to throw him down.
target_text: ka ra kèd'i aa'i-aa'i, ra babège eele ne nèti d'ara èmu sabaj'a èèna. hèia ra nuni rèti ne asa karasa rae, ho neo tule ne nèti dedha tèbhi ètu èèna, asa haha la'e.

source_text: but having gone through the midst of them, rebbe, melech hamoshiach was walking away.
target_text: te ngaa na kako asa li'u la'e re talora aae rèngu, ka tèke eele si ètu era èèna.

source_text: and moshiach went down to k'far-nachum, a shtetl of the galil. and he was saying them shiurim on the shabbatot.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus puru la'e asa kota kapernaum ètu sebhe dano galilea. d'ai lod'o-lod'o sabaj'a, na aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and they were amazed at his torah, because rebbe melech hamoshiachʼs dvar torah was with samchut authority.
target_text: dhèu sèra malaa ladhe ra nanene lii padhai na, te ne'a mèu isi lii holo-nori sèra.

source_text: and in the shul there was a man having a ruach hatameh unclean spirit, shed, demon and it let out a shrai scream.
target_text: ca tèka, ropa yesus aj'a-nori ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, abhu ca dhèu dhu nidhu tao, na pa'oo-parodha, peka na,

source_text: ah, mah lanu vlach, yehoshua of natzeret? did you come to destroy us? i have daas of who you are, hakadosh of hashem.
target_text: ee! yesus, dhèu nasaret! èu neo tao ngaa mi ji'i? èu mai sèna ka palaho ji'i, do? ji'i se tadhe èu. èu ne, dhèu mola, dhu uru èèna ama lamatua pajaji tèke ho hia mai.

source_text: and rebbe melech hamoshiach rebuked him saying, sha! shekit! and come out of him! and right in front of them, when the shed threw him down, the ruach hatameh came out of him and did not do him any harm.
target_text: te ngaa yesus jèke ne, peka na, rèno laa! hutu hèb'a èu na! kalua ka nèti dhèu ne'e! cag'ag'a laa, nidhu ded'e kalabhe dhèu ne asa rai, ètu talora aae dhèu sèra. ropa pabèbhe nare, hèia nidhu ne kalua tèke eele aa papèd'a boe isi dhèu ne hèi.

source_text: and astonishment came upon everyone. and they were talking to one another saying, what is this dvar torah, for with samchut authority and koach power he commands the ruchot hatemeiot unclean spirits and they come out!
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i malaa-maloha, ka ra peka na, ira ii! lii padhai dhèu ne'e, dènge koasa kapai bia! toke nidhu madhutu paredha na kahèi, ka kalua nèti dhèu!

source_text: and a report was going out about him into every place of the surrounding region.
target_text: hèia lii lolo lula-nèti yesus pale-lème rai èèna aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach got up from the shul and entered into the bais of shim'on. and the chamot mother-in-law, shviger of shim'on was fever-stricken, and they asked him about her.
target_text: lod'o rèngu kalua nèti èmu sabaj'a, yesus la'e asa èmu dhèu èci, ngara na simon. lod'o èèna, teto na dhu pèd'a maringi-sagoro isi pana bia. hèia ra manèngi yesus, peka na, ama! puri-pa'èle ku bhèni heka ne, laa!

source_text: and having stood over her, rebbe melech hamoshiach rebuked the kaddachatfever and it left her. and at once, having got up, she was functioning as their mesharetet servant, keli kodesh, lady minister.
target_text: ka yesus la'e titu ètu sebhe koi, ka puri papèd'a bhèni heka ne. cag'ag'a laa, èi papèd'a na ele dènge ka. hèia na kèd'i la'e lalau nganga'a hia si ra'a-rinu.

source_text: and while the shemesh sun was setting, all who had cholim sick people, all with various machlot illnesses brought them to rebbe melech hamoshiach. and he, laying his hands upon each one of them, was giving refuah healing to them.
target_text: ètu d'ara lod'o nihia èèna kahèi, ropa lod'o oe cèna, dhèu lere rèti dhèu pèd'a ae-ae mai asa yesus. èi papèd'a ra rupa-rupa. hèia na bane ai mi dhèu pèd'a se'e, ka aa'i-aa'i ra èle nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: and also shedim were coming out from many, shrieking a shrai and crying out, you are haben haelohim! and rebuking them, he was not allowing them to speak, because they had daas of his identity as rebbe melech hamoshiach.
target_text: nèti dhèu pèd'a se abhu kahèi dhu nidhu tao. hèia yesus paredha nidhu se, sèna ka kalua nèti dhèu sèra. ra rai kalua dènge lii taraa, peka na, èu ne, ana ama lamatua! te nidhu se re'a, na, nèngu ne kristus, dhu ama lamatua pajaji karèi nèti uru ka, ho hia mai. nèti èèna ka, yesus kai si sèna ka bisa boe ra padhai ca hèb'a sa, lula-nèti nèngu.

source_text: and in the boker, having gone forth, he went out to a desolate place. and the multitudes were seeking him, and when they got to him, they wanted to prevent his departure from them.
target_text: asa bèli d'ara oe mèu sa, yesus kèd'i, ka la'e asa era dhu kaliu èci ètu li'u kota. hèia dhèu tenge ne asa mia-mia. ropa paraga dènge ne, ka ra pamako ne, aku rèngu na, ama pea ka dènge ji'i laa! lamu iia ka asa era leo!

source_text: but he said to them, it is necessary for me to preach the malchut hashem in the other shtetlach, because this is the tachlis for which i was sent.
target_text: te ngaa na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a hud'i laku asa rae-rae leo, ho peka-padhai lii lolo be'a nèti paredha ama lamatua. te ama lamatua pua ja'a mai ne, sèna ka pakako sasab'a èèna.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was preaching in the shuls of yehudah.
target_text: hèia na kako nèti rae èci asa rae leo, ho aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu-èmu sabaj'a ètu propensi yudea.

source_text: now it came about that while the multitude was listening to the dvar hashem and pressing in upon rebbe melech hamoshiach, he had been standing beside lake kinneret,
target_text: ca tèka, yesus aj'a dhèu ètu sebhe dano galilea. dhèu ae mai sèna ka neo nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua. rèngu mai toke ra kalibhu rare yesus.

source_text: and he saw two sirot boats having been beside the lake. but the daiyagim fishermen had left them and were cleaning the nets.
target_text: padètu dènge era èèna, abhu dhèu dhu pamèu pèku ra ètu dedha nebhe. ka yesus nèdhi koha dua bua dhu panahu ètu era èèna.

source_text: and embarking into one of the sirot which was shimonʼs, rebbe melech hamoshiach asked shim'on to put out from the land a little; and having sat down, from the sirah boat to the multitudes rebbe melech hamoshiach was saying shiurim.
target_text: cue nèti koha se, unu simon. èle ka, yesus ca'e asa dedha koha ne, ka na manèngi sèna ka simon tob'e asa era marèma ciki. hèia na madhèdi ho aj'a dhèu ae sèra.

source_text: and when he stopped speaking, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to shim'on, launch out into the deep water and let down your nets for a catch.
target_text: aj'a nare, hèia na padhai lii dènge simon, peka na, simon! padedha hari ku asa d'ara marèma, ho core pèku la'a. te èèna na miu abhu i'a ae.

source_text: and in reply, shim'on said, adoni, throughout the whole lailah we have labored and caught nothing. but on account of your dvar i will let down the nets.
target_text: ka simon dhaa, peka na, te ngaa, ama. ji'i sab'a d'ai madhe d'ara camèd'a kateme kèna, te abhu boe ci'u sa hèi! te ngaa lula ama ku peka le sèmi èèna, ja'a madhutu! ja'a papuru sèku.

source_text: and having done this, they enclosed asach a lot of dagim, and their nets were being torn.
target_text: hèia ra papuru pèku. ropa ra neo ère paca'e hari, re'a boe na pèku ne dhu pènu dènge i'a, ka mulai mae.

source_text: and they signaled for their shuttafim partners in the other sirah to come and help them. and they came and they filled both sirot boats so much that they began to sink.
target_text: hèia simon rodhe angalai na ètu koha leo sèra, ho mai bara rèngu ère pèku. ka ra da'u i'a tao asa d'ara koha, toke koha dua bua se pènu dènge i'a, ka oe cène.

source_text: and having seen this, shim'on kefa fell down before rebbe melech hamoshiach, saying, depart from me, adoni, for an ish choteh sinful man am i. for astonishment seized shim'on kefa and all the ones with him on account of the catch of dagim which they took; and likewise also ya'akov and yochanan the banim of zavdai, who were business shuttafim partners with shim'on. and rebbe melech hamoshiach said to shim'on, do not be afraid. from now on you will catch bnei adam.
target_text: angalai simon se, nuka yakobis dènge yohanis, ana nèti sabadeus, ètu era èèna kahèi. rèngu se malaa, lula ra abhu i'a ae titu kèna. ropa simon petrus ladhe nèdhi ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne, hèia na patitu dènge ka, kètu urutuu na ètu madha yesus, hèia na peka, ja'a ne, ca dhèu dhu ue le sasala ae-ae. de be'a risi, lamatua padètu ia ka dènge ja'a. te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, simon! pangee ia ka j'ara ne'e, te ja'a neo pake miu se. miu tema le tenge i'a. te ngaa deo ne'e ne, ja'a aj'a miu sèna ka tenge dhèu ho madhutu ja'a.

source_text: and having left behind the sirot on the shore, they forsook all, and followed him.
target_text: èle ka, rèngu nuni dènge ka koha ra asa dedha nebhe. ka lasi tèke eele ka ngaa-ngaa ra aa'i-aa'i, lasi madhutu yesus.

source_text: and it came about, while he was in one of the shtetlach, hinei, there was an ish metzorah full of leprosy. and having seen rebbe melech hamoshiach, and having fallen on his face, he begged him saying, adoni, if you are willing, you are able to make me tahor clean.
target_text: ètu rae èci, yesus paraga dènge ca dhèu dhu ngi'u na pènu dènge èi papèd'a kusta. ropa dhèu ne nèdhi yesus, ka la'e patitu kètu urutuu na, aa na pacud'u d'ai rai. hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, ama! sue ku ja'a laa! te ja'a ke'a, na, ama bisa puri-pa'èle papèd'a ja'a ne, sèna ka dhèu madenge ia ka dènge ja'a. sad'i ama mo'o.

source_text: and having stretched out his hand, rebbe, melech hamoshiach touched him, saying, i am willing. be made tahor. and, ofen ort immediately, the leprosy departed from him.
target_text: ka yesus j'ole kacui-aai na ho g'ag'e ne. aa na peka, ja'a ko'o! èu èle dènge kèna! ropa na padhai lii nare, èi papèd'a dhèu ne èle dènge.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach gave orders to him to tell no one, but go and show yourself to the kohen and make a korban for your tohorah purification as moshe rabbeinu gave mitzvah; do this for an edut solemn testimony to them.
target_text: hèia yesus pasanèd'e ne, peka na, baku bhèlu, ee! èu èle le, te ngaa baku peka dènge dhèu èci sa! èu hud'i madhutu uuru ku paredha baki musa. de lamu asa ama agama, ho na parisa ngi'u èu, sèna ka ne'a èi papèd'a ne èle tare'a, do dhae. èle èèna na, èu hia mèdha èci sèmi tadha makasi, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a, èu ne èle tare'a le nèti papèd'a.

source_text: but the man was spreading even more the dvar about rebbe, melech hamoshiach, and many multitudes were assembling to listen and to receive refuah healing from their machlot illnesses.
target_text: masi ka yesus kai, te ngaa lii lolo nèti koasa na, pale-lème nèti dhèu èci asa èci d'ai mia-mia. ka dhèu mai sèmi tao cèci sa, ho ra nanene na aj'a-nori. hèia na puri-pa'èle dhèu ae nèti rupa-rupa èi papèd'a ra.

source_text: but rebbe, melech hamoshiach was withdrawing in hitbodedut seclusion, aloneness with g-d into the wilderness places and was davening.
target_text: te ngaa catèka-catèka, yesus d'èi kahèi patalele iisi, ho la'e manèngi-mangaj'i asa era dhu kaliu.

source_text: and it came about, on one of the yamim when he was teaching torah, that the perushim and sofrim had come from every shtetl of the galil and yehudah and yerushalayim and were sitting by. and the power of hashem was with rebbe melech hamoshiach to bring refuah healing.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus aj'a dhèu ètu d'ara èmu cue. lod'o èèna, abhu kahèi dhèu nèti partei agama parisi, dènge pèri-pèri mese agama, mai ho nanene lii padhai na. dhèu se mai nèti rae-rae ètu propensi galilea, propensi yudea, dènge kota yerusalem. ama lamatua hia yesus koasa, sèna ka pa'èle dhèu-dhèu pèd'a.

source_text: and hinei, anashim were carrying on a mat a man who had been paralyzed, and they were seeking to carry in the paralytic and to place him before rebbe melech hamoshiach. and not having found by what way they might carry him, because of the multitude, and having gone up onto the roof, they let the man down with the mat through the tiles so that he was right in the center in front of rebbe melech hamoshiach.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu pèri-pèri ded'e rèti dhèu karuku èci ètu dedha karad'a. rèngu tenge-tenge j'ara, sèna ka yesus puri-pa'èle ne. te ngaa ètu d'ara èmu ne, dhèu sèmi tao cacèci sa, ka rèngu bisa boe pasuki asa d'ara. nèti èèna ka, ra ded'e dhèu ne asa kolo èmu. rare dedha, ka ra bèdi eele rèu èmu, sèna ka tao ro'a, ho dulu dhèu karuku ne dènge karad'a kateme asa haha la'e. ra dulu dhèu ne'e asa talora aae dhèu ae-ae se, lèke mola-mola ètu madha yesus.

source_text: and having seen their emunah, rebbe melech hamoshiach said, ben adam, your chatta'im sins have received selicha forgiveness.
target_text: ropa nèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia yesus ne'a, na, rèngu se parcaya, na, nèngu bisa pa'èle angalai ra nèti karuku na. ka na lii dènge dhèu karuku ne, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! ja'a saku pamèu le sasala èu.

source_text: and the sofrim began to raise kashes questions, and also the perushim, saying, who is this who is speaking chillul hashem gidduf? who is able to grant selicha to chatta'im but hashem alone?
target_text: ropa tadèngi yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna, ka dhèu parisi dènge mese agama sèra, pakarèi, na, eeh! dhoka ama lamatua dhu dènge hak di, ho saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu. cee ka nèngu ne, ka na tao iisi na nuka sèmi ama lamatua! ne'e ne pa'ele iie kolongara lamatua!

source_text: but he having had daas of their machshavot thoughts, said to them in reply, why are you reasoning in your levavot?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a d'ai d'ara rèngu. hèia na peka, nga tao ka miu se ngee, na, ja'a ne padhai lii pa'ele iie kolongara lamatua?

source_text: which is easier: to say, your chatta'im have been granted selicha, or to say, get up and walk? but in order that you may have da'as that the bar enosh has samchut on haaretz to grant selicha to chatta'im, rebbe melech hamoshiach said to the one having been paralyzed, to you i say, get up, pick up your mat, and go to your bais house, home.
target_text: ja'a ne dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. aa ja'a ne dènge hak kahèi, ho abho sasala-sasigo dhèu. ladhe ja'a lii dènge dhèu karuku ne, ‘ja'a abho le sasala èu, ' miu mèdhi boe koasa ja'a ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa ladhe ja'a peka na, ‘kèd'i ka! ded'e karad'a èu, ho lèpa ka. ' ladhe nèngu kèd'i dènge ka, na, miu heka mèdhi koasa ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo puri-pa'èle dhèu karuku ne, sèna ka miu me'a, na, ja'a dènge hak ho abho sasala-sasigo dhèu. ka na piku asa dhèu karuku ne, aa lii, peka na, titu ka! ded'e karad'a èu, ho lèpa ka!

source_text: and at once the man arose in front of them, picked up the mat upon which he was lying, and departed to his bais, shouting, baruch hashem!
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, dhèu ne kèd'i titu ètu madha dhèu ae sèra, ka kèpe nare karad'a na. hèia na lèpa ka dènge koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: and astonishment seized everyone, and they were shouting, baruch hashem! and they were filled with yirat shomayim, saying, hayom today our eyes have beheld niflaot wonders!
target_text: rèdhi sèmi èèna, ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i se malaa. ka ra ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua, peka na, lamatua kapai risi eele! deo ne'e ne, èdhi tèdhi le dènge musi madha èdhi unu ti, tadha malaa dhu kapai!

source_text: and after these things rebbe melech hamoshiach went out and saw a moches tax collector named levi sitting in the tax office, and he said to him, follow me.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka yesus kalua nèti d'ara èmu, hèia ladhe nèdhi dhèu roro bea ca dhèu, dhu madhèdi ètu era roro doi bea. ngara dhèu ne, lewi. ka yesus peka dènge ne, mai ka madhutu ja'a!

source_text: and having forsaken all and having got up, levi was following rebbe melech hamoshiach.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii paroa ne, hèia lewi kèd'i dènge ka, tèke eele aa'i-aa'i sèra, la'e madhutu yesus.

source_text: and levi arranged a large seudah in his bais for rebbe melech hamoshiach, and there was a great number of mochesim and others who were with them, reclining at tish.
target_text: èle ka, lewi tao tatao kapai ètu èmu na, ka na nèru yesus. aa na nèru kahèi angalai na dhèu roro bea sèra, dènge tamu-tamu dhu leo ho lasi ra'a-rinu.

source_text: and the perushim and their sofrim were murmuring against rebbe melech hamoshiachʼs talmidim, saying, why with the mochesim and chote'im are you eating and drinking?
target_text: te ngaa pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama parisi, dènge mese-mese agama, ka'uu-kamuki mi ana madhutu yesus, aku rèngu na, tasamia ka miu mi'a-minu pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu laku boe, nuka dhèu roro bea, dènge dhèu karehe sèra? dhèu be'a bisa boe pa'èci dènge dhèu sèmi sèra sa!

source_text: and in reply, rebbe melech hamoshiach said to them, it is not the bariim who have need of a rofeh, but the cholim sick persons;
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge rèngu, peka na, dhèu pèd'a parluu dote-matarii. te ngaa dhu pèd'a boe, parluu boe.

source_text: i have not come to call the tzaddikim but chote'im sinners to teshuva repentance.
target_text: mamai ja'a ne, ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu karehe sèra. te ngaa ja'a mai boe ho uri dhèu dhu ngee na, ngi'u ra mola le.

source_text: but they said to rebbe, melech hamoshiach, yochananʼs talmidim undergo tzomot fasts often and offer tefillos; likewise also the ones of the perushim; but your talmidim eat and drink.
target_text: hèia dhèu nèti partei agama parisi dènge mese-mese agama ka'ugu mi yesus, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama! ana madhutu yohanis tuka sarani dhèu, rèngu tema puasa dènge sabaj'a. ana-ana madhutu dhèu parisi sèmi èèna kahèi. te ngaa tasamia ka, ana madhutu ama sèra, loe boe dènge ra'a-rinu? rèngu se re'a boe puasa, do?

source_text: but rebbe melech hamoshiach said to them, you are not able to make the bnei hachuppah undergo tzomot while the choson is with them, are you?
target_text: ka na dhaa pake lii pakasame, aku nèngu na, miu me'a le, ladhe dhèu tao pesta kab'i, dhèu-dhèu dhu ra nèru sèra, bisa boe puasa, te ngaa ra'a toke bècu. ladhe mone dhu kab'i èèna, dènge rèngu era, tatu rèngu ra'a palere aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: but yamim will come when the choson is taken away from them; then, in those yamim, they will undergo tzomot.
target_text: te ngaa ropa dhèu leo rai rèti mone dhu kab'i ne, hèia angalai na susa, heka ra puasa kèna.

source_text: now rebbe, melech hamoshiach was telling also a mashal to them: no one tears a piece from a new garment, and sews it as a patch on an old garment. otherwise, both the new will be torn, and the patch from the new will not match the old.
target_text: hèia yesus padhai lii pakasame èci hari, peka na, abhu mèka dhèu dhu rare bèla hiu ca'èta, ho kalape mi kodho dhui dhu mae. te ladhe base kodho ne, bèla hiu dhu kalape la'a èèna karuku, na kodho ne asa mae aae.

source_text: and no one puts yayin chadash new wine into old wineskins; otherwise, the new wine will burst the wineskins, it will be spilled, and the wineskins will be destroyed. rather, yayin chadash must be put into new wineskins.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, dhua dhu heka rèti nèti kapua, dhèu bhori boe asa sabha dhui. te aad'o na, sabha madhore eele, aa dhua èèna soli soo-soo asa rai la'e. de dhua dhu hiu, hud'i bhori ku asa d'ara sabha hiu. sèmi èèna ka, yesus aj'a si, peka na, lii aj'a na dhu hiu bisa boe pab'ali dènge lii aj'a dhu dhui nèti dhèu parisi.

source_text: and no one having drunk the old desires the chadash new, for he says, the alter old is besere better.
target_text: dhèu dhu rinu rèdhi le èi anggor dhui, d'èi boe rinu dhu hiu. te dhu re'a na, ‘èi anggor dhu kee risi nuka èi anggor dhui! '

source_text: and it came about on shabbos that the moshiach is passing through grain fields, and his talmidim were plucking and eating the heads of grain and rubbing them in their hands.
target_text: ca tèka, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, kako re j'ara ètu sebhe oka dhèu. ka ana madhutu na puru are-gandum dhu ètu madha rèngu sèra. hèia ra sarod'e d'ara kacui-aai, ka ra'a.

source_text: now some of the perushim said, why are you doing what is asur impermissible on shabbos?
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama parisi dhu kèpe pa'èra ad'a yahudi ra. ropa ladhe rèdhi ana madhutu yesus tao sèmi èèna, ka ra kai ne, peka na, tasamia ka ana-ana èu se sisu atora agama èdhi? rèngu sab'a lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a! ladhe ku laa! rèngu puru are-gandum nèi. baku tao sèmi èèna!

source_text: and in reply, rebbe melech hamoshiach said to them, have you not read what dovid hamelech did when he and those with him were hungry, how he entered into the beit hashem and took the lechem hapanim the bread of the presence, and he ate and gave to the ones with him, which is mutar permissible to eat only by the kohanim?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala, peka na, tasamia, ee? miu sanèd'e lii lolo baki daud? daud dènge dhèu madhutu na lula manganga ae, ka maso lasi asa d'ara paleo manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. hèia ra'e roti dhu ama agama hia le lamatua. te ngaa roti se'e dhodhoka ama agama di dhu bisa ra'e. dhèu leo bisa boe. ka baki daud si ra'e, te ngaa ca dhèu sa peka boe, na, rèngu sale. miu se, sèmi baca mèdhi boe sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua!

source_text: and he was saying to them, the bar enosh is adon hashabbos.
target_text: pasa dhilu ho nanene paie-iie! ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a dènge hak ho pama'ète, na, dhèu bisa sab'a ngaa, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a.

source_text: and it came about on another shabbos that rebbe, melech hamoshiach entered into the shul and taught torah. and there was a man there also whose right hand was withered.
target_text: ca tèka, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a dhu leo, yesus la'e aj'a ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. ètu era èèna, abhu dhèu mone èci, dhu ai madhe cabèka.

source_text: now the sofrim and perushim were watching rebbe, melech hamoshiach to see if he brings refuah on shabbos, in order that they might find something to accuse him.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu kahèi pèri-pèri mese agama, dènge dhèu nèti partei agama parisi, dhu tenge j'ara ho pamanahu yesus. ra tatae, tao-tao na neo puri-pa'èle dhèu dhu ai madhe cabèka ne, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu bisa abhu j'ara ho galaa ne ètu madha dhèu ae.

source_text: but he knew their machshavot thoughts, and said to the man having the withered hand, rise and stand in the midst. and the man got up and stood.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a ngangee rèngu. nèti èèna ka, na paroa dhèu dhu ai madhe cabèka ne, aku nèngu na, angalai! mai ku. titu ètu talora aae ne! hèia la'e titu dènge ka ètu talora èèna.

source_text: and rebbe melech hamoshiach said to them, i ask you whether it is mutar on shabbos to do hatov or to do harah, to save nefesh or destroy it?
target_text: ka yesus karèi dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra, peka na, ja'a karèi ku miu laa. madhutu atora agama èdhi, ngaa dhu èdhi bisa tao ètu lod'o a'ae sasab'a? èdhi tao dhu be'a, do, tao dhu karehe? hia mamuri mi dhèu, do, pa'ele iie mamuri na?

source_text: and having looked around at all of them, he said to the man, stretch out your hand. and he did. and his hand was restored.
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe palème rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, ka na lii dènge dhèu dhu ai madhe cabèka ne, peka na, j'ole ai èu mai! ka na soro ai na, hèia èle dènge ka.

source_text: but they the sofrim and the perushim were filled with ka'as anger, and they were discussing with one another what they might do to him.
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, ka dhèu kapai se nasa titu kèna. hèia ra peka, na, èdhi tenge hari ku j'ara leo, sèna ka pamanahu ne!

source_text: now it came about in those yamim that rebbe melech hamoshiach went forth to the mountain to daven, and he was spending the whole night b'tefillah to hashem.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, yesus la'e sabaj'a asa ledhe èci. na sabaj'a ètu èèna camèd'a kateme.

source_text: and when boker came, rebbe melech hamoshiach summoned his talmidim, and chose from them shneym asar twelve, whom he also named shlichim:
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae, yesus paroa ana madhutu na. ka nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, hag'e nare canguru dua dhèu ho j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na. dhèu dhu hag'e nare sèra, nuka:

source_text: shim'on, whom also he called kefa; andrew his brother; ya'akov, yochanan, philippos, bar-talmai,
target_text: simon dhu yesus pangare ne, ‘petrus' anderias ari simon, yakobis, yohanis ari yakobis, pelipus, bertolomeos,

source_text: mattityahu, t'oma, ya'akov ben-chalfai, shim'on, the one being called the zealot,
target_text: mateos, tomas, yakobis ana alpius, simon nèti partei politik selot,

source_text: yehudah ben ya'akov, and yehudah from k'riot, who became the boged traitor, betrayer of rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: yudas ana yakobis, aa yudas iskariot dhu èèna na pahia yesus.

source_text: and having come down with them, he stood on a level place, and a great multitude of his talmidim, and a great multitude of the am berit from all yehudah and yerushalayim and the coastal region of tzor and tzidon,
target_text: ropa puru mai nèti ledhe deo na, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, ae taha ètu era mera èci. ètu èèna, abhu dhèu ae dhu pakaboko. dhèu se mai nèti propensi yudea, nèti kota yerusalem, aa nèti tirus dènge sidon, nuka dua kota ètu sebhe dhasi.

source_text: came to hear him and to receive refuah healing from their machlot illnesses, and the ones being troubled by ruchot hatemeiot unclean spirits, shedim were given refuah,
target_text: rèngu mai ho nanene lii padhai yesus, aa abhu kahèi dhu neo manèngi sèna ka na puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a. ka yesus pa'èle si. na pa'èle kahèi dhèu dhu nidhu tao, dènge magèle eele nidhu nèti dhèu sèra.

source_text: and all were seeking to touch rebbe, melech hamoshiach because koach power was going out from him, and he was giving refuah to everyone.
target_text: dhèu ae dhu neo goi ne. te ropa goi lèke ne, dhèu se èle dènge nèti papèd'a ra, lula abhu koasa dhu kalua nèti nèngu.

source_text: and lifting up his eyes to look at his talmidim, rebbe melech hamoshiach said, ashrey are the aniyim poor, for yours is the malchut hashem.
target_text: èle ka yesus kabib'a asa ana madhutu na, hèia na aj'a si, aku nèngu na, dhèu unu aad'o sèra! miu abhu a'oto, lula ama lamatua mesa na, j'aj'i dhèu aae miu dhu be'a.

source_text: ashrey are the ones hungering now, for you will eat your fill. ashrey are the ones weeping now, for you will laugh.
target_text: dhèu dhu kabake manganga sèra! miu abhu a'oto, lula lamatua ka dhu hia miu bècu-manèsa. dhèu dhu tangi dènge d'ara susa sèra! miu abhu a'oto, lula èèna na d'ara mi karej'e.

source_text: ashrey are you when bnei adam have sinas chinom baseless hatred for you and when they ostracize you and they reproach you and cast out your name as rah evil on account of the bar enosh. have simcha in that day and leap for chedvah rejoicing, for your sachar reward is gadol in shomayim. according to the same their avot were doing to the neviim.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ka dhèu dhu abhu susa lula madhutu ja'a, miu abhu a'oto, lula èèna na lamatua b'ala rui-j'aj'èra miu ètu sorga. masi ka dhèu tèka d'ara dènge miu, do pakarehe kolongara miu, do j'èli marèu miu, do bata eele miu, tao sèmi dhèu bhelu sa, miu abhu a'oto, lula èèna na lamatua bhèlu boe miu ètu sorga. de ladhe dhèu paj'èra miu sèmi èèna, pakarej'e laa d'ara miu! aa karae laa dènge pasoa-pasoka! mage malaa kahèi, lula dhèu dhu paj'èra miu limuri ne, bèi-baki ra dhu uru èèna, paj'èra le dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua sèra kahèi. de ladhe miu paraga dènge j'aj'èra sèmi sèra, pakarej'e laa d'ara miu, lula èèna na lamatua b'ala hia miu ae-ae ètu sorga!

source_text: but oy to you, you ashirim, for you have already received in full your nechamah comfort.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu kaja! miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula mamuri karej'e miu, dhoka d'ai ne'e di.

source_text: oy to you, the ones having been well fed now, for you will hunger. oy, the ones laughing now, for you will mourn and weep.
target_text: dhèu dhu bècu-manèsa! miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula hèru manganga madèu dhu seli eele, mai salake nare miu. dhèu dhu kea rae-rae sèra! miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula j'aj'èra mai, tao miu tangi ngob'i-ngob'i.

source_text: woe when all bnei adam speak well of you. for according to the same things were their avot doing to the neviei hasheker false prophets.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'èi dhèu koa-kad'iri! miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula uru sèra bèi-baki miu d'èi pad'iri kahèi dhèu-dhèu dhu rèti lii leko-monya sèra!

source_text: but to you i say, to the ones listening, show ahavah to your oyvim enemies, do mitzvahs for the ones with sinas chinom for you,
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, pasa dhilu ho nanene paie-iie! èu hud'i sue ku musu èu, aa tao pabe'a laa mi dhèu dhu tèka d'ara dènge èu.

source_text: say a bracha for the ones cursing you, daven for the ones mistreating you.
target_text: sabaj'a ho manèngi ama lamatua, sèna ka hia babe'a mi dhèu dhu dhoo èu. aa manèngi sèna ka lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu dhu paj'èra èu rupa-rupa.

source_text: to the one hitting you on the cheek, offer also the other, and from the one taking away your kaftan coat, also the tunic and gartel do not withhold.
target_text: ladhe dhèu tèb'e ripi èu cabèka, soro hari ripi cabèka ho na tèb'e. ladhe dhèu parame rare kodho pana èu, na, hia hari laa kodho èu dhu leo.

source_text: to everyone asking you, give tzedakah; and from the one taking away your things, do not demand them back.
target_text: ladhe dhèu manèngi mèdha èu èci, hia laa. aa ladhe dhèu ded'e rèti mèdha èu èci, soro tèke sène. mage mu manèngi hari!

source_text: and just as you want that bnei adam may do to you, do to them similarly.
target_text: èu hud'i tao ku dhèu leo, nuka sèmi èu neo dhèu tao mi ngi'u èu.

source_text: and if you show ahavah to the ones showing ahavah to you, what kind of shvakh commendation to you is that? for even the chote'im sinners show ahavah to the ones showing ahavah to them.
target_text: èu d'èi pad'elo sasue mi dhèu èu mesa mu. èèna be'a. te ngaa kolo-karisi na ngaa? te dhèu bhelu sue dhèu rèngu kahèi.

source_text: for even if you do mitzvahs for the ones doing mitzvahs for you, what kind of shvakh to you is that?
target_text: ladhe èu pabe'a dhoka dènge dhèu dhu be'a dènge èu di, kolo-karisi ètu mia? te dhèu bhelu sèra, re'a b'ala babe'a dhèu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: and if you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what kind of shvakh to you is that? even chote'im lend to chote'im, that they receive in return the same amount.
target_text: ladhe èu dhodhoka hia pija mi dhèu dhu bisa pula hari doi èu, kolo-karisi na ngaa? te dhèu bhelu kahèi re'a hia dhèu leo pija doi, sad'i bèli-camèd'a sèmi aa'i hari dhu kateme iisi.

source_text: but show ahavah to your oyvim and do mitzvahs and gemilut chasadim, expecting nothing in return. and your sachar will be rav. and you will be bnei elyon sons of the most high, because he is kind to anashim ra'im and those without hodayah.
target_text: te ngaa dhu lèke ka, sèmi ne'e: sue la musu èu sèra! aa tao la be'a mi rèngu. ngaa dhu ra parluu, hia si pija. baku pangee, na, ra pula hari do aad'o. dènge j'ara ne, èèna na ama lamatua b'ala èu. pe èu j'aj'i ana nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele. lula mamuri èu sama sèmi ama mu, dhu d'èi ad'u-ue j'ara hua iia hia dhèu bhelu. nèngu d'èi kahèi tao j'ara hua iia hia dhèu dhu re'a boe manèngi makasi.

source_text: be anashim of rachamanut compassion, just as also your elohim haav is merciful.
target_text: de èu hud'i pad'elo ku kasia mi dhèu, nuka sèmi ama mu ètu sorga dhu pad'elo kasia na mi èu.

source_text: judge not, lest you be judged. and do not condemn, and by no means may you be condemned. if you pardon with mechila forgiveness, you will be pardoned with selicha forgiveness.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii aj'a na, peka na, baku lee dhèu, sèna ka dhèu baku lee hari èu. baku kahèti leli lii padhai dhèu, te aad'o na dhèu tao hari èu sèmi èèna kahèi. pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu, sèna ka rèngu baku nui sasala èu.

source_text: give, and it will be given to you. a good measure, having been pressed down and having been shaken, overflowing, will be put into your kheyk lap. for by what measure you measure it will be measured in return to you.
target_text: ladhe èu hia dhèu ngaa dhu ra parluu, pe èu abhu hari. te bèli-camèd'a ra hia hari èu pènu ai. èèna, nuka sèmi dhèu isi kab'ui asa d'ara balee a'uku, ka ra karèko ne, aa cèci ne, toke bua lale eele. dhu èu abhu, sama èci èèna ka. ladhe èu hia ciki, èu abhu hari ciki kahèi. te ngaa ladhe èu hia ae, èu abhu hari ae-ae.

source_text: now he told also a mashal to them. surely an ivver is not able to guide an ivver, is he? will not both fall into a pit?
target_text: yesus aj'a pake lii upama kahèi. na lole, peka na, dhèu bèdhu bisa boe pad'elo j'ara hia dhèu bèdhu dhu leo. te aad'o na, dua ra manahu asa d'ara ro'a lasi!

source_text: a talmid is not above his moreh. but everyone, having been fully trained, will be like his moreh teacher.
target_text: ana sakola bisa boe mèu risi nèti mese na! te ngaa ladhe na madhutu dènge be'a lii a'aj'a mese na, nèngu bisa j'aj'i sama sèmi mese na.

source_text: and why do you see the speck in the eye of your ach, but the log in your own eye you do not notice?
target_text: èu pa'èki more sasala dhèu, masi ka ana iiki-iiki èèna ka. te ngaa sasala èu dhu kapai, èu sèmi pame'a boe sa. èèna, nuka sèmi èu mèdhi ahu ca katèd'a ètu musi madha dhèu. masi ka agarii aae dhu pa'abhe nare musi madha èu, te ngaa èu oe sèmi pame'a boe sa!

source_text: how are you able to say to your ach, ach, let me remove the speck in your eye, while you yourself are not seeing the log in your own eye? tzeva, remove first the log from your eye, and then you will see clearly to take out the speck from your ach b'moshiach.
target_text: tasamia ka èu bani peka dènge angalai mu, na, ‘mai, ho ja'a tiu eele ahu nèti d'ara madha èu. ' te ngaa èu mesa mu bisa boe ladhe mèdhi ngaa-ngaa, te agarii dhu pa'abhe nare musi madha èu! weeh! èu ne, mema dhèu kapod'e-kabèli! tao eele uru ku agarii nèti d'ara madha èu, heka èu ladhe mèdhi, ho tiu eele ahu ca katèd'a èèna, nèti d'ara madha angalai mu.

source_text: for there is no etz tov producing pri rah, nor again an etz rah producing pri tov.
target_text: ka yesus tabha lii pakasame èci hari, peka na, abhu ètu mia, aj'u be'a, ladhe d'ai lod'o hua, hua na karehe. aa abhu boe ladhe aj'u karehe na hua, hua na be'a.

source_text: for each etz by its own pri will be known. for not from thorns do they gather figs nor from a thorn bush do they pick grapes.
target_text: dhèu bisa tadhe ladhe aj'u ca kapua, be'a do aad'o, mai nèti hua na. dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a, peka na, ètu mia dhèu puu lolobhangi, do, hua anggor nèti aj'u padhudhu.

source_text: the ish tov from the good storehouse of the lev produces tov, and the ish rah out of the evil storehouse produces rah. for from the abundance of the lev the peh mouth speaks.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu d'ara mola-mèci, ne'a tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. te ngaa dhèu dhu d'ara kaj'alu, tao j'ara-j'ara dhu bhelu-katub'a. te nèti lii padhai na, èdhi bisa tadhe babe'a-karehe dhèu.

source_text: and why do you call me adoni and yet you do not do what i say?
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, miu se loe boe paroa ja'a, na, ‘lamatua'. te ngaa tasamia ka miu mo'o boe tao madhutu lii padhai ja'a?

source_text: everyone coming to me and hearing my divrei torah and putting them into practice, i will show you to whom he is likened.
target_text: dhèu dhu mai nanene lii padhai ja'a, ho na tao madhutu, nèngu ne èci èèna ka

source_text: he is likened to the man building a bais who dug and went down deep and laid a yesod upon the av sela bedrock. and a flood having come, the river struck against that bais, and the flood was not strong enough to shake it, because its binnuy was firm.
target_text: dènge dhèu dhu neo patitu èmu dhu èra. na kèi ro'a fanderen toke abhu hadhu. hèia na padhèdi fanderen, heka na patitu èmu kèna. ladhe èi aae lala, èmu ne gaged'o boe sa hèi, lula era padhèdi na èra.

source_text: now the one having heard, and not having put them into practice, is like a man having built a bais house upon the ground without a yesod foundation, which the river struck against, and ofen ort immediately the bais collapsed, and gadol great was the churban of that bais.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu nanene dènge d'ara kajari, aa madhutu boe lii padhai ja'a, nèngu ne èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu neo patitu èmu sad'i j'aj'i di. na tao boe fanderen, te ngaa na patitu èmu na ètu dedha rai ètu sebhe loko. hèia ropa èi aae lala, èmu na guri laho mae-mae!

source_text: when he completed all his divrei torah in the oznei haam ears of the people, rebbe, melech hamoshiach entered into k'far-nachum.
target_text: ropa aj'a nare, ka yesus lèpa asa kota kapernaum.

source_text: now a certain eved of a centurion, an eved dear to him, was having a machla illness and was near mavet.
target_text: ca dhèu komedhaa sordad'u roma pea ètu ne'e. abhu dhèu sab'a na èci dhu nèngu parcaya. dhèu sab'a ne dhu pèd'a oe madhe.

source_text: and having had daas of rebbe melech hamoshiach, the centurion sent to him zekenim elders of the yehudim, asking him to come and to give refuah to his eved.
target_text: lod'o èèna, komedhaa tadèngi le tatao yesus, hèia na pua dhèu heka yahudi pèri-pèri lasi manèngi yesus mai puri dhèu sab'a ne.

source_text: and when they had come to rebbe melech hamoshiach, they were earnestly entreating him, saying, he is a worthy man that you grant this for him.
target_text: d'ai nèi, ra pamako yesus, sèna ka na la'e palere dènge rèngu. ra manèngi, peka na, dhèu roma ne, dhèu be'a! ama hud'i tolong ne.

source_text: for he is one of the chasidei ummot haolam who loves our jewish people and he built for us our shul.
target_text: te nèngu ka patitu èmu sabaj'a cue hia ji'i, lula na sue èdhi dhèu yahudi.

source_text: and rebbe melech hamoshiach was starting out on his derech with them; and when he was already not far from the bais, the centurion sent beloved re'im friends, saying to him, adoni, do not trouble yourself further, for i am not worthy for you to come under my roof;
target_text: ka yesus madhutu dènge si. rèngu dhae rare mèka èmu, te ngaa komedhaa ne pua le angalai na la'e peka dènge yesus, na, ama roca ia ka mai asa d'ara èmu ja'a, te ja'a nia boe sèmi ama asa d'ara èmu ja'a.

source_text: therefore, i did not consider myself worthy to come to you. but just say the dvar, and my eved will receive refuah. for i too am a man placed under the yad memshalah the governing authority, having chaiyalim soldiers under myself, and i say to this one, go, and he goes, and to another, come, and he comes, and to my eved, do this, and he does it.
target_text: aa ja'a nia boe kahèi ara dhiu asa katanga madha ama. ja'a ke'a ama dènge koasa. de sad'i ama padhai lii nèti èèna, tatu dhèu sab'a ja'a ne èle dènge nèti papèd'a na. ja'a ke'a j'ara ne'e ne, lula ja'a dènge dhèu paredha dedha kahèi, dhu dènge koasa ho paredha ja'a. aa ja'a dènge koasa kahèi ho paredha sordad'u ja'a. ladhe ja'a hia paredha mi sordad'u ja'a, peka na, ‘lamu sa nèi! ' tatu la'e dènge. aa ladhe ja'a peka, na, ‘mai sa ne'e' tatu na mai. aa ladhe ja'a pua dhèu sab'a ja'a, ‘sab'a ne'e' tatu na sab'a madhutu kahèi. de sad'i ama padhai lii di, dhèu sab'a ja'a ne, èle dènge.

source_text: and having heard these things, rebbe melech hamoshiach was mispoyel deeply impressed at him, and, having turned to the multitude following him, he said, i say to you, nowhere even in yisroel have i found such great emunah.
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, yesus malaa. ka na kabib'a sa dhèu ae dhu madhutu na sèra, hèia na peka, nia kahèi nga! nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a paraga kèdhi mèka dènge dhèu yahudi dhu lèka èra sama sèmi dhèu roma ne!

source_text: and when the ones having been sent returned to the bais, they found the eved being shalem bguf healthy.
target_text: de yesus d'ai dhoka era èèna di. hèia angalai komedhaa se lèpa. ropa d'ai èmu komedhaa, ladhe na, dhèu sab'a ne èle le nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: and it came about on the next day that rebbe melech hamoshiach proceeded to a shtetl called naim, and his talmidim were traveling along with him as well as a great company of people.
target_text: asa bèli èèna, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, pakèd'i lasi asa rae èci, ngara na nain. dhèu ae kako palere dènge ne.

source_text: now as rebbe melech hamoshiach approached the shaar of the shtetl, hinei, an ish met dead man was being carried out for kevurah burial; he was the ben yachid only son of his em, and she was an almanah widow, and a considerable crowd from the shtetl was with her.
target_text: ropa rèngu oe dètu dènge hèb'a tedhe maso asa rae ne, ra paraga dènge dhèu ca nau lasi padhane dhèu madhe. dhèu madhe ne, ana mone mesa nèti ca dhèu bhèni balu.

source_text: and when rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu saw her, he had rachmei shomayim heavenly compassion on her and said, do not weep.
target_text: ropa yesus nèdhi bhèni balu ne, ka d'ara na roe. hèia na lii dènge bhèni ne, aku nèngu na, ina! tangi ia ka!

source_text: and having approached, he touched the aron met coffin; and the bearers stood still, and he said, bocher, to you i say, get up.
target_text: hèia yesus la'e padètu-dètu, ka na g'ag'e karad'a dhèu madhe ne. ka dhèu dhu pasae karad'a ne titu taha. hèia yesus lii dènge dhèu madhe, aku nèngu na, ana! kèd'i ka!

source_text: and the niftar deceased person sat up and he began to speak, and rebbe melech hamoshiach gave him to his em mother.
target_text: ka ana ne mamuri hari, hèia na kèd'i madhèdi. èle èèna ka, na padhai lii dènge dhèu ae dhu titu reo rare ne. aa yesus peka dènge bhèni balu ne, aku nèngu na, ina! ana mu ka ne'e.

source_text: and everyone was filled with yirat shomayim and they were shouting, baruch hashem! and they were saying, a navi gadol great prophet is among us, and hashem has visited his people.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu sèra madha'u titu kèna! ka ra koa-kio ama lamatua, peka na, ama lamatua pua le ca dhèu na dhu kapai risi, dhu nèti lii padhai na hia èdhi! abhu hari dhu leo, peka na, ama lamatua mai le ètu talora aae èdhi, ho pad'elo d'ara hua iia na!

source_text: and this report about him went out into all yehudah and into all the surrounding countryside.
target_text: hèia lii lolo ne, ra palolo d'ai mia-mia ètu propensi yudea dènge era leo kahèi.

source_text: and yochananʼs talmidim reported to him about all these things. and when he had summoned a certain two of his talmidim, yochanan sent them to rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu, saying, are you hu habah or should we be looking for another? and when the men had come to him, they said, yochanan of the tevilah of teshuva sent us to you, saying, are you hu habah or should we be looking for another?
target_text: ana madhutu yohanis tadèngi aa'i le ngaa-ngaa dhu yesus ad'u-ue. ka lasi lole dènge yohanis ètu d'ara bèdho. hèia na pua dhèu dua lasi, ho karèi ne, peka na, ama ne tare'a-re'a kristus dhu ji'i mate tae-tae, do? do, ji'i mate hari ku dhèu leo? èle ka ra paraga dènge yesus, ka ra karèi sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: genoi at that time rebbe, melech hamoshiach gave refuah to many with machlot and afflictions and ruchot raot and to many ivverim he granted sight.
target_text: lod'o ana madhutu yohanis se ètu èèna, yesus puri-pa'èle dhèu ae nèti papèd'a ra. na bata eele nidhu nèti dhèu. aa na pa'èle dhèu bèdhu, ka rèdhi hari.

source_text: and in reply he said to them, go and tell yochanan what you have seen. ivrim tirenah, pisechim lame persons walk, the metzorim are cleansed, and chereshim hear, the mesim are restored to life, aniyim have the besuras hageulah preached to them.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, lèpa ka ho mi peka dènge a'a ku yohanis, aa'i-aa'i dhu miu tadèngi dènge mèdhi unu mi, sèmi dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya, suri tèke, ‘dhèu bèdhu rèdhi hari. dhèu karuku, kèd'i ho kako hari. dhèu pèd'a kusta, isi ra milu hari. dhèu katele-katipa, tadèngi hari. dhèu madhe, mamuri hari. dhèu dhu dènge boe unu, nanene lii lolo be'a. '

source_text: and ashrey is whoever does not find a michshol stumbling block, obstacle in me.
target_text: lami ho peka kahèi dènge a'a ku yohanis, na, ‘dhèu dhu makae boe sèmi rare ja'a, rèngu abhu a'oto. '

source_text: and when the messengers of yochanan had departed, he began to say to the multitudes about yochanan, what did you go out bamidbar to see? a reed shaken by the wind?
target_text: ropa ana madhutu yohanis se lèpa, hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu ae sèra lula-nèti yohanis, na, lod'o miu lami tenge yohanis ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a èèna, miu pangee, na, paraga dènge dhèu dhu lalole na sèmi ngaa? tatu miu lami boe ho paraga dènge dhèu dhu roe aai-roe èèla, nuka sèmi kalai èèu dhu bhabheu madhutu lai ngèlu di!

source_text: but what did you go out to see? a man dressed in a dandyʼs soft clothing? the ones with glorious apparel are living in luxury as courtiers in the palaces.
target_text: tatu lami boe ho ladhe dhèu dhu pake mèdha-papake dhu kab'ua aae, te dhèu sèmi èèna, era pea na dhodhoka ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae di!

source_text: but what did you go out to see? a navi? ken, i say to you, and one more than a navi.
target_text: de miu lami tenge dhèu cee ètu nèi? miu pangee na lami tenge dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, do? tare'a! te nèngu risi nèti ca dhèu nèti padhai lii lamatua.

source_text: this one is he about whom it has been written, hineni sholeiach malakhi behold, i send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your derech in front of you.
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci dhu suri tèke le, na, ‘nanene! ja'a pua dhèu ja'a, sèna ka bhoke j'ara hia èu. '

source_text: i say to you, among those born of isha there is no one greater than yochanan, yet he who is least in the malchut hashem is greater than he.
target_text: ètu rai-haha ne, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu kapai risi nèti yohanis. te ngaa dhèu dhu ana iiki-iiki ètu talora aae dhèu unu ama lamatua, kapai risi nèti yohanis.

source_text: and when kol haam all the people and the mochesim heard this, they acknowledged the tzidkat hashemrighteousness of g-d, having been submitted to the tevilah of teshuva of yochanan.
target_text: dhèu dhu tadèngi lii padhai yesus, rèngu re'a le, peka na, j'ara lamatua èèna, j'ara mamuri dhu lèke. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu roro bea sèra. lula rèngu uru èèna abhu sarani aa nanene kahèi lii aj'a-nori nèti yohanis.

source_text: but the perushim and the baalei hatorah rejected the tachlis purpose, aim of hashem for their lives, refusing the tevilah of teshuva of yochanan.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu nèti partei agama parisi dènge dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora agama yahudi sèra, ro'o boe madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, ra manèngi boe yohanis sarani si.

source_text: therefore, to what will i compare the people of hador hazeh this generation and what are they like?
target_text: hèia yesus karèi dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, ja'a pakasame dhèu-dhèu taa limuri se'e dènge ngaa? dhèu sèmi ngaa ka see?

source_text: they are like yeladim sitting in the marketplace and calling out to one another; and they say, we played the chalil flute for you and you did not dance; we sang a kina lament, funeral dirge and you did not weep.
target_text: rèngu se, èci èèna ka dènge ana-ana dhu madhèdi ètu d'ara pasa. ra re'a dhoka pa'oo-parodha dènge ka'uu-kamuki, peka na, ‘ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi tiu sakino, te ngaa miu roge boe dènge karej'e. aa ji'i sod'a lii beke dhèu madhe, te ngaa miu tangi boe. '

source_text: for yochanan of the tevilah of teshuva has come not eating lechem nor drinking yayin, and you say, he has a shed demon!
target_text: te, yohanis tuka sarani ninu boe èi anggor, aa na d'èi puasa, miu ka'uu-kamuki, peka na, ‘nèngu ne nidhu tao! '

source_text: the bar enosh has come eating and drinking, and you say, hinei, a man who is a zolel glutton and a shikkor drunkard, a re'a friend of mochesim and chote'im.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, tema kinu èi anggor dènge ku'a roti. ka miu ka'uu-kamuki, peka na, ‘dhèu ne, dhèu gagoo-gagehu! aa tema mahu! pa'angalai dènge dhèu roro bea! aa partei èci dènge dhèu dhu laku-laku boe! dhu ne'a heka ngi'u na! '

source_text: yet chochmah is justified by all of her yeladim.
target_text: te ngaa mi patadhe lii ja'a ne! dhèu dhu re'a mèu, tatu rèngu madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: now a certain one of the perushim was requesting rebbe melech hamoshiach at tish, and, he, having entered into the bais of the parush, reclined to eat.
target_text: ètu d'ara kota ne, abhu dhèu parisi ca dhèu, ngara na simon. ca lod'o, na nèru yesus si mai ra'a asa èmu nèngu. hèia yesus si lasi madhèdi, ka neo ra'a.

source_text: and an isha woman was in the shtetl, an isha chotet a woman of sin, and, when she had daas that rebbe, melech hamoshiach reclines at tish in the bais of the parush, she brought an alabaster flask of costly perfume.
target_text: lod'o èèna, bhèni kajeo ca dhèu tadèngi kahèi, na, yesus si neo ra'a-rinu ètu èèna. ka na maso la'e, nèd'u dènge èi hèu mèngi ca boto dhu kab'ua aae.

source_text: she stood behind him, and then she began weeping at his feet, and with her tears she began to wash the feet of rebbe, melech hamoshiach and she was drying them with her hair, and she was kissing his feet and was anointing them with perfume.
target_text: na mai padètu dènge yesus re kabodho na. hèia na patitu kètu urutuu na ètu haga yesus. na tangi d'ara pèd'a dènge roma iisi, toke èi madha na hae lèke haga yesus. ka na seka haga yesus pake rèu kètu na, aa na loe boe uu haga yesus kahèi. èle ka, na pasuti èi hèu mèngi èèna mi haga yesus.

source_text: but when the parush who had invited rebbe, melech hamoshiach saw this, he said to himself, if this one were a navi, he would have had daas who and what sort of isha is touching him, because she is an isha chotet woman of sin.
target_text: simon ne'a mèu j'ara mamuri bhèni ne. nèti èèna ka, na pajiko ètu d'ara na, ne'e j'aj'i mi tadha, na, yesus ne, dhèu dhu nèti boe lii padhai ama lamatua! ladhe tare'a-re'a ama lamatua ka dhu pua ne mai, tatu nèngu ne'a, na, bhèni dhu g'ag'e nèngu ne, bhèni kajeo. dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, sèmi boe nèngu ne, lula dhèu mola-mèci bisa boe padètu dènge dhèu kaj'alu!

source_text: and in reply, rebbe melech hamoshiach said to him, shim'on, i have something to say to you. and the parush said, speak, rabbi.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a ngaa dhu simon ngee. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, simon! sèmi ne'e. ja'a neo peka dènge èu ca j'ara. hèia simon dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama mese, peka laa.

source_text: two persons were debtors to a certain creditor; the one owed a choiv debt of chamesh meot five hundred denarii and the other a choiv debt of chamishim fifty.
target_text: ka yesus core lii, peka na, abhu ca dhèu dhu tema hia dhèu pija doi na. uru èèna, na hia nèdhi dhèu dua pija doi na. dhèu èci, abhu lèmi ngasu doi iia, aa ca dhèu hari lèmi nguru di.

source_text: not being able to repay, the creditor graciously forgave both debts. therefore which of them will have more ahavah for him?
target_text: te ngaa d'ai lod'o pula doi se'e, dua ra bisa boe b'ae rare. ka dhèu dhu hia pija, rasa kasia mi rèngu dua ra. nèti èèna ka, na peka mi dua ra, sèna ka b'ae ia ka kèlu ra sèra. de madhutu èu, nèti dhèu dua se, cee ka dhu sue risi dhèu tema hia dhèu pija doi ne?

source_text: in reply, shim'on said, i suppose the one whom the creditor forgave more. and rebbe melech hamoshiach said to him, your judgment is gantze nachon.
target_text: ètu d'ara ciki oo'e na kahèi, simon dhaa, peka na, tatu dhèu dhu kèlu na ae risi! ka yesus dhaa, na, mema tare'a!

source_text: and having turned to the isha, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to shim'on, do you see this isha? i entered your bais, you did not give me mayim for my feet, but she has washed my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her rosh.
target_text: ka yesus ladhe bhèni ne, hèia na peka dènge simon, aku nèngu na, èu ladhe sèku bhèni ne. deo na ja'a maso asa d'ara èmu èu, èu tèke boe èi sèna ka rase haga ja'a, madhutu ad'a èdhi. te ngaa bhèni ne pabasa haga ja'a dènge èi madha na, ka na seka pake rèu kètu na.

source_text: you did not give me neshikah kiss, but she, from the time i entered, did not stop kissing my feet.
target_text: aa ropa èu soru ja'a maso asa d'ara èmu èu, èu uu boe ja'a, madhutu ad'a èdhi. te ngaa karèi nèti ja'a ètu d'ara èmu èu, bhèni ne loe boe uu haga ja'a.

source_text: with oil my rosh head you did not anoint. but she with perfume anointed my feet.
target_text: èu bhèlu eele ad'a dhu palona èi hèu mèngi mi kètu tamu, ropa ja'a mai deo na. te ngaa bhèni ne bhori le èi hèu mèngi dhu kab'ua titu kèna mi haga ja'a.

source_text: oib azoi consequently, i say to you, her chatta'im, which are many, have been granted selicha forgiven, for with rabbah ahavah she loved. but he who is mekabel selicha accepting forgiveness only a little, has ahavah only a little.
target_text: èu nanene paie! sasala bhèni ne, mema ae. te ngaa lamatua saku eele aa'i le, lula na pad'elo le sasue na dènge manèngi makasi ae-ae mi ja'a. te ngaa bagi dhèu dhu rasa na tao boe sasala ae, nèngu ngee na parluu boe abhu abho ae kahèi. nèti èèna ka, nèngu ne'a boe sue aa ne'a boe manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: and he said to her, your averos have been granted selicha.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge bhèni ne, peka na, ja'a saku eele le sasala èu aa'i-aa'i ra!

source_text: and the ones reclining at tish with rebbe melech hamoshiach began to say to themselves, who is this who even grants selicha to averos?
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhèdi ra'a palere-lere, paka'uu, aku rèngu na, huuh! na ngee na, nèngu ne cee? ! na bani titu kèna saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu! j'ara ne'e ne dhodhoka ama lamatua mesa na, dhu dènge hak ho saku eele sasala dhèu!

source_text: and rebbe melech hamoshiach said to the isha, your emunah has gained you yeshu'at eloheinu. l'chi l'shalom go in shalom! .
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge bhèni ne, aku nèngu na, lula èu lèka le ja'a, nèti èèna ka lamatua hia le èu mamuri. lèpa ka dènge mera-milu!

source_text: and it came about afterwards that he was traveling through every shtetl and village darshenen and proclaiming the besuras hageulah of the malchut hashem; and the shneym asar were with rebbe melech hamoshiach.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka yesus dènge ana madhutu na, dhèu canguru dua sèra, kako palème kota-kota dènge rae-rae ètu sèra. la'e lolo dènge dhèu dad'èi ama lamatua. èèna ka dhu j'aj'i lii lolo be'a hia rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and there were some nashim who had received refuah from ruchot raot and machlot: miryam called magdalit, from whom shivah shedim had gone out;
target_text: ètu d'ara kaboko rèngu, abhu kahèi pèri-pèri dhèu bhèni dhu madhutu. bhèni se dhu uru èèna abhu rupa-rupa papèd'a, aa cahag'e dhu nidhu tao. te ngaa yesus ka dhu puri-pa'èle aa'i si. nuka sèmi maria nèti rae magdala, dhu uru èèna, yesus bata eele pidhu nidhu nèti nèngu.

source_text: and yochanah the wife of kuza, the steward of herod; shoshanah, and many others who were giving maamadot contributions for rebbe, melech hamoshiach from their private means.
target_text: abhu kahèi susana, dènge mama yohana. yohana ne, dhèu èmu kusa. kusa ne, kapala urusan nèti èmu dhèu aae herodes. aa abhu ae kahèi bhèni leo dhu lasi palere-lere dènge yesus si. bhèni se pake doi-dhari rèngu mesa ra ho ogo yesus si ètu j'ara.

source_text: now when a large multitude was coming together and the ones in every shtetl were making their derech to him, rebbe, melech hamoshiach spoke by way of a mashal:
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu mai nèti rae-rae ho tenge yesus. ropa dhèu ae se pakaboko, hèia na lolo dènge ra pake lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na,

source_text: the one sowing went out to sow his seed; and as he sows, some seed fell beside the road; and it was trampled upon, and the birds of the air devoured it.
target_text: abhu ca dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe, dhu la'e ceb'e hini asa d'ara oka na. hini se cahag'e lèke ètu j'ara. ropa dhèu kako re èèna, j'èli lèke hini se. aa manu-bhui mai ka tutu ra'e aa'i.

source_text: and other seed fell upon the rock, and as soon as it grew up, it dried up because it has no moisture.
target_text: hini cahag'e, lèke ètu dedha rai dhu pènu dènge hadhu. hini se muri, te ngaa nèbhu boe hèia kamale dhae-dhae, lula èi kura.

source_text: and other seed fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up with it and choked it.
target_text: hini cahag'e hari lèke ètu era aj'u padhudhu. te ngaa ropa hini muri, aj'u padhudhu hèlu pamadhe aa'i si.

source_text: and other seed fell in the adamah tovah good ground and, having grown up, produced pri a hundredfold. as rebbe, melech hamoshiach said these things, he was calling out, the one having oznayim ears to hear, let him hear.
target_text: aa hini dhu leo lèke ètu dedha rai hèu mèngi. hini se muri dènge sega, toke kapai ka hua. hua ae titu kèna, d'ai cangasu hari. lolo èle ka, yesus pa'èle lii pakasame ne, dènge lii dhu mèdhu, aku nèngu na, miu dhu pasa dhilu, na, ngee paie-iie!

source_text: now rebbe melech hamoshiachʼs talmidim began questioning him as to what this mashal might be.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu yesus karèi sasoa nèti lii pakasame deo na.

source_text: and he said, to you it has been granted to have daas of the razei malchut hashemmysteries of the kingdom of g-d, but to the others i speak in mashalim, in order that yiru they may not see and vshimu they may not have binah.
target_text: na dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! lula miu se d'èi madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua dènge d'ara kateme, nèti èèna ka ja'a peka paled'a, ho miu me'a tasamia lamatua neo paredha dhèu unu na. te ngaa dhèu leo ro'o boe pare'a dènge dad'èi lamatua. nèti èèna ka, ja'a aj'a-nori si pake lii pakasame di. te dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua dhu suri tèke le, peka na, ‘rèngu se rèdhi le, te ngaa ro'o boe re'a. rèngu tadèngi le, te ngaa ro'o boe sèmi. '

source_text: now the mashal is this: the seed is the dvar hashem.
target_text: hèia yesus peka sasoa nèti lii pakasame ne, aku nèngu na, hini se, nuka lii holo-nori ama lamatua.

source_text: the ones beside the road are the ones having heard, then hasatan comes and takes away the dvar hashem from their levavot, so that they may not have emunah faith and come to yeshu'at eloheinu.
target_text: hini dhu lèke ètu j'ara, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua, te ngaa dhèu aae nidhu mai parame nare nèti d'ara rèngu. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu parcaya boe lamatua, aa abhu boe mamuri.

source_text: now the ones upon the rock are those who when they hear, with simcha they receive the dvar; but these have no shoresh root. they have emunah for a while, but in time of nisayon trial, temptation, they become shmad and they fall away.
target_text: hini dhu lèke dedha hadhu, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua dènge d'ara karej'e. te ngaa amo na marèma boe. rèngu parcaya, te ngaa ropa paraga dènge j'aj'èra, rèngu manahu.

source_text: now the seed which fell among thorns, these are the ones who have heard, and as they go on their derech, they are choked by the deagot worries, anxieties and ashires riches and taanugot pleasures of the olam hazeh and they bring no pri to maturity.
target_text: hini dhu lèke era aj'u padhudhu, nuka dhèu dhu tadèngi, ka ra sèmi rare lii lolo be'a. te ngaa nare nèbhu boe, ka rèngu bhèlu eele lii lolo be'a, lula rèngu bhute dènge laladhe sasab'a-la'a rèngu, mèdha-panyau rèngu, aa dènge neo mamuri karej'e di. nèti èèna ka, parcaya rèngu dènge boe kab'ua ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: now the one in the adamah tova good ground, these are those who have heard the dvar hashem with a lev heart tov and yashir straight, and retain the dvar hashem and bear pri with savlanut patience.
target_text: te ngaa hini dhu lèke ètu dedha rai hèu mèngi, nuka dhèu dhu mamuri mola dènge d'ara hua iia. ropa rèngu tadèngi lii lolo be'a ama lamatua, rèngu sèle asa d'ara rèngu. dènge j'ara ne, rèngu parcaya taa-taa, aa ad'u-ue j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: now no one having lit a menorah covers it with a jar or places it under a bed; but he places the menorah on the shulchan, in order that the ones entering may see the ohr light.
target_text: ka yesus peka hari, na, abhu ètu mia, dhèu paheo rare labhu iiki, ho èèna na saguru dènge èru rai. aa abhu ètu mia, dhèu tao labhu ètu ro'a koi. te ladhe tao sèmi èèna, dhèu bisa boe rèdhi heo na. labhu dhu guna, nuka padhèdi ètu era dedha, sèna ka heo na bisa pasaraa dhèu dhu maso mai.

source_text: for nothing is nistar hidden which will not become nikar evident, nor anything hidden which shall not be made known and come to ohr light.
target_text: èci èèna kahèi dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu pahuni limuri ne, bèli-camèd'a pasabhoka. aa madha j'ara-madha j'ara dhu dhèu re'a boe limuri ne, èèna na dhèu bisa re'a mèu.

source_text: therefore, be shomer how you listen, for whoever has, to him shall more be given; and whoever does not have, even what he thinks he has shall be taken away from him.
target_text: de miu hud'i pangee paie-iie ku j'ara se'e. dhèu dhu neo tenge tare'a-re'a dad'èi lamatua, nèngu asa d'èlu-mèu. te ngaa rèngu dhu pusi pahae boe dad'èi lamatua, rèngu asa goa.

source_text: and the em of rebbe, melech hamoshiach and his achim came to him, and they were not able to get to him because of the multitude.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus bhute dènge dhèu ae. hèia ina dènge ari na mai neo paraga dènge ne. te ngaa ra bisa boe lasi padètu, lula dhèu se, ae titu kèna.

source_text: and it was announced to him, your em and your achim have been standing outside waiting to see you.
target_text: ka abhu dhèu la'e peka dènge yesus, na, ama! ina dènge ari ama, ètu li'u sèi. ra neo paraga dènge ama.

source_text: but in reply, rebbe melech hamoshiach said to them, my em and my achim are these: the ones who are shomei dvar hashemhearers of the word of hashem and also shomrei dvar hashemkeepers guarding, doing the word of hashem.
target_text: ka na dhaa, peka na, oo! te ngaa sèmi ne'e. ina dènge a'ari ja'a, nuka rèngu dhu tare'a-re'a d'èi nanene lii lolo be'a ama lamatua, aa tao madhutu.

source_text: now it came about on one of those yamim when he and his talmidim embarked into a sirah that he said to them, let us go over to the other side of the lake. and they launched out.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus gale dhèu pajuu-paleha na, aku nèngu na, mai lati ka asa cabèka dano. ka ra ca'e koha cue, hèia pakèd'i lasi.

source_text: but as they were sailing, he fell asleep; and a driving storm of wind descended upon the lake, and they began to be swamped and began to be in a situation of pikuach nefesh a matter of life and death.
target_text: ropa rèngu ètu talora dano, yesus bhèj'i. nèbhu boe cag'ag'a laa, ngèlu aae mai. naha tèb'e koha, hèia èi maso sa d'ara, ka oe molo.

source_text: and they came and woke him up, saying, adoneinu, adoneinu, we are perishing! and having been awakened, he rebuked the wind and the rough waves, and the storm ceased. and all became calm.
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ana madhutu se parèi ne, peka na, ama! ama! kèd'i ho tolong ku laa! te èdhi madhe aa'i kèna! ka yesus kèd'i. hèia na kai ngèlu dènge naha, peka na, mau ka! kaca'a laa, ngèlu dènge naha mau dènge ka.

source_text: and moshiach said to them, where is your emunah? and they were fearful and amazed, saying to one another, who then is this, that he commands even the winds and the sea and they obey him?
target_text: hèia na pasanèd'e ana-ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu parcaya mèka ja'a? rèngu madha'u dènge malaa, ka ra pakarèi èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, cee ka yesus ne? tasamia ka nèngu bisa paredha ngèlu dènge naha, ka ra madhutu dad'èi na?
