source_text: tighten your gartels for action and have your menorahs lit. and you should be like bnei adam who expectantly khakeh l'vo'o shel await the arrival of their adon when he returns from the chasunoh, in order that, when he comes and knocks, ofen ort they may open the delet for him.
target_text: yesus padhai lii hari, peka na, mèda-mèu miu musti bori mema dhari ho lalau lamatua. nuka sèmi ènu dhu beke, mate lamatua èmu na lèpa nèti pesta kab'i. ropa lamatua na kad'eu babèdho èmu, nèngu bhoke dènge.

source_text: ashrey are those avadim servants, whom, having come, the adon will find keeping shomer. omein, i say to you, that he will fasten his gartel, and have those avadim servants sit down to tish, and he will come and serve them.
target_text: ladhe lamatua mai nèdhi dhèu sab'a se dhu mate tae-tae, tatu rèngu oto. pe lamatua ra pad'elo d'ara be'a na mi rèngu. na pake mèdha-papake dhèu sab'a, ho la'e lalau nganga'a be'a, sèna ka hia dhèu sab'a se'e ra'a-rinu.

source_text: and if in the second or if in the third watch he comes and finds it thus, ashrey happy, blessed are those.
target_text: dhèu sab'a se mema oto, lula rèngu ladhe-leru lamatua ra dènge be'a. masi ka lamatua ra lèpa èmu hake pèri èèna ka, d'ara talora mèda, do oe mèu, rèngu dhu bori mema dhari.

source_text: but have daas of this, that if the baal bayit had had da'as in what hour the ganav thief comes, he would not have allowed his bais to be broken into.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! ladhe abhu lamatua èmu dhu ne'a mema hake pèri dhèu mana'u mai mana'u, tatu na soro tèke boe ho dhèu mana'u huki èmu na.

source_text: so you be shomer, for the bar enosh comes in an hour you do not think.
target_text: de miu hud'i bori mema dhari, te ca dhèu sa dhu re'a boe pèri lod'o dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a èèna mai hari.

source_text: and kefa said, adoneinu, are you speaking this mashal for us or for all?
target_text: hèia petrus karèi yesus, peka na, ama mese! lii pakasame ama deo na, lèke dhoka mi ji'i do, lèke mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i?

source_text: and haadon said, who then is the sochen haneeman and navon faithful and wise steward whom haadon will appoint over his avadim to give them their okhel food allowance at the proper time? ashrey is that eved, whom, having come, his adon will find doing thus. omein, i say to you, that he will appoint him over all that he has.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, lii pakasame deo na lèke mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tao sèmi kapala urusan dhu satia. nèngu d'èlu-mèu uri j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a hia mi lamatua na. te èèna na, lamatua na ded'e ne, sèna ka papala nganga'a hia mi dhèu sab'a dhu leo sèra. ladhe nèngu maj'èni sab'e madhutu sasab'a na sèmi èèna, masi ka lamatua na mai sange mera mia èèna ka, te ngaa nèngu ne dhu loe boe tao j'ara dhu lèke. hèia na oto, lula lamatua na ded'e ne ho ladhe-leru mèdha-panyau na aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: but if that eved says in his lev, adoni delays to come to me, and if that eved begins to beat the avadim servants and the shfakhot maid servants, and to gluttonize and get down in his schnapps,
target_text: te ngaa carui bagi kapala urusan dhu pangee, na, ‘ele boe nèbhu ku, heka lamatua ne lèpa kèna. ' hèia na kalabhe dhèu sab'a dhu leo sèra, mone dènge bhèni. ka na madhèdi na'a-ninu dènge kea rae-rae toke mahu.

source_text: haadon of that eved will come on a day which he does not expect and at an hour of which he does not have da'as, and will cut him in pieces and assign him the portion of the apikoros with the koferim unbelievers.
target_text: te ngaa ca tèka kapala urusan ne ne'a nare boe, cag'ag'a laa, lamatua na lèpa. ka lamatua na kalabhe ne, hèia babège eele ne, sèna ka sèmi nare pala na ètu li'u, palere-lere dènge dhèu dhu satia boe, tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua ra.

source_text: that eved, who had daas of the ratzon of his adon and did not get prepared or do according to his ratzon, will be beaten with a klap blow and not a few.
target_text: te dhèu sab'a dhu re'a dad'èi lamatua ra, te ngaa pa'èra boe tao madhutu, do, d'èi boe sab'e madhutu, bèli-camèd'a ra dui rare hahuku dhu bia.

source_text: but the one not having had daas, but having done things worthy of a klap, will receive but a few. but to everyone to whom much was given, much will be required from him, and to whom was entrusted much, even more achraius accountability will be required.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a dhu sab'e sale, lula re'a boe dad'èi lamatua ra, rèngu abhu boe hahuku dhu bia. te dhèu dhu abhu ae, ra manèngi ae nèti nèngu kahèi. dhèu dhu abhu sasab'a kapai, dhadhaa na kapai kahèi.

source_text: i came to throw eish on the earth, and how i wish it was already kindled!
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, mamai ja'a ne ho cèri eele dhèu ja'a nèti dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne. ne'e nuka sèmi dhèu pake ai, ho tunu eele maruru. dad'èi ja'a ka ladhe ai ne mulai heo ètu mia-mia.

source_text: and i have a tevilah i have to undergo, and how i am distressed until it is completed.
target_text: te ngaa uru nèti èèna, ja'a hud'i pasae ku j'aj'èra dhu bia. ja'a bèli-camèd'a j'èra ae, toke d'ai èle sasab'a-la'a ja'a.

source_text: do you think that i came to bring shalom on the earth? no, i tell you, but rather machaloket division, controversy.
target_text: miu pangee, na, ja'a mai kèti dame ètu rai-haha, do? aad'o! ja'a mai sèna ka tao dhèu rai-haha ne patao-palaha dènge mae-manyèla, lula lii holo-nori ja'a.

source_text: for there will be from now in one bais household chamesh five having been divided, shalosha against shenayim and shenayim against shalosha,
target_text: nèti deo ne'e, dhèu dhu pa'a'ari mae-manyèla. ètu d'ara èmu cue, dhèu tèlu lab'a dhèu dua, dua lab'a tèlu.

source_text: av will be divided against ben and ben against av, em mother against bat and bat against em, kallah bachamot daughter-in-law against mother-in-law and chamot against kallah.
target_text: ama lab'a ana, ana lab'a ama. ina lab'a ana; ana lab'a ina. teto lab'a ana mantu; ana mantu lab'a teto na.

source_text: and he was saying also to the multitudes, when you see the anan rising over the maarav west, ofen ort you say, geshem rain is coming, and so it happens.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu mèdhi ra'i-liru mèdhi aae cèu nèti haa, miu peka na, ‘ne'e, tadha èj'i oe mai kèna. ' mema lèke sèmi èèna.

source_text: and when there is a south wind blowing, you say, it will be kham hot, and it happens.
target_text: ladhe ngèlu balèu mai, miu peka na, ‘ne'e, tadha lod'o pana titu kèna. ' mema tare'a sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: tzevu'im! you have daas how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky; how is it, then, that you do not have daas of how to interpret hazman hazeh this time?
target_text: weeh! miu dhèu leko-monya dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo! miu d'èlu-mèu titu kèna me'a peka mia lod'o èj'i, aa mia lod'o pana aae. te ngaa tasamia ka mo'o boe me'a dènge dad'èi lamatua ètu taa limuri ne?

source_text: and why also for yourselves do you not judge what is yashar straight, right? for as you go with your ish riv opponent in a lawsuit to appear before the magistrate, on the derech make an effort to settle with him, lest he drag you to the shofet, and the shofet will hand over you to the shoter, and the shoter will throw you into the beit hasohar.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii na, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu tao lii langu, nga tao ka miu bisa boe pama'ète unu mi, mia dhu lèke! be'a risi uri uuru ku dame! mage dhoka miu d'ai katanga madha hakim, ho na pama'ète, na, miu maso asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: i say to you, by no means may you come out, until even the last peruta small coin you pay back.
target_text: te ladhe sèmi èèna, miu bisa boe kalua, ladhe miu b'ae mere mèka dedha dhu hakim pama'ète nare èèna.

source_text: now on the same occasion there were some present reporting to rebbe, melech hamoshiach about the men of the galil whose blood pilate mixed with their zevakhim sacrifices.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu mai peka dènge yesus, na, gubernur pilatus pamadhe le dhèu yahudi pèri-pèri nèti galilea, lod'o dhu mai asa yerusalem, rèti korban asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and, in reply, moshiach said, do you think that these men of the galil were greater chote'im sinners than all others of the galil, because they suffered this shud misfortune?
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, ka yesus karèi si, madhutu miu, na, tasamia? dhèu dhu ra pamadhe sèra, sasala ra kapai risi nèti dhèu galilea dhu leo aa'i-aa'i ra, do? nèti èèna ka, ra huku pamadhe si, do?

source_text: lo no, i say, but unless you make teshuva, you will all likewise perish.
target_text: aad'o! te ngaa ladhe miu tèke eele boe mamuri miu dhu bhelu, ho lèpa madhutu dad'èi lamatua, lod'o limuri miu laho nuka sèmi rèngu kahèi.

source_text: or do you think that those shmonah asar eighteen upon whom the migdal tower in shiloach fell and killed them, do you think that they were greater chote'im sinners than all the bnei adam living in yerushalayim?
target_text: aa tasa mera mia hari dènge canguru aru dhèu dhu madhe ca hari ni, ropa ètu siloam manara guri, hèia kabhie nare si, èèna? sasala si ae risi nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu yerusalem, do?

source_text: lo no, i tell you, but unless you make teshuva, you will all likewise perish.
target_text: aad'o! te ngaa ladhe miu tèke eele boe mamuri miu dhu bhelu, ho lèpa asa j'ara lamatua dhu mola, miu èèna na laho sèmi rèngu kahèi.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was speaking this mashal. a certain man had an etz te'enah fig tree which had been planted in his kerem, and he came seeking pri fruit on it, and he did not find any.
target_text: hèia yesus peka lii pakasame èci, na, abhu ca dhèu dhu dènge ana aaj'u ètu d'ara oka na. bèli-bèli, na la'e patigi, teko-teko ana aaj'u ne hua le, do dhae. te ngaa ana aaj'u ne dhae hua mèka.

source_text: so he said to the keeper of the kerem, hinei shalosh shanim three years i come seeking pri on this etz te'enah fig tree and i do not find any. therefore, cut it down! why is it even using up the adamah ground?
target_text: ka na pua dhèu sab'a ètu d'ara oka, aku nèngu na, ‘tèlu tèu kèna, ja'a laku-mai ho ladhe ana aaj'u ne hua le, do dhae, te ngaa ja'a abhu boe ngaa-ngaa. de patue eele ne, te nèngu ne dhoka na'e era di. '

source_text: but in reply he says to him, adoni, leave it also this year, until i may dig around it and may throw fertilizer on it,
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a ne dhaa, peka na, ‘ama baku pasori ku. hud'i nèbhu hari ku ciki laa d'ai ca tèu sa. pe ja'a kakèi rai reo kapua na, sèna ka tao pupuk, ho na sega.

source_text: and if indeed it produces pri in the future, tov me'od very well; otherwise, you will cut down it.
target_text: ladhe d'ai tèu mai nèi, aj'u ne hua, na be'a. ladhe aad'o, la'a sina ma, patue eele ka laa. '

source_text: now in one of the shuls rebbe, melech hamoshiach was saying shiurim on shabbos.
target_text: ca tèka, lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi, yesus la'e aj'a dhèu ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a.

source_text: and an isha which had a ruach hamachla a spirit of an infirmity, illness shmonah asar eighteen years was bent double and was not able to straighten up at all.
target_text: ètu ne'e abhu bhèni ca dhèu dhu kabodho kapo'o canguru aru tèu kèna, lula nidhu tao ne. bhèni ne bisa boe pamola kabodho na.

source_text: and when he saw her, rebbe, melech hamoshiach called out to her and said, isha woman, you have been set free from your machla illness.
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe nèdhi, hèia na paroa ne, aku nèngu na, ina! lamatua patalale le j'aj'èra nèti èu.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach placed his hands upon her. and ofen ort immediately she was straightened and she was crying, baruch hashem!
target_text: ka yesus tao ai mi bhèni ne. kaca'a laa, kabodho bhèni ne mola dènge kahèi. hèia bhèni ne manèngi makasi, aa koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: and in reply the rosh of the beit haknesset, being indignant that rebbe, melech hamoshiach had given refuah healing on shabbos, was saying to the multitude, there are sheshah yamim six days in which melachah work should be done; therefore, come during those sheshah yamim and get your refuah; but not on shabbos!
target_text: te ngaa kapala èmu sabaj'a ne nasa, lula yesus puri-pa'èle dhèu lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a. ka na peka dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, d'ara ca migu, dhèu sab'a èna lod'o. de be'a risi dhèu pèd'a mai lèke dènge lod'o-lod'o sab'a sèra, sèna ka tenge dhèu puri-pa'èle si. baku mai lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a!

source_text: but rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu answered him and said, tzevu'im! does not each of you on shabbos untie his ox or his donkey from the evus animal feeding trough and lead it away to water him?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala ne, heeh! dhèu kapod'e-kabèli! ètu d'ara lod'o sabaj'a, miu sab'a kahèi, si? te miu lami patabuli sapi dènge keled'ei miu, sèna ka hia ra'a-rinu, si?

source_text: but ought not this isha, a bat avraham avinu as she is, whom hasatan has bound hinei, nebbach regrettably these shmonah asar eighteen long years - should she not have been set free from this bond on shabbos?
target_text: bhèni ne, ana-èpu abraham sama sèmi èdhi. dhèu aae nidhu paj'èra ne canguru aru tèu kèna. ladhe ja'a patabuli ne nèti nidhu, lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i, na èèna sala, do?

source_text: and as rebbe, melech hamoshiach said these things, all his mitnaggedim opponents were put to bushah shame, and all the multitude was having simcha with chedvah rejoicing over all the things of kavod being accomplished by him.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare sèmi èèna, ka musu yesus sèra makae. te ngaa dhèu ae dhu leo sèra karej'e, lula sasab'a na sèra be'a titu kèna.

source_text: therefore, rebbe, melech hamoshiach was saying, what is the malchut hashem like? and to what shall i make a tzushtel comparison of it?
target_text: ka yesus peka hari, na, ja'a pasoro dhèu-dhèu lamatua sèmi ngaa hari?

source_text: it is like a mustard seed, which a man took and threw into his own garden, and it grew and became an etz tree, and the oph hashomayim nested in its branches.
target_text: hiu-hiu èèna rèngu ciki di, te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ka rèngu asa tabha ae. rèngu sèmi aj'u dhu lamusi na ana iiki-iiki. dhèu sèle ne ètu d'ara oka. ka muri mai, hèia j'aj'i ana aaj'u dhu kapai aae. èèna ka manu-bhui mai tao rèd'a ètu dadana na sèra.

source_text: and again rebbe, melech hamoshiach said, to what shall i compare the malchut hashem?
target_text: hèia yesus padhai lii hari, peka na, ja'a pasoro dhèu unu lamatua sèmi ngaa hari?

source_text: it is like se'or leaven, which an isha took and hid in shalosh three measures of wheat flour until the whole batch was leavened.
target_text: nèngu ne nuka sèmi ragi dhu dhèu bhèni nare, ho na pab'ali dènge tarigu dua saku, sèna ka tao roti pa'ae. lula ragi dhu ciki oo'e èèna, pab'ali dènge tarigu ae-ae, hèia ca'e aa'i. dhèu unu lamatua pangaru ra asa tabha kapai sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was itinerating throughout the shtetlach towns and villages saying shiurim and heading on toward yerushalayim.
target_text: èle ka, yesus si mulai kako lasi asa kota yerusalem. rèngu kako, lasi dhuli kota-kota dènge rae-rae, ho na aj'a dhèu.

source_text: and someone said to him, adoni, are there only a few coming to yeshu'at eloheinu? and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them,
target_text: d'ai era èci, ka ca dhèu karèi ne, ama mese! ele boe dhèu ciki di, dhu abhu sod'a, do?

source_text: strive to enter through the sha'ar hatzarut gate of narrowness, because many, i say to you, will seek to enter and they will not be able to.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, hèb'a maso asa sorga èèna, kob'o. de tenge j'ara paie-iie, sèna ka miu bisa maso re èèna. te abhu dhèu ae dhu sèku neo maso, te ngaa bisa boe.

source_text: after the baal bayit gets up and shuts the delet, and you begin to stand outside and to knock on the delet, saying, adoneinu, open up for us! and in reply, he will say to you, i do not have daas of you; from where are you from?
target_text: ladhe lamatua èmu patèke le babèdho, èèna na miu titu ètu li'u, ho kad'eu babèdho, dènge pa'oo manèngi, peka na, ‘ama! bhoke ku laa! ' te ngaa na b'ala, aku nèngu na, ‘miu sèra, cee? ja'a tadhe boe miu! '

source_text: then you will begin to say, we ate and drank in your presence, and in our rekhovot streets you taught.
target_text: hèia miu peka hari, na, ‘nga tao ka ama tadhe boe ji'i? ji'i se ka dhu tema madhèdi nga'a-nginu dènge ama. aa ama kahèi dhu tema aj'a-nori ji'i ètu j'ara oka-hoo ji'i. '

source_text: and he will speak, saying to you, i do not know you, from where are you from? go away from me, kol po'alei resha all workers of evil!
target_text: hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, ‘deo na ja'a dhu peka le, na, ja'a tadhe boe miu! miu se, dhèu dhu tema ad'u-ue bhabhelu di. de pakaj'èu nèti ne'e ne! '

source_text: there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when you will see avraham avinu and yitzchak and ya'akov and all the neviim in the malchut hashem, but you yourselves being thrown out.
target_text: ladhe d'ai lod'o ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, miu tangi roma iisi dènge kadhi ngutu lii kico-kico. te miu ladhe mèdhi baki abraham, isak dènge yakob, dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, madhèdi le ètu sorga. te ngaa miu lèke babège asa li'u.

source_text: and they will come from mizrach east and maarav west and from tzafon north and darom south and they will be the ones bimesibba reclining at tish in the malchut hashem.
target_text: pe dhèu mai nèti suu-suu rai-haha ne, nèti dhimu, nèti haa; nèti badae, nèti balèu, ho aa'i-aa'i ra madhèdi pa'èci, ra'a-rinu rame-rame ètu d'ara èmu ama lamatua.

source_text: and there are some acharonim who will be rishonim and there are some rishonim who will be acharonim.
target_text: patadhe pabe'a-be'a j'ara ne'e: ladhe d'ai ka lod'o lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, abhu dhèu dhu uru èèna, pangee, na, nèngu ana iiki d'ai seli, aa te ngaa nèngu kab'ua titu kèna. aa abhu dhu uru èèna peka, na, nèngu dhèu kapai, te ngaa ètu madha lamatua, nèngu dhoka ana iiki di.

source_text: in the same hour some perushim approached rebbe, melech hamoshiach, saying to him, depart and go from here, because herod wants to kill you.
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu parisi pèri-pèri, mai paraga dènge yesus, ka ra peka, na, hua iia ama mese pakaj'èu nèti era ne'e, te dhèu aae herodes neo pamadhe ama.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, go and tell that fox, hinei, i cast out shedim and i accomplish refuot healings hayom today and makhar tomorrow and yom hashlishi the third day i reach my goal. nevertheless, it is necessary for me to travel on hayom today and makhar tomorrow and the yom following, because it cannot be that a navi should have his violent death and his histalkus passing outside yerushalayim.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, herodes ne, cakaraa badha dhu d'èlu-mèu kapod'e-kabèli. lami peka dènge nèngu, na, ja'a bata eele nidhu dènge pa'èle dhèu nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra, deo ne'e ne dènge bèli. camèd'a ku, sasab'a ja'a ne heka èle kèna. masi ka tasa mera mia èèna ka, nèti kakako ja'a asa yerusalem ne, ja'a neo sab'a hari ku ciki. te dhèu yerusalem sèra, dhu d'èi pamadhe dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: o yerushalayim, yerushalayim, she who kills the neviim and stones the ones sent to her! how often i wanted to gather your yeladim just as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you were not willing!
target_text: waa, dhèu kabarai yerusalem, ee! miu dhu loe boe pamadhe dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, aa pèci pamadhe dhèu pajuu-paleha sèra dhu mai pad'elo j'ara hia miu. pèri-pèri hari le, ja'a neo kaboko miu ho bhiri mi nèti bhelu-katub'a, nuka sèmi manu rena dhu sarimu nare ana na ètu d'ara èla na. te ngaa miu mo'o boe.

source_text: hinei your beis is left to you desolate; and i say to you, you shall by no means see me until the zman time comes when you say, baruch habah b'shem adonai!
target_text: limuri ne, lamatua pusi-pahae heka èmu manèngi-mangaj'i miu. bèli-camèd'a nèngu j'aj'i èmu pa'ela. èèna na, miu mèdhi heka ja'a, toke miu dhaa, na, ‘ama lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu dhu mai nèti kolongara ama lamatua, lula ama lamatua ka dhu hia na mai! '

source_text: and it came to pass when he went into a bais of a certain one of the rashei haperushim on shabbos for betziat halechem, and they were watching him closely,
target_text: ca lod'o, lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i, ca dhèu ama nèti partei agama parisi nèru yesus ho ra'a-sisi ètu èmu na. ropa yesus madhèdi na'a, abhu dhèu dhu ma'u, neo rèdhi ne tao ngaa lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and there in front of rebbe, melech hamoshiach was a certain ish suffering from dropsy,
target_text: lod'o èèna, ca dhèu dhu pèd'a boho madhèdi ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: and in reply, rebbe melech hamoshiach spoke to the baalei torah and perushim, saying, is it mutar permissible on shabbos to give refuah or not?
target_text: hèia yesus karèi dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora yahudi dènge dhèu parisi dhu madhèdi ra'a ètu sèra kahèi, aku nèngu na, madhutu atora nèti baki musa, bisa pa'èle dhèu pèd'a lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a, do aad'o?

source_text: but they kept silent. and having taken hold of him, rebbe, melech hamoshiach granted him refuah and sent him away.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu èci sa bhoka boe hèb'a. hèia yesus gai dhèu pèd'a ne, ka na èle dènge nèti papèd'a na. ka yesus pua dhèu ne, sèna ka lèpa ka.

source_text: and to them rebbe, melech hamoshiach said, who of you having a ben or an ox fall into a well and will not ofen ort immediately pull him out on shabbos?
target_text: èle ka yesus karèi hari si, peka na, ladhe ana èci manahu asa d'ara èi lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a, miu lami ère eele ana ne'e, do aad'o? ladhe sapi manahu asa d'ara èi la'e, miu soro tèke, do, lami kaso ne asa li'u? tatu miu kaso ne asa li'u. de èèna, sasoa na, miu sab'a le, sina ma?

source_text: and they were not able to make a counter argument keneged against this.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai yesus ne, èci sa bisa boe dhaa.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach began speaking a mashal to the seudah banquet supper invitees, when he noticed how they had been picking out the rashei hamoshavot chief seats at the tish, saying to them,
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus taru kira mi dhèu mai ra'a-sisi ètu d'ara èmu ne. dhèu ae ka dhu d'èi era re madha, ho lasi madhèdi. ropa nèdhi sèmi èèna, yesus peka,

source_text: when you are invited by someone to a chasunoh wedding, you should not recline at tish in the rashei hamoshavot chief seats, lest a more distinguished person than you may have been invited by him,
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ladhe dhèu nèru miu asa pesta kab'i, mage lami madhèdi ka asa era dhèu aae-dhèu kapai. mage dhoka lamatua pesta ne nèru tamu dhu kapai risi.

source_text: and he who invited you both shall come and say to you, give place to this one, and then in bushah shame you proceed to occupy the seat of humiliation, the low seat.
target_text: ladhe sèmi èèna, lamatua pesta mai gai èu, peka na, ‘mage mu nasa kahèi, ama! ama pidha sa kabodho, ee. te ja'a tèke kadera ne hia dhèu kapai nèi. ' hèia èu kèd'i dènge makae, tèke eele kadera ne, ka lamu madhèdi asa kabodho.

source_text: but when you are invited, go and recline at tish in the moshav hashafel low seat, so that when the one who has invited you comes, he may say to you, chaver, move up to a higher place; then you will have kavod in the sight of all with you at the tish.
target_text: de ladhe èu abhu nèru, lamu madhèdi ètu kadera re kabodho tèka. ropa lamatua pesta ladhe nèdhi èu, na mai peka, ‘ama! mai madhèdi asa madha ne. ' dènge j'ara ne, miu abhu pakab'ua ètu madha tamu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: for everyone exalting himself shall be humbled, and the one humbling himself shall be exalted.
target_text: te dhèu dhu padedha iisi ra, èèna na lamatua pahaha si. te ngaa dhèu dhu tao iisi ra sèmi dhèu haha, èèna na lamatua ded'e padedha si.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was speaking also to the one who invited him, when you prepare a seudah or a melave malkah, do not invite your chaverim or your achim or your krovey mishpochot relatives or your shchenim haashirim, lest they also should invite you in return and repayment come to you.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka dènge lamatua èmu ne, lod'o leo, ladhe ama neo tao tatao, mage nèru dhoka a'ari ama dènge dhèu kaja sèra mesa ra! te tatu rèngu bisa nèru hari ama.

source_text: but when you prepare a seudah feast, invite the aniyim the poor, the baalei hamum the maimed, the pisechim the lame, the ivrim blind,
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ama tao tatao, nèru dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, dhèu haga roe cabèka, dhèu karuku, dènge dhèu bèdhu sèra.

source_text: and birkat shomayim the blessing of heaven will befall you, because they do not have the means to repay you; for you will be repaid in the yom tekumat hatzadikkimday of the resurrection of the righteous.
target_text: tatu rèngu b'ala rare boe ama. te ngaa ladhe ama nèru si, ama lamatua ka dhu b'ala ama. ladhe d'ai lod'o ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu-dhèu parcaya dhu madhe le, na bhèlu boe babe'a ama.

source_text: and when a certain one of those reclining at tish with rebbe, melech hamoshiach heard these things, he said to him, ashrey is he who will eat lechem in the malchut hashem!
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai lii yesus ne, ca dhèu dhu madhèdi ca mei dènge yesus, padhai lii, peka na, dhu karej'e risi ka, rèngu dhu madhutu ra'a pa'èci ètu d'ara èmu ama lamatua!

source_text: but rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to him, a certain man was preparing a big seudah, and he invited many;
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, peka na, ja'a lolo sèmi ne'e: abhu ca dhèu dhu tao tatao kapai. hèia na nèru dhèu ae titu kèna.

source_text: and at the dinner hour, he sent his eved to say to the seudah invitees, come, because everything is ready now.
target_text: ropa d'ai tadha dhèu ra'a-rinu, ka na pua ènu na, la'e paroa dhèu dhu ra nèru sèra, peka na, ‘mai lati ka, te neo mulai pesta kèna. '

source_text: but each began to come up with a teretz excuse. the rishon first said to him, i bought a sadeh field and i am compelled to go out and look at it. please be mekabel receive, accept my teretz.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu se'e padhai lii rupa-rupa, sèna ka lasi boe asa d'ara pesta. ca dhèu peka sèmi ne'e, ‘ja'a heka hèli kore oka cue, de neo laku ladhe sèku. de mage nasa, te ja'a lake kore boe. '

source_text: and another said, i have bought chamesh pair of oxen, and i am going to try them out. please be mekabel my teretz excuse.
target_text: dhèu leo hari peka na, ‘ja'a heka hèli kore sapi maroo rai lèmi pasa. de ja'a neo laku cob'a si. baku nasa, te ja'a lake kore boe! '

source_text: and another said, i took a wife and therefore i am not able to come.
target_text: dhèu leo hari peka na, ‘ja'a heka kab'i kèna, de bisa boe dhiu. '

source_text: and the eved returned and reported this to his adon. then the baal bayit became angry and said to his eved, go out quickly into the rekhovot streets and lanes of the shtetl and bring in here the aniyim the poor and the baalei hamum the maimed and the ivrim blind and the pisechim the lame.
target_text: ka ènu ne, lèpa peka dènge lamatua na. ropa tadèngi nare, ka nasa titu kèna. hèia na paredha ènu na, aku nèngu na, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, èu lamu lai-lai! lamu asa j'ara-j'ara, dènge asa sasanga j'ara ètu kota ne'e, sèna ka nèru dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, dhèu kasia, dhu haga roe cabèka, dhu bèdhu, dènge dhèu-dhèu karuku sèra. '

source_text: and the eved said, adoni, what you commanded has been done, and still there is room.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, la'e dènge ka nèru dhèu-dhèu sèra. ka na lèpa hari, hèia na peka dènge lamatua na, aku nèngu na, ‘ama! dhèu se, ka se'e le. te ngaa era madhèdi ae era. '

source_text: and the adon said to the eved, go out to the rekhovot and along the boundaries and urge them to come in, in order that my beis may be filled.
target_text: hèia lamatua na peka, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, lamu hari asa rae-rae ètu li'u kota, toke d'ai d'ara oka sèi. lamu pamako sad'i cee èèna ka, mèti si mai ho ra madhèdi papènu d'ara pesta ne.

source_text: for i say to you that no one of those bnei adam who were invited will taste my seudah.
target_text: nanene, ee! dhèu dhu pahae boe dènge lii nèru ja'a ne, rèngu se re'a boe babe'a tatao ne ciki sa hèi! '

source_text: and large multitudes were accompanying him, and rebbe, melech hamoshiach turned and said to them,
target_text: ka yesus si lasi taruu asa yerusalem. dhèu ae madhutu ne. hèia na kabib'a ladhe sa rèngu, ka na peka, na,

source_text: if someone comes to me, and does not hate his own abba and em mother and isha and yeladim and achim and achayot and in addition also his own life, he is not able to be my talmid.
target_text: dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a neo madhutu ja'a, nèngu hud'i sue ku ja'a risi nèti ngaa-ngaa aa'i-aa'i ra; risi nèti ina-ama na, risi nèti dhèu èmu-kamali na, risi nèti ana niki na, risi nèti a'ari na, aa risi-risi hari nèti ngi'u nèngu unu na. ladhe aad'o, dhèu ne nia boe j'aj'i ana madhutu ja'a.

source_text: whoever does not carry his own etz shel mesiros nefesh following me is not able to be my talmid.
target_text: te dhèu dhu d'èi boe pasae j'aj'èra lula nèngu madhutu ja'a, nèngu nia boe j'aj'i dhèu ja'a. dhèu dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu ja'a, masi ka dhèu neo pamadhe ne, te ngaa nèngu pasae j'aj'èra na taruu.

source_text: for who among you, wanting to build a migdal tower, will not first sit down and rechen calculate the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?
target_text: de ladhe neo madhutu ja'a, ngee pabe'a-be'a ku. nuka sèmi dhèu neo tao èmu dhu dènge tad'a-tad'a. nèngu hud'i ige uuru ku, ogo d'ai lutu sela. mage dhoka doi d'ai boe.

source_text: otherwise, having laid his yesod foundation and not being able to finish it, everyone seeing it may begin to make leitzonus fun, mockery of him,
target_text: ladhe ige boe paie-iie, ele boe d'ai fanderen di, doi dhu aad'o heka le. ladhe sèmi èèna, dhèu mari madhe aa pamakae ne hèi,

source_text: saying, this man began to build and was not able to finish.
target_text: peka na, ‘miu ladhe ku dhèu ne'e laa! heka na sab'e fanderen kèna, te ngaa doi na saku aa'i le! '

source_text: or what melech, going out to make milchamah war against another melech, will not first sit down and consider if he is able with aseret alafim ten thousand to meet the one with esrim elef twenty thousand coming against him?
target_text: conto dhu leo, nuka sèmi dhèu lasi pamusu. dhèu aae dhu neo la'e pamusu hud'i madhèdi ku, sèna ka pare'a uuru ku dènge angalai na. ladhe sordad'u rèngu dhoka canguru riho dhèu di, bisa segi musu dua nguru riho dhèu, do aad'o?

source_text: or else, while the other is noch yet far away, he sends an embassy delegation and seeks terms for shalom.
target_text: ladhe ige rare, te ngaa rèngu bisa boe segi, be'a risi lod'o musu dhu kaj'èu era, ra pua dhèu lasi peka sèna ka uri padame.

source_text: so, then, none of you can become my talmid if you do not renounce all your idolatrous holdings.
target_text: sama sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a. nèngu hud'i kali bagi ku la'e-mai, dhu peka na, nèngu dhu pa'èra le tèke eele aa'i ngaa-ngaa, do aad'o? te ladhe aad'o, na, dhèu ne'e nia boe j'aj'i ana madhutu ja'a.

source_text: therefore, melach salt is tov; but if even melach should become tasteless, with what will it be seasoned? it is useless either for the land or for the dung hill; they throw it away. the one who has ears to hear, shema!
target_text: yesus tuhu lii padhai pake lii pakasame dhu leo hari, na, masi ne, be'a. èdhi pake ne ho pabe'a nganga'a. te ngaa ladhe na sèro heka, j'aj'i ngaa hari? bisa heka pake ne, ho pabe'a nganga'a. neo tao mi pupuk, bisa boe kahèi. dhodhoka core eele iia d'ara di. dhèu cee dhu dènge ro'a dhilu, nanene paie-iie!

source_text: now all the mochesim tax-collectors and the chote'im sinners were coming near rebbe, melech hamoshiach to listen to him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu roro bea dènge dhèu dhu laku-laku boe mai ae-ae asa yesus, sèna ka nanene lii padhai na. te ngaa dhèu yahudi peka, na, rèngu sèra dhèu karehe.

source_text: and both the perushim and the sofrim were grumbling, saying, this one gives a kabbalat panim reception to chote'im sinners and eats at tish with them.
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu parisi dènge mese agama yahudi sèra ka'uu-kamuki, peka na, huuh! dhèu ne pa'angalai dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu laku boe se. ngaa hari na madhèdi na'a-ninu dènge si!

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach told them this mashal, saying,
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka yesus lolo dènge ra lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na,

source_text: what man of you, if he has meah kevasim a hundred sheep and has lost from them one, does not leave the tishim vteshah ninety-nine in the open pasture, and go for the one which has been lost until he finds it?
target_text: ladhe nèti miu abhu ca dhèu dhu unu kahib'i-kalèbho cangasu ngi'u. ka ci'u ele. na tao tasamia? tatu na tèke eele dhu ceo nguru ceo se ètu era dhu be'a, aa la'e tenge dhu ele deo na, toke rage ne.

source_text: and when he has found it, he puts it on his shoulders with lev same'ach.
target_text: ropa nèdhi hari kahib'i-kalèbho ne, ka na pasae nèti, dènge karej'e-karae.

source_text: and when he returns to his bais, he calls together his chaverim and his shchenim neighbors, saying to them, make a simcha with me, because i have found my keves sheep, the one that was lost!
target_text: d'ai èmu, ka na paroa angalai na aa'i-aa'i, hèia na peka dènge si, ‘mai, sèna ka karej'e dènge ja'a! te kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a dhu ele èèna, kèdhi hari le. '

source_text: i say to you that in the same way there will be more simcha in shomayim over one choteh sinner who becomes a baal teshuva than over tishim vteshah tzaddikim who have no need of teshuva.
target_text: ètu sorga, sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe ca dhèu dhu tao sala, hèia ele-ho'a, ka na lèpa hari asa lamatua, ana kabarai sorga aa'i-aa'i ra karej'e-karae. rèngu karej'e risi lula ca dhèu dhu lèpa hari asa lamatua, nèti ceo nguru ceo dhèu dhu mamuri mola, dhu sala boe j'ara.

source_text: or what isha having asaret ten drachmas, if she loses one drachma, will not light a licht light and sweep the bais and search carefully until she finds it?
target_text: ka yesus lolo hari lii pakasame dhu leo èci, peka na, abhu ca dhèu ina, dhu doi iia na canguru bua. ne'a na, dhu ele ca doi. ka na tao tasamia? tatu la'e suru labhu ho d'elo palème era, aa saku èmu ne d'ai ro'a kakilu, sèna ka tenge doi cue dhu ele ne.

source_text: and having found it, she calls together chaverim and shchenim saying, have simcha with me, for i have found the drachma which i lost.
target_text: ropa nèdhi hari doi ne, na paroa dènge dhèu dhu ètu baboa èmu na sèra, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, ‘miu mai, ho karej'e sama-sama dènge ja'a. te doi ja'a cue dhu ele deo na, kèdhi hari le! '

source_text: in the same way, i say to you, there is simcha in the presence of the malachim hashem over one choteh sinner who becomes a baal teshuva.
target_text: ètu sorga sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe abhu ca dhèu dhu tao sala, ka na ele-ho'a, ho lèpa hari asa ama lamatua, tatu ana pajuu ètu sorga aa'i-aa'i ra karej'e-karae.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said, a certain ben adam had shnei banim two sons.
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na dènge lii pakasame kahèi, peka na, ama ca dhèu dènge ana mone na dhèu dua.

source_text: and the younger of them said to his abba, avi, give to me the share of the estate that falls to me. and his abba divided his wealth between them.
target_text: ca lod'o, ana limuri peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ‘ama! hia ka pala ja'a nèti pusaka sèra, deo ne'e ne kahèi! ' hèia ama na bagi hia dua ra pusaka na, sèna ka èci-èci dènge pala ra.

source_text: and not many yamim later, having gathered together everything, the younger ben went on a journey to a far away country, and there he squandered his osher riches with gilui arayot sexual immorality and loose living.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka ana limuri ne pahie unu na. hèia na lalau mèdha na, ka la'e asa rae kaj'èu. ètu era nèi, ana limuri ne pasaku aa'i-aa'i doi-dhari na, ho pakarej'e iisi.

source_text: and when he had spent everything, there came a severe ra'av famine throughout that aretz, and he began to be nitzrach needy.
target_text: ropa doi na èle aa'i mèu-mèu, rai ne dhu lèke manganga bia, ka mamuri ana ne j'èra d'ai seli.

source_text: and he went and became associated with one of the citizens of that aretz, and he sent him into his fields to feed chazirim,
target_text: ka la'e tenge sasab'a. hèia ca dhèu nèti kabarai èèna hia na panga'a hahi.

source_text: and he was longing to fill his mogen stomach with the pods which the chazirim were eating, and no one was giving anything to him.
target_text: lula ana ne manganga d'ai seli, ka neo na'a nganga'a hahi se. te abhu boe ca dhèu sa hia ne na'a.

source_text: when he came to his senses, his seichel told him, how many of my abbaʼs sachirim hired workers have more than enough okhel food and i am perishing here with hunger.
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu, ka na pangee la'e-mai, aku nèngu na, ‘anga ee! ja'a ètu ne'e, oe madhe manganga kèna. te ngaa ètu d'ara èmu ama ku, dhèu sab'a ra'a toke bècu.

source_text: i will get up and go to my abba, and i will say, avi, i sinned against shomayim and in your sight.
target_text: de be'a risi ja'a lèpa hari asa ama ku, ho peka dènge ne, ama! ja'a tao le sala dhu kapai titu kèna, mi lamatua dènge ama.

source_text: i no longer have the zokheh merit worthy to be called a ben of my abba. make me as one of your sachirim hired workers.
target_text: ja'a nia boe j'aj'i ana ama ku. hud'i laa ama sèmi more ja'a ne j'aj'i mi kuli ètu d'ara èmu ama, ngaa-ngaa tao boe! '

source_text: and when he got up he came home to his own abba. and while he was still a long way off, his abba saw him, and was filled with rachmei shomayim heavenly mercy, compassion and tears, and fell upon his neck and kissed him.
target_text: ropa pangee nare sèmi èèna, hèia na kèd'i dènge ka, lèpa la'e asa èmu ama na. nèti kaj'èu era, ama na ladhe nèdhi le nèngu, ka ama na rasa kasia. ka na puru nèti èmu, rai la'e soru nare ana dhu lèpa hari ne. hèia na liku nare, ka uu ne.

source_text: and bno said to the abba, avi, i sinned against shomayim and in your sight. no longer do i have the zokheh merit to be worthy to be called your ben.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana ne peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ‘ama! ja'a ne tao le sala dhu kapai mi dedha lamatua dènge ama ku. ja'a nia heka j'aj'i hari ana ama. '

source_text: but his abba said to his avadim, shnel! quick! bring out the best kaftan and clothe him, and put a ring on his hand and sandals for his feet,
target_text: te ngaa ama na paredha dènge ka dhèu-dhèu sab'a na, peka na, ‘karohe! lami mere kodho madhera dhu be'a risi, ho papake ne. mere kadheli, ho pasaluu mi kacui-aai na. aa papake salapa mi haga na.

source_text: and bring the fattened calf, and slaughter it, and let us eat and have a simcha,
target_text: lami ère mere sapi kab'oi èèna ho pare, te èdhi neo ta'a-tinu rame-rame.

source_text: because this ben of mine was dead and now he has returned l'chayyim! he had been lost and now he is found. and they began to make a simcha.
target_text: lula ana ja'a ne, nuka sèmi dhu madhe le, te ngaa na mamuri hari. nèngu dhu ele le, te ngaa ja'a abhu hari ne. ' na padhai lii èle sèmi èèna, ka mulai ra'a-rinu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: but the abbaʼs alterer ben older son was in the sadeh field. and as he was coming, he drew near to the bais, and he heard the zemirot table songs, and the sound of the klezmer musician and the dancing,
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana uuru dhu aad'o ètu èmu, te na sab'a ètu d'ara oka. ropa na lèpa, nèti kaj'èu era, na tadèngi le dhèu karihu musiik dènge roge-ledho.

source_text: and having summoned one of the avadim servants, the alterer ben older son was inquiring what these things might be.
target_text: ka na paroa nare dhèu sab'a ca dhèu, hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, ee! tao rarame ngaa ètu ne'e?

source_text: and the eved said to him, your ach is present, and your abba sacrificed the fattened calf, because your abba received him back bari v'shalem safe and sound.
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a ne dhaa, peka na, ‘ari mu lèpa hari le. de ama mu pua pare sapi, sèna ka tao pesta kapai, te ana na lèpa hari dènge sod'a. '

source_text: and the alterer ben was filled with ka'as anger, and he did not want to enter. but his abba came out and was pleading with him.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia ana uuru ne pasaree. na no'o boe maso asa d'ara èmu. ka ama na la'e rarange ne.

source_text: but in reply the alterer ben said to his abba, hinei, so many years i serve you and never a mitzvah of you i disobeyed, and never for me did you give even a young goat that with my chaverim i might make a simcha.
target_text: te ngaa na ka'ugu, peka na, ‘ama! pangee ku laa! nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a sab'a toke èi kabhèsu hae, nuka sèmi kuli sa, hia mi ama. ja'a ne ke'a boe sisu dad'èi ama. masi ka sèmi èèna, abhu mèka ama hia ana kahib'i ci'u, sèna ka ja'a pakarej'e dènge mone aanga-angalai ja'a.

source_text: but when shows up this ben of yours, the one having devoured your property with zonot prostitutes, you sacrificed for him the fattened calf.
target_text: te ngaa ropa ana ama dhu bhera-lelu doi-dhari ama, ho la'e karihu dènge bhèni karehe, lèpa hari mai, ka ama pare sapi kab'oi na, tao pesta aae hia ne. '

source_text: and the abba said to him, beni, you are always with me, and everything which is mine is yours.
target_text: te ngaa ama na b'ala, aku nèngu na, ‘ana pasue, ee! nanene paie-iie. nèbhu nare sange ne'e, èu ne bera-bera dènge ja'a. aa'i-aa'i dhu unu ja'a, sèra sa unu èu kahèi.

source_text: but now it was necessary for us to have lev samei'ach and make a simcha, because the ach of you was dead and he has returned l'chayyim! he has been lost and now is found.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, èdhi hud'i karej'e dènge karae ku, lula ari mu ca dhèu ne. uru èèna, nuka sèmi dhu madhe le, te ngaa limuri ne mamuri hari. nèngu dhu ele le, te ngaa abhu hari. '

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach was saying also to the talmidim, a certain oisher rich man had a sochen steward, estate manager or agent, and the charge brought against him was that he was squandering the property of the oisher rich man.
target_text: ka yesus hia lii upama èci mi ana madhutu na, peka na, dhèu kaja ca dhèu dhu ded'e dhèu sab'a na èci j'aj'i kapala urusan. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, na tadèngi dhèu palolo, peka na, kapala urusan ne mulai kapod'e-kabèli ka parugi nèngu.

source_text: and having called him, the oisher said to the sochen, what is this i hear about you? submit to a bikoret beshbonot audit for that which is under your pekuddah stewardship care, for you are no longer able to be sochen.
target_text: hèia dhèu kaja ne paroa kapala urusan na, ka peka dènge ne, ‘èu ne, tasamia? ja'a tadèngi, na, èu kapod'e mèdha-panyau ja'a. de lamu suri ku ngaa dhu èu ad'u-ue ètu d'ara sasab'a èu, ho ja'a parisa ku. ladhe parisa kore, ja'a kalua eele èu. '

source_text: and the sochen said to himself, what may i do, because adoni takes away the pekuddah from me? i am not strong enough to dig, i am ashamed to beg.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi nare, hèia kapala urusan ne mulai pajiko, na, ‘ja'a ne j'èra kèna! ja'a neo sab'a ngaa hari? pare rai, ja'a èra boe. j'aj'i dhèu hèb'a mènyi, ja'a makae.

source_text: oh! i have daas of what i may do, that when i am removed from the work of the sochen, they may receive me into their batim.
target_text: ladhe ja'a sab'a heka ètu ne'e, ja'a hud'i tenge j'ara ku, sèna ka dhèu leo bisa hari sèmi rare ja'a ho sab'a. '

source_text: and having summoned his adonʼs debtors one by one, he was saying to the first, how much do you owe adoni?
target_text: nèti èèna ka, na paroa nare aa'i dhèu dhu pakèlu lamatua na. na karèi dhèu uru, aku nèngu na, ‘ee! kèlu èu ca ngaa ètu lamatua ja'a? '

source_text: and he said, one hundred jugs of olive oil. and the sochen said to him, take your bill, sit down, quickly write fifty.
target_text: dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, ‘ja'a dhu pakèlu èi lèngi saitun èpa riho liter. ' hèia kapala urusan ne peka, na, ‘tare'a. sasuri pakèlu èu ka ne'e. ciu eele ka, madhèdi ho suri gati sasuri kèlu dhu hiu, peka na, kèlu èu dua riho liter di. '

source_text: then to another he said, and you, how much do you owe? and he said, one hundred containers of wheat. he says to him, take your bill and write eighty.
target_text: ka karèi dhèu pakèlu ka dua, peka na, ‘aa èu hari, kèlu ca ngaa? ' ka dhèu ne dhaa, na, ‘ja'a pakèlu are, cariho karo. ' hèia kapala urusan ne peka, na, ‘ciu eele sasuri dhui èèna, ho suri dhu hiu hari, peka na, kèlu èu, aru ngasu karo di. '

source_text: and the baal bayit praised the unrighteous sochen because he acted with chochmah. because the bnei haolam hazeh have more seichel in dealing with their own generation than the bnei haohr.
target_text: na tao sèmi ne'e ka, toke lamatua na ne'a tatao nèngu. te ngaa lamatua ne hud'i mangaku, na, dhèu kapala urusan dhu bhelu ne mema mèu kapod'e-kabèli. de ja'a lolo lii upama ne, sèna ka miu me'a, na, ladhe pasoro dènge dhèu parcaya, dhèu dhu parcaya boe d'èlu-mèu risi tenge j'ara ho pa'oto ngi'u ra ètu talora aae kabarai limuri ne.

source_text: and i say to you, use the mammon the wealth of the olam hazeh to make for yourselves yedidim friends, chaverim, so that when unrighteous mammon fails, they may welcome you into the mishkenot olam eternal dwellings of the olam habah.
target_text: miu ngee sèku. masi ka dhèu rai-haha ne karihu kaj'alu re mèdha-panyau ra, te ngaa be'a risi miu pake mèdha-panyau miu sèra, ho soru-bara dhèu. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, miu abhu angalai ae. masi ka mèdha se èle, te ngaa bèli-camèd'a lamatua tao tèke era hia miu ètu sorga.

source_text: the one oisgehalten in little, also is neeman in much, and the one who is unrighteous in little, also in much is unrighteous.
target_text: ladhe dhèu mola ètu j'ara dhu ana iiki, tatu na mola kahèi ètu j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai. te ngaa ladhe dhèu mèu kapod'e ètu j'ara dhu ana iiki, tatu na kapod'e kahèi ètu j'ara dhu kapai.

source_text: if, then, you were not ne'eman with unrighteous mammon, who will entrust you with hon emes?
target_text: ladhe dhèu parcaya heka miu, ho uri mèdha-panyau ètu j'ara-j'ara dhu ana iiki ètu rai-haha ne, tasamia ka lamatua parcaya miu ètu j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai?

source_text: and if you were not neeman with that which belongs to another, who will give you what is your own?
target_text: ladhe miu bisa boe uri mèdha-panyau dhèu leo, na, dhèu cee ka dhu bani ho hia miu mèdha-panyau ra?

source_text: no eved is able to serve two adonim; for either he will have sinah hatred toward the one and he will have ahavah love toward the other, or one he will be devoted to and the other he will despise. your avodas service cannot be for both hashem and mammon.
target_text: dhèu sab'a èci bisa boe nanene dua lamatua. te aad'o na, nèngu d'èi boe èci, aa sue èci. nèngu d'ara kateme dènge ca dhèu, te ngaa pusi boe dènge èci. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. te dhèu bisa boe sue ama lamatua palere dènge sue doi-dhari.

source_text: and the perushim, who were ohavei kesef lovers of money, heard all this and they made leitzonus fun of rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu parisi pèri-pèri dhu nanene lii padhai yesus deo na. ka ra sasei ne, lula rèngu se dhèu manga'a doi-dhari.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, you are the ones who in the sight of bnei adam credit yourself as being yitzdak im hashemjustified with g-d, but hashem has daas knowledge of your levavot. because the thing highly esteemed among bnei adam is a to'eva abomination before hashem.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge si, masi ka miu pamèu iisi ètu madha dhèu, te ngaa ama lamatua ne'a d'ara bhelu miu. abhu j'ara ae dhu dhèu rai-haha ded'e padedha-dedha, te ngaa ama lamatua peka na, j'ara sèra karehe, aa dhu madenge dènge rèngu.

source_text: the torah and the neviim were proclaimed until yochanan; since then it is the malchut hashem that is being preached as besuras hageulah, and anyone entering it must strive to do so.
target_text: toke mamai yohanis tuka sarani, èdhi dhèu yahudi muri madhutu atora nèti baki musa aa nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, lii lolo be'a nèti lamatua pale-lème le ètu mia-mia. dhèu ae dhu tenge le j'ara, sèna ka ra mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: but it is easier for hashomayim and haaretz to pass away than for one tag ornamental flourish of the torah to fail.
target_text: masi ka dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne ele, te ngaa atora nèti ama lamatua ciki sa, ele boe. ca katèd'a sa ele boe hèi!

source_text: anyone giving the get to his isha and taking another wife commits ni'uf adultery, and the one marrying a gerusha divorcee commits ni'uf adultery.
target_text: dhèu dhu pa'ia-pa'ela dènge dhèu èmu na, aa na madhèdi hari dènge bhèni leo, nèngu bersina. aa dhèu dhu leo dènge bhèni dhu pa'ia-pa'ela, nèngu bersina kahèi.

source_text: now there was a certain oisher rich man. he was dressed in purple and fine linen, and yom yom daily he feasted sumptuosly and every day for him was to make a simcha.
target_text: ka yesus lole tabha hari, peka na, abhu dhèu kaja ca dhèu. nèngu d'èi pake mèdha-papake dhu be'a-be'a, tao nèti bèla alus. mèu-mèda na'a-ninu nganga'a dhu be'a hua, aa karae taruu.

source_text: and there was a certain ish oni poor man covered with sores, el'azar by name, who had been laid at the oisherʼs sha'ar gate.
target_text: ètu kota ne'e, abhu kahèi ca dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa. ngara na, lasarus. ngi'u na dhu pènu dènge kamèu. bèli-bèli angalai na rèti pamadhèdi ne ètu hèb'a tedhe dhèu kaja èèna.

source_text: and the ish oni el'azar longed to fill his mogen stomach with what fell from the oisherʼs tish. but even the kelevim dogs were coming and licking the sores of the ish oni poor man.
target_text: na sanao teko-teko abhu kaha'i nganga'a nèti dhèu kaja ne, sèna ka bisa na'a, te ngaa na abhu boe ngaa-ngaa. dhoka busa di mai, ho j'ore nana kamèu na.

source_text: and it came to pass that el'azar died, and he was carried away by the malachim to the tish at the kheyk bosom of avraham avinu. and then the oisher rich man died also, and he was buried.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, lasarus madhe. hèia ana pajuu ama lamatua mai nèti sorga, ka rèti lasi pamadhèdi ne ètu baboa abraham. aa nèbhu boe ka, dhèu kaja ne madhe kahèi, ka dhèu ded'e lasi padhane.

source_text: and lifting up his eynayim in sheol, where he was in the torments of agony, he sees avraham avinu off in the distance and el'azar at tish at his kheyk bosom.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu kaja ne maso boe sorga. nèngu maso asa d'ara naraka, sama-sama dènge dhèu-dhèu leo dhu madhe le. ètu era nèi, dhèu kaja ne abhu j'aj'èra taa-taa. ca tèka na boti kètu, ka ladhe nèdhi lasarus madhèdi ètu baboa baki abraham.

source_text: and he called, avraham avinu! chaneni na and send el'azar that he may dip the tip of his finger into the mayim and cool my tongue, because i am in torment in this moked fire.
target_text: hèia na pa'oo, peka na, ‘baki abraham, ee! sue ku ja'a laa! pua ku lasarus cèb'u kolo ai na asa d'ara èi, sèna ka mai pabasa ku kolo he'o ja'a ne. te ja'a j'èra titu kèna ètu d'ara ai naraka ne! '

source_text: but avraham avinu said, beni, have zikaron recollection that you received your tov in the span of your days, and el'azar likewise received the ra'ah. but now he is given nechamah comfort here, but you, yisurim sufferings, torments.
target_text: te ngaa abraham dhaa, peka na, ‘ana, ee! sanèd'e ku! uru èèna lod'o èu mamuri era ètu rai-haha nèi, èu abhu le aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a. te ngaa lasarus ne, unu dhodhoka sasusa di. ka limuri ne, lamatua pakarej'e ne ètu ne'e, te ngaa èu pasae more j'aj'èra.

source_text: and, in addition to all these things, there has been fixed between us and you a tehom gedolah a great abyss, chasm, so that the ones wishing to come over from here to you are not able, neither from there to us may they cross over.
target_text: risi-risi hari, ètu talora aae èu dènge ji'i, lamatua tao tèke loe aae èci dhu taleo dènge marèma. de dhèu nèti ne'e bisa boe dhiu asa era èèna, aa dhèu nèti èèna bisa boe pège sa ne'e mai. '

source_text: and the oisher said, i ask you then, avraham avinu, that you may send el'azar to the bais of avi,
target_text: hèia dhèu kaja ne pamako hari, aku nèngu na, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, baki abraham pua lasarus la'e asa èmu ama ku.

source_text: for i have chamesh achim five brothers that he may warn them, lest also they may come to this place of yisurim torments.
target_text: te ja'a ne dènge ari dhèu mone, dhèu lèmi era. sèna ka lasarus la'e pasanèd'e si, ho ra lèpa ka asa lamatua. masi ka lod'o d'ai ra madhe, rèngu maso ia ka asa era j'aj'èra ne. '

source_text: but avraham avinu says, they have moshe rabbeinu and the neviim. let them listen to them.
target_text: te ngaa abraham b'ala ne, ‘ama lamatua hia le rèngu sasuri nèti baki musa dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai na. ari mu si, bisa baca pahari-pahari ho re'a dad'èi lamatua. '

source_text: but the oisher said, lo no, avraham avinu, but if someone from the mesim should go to them, they will make teshuva.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu kaja ne pasisu, peka na, ‘baki abraham, ee! èèna dhae d'ai mèka. rèngu sèi pahae boe lii holo-nori ama lamatua! hud'i abhu ku ca dhèu nèti talora dhèu madhe la'e asa rèngu, heka rèngu ele-ho'a, aa neo nanene kèna. '

source_text: but avraham said to him, if moshe rabbeinu and the neviim they do not listen to, neither if someone should make his techiyah from the mesim should they be persuaded.
target_text: te ngaa abraham dhaa, peka na, ‘ladhe rèngu sèi ro'o boe nanene lii holo-nori nèti musa dènge nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua, na, masi ka dhèu madhe bhodho nèti d'ara ro'a ra, ho padhai lii dènge rèngu èèna ka, rèngu ro'o boe nanene. '

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to his talmidim, it is impossible for the nisayon temptation to sin not to come, but oy through whom it comes.
target_text: yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na, ae ka dhèu manahu asa d'ara sasala, lula tatao dhèu leo. te ngaa dhèu dhu pamanahu dhèu asa d'ara sasala èèna, pasae nare mamadhe-mamopo.

source_text: it is better for him if a millstone is hung around his neck and he had been thrown into the sea than that he should cause a michshol for these little ones.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ad'u-ue j'ara karehe, toke ana iiki parcaya boe ja'a, èèna na ama lamatua huku ne bia. dhu samaa risi, ladhe èki ladha goro dhèu ne'e dènge hadhu aae cue, ho parèu eele asa d'ara dhasi ètu talora lèu.

source_text: pay attention to yourselves. if your ach sins and you rebuke him, and if he makes teshuva, grant him selicha forgiveness.
target_text: de j'aga ngi'u pabe'a-be'a, sèna ka miu baku pamanahu dhèu asa d'ara sasala! te ngaa ladhe a'ari mu tao sala, pasanèd'e ne. ladhe na ele-ho'a, hèia na mai manèngi abho, na pabhèlu eele sasala na.

source_text: and if shevah pe'amim during the yom he sins against you and shevah pe'amim he turns around to you saying, i make teshuva, you will grant him selicha.
target_text: ladhe a'ari èu tao sala pidhu hari d'ara ca lod'o, ka na ele-ho'a, hèia na mai pidhu hari ho manèngi abho, èu hud'i pabhèlu eele sasala na pidhu hari kahèi.

source_text: and the shlichim said to rebbe, melech hamoshiach, adoneinu, increase our emunah.
target_text: ca lod'o, ana madhutu se mai asa yesus, ka ra manèngi, aku rèngu na, ama mese! parcaya ji'i se èra boe. de ama pa'èra ku parcaya ji'i.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu said, if you have emunah like a mustard seed, you would have said to this mulberry etz, be uprooted and be planted in the sea, and it would have given you mishma'at.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, ladhe miu parcaya koasa nèti ama lamatua, masi ka ciki oo'e èèna ka, te ngaa miu bisa paredha aj'u aae ne, ‘tahoi eele, ho pidha asa d'ara dhasi! ' ka aj'u ne madhutu lii paredha miu.

source_text: but who among you, having an eved plowing or tending kevesim, when the eved comes in from the sadeh, will say to him, here, come ofen ort immediately and recline at tish.
target_text: èle ka yesus lii, aku nèngu na, tare conto èci. nuka sèmi ènu dhu pare rai ètu d'ara oka, do, ladhe kahib'i-kalèbho ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a. sab'a nare, ka lèpa sa èmu. tatu lamatua na peka boe dènge ne, ‘mai ho dua ti ta'a sama-sama! '

source_text: rather, would he not say, prepare something that i may have okhel; gird up your tunic and serve me until i am satisfied, and, after that, you may have okhel?
target_text: aad'o, sina ma? dhu lèke ka, lamatua paredha ne, peka na, ‘lamu lalau mei hia ja'a. ku'a-kinu kore ku, pe èu mu'a-minu ètu kabodho nèi! '

source_text: there is no obligatory effusive todah, when the eved only did his chiyuv duty.
target_text: ladhe ènu ne lalau nare madhutu dad'èi lamatua na, miu ngee, na, lamatua ne manèngi makasi mi ènu ne, do? aad'o!

source_text: so also you, when you do all these things which are given you as mitzvot, say, we are useless avadim, we only did our chiyuv.
target_text: miu èci èèna kahèi. ladhe sab'a mere aa'i dhu lamatua paredha le, miu peka na, ‘ji'i dhoka ana pua-paleha di. ji'i tenge boe lii koa-kad'iri. ji'i dhoka pakako sasab'a-la'a ji'i di. '

source_text: and it came about while rebbe, melech hamoshiach goes to yerushalayim, he was traveling through the middle of shomron and the galil.
target_text: lod'o yesus si lasi asa yerusalem, rèngu d'ai too propensi galilea dènge propensi samaria.

source_text: and entering into a certain shtetl, some anashim metzoraim leprous men met rebbe, melech hamoshiach, and there were ten of them. keeping their distance,
target_text: ropa rèngu neo maso asa d'ara rae cue ètu èèna, dhèu canguru dhu pèd'a kusta mai, neo paraga dènge yesus. rèngu se titu nèti kaj'èu.

source_text: they shouted, saying, yehoshua, rabbi, chaneinu!
target_text: ka ra pa'oo palere-lere, peka na, yesus! mone kapai, ee! sue ku ji'i laa!

source_text: and having seen this, he said to them, go and show yourselves to the kohanim. and it came about while they were going away that they were made metoharim clean.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii pa'oo ra, ka na ladhe si, hèia na pua, aku nèngu na, lami pad'elo uuru ku isi miu asa ama agama, sèna ka ra parisa papèd'a kusta miu sèra, èle le, do dhae! ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka lasi dènge. te ngaa ropa d'ai talora j'ara, cag'ag'a laa, rèngu dhu èle le nèti kusta.

source_text: and one of them, having seen that he had received refuah, returned with a kol gadol loud voice, saying baruch hashem!
target_text: rèngu lasi taruu dènge karej'e-karae. te ngaa abhu ca dhèu di, dhu lèpa hari mai asa yesus. na pa'oo, peka na, koa-kio lamatua! te ja'a èle le nèti papèd'a!

source_text: and he fell on his face at the feet of rebbe, melech hamoshiach, giving hodayah thanksgiving. and he was a shomroni samaritan.
target_text: hèia na patitu kètu urutuu na, ho manèngi makasi ae-ae mi yesus. te'a boe, te nèngu ne dhèu yahudi boe. nèngu ne ca dhèu samaria dhu loe boe tao lii langu dènge dhèu yahudi.

source_text: and in reply rebbe melech hamoshiach said, were there not ten who were made metoharim? now the tishah nine, where are they?
target_text: ka yesus karèi dhèu sèra dhu madhutu dènge ne, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ee? deo na ja'a pa'èle dhèu canguru si? dhu ceo, mia lasi?

source_text: was none of them found to turn around and return and give kavod glory to hashem except this nokhri foreigner?
target_text: tasamia ka dhoka dhèu leo kara ne'e di, dhu lèpa mai ho manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, dènge koa-kio kolongara na?

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to him, get up and go. your emunah faith has delivered you.
target_text: hèia na peka mi dhèu ne, na, èu èle le, lula èu parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a. de kèd'i, lèpa ka dènge sod'a-mole!

source_text: now having been asked by the perushim, ad mosai? how much longer? when comes the malchut hashem? rebbe, melech hamoshiach replied, the malchut hashem is not coming with things observable, nor will they say, hinei, here it is, or there it is, for hinei, the malchut hashem is within you.
target_text: ca lod'o, dhèu parisi pèri-pèri mai karèi yesus, peka na, ama mese! peka ku dènge ji'i, lod'o mia ama lamatua neo pakako paredha na? ka yesus dhaa, sèmi ne'e. mage mi pangee, na, lamatua pakako paredha na dènge rupa-rupa tadha ètu rai-haha ne, dhu dhèu bisa rèdhi dènge musi madha ra. dhèu abhu boe tadha dhu peka na, ‘ladhe ku asa ne'e mai! te ama lamatua pakako paredha na ètu ne'e! ' do, ‘na pakako paredha na ètu nèi! ' aad'o! te na pakako paredha na ètu talora aae miu, ètu d'ara dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and he said to the talmidim, yamim are coming when you will long to see one of the yamim of the bar enosh. and you will not see it.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ana-ana madhutu na, nèbhu boe, na, ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, pa'èci heka dènge miu. d'ai ka lod'o j'aj'èra sèra, miu d'èi titu kèna neo mèdhi mamai hari ja'a. te ngaa d'ai mèka lod'o mamai ja'a.

source_text: they will say to you, hinei, there it is! or, hinei, here it is! do not go out after them nor pursue them.
target_text: ladhe èèna na dhèu mai peka, na, ‘kristus ètu ne'e! ' do, ‘kristus ètu nèi! ' na, miu baku bhute ho patangi-tenge, te lii padhai rèngu sèra, kapod'e-kabèli.

source_text: for as the lightning flashing out of one part under shomayim lights up the other part under shomayim, thus will be the bar enosh in his yom.
target_text: te ladhe dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, lèpa hari mai, tadha na dhu mèu aadha-aadha, nuka sèmi bela dhu heo kacèb'a ètu dedha-liru nèti suu asa suu.

source_text: but brishonah it is necessary for him to suffer many things and to be rejected by hador hazeh.
target_text: te ngaa nèngu hud'i abhu uuru ku j'aj'èra rupa-rupa. ka dhèu rai-haha taa limuri ne, ro'o boe nanene, aa neo tule eele ne.

source_text: and just as it was in the yamim of noach, thus will it be also in the yamim of the bar enosh.
target_text: te ngaa bèli-camèd'a, ladhe na neo mai hari, dhèu mamuri karehe sama biasa, èci èèna ka dènge lod'o noh mamuri era.

source_text: they were eating, drinking, marrying, and being given in marriage, until the yom when noach entered into the tevah ark and hamabbul the flood came and destroyed everything.
target_text: taa èèna, rèngu ra'a-rinu, tao pesta kab'i toke lod'o noh maso asa d'ara kapa na. te ngaa rèngu ro'o boe nanene kahèi. kaca'a laa, èi aae lala, ka pamadhe aa'i si.

source_text: likewise, just as it was in the yamim of lot: they were eating, drinking, buying, selling, planting, and building.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, lod'o lot mamuri era, dhèu mamuri karehe titu kèna. taa èèna, rèngu ra'a-rinu, bad'aga, sab'a oka-tedhe, patitu èmu, aa mamuri karehe sèmi biasa.

source_text: but on the yom when lot went out from s'dom, from shomayim it rained down eish and gofrit and destroyed everything.
target_text: te ngaa ro'o boe nanene kahèi. hèia mad'ae aae era, ropa lot rai eele nèti kota sodom, cag'ag'a laa, èj'i ai dènge èi nasu bhori mai nèti dedha-liru, aa labhu pakèpu rèngu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: so it will be on the yom when the bar enosh has his hisgalus revelation.
target_text: de miu baku pamud'e ku! mage dhoka bèli-camèd'a dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, lèpa hari mai, dhèu mamuri dhoka sèmi biasa di. te ngaa kaca'a laa, na cèu mai.

source_text: on that yom let not anyone on the housetop come back down inside for any of his property in the bais, and the one in a sadeh field likewise let him not turn back for things left behind.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ètu madha èmu, maso ia ka asa d'ara ho lalau mèdha. dhèu dhu sab'a ètu d'ara oka, lèpa ia ka asa èmu ho rare mèdha ra.

source_text: remember eshet lot lotʼs wife.
target_text: sanèd'e ku ngaa dhu uru èèna j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu lot. na madhe, lula nèngu ngee mèdha-panyau ètu èmu na.

source_text: whoever seeks to preserve his nefesh will lose it; but whoever loses it, will preserve it.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'èi boe madhutu ja'a lula sue ngi'u na, èèna na mamuri na ele iia d'ara. te ngaa dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a toke soro mamuri na, lula sue ja'a, bèli-camèd'a abhu sod'a-mole, aa mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: i say to you, in lailah hazeh there will be two in one bed: one will be taken; and the other will be left.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e mema! ropa dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, lèpa hari mai, ladhe dhèu dua j'unu ètu era èci, kabèdhi laa lamatua ded'e paca'e ca dhèu, aa tèke eele ca dhèu.

source_text: there will be shtayim two grinding at the same place: one will be taken, but the other will be left.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu bhèni dhèu dua dhu maj'u are, èèna na lamatua ded'e paca'e ca dhèu, aa tèke eele ca dhèu.

source_text: shtayim will be in the sadeh field; one will be taken and the other left.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dua dhu sab'a ètu d'ara oka, lamatua mai ded'e nèti èci, aa tèke eele ca dhèu.

source_text: and in reply they say to him, where, adoneinu? but rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, where the nevelah is, there also the nesharim vultures, eagles popularly will be gathered together.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu tadèngi rare, hèia ra karèi yesus, ama mese! sèra sa bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i ètu mia? ka yesus core lii, peka na, sèmi ne'e! ladhe miu mèdhi ka manu-bhui dhu tema ra'a sisi badha madhe, ra lela pa'oru ètu mia, na, miu me'a èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, dhu peka na, tatu abhu sisi hèu ètu era èèna. dènge sasoa dhu pahuni, peka na, ladhe yesus kristus lèpa hari mai, tadha na dhu mèu aadha-aadha, sad'i dhèu re'a baca tadha sèra.

source_text: now he was speaking a mashal to them about how it is necessary always for them to daven and not to lose chozek,
target_text: ca tèka, yesus padhai lii dènge ana madhutu na, pake lii pakasame ho rèngu loe boe manèngi-mangaj'i, aa baku ma'ète sanao-maena. rèngu hud'i parcaya taa-taa lamatua.

source_text: saying, an aza certain shofet was in a certain town. now this shofet had no fear of hashem nor any respect for bnei adam.
target_text: lii lolo na sèmi ne'e ka: ètu d'ara kota cue, abhu ca dhèu ama pama'ète lii langu, dhu pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua. na pahae boe ca dhèu sa hèi.

source_text: now an almanah was in that town and she was coming to him saying, grant me yashrus justice against my ish riv opponent in a lawsuit.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu kahèi bhèni balu èci, dhu loe boe mai sa dhèu pama'ète lii ne, ho manèngi, peka na, ‘ama hakim! j'ue ku lii langu ja'a dènge mola! '

source_text: and for a zman time the shofet was not willing. but after these things, he said to himself, if indeed hashem i do not fear nor do bnei adam i respect,
target_text: hiu-hiu èèna, dhèu pama'ète lii ne pusi boe dènge bhèni balu ne. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ka, na roca nanene ne. hèia na madhèdi pangee ka, ‘mema ja'a ne pusi boe dènge ama lamatua, risi-risi dènge dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: yet because this almanah widow causes me tzoros and is such a nudzh pest, i will grant yashrus justice to her, lest in the end she may wear me out by her constant coming.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni ne pakabo'o kètu ja'a. de be'a risi ja'a pama'ète lii na dènge mola. te ladhe ja'a panena, na mai taruu paj'èra ja'a. '

source_text: now rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu said, listen to what the unrighteous shofet says.
target_text: de miu pangee ku lii padhai dhèu pama'ète lii dhu bhelu ne.

source_text: now will not hashem by all means do mishpat for his bechirim crying out to him yomam valailah? will he delay long in bringing them help?
target_text: ladhe nèbhu-nèbhu dhèu pama'ète lii ne tao ai-hèb'a mi bhèni balu ne, tatu ama lamatua kahèi neo tao ai-hèb'a mi dhèu unu na dhu sabaj'a mèu-mèda mi nèngu ho manèngi sasue na. te ngaa lamatua mate heka panèbhu.

source_text: i say to you that hashem will bring about their yashrus justice swiftly, but when the bar enosh comes, will he then find emunah faith on haaretz?
target_text: te nèngu uri lii langu rèngu dènge boe pamata. de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: ladhe ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne mai hari, ja'a bisa paraga dènge dhèu parcaya ètu rai-haha ne era, do aad'o?

source_text: and he said this mashal also to some, who have become soimech confident, putting their trust and being dependent on themselves that they are tzaddikim and who are despising others.
target_text: ka yesus lolo tabha hari pake lii pakasame lula-nèti dhèu dhu pangee na ne'a aa'i mèu-mèu, aa dhu d'èi pahaha dhèu leo. na peka na,

source_text: shnei anashim two men went up to the beis hamikdash to daven, one was a parush and the other, a moches tax collector.
target_text: abhu ama dhèu dua dhu lasi sabaj'a asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ca dhèu nèti partei agama parisi, aa èci hari dhèu roro bea. dhèu yahudi peka na dhèu parisi sèra, dhèu dhu mola. te ngaa ra pangee, na, dhèu roro bea, dhèu karehe.

source_text: the parush was standing by himself, shawkling ritual swaying while davening, and his tefillah went like this: adonoi, modeh ani that i am not like other men, swindlers, resha'im, menaafim, or even this moches.
target_text: d'ai èmu sabaj'a dhèu parisi ne titu mesa-mesa na, ka na manèngi-mangaj'i, peka na, ‘makasi lamatua, te ja'a ne dhèu be'a. ja'a ne bhelu boe nuka sèmi dhèu leo sèra. ja'a mana'u boe. ja'a manga'a boe. ja'a dhèu dhu bersina boe. makasi lamatua, te ja'a ne bhelu boe nuka sèmi dhèu roro bea ne.

source_text: i undergo a tzom fast twice during the week, i give the ma'aser tithe of everything as much as i get.
target_text: ja'a ne maj'èni puasa ca migu dua hari. aa ja'a d'èi hia ca pala nèti canguru pala nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a abhu. ' dhèu parisi ne, sabaj'a sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: but the moches tax collector stood at a distance and was not willing even to lift up his eynayim to shomayim but was beating his chest, saying, adonoi, rachem na al choteh kamoni! l-rd, have mercy on a sinner like me!
target_text: te ngaa dhèu roro bea ne titu pakaj'èu ètu kabodho nèi. na bani boe boti kètu ho ladhe sa dedha. nèngu dhoka pacud'u di, dhu dènge d'ara ma'ète mae-mae. na sabaj'a, peka na, ‘ama lamatua! sue ku ja'a, dhèu dhu pènu dènge sasala-sasigo ne! abho eele ku sasala ja'a! '

source_text: i say to you, this one, rather than the other one, went down to his bais having been made yitzdak im hashemjustified with g-d. because everyone lifting himself up will be brought low, but the one bringing himself low will be uplifted.
target_text: lod'o dhèu dua se lèpa lasi asa èmu ra, cee ka dhu pabe'a dènge ama lamatua? dhèu parisi dhu pamone, do dhèu roro bea ne? tatu na sèmi dènge be'a, dhèu roro bea dhu pahaha iisi ne. te ngaa na pusi boe dènge dhèu parisi ne. te ama lamatua pahaha dhèu dhu pamone-pabhèni, te ngaa na padedha dhèu dhu re'a pahaha iisi.

source_text: now also they were bringing to rebbe, melech hamoshiach yeladim that he might place his hands on them. but having seen this, the talmidim were rebuking them.
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu sa'u rèti ana ra dhu rara iisi hiu asa yesus, sèna ka na tao ai na mi ana iiki se, aa padhai lii hia si mamèngi. ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, ana-ana madhutu yesus kai dhèu se'e.

source_text: but rebbe melech hamoshiach called for them saying, permit the yeladim to come to me and do not hinder them, for of such ones is the malchut hashem. omein, i say to you, whoever does not welcome the malchut hashem as a yeled would, may by no means enter into it.
target_text: te ngaa yesus soru mamai ra dènge be'a. hèia na kai ana-ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, hud'i laa ana iiki sèra mai asa ja'a. miu baku bhabhae si. sanèd'e paie! dhèu dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua, nèngu hud'i sanao-maena dhoka mi ama lamatua, nuka sèmi ana iiki dhu sanao-maena dhoka mi ina-ama na.

source_text: and a certain one of the manhigim leaders, one of the wealthier baale-battishe jews questioned rebbe, melech hamoshiach, saying, mori hatov good teacher, what mitzvah must i do to inherit chayyei olam?
target_text: ca lod'o, dhèu kapai yahudi èci, mai karèi yesus, aku nèngu na, ama mese dhu hua iia! ja'a ne hud'i tao ku tasamia, sèna ka ja'a ke'a tare'a, na, ja'a maso sorga, aa mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua?

source_text: and rebbe melech hamoshiach said to him, why do you call me tov? no one is tov except hashem alone, nu?
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, tasamia ka èu ne peka na, ja'a ‘dhu hua iia'? dhodhoka èci di dhu hua iia, nuka ama lamatua.

source_text: you have daas of the mitzvot. lo tinaf, lo tirtzach, lo tignov, lo taaneh vreiachah ed shaker, kabeid es avicha ves immecha.
target_text: èu me'a le atora ama lamatua karèi nèti uru ka, dhu peka na: baku j'unu pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu boe èu; baku pamadhe dhèu; baku mana'u; baku j'aj'i sakasii dhu leko-monya; aa pakab'ua ina dènge ama mu.

source_text: and he said, in all these things i have been shomer mitzvot and frum from my kinder-yoren.
target_text: ka dhèu ne dhaa, na, tare'a, ama! ja'a dhu madhutu le atora sèra, karèi nèti ja'a ana iiki era.

source_text: and having heard, rebbe melech hamoshiach said to him, still one thing for you is lacking. everything as much as you have, sell and distribute to the aniyim, and you will have otzar in himel; and come follow me.
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka yesus peka, na, be'a! te ngaa èu kura ca madha j'ara era. nuka, lamu ho pahie mèdha-panyau èu aa'i-aa'i. kab'ua ra, lamu pabagi hia dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa sèra. èle na, èu lèpa hari mai sèna ka madhutu ja'a. te èèna na, ama lamatua b'ala hari mèdha-panyau èu ètu sorga.

source_text: but having heard these things, he fell into agmat nefesh grief, sadness. for he had much kesef.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu ne d'ara na susa, te nèngu kaja d'ai seli.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach, when he saw him fall into agmat nefesh, said, how difficult it is for the ones having osher riches to enter into the malchut hashem.
target_text: ropa yesus nèdhi dhèu ne lèpa dènge d'ara na laho mae-mae, hèia na padhai lii dènge ana madhutu na, peka na, dhèu kaja mema carui titu kèna maso sorga.

source_text: for it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for an oisher rich man to enter into the malchut hashem.
target_text: èdhi pasèku ku dènge j'ara leo. mema bisa boe badha unta dhu kapai bisa maso asa d'ara oka na re ro'a j'aj'au. nuka sèmi èèna kahèi, dhèu dhu maena dhoka mèdha-panyau na, te ngaa maena boe lamatua, tatu nèngu bisa boe maso sorga.

source_text: but the ones, having heard, said, then who is able to come to yeshu'at eloheinu?
