source_text: and he said, the things impossible with bnei adam are possible with hashem.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, mi dhèu rai-haha, j'ara ae-ae mema carui. te ngaa bagi ama lamatua, aa'i-aa'i bisa j'aj'i.

source_text: and kefa said, hinei, we have left everything to follow you.
target_text: hèia petrus tuhu lii, peka na, ama! ji'i tèke eele aa'i mèdha-panyau ji'i, ka mai madhutu ama. bèli-camèd'a ji'i abhu ngaa?

source_text: and he said to them, omein, i say to you, that there is no one who left bais or isha or achim or horim parents or yeladim because of the malchut hashem,
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, petrus! nanene paie-iie. dhèu dhu tèke eele èmu na, dhèu èmu-kamali na, a'ari na, ina-ama na, do ana-ana na, lula nèngu pakako sasab'a ama lamatua,

source_text: who will not receive many times as much in this zman time and in the olam habah, chayyei olam.
target_text: tatu na abhu hari ae risi ètu rai-haha ne. aa ladhe èle rai-haha ne, nèngu abhu mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: and having taken the shneym asar twelve aside in a yechidus, he said to them, hinei, we are making another aliyah leregel pilgrimage to yerushalayim, and all the things having been written by the nevi'im about the bar enosh will be fulfilled.
target_text: ka yesus gale nèti ana madhutu na canguru dua dhèu sèra, ho lasi padhue-padhai mesa ra. hèia yesus peka dènge ra, miu se aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, na, èdhi kako ne, lati asa kota yerusalem. d'ai nèi, j'ara aa'i-aa'i nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua sèra dhu suri tèke le, lula-nèti dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a, pe j'aj'i nuka sèmi dhu ra suri.

source_text: for he the bar enosh moshiach will be delivered up to the goyim and he will be ridiculed and he will be mistreated and he will be spat upon,
target_text: èèna na, ra soro ja'a asa dhèu leo dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua. aa ra padhai lii pamakae ja'a, pahahe ja'a rupa-rupa, paru'e ilu ra mi ja'a,

source_text: and, having laid the shot whip on him, they will kill him and after his histalkus passing, on the yom hashlishi there will be techiyas hamoshiach.
target_text: ra hake kalabhe ja'a. èle èèna ka, ra pamadhe ja'a. te ngaa asa camèd'a èèna, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: and they had binah understanding, comprehension regarding none of these things, and this dvar was nistar concealed from them, and they had no understanding of the things being said.
target_text: ropa tadèngi yesus peka sèmi èèna, ana madhutu na bingu, lula rèngu dhane rare mèka sasoa nèti lii padhai yesus.

source_text: and it came about while rebbe, melech hamoshiach drew near to yericho, a certain ivver blind man was sitting beside the road begging.
target_text: lod'o yesus si oe maso kota jeriko, abhu dhèu bèdhu ca dhèu dhu madhèdi kanata ai ètu sebhe j'ara.

source_text: and having heard a multitude traveling through, he was asking what this might be.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi dhèu ae kako re èèna, ka na karèi, aku nèngu na, ngaa ne?

source_text: and they reported to him that yehoshua from natzeret is passing by.
target_text: ka dhèu peka dènge ne, na, yesus nèti nasaret dhu kako re ne'e.

source_text: and he cried out saying, ben dovid! chaneni! have mercy on me!
target_text: hèia dhèu bèdhu ne rodhe pamèdhu-mèdhu, peka na, yesus! ana-èpu dhèu aae daud, ee! sue ku ja'a!

source_text: and the ones going past him were rebuking him that he should be silent, but he just so much the more was crying out, ben dovid, chaneni!
target_text: hèia dhèu dhu kako uuru nèti yesus kai ne, sèna ka na mau-mau. te ngaa asa na hino dènge lii rodhe, peka na, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud, ee! sue ku ja'a laa!

source_text: and stopping, rebbe melech hamoshiach commanded the ivver to be led to him. having drawn near, rebbe, melech hamoshiach asked him, what do you wish that i may do for you?
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi, ka na titu. hèia na pua dhèu lasi pakako rèti dhèu bèdhu ne. d'ai madha na, ka yesus karèi ne,

source_text: and he said, adoni, that i may regain my sight.
target_text: èu neo ja'a tao ngaa hia èu? ka na dhaa, ama! ja'a manèngi sèna ka ja'a bisa kèdhi.

source_text: and rebbe melech hamoshiach said to him, regain your sight; your emunah faith has brought you refuah healing.
target_text: yesus b'ala ne, peka na, be'a. lula èu lèka na ja'a bisa pa'èle èu, de èu bisa mèdhi dènge kèna.

source_text: and at once he saw again and was following rebbe, melech hamoshiach, shouting, baruch hashem! and all the people, who were edei reiyah eyewitnesses of this, shouted, baruch hashem!
target_text: kaca'a laa, musi madha dhèu ne be'a dènge ka. ka la'e madhutu yesus dènge koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ladhe rèdhi ne, koa-kio kolongara lamatua kahèi.

source_text: and having entered, rebbe, melech hamoshiach was passing through yericho.
target_text: ka yesus si maso re kota jeriko, ho neo lasi taruu.

source_text: and, hinei, a man by name zakkai was there and he was a chief moches tax collector and he was an oisher rich man.
target_text: ètu ne'e, abhu ca dhèu kapala roro bea dhu roro doi hia dhèu paredha roma. ngara na sakeos, aa nèngu ne dhèu kaja.

source_text: and he was seeking to catch a look at rebbe melech hamoshiach and was not able to do so, because of the multitude, and because he was komah short of stature.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi yesus kako re èèna, ka nèngu neo nèdhi. te ngaa bisa boe nèdhi dènge be'a, lula katitu na bab'a d'ai seli, aa dhèu ae dhu kalibhu rare yesus.

source_text: and having run ahead to the front, he climbed up onto an etz tree, a sycamore, that he might see rebbe, melech hamoshiach, because by that derech way he was about to pass by.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, na rai uru, ka na ca'e asa kolo aj'u ca kapua ètu sebhe j'ara, dhu yesus neo re èèna.

source_text: and as he came to the place, having looked up, rebbe melech hamoshiach said to him, zakkai, hurry and come down, for hayom today in your bais house it is necessary for me to remain.
target_text: ropa d'ai kapua aj'u ne, yesus ladhe asa dedha. hèia na paroa, peka na, sakeos! puru ka! karohe, te deo ne'e kahèi, ja'a neo manubha ètu d'ara èmu èu.

source_text: and having hurried, zakkai came down and welcomed with kabbalas hamalchus accepting his sovereignty as king rebbe, melech hamoshiach with simcha joy.
target_text: ka sakeos malaa. hèia na puru pamèri-pamèri, la'e dènge yesus asa èmu na. d'ara na karej'e-karae.

source_text: and all, having seen this, were beginning to kvetch complain, saying, with a choteh sinner he entered to rest?

source_text: and zakkai stood there and said to rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu: hinei, half of my possessions, adoni, i give as tzedakah contribution to charity to the aniyim, and if from someone i defrauded of anything, i am paying back arbatayim four times.
target_text: d'ai d'ara èmu, sakeos titu ètu madha yesus, ka lii, peka na, ama mese! nèti deo ne'e ne, ja'a bagi mèdha-panyau ja'a mi dua, capala hia mi dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa. ladhe ja'a roro bea parisi, ja'a b'ae hari mi rèngu èpa kali lipat.

source_text: and he said to him, hayom today yeshu'at eloheinu has come to this bais, because he also is a ben avraham.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala ne, peka na, be'a. deo ne'e kahèi, ama lamatua pala-bagi sod'a-mole mi èu dènge isi èmu èu aa'i-aa'i, lula èu parcaya lamatua kahèi, nuka sèmi baki abraham.

source_text: for the bar enosh came to seek and to save the lost.
target_text: te ama lamatua pua ja'a mai j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ètu rai-haha ne. mamai ja'a ne, sèna ka tenge dhèu dhu sero nèti j'ara lamatua, ho hia si sod'a-mole.

source_text: now as they were hearing these things, rebbe, melech hamoshiach added a mashal parable, because he was near to yerushalayim and they had the havamina assumption that the malchut hashem was about to appear immediately.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae nanene lii padhai yesus. rèngu oe dètu dènge kota yerusalem. rèngu pangee, na, yesus neo pakako paredha ama lamatua ètu èèna, nuka sèmi dhèu aae. hèia yesus lolo dènge si lii pakasame èci.

source_text: then moshiach said, a certain man of noble birth traveled to a distant country to get for himself royal power for his malchut and to return.
target_text: na peka na, abhu dhèu kapai èci. neo la'e asa rai kaj'èu, ho dhèu ded'e ne j'aj'i dhèu aae ètu nèi. ladhe èle, nèngu neo lèpa hari mai ho j'aj'i dhèu aae ètu d'ara kabarai na.

source_text: and having summoned ten avadim servants of his, he gave them ten minas and he said to them, conduct business until i come.
target_text: lod'o nèngu pa'èra neo pakèd'i, paroa nare dhèu sab'a na canguru dhèu, ka na bagi hia si ca dhèu, juru cue. na paredha si, peka na, ‘miu pake doi se j'aj'i mi poko. te lod'o d'ai ja'a lèpa, miu hud'i peka ku leto na ca ngaa. ' èle èèna ka, na pakèd'i.

source_text: but his subjects were hating the man of noble birth and they sent a delegation after him saying, we do not want this one to rule over us.
target_text: te ngaa kabarai na d'èi boe ne. ka ra hia dhèu lasi peka, na, ‘ji'i ngo'o boe dhèu ne paredha ji'i. '

source_text: and it came about when he returned, having received the royal power of his malchut, he summoned to his presence these avadim to whom he had given the kesef, that he might have daas of what they had gained by trading.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, ra ded'e ne j'aj'i dhèu aae. hèia na lèpa hari ka. d'ai èmu na, ka na paroa dhèu sab'a na, dhèu canguru sèra, ka karèi si, peka na, ‘miu se leto ca ngaa nèti juru dhu ja'a hia miu sèra? '

source_text: and the rishon first came, saying, with your mina, adoni, ten minas more were gained.
target_text: dhèu sab'a dhu uru, peka na, ‘ama dhèu aae! ja'a leto juru canguru bua nèti poko dhu ja'a abhu! '

source_text: yafeh! eved tov! because you have been ne'eman faithful in a very small thing, have shlita authority over ten towns.
target_text: ka dhèu aae peka dènge ne, ‘be'a! èu ne dhèu sab'a dhu maj'èni. lula ja'a bisa lèka èu nèti j'ara dhu ana iiki, nèti èèna ka karèi nèti deo ne'e, ja'a ded'e èu ho paredha canguru kota. '

source_text: and the sheni second came saying, your mina, adoni, made five minas.
target_text: èle ka dhèu sab'a ka dua, peka na, ‘ama dhèu aae! ja'a abhu leto juru lèmi bua nèti poko dhu ja'a sèmi. '

source_text: and the man of noble birth said also to this one, and you have shlita authority over five towns.
target_text: ka dhèu aae peka, na, ‘be'a! ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a ded'e èu ho paredha lèmi kota. '

source_text: and the other came saying, adoni, hinei! your mina which i had put away in a tichel kerchief.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a ka tèlu nèti hari juru na. ka na peka, ‘doi ama ka ne'e! ja'a rapi ka pahuni ne, mage ele.

source_text: for i was fearing you, because you are a big machmir stickler, you take what you did not deposit, and you reap what you did not sow.
target_text: ja'a tao sèmi èèna, lula madha'u. ja'a ke'a ama, dhèu nasa. te ama d'èi more ngaa dhu unu boe ama, aa d'èi puu hua dhu ama sèle boe! '

source_text: he says to him, from your own mouth i will judge you, eved rasha bad servant. you had daas that i am a big machmir stickler, taking what i did not deposit and reaping what i did not sow?
target_text: ropa dhèu aae tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka na jèke ne, ‘èu ne, dhèu goa d'ara! lii padhai èu ne pabia ngi'u èu mesa mu. èu me'a, na, ja'a dhèu nasa, ho kore ngaa dhu unu boe ja'a, aa puu ngaa dhu ja'a sèle boe.

source_text: why then did you not put my kesef on deposit? then when i came i would have collected ribit interest.
target_text: de ladhe sèmi èèna, nga tao ka lamu boe tèke ne asa bank? ho sèna ka lod'o ja'a lèpa, ja'a bisa abhu leto. masi ka ciki di. '

source_text: and to the ones having stood nearby he said, take from him the mina and give it to the one having ten minas.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae ne pua dhèu leo ètu sèra, peka na, ‘mere doi nèngu ne, sèna ka hia mi dhèu sab'a dhu abhu leto canguru deo na. '

source_text: and they said to him, adoneinu, he has ten minas!
target_text: te ngaa ra pasisu, peka na, ‘ama! dhèu ne abhu ae le. nga tao ka neo more nèti dhèu dhu unu ciki, ho patabha sa nèngu hari? '

source_text: i say to you, that to everyone having, more will be given, but from the one not having, even what he has will be taken away.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu aae b'ala, peka na, ‘pangee paie-iie ku! ladhe dhèu dhu mèu uri ngaa dhu dhèu hia ne, èèna na nèngu abhu tabha hari. te ngaa dhèu dhu bai-eed'a, èèna na rare aa'i ngaa dhu na unu.

source_text: but these oyevim of mine, the ones refusing me the kabbalas hamalchus refusing my sovereignty as king over them, bring here and execute them before me.
target_text: de lami kèpe mere musu ja'a, dhu ro'o boe ja'a j'aj'i dhèu aae. mèti si mai sa ne'e, sèna ka pamadhe si ètu madha ja'a. lami ka! '

source_text: and having said these things, he was traveling ahead, making his aliyah leregel to yerushalayim.
target_text: ropa yesus lolo èle, hèia lasi taruu ka asa yerusalem. yesus dhu kako uru.

source_text: and it came about as he came near to beit-pagey and beit-anyah, by the mount of olives, rebbe, melech hamoshiach sent two of the talmidim,
target_text: ropa oe dètu dènge dua rae, nuka betfage dènge betania, dhu ètu karasa ledhe saitun, ka na pua ana madhutu na dhèu dua lasi uru.

source_text: saying, go to the shtetl ahead of you, in which entering you will find an ayir having been tied, upon which none among bnei adam ever sat, and having untied it, bring it here.
target_text: na pua si peka na, miu dua mi lami asa rae dhu ètu madha nèi. pe miu mèdhi keled'ei ngèru ci'u dhu èki tèke ètu èèna. keled'ei ne, dhèu manya'e rèdhi mèka. mi lècu dhari na, pakako mèti mai.

source_text: and if someone asks you, why are you untying it? - you will say this: haadon has need of it.

source_text: and having departed, the ones having been sent found it just as rebbe, melech hamoshiach told them.
target_text: dua ra lasi ka, hèia ra rage keled'ei ngèru nuka sèmi dhu yesus peka.

source_text: and while untying the ayir, its owners said to them, why are you untying the ayir?
target_text: ropa ra lècu dhari keled'ei ne, ka lamatua badha ne karèi si, na, nga tao ka miu patabuli badha ne?

source_text: and they said, rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu has need of it.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, lamatua ji'i neo pake ne.

source_text: and they led it to him and, having thrown their kaftans on the ayir, they put rebbe melech hamoshiach on it.
target_text: lamatua badha ne d'èi kahèi, ka dua ra nuni rèti keled'ei asa yesus. ra hèle sig'i-kalolo ra mi dedha kabodho keled'ei ne. èle èèna ka, ra paca'e yesus asa dedha na.

source_text: and as rebbe, melech hamoshiach was now approaching the path that makes the descent from the mount of olives, all the multitude of the rebbeʼs talmidim began with simcha joy and with a kol gadol a loud voice to shout baruch hashem for all the nifla'ot wonders and gevurot mighty deeds of hashem! for they had been edei reiyah eyewitnesses of these,
target_text: ropa na puru nèti ledhe saitun, ka dhèu se dènge ana-ana madhutu na, mulai pa'oo koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua, lula rèngu rèdhi le tadha-tadha koasa.

source_text: saying, baruch habah, hamelech b'shem adonoi! shalom b'shomayim! and kavod in the highest!
target_text: ra pa'oo peka na, nèngu ne, dhèu aae dhu ama lamatua pua mai! ama lamatua hia ne berkat! dhèu rai-haha limuri ne, bisa padame le dènge lamatua ètu sorga. koa-kio kolongara lamatua dhu madhèdi nèd'u paredha ètu dedha-liru dhu dedha risi.

source_text: and some of the perushim from the multitude said to him, rabbi, rebuke your talmidim!
target_text: te ngaa abhu kahèi dhèu-dhèu parisi ètu talora aae dhèu ae sèra. ka ra peka dènge yesus, ama mese! kai ku dhèu se, ho baku ra pakii-pakèce sèmi ne'e, te seli-kolane!

source_text: and in reply he said, i say to you, if these will be silent, the avanim stones will cry out.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, ja'a pasanèd'e mema! ladhe dhèu se'e kutu hèb'a ra, èèna na, hadhu se ka dhu koa-kio kolongara lamatua!

source_text: and as he came near, having seen the ir city of yerushalayim, rebbe, melech hamoshiach wept over it,
target_text: ropa rèngu oe dètu yerusalem, yesus ladhe nèdhi kota ne, hèia na tangi,

source_text: saying, if you had only had daas in hayom hazeh of the things leading to shalom, but now it was nistar from your eyes.
target_text: peka na, ira ii! dhèu yerusalem, ee! dad'èi ja'a deo ne'e, miu abhu dame dhu ja'a kèti mai. te ngaa lula miu pahae boe lamatua, ka miu unu heka. dame ne pakaj'èu le nèti miu.

source_text: because yamim days will come upon you when your oyevim enemies will construct a siege against you and they will surround you and will hem you in from all directions.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a musu miu mai udhu padedha rai palème li'u tedhe miu ne, hèia ra maso sa d'ara, musu dènge miu.

source_text: and they will dash you to the ground, you and your yeladim with you. and they will not leave an even stone upon an even stone within you, because you did not have daas of the zman time of your yom pekuddah visitation, reckoning.
target_text: ra dhedhe palaho kota miu, toke pamera dènge rai, hèia ra pamadhe aa'i miu dènge ana-ana mi. ra tèke eele boe hadhu cue sa dhu titu, lula miu mo'o boe tadhe lamatua lod'o na mai hia miu mamuri!

source_text: and having entered into the beis hamikdash, moshiach began to throw out the sellers,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus maso asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ètu madha èmu ne, dhèu tao sèmi pasa sa, ho ra pahia badha korban. ropa nèdhi, hèia yesus babège si nèti era èèna.

source_text: saying to them, it has been written, beiti beit tefillah yikarei, but you made it a mearat paritzim.
target_text: ka na jèke si, peka na, dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua dhu suri tèke le, peka na, ‘ja'a patitu èmu ne, ho dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa mai manèngi-mangaj'i ètu era ne'e. ' te ngaa mi tao ne nuka sèmi era pakaboko dhèu parapo.

source_text: and he was saying shiurim yom yom in the beis hamikdash. but the rashei hakohanim and the sofrim were seeking to kill him, and also the rashei haam,
target_text: èle èèna ka, bèli-bèli yesus la'e aj'a-nori dhèu ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. te ngaa kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra, patangi-tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: and they were not finding what they might do, for haam were all hanging on his every dvar.
target_text: te ngaa ra abhu boe j'ara, lula dhèu ae dhu d'èi titu kèna, nanene lii padhai yesus.

source_text: and it came about on one of the yamim rebbe, melech hamoshiach was saying shiurim to haam the people in the beis hamikdash and was preaching the besuras hageulah, the rashei hakohanim and the sofrim with the ziknei haam stood by;
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus la'e asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ka na aj'a-nori lii lolo be'a lamatua ètu èèna. hèia kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra, mai karèi ne.

source_text: they spoke, saying to him, tell us by what shlita authority you do these things, or who is the one having given to you this shlita?
target_text: ra peka na, mu peka ku laa! cee ka dhu hia èu hak sèna ka ad'u-ue maruru ètu ne'e med'a na?

source_text: in reply, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, i will also confront you will a she'elah, and you tell me:
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, ja'a neo karèi miu ca madha j'ara kahèi, heka ja'a dhaa lii karèi miu kèna.

source_text: the tevilah of teshuva of yochanan - was it from shomayim or from bnei adam?
target_text: sèmi ne'e: miu se tadhe yohanis tuka sarani dhèu, do? cee ka dhu hia ne koasa ho sarani dhèu? ama lamatua do, dhèu rai-haha?

source_text: and they reasoned to themselves saying, if we say, from shomayim, he will say, why did you not believe him?
target_text: hèia ra papeka èci dènge èci, ira ee! èdhi sèmi tare le pala ti ngaa. ladhe èdhi peka na, ‘ama lamatua ka pua', èèna na b'ala, aku nèngu na, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, nga tao ka miu lèka boe yohanis? '

source_text: but if we say, from bnei adam, haam the people all will subject us to sequilah stoning, for haam yisroel are all convinced that yochanan is a navi.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi dhaa, peka na, ‘dhèu rai-haha ka pua', na dhèu ae sèra pèci pamadhe èdhi. te dhèu sèra parcaya, na, yohanis ne dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua.

source_text: and they answered that they did not have daas of the origin of the tevilah of teshuva of yochanan.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i nge'a boe.

source_text: and rebbe melech hamoshiach said to them, neither am i telling you by what shlita authority i do these things.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ra, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a ko'o boe peka kahèi, cee ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: and he began to tell this mashal to haam yisroel. a certain ish planted a kerem and leased it to koremim vine keepers and he went away for a long time.
target_text: hèia yesus lolo dènge dhèu ae sèra, pake lii pakasame, peka na, abhu dhèu èci dhu sèle anggor ètu d'ara oka na. na hia dhèu seb'a oka anggor ne, sèna ka rèngu pabagi isi rai nèti oka-tedhe ne. ka na pidha la'e pea panèbhu asa rai kaj'èu.

source_text: and in season he sent to the koremim vine keepers an eved servant that from the pri of the kerem they will give to him. but the koremim vine keepers sent the eved away empty, having beaten him.
target_text: d'ai hèru puu-g'ètu, hèia lamatua oka anggor ne pua ana paleha na ca dhèu, la'e nare pala nèngu. te ngaa dhèu sab'a oka anggor se, game ana paleha ne, ka ra hia ne lèpa dènge ai hua.

source_text: and he proceeded to send another eved. but him also, when they had beaten and dishonored him, they sent him away empty.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua oka ne pua ana paleha na ca dhèu hari. te ngaa dhèu sab'a oka se game, ka ra pamakae ne. hèia ra babège ne lèpa dènge ai hua da'u-da'u.

source_text: and he proceeded to send an eved shlishi a third servant. and also this one, having wounded, they threw out.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua oka ne pua hari ana paleha na ka tèlu, te ngaa ra game ne, toke diu raa, ka ra core ne asa li'u oka.

source_text: and the adon of the kerem, said, what should i do? i will send beni ahuvi. perhaps this one they will respect.
target_text: hèia lamatua oka ne pangee ka, ‘ja'a tao hari ku tasamia? be'a risi ja'a pua ana pasue ja'a ka la'e. ele boe ra pakab'ua ne, de ra sèmi ne dènge be'a. ' de na pua ana d'èlu na la'e.

source_text: but having seen him, the koremim vine keepers were reasoning with one another saying, this one is the bechor, the heir. let us kill him, that the bechorah may become ours.
target_text: te ngaa ropa dhèu sab'a oka anggor se ladhe rèdhi ne, hèia ra papeka èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, ‘mi ladhe ku laa! te lamatua oka ne hia ana d'èlu na nuka mai nèi. nèngu ne ka dhu bèli-camèd'a unu pusaka ama na aa'i-aa'i ra. de ta pamadhe ne! sèna ka èdhi ka dhu unu oka anggor ne. '

source_text: and having driven him outside the kerem, they killed him. what then will the baal hakerem do to them?
target_text: ropa ana ne d'ai, hèia dhèu se nuni pa'oro ne rèti asa li'u oka, ka ra pamadhe ne. de ja'a neo karèi miu sèmi ne'e: miu pangee, na, lamatua oka ne tao dhèu sab'a oka sèra tasamia?

source_text: he will come and will destroy these koremim vine keepers and will give the kerem to others. and having heard this, haam yisroel said, chas vshalom!
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a, tatu na mai pamadhe aa'i si, ka na hia hari dhèu leo seb'a oka ne. ropa dhèu se tadèngi lii padhai yesus, rèngu peka na, ladhe bisa, na, ji'i baku abhu huku nèti ama lamatua sèmi èèna!

source_text: but having looked at them, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said, what then is this which has been written: even maasu haytah lerosh pinah the stone they rejected became the capstone?
target_text: hèia yesus laladhe patae si, ka na karèi, ladhe huku boe si sèmi èèna, nga tao ka dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua suri, na: ‘hadhu cue dhu tuka hadhu core eele le, te ngaa limuri ne dhu j'aj'i le era padhèdi agarii talora? '

source_text: everyone having fallen upon that even stone will be dakubroken into pieces, and upon whomever it falls, it will crush him.
target_text: dhèu dhu kadhunu lèke hadhu ne, nèngu tatu laho teb'o-teb'o, lula abhu huku. aa ladhe hadhu ne bèbhe lèke dhèu cee, nèngu laho kao-kao, lula lèke huku.

source_text: and the sofrim and the rashei hakohenim sought to lay their hands upon him in the same hour, but they were afraid of haam yisroel, for they knew that he spoke this mashal parable against them.
target_text: ropa mese agama dènge kètu agama yahudi se tadèngi lii lolo ne, rèngu re'a, na, yesus padhai lii padhèto dènge rèngu pake lii pakasame. rèngu se cakaraa dènge dhèu seb'a oka anggor deo sa. de ra nasa titu kèna. ka ra tenge j'ara ho neo kèpe ne. te ngaa rèngu madha'u dènge dhèu ae sèra, dhu d'èi nanene lii aj'a yesus. ka lasi tèke eele ne.

source_text: and having watched carefully, they sent spies pretending themselves to be tzaddikim, that they might catch him in his dvar, so as to deliver him to the rulers and the manhigim under the moshel governor.
target_text: èle ka, musu-musu yesus ma'u ne. rèngu tenge dhèu j'aj'i mata-mata dhu bisa tao iisi ra sèmi dhèu mola, sèna ka ra kèpe ne. rèngu sanao sèna ka yesus padhai lii dhu palab'a dènge dhèu paredha roma, ho èèna na lasi peka dènge gubernur, sèna ka ra pua dhèu lasi kèpe yesus.

source_text: and they set a she'elah question before him, saying, rabbi, we have daas that you speak beemes in the shiurim you say and you show no deference toward anyone, but on the basis of haemes you give torah about haderech hashem.
target_text: ka ra pua mata-mata, sèna ka pakarèi dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, ama mese! ji'i nge'a ama ca dhèu dhu d'ara mola. ama me'a boe kapod'e-kabèli, aa hag'e boe dhèu. ama aj'a-nori dhèu madhutu lii lolo be'a ama lamatua dènge mola.

source_text: is it mutar for us to pay tax to caesar or not?
target_text: de ji'i neo karèi ca j'ara: madhutu atora agama èdhi dhèu yahudi, hud'i ji'i b'ae ku doi bea mi dhèu aae kapai paredha roma, do aad'o?

source_text: but having noticed the ormahcunning, craftiness in their manner, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them,
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a le ngangee kaj'alu rèngu ho neo pamanahu ne. ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na,

source_text: show me a denarius. whose demut likeness has it? and whose inscription? and they said, caesarʼs.
target_text: pad'elo sèku ja'a doi iia cue. hèia ra pad'elo dènge ne doi èci. ka yesus karèi si, ne'e ne, rupa cee ka ne? aa ngara cee, ne? ra dhaa, peka na, èèna, dhèu aae kapai, keser.

source_text: and he said to them, then give the things of caesar to caesar and the things of hashem to hashem.
target_text: hèia yesus peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, hia asa dhèu paredha, ngaa dhu unu rèngu. aa hia mi ama lamatua ngaa dhu j'aj'i hak ama lamatua.

source_text: and they were not able to catch him in his dvar before the people and, having been nispoyel marveled at his teshuva answer, they were silent.
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, dhèu se malaa, lula rèngu bisa boe sii pamanahu rare ne ètu madha dhèu ae. ka hèb'a ra kutu mèno.

source_text: and some of the tzedukim - the tzedukim are the ones speaking against the techiyas hamesim, who say there is none - approached rebbe, melech hamoshiach. they set a she'elah question before him,
target_text: èle èèna ka, pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama saduki mai ho neo kèpe yesus. dhèu saduki aj'a, na, dhèu madhe mamuri heka ètu lod'o èle rai-haha ne. rèngu mai pakarèi dènge yesus, na,

source_text: saying, rabbi, moshe rabbenu laid it down in writing to us, if someoneʼs ach dies and has an isha, and uven ein lo and there is no son to him, that he should take the almanah of his ach and he should raise up a zera seed to his ach.
target_text: ama mese! atora musa dhu suri tèke hia èdhi, peka na: ladhe dhèu mone madhe, aa dhu dènge mèka kolo, na, ari nèti dhèu madhe ne madhèdi nare hari bhèni balu ne, sèna ka abhu kolo hia a'a dhu madhe ne.

source_text: now there were shiva achim. and the first took an isha, and died uven ein lo and there is no son to him.
target_text: mema uru èèna baki musa aj'a sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa ji'i neo karèi sèmi ne'e: ana mone dhèu pidhu dhu pa'a'ari. dhu uru leo-èmu, te ngaa madhe dènge boe ana.

source_text: and the second took her to be his isha, and he died childless.
target_text: hèia ari na todhe nare hari bhèni balu ne. nèbhu boe ka, na madhe, dhu dènge mèka kolo kahèi.

source_text: and the third took her; and likewise also the seventh did not leave behind a ben and they all died.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ana ka tèlu. na leo dènge bhèni balu ne, te ngaa madhe kahèi dènge boe ana. toke ari ra limuri tèka, madhe kahèi dènge boe kolo.

source_text: and lemaskana finally the isha died.
target_text: hèia bhèni balu ne madhe.

source_text: the isha, then, in the techiyas hamesim, of which of them does she become the wife? for shiva had her as isha wife.
target_text: de ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: bhèni ne leo nèdhi le dènge ana mone dhèu pidhu sèra. ladhe d'ai èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe sèra, bhèni ne j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu cee?

source_text: and rebbe melech hamoshiach said to them, the banim of the olam hazeh marry and are given in marriage:
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, peka na, dhèu dhodhoka paleo èmu ètu rai-haha ne di.

source_text: but the ones having been considered worthy to attain to the olam habah and the techiyas hamesim neither marry nor are given in marriage. for neither is it possible any longer for them to die, for they are like malachim and they are bnei haelohim, being bnei hatechiyas hamesim.
target_text: te ngaa ètu sorga dhèu paleo boe èmu. aa ètu era nèi, dhèu madhe heka. rèngu èci èèna ka dènge ana pajuu nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga. te, lod'o ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe, na hag'e nare si, sèna ka j'aj'i mi ana na.

source_text: but that the mesim are made to stand up alive, even moshe revealed at the burning bush, as he calls adonoi elohei avraham elohei yitzchak velohei ya'akov.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri baki musa, dhu lole aj'u iiki ca kapua dhu ai na'e, te ngaa kèpu boe. nèti lii lolo ne, èdhi te'a, na, dhèu madhe bisa mamuri hari. ètu èèna, ama lamatua peka dènge musa, na, ‘ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti baki èu dhu uru-uru sèra. nuka baki abraham, isak dènge yakob. rèngu se mangaj'i taa-taa mi ja'a toke d'ai sange ne'e ne. '

source_text: but hashem is not the g-d of mesim but is elohei hachayyim, for to hashem all are alive.
target_text: masi ka baki mu se madhe karèi jahi ali. te ngaa, lula ama lamatua ka dhu peka na, nèngu j'aj'i mi lamatua rèngu era, de èdhi te'a le, na, rèngu se mamuri era. de masi ka dhèu madhe le, te ngaa ra mamuri hari. te dhoka dhèu dhu mamuri di, dhu pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua; dhèu madhe, aad'o si!

source_text: and, in reply, some of the sofrim said, rabbi, you spoke well.
target_text: tadèngi yesus dhaa sèmi èèna, ka mese agama padhai lii, peka na, lii dhaa ama mese èèna, lèke kèna.

source_text: for no longer were they daring to set a she'elah question before him regarding anything.
target_text: nèti lod'o èèna, abhu heka ca dhèu sa dhu bani karèi yesus, lula abhu boe j'ara dhu bisa pamanahu rare ne.

source_text: and he said to them, how do they say that the rebbe melech hamoshiach is to be merely dovidʼs ben?
target_text: yesus aj'a-nori dhèu ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i era. ka na karèi dhèu sèra, peka na, madhutu a'abhu miu, tasamia? mese agama sèra, aj'a peka na, kristus èèna, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru-uru ka. madhutu a'aj'a rèngu, nèngu ne dhodhoka ana-èpu dhèu aae daud di. te ngaa èèna dhae d'ai mèka.

source_text: for dovid himself says in the book of tehillim, neum hashem ladoni: shev limini,
target_text: lula uru èèna, dhèu aae daud mesa na dhu suri le, ètu d'ara lii sod'a koa-kio, na, ‘ama lamatua peka le dènge lamatua ja'a, na, mai madhèdi mi era dhu kab'ua ètu babo g'ana ja'a ne.

source_text: ad ashit oyvecha hadom l'raglecha.
target_text: te bèli-camèd'a ja'a tao musu-musu èu, toke ra pahaha iisi mi èu. '

source_text: therefore, if dovid calls him adon, how is he merely ben dovid?
target_text: de nèti sasuri ne, èdhi te'a, na, dhèu aae daud mesa na paroa kristus ne, ‘lamatua'. sasoa na, ladhe dhèu peka na kristus ne dhoka ana-èpu nèti dhèu aae daud di, èèna dhae d'ai mèka! lula nèngu ne j'aj'i lamatua nèti dhèu aae daud kahèi!

source_text: in the hearing of all the people, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to his talmidim,
target_text: ropa dhèu aa'i-aa'i taru kira mi lii padhai yesus, hèia na peka dènge ana-ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na,

source_text: beware of the sofrim rabbonim, the ones wanting to strut around in long kaftans and loving birkat shalom greetings in the marketplaces and the rashei hamoshavot chief seats in the shuls and the places of kavod at seudos tishen,
target_text: baku pamud'e dènge mese agama sèra. te rèngu d'èi kako pake kodho robho rai, lasi paraga dènge dhèu ae, ho dhèu koa si, peka na, ‘rèngu se dhèu kapai! ' rèngu d'èi tenge era re madha ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a, ètu d'ara pesta, aa ètu era-era dhèu ae pakaboko.

source_text: which devour the batim houses of the almanot widows and for the sake of appearance daven lengthy tefillos prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.
target_text: de miu baku pamud'e, lula rèngu d'èi kapod'e-kabèli bhèni balu ho parame rare èmu ra. te ngaa ètu madha dhèu ae, rèngu pahuni bhabhelu ra dènge titu ho sabaj'a panèbhu-nèbhu. rèngu d'èi dhèu koa ra, peka na, rèngu dhèu mola. te ngaa lamatua ne'a sasala ra, de èèna na nèngu huku si bia risi.

source_text: and having looked up, rebbe, melech hamoshiach saw the ashirim rich people putting into the beis hamikdash otzar treasury their matanot gifts.
target_text: lod'o yesus aj'a ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ladhe nèdhi dhèu kaja mai pamaso doi asa d'ara boaraka derma.

source_text: and he saw a certain poor almanah widow putting in there two leptas.
target_text: ladhe nèdhi kahèi bhèni balu ca dhèu dhu unu boe ngaa-ngaa mai madhutu sabaj'a. na pamaso kahèi doi dua sen asa d'ara boaraka ne. doi na se'e, kab'ua ciki oo'e di.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said, omein, i say to you that this poor almanah widow put in more tzedakah than everyone.
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge ana madhutu na, peka na, nanene pabe'a-be'a! bhèni balu ne, dhoka pamaso doi dua sen di, te ngaa na hia risi nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: for all these put in matanot gifts out of their abundance, but this almanah widow, out of her need, put in her michyah subsistence.
target_text: dhèu leo se pamaso doi kolete nèti doi karisi rèngu. te ngaa bhèni balu ne hia aa'i mèu-mèu doi na tao mi doi kolete. masi ka nèti doi ne'e, nèngu ako taha mamuri.

source_text: and as some were speaking about the beis hamikdash, that with beautiful avanim stones and with matanot gifts it has been decorated, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said,
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana madhutu yesus dhu koa-kad'iri èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, peka na, ama! ladhe ku laa, èmu ne be'a titu kèna! ra pake hadhu cetak dhu kapai hua, ka ra paca'e mera titu kèna. aa dhèu hia kahèi mèdha ra dhu kab'ua, sèna ka pasaraga èmu lamatua ne! te ngaa yesus b'ala, na,

source_text: yamim days will come in which of these things which you see there will not be left an even stone upon an even stone which will not be thrown down.
target_text: èmu ne mema saraga. te ngaa nèbhu heka, dhèu paguri eela hadhu se, toke mera dènge rai.

source_text: and they questioned him, saying, rebbe, ad mosai? how much longer? when will these things be, and what will be the ot when these things are about to take place?
target_text: hèia ana madhutu yesus se karèi, peka na, ama mese! ngaa dhu ama peka-padhai deo na, j'aj'aj'i na pèri lod'o? ladhe lod'o na dètu le, tadha-tadha na sèmi ngaa sa?

source_text: and he said, beware, you should not be deceived. for many will come bishmi in my name saying, i am he. and, the time of the geulah has drawn near. do not follow after them.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sad'i miu j'aga paie-iie, ho baku lèke tipu. te èèna na rupa-rupa dhèu mai tèb'a kakara ra, peka na, ‘ja'a ne, kristus. ' abhu kahèi dhu peka na, ‘lod'o a'èle rai-haha dètu kèna! ' te ngaa baku mi parcaya kahèi!

source_text: but whenever you hear about wars and intifadas, do not be a pachdan coward. for it is necessary for these things to occur barishonah, but it is not immediately haketz.
target_text: ladhe miu tadèngi ka dhèu palolo, peka na: dhèu patao-palaha, dènge papara-pakèj'i ètu mia-mia, baku mi cag'ag'a. sèra sa hud'i j'aj'i uru ku. te ngaa d'ai mèka lod'o èle rai-haha ne.

source_text: then he was saying to them, ethnic group will have an intifada against ethnic group, and malchut against malchut,
target_text: bèli-camèd'a suku èci pamusu dènge suku leo. negara èci papara-pakèj'i dènge negara leo.

source_text: there will be great earthquakes and in various places, raav famine and makkot plagues, both horrible portents and great moftim signs in shomayim.
target_text: èèna na, j'aj'i rai opo dhu kapai aae. ètu mia-mia, manganga-mad'èu dhu seli eele, aa èi papèd'a pad'ai cèu palème era. bèli-camèd'a dhèu ladhe rèdhi kahèi tadha dhu pamadha'u dhèu, aa tadha-tadha dhu kapai aae ètu dedha-liru.

source_text: but before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and bring redifot persecutions on you, handing you over to the shuls and the batei hasohar prisons, being led away before melachim kings and moshelim governors because of my name yehoshua, yeshua.
target_text: j'ara se'e se j'aj'i aa'i mèka, te ngaa èèna na dhèu mai kèpe rare miu, aa paj'èra miu, lula miu parcaya ja'a. hèia ra soro miu asa dhèu dhu uri lii langu ètu d'ara èmu-èmu sabaj'a, aa ra taha miu ètu d'ara bèdho. ra rèti miu asa madha dhèu aae-dhèu aae, dènge dhèu paredha leo. aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i, lula miu madhutu ja'a.

source_text: it will turn out for you to be an opportunity for being an eidus witness to the edut testimony.
target_text: te ngaa miu hud'i pake lod'o ne'e, sèna ka peka dènge rèngu lii lolo be'a ja'a.

source_text: therefore, keep in your levavot hearts not to prepare to defend yourselves.
target_text: de mage pangee tasamia miu siri iisi.

source_text: for i will give to you a peh mouth and chochmah which none of your mitnaggedim will be able to resist or to contradict.
target_text: te lod'o èèna, ja'a hia miu lii-lii dhu pamèci dènge lii dhaa. dènge sèmi èèna, musu miu sèra, re'a heka peka-padhai sèmi ngaa hari.

source_text: and you will be handed over also by horim and achim and krovey mishpachot relatives and chaverim friends, and they will have some of you executed and you will die al kiddush ha-shem, and you will be the focus of sinas chinom baseless hatred from everyone because of my name yehoshua, yeshua.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a dhèu tèka d'ara dènge miu, lula miu madhutu ja'a. abhu nèti a'ari miu unu mi, sèmi ina-ama, a'ari, kera ba'i, rae lesa dènge mone anga-aangalai. èèna na nèti rèngu se'e ka, tenge j'ara ho pahie eele miu, toke ra pamadhe miu cahag'e.

source_text: and not even a hair of your rosh will by any means perish.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku madha'u, te lamatua bhèlu boe miu. rèu kètu miu ca loa sa kabhui eele boe, ladhe dènge boe dad'èi na.

source_text: in your savlanut patience and endurance you will gain your nefashot souls.
target_text: ladhe miu taha mere taruu, tatu ama lamatua pala-bagi mamuri hia miu.

source_text: but when you see yerushalayim being surrounded by machanot encamping armies, then have daas that the sho'ah of it has drawn near.
target_text: yesus padhai lii tabha hari, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu mèdhi ka sordad'u mai pamusu reo rare yerusalem, miu me'a le, na, d'ai lod'o ele iie yerusalem kèna.

source_text: then the ones in yehudah, flee to the mountains, and the ones inside hair the city, let them get out, and the ones in the sadot fields, let them not enter into hair the city,
target_text: ropa ladhe mèdhi sèmi èèna, dhèu ètu propensi yudea rai dènge ka asa ledhe-ledhe. dhèu ètu d'ara kota kèd'i kahèi, sèna ka rai. aa dhèu ètu rae, mai ia ka asa d'ara kota.

source_text: because these are the yemei nekamah days of vengeance, as a fulfillment of all the kitvei hakodesh.
target_text: te lamatua hia lod'o-lod'o sasusa sèra, ho huku dhèu-dhèu dhu ro'o boe nanene nèngu. se'e se lèke nuka sèmi lii padhai nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu suri tèke karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: oy to the ones with child and to the ones nursing in yamim hahem those days. for there will be tzarah gedolah great tribulation upon eretz yisroel and kaas anger against this people,
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu dhu j'èra risi, nuka, dhèu bhèni dhu dènge babia, aa ina-ina dhu dènge ana susu. lod'o èèna, abhu susa palème rai-haha, aa dhèu yahudi j'èra bia, lula ama lamatua nasa dènge rèngu sèra.

source_text: and they will fall by the edge of the cherev sword and they will all be led captive into the golus, and yerushalayim will be trampled down by the goyim, until the times of the goyim are fulfilled.
target_text: èèna na musu mai pamadhe si cahag'e, aa taha cahag'e ho j'aj'i ènu ètu mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne. ka dhèu leo rai kara dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua, mai j'aj'èli pakaj'alu kota yerusalem, aa koasa rare kabarai na, toke èle lod'o ra.

source_text: and there will be otot miraculous signs in the shemesh sun and the levanah moon and the kochavim stars, and upon the earth there will be dismay among the goyim, in perplexity at the sound of the sea and the waves;
target_text: èle ka yesus lole mamai hari na, aku nèngu na, bèli-camèd'a ladhe dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a neo mai hari, abhu tadha ètu madha lod'o, hèru, dènge hua hètu-hua hètu. ètu rai-haha ne abhu tadha kahèi, sèmi uli sea, dhasi ko'a dhu loe boe, aa naha aae lalulu mai. se'e se tao dhèu rai-haha ne, madha'u dènge ele ngangee, toke re'a heka tao ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: bnei adam will be fainting from pachad terror and from expectation of the things coming upon the olam hazeh, for the kochot powers of the heavens will be shaken.
target_text: koasa-koasa ètu dedha-liru loe boe karèbha. ropa ladhe rèdhi aa'i-aa'i, hèia ra madha'u titu kèna, lula rai-haha ne oe ele iie kèna!

source_text: and then you will see the bar enosh and his bias hamoshiach on an anan cloud with gevurah miraculous power of hashem and kavod rav great glory.
target_text: èle ku heka dhèu ladhe rèdhi ja'a kèna, ‘dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne puru mai ètu d'ara ra'i-liru'. ja'a mai dènge koasa, aa dènge dadedha dhu kapai risi eele.

source_text: and when the reshit the beginning of these things occurs, stand erect and lift up your roshim heads, because your geulah redemption draws near.
target_text: ladhe mulai j'aj'i ka tadha sèra, na, miu boti ka kètu miu, te lod'o d'ai kèna, lamatua hia mamuri mi miu.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach told a mashal parable to them. you see the etz te'enah fig tree and all the etz.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lolo pake lii pakasame, aku nèngu na, miu taru kira pabe'a-be'a ku mi aj'u sèra.

source_text: when they sprout leaves already, you see for yourselves and you have daas that kayits summer is already near.
target_text: ladhe d'ai ka hèru rèu ra karara, èèna tadha na hèru hadhu dètu le.

source_text: so also you, when you see these things happening, you have daas that the malchut hashem is near.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge lod'o-lod'o sasusa. ladhe cèu, èèna tadha na paredha ama lamatua dhu dètu iiki le.

source_text: omein, i say to you, that hador hazeh will not pass away until all these things may occur.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e mema miu! nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri limuri ne, bèli-camèd'a cahag'e dhae madhe mèka, te lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra se mai le.

source_text: hashomayim and haaretz will pass away, but my devarim will by no means pass away.
target_text: masi ka liru dènge rai-haha ele, te ngaa lii holo-nori ja'a taha taa-taa.

source_text: and be shomer regarding yourselves lest your levavot hearts may be burdened with dissipation and drunkenness and the cares of the olam hazeh and yom hahu that day may come upon you pitomsuddenly.
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, mi j'aga-j'aga, te cag'ag'a laa ja'a mai hari sahèka! mage dhoka miu taru kira heka, hèia miu mamuri dènge minu mahu, aa bhute dhoka tenge mamuri karej'e di. mage dhoka miu me'a boe tadha ne, lula miu bhute dènge j'ara dhu leo.

source_text: for as a mokesh trap it will come upon all the ones dwelling on the pnei kol haaretz the face of all the earth.
target_text: ladhe ja'a lèpa hari mai, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa pahuni iisi ra nèti madha ja'a.

source_text: but be shomer on guard, alert, always davening that you may be able to escape all these things that are about to happen and that you may be able to stand before the bar enosh.
target_text: de miu hud'i mate tatae ku. baku ma'ète manèngi-mangaj'i, sèna ka miu bisa taha ètu talora aae sasusa sèra. dènge sèmi èèna, ropa ja'a lèpa hari mai, miu makae boe titu ètu madha dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne.

source_text: now in those days rebbe, melech hamoshiach was saying shiurim in the beis hamikdash, and balailah at night he was going out into the har hazeytim.
target_text: bèli-bèli, ladhe re mèu, yesus la'e aj'a lii holo-nori lamatua ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. te ngaa ladhe re mèda, kalua nèti yerusalem ho la'e bhèj'i asa rae ètu ledhe saitun.

source_text: and all the people were getting up early in the boker to come to rebbe, melech hamoshiach in the beis hamikdash to hear him.
target_text: mad'ae aae era, dhèu ae-ae dhu mai le pakaboko ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho nanene lii aj'a-nori na.

source_text: and the chag hamatzot was approaching, the feast called pesach.
target_text: lod'o èèna, oe d'ai lod'o hua iia dhèu yahudi, nuka pesta roti dhu dènge boe ragi. ètu d'ara lod'o hua iia se, ra roro kahib'i-kalèbho tao kalela paska kahèi. rèngu tao sèmi ne'e, sèna ka pasanèd'e uru èèna, lod'o bèi-baki rèngu kalua nèti masir.

source_text: and the rashei hakohanim and the sofrim were seeking how they might destroy him, for they were afraid of the people.
target_text: lod'o èèna, kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra tenge j'ara ho pamadhe yesus. te ngaa ra mage dhèu ae sèra maruru, lula dhèu se d'èi nanene ne.

source_text: and hasatan entered into yehudah, the one being called yehudah from k'riot, being one of the shneym asar.
target_text: nèti dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus, dhèu canguru dua sèra, èci ngara na yudas iskariot. lod'o kètu agama yahudi sèra tenge j'ara ho pamadhe yesus, dhèu aae nidhu maso asa d'ara yudas iskariot.

source_text: and having departed, yehudah spoke with the rashei hakohanim and ketzinim officers of the beis hamikdash how he might hand him over to them.
target_text: hèia la'e tenge kètu agama yahudi se dènge kètu nèti dhèu madhenga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. la'e neo pane'a dènge ra, sèna ka pahie yesus dènge rèngu.

source_text: and they got a lot of geshmak out of this, and they agreed to pay him kesef.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai yudas, hèia ra karej'e titu kèna. ra pamoa, peka na, la'a, ma! ladhe èu neo pahie yesus dènge ji'i, na ji'i b'ae.

source_text: and yehudah consented and he was seeking an opportunity to betray him when there was no multitude with them.
target_text: ka yudas d'èi, hèia na mulai tenge lod'o dhu lake nare, sèna ka dhèu ae baku re'a nèngu pahie eele yesus.

source_text: shoin already now came the yom hamatzot, in which it was necessary to sacrifice the pesach korban, the seh lamb.
target_text: hèia d'ai ka lod'o hua iia dhèu yahudi, dhu rèngu biasa roro ana kahib'i-kalèbho sèna ka tao kalela paska.

source_text: and he sent kefa and yochanan, having said, go and make our preparations that we may eat and have the pesach seder.
target_text: ka yesus pua petrus dènge yohanis, aku nèngu na, dua mi lami uuru, sèna ka sadia tèke nganga'a kalela paska ho ta'a sama-sama.

source_text: and they said to rebbe, melech hamoshiach, where do you wish that we should prepare it?
target_text: ka dua ra karèi, ama! ji'i la'a sadia nganga'a asa mia?

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, hinei. when you enter into hair, you will meet a man carrying a jar of mayim. follow him into the bais house into which he enters,
target_text: hèia na b'ala, ladhe miu maso asa d'ara kota yerusalem, pe miu paraga dènge dhèu mone ca dhèu dhu pasae g'ala èi cue. madhutu ne toke d'ai èmu na.

source_text: and you will say to the baal bayit, the rebbe says to you, where is the mekom linah guest room where i may conduct the pesach seder with my talmidim?
target_text: peka dènge lamatua èmu ne, ‘ama mese ji'i manèngi ca kama, ho neo pake tao kalela paska dènge ana-ana madhutu na. abhu, do? '

source_text: and that one will show you a large aliyyah having been furnished: there prepare the seder.
target_text: èèna na lamatua èmu ne pad'elo dènge miu kama èci dhu taleo ètu èmu dedha. nèngu lalau pamèci nare aa'i le kama èèna. ate dhoka miu dua mi lami sadia nganga'a ètu èèna.

source_text: and having departed, they found things just as he had told them, and they prepared the seder.
target_text: ka dua ra lasi. hèia ra paraga ka nuka sèmi ngaa dhu yesus peka le. ka dua ra sadia nganga'a-nganginu kalela paska ètu nèi.

source_text: and when the hour came, he reclined at tish and the moshiachʼs shlichim were with him.
target_text: ropa lalau rare aa'i, yesus si mai. yesus madhèdi ètu mei, aa ana-ana pajuu-paleha na madhèdi kahèi ra'a pesta.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, with great tshuka deep and sincere desire, longing i have desired to eat this pesach with you before i suffer.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge si, ja'a d'èi titu kèna madhèdi ku'a kalela paska dènge miu aa'i-aa'i mi, uru nèti ja'a abhu j'aj'èra.

source_text: for i say to you, i may by no means eat it until it is fulfilled in the malchut hashem.
target_text: patadhe pabe'a-be'a. te èle ne'e ne, ja'a madhèdi heka ku'a kalela paska dènge miu. ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a mèu ku, peka na, ama ku nèd'u paredha, ja'a heka ku'a hari kèna.

source_text: and having taken the cup of redemption, having made the bracha, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said, take this, and share it among yourselves.
target_text: hèia na kèpe nare galaa cue dhu isi èi anggor. ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, èle ka na soro galaa ne asa rèngu. hèia na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, sèmi mere galaa ne, ho èci-èci minu.

source_text: for i say to you, from now on by no means shall i drink from the p'ri hagefen until the malchut hashem comes.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! karèi nèti mèda ne'e ne, ja'a kinu heka èi anggor. ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a mèu ka, peka na, ama ku nèd'u paredha, ja'a heka kinu hari kèna.

source_text: and having taken the afikoman and having made the hamotzi, rebbe, melech hamoshiach broke the matzah and gave it to them, saying, this is my basar being given for you: this do in zikaron remembrance of me.
target_text: hèia na kèpe nare roti cue, ka manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka na pamae roti ne, hèia na soro sa rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra. ka na peka, roti ne'e ne, ngi'u aae ja'a dhu ja'a hia sa miu aa'i-aa'i mi. lod'o-lod'o dhu miu mi'e ne, pasanèd'e taruu miu, lula tatao ja'a.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach took the kos cup similarly after they ate, saying, this kos cup is habrit hachadasha in my dahm, being shed for you.
target_text: ropa ra'a rare, ka na ded'e nare galaa dhu isi èi anggor. hèia na lii, peka na, èi anggor ne'e ne, raa ja'a ka ne, dhu bhori mai sèna ka hia sod'a-mole mi miu. nèti raa ne'e ka, ama lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dhu hiu dènge miu.

source_text: nevertheless, hinei, the hand of the one betraying me is with me on the tish table.
target_text: mage pamud'e, te abhu dhèu dhu madhèdi sama-sama dènge èdhi ètu mei ne, èèna na, nèngu pahie eele ja'a.

source_text: because the bar enosh indeed goes according to the thing having been determined: but oy to that man through whom he is betrayed.
target_text: mema ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, hud'i madhe ku madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu pahie eele ja'a, sanèd'e, ee! te bèli-camèd'a, nèngu pasae nare mamadhe-mamopo!

source_text: and they began to discuss among themselves who then it might be among them that would do this.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi lii ne, ana-ana pajuu-paleha se pakarèi, peka na, cee ka dhu ad'u-ue madha j'ara bhelu ne mi dedha na?

source_text: and there came about also a dispute among them, as to which of them seemed to be the gadol.
target_text: ka ana madhutu yesus se pasisu, peka na, nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, cee ka dhu dhèu re madha.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, the melachim kings of the goyim domineer them and the ones having shlita control over the goyim are called benefactors.
target_text: te ngaa yesus kai si, peka na, ètu rai-rai dhu kabarai ra tadhe boe lamatua, dhèu aae ra hia paredha dhu bia risi mi kabarai rèngu. te ngaa rèngu neo sèna ka kabarai paroa rèngu, peka na, ‘ama dhu taru kira kabarai'.

source_text: but with you it is not so, but he of the gedolim among you, let him be as the youngest, and he of the manhigim, as the one serving.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku madhutu j'ara sèra. cee dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai, mamuri na hud'i tare'a-re'a sama sèmi dhèu haha ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra. dhu neo j'aj'i kètu, hud'i ladhe-leru ku sama sèmi ana pua-paleha.

source_text: for who is hagadol? the one reclining at tish or the one serving? is it not the one reclining at tish? but i am in your midst as one serving.
target_text: miu pangee sèku, dhèu kapai sèra nuka mia? dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu mei, do, dhu lalau mei? tatu dhèu dhu madhèdi ne, dhèu kapai, si? te ngaa ja'a ne, tao boe ngi'u sèmi sèra. ja'a mai lalau-lalo'o miu.

source_text: but you are the ones having remained with me in my nisyonos temptations.
target_text: miu se'e ka dhu bera-bera dènge ja'a, lod'o ja'a paraga dènge j'aj'èra.

source_text: and i assign shlita authority to you, just as avi assigned shlita to me; a malchut kingdom,
target_text: ama ku ded'e le ja'a, sèna ka kèd'u paredha ètu era paredha na. ka limuri ne, ja'a ded'e miu kahèi,

source_text: that you may eat and drink at my tish in my malchut, and you will sit upon kissot thrones judging the shneym asar shivtei yisroel twelve tribes of yisroel.
target_text: ho miu bèli-camèd'a madhèdi mi'a dènge ja'a ca mei ètu sorga. ja'a hia koasa kahèi, sèna ka miu paredha canguru dua suku dhèu isra'el.

source_text: shim'on, shim'on, hinei, hasatan asked for you, to sift you like wheat.
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge petrus, peka na, petrus. dhèu aae nidhu neo hia miu pacèri nèti ja'a, nuka sèmi dhèu tatai ho hag'e eele èto nèti laludhu.

source_text: but i davened for you, that your emunah may not fail: and when you have made teshuva, give chizzuk to your achim b'moshiach.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a sabaj'a hia èu, petrus, ho èu lèka ja'a taruu. ladhe èu lèpa hari mai asa ja'a, na, èu hud'i pa'èra ku d'ara a'ari èu, nuka dhèu unu lamatua sèra.

source_text: but shim'on kefa said to him, adoni, with you i am prepared even to go to the beis hasohar, even to die al kiddush ha-shem.
target_text: hèia petrus b'ala, aku nèngu na, aad'o, ama! masi ka tasamia èèna ka, ja'a bisa boe tèke eele ama. te ja'a pa'èra maso bui sama-sama dènge ama. masi ka ja'a madhe palere-lere dènge ama, ngaa-ngaa tao boe.

source_text: but rebbe, melech hamoshiach said, i say to you, a tarnegol will not crow hayom until shalosh pe'amim you, kefa, will make hakhchashah denial of your daas of me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka na, petrus! nanene paie. mèda ne'e kahèi, manu dhae kokotoo mèka, èu pasili le tèlu hari, na, èu tadhe boe ja'a.

source_text: he said to them, when i sent you without a money belt and a bag and sandals, did you lack anything? and they said, nothing.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus padhai lii dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ca hari na, ja'a pua miu lami lole lii lolo be'a ja'a asa mia-mia, ja'a peka dènge miu, ho baku mèti doi, tas, dènge salapa. lod'o èèna, miu kura ngaa? ka aa'i-aa'i ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ca hari na, ji'i kura boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa!

source_text: rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, but now the one having a money belt, let him take it; likewise also a bag; and the one not having, let him sell his kaftan and let him buy a cherev.
target_text: hèia yesus peka tabha hari, na, te ngaa limuri ne, leo. ladhe miu dènge doi, na todhe mèti. ladhe dènge tas, na mèti kahèi. ladhe dènge boe samala, pahia kodho miu, sèna ka hèli.

source_text: for i say to you, that it is necessary that what stands written be fulfilled in me, ves posheim nimnahand with lawless persons he was numbered. for indeed what was written about me is being fulfilled.
target_text: te dhèu yahudi pangee na, ja'a ne dhèu bhelu. hèia nèbhu heka, rèngu mai kèpe ja'a. j'ara ne, nuka sèmi dhu baki yesaya suri tèke le: ‘ra tao ne sèmi dhèu bhelu-katub'a! '

source_text: and they said, adoni, hinei, here are shtei charavot two swords. and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, it is enough.
target_text: ka ra peka na, ama! ji'i ngèti hela dua. hèia yesus peka, d'ai le. ale ia ka sèra!

source_text: and having gone out, he went according to his kvius regimen to the har hazeytim, and his talmidim followed him also.
target_text: ra'a rare paska, ka yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi asa ledhe saitun, sèmi biasa.

source_text: and having come to the place, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, daven and offer tefillos, lest you enter lidey nisayoninto temptation.
target_text: d'ai nèi, yesus peka dènge si, miu hud'i sabaj'a ku, ho baku lèke dadugu-rariu.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach had withdrawn from them about a stoneʼs throw, and, having fallen down, he was davening,
target_text: hèia na tèke eele si, la'e kaj'èu boe. ka na patitu kètu urutuu na, ho sabaj'a, peka na,

source_text: saying, avi, im yirtzeh hashem, if you are willing, take this kos cup away from me. nevertheless not the ratzon of me but rtzonecha thy will be done.
target_text: ama! ladhe ama d'èi na, pakaj'èu ku j'aj'èra ne nèti ja'a. te ngaa mage madhutu dad'èi ja'a; hud'i laa madhutu dhoka dad'èi ama di.

source_text: and a malach min hashomayim appeared to him, strengthening him.
target_text: ka ana pajuu ama lamatua èci mai nèti sorga pa'èra d'ara na.

source_text: and having been in agony, rebbe, melech hamoshiach was davening more fervently; and his sweat became like drops of dahm falling down upon the adamah.
target_text: lula d'ara na j'èra titu kèna, toke èi kabhèsu na suti sèmi raa sa.

source_text: and having got up from davening and having come to the talmidim, he found them sleeping, because of agmat nefesh grief.
target_text: ropa sabaj'a nare, na kèd'i la'e paraga dènge ana madhutu na. te ngaa rèngu dhu bhèj'i, lula ngi'u roe aa d'ara susa.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to them, why are you sleeping? get up, daven, lest you enter lidey nisayon into temptation.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ra, tasamia ka miu se bhèj'i? be'a risi miu sabaj'a, ho ladhe paraga dènge dadugu-rariu, miu baku manahu.

source_text: yet as he was speaking, hinei, a multitude! and going at their head was the one being called yehudah, one of the shneym asar, and he drew near to rebbe melech hamoshiach to give him a neshikah kiss.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii era, yudas ca dhèu nèti canguru dua ana madhutu na, mai dènge dhèu ae-ae. na mai padètu-dètu dènge yesus, neo kèpe ho uu ne.

source_text: and rebbe melech hamoshiach said to him, yehudah, do you with a neshikah the bar enosh betray?
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii dènge ne, peka na, yudas! èu neo pahie eele dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a dènge a'uu, do?

source_text: but having seen what was coming, the ones around rebbe, melech hamoshiach said, adoni, should we strike with the cherev sword?
target_text: ropa ana madhutu leo sèra re'a tatao bhelu nèti yudas ne, ka ra karèi yesus, peka na, ama! ji'i lab'a si, do? te ji'i dhu ngèti hela.

source_text: and a certain one of them struck the eved servant of the rashei hakohanim and cut off his right ear.
target_text: ka ca dhèu nèti rèngu se, bete hela na, ka na pare pama'ète rèu dhilu g'ana nèti dhèu èci. dhèu ne, ènu nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: and, in reply, rebbe melech hamoshiach said, blaib shtein! stop! no more of this! and having touched the ear, he healed him.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa si, peka na, sange èèna ka! baku lab'a si. hèia na g'ag'e dhilu dhèu ne, ka pa'èle.

source_text: and rebbe melech hamoshiach said to the ones having come against him, the rashei hakohanim and the beis hamikdash shomrim and the ziknei haam, do you have the chutzpah to come out as against a ganav thief with charavot and clubs?
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu mai kèpe yesus, nuka: kètu agama yahudi sèra, dhèu heka d'ara rae, kètu nèti dhèu madhenga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, dènge dhèu leo hari kahèi. yesus karèi si, tasamia? miu se ngee, na, ja'a ne dhèu bhelu, ka mai kèpe ja'a mèti samala dènge aj'u cèki, do?

source_text: yom yom daily i was with you in the beis hamikdash and you did not stretch out your hands against me, but this is your hour and the shlita of choshech power of evil, sitra ahra.
target_text: bèli-bèli èèna, ja'a aj'a miu ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, te ngaa abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu mai kèpe ja'a. de hud'i laa! ne'e d'ai lod'o miu. ne'e ne mai nèti koasa dhèu aae nidhu!

source_text: and having seized rebbe, melech hamoshiach, they led him away and brought him into the bais of the kohen gadol. and kefa was following from a distance.
target_text: hèia ra kèpe rare lamatua yesus, ka nuni rèti ne asa èmu kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. petrus kako mau-mau re kabodho.

source_text: and some kindled a hadlakah bonfire in the middle of the courtyard, and having sat down together, kefa was sitting in their midst.
target_text: ètu madha èmu ne, dhèu tao ai raci. hèia petrus la'e manyiru ai kahèi.

source_text: and a certain shifcha, seeing him sitting in the light of the hadlakah bonfire, staring intently at kefa, said, and this one was with him.
target_text: ka bhèni sab'a ca dhèu ladhe nèdhi petrus dhu manyiru ai. na ladhe patae rèhu petrus, ka peka dènge dhèu leo ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, dhèu ne'e ne dhu madhutu yesus kahèi!

source_text: but kefa denied it, saying, i do not have daas of him, isha.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pasili, ka na peka, aad'o! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu ne. èu me'a ngaa?

source_text: and after a short while, another, having seen him, said, and you are of them! but kefa said, man, i am not!
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, ca dhèu ladhe sa petrus, èle ka na lii, aku nèngu na, tare'a. èu ne, mema ca dhèu nèti dhèu yesus sèra, si? te ngaa petrus pasili, ka na peka, aad'o! èu peka leli na!

source_text: and about one hour had passed, and still another was insisting, saying, beemes in actuality this one was with him also, for he also is a gelili inhabitant of the galil!
target_text: pe d'ai ca jam sa, ca dhèu leo hari, peka na, ja'a ke'a dhèu ne'e ne, ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu yesus. te nèngu ne, dhèu galilea kahèi.

source_text: but kefa said, ben adam, i do not have daas what you are saying. and immediately, while kefa was speaking, a tarnegol crowed.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pasili hari kahèi, aku nèngu na, èu monya èèna! ropa petrus padhai lii sèmi èèna, kaca'a laa manu kokotoo.

source_text: and having turned, adoneinu looked at kefa, and kefa was reminded of the dvar of moshiach adoneinu when he said to him, before the tarnegol crows hayom today you will make hakhchashah denial of me shalosh pe'amim.
target_text: hèia yesus kabib'a sa nèngu. ka petrus sanèd'e lii yesus deo na, dhu peka na, mèda ne'e ne kahèi, manu dhae kokotoo mèka, te èu pasili le ja'a tèlu hari kèna.

source_text: and having gone outside kefa wept bitterly.
target_text: ngee nèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia petrus kalua nèti madha èmu ne, dènge tangi dhu d'ara laho mae-mae.

source_text: and the men, the ones having rebbe, melech hamoshiach in custody, were ridiculing and beating him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu dhu j'aga yesus, padhai lii pahaha ne, dènge game pa'oke ne.

source_text: and having blindfolded him, they were setting a she'elah in front of him, saying, give a dvar nevuah, who is the one having given you a klap blow?
target_text: ra pahutu rèhu na pake bèla, ka ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, wee! ladhe èu ne dhèu mèti lii padhai lamatua, na, èu peka sèku! cee ka dhu j'ubhu èu?

source_text: and with much other chillul hashem gadfanut they were speaking against rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: èle ka, ra padhèd'a aape ne.

source_text: and when boker came, the ziknei haam were gathered together, both the rashei hakohanim and the sofrim, and they led him away to their sanhedrin,
target_text: mad'ae aae era, kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra, pakaboko le uri lii langu yesus. ka ra pua dhèu lasi nuni rèti yesus asa era pama'ète lii langu agama.

source_text: saying, if you are the rebbe melech hamoshiach, tell us. but he said to them, if i say this to you, you will by no means have emunah.
target_text: ropa yesus maso, ka ra karèi ne, èu peka ku laa! èu ne, tare'a kristus, do? hèia na b'ala, peka na, masi ka ja'a dhaa na tare'a, miu se lèka boe.

source_text: and if i set a she'elah before you, you will by no means give answer.
target_text: aa ladhe ja'a bari miu ca madha j'ara, tatu miu dhaa boe.

source_text: but from now on the bar enosh will be yoshev limin at the gevurat hashem.
target_text: nèbhu heka ama lamatua pake koasa na dhu kapai èèna, ded'e padedha-dedha ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. ho èèna na, ja'a madhèdi ètu baboa g'ana na, sèna ka paredha sama-sama dènge ne.

source_text: and everyone said, then you are the ben haelohim? rebbe, melech hamoshiach said, you are saying that i am.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka aa'i-aa'i ra karèi, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, èu ngee, na, èu ne ana ama lamatua, do? ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a, sèmi dhu miu peka na.

source_text: and to them they said, why still do we have need of an eidus witness? for we ourselves heard from his peh mouth!
target_text: hèia dhèu dhu uri lii langu se, aa'i-aa'i peka, na, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti tadèngi le, si? na ded'e iisi na, j'aj'i ana ama lamatua. ne'e ne lii pahahe kolongara ama lamatua! madhutu atora agama èdhi, ladhe dhèu tao iisi ra nuka sèmi lamatua, dhèu ne hud'i madhe ku. de tasamia? èdhi parluu heka sakasii. huku pamadhe ne!

source_text: and the whole multitude of them got up and led rebbe, melech hamoshiach before pilate.
target_text: masi ka dhèu uri lii langu agama yahudi sèra pama'ète rare le sèna ka huku pamadhe yesus, te ngaa rèngu dènge boe hak ho huku pamadhe dhèu. nèti èèna ka, lere rèti yesus asa madha gubernur nèti paredha roma, dhu ètu èèna nuka pilatus. rèngu d'èi ladhe gubernur ka dhu huku ne.

source_text: and they began to accuse him saying, this one we found misleading our nation and making it asur to pay taxes to caesar and calling himself moshiach and that he is to be a melech.
target_text: de ropa d'ai madha gubernur, ra lole sasala yesus èci-èci, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, tuka lab'a paredha roma. na aj'a peka na, dhèu baku b'ae bea sa dhèu paredha. na ded'e iisi na, peka na, nèngu ne, kristus, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi.

source_text: and pilate cross-examined him, saying, are you the melech hayehudim? and in reply, he said to him, you say so?
target_text: tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, ka gubernur karèi ne, peka na, tare'a, do? èu ne, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi, do? hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a. sèmi lii padhai ama.

source_text: and pilate said to the rashei hakohanim and the multitudes, i find no ashmah guilt in this man.
target_text: parisa èle ka, gubernur ladhe sa kètu agama yahudi, dènge dhèu ae sèra. ka na lii, peka na, sèmi ne'e. ja'a abhu boe sasala dhèu ne ciki sa hèi.

source_text: but they were insisting, saying, he incites the people, from where he began with his torah teaching, throughout all of yehudah, from the galil even to this place.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu se pakadhii taruu, aku rèngu na, aad'o, ama gubernur. dhèu ne la'e aj'a sa mia-mia, ho kakèj'i kabarai, sèna ka palab'a dènge dhèu paredha. na tao maruru mulai nèti propensi galilea toke d'ai kota yerusalem ne'e.

source_text: and when pilate heard this, he asked whether the man was a gelili an inhabitant of the galil.
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia gubernur karèi si, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, nèngu ne dhèu galilea, do? ka dhèu se dhaa, tare'a. nèngu nèti galilea.

source_text: and having learned that he is under the jurisdiction of herod, he sent him to herod, who was also in yerushalayim during those days.
target_text: ropa ne'a nare sèmi èèna, hèia gubernur pua lere rèti yesus asa dhèu aae herodes, dhu paredha propensi galilea. lod'o èèna, nèngu ètu kota yerusalem.

source_text: and herod, having laid eyes on rebbe melech hamoshiach, had great simcha. for he was for a long time wanting to see him, because he keeps hearing things about him and was hoping to watch some ot miraculous sign being performed by him.
target_text: herodes ne, dhu tadèngi ae le, dhèu palolo tatao yesus, aa nèbhu le neo paraga dènge ne kahèi. nèngu dhu sanao-maena bisa nèdhi dènge madha na tadha malaa èci-dua sa nèti yesus. nèti èèna ka, lod'o lere rèti yesus asa nèngu, d'ara na karej'e.

source_text: and herod was questioning him with many words, but he answered him nothing.
target_text: hèia na karèi yesus rupa-rupa j'ara, te ngaa yesus dhaa boe ca hèb'a sa.

source_text: and the rashei hakohenim and the sofrim had stood by vehemently accusing rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: ropa herodes padhai lii era dènge yesus, te ngaa kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra galaa hari yesus dènge rupa-rupa sasala.

source_text: and having treated him with contempt, herod with his chaiyalim also ridiculed him, having clothed him in an elegant royal robe. so they thus sent back him to pilate.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae herodes dènge sordad'u na padhai lii pahahe ne. ka ra papake yesus kodho saraga dhu madhera robho d'ai rai èci, sèmi dhèu aae tema pake, hèia ra padhai lii pahahe ne taruu. ka rèti hari ne la'e asa gubernur pilatus.

source_text: and herod and pilate became fast friends with one another on that very day, for they were previously at enmity toward each other.
target_text: uru nèti èèna, gubernur dènge dhèu aae herodes dhu pamusu. te ngaa nèti lod'o èèna, dua ra pa'angalai.

source_text: and pilate, when he had assembled the rashei hakohanim and the manhigim and the people,
target_text: èle èèna ka, gubernur pilatus paroa kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi, sama-sama dènge dhèu ae sèra, mai pakaboko ho nanene lii pama'ète.

source_text: said to them, you brought to me this man causing the people to rise up in mered revolt, and, hinei, i have cross-examined him before you and i found nothing in this man of the crime of which you make accusations against him.
target_text: aku nèngu na, miu mèti le yesus asa ja'a, aa mi galaa ne, peka na, nèngu d'èi kakèj'i kabarai ho lab'a paredha roma. ja'a parisa le toke lutu ètu madha miu, te ngaa ja'a abhu boe sasala na èci sa.

source_text: and neither did herod, for he sent him back to us, and, hinei, nothing worthy of mishpat mavet has been done by him.
target_text: dhèu aae herodes parisa le kahèi. te ngaa na abhu boe sasala ngaa-ngaa kahèi. nèti èèna ka, na hia hari ne mai sa ja'a. dhèu ne dènge boe sasala ngaa-ngaa. de ja'a bisa boe huku pamadhe ne.

source_text: therefore, having disciplined him, i will release him.
target_text: ja'a neo pama'ète sèmi ne'e: ja'a pua kalabhe ne pake gui, èle na ja'a patabuli eele ne.

source_text: now he was obliged to release to them one at the chag festival. but they cried out with one kol, saying, away with this one! and release to us bar-abba!
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, bisa boe! pamadhe ne! patabuli barabas. ra pa'oo-parodha sèmi èèna, lula tèu mai-tèu mai, dhu tema le, ladhe d'ai lod'o kalela paska dhèu yahudi, gubernur patabuli ca dhèu nèti d'ara bèdho madhutu dad'èi rèngu.

source_text: bar-abba was a man who was thrown into the beis hasohar, because of some insurrection which occurred in hair as well as a retzach.
target_text: barabas ne maso bèdho, lula na kakèj'i dhèu lab'a paredha roma ètu kota yerusalem, aa na pamadhe dhèu kahèi.

source_text: and again pilate addressed them, wishing to release rebbe melech hamoshiach.
target_text: te ngaa gubernur neo patabuli yesus. ka na karèi hari dhèu ae sèra, tasamia ladhe ja'a patabuli yesus?

source_text: but they were crying out saying, let him be talui al haetz! let him be hanged on haetz!
target_text: te ngaa asa ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, aad'o! paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha! paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha!

source_text: and a paam shlishit third time, pilate said to them, but what raah did this one do? no crime worthy of mavet did i find in him. therefore, having disciplined him, i will release him.
target_text: te ngaa gubernur ngee na j'ara ne lèke boe, ka na karèi d'ai tèlu hari, peka na, nga tao ka ja'a madhutu miu ho paku pamadhe ne? bhabhelu na ngaa? ja'a parisa le nèngu ne, te ngaa abhu boe j'ara èci sa kahèi, ho huku pamadhe ne. de ja'a neo dhoka kalabhe ne, èle ku, heka patabuli ne.

source_text: but they insisted with a kol gadol demanding him to be hanged on haetz and their voices were roiv the larger portion prevailing.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra pa'oo-parodha hari pamèdhu-mèdhu, sèna ka laka-seti ne ho paku pamadhe yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. hèia gubernur taha nare heka,

source_text: and pilate decided that their demand be accomplished.
target_text: ka na pama'ète madhutu dad'èi dhèu sèra.

source_text: and pilate released the one they were requesting, the one who had been thrown into the beis hasohar on account of an insurrection and retzach, but rebbe melech hamoshiach he delivered over to their ratzon.
target_text: hèia na patabuli barabas, ca dhèu dhu d'èi palab'a, dènge pamadhe dhèu. te ngaa na soro yesus la'e asa adhe-aai dhèu se'e, sèna ka ra tao ne madhutu dad'èi rèngu.

source_text: and as they led him away, having seized a certain shim'on, a cyrenian, coming in from the country, they put upon him moshiachʼs etz to carry, following rebbe melech hamoshiach.
target_text: èle ka, sordad'u roma sèra nuni rèti yesus asa li'u kota yerusalem. ètu talora j'ara, ra paraga dènge dhèu èci nèti kota kirene, dhu ngara na simon, dhu neo maso asa d'ara kota yerusalem. ka ra laka-seti ne, sèna ka pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha ne gati yesus. ka na kako re limuri madhutu yesus.

source_text: and a great multitude of haam were following him and nashim, who were acting as avelim, lamenting for him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae mai laladhe yesus. abhu kahèi ina-ina dhu pasuti èi madha, lula d'ara pèd'a ropa rèdhi ne.

source_text: and having turned to them, rebbe melech hamoshiach said, benot hayerushalayim daughters of yerushalayim, stop weeping for me; weep for yourselves and for your yeladim,
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe bhèni se tangi, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, ina-ina nèti yerusalem. baku tangi ja'a ne. tangi hiu ngi'u miu mesa mi, dènge ana niki miu.

source_text: because, hinei, yamim are coming in which they will say, ashrey are the barren and the wombs which did not bear and the breasts which did not nurse.
target_text: te bèli-camèd'a, sasusa dhu kapai risi mai, hèia dhèu peka na, ‘bhèni dhu kalua hua iia, nuka, bhèni dhu rara iisi rèdhi boe, aa dhu pasusu rèdhi boe ana. '

source_text: then they will begin to say to the mountain, fall on us! and to the hills, bury us.
target_text: lod'o sasusa aae na mai, dhèu j'èra titu kèna, toke ra manèngi, peka na, ‘be'a risi, ledhe guri mai ho kabhie ka ji'i! ' aa ra peka kahèi, ‘dènge j'aj'èra sèmi ne'e ne, be'a risi kabhuku dhènu eele ka ji'i. '

source_text: because if while an etz tree is green they do these things, what may happen when it is dry?
target_text: ladhe dhèu bisa paj'èra dhèu dhu dènge boe sasala, tasamia hari mi dhèu bhelu?

source_text: and two posha'imcriminals, resha'im were also being led away with rebbe, melech hamoshiach to be executed.
target_text: ropa sordad'u se rèti yesus, ra nuni rèti kahèi dhèu bhelu dhèu dua, ho huku pamadhe palere-lere dènge ne.

source_text: and when they came upon the place being called the skull, there they hanged each on his etz, rebbe, melech hamoshiach and the posha'im criminals, one on the right, and one on the left.
target_text: rèngu d'ai era èci, dhu ngara na ‘rui kètu. ' hèia ra paku yesus dènge dhèu bhelu dhèu dua se, mi aj'u palolo-palèbha ra èci-èci. ka ra sèle patitu aj'u palolo-palèbha sèra. ra hia dhèu bhelu èci ètu karasa g'ana yesus, aa èci hari ètu karasa kariu na.

source_text: but rebbe melech hamoshiach was saying, abba, grant selicha to them, for they have no daas of what they are doing. and dividing up his garments, vappilu goral they cast lots.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus sabaj'a peka na, ama! bhèlu eele sasala dhèu se, te rèngu re'a boe ngaa dhu ra ad'u-ue. èle ka sordad'u se ère lot, sèna ka neo re'a cee ka dhu abhu mèdha-papake na.

source_text: and haam had stood watching. and the manhigim were mocking him also, saying, others he saved, let him save himself, if this one is the rebbe melech hamoshiach of hashem, the bechir hashem.
target_text: dhèu ae mai laladhe ètu era èèna. dhèu aae-dhèu kapai yahudi sèra, peka pa-aape yesus, aku rèngu na, nèngu dhu patabuli nare le dhèu leo nèti mamadhe-mamopo, te ngaa bisa boe patabuli ngi'u nèngu mesa na. ladhe nèngu ne, tare'a-re'a kristus, dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare, hud'i laa na puru unu na nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha ne.

source_text: and the chaiyalim also ridiculed him as they approached, offering chometzwine vinegar to him,
target_text: sordad'u se padhai lii pa-aape ne kahèi. ra hia ne ninu èi anggor manyilu,

source_text: and saying, if you are hamelech hayehudim, save yourself.
target_text: aa ra parodha pahaha ne, peka na, ladhe èu ne tare'a-re'a dhèu aae yahudi, na, patabuli eele ka ngi'u mu nèti mamadhe!

source_text: and there was also an inscription over him, this is hamelech hayehudim.
target_text: ra suri ètu papa èci, peka na, ne'e ne, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi. ka ra paku papa ne re dedha kètu yesus, sèna ka dhèu re'a, na, ra huku ne lula j'ara ne'e ka.

source_text: and one of the posha'im criminals having been hanged with him was speaking chillul hashem gadfanut against him, saying, are you not the rebbe melech hamoshiach?
target_text: ca dhèu bhelu dhu paku ètu karasa yesus padhai lii pa-aape ne kahèi, aku nèngu na, èu ne tare'a kristus, do? ladhe tare'a, na, patabuli eele ka èdhi!

source_text: save yourself and us. and in reply the other, rebuking him, said, do you not have yirat shomayim? for you are under the same gezar din verdict of harshaah condemnation as guilty.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu bhelu èci hari kai ne, aku nèngu na, weh! èu ne me'a boe madha'u dènge ama lamatua, hèi? te èu ne abhu huku madhe èci èèna ka dènge nèngu kahèi.

source_text: and this is a just gezar din against us, for we deserve what we are getting for our ma'asim deeds. but this one did nothing rah.
target_text: èdhi dua ti pasae tare huku madhe ne, lèke dènge tatao èdhi. te ngaa dhèu ne, tao boe sasala ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: and he was saying, adoni, remember me when you come into your malchut.
target_text: ka dhèu ne, peka hari, aku nèngu na, yesus! ladhe ama maso ka asa era paredha ama, na baku bhèlu ja'a.

source_text: and rebbe, melech hamoshiach said to him, omein, i say to you, hayom today you will be with me in gan eden.
