source_text: and having been brought safely through, we then found out that the island is called malta.
target_text: ropa ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi d'ai dae dènge sod'a, heka nge'a kèna, na, rai èèna, pulu malta.

source_text: and the natives were showing not the ordinary kindness to us for, because of the geshem rain that had set in and because of the cold, they lit a hadlakah bonfire.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu ètu kabarai èèna, sèmi rare ji'i dènge be'a. lula èj'i mai, ka pacuhi titu kèna, nèti èèna ka, ra bhubhu ai ètu kètu nebhe èèna, ka ra gale ji'i la'a manyiru ai.

source_text: and when rav sha'ul gathered some brushwood and placed the sticks on the hadlakah bonfire, a nachash serpent from the heat came out and fastened onto rav sha'ulʼs hand.
target_text: paulus madhutu kabhili aj'u kahèi, ho palake asa d'ara ai. te ngaa ropa na tao aj'u asa d'ara ai, cag'ag'a laa, mege ci'u dhu dènge raco kalua asa li'u mai, lula taha boe dènge ai pana. ka na kadhi kacui-aai paulus.

source_text: and when the natives saw it hanging from his hand, they were saying to one another, surely this man is a rotzeach murderer; for though he was brought safely from the sea, yashrus justice did not allow him to live.
target_text: ropa dhèu malta sèra ladhe rèdhi mege dhu dhone-dhone ètu kacui-aai paulus, ka ra paka'uu èci dènge èci, peka na, èle boe dhèu ne, tuka pamadhe dhèu. ka masi ka nèngu madhe boe dhasi, te ngaa ne'e ne d'ai unu nèngu kèna. nèti èèna ka, nèngu bisa heka mamuri! lula cee dhu ad'u-ue bhabhelu, nèngu ka dhu sèmi nare babia na.

source_text: then, having shaken off the nachash into the eish fire, rav sha'ul suffered no ill effects. but the natives were expecting him to be about to swell up or suddenly to fall down. but they watched him expectantly for a long time, and when they observed nothing unusual happening to him, they changed their minds and were saying that he was a g-d.
target_text: dhèu se pangee, na, tatu ciki oo'e hari, kacui-aai paulus bai, ho na madhe dènge ka. te ngaa paulus pici mege ne asa d'ara ai la'e. aa na rasa boe pèd'a ciki sa. ka dhèu se'e tatae ku nèbhu j'oo aae, te ngaa paulus ngaa-ngaa tao boe. hèia ra pangee, na, èle boe dhèu ne, dewa!

source_text: now in the area around that place were lands belonging to the leading man of the island, publius by name, who welcomed us and gave us hachnosas orchim.
target_text: kaj'èu boe nèti era èèna, abhu èmu-èmu gubernur ètu rai dhu taleo. gubernur èèna, ngara na publius. na mai soru ji'i ètu nebhe dhasi, ka gale nèti ji'i la'a pea ètu èmu na. ètu èèna, na ladhe-leru ji'i tèlu lod'o.

source_text: and it came about that the abba of publius was bedfast, suffering fevers and dysentery. rav sha'ul approached him, and having davened, laid his hands on him and administered refuah shleimah to him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ama d'èlu gubernur pèd'a maringi sagoro, dènge pèd'a po'e taruu. ka paulus la'e ladhe ne asa d'ara kama na. hèia na soro kacui-aai na g'ag'e dhèu pèd'a ne, ho na sabaj'a hia ne. ka na èle dènge ka.

source_text: and when this happened, also others on the island, the cholim, were approaching rav sha'ul and were receiving refuah shleimah.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi ama d'èlu gubernur èle le, ka dhèu pèd'a dhu leo sèra mai asa paulus. ra manèngi tulu nèti nèngu, ka na puri-pa'èle si.

source_text: the natives bestowed matanot rabbot on us and, while being put out to sea, they gave us the provisions for our needs.
target_text: hèia dhèu se pad'elo tadha makasi rèngu, dènge rèti mèdha ae titu kèna hia ji'i.

source_text: and after shloshah chodashim, we set sail in an oniyah, having spent the winter on the island. it was an alexandrian oniyah marked by the insignia of the twin achim.
target_text: ji'i pea ètu malta tèlu hèru, toke pa'èle hèru dhasi-ngèlu aae. lod'o èèna, abhu kapa cue nèti alexandria dhu karèi nèti hèru dhasi aae ngèlu aae panahu le ètu èèna. ngara kapa na, ana kembar, lula ètu kaduru kapa ne, ra tao patung dewa kembar. ka ji'i neo ca'e kapa èèna, ho la'a taruu asa roma. de lod'o ji'i neo ca'e asa dedha kapa, dhèu malta sèra hia ji'i parèko j'ara dènge mèdha leo dhu ji'i parluu ètu d'ara kakako.

source_text: and having put in at syracuse, we stayed 3 days.
target_text: ji'i kako mau-mau, ka ji'i d'ai kota sirakusa, ètu pulu sisilia. hèia ji'i panahu ètu èèna, tèlu lod'o.

source_text: then we weighed anchor and arrived at rhegium. and after one day, a southwest wind sprang up and on the second day we came to puteoli.
target_text: nèti èèna, ji'i kako oro-oro re sebhe pulu sisilia, ka ji'i d'ai kota regium. asa bèli èèna, ngèlu balèu mèdhu aae, hèia ji'i kako taruu, ka d'ai malai. asa camèd'a èèna, ji'i d'ai kota hèb'a-namo cue, ngara na putioli.

source_text: there we found achim b'moshiach and we were invited by them to stay shivah yamim. and so we came to rome.
target_text: ètu èèna, ji'i puru tèke eele kapa èèna. hèia ji'i la'a tenge dhèu sarani dhu ètu era sèra. ropa paraga dènge ra, ka ra manèngi sèna ka ji'i pea dènge rèngu. ka ji'i manubha ètu èèna, ca migu. èle èèna ka, ji'i kako haga la'a asa roma.

source_text: and from there, the achim b'moshiach when they heard of us, came out to meet us, even as far as the forum of appius and the three taverns. on seeing them, ometz lev came to rav sha'ul and he said a bracha, davening hodah to hashem.
target_text: ropa dhèu sarani ètu roma sèra tadèngi, na, ji'i neo la'a asa nèi, hèia rèngu mai soru ji'i ètu talora j'ara. cahag'e paraga dènge ji'i ètu pasa apius; aa cahag'e hari paraga dènge ji'i ètu era èci, ngara na pasanggrahan tèlu. lod'o paulus ladhe nèdhi si, ka na manèngi makasi ae-ae mi ama lamatua, ka d'ara na èra dènge.

source_text: now when we entered into rome, rav sha'ul was permitted to live by himself in his own quarters with a chaiyal guarding him.
target_text: ropa d'ai roma, sordad'u sèra pamaso dhèu bèdho sèra asa d'ara bèdho. te ngaa ra pamaso boe paulus. ra hud'i ne sène, ho bisa seb'a èmu cue. ètu èmu èèna, na pea dènge sordad'u dhèu èci dhu j'aga ne. kacui-aai rèngu dua ra, dhu èki pake rate.

source_text: and it came about after shloshah yamim, that rav sha'ul called together the chashuve yehudim. and when they had assembled, rav sha'ul was saying to them, anashim, achim, though i had done nothing keneged against, in opposition to our jewish people or to the minhagei avoteinu of orthodox judaism, i was arrested in yerushalayim and delivered over into the hands of the romans,
target_text: èle tèlu lod'o, hèia paulus paroa dhèu heka-dhèu heka dhèu yahudi ètu sèra, ho mai paraga dènge ne. ropa ra pakaboko, hèia paulus padhai lii dènge si, aku nèngu na, a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a ètu ne'e ne, lula a'ari èdhi dhèu yahudi sèra kèpe rare ja'a ètu yerusalem. ka ra soro ja'a asa d'ara kacui-aai dhèu paredha roma. te ngaa ja'a tao sala boe ngaa-ngaa! ja'a tao boe ngaa-ngaa dhu lab'a isi kabarai èdhi. aa ja'a lab'a boe kahèi atora ad'a dhu èdhi sèmi tare nèti bèi-baki èdhi sèra.

source_text: who, having examined me, were desiring to release me, because i had done nothing worthy of the death penalty.
target_text: dhèu paredha parisa le lii ja'a ne ètu nèi. te ngaa ra abhu boe sasala ja'a èci sa dhu bisa abhu huku madhe. nèti èèna ka, ra neo patalale eele ja'a.

source_text: but when the yehudim spoke keneged in opposition to, against this, i was forced to appeal to caesar, but only to defend myself, not to bring accusation against am yisroel, my people.
target_text: te ngaa, lula ama-ama dhèu yahudi sèmi boe lii pama'ète nèti dhèu paredha ho patalale ja'a, nèti èèna ka, ko'o do ko'o boe, ja'a hud'i ca'e banding ku mai asa roma. masi ka ja'a tao sèmi ne'e, te ngaa dènge boe d'ara neo galaa dhèu ja'a unu ku.

source_text: on account of this reason, therefore, i summoned you, to see you and to speak with you, since it is for the sake of the tikvat yisroel that i am wearing these prison sharsherot chains.
target_text: nèti lii langu ne'e ka, ja'a pakaboko a'ari aa'i-aa'i ètu ne'e. madhutu dad'èi ja'a, èdhi bisa padhue-padhai ngaa dhu èdhi dhèu yahudi sanao-maena: nuka, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti sanao mi dhèu aae dhu ama lamatua neo hia mai, sèna ka hia mamuri mi èdhi dhèu isra'el. nèti j'ara se'e ka, ra èki ja'a dènge rate ne.

source_text: and they said to rav sha'ul, we neither received iggrot about you from yehudah nor have any of the achim arrived and reported or spoke any lashon hora about you.
target_text: hèia dhèu se dhaa, aku rèngu na, toke d'ai lod'o deo ne'e ne, ji'i sèmi mèka sasuri èci sa nèti yudea, dhu peka lii langu èu ne. sèmi èèna kahèi, a'ari dhu mai nèti nèi, lolo boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa lula-nèti èu.

source_text: but we desire to hear from you what you think, for lichora apparently with regard to this kat of judaism, we have da'as that it is spoken keneged against everywhere.
target_text: te ngaa ji'i neo nanene ngaa dhu èu parcaya, lula ji'i tadèngi le ètu mia-mia, peka na, dhèu sèmi boe ngaa dhu partei kristen sèra aj'a-nori si. de mamèci na, tasamia? ji'i dhae nge'a mèka. de lolo ku dènge ji'i laa.

source_text: and they set a day for him, and they came to him in his lodgings, and there were many of them. and rav sha'ul was making a midrash, bearing solemn edut about the malchut hashem, and persuading them about yehoshua from both the torah of moshe rabbenu and from the nevi'im, from haboker to haerev.
target_text: ka rèngu rare lii èci ho pili ca lod'o dhu leo, sèna ka ra paraga hari. ropa d'ai lod'o pamoa èèna, dhèu ae titu kèna mai pakaboko ètu era pea paulus. hèia paulus mulai lole ka dènge rèngu, dad'èi ama lamatua mi dhèu unu na. na pake isi nèti sasuri musa, dènge sasuri dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua dhu leo sèra, sèna ka rèngu bisa parcaya yesus. na padhai lii nèti mad'ae toke d'ai lod'o nihia.

source_text: and some yehudim were being persuaded by the things being said, but others had no emunah faith.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii padhai lii paulus ne, abhu ka cahag'e dhu parcaya. te ngaa abhu kahèi dhu parcaya boe.

source_text: and so they disagreed with one another. and as they were leaving, rav sha'ul said a final dvar. rightly the ruach hakodesh spoke through yeshayah hanavi to your avot,

source_text: which hashem promised beforehand through his neviim in the kitvei hakodesh. the good news of redemption of hashem concerns the zun fun der oybershter ben haelohim of hashem born from the zera dovid, as far as basar is concerned,
target_text: uru èèna, ama lamatua dhu ator tèke le, ho dhèu rèti lii padhai na suri j'ara-j'ara nèti lii lolo be'a èèna ètu sasuri mola-mèci na. te, ètu d'ara sasuri ne, lamatua pajaji neo hia mai ana na yesus, ho j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha. de limuri ne, lii moa na èèna j'aj'i le, lula yesus dhu mai le nèti ana-èpu dhèu aae daud.

source_text: but, as far as the ruach hakodesh is concerned, appointed to be zun fun der oybershter in power by means of moshiachʼs techiyah resurrection from hamesim.
target_text: te ngaa re èci hari, ama lamatua pad'elo tadha, peka na, yesus kristus èèna, ana nèngu kahèi. te roh yesus èèna, mola-mèci tare'a-re'a, sama sèmi ama lamatua. aa lamatua pake koasa na, sèna ka pamamuri hari yesus nèti mamadhe na. nèti èèna ka, èdhi te'a, na, ana ama lamatua èèna, nuka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: through him and for the kavod of his name, we have received unmerited chen v'chesed hashem and the shlichus for the tachlis purpose of bringing about the mishma'at of emunah among all nations,
target_text: yesus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a, te na pili nare le ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na, ho lole lii aj'a-nori na buli mia-mia. dad'èi na, dhèu dhu yahudi boe parcaya ne kahèi, aa mamuri madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. ja'a neo kahèi, sèna ka dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i lèka kristus, aa mamuri madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: among whom you also are summoned to belong to rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua;
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu ètu kota roma. miu j'aj'i nèti suku ae-ae nèti mia-mia, yesus kristus dhu hag'e nare le miu, peka na, mai ka! mai j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a!

source_text: to all who are in rome, ahuvei hashembeloved ones of g-d, summoned by hashemʼs kri'ah calling to be kedoshim holy ones - unmerited chen v'chesed hashem and shalom hashem from elohim avinu and rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua adoneinu.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a pa'adhu sasuri ne hia miu ètu roma, dènge pasanèd'e, peka na, ama lamatua sue miu. nèngu manèngi kahèi ho miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na dhu mamuri mola-mèci. ja'a sabaj'a sèna ka ama èdhi, ama lamatua, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra, aa hia miu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: first of all, modeh ani i thank my g-d through rebbe melech hamoshiach yehoshua for all of you, because your emunah faith, your bitachon, is being reported abroad b'chol haolam all over the world.
target_text: ja'a bhoke sasuri ja'a ne, dènge manèngi makasi ae-ae mi ama lamatua, lula yesus kristus sab'a ètu d'ara miu. ja'a manèngi makasi kahèi, lula dhèu dhu pea ètu rae-rae d'ara paredha roma, ra palolo lula-nèti parcaya miu mi yesus.

source_text: for der oybershter is my eidus! g-d is my witness! , whom i serve with my neshamah in the besuras hageulah of the zun fun der oybershter of hashem, how, when i daven, i constantly mention you in my tefillos,
target_text: ja'a loe boe sabaj'a hia miu. tare'a! lamatua mesa na ne'a, na, ngaa dhu ja'a padhai ne, lèke. nèngu ne'a kahèi, na, ja'a ne sab'a dènge d'ara kateme ho lole dènge dhèu lii lolo be'a nèti ana na.

source_text: always making techinnah supplication and petitioning that i might somehow now at last efsher perhaps succeed im yirtzeh hashemif the l-rd wills to make my way to you.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i, ja'a peka sèmi ne'e ka: lamatua, ja'a mesa ku ke'a boe j'ara na tasamia. te ngaa, ladhe madhutu dad'èi lamatua, na, bhoke la j'ara, sèna ka ja'a bisa laku pangad'o dènge angalai ja'a sèra ètu roma.

source_text: for i am longing to see you, that i may impart to you some mattanah ruchanit spiritual gift for the tachlis purpose of imparting chizzuk strengthening, encouragement to you and be mechazek be strengthened spiritually;
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a sèmi èèna, te ja'a neo titu kèna kèdhi miu, sèna ka ja'a bisa bagi hia miu koasa nèti roh lamatua, ho hud'i laa miu j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua dhu taha pa'èra-èra.

source_text: or rather, so that there may be mutual chizzuk strengthening, encouragement among you through each otherʼs emunah faith, both yours and mine.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe ja'a j'aj'i dhiu pea dènge miu, ja'a neo pa'èra d'ara miu, ho sèna ka parcaya miu asa èra. aa ja'a neo kahèi ho miu pa'èra d'ara ja'a.

source_text: now i do not want you to lack da'as, achim b'moshiach of mine, of how i often made plans to come to you, though i have been prevented thus far, in order that i might have some p'ri for hashem among you as well, just as among the rest of the ethnic peoples.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ja'a d'èi ladhe miu me'a, na, ja'a neo ae le ho dhiu pangad'o dènge miu ètu roma. te ngaa toke sange ne'e, dhodhoka tao nelu di. de ladhe ja'a j'aj'i dhiu, ja'a sanao sèna ka abhu dhèu ae era dhu lèka èra kristus, sama sèmi dhu ja'a abhu ètu era-era leo. ladhe sèmi èèna, na, rui-j'aj'èra ja'a abhu hua-hela dhu be'a.

source_text: i am meshubad obligated morally, under shiebud obligation, to both cultured greek-speakers and non-greek-speaking barbarians, both the learned and the untutored. hence my eagerness to preach the besuras hageulah to you who are in rome as well.
target_text: masi ka, tasamia èèna ka, ja'a hud'i lole ku lii lolo be'a lamatua mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. mi dhèu dhu pake lii yunani do, dhèu dintiu dhu pake lii leo, dhèu kapai do, dhèu haha do, dhèu sakola do, dhèu sakola boe. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pa'èra neo dhiu sa roma, sèna ka paraga dènge miu.

source_text: for i am not ashamed of the besuras hageulah. it is the ko'ach power of hashem for the geulah deliverance to all who have emunah, to the yehudi the jew above all, but also the yevani greek.
target_text: ja'a makae boe ciki sa, dènge lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus. te ladhe abhu dhèu dhu parcaya ama lamatua, lii lolo be'a ne dènge koasa nèti lamatua, ho patabuli dhèu ne'e nèti koasa sasala-sasigo na. dhèu yahudi ka dhu re'a uuru j'ara ne'e ne, heka dhèu suku leo sèra kèna.

source_text: for the tzidkat hashem, the righteousness of hashem is having its hisgalus revelation in the besuras hageulah by emunah faith from first to last, from faith to faith, as it is written, v'tzaddik be'emunato yiche'yeh the righteous by his faith shall live.
target_text: lii lolo be'a ne pad'elo kahèi j'ara lamatua ho pamola dhèu nèti sasala ra. aa'i-aa'i sèra sa bisa j'aj'i, sad'i dhèu parcaya ne. te dhu suri le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na, dhèu hud'i parcaya uuru ku ama lamatua, heka bisa pabe'a dènge nèngu kèna. te ladhe ra mamuri dènge parcaya ne, heka abhu mamuri dhu lèke kèna.

source_text: for the charon af hashemthe burning anger of g-d is being revealed from shomayim. it is being revealed against all without yirat shomayim and tzedek, all bnei adam who wickedly repress haemes,
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua peka le, na, abhu dhèu dhu pusi-pahae boe nèngu. aa abhu dhu ad'u-ue rupa-rupa j'ara bhelu-katub'a. te ngaa lamatua sèmi nare boe tatao rèngu sèra. lula ètu d'ara iiki rèngu, dhu re'a le, mia ka dhu lèke. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa rèngu loe boe tao j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe sèra. ra kakèj'i dhèu, toke dhèu re'a heka mia ka dhu lèke. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua papuru hahuku nèti dedha-liru, sèna ka paj'èra si.

source_text: all anashim who, even though what is knowable about hashem lies plainly before their eyes for g-d has shown them! , they nevertheless cling to their resha and wickedly suppress haemes. for his invisible characteristics from the bri'at haolam the creation of the world are perceived intellectually in the things which have been created; that is, both his eternal ko'ach and elohut are discernable. so bnei adam have no terutz excuse and are inexcusably culpable before an angry g-d,
target_text: dhèu se'e se, abhu boe alasan ho siri iisi ra, lula j'ara-j'ara dhu pahuni boe dhu dhèu bisa re'a mèu nèti lamatua. te ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu pad'elo! a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: mulai nèti na paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha, toke d'ai sange ne'e ne, ladhe dhèu neo re'a mèu nèti ngi'u lamatua, aa dènge koasa na dhu dènge boe too-lane èèna, bisa kahèi! masi ka ladhe tèdhi boe ama lamatua, te ngaa dhèu bisa tadhe ne nèti ngaa-ngaa dhu na ad'u-ue. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka, na, dhèu bhelu sèra abhu boe alasan ho siri iisi ra, peka na, ja'a ke'a boe ngaa-ngaa nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: because, even though they in actual fact knew g-d, they did not ascribe him kavod glory as g-d or give hodayah thanksgiving to him, but became filled with hevel futility, vanity, emptiness, worthlessness in their thinking, and their senseless levavot were darkened.
target_text: de masi ka rèngu re'a j'ara-j'ara lamatua, te ngaa ro'o boe mangaku, na, lamatua èèna, ama lamatua èdhi! rèngu se ro'o boe, manèngi makasi mi lamatua kahèi. ka ngangee ra j'aj'i kahèlu, toke ra re'a heka ngaa dhu lèke. rèngu j'aj'i bingu aa padhai lii rupa-rupa dhu kolo-kapua aad'o lula-nèti ama lamatua. aa d'ara ra maroga aatu-aatu.

source_text: claiming to be chachamim wise ones, they became kesilim fools,
target_text: rèngu èci-èci padedha iisi ra, peka na, ja'a ke'a mèu madha j'ara ae-ae! masi ka ngangee ra sèmi èèna, te ngaa madhutu mola-mola na, rèngu goa titu kèna.

source_text: and traded in the kavod glory of the incorruptible g-d for the mere likeness of the demut image, icon of corruptible man, birds, beasts, and reptiles.
target_text: ka dhèu se pahaha boe iisi ra mi ama lamatua dhu kapai risi eele èèna, te rèngu peka na, ji'i pusi boe lamatua sèmi èèna! te ngaa ra sogo-tagu mi rupa-rupa patung, raropa sèmi dhèu rai-haha, sèmi manu-bhui sa, do sèmi badha leo sèra, toke d'ai patung dhu rupa sèmi mege sa. dènge ra sogo-tagu sèmi èèna, rèngu tule eele ama lamatua dhu mamuri taa-taa, ho ra gati eele dènge mèdha-panyau dhu bisa madhe!

source_text: therefore, g-d in wrath delivered them over in the ta'avot of their levavot to tum'a uncleanness to the dishonoring and perverting of their bodies among themselves:
target_text: nèti èèna ka, lamatua soro tèke si, sèna ka ra ad'u-ue madhutu dad'èi rèngu. na soro tèke si, ho ra tao j'ara bhelu-katub'a rupa-rupa, dhu amo le ètu d'ara rèngu. toke rèngu se re'a heka makae sa hèi. hèia dènge ngi'u aae ra, rèngu ad'u-ue madha j'ara kaj'alu rupa-rupa, aa ra tao sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu leo.

source_text: they traded in haemes hashemthe truth of g-d for sheker, for a lie, and worshiped and served habri'ah the creature, the creation rather than habo're the beshefer, hamvorach l'olamim. omein who is blessed forever. amen.
target_text: ètu d'ara iiki ra dhu re'a le j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke nèti ama lamatua, te ngaa ro'o boe madhutu. ngangee rèngu dhu moca le, hèia ra pangee, na, be'a risi èdhi tao rupa-rupa. masi ka pakarehe aa'i-aa'i, ngaa-ngaa tao boe! ra koa-kad'iri mèdha dhu lamatua paj'aj'i, te ngaa rèngu pahaha boe iisi mi lamatua dhu paj'aj'i mèdha se. ra tao iisi sèmi dhèu dhu mola-mèci, te ngaa dhu mola-mèu lao di! dhu lèke ka, ladhe èdhi dhèu rai-haha ne koa-kio taruu ama lamatua! èèna ka dhu mèci!

source_text: for this reason, hashemin wrath delivered them over to paskudneh contemptible sexual desires. for their females traded off natural sexual intercourse for unnatural.
target_text: nèti bhabhelu-katub'a rèngu sèra ka, lamatua soro tèke si, ho rèngu tao karehe sèmi èèna madhutu dad'èi ra. hèia ra tao rupa-rupa j'ara makae, dhu dènge heka d'ara makae. bhèni ra, ro'o heka pa'èci dènge mone dhèu èmu ra, te ngaa d'èi tao dhu lèke boe. te bhèni j'unu tao j'ara makae dènge bhèni.

source_text: likewise also the males abandoned natural sexual intercourse with the female counterpart and were inflamed with craving for one another, males with males committing what is indecent and receiving back in exchange in themselves the appropriate gemul retribution for their toyus error.
target_text: dhèu mone sèmi èèna kahèi! ra d'èi heka j'unu pa'èci dènge dhèu èmu ra, te ngaa d'èi j'unu dènge dhèu mone leo! rèngu se, dhu dènge heka d'ara makae! nèti èèna ka, pe rèngu dui rare j'aj'èra pamèci dènge tatao rèngu sèra! te rèngu se dhu sigo eele kaj'èu le, nèti j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: and as far as g-dʼs worthiness to be recognized by them was concerned, vi-bahlt since they marked g-d down as failing the test, therefore g-d in wrath delivered them over to a failure of a brain, one that has a mind bent on doing what is perversely unworthy
target_text: ra pangee, na, be'a risi baku patai-patapa dènge lamatua. nèti èèna ka, lamatua soro tèke si, sèna ka ra tao madhutu dad'èi ra! de rèngu ngee dhoka dhu karehe di! ka ra tao j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe!

source_text: - filled with all resha, wickedness, chamdanut greediness, and what is damagingly evil - full of kin'a jealousy, retzach murder, rivalry, mirmah deceit, merivah strife, remiyah guile, deceit, all kinds of lashon hora, malicious,
target_text: mamuri ra pènu dènge rupa-rupa bhabhelu-katub'a. ka re'a heka tao dhu be'a, te ngaa dhoka dhu bhelu di. rèngu manga'a. èci tèke d'ara dènge èci. èci d'èi boe karisi èci. èci pamadhe èci. ra d'èi patao-palaha. ra kapod'e-kabèli. ra leko-monya. ra d'èi padhai-kakoli dhèu.

source_text: backbiters, slanderers, haters of g-d, insolent, arrogant, braggarts, contrivers of evil, disobedient to horim.
target_text: rèngu d'èi pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu. ra palab'a dènge ama lamatua. ra kurang ajar, d'èi pahahe dhèu, d'èi padedha iisi, d'èi tenge j'ara-j'ara karehe, aa d'èi palab'a dènge ina-ama ra.

source_text: without seichel, without ne'emanut faithfulness, without ahavah love, without rachamanut.
target_text: ro'o boe re'a dènge j'ara dhu mola. ro'o boe re'a dènge lii pamoa unu ra, ka dhèu lèka heka rèngu. re'a boe sue dhèu. dènge boe d'ara kasia ciki sa mi dedha dhèu.

source_text: although they have known full well the just requirements of hashem, that is, that those who practice such things are bnei mavet, they not only do the very same, but even give their perverted bracha blessing on those who practice such. for this reason, you are without terutz excuse for yourself before an angry g-d, you, sir, each one of you who passes judgment.
target_text: rèngu re'a le atora ama lamatua dhu peka na, dhèu dhu tao rupa-rupa bhabhelu, hud'i abhu huku madhe. masi ka re'a le atora ne, te ngaa loe boe tao rupa-rupa bhabhelu. mesa boe se'e se di, te ngaa ra dadugu-rariu dhèu leo, sèna ka tao bhelu kahèi. ne'e ne seli-kolane!

source_text: for in that you pass judgment on the other, you condemn yourself; for you practice the very things on which you pass judgment.
target_text: èu dhu tadèngi le rupa-rupa j'ara bhabhelu-katub'a deo na, si? hèia èu pangee, na, bhabhelu dhèu se'e seli-kolane! ladhe èu pangee le sèmi èèna, na, mu mage-mage, ee! te èu mesa mu bhelu sèmi èèna kahèi. nèti èèna ka, èu dènge boe alasan ho siri iisi èu, masi ka èu ne cee èèna ka. ladhe èu peka, na, lèke tare'a dhèu dhu bhelu sèra abhu huku, te ngaa baku bhèlu, na, èu mesa mu ka pèci sasala mi ngi'u èu unu mu. te èu tao sala sèmi èèna kahèi!

source_text: and we have da'as that the judgment of hashem hashofet against those who practice such things is in accordance with haemes hashem.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi te'a, peka na, ladhe ama lamatua hia huku mi dhèu bhelu sèra, tatu nèngu pama'ète lii langu ra dènge mola.

source_text: you, sir, you who pass judgment on those who practice such things and yet do the same yourself, do you suppose then that you will escape the mishpat hashem?
target_text: do, tasamia? ele boe èu pangee, na, lèke tare'a ladhe dhèu dhu tao bhelu-katub'a sèra abhu hahuku nèti lamatua. aa te ngaa èu kahèi dhu ad'u-ue bhabhelu sama sèmi rèngu. te èu pangee, na, ja'a abhu boe hahuku nèti lamatua. ngangee èèna mai nèti mia?

source_text: or do you think lightly of the wealth of his nedivut generosity and of his chesed and of his being erech apayim slow of anger, forbearing and of his savlanut patience, disregarding the fact that the chesed hashemthe kindness of g-d is to lead you to teshuva?
target_text: ama lamatua dhu pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èu. aa na mau-mau era, nèti tatao èu sèra. te ngaa tasamia ka èu pahahe ne? ele boe èu me'a boe, na, lamatua dhu pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èu ne, sèna ka èu tèke eele sasala èu, aa lèpa hari asa nèngu.

source_text: as a result of your keshistubbornness, hardness and your levavot without teshuva, you are storing up for yourself charon af hashemthe burning anger of g-d in the yom af the day of wrath, when will be revealed the mishpat hatzedek of hashem,

source_text: a rabbinic moreh teacher of the foolish, a melammed instructor of the young, having the embodiment of da'as knowledge and emes in the torah…

source_text: and the naturally uncircumcised ben adam who has mishma'at obedience to the torah will arise as a judgment on you. you! the very one who through chumra stringency, strict adherence to the letter of the law and circumcision are the transgressor of torah!

source_text: for the true yehudi jew is not the one humanly perceived as such, nor true milah that which is performed visibly in the flesh;

target_text: bisa boe! masi ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne kapod'e-kabèli, te ngaa ama lamatua padhai lii dhu mola taruu! sanèd'e, te dhu suri tèke ètu sasuri mola-mèci lula-nèti ngi'u lamatua, peka na, abhu dhèu dhu pèci sasala, peka na, nèngu pama'ète lii langu dhu bia cabèka. te ngaa pe rèngu re'a, na, ngaa dhu na peka-padhai èèna lèke tare'a. nèngu tatu segi, lula na bisa boe padhai lii sale.

source_text: but if our unrighteousness brings out and highlights the tzedek olamim, the tzidkat hashemthe righteousness of g-d, what shall we say? rhetorically speaking, is g-d unjust in inflicting charon af hashem? i speak from a human standpoint.

source_text: they are acquitted and accounted to be yitzdak im hashem as a matnat hashemgift of g-d by the unmerited chen v'chesed hashemgrace of g-d through hapedutthe ransom, which is in rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua,

source_text: or is hashem g-d of the yehudim only? is hashem not also g-d of the nations? ken, of non-jews, too,
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: ama lamatua sèmi nare dhoka dhèu yahudi di, do nèngu sèmi nare dhèu leo kahèi? lèke! na sèmi nare aa'i!

source_text: vi-bahlt since, after all, adonai echadg-d is one. therefore, he will consider to be yitzdak im hashem and acquit those of the milah on the ground of emunah and the arelim uncircumcised ones through that same emunah.
target_text: te ama lamatua ne, dhoka èci di. aa dhoka j'ara èci di, dhu na sèmi nare sèna ka èdhi dhèu rai-haha ne bisa pabe'a dènge ne. nuka èdhi hud'i parcaya kristus. j'ara ne pala mi dhèu yahudi dènge dhèu yahudi boe kahèi.

source_text: does it follow that we abolish torah and make it invalid through emunah? chas v'shalom! aderaba to the contrary, we uphold the torah.
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: ladhe èdhi parcaya lamatua, èèna na tao atora na j'aj'i heka ngaa-ngaa, do? aad'o! dhu lèke ka, parcaya èdhi èèna ka dhu tao pamèci atora na.

source_text: what then shall we say about the one who according to the basar flesh is avraham avinu? what did he find to be the case?
target_text: èdhi tare conto nèti abraham, baki ji'i dhèu yahudi. èdhi bisa te'a ngaa nèti nèngu lula-nèti dhèu bisa pabe'a dènge lamatua, lula parcaya kristus?

source_text: for if avraham avinu was accounted to be yitzdak im hashem and acquitted before hashem on the basis of ma'asim of gezetz, he has something to boast about. but not before hashem!
target_text: èdhi bisa te'a sèmi ne'e: ladhe abraham bisa pabe'a dènge lamatua, lula na tao j'ara be'a, nèngu kahèi abhu hak ho koa iisi ètu madha dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa ètu madha lamatua, nèngu bisa boe bhoka hèb'a.

source_text: for what does the torah say? avraham avinu had emunah faith in hashem v'yachsheveha lo tzedakahand it was accounted, credited, reckoned, imputed to him for righteousness.
target_text: te dhu suri ètu sasuri lamatua dhu mola-mèci, peka na, lula abraham parcaya ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka, lamatua peka na, abraham ne dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge nèngu.

source_text: now to him who works, the loin wages, batzalon remuneration is not credited to oneʼs account as a favor or gift of chesed but as a choiv debt.
target_text: dhèu sab'a, tatu abhu gaji. èèna na doi iia d'ara boe, te ngaa doi dhu lamatua na b'ae ne gati rui-j'aj'èra. te sèra sa hak nèti dhèu sab'a.

source_text: but to the man who does not work but has emunah and bitachon in the one who takes the impious man lacking chasidus and accounts him to be yitzdak im hashem justified with g-d, such a man who does not work but has emunah faith, such emunah is credited to him for tzedakahrighteousness.
target_text: lamatua ka dhu unu hak, ho peka na, dhèu cee dhu parcaya yesus kristus bisa pabe'a hari dènge ne, masi ka uru èèna, dhèu ne tao sala aa pahae boe lamatua. abhu boe j'ara èci sa, dhu dhèu bisa ad'u-ue, ho pabe'a ngi'u nèngu dènge lamatua. te dhèu hud'i parcaya uuru ku yesus kristus, heka lamatua peka na, nèngu dhèu d'ara mola, aa lamatua sèmi nare ne.

source_text: as also dovid hamelech speaks of the me'ushar blessedness of the person whom hashem reckons to be yitzdak im hashem justified with g-d without dependence on ma'asim of gezetz:
target_text: dhèu aae daud peka kahèi, na, d'ara dhèu karèj'e-karae, ropa ama lamatua peka na, dhèu se dhu d'ara mola, masi ka rèngu tao boe ngaa-ngaa. te daud suri, na,

source_text: ashrey blessed, happy are those whose lawless deeds have been forgiven, and whose sins have been covered over;
target_text: masi ka dhèu se sisu atora lamatua, te ngaa na saku eele sasala-sasigo si. nèti èèna ka, rèngu oto titu kèna! dhèu dhu tao bhabhelu, lamatua pabhèlu eele sasala si.

source_text: ashrey adam lo yakhshov hashem lo avonblessed, happy is the one whose sin hashem will by no means count.
target_text: te ladhe lamatua pa'iga heka sasala dhèu, na, dhèu sèra oto tare'a!

source_text: this me'ushar blessedness, then, does it come on those of the milah the circumcised or also on those without the bris milah the uncircumcised? for we say, emunah was credited counted, reckoned to avraham avinu for tzedakahrighteousness.
target_text: de ele boe miu pangee, na, dhodhoka dhèu yahudi dhu suna di, dhu bisa oto, ho ra pabe'a dènge lamatua, si? aa dhèu suku leo dhu suna boe, bisa boe, si? aad'o! ngangee sèmi sèra sala! nèti èèna ka, ji'i dhu peka mema-mema le, lula abraham parcaya lamatua, ka lamatua cap ne, dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge nèngu.

source_text: when then was it credited? when avraham avinu was bris milah and was in the state of circumcision? or when avraham avinu did not have the bris milah and was in the state of uncircumcision?
target_text: lod'o mia lamatua cap abraham sèmi èèna? lod'o dhu na suna le, do dhae? dhu mola-mola, nuka lèke lod'o dhu na suna mèka.

source_text: not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision! and he received the ot sign or distinguishing mark of the milah circumcision as a chotam seal of the tzidkat haemunah the righteousness of faith which he had in his uncircumcision, in order that he might be father of all who believe through uncircumcision, that to be yitzdak im hashem might be reckoned, counted to them as well,
target_text: tare'a! lod'o abraham suna mèka, ama lamatua cap nare le nèngu dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge lamatua. nèbhu ku, heka na suna kèna, ho j'aj'i tadha, na, nèngu j'aj'i le dhèu dhu lèka lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna ka, abraham j'aj'i dhèu oti j'ara hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya lamatua. te lamatua sèmi nare dhèu dhu parcaya, ho ra pabe'a dènge lamatua, masi ka ra suna, do aad'o.

source_text: and in order that he might be av father to the nimolim circumcised ones, to those who are not only hanimolim but also who follow in the footsteps of the emunah of avraham avinu, which he had in his uncircumcision.
target_text: abraham bhoke j'ara kahèi hia èdhi dhèu yahudi dhu suna le. lula boe nèti èdhi suna, te ngaa lula èdhi parcaya kristus sama sèmi abraham parcaya lamatua lod'o dhu na suna mèka.

source_text: for the havtachah promise to avraham avinu and his zera seed, that he should be yoresh haolam heir of the world, did not come through the context of gezetz but through the tzidkat haemunah the righteousness of faith.
target_text: ama lamatua dhu pa'èki pajaji dènge abraham, dènge ana-èpu na, peka na, nèbhu-nèbhu rai-haha kateme j'aj'i mi pusaka rèngu. lamatua pajaji sèmi èèna, lula abraham parcaya ne, aa lamatua cap ne dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge ne. te ngaa lamatua pajaji boe sèmi èèna, ladhe dhoka abraham tao madhutu atora lamatua.

source_text: for if those depending on zokheh of works are yoreshim heirs, emunah faith is rendered invalid and the havtachah the promise is annulled,
target_text: te ladhe dhèu dhu madhutu dhoka atora lamatua di, bisa sèmi rare pusaka dhu lamatua moa, sasoa na, parcaya mi lamatua parcuma di. aa lii pajaji lamatua èèna guna boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: for gezetz law brings about the charon af hashem, and where there is no gezetz there is no averah transgression, violation of the law.
target_text: ètu era mia abhu atora lamatua, ètu èèna kahèi dhèu sisu atora èèna. aa ladhe dhèu sisu atora lamatua, na, lamatua nasa, hèia na huku si. aa ladhe atora lamatua aad'o, tatu dhèu sisu boe.

source_text: for this reason the havtachah promise is of emunah faith, in order that it might be in accordance with unmerited chen v'chesed hashem, that the havtachah might be certain to all the zera seed, not to him who is of the torah only, but also to bnei emunat avraham the sons of the faith of avraham avinu, to those who are of the faith of abraham. avraham avinu is the father of us all,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i parcaya ku lamatua. èèna ka dhu risi eele nèti aa'i-aa'i. te lamatua d'èi pad'elo dènge mola-mola d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu dhu parcaya ne. aa ladhe èdhi lèka ne, sama sèmi abraham, tatu èdhi abhu ngaa dhu na moa, masi ka èdhi dhèu yahudi dhu tao madhutu atora na, do aad'o. de èdhi aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ne, sama sèmi ana-èpu abraham.

source_text: as it is written, av hamon goyim n'tatichai have made you father of many nations. this was in the sight of hashem in whom he believed, g-d who gives chayyim to the mesim and calls things which have no existence into existence.
target_text: lamatua dhu peka tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci na, aku nèngu na, ja'a ad'u-ue sèna ka èu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti suku ae-ae. abraham parcaya ama lamatua. nèbhu-nèbhu ka ama lamatua tao paj'aj'i lii moa na. nèngu kahèi dhu pamamuri hari dhèu madhe. lamatua dhoka padhai lii di, ka ngaa-ngaa dhu aad'o, j'aj'i dènge.

source_text: against tikvah hope, in tikvah he believed, in order that he might become av hamon goyimfather of many nations in accordance with what had been said, so shall thy zera seed be.
target_text: masi ka abraham dènge mèka ana, te ngaa na lèka ama lamatua, aa tatae lamatua tao madhutu lii pajaji na. nèti parcaya èèna ka, lamatua tao ne j'aj'i mi bèi-baki nèti suku ae-ae. èèna nuka sèmi dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, na, ana-èpu ae-ae bèli-camèd'a mai nèti èu.

source_text: without weakening in emunah in personal faith, bitachon, trust he contemplated his own body, now as good as dead vi-bahlt since he was about one hundred years old, and also the deadness of sarahʼs womb.
target_text: abraham lèka èra lamatua, masi ka ne'a nèngu dhu heka bhora le, umur dhu cangasu tèu kèna. era ana nèti sara dhu bèdho mèno le, aa na heka d'ai seli le.

source_text: he did not, in disbelief, doubt the havtachah of hashemthe promise of g-d, but was strengthened in emunah faith, giving kavod glory to hashem,
target_text: te ngaa lalèka abraham kura boe, ho pangee na, lamatua bisa boe tao madhutu lii padadha na. parcaya na asa tabha èra mi lamatua, aa na ded'e padedha kolongara lamatua.

source_text: being fully convinced that what hashem had promised he also was able to do.
target_text: abraham lèka tare'a-re'a, ngaa dhu lamatua padhadha le, nèngu bisa tao.

source_text: therefore, v'yachsheveha lo tzedakah it was credited to him for righteousness.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua cap abraham, peka na, dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge nèngu.

source_text: nor was it written down for his sake alone that it was reckoned to him,
target_text: sasuri mola-mèci lamatua peka na, lamatua ige boe sèmi èèna hia abraham mesa na,

source_text: but also for us, to whom it is to be reckoned, who believe in him who raised yehoshua adoneinu from the mesim dead ones,
target_text: te ngaa mi èdhi kahèi! te ladhe èdhi parcaya lamatua, na cap èdhi kahèi dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge ne. lamatua ka dhu pamamuri hari kètu èdhi, yesus nèti mamadhe na.

source_text: who was handed over for peysha'einuour transgressions, and made to stand up in his techiyas hamoshiach that we be yitzdak im hashembe justified with g-d, that we have our justification, our acquittal, vindication.
target_text: yesus madhe, lula èdhi ad'u-ue sasala-sasigo. hèia na mamuri hari, ho bhoke j'ara, sèna ka èdhi bisa pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: therefore, having been acquitted and declared not guilty, declared to be yitzdak im hashem on the yesod basis of our emunah faith, we have shalom peace in relation to hashem through rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua adoneinu,
target_text: de, lula èdhi parcaya ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka na cap èdhi dhèu d'ara mola. hèia d'ara èdhi j'aj'i mola-mèci hia lamatua, lula kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, dhu lamatua pua mai, bhoke j'ara ho èdhi bisa padame dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: through whom also we have hasha'ar lahashemgate to appoach g-dʼs presence, access of the tzaddikim by emunah into this unmerited chen v'chesed in which we stand and glory in tikvah of the kavod eloheinu.
target_text: kristus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi, lula èdhi parcaya le nèngu. nèti èèna ka, d'ara èdhi j'aj'i èra. aa d'ara èdhi karae kahèi, lula te'a, na, bèli-camèd'a lamatua neo ded'e èdhi, sèna ka te'a mèu dadedha na.

source_text: not only so, but we also glory in tzoros troubles, afflictions, knowing that tzarah trouble produces savlanut patience,
target_text: masi ka èdhi abhu rupa-rupa sasusa, te ngaa d'ara èdhi karej'e-karae taruu. te èdhi te'a, na, j'èra uuru ku heka bisa taha dènge èra risi hari.

source_text: savlanut produces tested character and midos, and tested character and midos produce tikvah.
target_text: ladhe èdhi èra ka ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, èèna ka dhu tao èdhi manahu boe, aa mamuri èdhi pakarej'e d'ara lamatua. ladhe èdhi mamuri sèmi èèna, èèna ka dhu pa'èra parcaya èdhi, peka na, pe lamatua neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi.

source_text: and tikvah does not in the end lead to our being meyayesh despairing in disillusionment and bushah shame, because the ahavas hashemg-dʼs love has been poured out in our levavot through the ruach hakodesh given to us.
target_text: ladhe lalèka èdhi asa èra sèmi èèna, èdhi makae boe. te lamatua dhu bagi le hia èdhi, roh na dhu mola-mèci, sèna ka èdhi te'a mèu, na, nèngu dhu sue èdhi titu kèna.

source_text: for while we were still helpless, moshiach died for the resha'im the unrighteous persons, the wicked, doing so at the appointed time!
target_text: nèngu pad'elo sasue na sèmi ne'e ka: ropa èdhi mampu boe pabe'a dènge lamatua, te'a boe, na, lamatua dhu pua kristus madhe pala èdhi. te ngaa èdhi dhu mamuri pusi-pahae boe lamatua. lamatua pili lod'o dhu lèke sèna ka tao aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: for only rarely will someone die for a tzaddik righteous man; though efsher perhaps it is conceivable that someone will dare to die for the tzaddik.
target_text: pangee paie-iie ku! te cadhui ku abhu dhèu dhu sadia madhe hia angalai na dhu d'ara mola. ele boe abhu dhèu cahag'e dhu sadia madhe, ho soru dhèu d'ara be'a.

source_text: but hashem demonstrates his ahavah for us in that while we were still chote'im, moshiach died for us.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua pad'elo le sasue na ae-ae mi dedha èdhi. lula, lod'o èdhi mamuri ètu d'ara sasala era, kristus madhe le gati èdhi.

source_text: how much more then, having now been acquitted and pronounced to be yitzdak im hashem on the basis of the moshiachʼs dahm blood and sacrificial death, how much more then shall we be delivered through him from the eschatological charon af hashemburning anger of g-d!
target_text: ama lamatua cap èdhi, dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge ne, lula kristus pasuti raa na, sèna ka madhe gati èdhi. aa te ngaa, ladhe dhèu ue sasala, lamatua nasa. te ngaa nèti mamadhe kristus, èdhi dhu tao sala abhu heka huku.

source_text: for if when we were g-dʼs oyevim enemies, we were reconciled to hashem through the histalkus passing, the mavetdeath of the zun fun der oybershter, how much more, having been reconciled and no longer oyevim, shall we be delivered by his chayyim!
target_text: uru èèna, èdhi pamusu dènge lamatua. te ngaa ana ama lamatua mesa na madhe, ho cuhi d'ara lamatua, sèna ka èdhi bisa padame dènge lamatua. de limuri ne, èdhi pamusu heka, te ngaa pabe'a hari le. risi-risi hari, kristus dhu mamuri hari le, pe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, na hia èdhi mamuri, sèna ka èdhi baku lèke hahuku.

source_text: not only so, but we also glory in hashem though rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua adoneinu, through whom we have now received the ritztzuy reconciliation, cessation of enmity, hostility between a wrathful holy g-d and sinful men.
target_text: mesa boe èèna di! d'ara èdhi bisa karae, peka na, lamatua ne, dedha risi eele! lula èdhi pa'èki dènge ne. èdhi bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu na, lula kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, madhe le pala èdhi, sèna ka èdhi padame dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: therefore, just as through one adam one man, humanity, adam, chet sin entered into the olam hazeh and, through chet sin, entered mavetdeath, and so mavet passed through to kol bnei adam all mankind, all the sons of adam, because all sinned.
target_text: de karèi nèti uuru èèna ka, adam ka dhu tao uru sasala-sasigo. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua hia boe ne mamuri taruu. hèia karèi nèti lod'o èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne madhutu ad'u-ue sasala kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge nèngu. aa, lula rèngu tao sala sama sèmi adam, ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra hud'i madhe ku nuka sèmi nèngu kahèi.

source_text: for before the epoch of the torah law, chet sin, chet kadmon, original sin was in haolam hazeh, the world. but chet sin is not accounted, recorded in the absence of gezetz.
target_text: uru-uru sèra, lod'o ama lamatua papuru mèka atora na, dhèu tao le sasala dhu pale-lème le rai-haha ne. te ngaa, lula dènge mèka atora, ka abhu boe dhu ige sasala-sasigo dhèu sèra.

source_text: nevertheless, mavet death reigned supreme from the epoch of adam until the epoch of moshe rabbeinu, even over those who did not sin in the very same manner of adamʼs averah transgression, disobedience, commandment rebelled against and recorded for death penalty - that is, adam who is a tipus pattern, prophetic type, a demut he'atid a future figure of hu habahhe who comes, moshiach the coming one, the coming go'el redeemer.
target_text: mulai nèti adam toke d'ai musa sèmi rare atora lamatua èèna, dhèu aa'i-aa'i tatu madhe. masi ka rèngu sisu boe paredha lamatua dhu pangèd'u mi adam, te ngaa ra tao rupa-rupa sasala. nèti èèna ka, rèngu hud'i madhe ku, nuka sèmi adam. ladhe èdhi pasoro adam dènge lamatua yesus, abhu dhu sama, aa abhu dhu sama boe. te adam èci èèna ka dènge rupa dhu paj'uj'u asa raropa yesus, dhu bèli-camèd'a èèna cèu mai.

source_text: but the averah transgression was not like the effect of unmerited chesed grace. for if by the averah of the one, the rabbim many died, how much more the unmerited chen v'chesed hashemgrace of g-d and the matnat hachesed free gift of grace of the adam haechad one man rebbe melech hamoshiach yehoshua have overflowed larabbimto the many.
target_text: te ngaa sasala adam, sama boe dènge babe'a dhu yesus hia èdhi. te dhèu èci, nuka adam, sisu paredha lamatua. nèti èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra hud'i madhe ku. te ngaa dhèu èci hari, nuka yesus kristus, tao rupa-rupa babe'a hia mi èdhi, aa pamata boe dhèu b'ala babe'a na. nèti tatao ca dhèu ne'e ka, pad'ai mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, te ama lamatua d'èi tao be'a hia èdhi.

source_text: and the mattanah free gift is not like the effect of that one adamʼs averah. for the mishpat judgment is from one averah transgression to the gezar din verdict of ashem guilty, to harsha'ah condemnation as guilty; but the effect of the unmerited chen v'chesed hashem is from averot rabbot many transgressions to zikkuy acquittal, to that of being yitzdak im hashemjustified with g-d, i. e. , acquittal, justification with hashem of the many.
target_text: dhu ama lamatua pangèd'u mi èdhi, sama boe dènge sasala dhu adam tao èèna. ropa adam tao sasala, ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu, peka na èu sala. de èu hud'i abhu huku! te ngaa masi ka dhèu ue sasala ae titu kèna, ama lamatua, dhu parisa mamuri dhèu aa'i-aa'i, neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na era, aa pama'ète, na, èu sala boe. de èu bebas le, aa mu abhu heka huku. mai, sèna ka pabe'a hari dènge ja'a!

source_text: for if by the averah transgression of the one, mavet death reigned supreme through the one adam, how much more those, who receive the abundance of unmerited chen v'chesed hashemgrace and of the matnat hatzedakah the gift of righteousness, shall reign in life through the one adam, rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua.
target_text: de ca dhèu nuka adam dhu tao sala, aa sisu paredha lamatua. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i madhe ku. te ngaa dhèu èci hari, nuka yesus kristus dhu tao be'a. lula tatao na dhu be'a èèna ka, èdhi bisa pabe'a hari dènge lamatua. èèna nuka sèmi mèdha èci dhu na hia iia d'ara mi èdhi. na neo hia èdhi mamuri dhu lèke, sama sèmi èdhi j'aj'i angalai dhèu aae.

source_text: so, then, as through one averah transgression of adam to kol bnei adam to harsha'ah condemnation as guilty, so also through one mitzvah righteous or worthy deed of moshiach to kol bnei adam to justification unto chayei olam.
target_text: de nèti ca dhèu dhu ad'u-ue sasala, na bhoke j'ara ho ama lamatua babège eele dhèu aa'i-aa'i nèti madha na. aa nèti ca dhèu leo hari dhu tao j'ara dhu lèke, na bhoke j'ara ho dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa pabe'a hari dènge lamatua, sèna ka mamuri mola dènge ne.

source_text: for as through the disobedience of the one adam, the many were made chote'im sinners, so also through the mishma'at obedience of the one adam, the many will be made tzaddikim righteous ones.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e: adam ne, ca dhèu dhu d'èi boe nanene lamatua, ka sisu paredha lamatua. aa dhèu ae kahèi madhutu tao sasala, sama sèmi adam. aa yesus ne, ca dhèu dhu nanene lamatua, ka tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua. nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara, sèna ka dhèu ae bisa pabe'a hari dènge lamatua.

source_text: the epoch of the gezetz came to increase the averah transgression; but where chet sin, chet kadmon increased, unmerited chen v'chesed hashem overflowed in abundance,
target_text: ama lamatua papuru atora na re musa, ho dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a mèu, mia dhu sala. te ngaa ètu mia-mia sasala dhèu asa tabha ae. ètu èèna kahèi, lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na ae risi hari.

source_text: in order that as chet sin reigned in mavet death, so also chesed might reign through tzedek olamim to chayyei olam through rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua adoneinu.
target_text: uru èèna, bhabhelu ètu d'ara dhèu abhu koasa dhu uri rèngu, toke ra tao sasala dhu nèti mamadhe. te ngaa limuri ne, j'ara be'a dhu kètu èdhi, yesus kristus tao èèna, ama lamatua pake ho pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi. aa j'ara be'a ne dènge koasa sèna ka ator èdhi kahèi, hèia èdhi bisa pabe'a dènge ama lamatua, aa mamuri mola taruu dènge ne.

source_text: what then shall we say? are we to persist in chet sin in order that the unmerited chen v'chesed hashem might increase?
target_text: de èdhi peka ngaa hari? ele boe miu pangee, na, ama lamatua pabhèlu eele le sasala èdhi, lula d'ara hua iia na. nèti èèna ka, hud'i laa èdhi tino tao sala, sèna ka lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na risi hari mi èdhi.

source_text: chas v'shalom! vi-bahlt since we have died to chet, how can we still live in it?
target_text: aad'o sèmi èèna! lèke boe ladhe èdhi tao sala taruu. te èdhi dhu pama'ète tare le, peka na, èdhi tèke eele aa'i le sasala-sasigo èdhi. lula èdhi pa'èki heka dènge bhabhelu-katub'a, èèna nuka sèmi èdhi dhu madhe le! te dhèu dhu madhe le bisa heka tao sala, si? ladhe èdhi madhe le, tasamia hari èdhi bisa mamuri ad'u-ue sasala? bisa boe, sina ma?

source_text: or do you lack da'as that all we who were given a mikveh mayim tevilah into rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua were given a tevilah into moshiachʼs histalkus, into his mavet death?
target_text: ele boe miu me'a boe, na, ropa sarani èdhi, èèna j'aj'i tadha, na, èdhi tèke eele le mamuri dhui, ho abhu mamuri hiu, nuka dhu pa'èki dènge yesus kristus. èèna sama sèmi èdhi madhe le palere-lere dènge ne.

source_text: so then we were co-buried, buried together with kivromoshiachʼs kever through a tevilah into mavet, in order that, just as rebbe melech hamoshiach was given the techiyah resurrection from hamesim the dead ones through the kavod haav, so we also should have a halakhah walk lifnei hashem in hitkhadshut renewal, regeneration, in chayyim chadashim new life.
target_text: lod'o kristus madhe, ra padhane ne. aa lod'o ra sarani èdhi, èèna nuka sèmi èdhi madhe kahèi, tèke eele mamuri dhui, hèia ra padhane èdhi. de ama lamatua pake koasa na dhu kapai aae èèna, ho pamamuri hari kristus nèti mamadhe na. ama lamatua d'èi ladhe èdhi sèmi tare koasa na kahèi, ho mamuri hari j'aj'i dhèu dhu hiu.

source_text: for if we have become grown together with the very likeness of his histalkus, his mavet death, we shall certainly also be grown together with the very likeness of his techiyah from hamesim resurrection.
target_text: te èèna sama sèmi èdhi madhe palere dènge yesus. de èdhi dhu pa'èki dènge ne, tatu bèli-camèd'a èdhi mamuri hari nèti mamadhe, sama sèmi nèngu mamuri hari.

source_text: having da'as of this, that, with moshiach, our old humanity in adam has been put to death on moshiachʼs etztree, the etz hakelelat hashem, the tree of the curse of g-d in order that the etsem haadam hachet the essence of the sinful human condition might be done away with, so that we might no longer serve chet sin.
target_text: uru èèna, èdhi j'aj'i dhèu dhu tao rupa-rupa sasala. te ngaa mamuri èdhi dhu dhui èèna, madhe le, èci èèna ka dènge paku pamadhe èdhi ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha palere-lere dènge kristus. limuri ne, bhabhelu ètu d'ara èdhi dènge heka koasa ho uri èdhi. limuri ne, èdhi aad'o heka ètu d'ara a'èki sèna ka tao hari sasala. te èdhi sèmi heka ènu dhu dènge boe hak ho pili neo tao ngaa.

source_text: for he who has died is declared niftar freed, deceased from chet.
target_text: ladhe dhèu dhu madhe le, nèngu bebas le, si? abhu heka ngaa èci sa laka-seti ne, ho ad'u-ue hari sasala.

source_text: but if we have died with moshiach, we believe that we shall also live with him,
target_text: de, lula èèna nuka sèmi èdhi madhe le palere-lere dènge kristus, na, èdhi parcaya, peka na, bèli-camèd'a èdhi mamuri taruu dènge ne kahèi.

source_text: having da'as that moshiach, having been given the techiyah resurrection from the mesim dead ones, no longer dies, mavet death and histalkus no longer exercise control over him.
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, lula yesus kristus mamuri hari le nèti mamadhe na, de nèngu bisa heka madhe hari. te abhu boe èci sa dhu dènge koasa ho pamadhe hari ne.

source_text: for the mavet moshiach died, he died to chet sin once and for all; but the chayyim moshiach lives, he lives to hashem.
target_text: na madhe ca tèka èèna ka, ho segi koasa nèti sasala. te ngaa limuri ne na mamuri ho pakab'ua ama lamatua.

source_text: so also you must reckon yourselves mesim dead ones to chet sin but chayyim l'hashem b'moshiach yehoshua alive to g-d in messiah yehoshua.
target_text: miu hud'i tao ku iisi sèmi èèna. nuka sèmi miu dhu madhe le, nèti èèna ka sasala dènge heka koasa mi dedha miu. de limuri ne, miu hud'i mamuri ku ho pakab'ua ama lamatua, lula miu dhu pa'èki le dènge yesus kristus.

source_text: therefore, do not let chet sin reign in your mortal body to obey its ta'avot,
target_text: bhabhelu ètu d'ara èu dhu dènge koasa. baku soro tèke bhabhelu èèna ator èu, ka èu dhoka madhutu dad'èi ngi'u aae sèna ka èu tao bhabhelu-katub'a. te èèna na ngi'u aae èu madhe.

source_text: and do not give chet sin control of your natural capacities as neshek weapons of peysha unrighteousness, transgression, but present yourselves to hashem as ones alive from the mesim and present to hashem your natural capacities as neshek weapons of tzedek olamim.
target_text: aa baku soro isi èu sèna ka tao j'ara dhu lèke boe, te èèna sala kahèi. te ngaa pangèd'u mamuri èu mi ama lamatua di, sèna ka nèngu ka dhu uri mamuri èu. sama sèmi èu dhu madhe le, ka mamuri hari. de pake la mamuri èu kateme aa'i, sèna ka tao j'ara dhu lèke sèra, hia mi lamatua.

source_text: for chet sin shall not exercise bailus sovereignty, ownership, dominion over you; for you are not under gezetz but under chesed grace.
target_text: baku soro tèke sèna ka sasala ator miu, sama sèmi sasala ka dhu j'aj'i lamatua miu. de limuri ne miu hud'i mamuri madhutu ia ka atora musa, sèna ka pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua. te miu dhu mamuri mola le, lula lamatua dhu pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi miu. de limuri ne d'ara hua iia lamatua ka dhu uri mamuri miu.

source_text: what then? should we commit averah, because we are not under gezetzlaw but under chesed grace? chas v'shalom!
target_text: de tasamia? ele boe miu ngee, na, èdhi madhutu ia ka atora musa, ho pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua. de hud'i laa èdhi tao sala taruu di. te lamatua neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na era mi èdhi! miu pangee sèmi èèna ka, si? ja'a pasanèd'e, èèna na sale!

source_text: do you not know that when you give control of yourselves as someoneʼs avadim slaves to obey him, you are the avadim slaves of the one you obey, whether of chet sin resulting in mavet death, or of lishmo'a b'kol hashemlistening to the voice of hashem, mishma'at, obedience resulting in tzedek olamim?
target_text: ja'a kore upama nèti ènu dènge lamatua na. ladhe miu soro ngi'u mi ho sab'a hia dhèu èci, na, miu hud'i nanene, aa sab'a madhutu dad'èi na. te nèngu èèna kètu miu, aa miu j'aj'i ènu na. sèmi èèna kahèi, miu bisa pili neo madhutu mia. te miu bisa pili, sèna ka ad'u-ue sasala, hèia miu j'aj'i mi ènu nèti sasala ne. te ngaa ladhe miu pili sèmi èèna, miu tao iisi mi pacèri nèti ama lamatua. do, miu bisa pili tao dhu lèke, dènge j'aj'i ènu dhu tao madhutu ngaa dhu lamatua pua mi. ladhe pili sèmi èèna, miu bisa pabe'a dènge ne!

source_text: but baruch hashemblessed be g-d that you used to be avadim slaves of chet, but you gave your mishma'at shebalev obedience from the heart to the pattern of torahthe pnimiyus torah of moshiach to which you were handed over.
target_text: uru èèna, miu soro tèke sèna ka sasala uri miu, te ngaa limuri ne miu nanene d'ara iiki miu, sèna ka tao madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu sarani aj'a-nori miu. nèti èèna ka ja'a manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: having been set free from chet sin, you became an eved of the tzidkat hashemthe righteousness of g-d.
target_text: te lamatua dhu patalale le miu nèti koasa sasala, toke sasala sèra uri heka miu. de limuri ne, j'ara dhu lèke ka dhu uri miu.

source_text: i speak in human terms on account of the weakness of your frail fallen humanity. for just as you handed over your natural capacities as avadim slaves to tum'a uncleanness and to lawlessness which results in lawlessness, so now hand over your natural capacities as servants of tzidkat hashem which results in kedushah holiness.
target_text: ja'a peka ne'e, pake conto dhu j'aj'i bèli-bèli, nèti lamatua dènge ènu, sèna ka miu me'a malai ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai. uru èèna, miu hia ngi'u miu j'aj'i ènu sèna ka tao sala, dhu pakaj'alu miu madhutu atora musa. te ngaa limuri ne, miu hud'i hia ngi'u miu j'aj'i ènu dhu me'a dhoka tao dhu be'a di, dhu hia miu j'aj'i dhèu mola-mèci ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: for when you were avadim slaves of chet, you were free in relation to tzedek olamim.
target_text: uru èèna, ropa miu dhoka nanene aa tao madhutu dad'èi sasala, miu mo'o boe nanene aa tao dhu lèke.

source_text: what p'ri for hashem did you produce then? things for which you now have bushah shame, for the end result of those things is mavet death.
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: miu abhu ngaa dhu be'a nèti tatao miu sèra? aad'o, sina ma? aa te ngaa, ngaa dhu miu abhu sèra tao miu mi'e makae di. lula miu tao sala sèmi èèna, ka dhu miu abhu, nuka lamatua soro kabodho mi miu.

source_text: but now, having been set free from chet sin and having been made an eved hashema servant of g-d, you have your p'ri for hashem, resulting in kedushah, and the end is chayyei olam eternal life.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, ama lamatua patalale eele le miu nèti lamatua uru èèna, de miu parluu ia ka tao sasala. de ne'e ne miu hud'i j'aj'i ku dhèu sab'a nèti ama lamatua. lèpa lod'o limuri, pe miu j'aj'i mola-mèci hia ne, aa abhu mamuri mola-mèci dhu d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: for the loin wages that chet sin pays out of its own payroll is mavet death; however, the gracious matnat hachesed hashemthe gift of the grace of g-d is chayyei olam b'moshiach yehoshua adoneinu.
target_text: te ropa èdhi tao sasala, lamatua tule eele èdhi toke d'ai mia-mia. èèna ka dhu èdhi abhu. èdhi madhe kèna! te ngaa ama lamatua bhoke le j'ara èci hia èdhi. te na neo hia iia èdhi mamuri mola dhu ma'ète boe. èdhi abhu mamuri èèna, ladhe èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: do you not have da'as, achim b'moshiach, for i speak to those who know the torah, that the torah exercises marut authority, rule over a man so long as he lives?
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a neo padhai lii dènge miu dhu me'a mèu atora huku sèra. sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe miu mamuri era, atora huku dènge hak ho ator miu. te ngaa ladhe miu madhe le, atora huku dènge heka hak mi miu.

source_text: for the agunah woman whose husbandʼs whereabouts are unknown is bound by the gezetz to her husband while he lives; but in the case that her husbandʼs death can be confirmed, she is no longer an agunah and is released from the gezetz of her husband.
target_text: ja'a kore pakasame nèti atora dhèu èmu-kamali. ladhe dhèu bhèni èci leo le èmu dènge mone èci, na, madhutu atora huku, dua ra j'aj'i dhèu èmu-kamali toke madhe. te ngaa ladhe dhèu mone madhe uuru, bhèni balu ne pa'èki heka dènge atora deo na. nèngu bisa hari leo-èmu.

source_text: accordingly she will be named no'ehfet adulteress if, while her husband lives, she becomes another manʼs. but if her ba'al husband dies, she is free from the gezetz, so that she is no no'ehfet adulteress if she becomes another manʼs.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe bhèni ne leo hari èmu lod'o dhèu èmu na mamuri era, nèngu bersina. te ngaa ladhe dhèu èmu na madhe le, atora nèti laleo èmu lèke heka nèngu. bhèni ne j'aj'i dhèu kalora iisi. de ladhe na madhèdi hari dènge dhèu leo, madhutu atora, nèngu bersina boe.

source_text: so then, achim b'moshiach, you also were put to death in relation to the gezetz through the basar of moshiach, in order that you might become anotherʼs, bound to moshiach who was given techiyah resurrection from the mesim, so that we might bear p'ri for hashem.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu dhèu parcaya! sèmi ne'e: kristus madhe le. èèna nuka sèmi miu madhutu madhe dènge ne kahèi, hèia tèke eele mamuri miu dhu dhui. ka atora huku lèke heka mi miu. limuri ne atora huku lèke heka miu, te ngaa mamuri miu pa'èki dènge kristus, dhu mamuri hari nèti mamadhe na. èèna cakaraa dènge bhèni balu dhu leo hari èmu. ngaa-ngaa tao boe. de limuri ne aa'i-aa'i dhu miu ad'u-ue sèra, hia mi lamatua.

source_text: for when we were in the basar in the fallen condition of the old humanity, through the gezetz, the ta'avat besarim, the sinful passions were working in our natural capacities, so as to bear p'ri for mavet death.
target_text: te uru èèna, èdhi tao dhoka madhutu dad'èi ngi'u aae èdhi di. lula èdhi te'a atora, èèna ka dhu hia èdhi sisu atora sèra, ho tao j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe. de sasala èdhi sèra ka dhu tao ama lamatua soro kabodho mi èdhi.

source_text: but now we have become niftar freed, deceased from the dominating ownership of the gezetz, having died to that by which we were confined, so that we might serve in the ruach hakodesh of hitkhadshut and newness and not in the yoshen oldness of chumra stringency, strict adherence to the letter of the law.
target_text: uru èèna, èdhi hud'i tao madhutu ku atora. te ngaa limuri ne, atora ne lèke heka èdhi, dhu tèke eele le mamuri dhu dhui. madhutu dad'èi j'ara dhui, na, atora musa dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci èèna, dhu èki tèke èdhi. te ngaa madhutu dad'èi j'ara hiu, na, èdhi pa'èki heka dènge atora èèna. te roh lamatua ka dhu uri èdhi! nèti èèna ka, limuri ne èdhi sab'a dhoka hia lamatua.

source_text: what then shall we say? that the gezetz is considered as chet sin? chas v'shalom! nevertheless, i would not have experienced chet sin except through the gezetz; for i would not have known chamdanut covetousness, greediness if the torah had not said, lo tachmodthou shalt not covet.
target_text: de èdhi neo peka ngaa? neo peka, na, atora dhu lamatua hia re musa ne, sala! aad'o! te ladhe ja'a ke'a mèu boe atora ne, tatu ja'a bisa boe ke'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe ètu d'ara ja'a. nuka sèmi, abhu atora dhu peka na, mage d'ara neo mere mèdha-panyau dhèu. te ngaa dènge j'ara tasamia ka, ja'a bisa ke'a, na, d'ara neo sèmi èèna, sala, ladhe ke'a boe atora èèna? bisa boe!

source_text: but chet sin, seizing its opportunity through the mitzvoh commandment, stirred up all manner of chamdanut covetousness in me. for in the absence of the gezetz, chet sin is dead.
target_text: te ngaa lula abhu atora dhu peka sèmi èèna, èèna nuka sèmi j'ara-j'ara bhelu ètu d'ara ja'a, sèna ka ja'a neo kore rupa-rupa mèdha-panyau dhèu. ladhe dènge boe atora dhu kai, sasala na abhu boe koasa ho ator dhèu.

source_text: and in the absence of the gezetz i was once alive. but when the mitzvoh commandment came, chet sin became alive,
target_text: ètu mamuri ja'a uru èèna, ja'a ke'a mèu mèka dad'èi nèti atora lamatua. nèbhu-nèbhu ku, heka ke'a kèna. nèti èèna ka, ja'a mulai mase'a, na, ja'a sisu le atora sèra ka ad'u-ue sasala. de hua nèti sasala èèna ka, ja'a hud'i madhe ku.

source_text: and i died. the mitzvoh commandment intended as the derech l'chayyim way to life proved for me a means to mavet death.
target_text: hèia d'ara ja'a roe bhilu, te ke'a na, ja'a mesa ku bisa boe pabe'a ja'a dènge lamatua, ladhe tao madhutu dhoka atora na. de pantas ladhe ja'a abhu nanasa nèti lamatua, nuka huku madhe èèna, lula ja'a sisu le atora na. aa te ngaa lamatua hia atora ne, sèna ka dhèu bisa mamuri dhu lèke. te ngaa bagi ja'a, atora ne ka dhu pa'ele iie ja'a, ka lamatua soro kabodho mi ja'a.

source_text: for chet sin, seizing its opportunity through the mitzvoh commandment, deceived me and, through the mitzvoh commandment, killed me.
target_text: atora ne mema pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu mola. te ngaa abhu bhabhelu dhu sub'u ètu d'ara ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a tipu hari ngi'u ja'a mesa ku, ho pangee na, ja'a bisa pabe'a ja'a dènge ama lamatua, sad'i ja'a tao madhutu atora na. hèia èèna nuka sèmi atora mesa èèna ka dhu tao toke lamatua mad'enge dènge ja'a.

source_text: so that the torah is kedoshah holy and the mitzvoh commandment is kedoshah and yasharah and tovah.
target_text: de ladhe deo na dhèu peka na, atora dhu lamatua hia re musa èèna, sala, na, ja'a dhaa na, aad'o! atora lamatua ne, mola-mèci! aa paredha aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara atora ne mola-mèci, lèke, aa be'a kahèi.

source_text: did that which is good, then, become mavet death to me? chas v'shalom! but chet sin, it was chet, working mavet death in me through that which is tovah, in order that chet might be shown as chet sin, and in order that chet through the mitzvoh commandment might become chata'ah gedolah ad m'od utterly sinful.
target_text: ele boe miu pangee, na, atora ne ka dhu tao lamatua soro kabodho mi ja'a, do? aad'o! te masi ka ja'a ke'a atora sèra, te ngaa ja'a nanene taruu bhabhelu ètu d'ara ja'a, nèti èèna ka ja'a tao sala. de nèti sasala ja'a èèna ka lamatua soro kabodho mi ja'a. atora ne mema be'a, te èèna ka dhu pad'elo j'ara-j'ara bhelu-katub'a dhu tao èdhi pacèri nèti ama lamatua. de ropa lamatua pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu lèke, atora èèna ka dhu peka paled'a, na, bhabhelu ètu d'ara èdhi èèna, be'a boe.

source_text: for we have da'as that the torah is ruchanit spiritual, of the ruach hakodesh; but i am of the basar fallen humanity sold under the power of slave master chet kadmon chet.
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, atora dhu lamatua pangèd'u re musa, puru mai nèti roh lamatua. te ngaa ja'a ne dhoka dhèu rai-haha biasa di, dhu dènge d'ara dhu èra boe. hèia ja'a nanene j'ara-j'ara bhelu ètu d'ara ja'a, toke ja'a manahu asa d'ara sasala. èèna nuka sèmi sasala dhu j'aj'i lamatua ja'a, aa ja'a j'aj'i mi ènu nèti sasala.

source_text: for i do not have da'as what i do. for that which i commit is not what i want; no, it is what i hate that i do!
target_text: pamalaa ja'a. ja'a ke'a boe ngaa ka dhu ja'a tao. te ja'a tao boe madhutu ngaa dhu ja'a neo tao. te ngaa ja'a tao madhutu ngaa dhu ja'a d'èi boe tao.

source_text: but if that which i do is what i do not want, i agree with the torah that the gezetz is good.
target_text: ladhe ja'a tao ngaa dhu ja'a neo boe tao, ja'a mangaku, na, atora lamatua ne lèke.

source_text: but now it is no longer i doing this, but the power of chet sin which dwells within me.
target_text: de ja'a boe ka dhu uri ngi'u ja'a. te bhabhelu dhu muri ètu d'ara ja'a ka dhu uli ja'a!

source_text: for i have da'as that there dwells in me, that is, in my basar my fallen humanity enslaved to chet kadmon no good thing; for the wish to do what is right lies ready at hand for me, but to accomplish the good is not.
target_text: ja'a ke'a le, na, abhu boe j'ara dhu be'a muri ètu d'ara ja'a. te ja'a ne dhèu rai-haha dhu d'ara karehe. d'èi do d'èi boe, ja'a bisa boe pakaseti iisi sèna ka tao dhu lèke. ja'a d'èi tao dhu be'a, te ngaa j'aj'i boe!

source_text: for i fail to do good as i wish, but harah the evil which i do not wish is what i commit.
target_text: te ja'a d'èi tao dhu be'a, te ngaa j'aj'i boe tao. aa ko'o boe tao dhu bhelu, te ngaa cèku tao!

source_text: but if what i do not wish is that which i do, it is no longer i doing it but the power of chet sin, chet kadmon, original sin which dwells within me.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a ad'u-ue ngaa dhu ko'o boe tao, èèna mai boe nèti ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa lula sasala dhu muri ètu d'ara ja'a.

source_text: i find then it be a gezetz that for me who wishes to do hatov the good, that for me harah the evil lies ready at hand.
target_text: ne'e ne j'aj'i mi tate'a èci, sèmi ne'e ka: masi ka ja'a neo tao dhu be'a, te ngaa abhu bhabhelu dhu palab'a ètu d'ara ja'a.

source_text: for i rejoice, i have simcha torah in the torah of hashem, so far as the adam hapenimi is concerned,
target_text: aa te ngaa madhutu iia-iia ètu d'ara ja'a karej'e titu kèna, ladhe ja'a pangee atora lamatua.

source_text: but i see another gezetz law in my natural capacities at milchamah war with the torah of my mind and making me a prisoner to the gezetz of chet sin which is a power in my natural capacities.
target_text: te ngaa nuka sèmi abhu koasa ètu d'ara ja'a dhu pa'ele iie ja'a. te ja'a neo tao dhu be'a, te ngaa j'aj'i boe. èèna nuka sèmi koasa bhabhelu ètu d'ara ja'a dhu kèpe nare ja'a, ho laka-seti madhutu ne.

source_text: wretched man am i! who will deliver me from the body of this mavet death?
target_text: ira ii, kasian, ee! ja'a ne dhèu j'èra! dhèu cee ka dhu bisa patabuli ja'a nèti koasa bhabhelu dhu muri ètu d'ara ja'a ne, dhu tao lamatua mad'enge dènge ja'a?

source_text: hodu l'hashemthanks be to g-d b'moshiach yehoshua adoneinu. so then i myself with my mind serve the torah of hashem and with my basar i serve the gezetz of chet the law of sin.
target_text: te ngaa malo-malo ka! ama lamatua unu na ka dhu bhoke j'ara ho patabuli eele ja'a! ja'a manèngi makasi ae-ae mi lamatua, lula kètu èdhi yesus kristus bisa hia mamuri mi ja'a! de ladhe ja'a mamuri maena dhoka mi ngi'u ja'a di, na, ja'a j'èra. masi ka ja'a neo tao madhutu atora lamatua, te ngaa abhu koasa bhabhelu ètu d'ara ja'a, dadugu ja'a, sèna ka tao taruu dhoka bhabhelu-katub'a di.

source_text: therefore, now there is no gezar din verdict of ashem guilty, no harsha'ah condemnation as guilty for those in moshiach yehoshua.
target_text: de ama lamatua huku boe dhèu dhu pa'èki dènge yesus kristus!

source_text: for the torah of the ruach hakodesh that gives chayyim in moshiach yehoshua has set me free from the gezetz of chet and mavet.
target_text: te abhu dua lii tate'a dhu lèke: ka èci peka na, ladhe èdhi pa'èki dènge yesus kristus, roh lamatua hia koasa mi èdhi ho bisa mamuri mola. ka dua peka na, abhu bhabhelu ètu d'ara èdhi dhu kakèj'i èdhi ho tao sala. aa ladhe èdhi tao sala, ama lamatua mad'enge dènge èdhi. aa ladhe èdhi abhu roh lamatua, na patalale èdhi nèti koasa sasala.

source_text: for what the gezetz was unable to do in that it was weak through the basar, g-d sent his own zun fun der oybershter in the very demut likeness of the basar of sinful humanity and as a chattatsin offering, sin atoning sacrifice, and both pronounced and effected a sentence of death on hachet babasar sin in the flesh, in the fallen old humanity,
target_text: masi ka èdhi tao madhutu atora musa, èèna bisa boe patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala, lula èdhi se dhoka dhèu rai-haha biasa di dhu tao bhabhelu katub'a taruu. te ngaa lamatua ka dhu bhoke j'ara. te nèngu pua ana mone mesa na mai, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha biasa, sama sèmi èdhi kahèi. masi ka èdhi dhèu rai-haha biasa tao rupa-rupa sasala, te ngaa yesus mesa-mesa na dhu tao nèdhi boe sasala ngaa-ngaa. ngaa hari, nèngu j'aj'i korban, ho saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu.

source_text: in order that the maleh chukat hatorahthe full statute requirement of the torah might be fulfilled in us whose halakhah is in the derech hachayyim the way of life according to the ruach hakodesh and not in accordance with the basar.
target_text: ama lamatua hia kristus mai, sèna ka na madhe, ho hud'i laa èdhi bisa tao j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke, madhutu atora lamatua. ka limuri ne, èdhi tao j'ara-j'ara dhu mola madhutu dad'èi roh lamatua, aa tao heka madhutu dad'èi d'ara unu ti.

source_text: for those who exist in terms of the basar take the side of the basar, whereas those who exist in terms of the ruach take the side of the ruach hakodesh.
target_text: dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi d'ara unu ra, tao sèmi èèna lula ra pangee dhoka j'ara bhabhelu di. te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi roh lamatua, rèngu dhoka pangee j'ara-j'ara dhu pakarej'e d'ara roh lamatua di.

source_text: for the way of thinking of the basar is mavet death, whereas the way of thinking of the ruach hakodesh is chayyim and shalom.
target_text: dhèu dhu soro tèke bhabhelu ator ngangee na, sama sèmi dhèu dhu nanene boe roh lamatua, nuka sèmi d'ara nèngu aad'o heka dènge lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu soro tèke roh lamatua ator ngangee na, mamuri na mola, aa d'ara na mera-milu.

source_text: because the way of thinking of the basar is hostility, eyvahenmity toward g-d, for it does not submit itself to the gezetz of g-d; for it cannot.
target_text: dad'èi èdhi dhèu rai-haha ne, palab'a bia dènge dad'èi lamatua. hèia èdhi to'o boe pahaha iisi ho nanene lamatua, lula èdhi mesa ti bisa boe.

source_text: and those who are in the basar are not able to please hashem.
target_text: te dhèu dhu soro tèke dad'èi ra ator rèngu, d'èi do d'èi boe, èèna bisa boe pakarej'e d'ara lamatua.

source_text: however, you are not in the basar but in the ruach hakodesh, assuming that the ruach hakodesh of hashem does indeed dwell in you - if anyone does not have the ruach hamoshiach, that person does not belong to moshiach.
target_text: te ngaa miu se, dhèu dhu mamuri bhelu heka, madhutu dad'èi d'ara mi. te ladhe abhu roh lamatua dhu mamuri ètu d'ara miu, miu tao j'ara-j'ara dhu pakarej'e d'ara nèngu. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu roh kristus pea boe ètu d'ara na, nèngu j'aj'i boe dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: and if moshiach is in you, the body of the basar is dead because of sin but the ruach is life for you because of tzedek righteousness.
target_text: ngi'u aae miu bèli-camèd'a madhe, lula sasala dhu miu tao uru sèra. te ngaa, lula limuri ne kristus mamuri ètu d'ara miu, roh miu mamuri taruu, lula ama lamatua cap le miu dhèu d'ara mola, hèia miu pabe'a hari le dènge ne.

source_text: but if the ruach hakodesh of him who gave yehoshua techiyah resurrection from the mesim dwells in you, he who raised moshiach from the mesim will give chayyim to your mortal bodies as well, through his indwelling ruach hakodesh in you.
target_text: te ama lamatua ka dhu pamamuri hari yesus kristus nèti mamadhe na. de masi ka èdhi madhe, te ngaa ladhe roh lamatua dhu mamuri ètu d'ara èdhi, pe nèngu pamamuri hari èdhi kahèi. sasoa na, na pamamuri èdhi sama sèmi na pamamuri hari kristus.

source_text: so then, achim b'moshiach, we are under no obligation to the basar to live in accordance with the basar.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e a'ari aa'i-aa'i! èdhi dhu dènge kèlu-g'ètu. mage nèti kèlu-g'ètu ne, ho mamuri èdhi madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha di, te ngaa èdhi hud'i mamuri madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: for if you live in accordance with the basar you will certainly die; but if by the ruach hakodesh you put to death the shameful acts of the body, you will live.
target_text: te ladhe èdhi mamuri madhutu dhoka bhabhelu ètu d'ara èdhi di, tatu lamatua soro kabodho mi èdhi, aa èdhi pasae tare huku madhe! te ngaa ladhe èdhi soro tèke roh lamatua palaho koasa sasala ètu d'ara èdhi, èèna na èdhi heka bisa mamuri dhu mola kèna.

source_text: for as many as are led by the ruach haelohim, they are bnei haelohim.
target_text: dhèu dhu nanene roh lamatua, sèna ka na ator si, na, dhèu se'e ka dhu j'aj'i ana-ana ama lamatua.

source_text: for you did not receive a spirit of avdut, falling back into pachad fear; but you received the ruach of mishpat habanim adoption, having ma'amad habanim the standing as sons, by which we cry, abba, avinu!
target_text: ladhe èdhi soro tèke roh lamatua ator èdhi, na tao boe èdhi sèmi ènu dhu mamuri dhoka dènge d'ara madha'u di. uru èèna, èdhi mamuri sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa, lula èdhi sèmi tare le roh lamatua ho uri èdhi, èdhi te'a le, na, èdhi j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, nèngu d'èi tadèngi, ladhe èdhi paroa ne, ama pasue!

source_text: the ruach hakodesh himself bears eidus witness with our ruach that we are bnei haelohim.
target_text: d'ara èdhi unu ti ka dhu peka na, èdhi j'aj'i ana-ana lamatua. aa roh lamatua kahèi peka sèmi èèna.

source_text: and if bnei haelohim, then also yoreshim heirs of g-d and co-heirs together with moshiach, provided that we suffer with him in order that we might also be set in kavod glory, eschatological glorification with him.
target_text: ladhe èdhi j'aj'i ana-ana lamatua, èèna sasoa na, bèli-camèd'a èdhi sèmi tare pusaka na, lula nèngu j'aj'i ama èdhi. aa ladhe ama hia pusaka mi ana na kristus, èdhi kahèi sèmi palere-lere dènge ne. te ngaa abhu ca j'ara era: èdhi hud'i abhu ku j'aj'èra, sama sèmi kristus kahèi dhu abhu le j'aj'èra, sèna ka bèli-camèd'a lamatua ded'e èdhi padedha-dedha, nuka sèmi nèngu ded'e padedha-dedha le kristus.

source_text: for i reckon that the yisurim suffering of zman hazeh of this present time are not to be compared with the coming kavod glory to be revealed in us.
target_text: te ngaa madhutu a'abhu ja'a, j'aj'èra dhu èdhi pasae ne'e ne, kab'ua na aad'o, ladhe pasoro dènge dadedha dhu lamatua neo pad'elo mi èdhi.

source_text: for the eager expectation of habri'ah the creation awaits the heavenly hisgalus revelation, unveiling of the bnei haelohim.
target_text: madhutu iia-iia na, aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua paj'aj'i ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha, dhu mate tatae neo rèdhi na pad'elo ana-ana na sèra, nuka cee! te na neo pad'elo dènge ra, dènge d'ara karej'e-karae.

source_text: for habri'ah the creation was subjected to hevel futility, not willingly, but on account of him who subjected it, in tikvah hope,
target_text: te ama lamatua paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha, aa dènge isi ra aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka tao madhutu dad'èi na. te ngaa ra madhutu boe, lula boe dad'èi rèngu, te ngaa nèti dad'èi lamatua, te na huku si sèna ka pa'ele iie si. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu era maena era.

source_text: because habri'ah also itself will be set free from the avdut slavery of corruption into the derorfreedom of the kavod glory of the bnei haelohim.
target_text: te limuri ne aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua paj'aj'i sèra ele iie, aa abhu boe j'ara kalua. te ngaa èèna na, lamatua neo patabuli si, sèna ka ra ele iie heka, te ngaa rèngu bisa j'aj'i kapai titu kèna madhutu dad'èi na. lamatua kahèi neo ded'e padedha-dedha ana-ana na, ho patabuli rèngu nèti dhu ele iie sèra.

source_text: for we have da'as that the whole bri'ah groans and suffers the chevlei leydah pangs of childbirth until now.
