target_text: de ladhe ja'a pabagi kore ka doi se'e mi a'ari èdhi ètu yerusalem, ja'a neo dhuli pangad'o dènge miu, ropa laku asa spanyol.

source_text: and i have da'as that when i come to you, i will come in the fullness of the birkat hamoshiach.
target_text: ladhe ja'a dhiu, kèti dènge mèngi-nale ae-ae nèti kristus.

source_text: i appeal to you, achim b'moshiach, through adoneinu moshiach yehoshua and the ahavas haruach hakodesh, to contend with me in your tefillos to hashem on my behalf,
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! lula yesus kristus j'aj'i kètu miu, aa lula roh lamatua ka tao miu pasue èci dènge èci, nèti èèna ka ja'a manèngi ho miu sabaj'a patare'a-re'a, sèna ka lamatua soru-bara ja'a.

source_text: that i might be delivered from those without mishma'at in yehudah and my avodas kodesh service to yerushalayim might be acceptable to the kedoshim,
target_text: manèngi sèna ka lamatua bhiri-sarobho ja'a ètu propensi yudea, ho dhèu dhu ro'o boe parcaya lamatua baku tao bhelu mi dedha ja'a. aa manèngi ho ladhe ja'a lalau-lalo'o dhèu sarani ètu yerusalem, rèngu sèmi rare ja'a dènge be'a.

source_text: that i might come to you in simcha joy birtzon hashemin the will of g-d and be mutually refreshed by your hitkhabrut fellowship in the messianic chavurah.
target_text: èle èèna, ladhe madhutu dad'èi lamatua, ja'a bisa dhiu asa miu dènge d'ara karej'e, lula ja'a neo ae kore ciki dènge miu.

source_text: v'elohei hashalom im kulechem. omein. may the g-d of peace be with you all. amen.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a sèna ka lamatua bera-bera dènge miu. te nèngu ka dhu bisa tao ho dhèu mamuri dame dènge mera-milu. lèke tare'a!

source_text: i recommend to you achoteinu our sister phoebe, the messianic shammash of the kehillah in cenchrea,
target_text: dènge sasuri ne'e, ja'a neo patadha miu dènge ana hèni èdhi febe, aa manèngi ho miu sèmi mere ne. nèngu ka dhu ra ded'e ho ladhe-leru juma'at ètu kota kengkrea.

source_text: that you be mekarev welcome and treat well to her in adoneinu, in a manner worthy of the kedoshim and assist her in whatever matter she may have need of you. for she herself has also been patroness of many and of myself.
target_text: ja'a manèngi ho miu sèmi mere ne dènge be'a. tao dhu pantas mi nèngu, nuka sèmi hia dhèu sarani sèra, lula nèngu ne pa'èki dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ladhe na parluu ngaa, soru-bara ne. te nèngu biasa soru-bara le ja'a dènge dhèu ae-ae, karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: drishat shalom to prisca and aquila my fellow po'alim workers in rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua,
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi ana hèni èdhi, priskila dènge dhèu èmu na, akila. ji'i ka dhu sama-sama pakako sasab'a ae-ae nèti yesus kristus.

source_text: who performed an act of messianic mesirat nefesh whole-hearted devotion to the cause of moshiach, even at risk of life for my sake, and for whom not only i give thanks, but also kol kehillot of the nations;
target_text: dua ra oe madhe sad'i neo pamamuri ja'a. te ngaa mesa boe ja'a di dhu manèngi makasi mi dua ra. te dhèu yahudi boe dhu j'aj'i le dhèu sarani, nèti juma'at aa'i-aa'i buli mia-mia, manèngi makasi kahèi, lula tatao ra dhu be'a.

source_text: also drishat shalom to the kehillah congregation that meets in their house. drishat shalom to my beloved epaenetus, who is the bikkurim firstfruits of asia for moshiach.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pakaboko ho manèngi-mangaj'i ètu d'ara èmu priskila dènge akila. hia lii maho'o ja'a mi angalai ja'a, epenetus. nèngu ka, dhèu uru tèka parcaya kristus ètu propensi asia.

source_text: drishat shalom to miryam, who has labored much for you.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi ana hèni èdhi, maria. nèngu dhu sab'a ne'a boe j'èra ètu talora aae miu.

source_text: drishat shalom to andronicus and junia, my kinsfolk and my fellow prisoners, who are outstanding among moshiachʼs shlichim, and also were in moshiach before me.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi andronikus dènge ana hèni èdhi, yunia. dua ra dhèu yahudi, sama sèmi ja'a kahèi. dua ra parcaya uuru kristus nèti ja'a. uru èèna, rèngu sama-sama dènge ja'a ètu d'ara bèdho. dua ra j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua, aa dhèu ae tadhe si.

source_text: drishat shalom to ampliatus, my beloved chaver in adoneinu.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi ampliatus. ja'a sue ne, lula nèngu dhu pa'èki dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: drishat shalom to urbanus, our fellow po'el worker in moshiach, and my beloved stachys.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi urbanus. nèngu kahèi pakako sasab'a kristus sama-sama dènge èdhi. hia lii maho'o ja'a mi stakis, dhu ja'a sue.

source_text: drishat shalom to apelles, approved in moshiach. drishat shalom to those from the household of aristobulus.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi apeles. masi ka nèngu lèke dadugu-rariu, te ngaa na segi ka nare li'u, lula lèka èra kristus. hia lii maho'o mi a'ari aa'i-aa'i nèti aristobulus.

source_text: drishat shalom to herodion, my kinsman. drishat shalom to those of the household of narcissus who are in adoneinu.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi a'a herodion. nèngu dhèu yahudi kahèi, sama sèmi ja'a. hia lii maho'o ja'a mi isi èmu narkisus dhu parcaya kristus.

source_text: drishat shalom to tryphaena and tryphosa, who have worked hard in adoneinu. drishat shalom to the beloved persis, who has labored much in adoneinu.
target_text: hia lii maho'o mi ana hèni èdhi, trifena dènge trifosa. rèngu pakako kahèi sasab'a nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. hia lii maho'o mi angalai ja'a, ana hèni èdhi, persis. te nèngu kahèi sab'a bia hia kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: drishat shalom to rufus the bechir the chosen one in adoneinu; also his em and mine.
target_text: hia lii maho'o mi rufus. kètu èdhi, yesus kristus ka dhu hag'e nare ne. hia lii maho'o mi ina na kahèi. te nèngu ne, nuka sèmi ina d'èlu ja'a.

source_text: drishat shalom to asyncritus, phlegon, hermes, patrobas, hermas, and the achim b'moshiach with them.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi asinkritus, flegon, hermes, patrobas, hermas dènge a'ari aa'i-aa'i dhu pea dènge rèngu.

source_text: drishat shalom to philologus and julia, nereus and his achot; also olympas and all the kedoshim with them.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi filologus, ana hèni èdhi, yulia, olimpas, nereus dènge ana hèni na, dènge dhèu-dhèu sarani aa'i dhu sama-sama dènge rèngu.

source_text: greet one another with a neshikat hakodesh. all the kehillot of moshiach send you drishat shalom.
target_text: ladhe miu pakaboko, na, mi pa'uu èci dènge èci, dhu pantas mi dhèu parcaya. juma'at kristus aa'i-aa'i ètu se'e, hia lii maho'o mi miu kahèi.

source_text: i appeal to you, achim b'moshiach, to look out for those who cause kitot sects and nisyonot temptations contrary to the torah which you learned, and keep away from them.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu mage-mage! j'aga paie-iie, te abhu dhèu dhu tao miu mae-manyèla, aa dhu neo sii pabèbhe miu. ngaa dhu rèngu peka dènge miu sèra, palab'a dènge ngaa dhu ji'i aj'a-nori le miu. de baku pa'angalai dènge dhèu sèmi sèra!

source_text: for such people do not serve rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu but their own appetites, and through smooth loshon and fine sounding words they deceive the levavot of the unsuspecting.
target_text: dhèu sèra sab'a boe hia kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. rèngu sèra dhoka sab'a ho pa'oto ngi'u rèngu unu ra. dhèu sèra dhoka hèb'a mènyi mi dhèu dhu dhae re'a mèka mia ka dhu be'a, aa mia ka dhu karehe. rèngu hèb'a mènyi ho kapod'e-kabèli dhèu.

source_text: for your mishma'at has become known to all. so i have simcha over you, but want you to be chachamim regarding what is hatov and innocent regarding what is harah.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadèngi le, na, miu loe boe madhutu dad'èi lamatua. nèti èèna ka d'ara ja'a karej'e titu kèna lula miu. dad'èi ja'a ka, ladhe miu d'èlu-mèu ètu j'ara-j'ara be'a, aa baku pakihu kee dènge j'ara-j'ara karehe.

source_text: and elohei hashalom will soon crush hasatan under your feet. chesed adoneinu moshiach yehoshua yi'heyeh immachem the unmerited favor, mercy and grace of adoneinu moshiach yehoshua be with you.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu bisa hia èdhi mamuri dame dènge mera-milu. nèngu ka dhu èèna na palaho koasa nèti dhèu aae nidhu, aa pad'elo, peka na, miu ka dhu segi. se'e se nèbhu heka j'aj'i. ja'a sabaj'a, manèngi sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu.

source_text: timotiyos my fellow po'el sends drishat shalom to you; also lucius, jason, and sosipater, my kinsmen.
target_text: ari èdhi, timotius, dhu sab'a sama-sama dènge ja'a, hia lii maho'o mi miu kahèi. lukius, yason, dènge sosipater, hia lii maho'o kahèi. rèngu se dhèu yahudi, èci èèna ka dènge ja'a.

source_text: i, tertius, who have written the iggeret, send drishat shalom to you in adoneinu.
target_text: ja'a ne, tertius, ka dhu suri sasuri ne'e madhutu ngaa dhu paulus pua ja'a suri. lii maho'o nèti ja'a, te ja'a ne dhèu unu kètu èdhi, yesus kristus kahèi.

source_text: gaius, who is host to me and to the whole kehillah sends drishat shalom to you. erastus, the city treasurer, sends drishat shalom to you, also the ach b'moshiach, quartus.
target_text: ja'a, paulus, manubha ètu èmu gayus. dhèu sarani aa'i-aa'i tema pakaboko ètu èmu na ho manèngi-mangaj'i. nèngu hia lii maho'o kahèi. erastus, dhu j'aj'i bendahara kota, dènge a'ari èdhi kuartus, hia miu lii maho'o kahèi.

source_text: the chen v'chesed of adoneinu moshiach yehoshua be with you all. omein.
target_text: ja'a manèngi, sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu aa'i-aa'i mi! lèke tare'a!

source_text: to him who is able to establish you by my besuras hageulah, and the hachrazah proclamation, kerygma of moshiach yehoshua, in the hisgalus hasod concealed for long ages,
target_text: koa-kio mi ama lamatua! te nèngu ka dhu unu koasa, sèna ka tao miu j'aj'i èra. lii lolo be'a na peka sèmi èèna ka, aa ja'a aj'a-nori dhèu sèmi èèna kahèi, ropa ja'a peka dènge rèngu lula-nèti yesus kristus. lamatua ka dhu bhoke paled'a hia mi èdhi j'ara aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti kristus, dhu uru-uru sèra dhèu dhae re'a mèka, lula dhu pahuni era.

source_text: but now made manifest and through ketuvim nevu'iyim, in accordance with the mitzvoh of the elohei olam the eternal g-d, made known for the mishma'at obedience of emunah for kol hagoyim,
target_text: te ngaa j'ara-j'ara dhu uru sèra dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua suri ètu sasuri mola-mèci, limuri ne mèu aadha-aadha le. ama lamatua dhu madhe nèdhi boe, nèngu ka ator sèna ka dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i, re'a mèu madha j'ara dhu pahuni uru sèra. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu sèra bisa parcaya ne, aa tao madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: to the only elohim hechacham only wise g-d, lo hakavod b'moshiach yehoshua leolemei olemim. omein.
target_text: dhodhoka nèngu mesa-mesa na di, ama lamatua. dhodhoka nèngu mesa-mesa na, dhu ne'a aa'i mèu-mèu j'ara. ja'a d'èi j'oka padedha-dedha ne, lula tatao yesus kristus! lèke tare'a! sasuri ja'a d'ai sange ne'e ka, saloom, paulus

source_text: from sha'ul, given the kri'ah call of hashem and summoned to be a shliach of rebbe, melech hamoshiach birtzon hashem; and from sosthenes the ach b'moshiach.
target_text: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, paulus. ama lamatua hag'e nare le ja'a, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. sostenes hia miu lii maho'o kahèi.

source_text: to the kehillah congregation of hashem existing in corinth, to the ones having been set apart unto kedushah holiness in rebbe, melech hamoshiach, given the kri'ah to be kedoshim, with all the ones who in every place call on the name of adoneinu, theirs and ours, rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua.
target_text: ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu dhèu parcaya ama lamatua ètu kota korintus. na hag'e nare le miu ho j'aj'i dhèu mola-mèci nèngu, lula miu parcaya le yesus kristus, dhu ama lamatua pajaji mema le karèi nèti uru ka ho na mai. ama lamatua tao miu mola-mèci kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i ètu mia-mia. te rèngu manèngi le sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus soru-bara si. nèngu ne j'aj'i kètu mi dedha èdhi aa rèngu kahèi.

source_text: chen v'chesed hashem and shalom from elohim avinu and adoneinu rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua.
target_text: ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama èdhi, ama lamatua, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ja'a manèngi sèna ka rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi miu, ho miu mamuri dame dènge mera-milu.

source_text: modeh ani i give thanks to my g-d always concerning you for the chen v'chesed hashem having been given to you in rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua,
target_text: lod'o-lod'o ja'a ngee kèdhi miu, ja'a padhai lii dènge lamatua ja'a, peka na, makasi ae-ae lula parcaya dhèu korintus sèra! te lamatua dhu pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi miu, lula miu lèka taruu yesus kristus, dhu lamatua pua na mai.

source_text: that in everything you were enriched in moshiach in all expression and kol da'as all knowledge,
target_text: hèia na hia miu a'èra, ka miu bisa pakako sasab'a-la'a aa'i-aa'i, lula miu pa'èki dènge ne. èèna ka dhu tao d'ara miu kaja-su'i dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. nèti èèna ka miu me'a mèu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu hua iia risi, lula-nèti j'ara mamuri nèngu. miu me'a kahèi j'ara mia dhu be'a risi, ladhe miu lole mi dhèu lula-nèti yesus kristus.

source_text: even as the edut testimony of rebbe, melech hamoshiach was confirmed in you,
target_text: j'ara aa'i-aa'i ne'e ka dhu padelo, na, j'ara-j'ara dhu ji'i peka le dènge miu lula-nèti kristus èèna, dhu amo le ètu d'ara miu. nèti èèna ka, miu me'a tare'a-re'a, na, j'ara sèra lèke.

source_text: so that you are not lacking in any matnat elohim, awaiting the hisgalus revelation of adoneinu rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua,
target_text: de miu abhu le j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a, dhu roh lamatua pala-bagi hia dhèu unu na. kura boe ciki sa. hèia miu tatae lod'o dhu bèli-camèd'a lamatua bhoke ho pad'elo kètu èdhi, yesus kristus mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: who also with chizzuk strengthening will confirm you ad es ketz until the time of the end, unreprovable in the yom hashem, the yom adoneinu, rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua.
target_text: kristus èèna ka dhu neo pa'èra miu sèna ka miu taha taruu, toke na mai hari asa rai-haha ne. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu manahu boe, aa abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa pèci sasala mi dedha miu.

source_text: ne'eman faithful is hashem through whom you were called into the chavurah company, fellowship, society of his zun fun der oybershter rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua adoneinu.
target_text: èdhi bisa parcaya lii holo-nori ama lamatua, lula ngaa dhu nèngu peka, èèna ka dhu j'aj'i. tatu nèngu neo tao j'ara se aa'i-aa'i hia miu. te nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara, sèna ka miu bisa tadhe ana na, nuka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus èèna.

source_text: now i exhort you, achim b'moshiach, b'shem adoneinu rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua, that you all speak the same thing and that there not be among you machlokot divisions of dissension, but that you may have achdus unity in the same mind and in the same way of thinking.
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue! ètu d'ara aa'i-aa'i se, ja'a padhai lii pake kolongara kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. de ja'a manèngi tare'a-re'a, sèna ka miu loe ka nèti padhèto ètu d'ara lii padhai. te ngaa miu hud'i tenge j'ara sèna ka mamuri d'ara èci, aa baku mae-manyèla. miu hud'i pake ngangee madhera, ho me'a, na, miu neo d'ai too-lane dhu èci èèna ka di.

source_text: for it was made clear to me about you, achim b'moshiach of mine, by the ones of chloe, that there is merivah strife among you.
target_text: te abhu dhèu nèti isi èmu ana hèni èdhi kloe dhu mai peka dènge ja'a, na, ètu talora miu abhu dhèu cahag'e dhu patao-palaha taruu.

source_text: now i say this, because each of you says, i am of sha'ul, or, i am of apollos, or i am of kefa, or i am of rebbe, melech hamoshiach!
target_text: a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e: miu cahag'e peka na, ja'a re paulus! aa cahag'e peka na, ja'a re apolos! aa abhu kahèi dhu paka'uu, na, ja'a re petrus! aa dhu leo hari peka na, ja'a ne, nanene dhoka kristus di!

source_text: has moshiach been divided? surely sha'ul was not for you the one talui al haetz being hanged on the tree? surely it was not in the name of sha'ul that the moshiachʼs tevilah in the mikveh mayim was given to you?
target_text: miu pangee tasamia, ee? dhèu unu kristus bisa boe mae-manyèla. do, miu pangee, na, ja'a ka dhu madhe pala miu ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha? aad'o! do, lod'o ra sarani miu, rèngu pake ngara ja'a, ho miu j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a, do? bisa boe, si?

source_text: modeh ani hashem that to not one of you i gave moshiachʼs tevilah, except crispus and gaius,
target_text: ja'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, te lod'o ja'a ètu èèna dènge miu, ja'a sarani boe dhèu ae. dhu ja'a sarani ètu nèi dhoka krispus dènge gayus di.

source_text: lest anyone should say that in my name you were given the moshiachʼs tevilah.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, abhu boe dhèu dhu bisa peka na, ra sarani ja'a pake ngara paulus, ka ja'a j'aj'i dhèu unu paulus.

source_text: now i gave moshiachʼs tevilah also to stephanasʼ household; as to the rest, i do not know if i gave moshiachʼs tevilah to anyone else.
target_text: ee, ja'a heka sanèd'e kèna. ja'a sarani isi èmu stefanus cahag'e kahèi. te ngaa ja'a sanèd'e heka, abhu dhèu era dhu ja'a sarani, do aad'o.

source_text: for moshiach did not send me to give moshiachʼs tevilah in the mikveh mayim, but to preach the besuras hageulah, not by means of the lomdes cleverness, erudition of the rhetoric of bnei adam, lest the gevurah power of haetz hakelalat hashemthe tree of the curse of g-d of rebbe, melech hamoshiach be buttel cancelled out.
target_text: te kristus pua boe ja'a ho laku sarani dhèu. kapua sasab'a ja'a, nuka peka-padhai dènge j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti lii lolo be'a na. te ngaa ladhe ja'a lole mi dhèu, nèngu d'èi boe ja'a peka mamèu ja'a, do, pad'elo j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai. te ladhe ja'a padhai lii sèmi èèna, èèna pakura koasa nèti lii lolo mamadhe kristus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: for the darshenen of haetz hakelalat hashemthe tree of the curse of g-d is narrishkait to the ones perishing. but to us who are being delivered in yeshu'at eloheinu, it is the gevurat hashemthe power of g-d.
target_text: abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi peka-padhai lula-nèti mamadhe kristus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna, goa titu kèna. te ngaa dhèu sèmi sèra, bèli-camèd'a cèri eele nèti ama lamatua. aa te ngaa, bagi mi èdhi, mamadhe kristus ne, sèna ka pad'elo koasa lamatua ho patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: for it has been written, i will destroy chochmat chachamav the wisdom of the wise ones u'vinat nevonav and the intelligence of the intelligent i will set aside.
target_text: j'ara ne'e nuka sèmi dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya, suri tèke, peka na, ama lamatua peka na, ‘madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu d'èlu-mèu re'a, bèli-camèd'a ja'a pa'ele iie aa'i si, sèna ka j'aj'i mi mèdha dhu dènge boe kab'ua. rupa-rupa mamèu rèngu, bèli-camèd'a ja'a core eele aa'i si, sèna ka j'aj'i mi mèdha dhu guna boe. '

source_text: where is the chacham wise man? where is the sofer scribe of the yeshiva, where is the talmid chacham? where is the philosophical debater of the olam hazeh? did not hashem make the so-called chochmah wisdom of the olam hazeh to look like narrishkait?
target_text: uru èèna, mema lamatua padhai lii sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa limuri ne, tasamia hari? dhèu d'èlu-mèu sèra, sèmi ngaa sa? mese agama sèra, j'aj'i sèmi ngaa? aa tuka tao lii langu sèra, tasa mera mia? miu nanene sèku! lamatua tao si nuka sèmi dhèu goa! nèngu bete eele aa'i le mamèu dhu amo ètu d'ara kahadhu dhèu rai-haha ne, aa tao mamèu sèra nuka sèmi mèdha dhu dènge boe kab'ua.

source_text: for, als since - and this was by the chochmah of hashem - the olam hazeh did not by its chochmah have da'as of hashem, g-d was pleased through the sichlut foolishness of the hachrazah proclamation, kerygma, preaching of the besuras hageulah to save the ma'aminim believers. yehudim ask for otot signs and yevanim greeks seek chochmah,
target_text: mamèu ama lamatua lènge aa'i mèu-mèu. masi ka dhèu rai-haha ne pangee, na, rèngu d'èlu-mèu, te ngaa j'ara ngangee rèngu mesa ra d'ai mèka ho ra tadhe hua iia ama lamatua. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa lamatua pake le mamèu na ho bhoke j'ara hia dhèu rai-haha. te uru èèna, lamatua pangee, peka na, masi ka dhèu rai-haha pangee, na, dhèu pajuu-paleha ja'a sèra goa, te ngaa tasamia èèna ka, hud'i ja'a pua ku dhèu lasi lole dènge ra j'ara dhu lèke nèti ja'a. te lamatua pua dhèu rèti lii padhai na ho lasi lole dènge dhèu. na pama'ète nare le neo pake lii moa èèna, sèna ka dhèu bisa parcaya ne. nèngu pake j'ara ne, ho patabuli dhèu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. te ngaa dhèu rai-haha ne pangee, na, j'ara ama lamatua ne, goa. nèti èèna ka, rèngu pusi-pahae boe dhèu pajuu-paleha na. te dhèu yahudi neo manèngi dhoka tadha-tadha malaa di, sèna ka bisa rèdhi koasa lamatua. aa dhèu yunani neo nanene dhoka j'ara-j'ara hua iia dhu maso asa d'ara kahadhu ra, madhutu ngangee rèngu mesa ra.

source_text: but, we proclaim moshiach and nivlato al haetz his body on the tree: to jews, a michshol; to goyim, narrishkait foolishness.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa èdhi dhu j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua lati peka dènge dhèu, na, lamatua pua le kristus, nuka dhèu dhu nèngu pajaji mema karèi nèti uru ka, mai asa rai-haha ne. ka dhèu leo paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. ropa dhèu yahudi tadèngi lii lolo ne'e, rèngu sisu, te madhutu a'abhu ra, dhèu dhu lamatua neo pua mai èèna, bisa boe madhe sèmi èèna. ropa dhèu yunani tadèngi lii lolo ne, ra pangee na, lii lolo dhèu goa!

source_text: yet, to those whom hashem has given the kri'ah and summoned, to hakeru'im to the called ones, both to yehudim and to yevanim rebbe, melech hamoshiach, the gevurat hashem and the chochmat hashem.
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhèu dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na. rèngu sèra cahag'e nèti dhèu yahudi, aa cahag'e nèti dhèu yahudi boe. madhutu a'abhu rèngu, mamadhe kristus dhu pad'elo le mi rèngu, na, koasa ama lamatua dènge boe too-lane, aa mamèu na risi aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: for the so-called sichlut foolishness of hashem has more chochmah than bnei adam, and the weakness of g-d has more koach power than bnei adam.
target_text: masi ka dhèu rai-haha pangee, na, j'ara lamatua ne unu dhèu goa, te ngaa nèngu mèu risi eele rèngu. aa masi ka ra pangee, na, lamatua dènge boe koasa, te ngaa koasa na dedha risi eele nèti rèngu.

source_text: for you see your kri'ah call, achim b'moshiach, what you were, that not many of you were chachamim wise ones by the standards of bnei adam, not many ba'alei hashpa'ah people of influence, not many ba'alei zchus privileged.
target_text: a'ari pasue! sèna ka miu bisa me'a mèu lii padhai ja'a ne, sanèd'e mamuri miu, lod'o lamatua hag'e nare miu, ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na. madhutu a'abhu dhèu rai-haha, ètu talora aae miu, abhu boe dhèu ae dhu d'èlu-mèu, abhu boe dhèu ae dhu dènge pangaru kapai, aa abhu boe dhèu ae dhu a'ari ra dhu dènge kolongara kapai.

source_text: but hashem in his bechirah selection chose the things of sichlut foolishness, that he might bring the chachamim to bushah shame; and hashem in his bechirah selection chose the things of weakness that he might bring the strong to bushah shame.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua hag'e nare dhèu dhu madhutu ngangee dhèu rai-haha, na, tabhènga ana liku, sèna ka pamakae dhèu dhu pangee, na, rèngu d'èlu-mèu. aa na hag'e nare dhèu dhu madhutu dhèu rai-haha, dhèu dhu dènge boe koasa, sèna ka pamakae dhèu dhu pangee, na, rèngu dènge koasa.

source_text: and those of the olam hazeh without mishpochah atzilah noble birth and those which are hanivzimthe despisedhashem chose, choosing the things that are not, in order to bring to naught the things that are.
target_text: hèia na hag'e nare dhèu haha dhu dènge boe kolongara, aa dhu biasa dhèu pahaha si. te lamatua neo pake si, sèna ka dhèu dhu pangee, na, rèngu dhèu kapai, j'aj'i sèmi dhèu dènge boe pangaru ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: his tachlis purpose is that no basar fallen humanity sold under the power of slave master chet kadmon, original sin may boast before hashem.
target_text: dènge j'ara èèna, bèli-camèd'a abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu bisa tèb'a kakara ètu madha ama lamatua, peka na, nèngu dhèu kapai.

source_text: but you are of hashem in rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua who became to us chochmah wisdom from hashem, our tzidkanut righteousness and our kedushah holiness and our geulah laolam redemption to the world,
target_text: te ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu bhoke pataleo j'ara, sèna ka miu bisa maso j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus. lamatua ka pake yesus j'aj'i dhèu dhu pala-bagi mamèu na mi dedha èdhi. yesus èèna ka dhu oti j'ara ho èdhi bisa padame dènge ama lamatua. yesus èèna ka dhu tao èdhi ho bisa mamuri mola dènge mèci. aa nèngu ka dhu patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala.

source_text: al menat in order that, as it has been written, yithallel hamithallel b'hashemthe one boasting let him boast in the l-rd.
target_text: èèna nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, cee ka dhu d'èi pakapai kolongara dhèu, be'a risi pakapai kolongara lamatua èdhi. baku pakapai iisi!

source_text: when i came to you, achim b'moshiach, i did not come preaching and announcing to you the sod hashemmystery of g-d as a ba'al melitzot rhetorician, fine talker or in the excellence of chochmah.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! uru èèna, lod'o ja'a dhiu asa miu, ja'a bhoke paled'a j'ara-j'ara lamatua dhu uru èèna dhèu rai-haha ne re'a mèka. te ngaa ja'a kèti boe lii sèra ho padedha iisi. aa ja'a padhai boe pake lii dhu carui, sèna ka pad'elo mamèu ja'a unu ku.

source_text: for i made the decision not to have da'as of anything among you except moshiach and nivlato al haetzhis body - gufa, bar-minen - on the boim yiddish for tree.
target_text: lod'o ja'a bera-bera dènge miu, ja'a pangee sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a pad'elo dhoka ca j'ara di, nuka yesus kristus. nèngu ne, dhèu dhu ama lamatua pajaji mema karèi nèti uru ka, ho hia mai. te ngaa ropa yesus mai, dhèu paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. dhoka j'ara ne'e di, dhu ja'a ke'a mèu.

source_text: and i came to you in weakness and in yir'at shomayim and in fear and in much trembling i was with you,
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ja'a bera-bera dènge miu, ja'a rasa mamèu ja'a d'ai boe, aa ja'a madha'u ka isi karèbha.

source_text: and my speech and my hachrazah proclamation, kyrygma, preaching to you of the besuras hageulah of hashem was not in persuasive words but in the demonstration of the ruach hakodesh and the gevurat hashempower of g-d,
target_text: j'ara lii padhai ja'a, aa ngaa dhu ja'a lole, mud'a di. te ja'a ko'o boe pake lii dhu karisi sèna ka pamako miu. aad'o! te ngaa ropa ja'a peka-padhai, na, lii padhai ja'a j'aj'i led'a, lula roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci ka dhu ator ja'a, aa koasa na sab'a ètu ja'a kahèi.

source_text: that the emunah faith of you may not be in the olam hazeh chochmah of bnei adam, but in the gevurat hashem.
target_text: te ja'a pangee, na, be'a boe ladhe miu parcaya ama lamatua, lula miu nanene lii padhai dhèu d'èlu-mèu di. dhu be'a risi, ladhe miu parcaya lamatua, lula na pad'elo koasa na mi dedha miu.

source_text: but we do speak chochmah wisdom to the man who is mevugar mature, grown up, to those with mature ruchaniyut spirituality in rebbe, melech hamoshiach, yet, it is a chochmah wisdom not of the olam hazeh, neither of the rulers of the olam hazeh, the ones being brought to naught.
target_text: aa te ngaa, ladhe ji'i padhai lii dènge dhèu dhu parcaya èra le, ji'i aj'a rèngu pake lii padhai dhu dhèu bisa re'a mèu. te ngaa dhu re'a mèu èèna, madhutu boe ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, do, madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu paredha sèra aj'a limuri ne. te sèra sa, bèli-camèd'a ele iie aa'i si.

source_text: but we speak the chochmah of hashem in a hidden sod mystery, which was nigzar merosh determined from the beginning, preordained, predestined, decided beforehand by hashem lifnei yemei haolam before the days of eternity for our kavod glory;
target_text: te ngaa ji'i aj'a dhoka j'ara mamèu dhu mai nèti ama lamatua. lula uru-uru sèra, lod'o rai-haha j'aj'i mèka, lamatua pahuni j'ara sèra. te ngaa limuri ne, nèngu pama'ète le, sèna ka neo bhoke patalele lii pahuni èèna hia èdhi, ho èdhi kahèi abhu pala ètu d'ara kolongara na dhu kapai risi eele.

source_text: a chochmah which not one of the rulers of the olam hazeh has known, for, if they had had da'as, they would not have made talui al haetz hakelalat hashembeing hanged on the tree of the curse of g-d the adon hakavod.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu paredha limuri ne, re'a mèu iia boe mamèu lamatua. te ladhe re'a tare'a, tatu ra paku pamadhe boe kètu èdhi dhu dedha risi èèna, ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: but even as it has been written, things which no eye has seen and lo shamu they had not heard nor did it come up into the heart of bnei adam, the things g-d prepared for the ones who have ahavah for him.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua dhu suri lula-nèti rahasia lamatua dhu uru èèna pahuni tèke, peka na, abhu j'ara dhu dhèu rai-haha dhae rèdhi mèka dènge musi madha ra, aa abhu j'ara dhu dhèu rai-haha dhae tadèngi rèdhi mèka dènge ro'a dhilu ra, dhu dhèu rai-haha bisa ngee rèdhi boe. aa te ngaa, madhutu iia-iia na lamatua sadia tèke le j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i, bagi mi dhèu dhu sue nèngu.

source_text: but hashem has made the hitgalut hasod the revelation of the mystery to us of these things through the ruach hakodesh; for the ruach hakodesh searches all things, even the deep things of g-d.
target_text: uru èèna, mema dhèu re'a boe j'ara sèra, te ngaa limuri ne ama lamatua pake roh na ho bhoke paled'a hia èdhi. roh lamatua èèna ne'a aa'i mèu-mèu. te nèngu parisa toke lutu d'ara iiki lamatua kahèi.

source_text: for who of bnei adam has da'as of the things of bnei adam except the ruach of a man in him? so also the things of g-d no one has known except the ruach hashem.
target_text: èdhi èci-èci ka dènge roh ètu d'ara èdhi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi dhèu rai-haha, èci-èci ka dènge ngangee aa tatao na. aa abhu boe dhèu leo èci sa dhu ne'a mèu d'ara iiki èdhi, dhoka roh èdhi unu ti dhu ne'a. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ama lamatua. abhu boe ca dhèu sa kahèi dhu ne'a d'ara iiki lamatua. dhoka roh nèngu mesa na ka dhu ne'a mèu.

source_text: now we have not received the ruach of the olam hazeh but the ruach hakodesh from hashem, that we may have da'as of the things having been freely given to us by hashem,
target_text: èdhi dhu sèmi tare le roh lamatua, ka nèngu ka dhu ator èdhi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi madhutu boe ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha ne. lula roh lamatua ètu d'ara èdhi, nèti èèna ka èdhi tadhe aa'i j'ara dhu be'a, dhu nèngu tao le hia èdhi.

source_text: which things also we speak, not in devarim words taught by chochmah habnei adam, but in devarim taught by the ruach hakodesh, making midrash of the things of the ruach hakodesh by means of the words of the ruach hakodesh.
target_text: j'ara sèra ka dhu èdhi tema padhue-padhai. te ji'i lole j'ara-j'ara dhu roh lamatua aj'a-nori ji'i. ka ji'i se aj'a boe pake lii dhu nèti mamèu madhutu a'abhu dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa ji'i aj'a-nori pake lii dhu mai nèti roh lamatua mi dhèu dhu tadhe nèngu.

source_text: but a natural person does not receive the things of the ruach hakodesh of hashem, for they are narrishkait foolishness to him, and he is not able to have personal saving da'as of them, because they are discerned in the ruach hakodesh.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tadhe boe roh lamatua, ropa na nanene lii padhai ji'i, nèngu d'èi boe sèmi. lula nèngu ngee, na, ngaa kèna? maso boe d'ara kahadhu! aa te ngaa, masi ka tasamia èèna ka, dhèu ne bisa boe ne'a j'ara sèra, te nèngu dhu mamuri pa'èki boe dènge roh lamatua.

source_text: now the man of the ruach hakodesh discerns all things, but, by no one is he discerned.
target_text: dhèu dhu mamuri pa'èki dènge roh lamatua, heka re'a j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i, aa bisa re'a mia ka dhu lèke. te ngaa dhèu leo pajiko rare boe ngangee dhèu sèmi sèra.

source_text: for, who has known the mind of hashem so as to instruct him? but we have the mind of moshiach.
target_text: bisa tasamia? te abhu dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na: cee ka dhu bisa re'a ngangee ama lamatua? do, cee ka dhu bisa ator lamatua, ho ama lamatua tao madhutu lii holo-nori dhèu èèna? abhu boe ca dhèu sa! madhutu iia-iia na, èdhi te'a j'ara se'e, lula kristus ka dhu soru-bara sèna ka èdhi bisa pangee madhutu ngangee nèngu.

source_text: achim b'moshiach, i was not able to speak to you as to men of hitkhadshut and ruchaniyut; i had to speak to you as bnei basar, as olalim b'moshiach.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! lod'o ja'a ètu èèna era, miu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu dhae pa'èki èra mèka dènge roh lamatua. lula miu madhutu dhodhoka dad'èi d'ara miu dhoo-dhoo di, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu rai-haha dhu leo sèra. nèti èèna ka, ja'a bisa boe padhai lii dènge miu, nuka sèmi padhai lii dènge dhèu ee'a, te miu nuka sèmi ana iiki sa.

source_text: cholov i gave you to drink, not solid okhel food, for you were not yet able to receive it, but neither yet are you able now.
target_text: ja'a hud'i aj'a miu j'ara-j'ara dhu carui boe, lula miu bisa mèka sèmi mere j'ara dhu carui, nuka sèmi ana iiki dhu bisa mèka ra'a sisi. miu hud'i kadhii ku, sama sèmi dhèu ee'a dhu tema ra'a sisi. te ngaa limuri ne, miu nuka sèmi ana rara iisi hiu era, dhu me'a dhoka minu susu di.

source_text: for still you are bnei basar carnally-minded believers. for als since there is still kinah and merivah strife among you, are you not bnei basar, by the standards of bnei adam?
target_text: lula ngangee miu cakaraa dhèu dhu neo dhoka madhutu dad'èi d'ara di. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu risi nèti miu, miu tèka d'ara aa patao-palaha leli! nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka na, miu me'a dhoka madhutu dad'èi miu dhoo-dhoo. de sèmi èèna na, miu sama sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: for, whenever anyone says, i am of sha'ul, but another, i am of apollos, are you not as anshei shechichim ordinary men?
target_text: lula miu cahag'e peka na, ja'a ne, re paulus! aa cahag'e dhu peka na, ja'a ne, re apolos! lod'o-lod'o miu padhai lii sèmi èèna, miu pad'elo, na, miu èci èèna ka dènge dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: what then is apollos? and what is sha'ul? klei kodesh ministers of rebbe, melech hamoshiach, through whom you came to emunah, even as to each one a task was given by adoneinu.
target_text: madhutu iia-iia na, apolos èèna, cee? aa ja'a, paulus ne, cee? te ji'i dua mi se, dhoka ana pua-paleha di. ji'i dhoka pad'elo j'ara ho miu bisa parcaya kristus. apolos pakako sasab'a madhutu paredha kètu èdhi. aa ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi!

source_text: i planted, apollos watered, but hashem gave the increase.
target_text: ja'a ka dhu uru tèka lole dènge miu lula-nèti kristus. èèna nuka sèmi ja'a ka dhu sèle hini. hèia apolos mai aj'a-nori miu. èèna nuka sèmi nèngu ka dhu bui-tatee hini dhu ja'a sèle kore sèra. te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu tao hini sèra muri j'aj'i kapai aae.

source_text: therefore, neither is the one planting anything nor the one watering, but it is the one giving the increase - hashem!
target_text: de dhèu dhu sèle hini sèra dènge boe kab'ua. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu bui. dhodhoka èci di dhu dènge kab'ua, nuka ama lamatua. lula nèngu ka tao hini sèra muri, ka sub'u dènge sega.

source_text: now the one planting and the one watering are be'ichud united, and, each one will receive his own sachar reward according to his own amal toil.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèle, aa dhèu dhu bui-tatee, sab'a sama-sama, te sasab'a rèngu èci èèna ka. aa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pakako sasab'a lamatua, bèli-camèd'a na b'ae rui-j'aj'èra ra.

source_text: for we are fellow po'alim workers of hashem, you are the sadeh hashemfield of g-d, you are hashemʼs binyan building.
target_text: te ji'i sama-sama dhèu sab'a nèti lamatua. aa miu nuka sèmi oka lamatua, dhu nèngu neo uri. sèmi èèna kahèi, miu nuka sèmi èmu dhu ama lamatua patitu.

source_text: according to the chen v'chesed hashem having been given to me as a bannai chacham wise builder, i laid a yesod foundation, and another builds on it. but, let each one beware how he builds on it.
target_text: de lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a. nèti èèna ka ja'a sama sèmi dholu. ka lamatua soru-bara ja'a ho ke'a mèu j'ara-j'ara nèti kapua, sèna ka ja'a tao era padhèdi dhu èra ètu d'ara mamuri miu. hèia dhèu leo aj'a-nori miu kahèi, ho rèngu patitu mi era padhèdi dhu ja'a tao kore èèna. te ngaa tuka èci-èci hud'i sab'a ku dènge d'ara kateme, ho rèngu patitu èmu dhu èra.

source_text: for no other yesod other than the one that has been laid can be laid: rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: era padhèdi dhu èra èèna, abhu le. nuka yesus kristus. nèti èèna ka, dhèu leo bisa boe tao era padhèdi leo ètu d'ara miu, te lamatua dhu tao tèke le era padhèdi dhu lèke.

source_text: now if anyone builds on the yesod with gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, stubble,
target_text: tatu abhu dhèu dhu neo patitu kahèi ètu era padhèdi èèna pake rupa-rupa nèu. abhu dhu neo pake nèu dhu kab'ua, sèmi hualaa, doi pudhi do hadhu kale'e. abhu dhu pake nèu biasa, nuka sèmi aj'u, j'u'u do rèu hidhu.

source_text: the ma'aseh work of each bannai will become evident, for, hayom will make it have its hisgalus, because by eish fire it is revealed; and the eish fire itself will test the quality of each oneʼs ma'aseh.
target_text: te ngaa sasab'a tuka èci-èci ka bisa te'a, aa dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa re'a sasab'a rèngu èèna, be'a do aad'o. te lod'o èle rai-haha, lamatua neo sèku ne, sama sèmi na pake ai ho pad'elo, na, sasab'a dhèu sèra, bisa taha do aad'o.

source_text: if anyoneʼs ma'aseh he built on the yesod will survive, a sachar reward he will receive;
target_text: ladhe uji nare sasab'a nèti ca dhèu pake ai, aa nèu dhu na pake bisa taha, bèli-camèd'a lamatua b'ae rui-j'aj'èra na ètu sorga.

source_text: if anyoneʼs ma'aseh will be consumed, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, yet so as through eish fire.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe uji nare sasab'a dhèu pake ai, aa ai na'e aa'i nèu dhu nèngu pake patitu ètu era padhèdi èèna, na, lamatua hia boe dhèu ne ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa tuka ne abhu mamuri era, masi ka sèmi dhèu dhu rai kalua nèti d'ara èmu ai na'e.

source_text: do you not have da'as that you are a heikhal hashem and the ruach hakodesh of hashem dwells in you?
target_text: miu hud'i me'a ku, dhu peka na, miu sama sèmi èmu sabaj'a lamatua, aa roh na dhu pea ètu d'ara.

source_text: if anyone attempts to cause churban to the heikhal hashem, g-d will destroy this man, for the heikhal hashem is kadosh, and you plural are that heikhal.
target_text: aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pa'ele iie èmu sabaj'a lamatua, nuka era pea na, na mage-mage! bèli-camèd'a lamatua pa'ele iie ne kahèi! te èmu sabaj'a lamatua èèna mola-mèci. de miu hud'i mola-mèci ku kahèi.

source_text: let no one deceive himself: if anyone presumes to be chacham among you in the olam hazeh, let him become a kesil fool, that he may become chacham.
target_text: miu baku tipu ngi'u miu unu mi! ladhe abhu ca dhèu dhu pangee, na, nèngu d'èlu-mèu aa ne'a aa'i madhutu mamèu dhèu ètu rai-haha lod'o limuri ne, èèna peka na, nèngu ne'a boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa. ladhe èu mase'a le, peka na, èu me'a boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa, heka èu mulai me'a kèna.

source_text: for the chochmah wisdom of olam hazeh is narrishkait foolishness with hashem. for it has been written, loched chachamim be'armam he catches the wise in their own craftiness.
target_text: ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha taa limuri ne, ama lamatua peka na, goa. te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci dhu suri tèke, peka na: abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, nèngu d'èlu-mèu, te ngaa èèna na lamatua pake hari ngangee na dhu karehe sèra, j'aj'i mi sasii, ho sii pa'ele iie hari nèngu!

source_text: and again, hashem yode'a machsh'vot adam ki hemah hevel the l-rd knows the thoughts of the wise that they are empty vanity.
target_text: ètu era leo dhu suri kahèi, peka na, lamatua èdhi dhu ne'a le ngaa dhu dhèu d'èlu-mèu sèra pangee, aa dhèu dhu hud'i re'a ku neo tao ne tasa mere mia, nèngu dhu ne'a nare le, na, rèngu dhoka ngee iia d'ara di.

source_text: so let no one boast in bnei adam, for all things belong to you, whether sha'ul or apollos or kefa or haolam the world or chayyim life or mavet death or things present or things to come; all things are yours,
target_text: de miu baku padedha dhèu èci sa, dhu peka na, nèngu èèna lènge aa'i dhèu. te lamatua ka dhu ded'e dhèu, ho ator miu. aa'i-aa'i sèra j'aj'i le unu miu. de dhèu dhu ator miu sèra, sama sèmi: ja'a, apolos, dènge petrus, ji'i se j'aj'i unu miu. aa aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne unu miu kahèi, masi ka miu mamuri do miu madhe, masi ka deo ne'e do lod'o dhu mai, aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i unu miu kateme aae.

source_text: and you are moshiachʼs and moshiach is hashemʼs.
target_text: aa miu j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus. aa kristus unu ama lamatua!

source_text: so let a man consider us as gabba'im of rebbe melech hamoshiach and mefakkechim stewards, supervisors of the sodot mysteries of hashem.
target_text: de miu baku koa-kad'iri ji'i, te ji'i dhoka ana pua-paleha kristus di. aa ama lamatua lèka ji'i, sèna ka j'aga paie-iie j'ara-j'ara dhu uru èèna pahuni tèke.

source_text: moreover, it is sought in mefakkechim that one be found that has ne'emanut faithfulness.
target_text: dhèu dhu madhenga mèdha-panyau lamatua na, nèngu hud'i j'aj'i ku dhèu dhu tao madhutu ngaa dhu lèke.

source_text: but to me it is a very small thing that i be brought, as it were, before your bet din for you to play dayanim religious judges judging me, or that i am judged by bnei adam on their merely human yom hadin; i do not even act as dayan judge of a rabbinical court of myself.
target_text: tasamia dènge ja'a? ja'a sab'e madhutu ngaa dhu lèke, do aad'o? ja'a ko'o boe ke'a, miu nile ja'a tasa mera mia. aa ja'a pusi-pahae boe kahèi dhèu leo nile ja'a sèmi ngaa sa. ja'a ke'a boe nile ngi'u ja'a unu ku kahèi.

source_text: i am aware of nothing against myself, but not in this have i been yitzdak justified; it is the l-rd who is my shofet judge.
target_text: te masi ka d'ara iiki ja'a peka na, ja'a be'a le, tatu boe sasoa na, ja'a be'a. dhu mèci ka, lamatua ka dhu nile ja'a tasa mera mia.

source_text: therefore, do not judge anything before the time, until the bias adoneinu, who both will bring to ohr light the hidden things of the choshech darkness and manifest the motives of the levavot. and then the tehillah praise each one will receive will be from hashem.
target_text: de miu baku tao ngi'u sèmi dhèu pama'ète lii langu ho nile dhèu leo sèra. mate mamai hari lamatua, te nèngu ka dhu èèna na bhoke patalele aa'i mèu-mèu. nèngu ka pasabhoka aa'i bhabhelu-katub'a dhu dhèu tao pahuni ètu d'ara maroga. nèngu neo bhoke paled'a j'ara-j'ara dhu dhèu ngee ètu d'ara ra. hèia ama lamatua neo peka aa'i j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, dhu dhèu tao le.

source_text: now these things, achim b'moshiach, i made a dimyon comparison applied with respect to myself and apollos for your sake, that through us you may learn not to go beyond what things have been written, lest you are puffed up as ba'alei ga'avah conceited, haughty persons in favor of one or against the other.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a dhu padhai lii lula-nèti ja'a dènge apolos, nuka sèmi ja'a j'aj'i mi conto ho miu bisa aj'a nèti ji'i, nuka: tao madhutu j'ara-j'ara dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua. baku tao dhu leo. ladhe miu madhutu ka j'ara se'e, miu baku bia re èci sa, aa padedha iisi lula madhutu ca dhèu, aa pahahe dhèu leo.

source_text: for who makes you so distinguished? and, by the way, what do you have which you did not receive? and if indeed you were given it, why this ga'avah, this boastfulness as if you had not received it?
target_text: de tasamia? miu pangee, na, miu risi nèti dhèu leo, do? baku! te aa'i-aa'i dhu miu unu, miu abhu nèti ama lamatua. de ladhe sèmi èèna, nga tao ka miu nged'e ej'a ai, nuka sèmi miu ad'u-ue unu mi?

source_text: already you have so much, already you ascended to osher riches and without us shlichim! you became melechim kings; i would that you did indeed become melechim that also we might reign as melechim with you.
target_text: nuka sèmi aa'i-aa'i dhu miu parluu, miu abhu le. nuka sèmi miu kaja le! miu tao ngi'u mi, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu kapai sama sèmi dhèu aae sa, aa ji'i soru-bara boe ciki sa. madhutu iia-iia na, lamatua ka dhu hia aa'i-aa'i dhu miu parluu. te ngaa ladhe miu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i dhèu aae, ele boe ji'i ngèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge miu, si?

source_text: for, omein, i believe that hashem has exhibited us, the shlichim of rebbe, melech hamoshiach, as last in the program, condemned to death, because, like wretches under a mishpat mavet death sentence, we became displayed in the arena for the eyes of the olam hazeh, malachim as well as bnei adam.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu pua-paleha ji'i, ho la'a asa mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne, sèna ka lole dènge dhèu j'ara-j'ara kristus. te ngaa ca tèka-ca tèka sa ja'a pangee, na, lamatua pua ji'i titu re limuri tèka, sama sèmi ana bèdho dhu tatae abhu huku madhe. hèia na hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, aa dènge ana-ana pajuu na ètu sorga mai laladhe ji'i.

source_text: we are kesilim fools because of moshiach, but you are chachamim in moshiach; we are weak, but you are strong; you are treated with honor; we dishonor.
target_text: miu kapai titu kèna, nga! te abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, miu d'èlu-mèu, lula pa'èki dènge kristus. te ngaa rèngu pangee, na, ji'i goa titu kèna, lula ji'i j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus. ele boe rèngu ngee, na, miu èra risi, aa ji'i se roe aala-aala. ele boe ra ded'e miu padedha-dedha, te ngaa ro'o boe pusi-pahae ji'i ciki sa hèi. seli-kolane, nga!

source_text: until the present sha'ah hour we both hunger, and thirst, and are naked, and are beaten and homeless.
target_text: toke d'ai deo ne'e, ji'i manganga dènge koko-kamango. mèdha-papake ji'i kaha'i-kaheru. dhèu loe boe game ji'i. ji'i nuka sèmi dhèu dhu dènge boe era pea.

source_text: and we have parnasah, toiling with our own hands; being reviled, we make a bracha; being persecuted, we endure it:
target_text: ji'i sab'a dènge kacui-aai ji'i unu mi toke d'ai èi kabhèsu hae. ladhe dhèu padhai-kakoli ji'i, ji'i dhoka b'ala, peka na, ji'i manèngi, sèna ka ama lamatua tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a hia miu. ladhe dhèu paj'èra ji'i, na, ji'i b'ala boe, dhoka mau-mau di.

source_text: being defamed by loshon hora, we conciliate. we have become what the earth wants swept out the door, something considered trash the olam hazeh wants removed.
target_text: ladhe dhèu padhai pa'ele iie kolongara ji'i, ji'i dhoka dhaa dènge rèhu mare di. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, ji'i se nuka sèmi kaj'alu do mamumu dhu core eele.

source_text: the purpose of this iggeret is not to bring you under bushah shame. i write these things as admonishing my beloved yeladim.
target_text: ja'a suri j'ara se'e, neo boe pamakae miu. te ngaa ja'a neo pasanèd'e miu, lula ja'a sue miu nuka sèmi ana matana ja'a sa. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka dènge miu, ho lèpa asa j'ara dhu mola.

source_text: for, though you may have in moshiach morei derech numbering ten thousand, you have not many avot, for in moshiach through the besuras hageulah i became your abba.
target_text: masi ka dhèu riho-riho dhu bisa pad'elo j'ara hia miu lula-nèti kristus, te ngaa dhoka ja'a mesa ku dhu j'aj'i ama miu. te ja'a ka dhèu uru j'ara dhu peka-padhai dènge miu lii lolo be'a nèti yesus kristus. nèti èèna ka, miu parcaya ne. ja'a tao j'ara èèna, lula ja'a dhu pa'èki mèno dènge ne.

source_text: therefore, i encourage you, imitate me.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi, sèna ka miu madhutu j'ara mamuri ja'a ne.

source_text: because of this very thing, i sent timotiyos to you who is my beni haahuv beloved son and ne'eman faithful, trustworthy in hashem, who will remind you of my derech bakodesh in moshiach, even as i give shiurim everywhere in every kehillah.
target_text: nèti èèna ka ja'a pua timotius dhiu soru-bara miu. ja'a sue ne, sama sèmi ana matana ja'a. ja'a lèka ne, te nèngu kahèi mamuri pa'èki dènge lamatua èdhi. èèna na nèngu soru-bara miu ho pasanèd'e miu nèti mamuri ja'a. j'ara mamuri ja'a sèmi èèna, lula ja'a pa'èki dènge yesus kristus, dhu ama lamatua hia mai. èèna ka dhu ja'a aj'a-nori dènge dhèu sarani dhu pakaboko ètu mia-mia.

source_text: now as to my coming to you, some were puffed up,
target_text: abhu nèti miu dhu pangee, na, ja'a lake kore boe dhiu dènge miu. nèti èèna ka rèngu nged'e titu kèna.

source_text: but i will come shortly to you, im yirtzeh hashemif the l-rd wills, and i will find out not the speech of the ones having been puffed up but the ko'ach power.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe lamatua èdhi d'èi, nèbhu boe ja'a d'ai kota korintus. ho èèna na ja'a ke'a mèu, na, dhèu sèra padhai lii padedha iisi, do, rèngu tare'a dènge koasa!

source_text: for the malchut hashem depends not on the talk of the ish sefatayim the eloquent speaker but on ko'ach power.
target_text: te ama lamatua èèna dhèu aae dhu unu koasa. ka dhèu nèngu hèb'a mènyi boe, ho pa'èra dhèu ètu d'ara lalèka ra, te ngaa rèngu pake koasa dhu lèke.

source_text: what do you want? that i should come to you, so to speak, with an abbaʼs switch or in ahavah and an anavat ruach a spirit of meekness?
target_text: de dad'èi miu tasamia? ladhe ja'a dhiu, na, ja'a tao lii sakaa aa huku miu? do, ja'a dhiu pad'elo sasue dènge d'ara be'a?

source_text: zenut fornication is actually reported among you, and such zenut which is not even among the goyim, that one of you corinthians has the isha wife of his abba.
target_text: ja'a tadèngi, na, ca dhèu nèti juma'at miu dhu ad'u j'ara karehe dènge dhèu bhèni. ngaa dhu nèngu ad'u-ue ne bhelu risi nèti dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua. lula nèngu j'unu pa'èci dènge ina bhala na!

source_text: and you have been puffed up with ga'avah pride. should you not rather have been filled with agmat nefesh grief, so that he who has done this would have been taken away from among you?
target_text: te ngaa miu pamone-pabhèni, sèmi juma'at miu mola-mèci le! te ngaa madhutu iia-iia na, miu hud'i makae ku, aa d'ara pèd'a. dhèu sèmi èèna, babège eele ne pakaj'èu!

source_text: for i indeed being not present in habasar but being not absent in the ruach hakodesh have already, as being present, pronounced the rebbe, melech hamoshiachʼs bet din mishpat on the one who has done such a thing.
target_text: masi ka èdhi pakaj'èu èci dènge èci, te ngaa d'ara ja'a dhoka ètu miu di. de ja'a pama'ète kore le lii langu dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae èèna, nuka sèmi ja'a dhu ètu èèna le.

source_text: in the name of adoneinu yehoshua, when you have assembled in your shul and i am with you by the same ruach hakodesh along with the gevurat adoneinu yehoshua,
target_text: ja'a dènge hak ho pama'ète sèmi èèna, lula yesus j'aj'i kètu èdhi, aa ja'a dhèu pajuu-paleha na. de miu hud'i madhèdi pa'èci ku ho pama'ète lii langu èèna pake kolongara kètu èdhi. aa d'ara ja'a sama-sama dènge miu kahèi.

source_text: you are to transmit and hand over to hasatan such a person for the churban of the basar, that his neshamah may be spared in the yom hashem.
target_text: hèia miu hud'i saraka dhèu ne asa dhèu aae nidhu, sèna ka nèbhu-nèbhu na core eele j'ara bhelu-katub'a nèti d'ara na. sèna ka ladhe kètu èdhi mai hari, na, nèngu patabuli dhèu ne'e nèti koasa sasala-sasigo na.

source_text: your boasting is not good. do you not have da'as that a little chametz all the mixture leavens?
target_text: be'a boe ladhe miu nged'e! baku bhèlu, na, èdhi pakihu bibit roti ciki di ho bisa pakapai adonan aa'i-aa'i. bibit roti, nuka sèmi bhabhelu dhèu. de ladhe soro tèke dhèu ad'u-ue bhabhelu ètu talora aae miu, bèli-camèd'a dhèu sarani leo sèra madhutu tao bhelu kahèi!

source_text: purge out the old chametz leavened bread, that you may be issa chadasha new dough, batzek, deaf dough, having no indication of fermentation, as you are indeed like matzot unleavened bread. more than that, our korban pesach has been sacrificed, moshiach.
target_text: babège eele dhèu bhelu èèna nèti juma'at miu, sèmi uru èèna dhèu yahudi sèra core eele ragi aa'i-aa'i nèti èmu rèngu sèra ho neo ra'a kalela paska. dènge j'ara ne, miu bisa j'aj'i hari nuka sèmi dhèu dhu d'ara na abhu heka bhelu-katub'a. miu hud'i j'aj'i ku sèmi èèna. uru èèna, dhèu roro ana kahib'i-kalèbho sèna ka tao badha korban kalela paska. d'ai limuri ku, rèngu pamadhe dhèu mola-mèci ama lamatua, sèna ka j'aj'i korban dhu pamèu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: so let us celebrate pesach, not with old chametz, nor with the chametz of kavvanah ra'ah malice and wickedness, but with matzot of kenut sincerity and emes.
target_text: uru èèna, dhèu yahudi ra'a gee-j'ara nèti roti dhu pake boe ragi ètu d'ara lod'o kalela paska. limuri ne, èdhi nuka sèmi roti dhu pake boe ragi èèna. nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i j'aga paie mamuri èdhi sèna ka baku tao ia ka j'ara-j'ara dhu bhelu, aa baku papèd'a d'ara dhèu leo. èdhi hud'i padhai lii dhu lèke taruu. hèia ropa dhèu ladhe rèdhi mamuri èdhi, ra peka na, tatao èdhi madhutu d'ara mola.

source_text: i wrote to you in the iggeret not to mix with those engaging in acts of zenut fornication,
target_text: ca hari ni, ja'a suri kèdhi le sasuri dhu peka na, baku pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe.

source_text: not meaning to completely disassociate from the zannayim of the olam hazeh or those guilty of chamdanut greed and the ones practicing hona'ah swindling or those guilty of avodah zarah idol worship, als since in that case you would have to exit the olam hazeh.
target_text: a'abhu ja'a ne peka boe, na, miu baku pa'èci dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, dhu pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua, do dhèu manga'a, do dhèu kapod'e-kabèli dhu mana'u rare mèdha-panyau dhèu, do dènge dhèu sogo-tagu nidhu. te ladhe sèmi èèna, miu hud'i tao iisi mi pakaj'èu nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: but, now i wrote to you not to mix with any ach b'moshiach who is a zannay fornicator or a kamtzan miser or an oved elilim idolater or a megadef reviler or a shikkor drunkard or a shoded robber; with such a man do not sit at tish table, do not share betzi'at halechem breaking of bread.
target_text: te ngaa dhu ja'a peka ne nuka: miu baku pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu peka na, nèngu dhèu sarani, aa te ngaa nèngu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe, do dhu manga'a, do dhu sogo-tagu nidhu, do dhu pahahe kolongara dhèu, do dhu mahu, do dhu kapod'e mèdha-panyau dhèu. èdhi baku pa'èci dènge dhèu sèmi sèra. aa loe eele ka madhèdi mi'a-minu pa'èci dènge dhèu sèmi sèra!

source_text: for what is it to me to sit as a dayan in the bet din and then judge ones outside the kehillah? will your bet din not judge the ones within the kehillah?
target_text: miu dènge hak ho lee mamuri dhèu sarani. te ngaa ja'a dènge boe hak, sèna ka pama'ète lii langu dhèu dhu parcaya boe ama lamatua.

source_text: but the outsiders hashem judges. uvi'arta hara mikkir'becha you must purge the evil from among you.
target_text: te ama lamatua mesa na ka bèli-camèd'a pama'ète hia dhèu dhu parcaya boe ne. de miu baku bhèlu, ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua dhu suri, peka na, dhèu dhu peka na, nèngu dhèu unu lamatua, te ngaa loe boe tao bhabhelu, na, babège eele ne!

source_text: does anyone of you having a dispute with an ach b'moshiach dare to be judged before the resha'im unrighteous, evildoers and not before the bet din of the kedoshim?
target_text: ladhe ca dhèu sarani pagalaa dènge a'ari na dhèu sarani, nga tao ka lami asa pengadilan ètu madha hakim dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua? tasamia ka j'aj'i sèmi èèna? be'a risi lami asa madha dhèu-dhèu parcaya, sèna ka rèngu uri lii langu miu!

source_text: or do you not have da'as that the kedoshim will sit in mishpat over the olam hazeh? and if the olam hazeh is to be judged by you, are you incompetent dayanim to try the smallest cases?
target_text: nuka sèmi dhu dhae me'a mèka, peka na, dhèu-dhèu parcaya, bèli-camèd'a rèngu ka dhu pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. de tasamia ka miu mesa mi bisa boe uri lii langu dhu ana iiki-iiki?

source_text: do you lack da'as that the malachim will come before our bet din? not to mention the things of olam hazeh!
target_text: dhu mola-mola ka, ladhe bèli-camèd'a èdhi ka dhu uri lii langu ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga. de tatu hud'i miu ku dhu uri lii langu dhu bèli-bèli j'aj'i ètu talora aae miu.

source_text: if, then, you have cases concerning matters of the olam hazeh, how could you appoint as your bet din dayanim men who have no standing in the kehillah?
target_text: risi-risi hari, ladhe miu dhèu parcaya pagalaa lula-nèti j'ara dhu ana iiki-iiki sèra, nga tao ka miu pake dhèu pama'ète lii dhu dhèu-dhèu sarani pakab'ua boe si?

source_text: i speak to your bushah shame. is there not among you even one chacham wise man who will be able to sit in mishpat between his achim b'moshiach?
target_text: de ja'a neo peka ca j'ara dhu pamakae miu. sèmi ngaa? nuka sèmi ètu talora aae miu abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu d'èlu-mèu uri lii langu dhu ana iiki-iiki sèra, sèmi lii langu dhu cèu nèti a'ari èdhi.

source_text: but an ach b'moshiach takes another ach b'moshiach to court, and this before the courtroom of apikorosim unbelievers?
target_text: te ngaa nèti talora miu abhu dhèu parcaya dhu ère nèti a'ari na dhèu parcaya asa madha dhèu pama'ète lii langu! aa te ngaa dhèu pama'ète lii langu ne dhu parcaya boe lamatua!

source_text: already, therefore, it is a total defeat for you, that you have lawsuits with one another. why not rather suffer wrong? why not rather be cheated?
target_text: lèke boe, sina ma? miu dhu segi boe le èèna, ladhe miu èci dènge èci lami pagalaa asa era pama'ète lii langu. be'a risi, a'ari èu èèna soro tèke ne, ladhe na tao sala mi dedha èu. aa ladhe a'ari èu dhèu parcaya mana'u nare mèdha-panyau èu, be'a risi hud'i laa nare!

source_text: but you yourselves do wrong and practice hona'ah cheating, and this to your achim b'moshiach.
target_text: te ngaa miu dhèu parcaya èci tao sala mi a'ari miu. aa èci mana'u èci. aa te ngaa miu sama-sama dhèu parcaya!

source_text: or do you not have da'as that the resha'im unrighteous ones will not inherit the malchut hashem? do not be deceived! neither zannayim fornicators, nor ovdei elilim idolaters, nor mena'afim adulterers, nor effeminate call boys nor homosexuals,
target_text: miu nuka sèmi me'a boe j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i! te dhèu dhu ro'o boe tao dhu lèke, tatu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. mage soro tèke dhèu tipu miu, sèna ka miu ad'u-ue sasala! dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe, dhu sogo-tagu nidhu, dhu bersina, mone dhèu dua dhu pa'èci nuka sèmi dhèu èmu-kamali,

source_text: nor ganavim thieves, nor kamtzanim misers, nor shikkorim drunkards, nor megadefim revilers, nor the ones doing hona'ah swindling - none of these will inherit the malchut hashem.
target_text: dhèu mana'u, dhèu manga'a, dhèu rinu mahu, dhu padhai lii pakarehe kolongara dhèu, dhu pakapod'e ho rare mèdha-panyau dhèu, te dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèmi se'e se, tatu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua!

source_text: and some of you were these things. but you were washed and made tehorim clean, you were made to be am kadosh, you were made to be yitzdak im hashem in the name of rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua adoneinu and in the ruach hakodesh of eloheinu.
target_text: mema, uru èèna miu cahag'e sèmi èèna kahèi! te ngaa ama lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo miu, hèia pamèu miu. aa nèngu bhoke le j'ara kahèi, sèna ka miu bisa pabe'a hari dènge ne. na tao j'ara se'e, lula miu pa'èki dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, aa lula miu pa'èki dènge roh lamatua kahèi.

source_text: all things to me are proper! but not all things are beneficial. all things to me are proper! but i will not be mastered by anything.
target_text: ja'a dènge hak sèna ka tao aa'i mèu-mèu. te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a neo tao sèra, tatu boe be'a hia ja'a. de masi ka ja'a dènge hak sèna ka tao aa'i mèu-mèu, te ngaa ja'a ko'o boe j'ara dhu karehe koasa nare ja'a.

source_text: okhel food for the stomach and the stomach for okhel, but hashem will destroy both one and the other; but the body is not for zenut but for hashem, and hashem for the body.
target_text: conto sèmi, dhèu peka na, nganga'a parluu kabake, aa kabake parluu nganga'a. te ngaa sanèd'e, te bèli-camèd'a lamatua palaho aa'i dua-dua ra. conto dhu leo hari, èdhi bisa boe soro ngi'u èdhi sèna ka bisa tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu-kamali èdhi boe. èdhi unu ngi'u ne, sèna ka sab'a hia lamatua èdhi. aa lamatua èdhi ladhe-leru ngi'u èdhi.

source_text: and hashem brought about the techiyah from hamesim for moshiach adoneinu and will also bring about the techiyas hamesim for us through his gevurah power.
target_text: ropa kètu èdhi, yesus kristus madhe, ama lamatua ka pamamuri hari ne. de ladhe èdhi madhe, nèngu dènge koasa kahèi ho pamamuri hari èdhi.

source_text: do you not have da'as that your gufot bodies are evarim members, limbs of moshiach? should i then take the evarim members of moshiach and make them evarim members of a zonah prostitute? chas v'shalom! g-d forbid!
target_text: ngi'u miu j'aj'i mi unu kristus, nuka sèmi miu bagian nèti ngi'u kristus. tatu j'ara ne, miu me'a le! de ladhe ja'a pake bagian nèti ngi'u kristus, ho laku pa'èci dènge ngi'u nèti bhèni kajeo, na tasamia? baku sèmi èèna! te èèna na lèke boe!

source_text: or do you not have da'as that of the one joining himself to a zonah, that v'hayu l'vasar echad and they will be as one flesh?
target_text: tatu miu me'a le, ladhe dhèu tao j'ara makae ho j'unu pa'èci dènge bhèni kajeo, na, dua-dua pakihu kee j'aj'i mi èci. te dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, rèngu dua ra pa'èki le j'aj'i mi èci.

source_text: but the one with deveykuscleaving, attachment to hashem has achdus union in the ruach hakodesh with elohim.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri d'ara èci dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, j'aj'i le èci dènge nèngu, sama sèmi dua ra dhu pa'èki ètu d'ara roh èci.

source_text: flee zenut! every chet is outside the body, you say. but the one guilty of zenut commits chet against the body itself.
target_text: ladhe èu abhu tebho tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu èu boe, na, rai pakaj'èu! dhèu ad'u-ue sasala rupa-rupa dhu pa'ele iie rèngu unu ra, aa pa'ele iie dhèu leo kahèi. te dhèu dhu karihu kaj'alu pa'ele iie ngi'u nèngu unu na.

source_text: or have you no da'as that your body is a heikhal hashem of the ruach hakodesh in you, whom you have from hashem, and you are not your own?
target_text: ngi'u èu èèna, nuka sèmi èmu sabaj'a roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci. roh nèngu èèna ka, dhu pea ètu d'ara miu, te ama lamatua mesa na ka hia roh na mi dedha miu. nèti èèna ka, miu dènge boe hak ciki sa hèi, ho j'aj'i lamatua dhu ator ngi'u miu unu mi. te ngaa, nga tao ka miu mamuri sèmi pame'a boe sa dènge j'ara se'e?

source_text: for the geulah redemption of you from the golus of chet was purchased with a price; therefore, bring kavod to hashem with your gufot.
target_text: kristus sui nare le miu dènge kab'ua titu kèna. de miu hud'i mamuri ku dènge pakab'ua ngi'u miu unu mi, ho pad'elo, na, miu pakab'ua ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: now, concerning the things in your iggeret, letʼs take up the next inyan topic: it is beneficial for a man not to touch an isha.
target_text: ja'a neo suri j'ara-j'ara dhu miu pakarèi ètu d'ara sasuri miu èèna, dhu peka na, tasamia? dhu be'a ka, dhèu mone baku leo-èmu, do?

source_text: but, because of the acts of zenut, let each ben adam have his own isha, and let each isha have her own ba'al husband.
target_text: sèmi ne'e: lula abhu lod'o taleo ae, dhu dhèu bisa manahu asa d'ara tatao dhu sala ètu d'ara pa'èci mone dènge bhèni, nèti èèna ka be'a risi dhèu mone èci hud'i dènge ku dhèu èmu nèngu mesa na. sèmi èèna kahèi, dhèu bhèni hud'i pa'èci ku dènge dhèu èmu nèngu mesa na.

source_text: let the ba'al render the conjugal choiv debt to his isha, and likewise also the isha to her ba'al husband.
target_text: mone dhu dènge le dhèu èmu! mage mo'o boe j'unu pa'èci dènge dhèu èmu èu. aa dhèu bhèni dhu dènge le dhèu èmu! mage mo'o boe j'unu pa'èci dènge dhèu èmu èu.

source_text: it is not the isha who has samchut authority over her own body, but the ba'al husband; likewise, also it is not the ba'al husband who has samchut over his own body, but the isha.
target_text: te bhèni dhu leo le èmu, hia le ngi'u na sèna ka j'aj'i unu dhèu èmu na. aa mone dhu leo le èmu, hia le ngi'u na ho j'aj'i unu dhèu èmu na.

source_text: do not deprive each other, unless by agreement for a set time, that you may renew zerizut diligence to tefillah prayer and again you may be together, lest hasatan lead you into nissayon temptation because of your lack of shlitah atzmi self-control.
target_text: de miu baku patula-pajuku, lula dua-dua mi dhu dènge hak hua! te ngaa ladhe miu neo sabaj'a di, ho mo'o boe ngee j'ara dhu leo-leo, na, j'unu pa'èci boe d'ara ciki oo'e èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. sad'i dua mi mere lii èci ku. aa ladhe sabaj'a mere, na, be'a risi pakaboko hari dènge ka. te ladhe aad'o, na, bisa j'aj'i be'a boe! te dhèu aae nidhu bisa dadugu-rariu dhèu dhu taha rare boe d'ara.

source_text: but i say this according to concession, not according to mitzvoh.
target_text: j'ara ne mai nèti a'abhu ja'a di, nèti boe atora lamatua.

source_text: but, i wish kol bnei adam even to be as i am; however, this is impossible since each has his own matanah gift from hashem: one this; and another that.
target_text: madhutu ngangee ja'a, be'a risi dhèu baku leo-èmu, nuka sèmi ja'a dhu dènge boe dhèu èmu. te ngaa ama lamatua hia dhèu karunya pamèci dènge nèngu. nèti èèna ka, abhu dhèu dhu ama lamatua hia si leo-èmu, aa abhu cahag'e dhu na hia si leo boe èmu.

source_text: but, i say to the bochrim and the almanot widows, it is beneficial for them if they remain as i am;
target_text: ja'a neo peka dènge dhèu mone do dhèu bhèni dhu leo mèka èmu, aa dènge bhèni balu, na, be'a risi miu baku leo-èmu, nuka sèmi ja'a ne.

source_text: but if they do not have shlitah atzmi, let them marry. for better it is to marry than with eish to be set ablaze.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe taha mere boe, hua iia leo èmu ka. dhu hua iia risi ladhe dhèu leo-èmu, te aad'o na, dad'èi d'ara na pa'ele iie ngi'u nèngu unu na.

source_text: but to the ones having entered bibrit hanissuim in covenant of marriage, i charge, not i but rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu, an isha is not to separate from her ba'al husband.
target_text: ne'e ne mai boe nèti ngangee ja'a mesa ku. te ja'a neo peka ngaa dhu lamatua èdhi paredha le mi dhèu dhu leo le èmu, na, bhèni bisa boe pa'ia-pa'ela dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na.

source_text: but, if indeed she is separated, let her remain so, or be reconciled to her basherter; and a ba'al should not leave his isha.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe nèngu tèke eele dhèu èmu na, be'a risi leo ia ka èmu. hua iia nèngu la'e padame dènge mone dhu j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. sèmi èèna kahèi mone, bisa boe pa'ia-pa'ela dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na.

source_text: but, to the rest i - sha'ul - not rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu, say: if any ach b'moshiach has an isha who is an apikoros and she is willing to live with him, let him not leave her;
target_text: ne'e ne madhutu ngangee ja'a, mai boe nèti lamatua èdhi. aa mi dhèu leo, ja'a neo padhai lii sèmi ne'e: ladhe abhu mone dhèu sarani dhu dhèu èmu na parcaya boe kristus, na, baku ia eele ne, ladhe dhèu èmu na neo mamuri taruu dènge nèngu.

source_text: and if an isha has a ba'al husband who is an apikoros, and he is willing to dwell with her, let her not leave her ba'al husband.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge bhèni dhu dhèu èmu na parcaya boe kristus, na, baku ia eele ne, ladhe mone ne d'èi era sèna ka dua ra mamuri pa'èci taruu.

source_text: for, the ba'al who is an apikoros is mekudash b'ruach hakodesh set apart as holy in the ruach hakodesh by the isha, and the isha who is an apikoros likewise by the ach b'moshiach; otherwise, your yeladim are tema'im unclean; but now they are tehorim clean.
target_text: te mone dhu parcaya boe kristus, bisa mola-mèci, lula nèngu dhu pa'èki le dènge bhèni dhu j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. aa bhèni dhu parcaya boe kristus, bisa j'aj'i mola-mèci kahèi, lula nèngu dhu pa'èki dènge mone dhu j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. te ladhe aad'o, na, ana-ana rèngu bisa boe mola-mèci. te ngaa dènge j'ara ne, rèngu bisa mola-mèci ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: but, if the one who is an apikoros separates and departs, let the separation occur; the ach b'moshiach has not been enslaved, or the achot b'moshiach in such cases; but hashem has given you a kri'ah b'shalom.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu bhèni do dhèu mone dhu parcaya boe kristus, dhu la'e tèke eele dhèu èmu-kamali na dhu parcaya, na hud'i nèngu sène. ka dhèu èmu dhu parcaya, pa'èki heka dènge ne. te ama lamatua paroa miu sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na, ho miu mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: for how do you know, isha, if you will not bring your basherter destined mate, your ba'al, to yeshu'at eloheinu?
target_text: dhèu bhèni dhu parcaya, dhu leo le èmu aa'i-aa'i! ele boe miu bisa hia mamuri mi dhèu èmu miu. aa bisa aad'o kahèi. sèmi èèna kahèi dhèu mone dhu parcaya dhu leo le èmu sèra! ele boe miu bisa hia mamuri mi dhèu èmu miu. aa bisa aad'o kahèi. miu me'a iia mèka.

source_text: only each of you walk the derech to which you were called by hashem. this is my charge in all the kehillot of moshiach.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa mamuri dhèu èci-èci tasa mera mia lod'o ama lamatua paroa nare miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, mamuri taruu sèmi èèna. baku ub'a hari, te ama lamatua dhu ator nare le sèmi èèna. ja'a aj'a-nori atora ne ètu juma'at aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: if as a ben berit with bris milah anyone received their kri'ah, let him not conceal it; if anyone without bris milah has been called, let him without bris milah not undergo bris milah.
target_text: conto, ladhe miu suna le sèna ka pad'elo, na, miu dhèu yahudi, hèia lod'o limuri miu tadèngi ama lamatua paroa nare miu, na, baku pasili, peka na, miu suna le. aa dhèu dhu dhae suna mèka ropa tadèngi ama lamatua paroa si, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na, na, suna ia ka. lula rèngu dhu j'aj'i le dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: bris milah is not everything; nor is the lack of it; but being shomer mitzvot hashem.
target_text: ladhe dhu suna le, èèna j'aj'i boe mi ngaa èci sa. aa suna mèka èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. dhu dènge kab'ua ka, nuka èdhi madhutu lii paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: each one walk the derech of his kri'ah calling, summons, and remain there.
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua hag'e nare miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, lamatua pua boe miu suna, do baku suna. de hud'i ka laa sèmi èèna. baku ub'a ia ka.

source_text: if while a bond servant you were called, do not let it consume you, although if you can gain your deror freedom, liberty, do so.
target_text: ja'a hia hari conto èci. ladhe èu j'aj'i ènu lod'o ama lamatua paroa èu, na, hud'i laa sèmi èèna, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. te ngaa ladhe sèmi èu dhu ènu boe, na, hud'i laa! ladhe bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu bebas, ngaa-ngaa tao boe kahèi.

source_text: for, the one in hashem having been called while a bond servant is adoneinuʼs ben chorin freedman; likewise, the one having been called while a ben chorin is the rebbe, melech hamoshiachʼs bond servant.
target_text: te ropa lamatua paroa ca dhèu ènu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, ènu ne j'aj'i le sèmi ca dhèu dhu bebas, dhu sab'a hia lamatua na ètu sorga. aa lod'o ama lamatua paroa ca dhèu bebas j'aj'i dhèu unu na, dhèu ne j'aj'i ana pua-paleha kristus.

source_text: you were bought with a pidyon nefesh price; do not become avadim habnei adam.
target_text: kristus tihe pama'ète nare le miu dènge kab'ua titu kèna! de miu baku j'aj'i ènu hia dhèu leo.

source_text: each one wherever on the derech of chayyim he was called, achim b'moshiach, there let him remain in deveykus with hashem.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! lod'o ama lamatua paroa nare miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, mamuri miu tasamia èèna ka, hud'i laa sèmi èèna. baku ub'a ia ka. hud'i laa sèmi èèna ka, hia mi lamatua.

source_text: next sugya topic: concerning the betulot virgins. a mitzvoh of rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu i do not have, but a bit of wisdom i offer as one who by the rachamim hashem is ne'eman faithful.
target_text: miu karèi ja'a lula-nèti dhèu kalora iisi dhu j'unu pa'èci rèdhi mèka dènge dhèu èci sa. ama lamatua peka boe ngaa-ngaa dènge ja'a nèti j'ara èèna. te ngaa miu bisa sèmi ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai, lula ama lamatua pad'elo rasa kasia mi ja'a. madhutu a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: i consider therefore, it to be beneficial, because of the impending crisis that you remain as you are.
target_text: limuri ne èdhi abhu j'aj'èra rupa-rupa. de mamuri dhèu tasa mera mia èèna ka, hud'i laa sèmi èèna. dad'èi ja'a sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: have you entered bibrit hanissuim in covenant of marriage with an isha? do not seek to be free. are you freed from an isha? do not seek an isha.
target_text: ladhe èu pa'èki dènge dhèu èmu èu, na, baku ia eele ne. ladhe èu dhu pa'èki heka dènge dhèu èmu èu, na, tenge ia ka bhèni leo, sèna ka leo ia ka èmu.

source_text: but if indeed you enter bibrit hanissuim in covenant of marriage, there is no chet; and if the betulah virgin marries, there is no averah in that for her. but such will have tzoros in the basar, which i am trying to spare you.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èu leo hari èmu, na, èu sala boe ngaa-ngaa. aa ladhe bhèni dhu pa'èci rèdhi mèka dènge dhèu mone leo-èmu, nèngu ad'u-ue boe sasala ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa sanèd'e, dhèu dhu paleo èmu, bèli-camèd'a paraga dènge j'aj'èra rupa-rupa ètu rai-haha ne. dad'èi ja'a sèna ka miu baku susa sèmi èèna.

source_text: now this i say, achim b'moshiach, the time until haketz has been shortened. from now on, let those having nashim live as if not having nashim,
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! madhutu ngangee ja'a, nuka: lod'o oe èle rai-haha ne dètu ae le. de mone dhu dènge dhèu èmu, mage ladhe dhoka dhèu èmu nèngu di, te ngaa laladhe kahèi asa lamatua.

source_text: and let the ones weeping as not weeping, and let the ones having simcha as not having simcha, and let the ones buying as not possessing,
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe abhu dhu tangi, be'a risi pa'èra d'ara ho baku tangi, sèna ka laladhe asa ama lamatua. ladhe abhu dhu karej'e-karae, be'a risi baku karej'e seli, te ngaa laladhe asa ama lamatua. ladhe abhu dhu hèli ngaa-ngaa, be'a risi tao mamuri na nuka sèmi dhèu dhu dènge boe unu, sèna ka laladhe asa ama lamatua.

source_text: and let the ones using the olam hazeh as not fully using it, for the present form of the olam hazeh is passing away.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhu pake mèdha-panyau nèti rai-haha ne, be'a risi tao ngi'u na, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu mamuri na dhu maena boe mi mèdha-panyau rai-haha ne, sèna ka na laladhe dhoka asa ama lamatua di. lula j'ara mamuri rai-haha ne bèli-camèd'a ele.

source_text: but i would have you free from de'agot worries. the ben adam without isha cares for the things of hashem, how he may please hashem.
target_text: ja'a d'èi sèna ka miu baku pangee ae-ae. te dhèu dhu leo boe èmu, lod'o nèngu ae ho na tao madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. sèna ka nèngu bisa tenge j'ara ho sab'a pakarej'e d'ara lamatua.

source_text: but the one having taken an isha cares for the things of the olam hazeh, how he may please his isha, and he has been divided. both the isha free of a ba'al or the betulah cares for the things of hashem, that she may be tehorah spiritually and physically. but the isha with a ba'al cares for the things of the olam hazeh, how she may please her ba'al.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu leo le èmu, hud'i taru kira dad'èi rai-haha ne. nèngu kahèi hud'i taru kira ku mi dad'èi ama lamatua, te ngaa nèngu hud'i tenge j'ara ho pakarej'e d'ara dhèu èmu na kahèi. j'ara se'e se ka tao ngangee na j'aj'i mi kajari. sèmi èèna kahèi, bhèni dhu dènge heka dhèu èmu, aa bhèni kalora iisi. rèngu taru kira dad'èi ama lamatua, sèna ka bisa mamuri mola-mèci ètu d'ara dènge ngi'u aae. te ngaa bhèni dhu leo le èmu, d'ara na kajari. nèngu taru kira ka mi dad'èi lamatua, te ngaa na tenge j'ara ho pakarej'e d'ara dhèu èmu na kahèi.

source_text: now, this i say for your own benefit, not that i may throw a noose on your deror freedom, but i speak with respect to what is decent, seemly, and sits well with hashem, without distraction in avodas kodesh.
target_text: ja'a lole j'ara se'e, sèna ka nèti babe'a hia miu. ja'a ko'o boe ho miu lèke sasii. dad'èi ja'a ka, miu tao dhu lèke, aa tangare asa dad'èi ama lamatua, sèna ka ngangee miu baku kajari.

source_text: however, if anyone thinks he does not have proper hitnahagut conduct toward the betulah of his eirusin betrothal, engagement, and if he thinks his basherte destined mate is getting along in years, and thus it has to be, what he desires, let him do; there is no chet, let them enter bibrit hanissuim in covenant of marriage.
target_text: ladhe dhèu mone dhu lii d'ai le bhèni dhu d'ai umur paleo èmu, na, hud'i laa ra paleo, ladhe mone ne d'èi heka pamata. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, rèngu tao boe j'ara sala. te ladhe ra mate panèbhu, mage dhoka mone èèna taha nare boe d'ara, hèia nèngu tao j'ara dhu lèke boe.

source_text: but he who in his lev has settled the decision, not having the need of conjugal intimacy, but having mastery concerning his own desire, and thus he in his lev has decided, not to enter bibrit hanissuim with his betulah virgin, he does well.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe mone ne bisa taha nare d'ara, nèngu baku laka-seti ho kab'i lai-lai. te ne'a ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao. masi ka nare nèbhu, dènge boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: so then both the one entering bibrit hanissuim with his betulah does well, and the one not entering bebrit hanissuim with his arusah betrothed will do better.
target_text: de dhèu mone dhu leo dènge bhèni na, èèna be'a. aa dhu leo boe èmu èèna, be'a risi hari.

source_text: an isha has been bound bibrit hanissuim, in covenant of marriage for so long a time as her ba'al lives, but if her ba'al should sleep the sleep of the mesim, she is free to enter bibrit hanissuim with the ba'al she desires, but only in rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu.
target_text: bhèni dhu leo le èmu, pa'èki toke madhe dènge dhèu èmu na. te ngaa ladhe dhèu èmu na madhe, nèngu bisa leo hari dènge dhèu mone leo, sad'i mone ne dhèu dhu parcaya kristus kahèi.

source_text: however, happy is she, and even more so, if she remains as she is; and i think in this bit of wisdom i am offering that i have the ruach hakodesh.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a, be'a risi bhèni balu ne, leo ia ka èmu. ja'a pangee, na, lii holo ne cèu nèti roh lamatua dhu ètu d'ara ja'a kahèi.

source_text: now concerning the sacrifice to an elil idol in avodah zarah, idol worship, we know that we all possess da'as knowledge. but da'as puffs up with ga'avah, but ahavah agape builds up.
target_text: ja'a neo lole lula-nèti sisi dhu dhèu pake sogo-tagu nidhu. èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti dhu te'a ae le j'ara se'e. dhu j'aj'i mi lii langu, ka ladhe dhèu ne'a ae, na, nèngu bisa nged'e, te na pangee, na, nèngu d'èlu-mèu risi nèti dhèu leo sèra. de be'a risi, èdhi mamuri dènge pasue di. te j'ara pasue ne'e ka tao dhèu aa'i-aa'i asa tabha èra ètu d'ara parcaya ra.

source_text: if anyone presumes he has da'as of anything, he does not yet have da'as of the necessary da'as.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, ne'a mèu, èèna peka na, mamèu nèngu dhae d'ai mèka.
