source_text: but if a person has ahavas hashem, hashem has da'as of that person.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu sue ama lamatua, tatu lamatua tadhe ne. ne'e ka dhu lèke mola-mola.

source_text: now concerning the eating of the okhel food at the mizbe'ach of avodah zarah which is sacrificed to an elil idol, we have da'as that an elil is nothing in the world, and that there is no g-d but echad.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu na'a sisi dhu sogo-tagu le mi nidhu, èdhi aa'i-aa'i te'a, na, nèngu dhoka pahaha iisi mi mèdha sogo-tagu ètu rai-haha di, te ngaa pahaha boe iisi mi lamatua dhu lèke. te èdhi te'a, na, abhu dhoka ama lamatua èci di dhu lèke aa, mèdha sogo-tagu aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu sogo-tagu, dènge boe kab'ua.

source_text: for even if there are so-called g-ds, whether in shomayim or on ha'aretz, even as there are so-called g-ds many and l-rds many,
target_text: abhu mèdha ae-ae ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne, dhu dhèu peka, na, ‘lamatua rèngu' do aad'o na, ‘kètu rèngu'.

source_text: yet in fact for us we have da'as that there is adonoi echad l-rd is one, hashem av echad l'chullanu one father of us all, from whom are all things, and we exist for hashem, and there is adon echad, moshiach yehoshua, through whom are all things and we through him.
target_text: te ngaa bagi èdhi, ama lamatua dhoka èci di. nèngu èèna, ama èdhi. aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i nèti nèngu. aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi tao hia mi nèngu. aa kètu èdhi dhoka èci di, nuka yesus kristus. ama lamatua pake yesus, lod'o na paj'aj'i aa'i-aa'i. aa èdhi mamuri, lula yesus ka dhu hia èdhi.

source_text: however, not kol bnei adam have this da'as knowledge. some are so accustomed to the elil idol until now that when they eat, they think of the okhel food as being sacrificed to the elil in avodah zarah, and their matzpun conscience, being weak, is made to be tameh defiled.
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhèu dhu re'a boe j'ara se'e. rèngu loe boe pangee mèdha sogo-tagu sèra, hèia ngangee rèngu èci èèna ka dènge ngangee rèngu uru sèra. nèti èèna ka, ropa ra'a sisi dhu sogo-tagu nidhu, rèngu pangee, na, nganga'a ne j'aj'i le korban ho pake sogo-tagu nidhu! ladhe ja'a ku'a mèdha ne'e, na, ja'a pa'èki era dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu bhelu! de ne'e ne ka dhu pa'ele iie ngangee rèngu, toke rèngu bisa heka unu ngangee madhera, lula d'ara rèngu èra boe.

source_text: but okhel food will not usher us into the presence of hashem; neither are we falling short if we do not eat okhel, nor are we better if we eat.
target_text: nga tao ka sèmi èèna? nganga'a bisa boe nèti èdhi asa madha ama lamatua, si? ladhe ta'a boe, èdhi asa boe bhelu, sina ma? aa ladhe ta'a, tao boe èdhi j'aj'i dhèu be'a, si?

source_text: but beware lest somehow your cherut freedom becomes a michshol stumbling block to the weak ones.
target_text: te ngaa mage-mage! masi ka èu dènge hak sèna ka ad'u-ue madha j'ara èci, tatu boe j'ara ne nèti babe'a hia èu. ladhe sèmi abhu a'ari ca dhèu dhu parcaya èra boe, ladhe nèdhi èu tao j'ara èèna, hèia na manahu, na, èèna be'a boe!

source_text: for if anyone sees you, the one having da'as knowledge, eating in the temple of an elil, will not the matzpun of him be strengthened so as to eat the okhel sacrificed to an elil idol at the mizbe'ach of avodah zarah?
target_text: èu dhu me'a le, j'ara ne j'aj'i boe mi ngaa èci sa. te ngaa ladhe a'ari dhèu parcaya dhu d'ara na èra boe, ladhe nèdhi èu mu'a ètu d'ara èmu sogo-tagu, na pangee sèmi ngaa? tatu na pangee, na, ladhe ja'a ku'a nganga'a sogo-tagu èèna, ngaa-ngaa tao boe, masi ka nganga'a èèna ra pae'a le nidhu.

source_text: for the one being weak in emunah is being destroyed by your da'as, the ach b'moshiach for whom moshiach died.
target_text: èu me'a le j'ara ae-ae. te ngaa ladhe èu tao sèmi èèna, èu asa paroe d'ara dhèu dhu èra mèka. aa te ngaa dhèu èèna, a'ari èu dhèu parcaya. kristus madhe hia nèngu kahèi!

source_text: and thus by sinning against the achim b'moshiach and wounding their weak matzpunim consciences, you commit averos against rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: hua iia pangee sèmi ne'e: ladhe a'ari èu dhu d'ara èra mèka ad'u-ue j'ara èci dhu madhutu ngangee rèngu sala lula tatao èu, na, èu tao le sasala hia rèngu. aa èu tao sasala mi kristus kahèi.

source_text: therefore, if okhel causes my ach b'moshiach to trip on a michshol, i should never eat meat again, lest i cause my ach b'moshiach to stumble.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a ku'a nganga'a dhu tao a'ari ja'a dhèu parcaya manahu asa d'ara sasala, be'a risi ja'a baku ku'a sisi sèmi sèra, toke d'ai ja'a madhe. te ja'a ko'o boe rèngu manahu asa d'ara sasala.

source_text: do i not have cherut? am i not a shliach? have i not seen rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu? are you not my po'al work in adoneinu?
target_text: baku pangee, na, ja'a dènge boe hak ho suri sèmi ne'e hia miu. te ama lamatua pua ja'a laku lole dènge dhèu lula-nèti nèngu. ja'a dhu kèdhi le kètu èdhi, yesus èèna. ja'a dhu pa'èki mèno dènge ne. hèia miu aa'i-aa'i parcaya nèngu kahèi, lula sasab'a-la'a ja'a ne.

source_text: if to others i am not a shliach, surely i am to you, for you are the chotam seal of my shlichus, in hashem.
target_text: masi ka dhèu leo ro'o boe sèmi rare ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua, te ngaa tatu miu me'a, na, lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a dhiu peka-padhai lii moa na asa miu. ladhe miu neo me'a mèu, na, lee mamuri miu di. te miu dhu pa'èki era dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus!

source_text: my apologetic to the ones cross-examining me is this:
target_text: ja'a neo dhaa mi dhèu dhu pèci sasala mi dedha ja'a, sèmi ne'e:

source_text: do i not have the privilege of eating and drinking?
target_text: miu ngee, na, ja'a dènge barnabas dènge boe hak ho abhu nganga'a-nganginu nèti dhèu dhu ji'i aj'a-nori si, do?

source_text: is the privilege not mine to take an achot b'moshiach as isha in my travels for rebbe, melech hamoshiachʼs avodas kodesh, just as the rest of his shlichim do and the achim of rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu and kefa?
target_text: miu pangee, na, ji'i dènge boe hak ho leo dènge dhèu bhèni kristen, dhu la'a sama-sama pakako sasab'a lamatua ètu era leo, do? madhutu iia-iia na, dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua dhu leo sèra, rèti kahèi dènge dhèu èmu ra. ari lamatua yesus sèra tao sèmi èèna. petrus mesa na sèmi èèna kahèi!

source_text: or is it only bar-nabba and i who are denied the privilege of not working at a parnasah?
target_text: do, miu ngee na, dhoka ja'a dènge barnabas di dhu hud'i sab'a tenge doi-dhari, sèna ka bisa mamuri ho aj'a-nori dhèu?

source_text: whoever heard of someone serving as a chaiyal soldier but having to pay his own wages for doing so? who plants a kerem vineyard but does not eat the p'ri hakerem? and who serves as a ro'eh shepherd over a flock and of the cholov milk of the flock does not partake?
target_text: ngangee miu sèmi èèna, mai nèti mia? ladhe sèku sordad'u sèra. rèngu pusi boe hèli nganga'a-nganginu dènge mèdha-papake. ladhe sèku dhèu sab'a ètu oka anggor. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu kai, peka na, èu baku mu'a hua anggor sèra! aa ladhe sèku dhèu madhenga badha. dhèu ne dènge hak ho nare susu nèti kahib'i-kalèbho dhu nèngu j'aga.

source_text: do i say this according to the dvar habnei adam? or does not the torah say these things?
target_text: ja'a padhai lii ne madhutu boe ngangee ja'a dhèu rai-haha ne. te atora sèra nèti ama lamatua dhu peka sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: for, in the torah of moshe it has been written, lo tachsom shor bedisho you shall not muzzle an ox treading grain. surely it is not for oxen that hashem is concerned.
target_text: ètu atora musa, dhu suri peka na, ropa sapi j'èli are ho hag'e eele lamusi nèti huri na, baku kape hèb'a na, sèna ka bisa na'a. miu pangee, na, lamatua soro tèke sèna ka dhoka sapi di dhu bisa na'a, do?

source_text: or does he not speak altogether for our sake, and is it not for us that hashem says this? ken, for us, because it was written that the one plowing ought to plow on in tikvah, and the one threshing ought to partake with tikvah. if we sowed spiritual things to you, is it too much if we reap in material things from you?
target_text: aad'o! lamatua peka na, nèngu taru kira èdhi kahèi. te dhu suri tèke, peka na, dhèu dhu kabèli rai, aa dhèu dhu hag'e eele lamusi nèti huri na, ropa ra sab'a, rèngu re'a kahèi, èèna na abhu pala ra. sèmi èèna kahèi, be'a risi dhèu pajuu-paleha dhèu kristen sèra, bisa abhu pala nèti rui-j'aj'èra ra. te lod'o ji'i aj'a-nori miu j'ara-j'ara nèti roh lamatua èèna, ji'i nuka sèmi ca dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe dhu sèle hini. de lod'o ji'i aj'a ngare, ladhe ji'i abhu nganga'a-nganginu do ngaa hari nèti miu, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. te j'ara na sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: if others over you can claim this privilege, can we not even more? but we did not make use of this privilege; we endure all things, lest any hindrance we should give to moshiachʼs besuras hageulah.
target_text: dhèu leo dhu aj'a-nori miu, dènge hak sèna ka abhu dhua-èi dènge mèdha-panyau nèti miu, si? aa ji'i tasamia? ji'i dènge hak risi eele nèti rèngu! te ngaa miu me'a le. ji'i se pake ngèdhi boe hak ho laka-seti miu. ji'i pa'èra ètu rupa-rupa j'ara, sèna ka baku magee miu. te, dènge j'ara ne'e, miu d'èi nanene lii lolo be'a yesus kristus dhu ji'i peka-padhai dènge miu.

source_text: do you not have da'as that the kohanim serving in the beis hamikdash sherut service in the temple eat the things of the beis hamikdash; the kohanim attending the mizbe'ach altar have their share with the mizbe'ach altar?
target_text: pangee ku laa! ama-ama agama dhu sab'a ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi, mamuri nèti persembahan dhu dhèu rèti. aa dhèu dhu sab'a ètu mei korban, ra'a sisi nèti badha dhu dhèu rèti.

source_text: so also moshiach adoneinu appointed the ones proclaiming the besuras hageulah to get their parnasah from the besuras hageulah.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, lamatua dhu moa, na, dhèu dhu sasab'a ra peka-padhai lii lolo be'a kristus, rèngu bisa mamuri nèti rui-j'aj'èra nèti sasab'a-la'a ra. dhu lèke kèna.

source_text: but i have not used any of these privileges; i did not write these things that it might be so with me; for itʼs better for me rather to die than that someone deprive me of my kavod in rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: masi ka ja'a dènge hak ho mamuri sèmi èèna, te ngaa ja'a d'èi boe tao sèmi èèna. ja'a suri boe sasuri ne sèna ka miu hia ja'a ngaa-ngaa. nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a pakako sasab'a lamatua hia miu, te ngaa manèngi boe ngaa-ngaa nèti miu. de hua iia risi ja'a madhe, ladhe dhèu pangee, na, ja'a manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti miu.

source_text: for if i preach the besuras hageulah there is nothing for me to boast about, als since necessity is laid on me, for oy li woe to me! if i do not preach the besuras hageulah.
target_text: masi ka ja'a lole taruu dènge dhèu lula-nèti lii lolo be'a lamatua, te ngaa èèna j'aj'i boe mi ngaa sa èci, dhu ja'a bisa padedha iisi. ja'a hud'i lole ku dènge dhèu lula-nèti lamatua, te lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a sèmi èèna. ladhe ja'a sab'a boe madhutu sasab'a ja'a, na dui kore j'aj'èra! te tatu pasae kore hahuku.

source_text: for, if i do this willingly, i have a sachar reward, but if unwillingly, then a ne'emanut trusteeship, a kehunah for the besuras hageulah has been entrusted to me.
target_text: ladhe ja'a sab'a sasab'a ne lula madhutu dhoka dad'èi ja'a mesa ku, na, ngaa dhu ja'a abhu sèra, nuka sèmi gaji dhu dhèu sab'a sèra abhu. te ngaa ladhe ja'a sab'a sasab'a ne, lula lamatua pua ja'a, èèna leo. te lamatua lèka ja'a ho j'aga mèdha-panyau na dhu kab'ua.

source_text: what then is my sachar reward? that in preaching as a maggid of the besuras hageulah, i may make the besuras hageulah free of charge, so as not to make full use of my right in the besuras hageulah.
target_text: de ladhe sèmi èèna, upa ja'a ngaa? ja'a parluu boe gaji. ja'a padhue-padhai lii lolo be'a lamatua, dhu manèngi boe ngaa-ngaa. ne'e ka dhu tao ja'a karae, nuka sèmi ja'a abhu le upa. de masi ka ja'a unu rupa-rupa hak, nuka sèmi dhèu leo dhu sasab'a ra padhue-padhai lii lolo be'a èèna, te ngaa ja'a pake aa'i boe hak sèra.

source_text: for being no indentured servant to any one of the bnei adam, i made myself a servant working for nothing to kol bnei adam, that i might win the more.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu bebas dhu sab'a madhutu dad'èi d'ara ja'a. dhèu dènge boe hak ho pua ja'a tao ne'e, do, tao èèna. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ja'a tao ngi'u nuka sèmi ènu, ho dhèu aa'i-aa'i abhu hak ho paleha ja'a. dènge j'ara ne, ja'a bisa soru-bara dhèu ae, sèna ka ra madhutu ama lamatua taruu.

source_text: and i became to the yehudim as a yehudi, that i might win yehudim; to the ones under gezetz, i became as under gezetz - not being myself under the epoch of gezetz - that the ones under gezetz i might win;
target_text: de ladhe ja'a pa'èci dènge dhèu yahudi, na, ja'a tao iisi sèmi dhèu yahudi, sèna ka soru-bara dhèu yahudi ho ra tadhe lamatua. ladhe ja'a pa'èci ka dènge dhèu dhu kèpe pa'èra atora lamatua, ja'a tao madhutu atora lamatua, ho ja'a bisa soru-bara si, sèna ka ra tadhe mèu lamatua, masi ka ja'a ke'a, na, tao madhutu atora èèna, bisa boe pabe'a ja'a dènge lamatua.

source_text: to the ones without gezetz, as without gezetz, though not being without the torah of hashem but being under moshiachʼs torah, that i might win the ones without gezetz.
target_text: ladhe ja'a pakaboko dènge dhèu dhu re'a boe atora lamatua, ja'a j'aj'i sèmi rèngu ho lere kèti si asa lamatua. ja'a patabuli boe atora lamatua dhu na hia mai re musa, te ngaa ja'a mamuri pake atora kristus

source_text: i became weak to the weak ones that i might win the weak ones. i have become all things to kol bnei adam, that by all means i might save some.
target_text: dènge dhèu dhu d'ara èra boe, na, ja'a tao iisi sèmi dhèu dhu d'ara èra boe kahèi, ho ja'a bisa pamako si sèna ka mai asa ama lamatua. dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, ja'a tao iisi sèmi rèngu, sèna ka, ladhe bisa, kèti cahag'e asa madha lamatua.

source_text: and all things i do because of the besuras hageulah that a fellow partaker and deveykus sharer in it i may become.
target_text: ja'a tao j'ara aa'i-aa'i se, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa lèka lii lolo be'a lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi bisa abhu pala dhu be'a nèti madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i, dhu lamatua hia èdhi.

source_text: do you not have da'as that the ones running on a race course all indeed run, but it is only one who receives the prize? so run that you may obtain the prize.
target_text: ja'a pakasame dènge pa'uji rai. dhèu ae-ae madhutu pa'uji rai, te ngaa dhu abhu juara dhoka dhèu èci di. de miu èci-èci mi hud'i rai pa'èra-èra ku ho j'aj'i juara hia lamatua.

source_text: and everyone competing in the olympic games in all things exercises shlitah atzmi: those ones, therefore, that they may obtain a perishable wreath; but we, an imperishable.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu pa'uji, hud'i madhutu ku paredha nèti dhèu dhu aj'a rèngu, si? dhèu se sab'a bia sèmi èèna, lula neo abhu solo juara dhu bèli-camèd'a ele iie. te ngaa èdhi sab'a sèna ka abhu upa dhu taha toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: therefore, i run not as one without a goal that is kovua fixed, set. i box as not beating the air.
target_text: de ja'a rai leli boe. te ngaa ja'a tenge j'ara ho rai pa'èra-èra toke d'ai lane. ladhe pasoro ja'a sèmi dhèu tuka paj'ubhu, na, ja'a j'ubhu leli boe, te ngaa hud'i j'ubhu palèke ku.

source_text: but i do more than merely spar with my basar; i pommel it and keep it under strict subjection, so that after i am the maggid to others, i myself will not become declared ineligible.
target_text: ja'a pa'èra d'ara, aa aj'a ngi'u sèna ka bisa taha taruu. te be'a boe ladhe ja'a peka dènge dhèu leo lula-nèti ama lamatua, aa te ngaa ja'a mesa ku sisu atora, hèia lamatua kalua eele ja'a nèti d'ara pa'uji rai èèna.

source_text: i do not want you to be without da'as, achim b'moshiach, that avoteinu all were under the anancloud and passed through the sea,
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! mage miu bhèlu eele lii lolo dhu uru èèna, lod'o bèi-baki èdhi ètu era dhu dhèu pea boe. ama lamatua paj'uj'u j'ara hia rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, pake ra'i-liru dhu kako uuru nèti rèngu. aa ama lamatua hag'e eele èi dhasi, hèia ra kako d'ai cabèka dhasi dènge sod'a.

source_text: and all into moshe rabbenu were given tevilah in the anan cloud and in the sea,
target_text: dhasi dènge ra'i-liru se, nuka sèmi lii pakasame sa. te bèi-baki èdhi sèra lèka musa nuka sèmi ama ho lere si, ka ra madhutu ra'i-liru, aa maso asa d'ara dhasi palere-lere dènge ne. èèna sama sèmi èdhi dhu parcaya kristus hèia abhu sarani, dhu peka na, èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu na, aa ti nanene ne.

source_text: and all of the same spiritual okhel food ate,
target_text: bèi-baki èdhi aa'i-aa'i ra, ra'a nganga'a dhu roh lamatua sadia tèke hia ra.

source_text: and all of the same spiritual drink drank, for they were drinking from a spiritual tzur following them, and that tzur was moshiach.
target_text: aa rinu nèti èi dhu roh lamatua sadia hia ra kahèi. èi dhu rinu èèna kalua nèti hadhu aae dhu roh lamatua paj'uj'u tèke. rèngu lasi asa mia-mia èèna ka, hadhu èèna dhu ètu èèna le. madhutu iia-iia na, hadhu èèna, nuka kristus.

source_text: but hashem was not pleased with most of them, for they were strewn about in the desert, vayishchatem bamidbar then he slaughtered them in the desert.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua d'èi boe dènge tatao dhèu ae sèra. ka ropa ra kako palème era mamoo dhu taleo èèna, dhèu ae madhe. ka ra padhane si palème era.

source_text: now these things occurred as moftim examples for us, in order that we would not crave what is ra'ah as they did.
target_text: j'ara aa'i-aa'i se ho j'aj'i mi conto, sèna ka èdhi baku d'èi tao j'ara bhelu sama sèmi rèngu.

source_text: neither should you become ovdei elilim idolaters, as some of them did, as it has been written, and the people sat to eat and to drink and they got up to revel.
target_text: baku pae'a nidhu sèmi rèngu cahag'e. ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, dhu suri, peka na, dhèu isra'el madhèdi ra'a-rinu pesta ètu madha patung sapi iiki ci'u. ka ra sogo-tagu ne.

source_text: neither should we commit zenut as some of them committed zenut and fell in one day twenty-three thousand.
target_text: èdhi baku tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu-kamali boe èdhi. te uru-uru sèra, rèngu tao j'ara makae sèmi sèra ka, hèia dua nguru tèlu riho dhèu madhe ètu d'ara ca lod'o doko èèna ka.

source_text: neither let us tempt moshiach, as some of them put moshiach to the test, and by nechashim serpents were being destroyed.
target_text: èdhi baku ad'u-ue bhabhelu rupa-rupa, ho neo te'a, kristus huku èdhi, do aad'o. te dhèu isra'el cahag'e neo sèku ama lamatua sèmi èèna ka, ka na hia mege ae-ae dhu dènge raco sèna ka kadhi pamadhe si.

source_text: neither should we murmur and grumble even as some of them vayilonu and they murmured and they were destroyed by the destroyer.
target_text: èdhi baku ka'uu-kamuki kahèi. te dhèu isra'el cahag'e re'a dhoka ka'uu-kamuki di, ka ama lamatua pua ana pajuu na èci nèti sorga mai pamadhe si.

source_text: now, these things happened to those ones as moftim examples, but it was written for our admonition, to whom the kitzei haolamim has come.
target_text: j'ara ne lèke mi dhèu isra'el, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha hia mi èdhi. ra suri se'e se, ho èdhi bisa te'a, sèna ka baku tao madhutu sasala rèngu. te lod'o èle rai-haha ne dètu ae le.

source_text: so then the one that presupposes that he stands, let him take care lest he fall.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! limuri ne èu ngee, na, èu èra le. te ngaa baku pamud'e, sèna ka baku manahu.

source_text: no nissayon temptation has overtaken you, except that which is common to bnei adam, but, hashem is ne'eman faithful, who will not let you to be brought into nissayon beyond what you are able, but will make with the nissayon also the derech tzaddikim as a way out for you to be able to endure.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o ngee mèdhi neo tao bhabhelu, te ngaa sanèd'e, te dhèu leo dhu paraga rèdhi le kahèi, dadugu-rariu sèmi sèra. te ngaa èu bisa parcaya ama lamatua, sèna ka na tao madhutu ngaa dhu nèngu peka. te lamatua soro tèke boe èu ho abhu dadugu-rariu risi nèti a'èra èu. ropa èu paraga dènge dadugu-rariu, nèngu pad'elo j'ara kalua hia èu. nèngu neo pa'èra èu, ho baku manahu.

source_text: therefore, my chaverim, flee from avodah zarah.
target_text: de a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ladhe dhèu neo laka-seti miu sèna ka sogo-tagu nidhu, na, pakeso nèti era èèna! baku pamata!

source_text: i speak as to thinking men; you judge what i say.
target_text: ja'a padhai lii dènge miu dhu me'a ngee madhera. hud'i laa miu mesa mi dadoo unu mi, ngaa dhu ja'a neo peka-padhai èèna, lèke tare'a.

source_text: the kos habracha cup of blessing over which we say the bracha, is it not a mizbe'ach sharing and deveykus participation in the korban pesach death and kapporah of moshiach? the matzoh which we break, is this not a sharing and a deveykus participation in the guf hamoshiach?
target_text: pangee sèku j'ara ne: ladhe èdhi pakaboko sèna ka ta'a-tinu ètu mei ama lamatua, hèia tare galaa ho manèngi makasi mi lamatua, ka tinu nèti galaa èèna, sasoa na, èdhi dhu pa'èki dènge kristus. ropa na pasuti raa na ka na madhe, èèna sama sèmi èdhi madhutu madhe kahèi. ladhe èdhi pamae roti èèna, hèia ta'e, sasoa na, èdhi dhu pa'èki dènge kristus. de ropa kristus madhe, èèna sama sèmi èdhi kahèi madhe sama-sama dènge ne.

source_text: because the matzoh is echad, we, many as we are, are one body, one new humanity, for we all partake of the matzoh echad.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti ta'e nèti roti cue. de aa'i-aa'i dhu rare pala nèti roti cue ne, nuka sèmi èdhi dhu pa'èki j'aj'i mi ngi'u èci, masi ka èdhi dhèu ae-ae.

source_text: observe yisroel according to the basar. are not the ones eating the korbanot sacrifices partakers of the mizbe'achaltar?
target_text: pangee sèku dhèu isra'el uru sèra. ropa rèngu roro badha ètu dedha mei korban sèna ka pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, ama agama dhu roro ne ka dhu bisa na'e sisi èèna. sasoa na, rèngu pa'èki dènge lamatua, aa pa'èki kahèi dènge dhèu dhu rèti badha ho j'aj'i mi korban.

source_text: what then am i saying? that a sacrifice to an elil idol is anything or that an idol is anything? no, the things which they sacrifice, yizb'chu lashedim lo elohim they sacrificed to demons which were not g-d. now i do not want you to become sharers with the shedim demons.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a, tasamia? lod'o dhèu dhu tadhe boe lamatua neo hia mèdha-panyau rèngu j'aj'i mi mèdha sogo-tagu ra, èèna dènge boe kab'ua, do? te mèdha sogo-tagu sèra, dhoka patung dhu madhe di! aad'o! a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: lod'o dhèu roro badha ho j'aj'i badha sogo-tagu, rèngu sogo-tagu nidhu bhelu. te ngaa rèngu pahaha boe iisi mi ama lamatua dhu lèke. de ja'a ko'o boe ho miu pa'èki dènge nidhu bhelu sèmi sèra.

source_text: you are not able to drink from the kos of hashem and also from the kos hashedim; you are not able to partake of the shulchan of hashem and the shulchan of shedim demons.
target_text: ladhe miu pa'èki dènge lamatua, ka minu nèti galaa ètu mei lamatua, na, miu bisa boe pa'èci dènge nidhu bhelu sèra, aa baku minu nèti galaa dhu ra pake pae'a nidhu. te ladhe miu minu sèmi èèna, sasoa na, miu pa'èki dènge nidhu bhelu. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe mi'a ètu mei lamatua, miu bisa boe mi'a ètu mei nidhu. goa, ee! te sasoa na, miu pa'èki dènge nidhu bhelu sèra!

source_text: or is it that you would move hashem to kinah jealousy? we don't think we are stronger than he, do we?
target_text: madhutu a'abhu miu sèmi ngaa? neo papèd'a d'ara lamatua èdhi, do? èèna bahaya! ele boe miu ngee, na, miu èra risi lamatua, do?

source_text: all things are lawful? but not all things are beneficial; all things are lawful? but not all things edify.
target_text: ele boe miu pangee, na, ja'a neo tao ngaa èèna ka, bisa. te èèna hak ja'a. tare'a. te ngaa sanèd'e, tatu boe j'ara aa'i-aa'i sèra nèti babe'a hia èu. aa tatu boe j'ara aa'i-aa'i sèra, bisa soru-bara èu ho pa'èra d'ara mu.

source_text: let no one seek his own benefit but the benefit of the other.
target_text: baku tenge dhoka leto pala ngi'u èu di. be'a risi tenge oto hia dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: everything being sold in a meat market eat without raising qualms of matzpun conscience.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e: ladhe hèli sisi ètu d'ara pasa, na, mu'a laa. baku pakarèi ia ka, peka na, sisi pae'a nidhu, do? do pangee, na, ja'a bisa ku'a sisi ne, do aad'o?

source_text: for lahashem ha'aretz umeloah the earth is the l-rdʼs and the fullness thereof.
target_text: lula ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua dhu suri tèke, peka na, rai-haha dènge isi na aa'i-aa'i, unu lamatua èdhi.

source_text: if anyone of the apikorosim invites you and you want to go, eat everything being set before you without raising qualms of matzpun conscience.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu parcaya mèka kristus nèru miu, peka na, mai lati ta'a asa èmu ja'a! ladhe miu lami, na, mi'a ngaa dhu na hia miu. baku pakarèi ia ka, na, ja'a bisa ku'a nganga'a ne'e, do aad'o?

source_text: but if anyone should say to you, zeh nizbach l'elil! this is sacrificed to an idol! , do not eat out of consideration for that man who informed you and because of matzpun conscience.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhu mai paka'uu, peka na, baku mu'a ne'e ne, te sisi ne sisi sogo-tagu nidhu, be'a risi èu baku mu'a. èu hud'i taru kira ku mi dhèu dhu mai peka lii deo na, ho baku pabia ne.

source_text: but i speak not about your matzpun but about the matzpun of the other man, for why is my cherut freedom brought into mishpat judgment by anotherʼs matzpun conscience?
target_text: a'abhu ja'a, na, pangee paie-iie, madhutu ngangee dhèu deo na, bisa ku'e do aad'o. baku ngee dhoka dhu be'a madhutu ngangee èu mesa mu. aa te ngaa, ja'a bisa tao madhutu d'èi d'ara ja'a. te ngaa ladhe dhèu leo pangee, na, be'a boe ladhe nèngu ad'u-ue ca madha j'ara, nga tao ka ja'a bebas boe sa hèi tao madhutu dad'èi d'ara ja'a, lula be'a boe bagi mi dhèu leo?

source_text: if i partake with birkat hamazon grace after meals, why am i blamed for what i give todah thanks?
target_text: ladhe ja'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, hèia ja'a ku'a, na, nga tao ka dhèu padhai pamanahu ja'a?

source_text: whether, therefore, you eat or you drink or whatever you do, do all things to the kavod glory of hashem.
target_text: de miu neo mi'a do, minu do, tao ngaa èèna ka, na, tao aa'i-aa'i sèna ka pakapai kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: be without michshol both to yehudim and to yevanim and to the kehillah of hashem,
target_text: baku pasusa dhèu yahudi, do dhèu yahudi boe, do dhèu unu lamatua dhu parcaya sèra.

source_text: even as i also please bnei adam in all things, not seeking my own advantage but that of the many, that they may be brought to yeshu'at eloheinu.
target_text: tao nuka sèmi ja'a tao. te ja'a neo cob'a pakarej'e si ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. ja'a mesa boe tao dhu be'a hia ja'a di, te ngaa neo tao dhu be'a bagi rèngu aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka rèngu abhu sod'a kahèi.

source_text: become imitators of me as i also am an imitator of moshiach.
target_text: miu ladhe mi ja'a, aa tao madhutu j'ara mamuri ja'a. te ja'a ladhe mi kristus, aa tao madhutu tatao nèngu.

source_text: now, i commend you that in all things you have remembered me and you hold fast to the masoret torat hashlichim just as i transmitted and handed them over to you.
target_text: ja'a koa-kad'iri miu, lula tasamia èèna ka miu sanèd'e taruu ja'a. aa j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a aj'a-nori le miu, miu tao madhutu era. be'a titu kèna!

source_text: but i want you to have da'as that rebbe, melech hamoshiach is the rosh head of every one of the bnei adam, and the rosh of an isha is the ben adam man, ba'al, and the rosh of moshiach is hashem.
target_text: te ngaa ca j'ara dhu ja'a neo pasanèd'e miu nuka: baku bhèlu j'aj'aj'i miu nèti mia. dhèu mone dhu parcaya sèra, kèni na nèti kristus, dhu j'aj'i kètu ra. dhèu bhèni j'aj'i nèti dhèu mone. aa kristus mai nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: every ben adam davening or speaking forth a nevu'ah prophecy having anything hanging down over his rosh brings bushah shame upon his rosh.
target_text: dhèu mone baku pahutu kètu na lod'o nèngu manèngi-mangaj'i, do, ropa na peka-padhai lii moa lamatua. te èèna sama sèmi nèngu pamakae kristus, lula ne'a boe pakab'ua madhutu ad'a èdhi.

source_text: but every isha davening or speaking forth a nevu'ah prophecy in shul, begile rosh with head uncovered, brings bushah shame upon her rosh, for it is one and the same thing to uncover the rosh as it is for the rosh of the isha having been shaved.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni hud'i pahutu kètu na lod'o sabaj'a, do ropa nèngu lole lii moa lamatua. te ladhe aad'o na, èèna sama sèmi nèngu pamakae dhèu èmu na, lula ne'a boe pakab'ua madhutu ad'a èdhi. aa nèngu pamakae ngi'u nèngu unu na, nuka sèmi dhèu bhèni dhu lusu pakahoni kètu na.

source_text: for, if an isha is not covered, also let her be shorn. but als since it is in fact a thing of bushah shame for an isha to be shorn or to be shaved, let her be covered.
target_text: te ladhe abhu dhèu bhèni dhu d'èi boe pahutu kètu na, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha nèngu pakab'ua dhèu èmu na, be'a risi nèngu g'ute pabab'a rèu kètu na. te ngaa ladhe nèngu rasa kètu na kahoni pamakae nèngu, hua iia nèngu pahutu kètu na.

source_text: for a ben adam indeed ought not to be covered on the rosh, being the demut hashem and the kavod hashem, and the isha being the kavod glory, the glorious reflection of adam.
target_text: ngee sèku sèmi ne'e: dhèu mone parluu boe hutu kètu na, te ama lamatua paj'aj'i dhèu mone madhutu raropa na. nèti èèna ka, dhèu mone j'aj'i mi hua-hela dhu pad'elo dadedha ama lamatua. aa dhèu bhèni kahèi j'aj'i mi hua-hela dhu pad'elo dadedha dhèu mone.

source_text: for adam is not out of the isha but isha out of adam man.
target_text: te lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i rai-haha ne, na tao boe dhèu mone nèti dhèu bhèni. te ngaa paj'aj'i dhèu bhèni nèti dhèu mone.

source_text: indeed, adam was not created because of the isha, but the isha because of adam man.
target_text: aa lamatua tao boe dhèu mone hia mi dhèu bhèni. te ngaa na pangèd'u dhèu bhèni mi dhèu mone.

source_text: because of this, the isha ought to have a kesut rosh head covering of marut authority, discipline on her rosh because of the malachim.
target_text: de hua iia risi dhèu bhèni pahutu kètu ho dhèu re'a, na, nèngu pake hak na ho sabaj'a aa lole lii moa lamatua, madhutu j'ara dhu lèke. ana pajuu nèti sorga re'a sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: however, neither is isha without adam man nor adam man without isha in hashem.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe rèngu pa'èki dènge lamatua, bhèni dènge mone bisa boe èci-èci ka tao unu na.

source_text: for just as the isha comes out of adam man, so also the ben adam man comes through the isha but all things are of hashem.
target_text: ama lamatua paj'aj'i uuru ku dhèu mone. hèia na paj'aj'i dhèu bhèni nèti dhèu mone. te ngaa èle èèna ka, dhèu bhèni ka dhu nara iisi dhèu mone. aa ama lamatua ka dhu tao aa'i-aa'i, j'aj'i.

source_text: you yourselves be the dayan judge: is it fitting for an isha to offer tefillos to hashem begile rosh with head uncovered?
target_text: miu pangee sèku! ladhe dhèu bhèni pahutu boe kètu ho sabaj'a mi ama lamatua, madhutu a'abhu miu, na, be'a, do aad'o?

source_text: does not teva nature itself give you the shiur lesson that if a ben adam wears a long hair-do of a ladyʼs coiffure, it is a dishonor to him?
target_text: madhutu ad'a miu ètu kota korintus, ladhe dhèu mone rèu kètu madhera, èèna pamakae nèngu, do?

source_text: but if an isha wears a long hairdo of a ladyʼs coiffure, it is her kavod? because the long hair has been given to her instead of the sterntichel kerchief or kesut rosh head covering.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni dhu rèu kètu na madhera, be'a titu kèna, si? lamatua hia ne rèu kètu madhera ho pa'abhe kab'a kètu na. èèna ka dhu lèke mola-mola.

source_text: but if anyone presumes in his thinking to be contentious, we have no such minhag, nor do the kehillot of hashem.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhu loe boe pakarèi nèti j'ara ne'e, sanèd'e, te nèti ji'i dhu j'aj'i kètu juma'at, aa nèti juma'at-juma'at, ne'e ne dhu tema le j'aj'i ètu talora èdhi.

source_text: but in giving the divrei torah that follows i give no commendation, because when you assemble as the shul of moshiach, it is not for the better that you assemble, but for the worse.
target_text: limuri ne, ja'a neo padhai lii ca j'ara. te ngaa lii ne koa-kad'iri boe miu. te ropa miu pakaboko, miu tao boe j'ara dhu lèke, te ngaa miu asa tao maruru.

source_text: ershtins first of all, indeed when you come together as the kehillah i hear there exist machlokotdivisions and schisms among you, and partly i believe it.
target_text: partama, dhu ja'a tadèngi, na, lod'o miu pakaboko tao kasasi, miu dhu mae-manyèla. nèti lii dhu ja'a tadèngi sèra, tatu abhu cahag'e dhu lèke tare'a.

source_text: for it is necessary also for kitot sects of minut heresy, of kefirah heresy, denial to be among you that also the approved ones may become manifest among you.
target_text: mema, lula mamae-manyèla miu èèna ka, bisa te'a cee ka dhu tare'a-re'a nanene lamatua èdhi, aa mia dhu nanene boe.

source_text: therefore, your farbrengen gatherings in one kahal community are not for the purpose of having moshiachʼs tish.
target_text: te lod'o miu dhèu sarani pakaboko ho mi'a ètu mei lamatua, miu hud'i sanèd'e ku mi lamatua yesus. èèna ka dhu lèke. te ngaa miu tao boe sèmi èèna.

source_text: for each one rushes ahead with his own seudah meal. one is hungerik hungry, one has passed out in his schnapps.
target_text: tadha na, nuka ropa miu madhèdi mi'a, abhu dhu mate boe dhèu leo, abhu dhu ra'a dènge gagoo, aa abhu leo dhu rinu mahu. toke abhu dhèu cahag'e dhu abhu boe pala, ka ra manganga.

source_text: hey, you people, do you not have houses in which to eat and to drink? or do you despise the kehillah congregation of g-d? and do you bring bushah shame, even humiliation, on the ones having nothing? what should i say to you? will i commend you? in this i do not commend you people!
target_text: tasamia ka ne! ? miu dènge boe èmu ho mi'a-minu, do? do, miu neo pa'ele iie kolongara juma'at lamatua? do, miu neo pamakae dhèu dhu unu aad'o sèra? miu neo ja'a padhai lii tasamia hari? neo sèna ka ja'a koa-kad'iri miu ètu d'ara tatao miu ne, do? baku maena!

source_text: for i received from rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu that which also i transmitted and handed on to you, that adoneinu yehoshua, on the very lailah night in which he was betrayed, took the pesach matzoh,
target_text: lamatua yesus ka dhu peka unu na dènge ja'a j'ara ne, de ja'a peka hari dènge miu. peka na, ropa dhèu pa'èra neo pamadhe ne, mèda èèna nèngu nare roti cue.

source_text: and, having made the hamotzi, rebbe, melech hamoshiach offered the betzi'at halechem breaking of the bread and said, zeh hu vesari hannivtza ba'adchem; zot asu l'zikroni. this is my flesh, which is broken on your behalf. do this in memory of me.
target_text: hèia na sabaj'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, mi'a roti ne, te ne'e ne ngi'u ja'a, dhu mae hia miu. de miu hud'i mi'a roti ne, sèna ka sanèd'e ja'a.

source_text: in like manner, after eating the pesach seudah, also after the bracha over the kiddush cup, rebbe, melech hamoshiach said, this kos cup is the brit chadasha in my dahm blood. this do, as often as you drink, in zikaronremembrance of me.
target_text: ropa ra'a rare, na tao sèmi èèna kahèi dènge galaa dhu isi èi anggor, aku nèngu na, èi anggor ne, sasoa na, ama lamatua neo pa'èki lii padhadha hiu dènge miu. ka ja'a hud'i pasuti raa ja'a toke madhe, heka lii padhadha èèna j'aj'i. lod'o-lod'o miu minu èi anggor sèmi ne'e, miu hud'i ngee mèdhi ku mamadhe ja'a.

source_text: for as often as you eat this pesach matzoh and drink from this pesach kiddush cup, you do proclaim the mavet of rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu until the bias hamoshiach.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o miu tao j'ara sèmi ne'e, ho mi'a roti dènge minu nèti galaa sèmi ne'e, toke kristus lèpa hari mai, èèna nuka sèmi miu palolo hari mamadhe na.

source_text: therefore, whoever eats the pesach matzoh or drinks the kiddush cup of adoneinu unworthily will be guilty and answerable for the basar and the dahm of adoneinu.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, lod'o dhèu ra'a roti dènge rinu nèti galaa èèna, sèna ka sanèd'e kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu d'ara na mola boe dènge dhèu leo, èèna na ama lamatua huku ne. lula, èèna ngi'u dènge raa nèti lamatua yesus. de ladhe d'ara dhu mola mèka, na, nèngu nia boe na'a dènge ninu, lula j'ara èèna pahahe lamatua yesus.

source_text: but let a ben adam apply cheshbon hanefesh to himself and in that manner let him eat of the pesach matzoh and let him drink of the pesach kiddush cup.
target_text: be'a risi ca dhèu-dhèu ka parisa uuru ku d'ara na. ladhe d'ara na dhu mola le, heka bisa na'a roti aa ninu èi anggor kèna.

source_text: for the one eating and drinking is the one eating and drinking mishpat to himself when not discerning the basar body.
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhu ra'a dènge rinu dhu d'ara ra koe-kapengo. te ra pangee, na, mamadhe yesus èèna, dènge boe kab'ua. ngi'u yesus dènge boe sasoa bagi mi ja'a. dhèu sèmi se'e se, bèli-camèd'a dui rare pala ra, lula hahuku dhu sadia tèke le.

source_text: because of this, many among you are weak and there are cholim sick and a number are sleeping the sleep of the mesim.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ètu talora aae miu sèra, abhu dhu èra boe, abhu dhu lèke papèd'a-tarègu, aa abhu dhu madhe le.

source_text: but if we were judging ourselves, we would not be brought into mishpat judgment.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi parisa paie-iie d'ara èdhi, èdhi abhu boe huku sèmi sèra.

source_text: but, being brought into mishpat judgment by hashem, we are being disciplined, that we may not be condemned with the olam hazeh.
target_text: ladhe lamatua èdhi huku èdhi, na tao sèmi èèna sèna ka aj'a-nori èdhi ho èdhi madhutu j'ara dhu lèke. te nèngu d'èi boe ladhe èdhi lèke huku sama sèmi dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: therefore, achim b'moshiach of mine, when you have your farbrengen gatherings and you gather for tish, wait for one another.
target_text: de a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ladhe miu pakaboko ho mi'a-minu ètu mei lamatua, èci hud'i mate ku èci.

source_text: if anyone is so hungerikhungry that he cannot wait, in his home let him eat, lest for mishpat you have kehillah. and as far as the hemshech remaining part is concerned, whenever i come i will set b'seder in order.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhu taha boe manganga, be'a risi mi'a uuru ku ètu èmu, sèna ka ropa miu pakaboko pa'èci, baku abhu dhu lèke huku. j'ara leo dhu miu karèi sèra, pe ja'a dhiu ku, heka ator si kèna.

source_text: now i do not want you to lack da'as concerning the things of the ruach hakodesh, achim b'moshiach.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! dad'èi ja'a ka ladhe miu me'a mèu nèti koasa dènge karunya dhu roh lamatua pangèd'u mi èdhi, sèna ka èdhi pake.

source_text: you have da'as that when you were goyim, somehow you were influenced and led astray to the elilim illemim dumb idols, idols incapable of speech.
target_text: miu dhu me'a, na, lod'o miu dhae j'aj'i mèka dhèu unu lamatua, miu sogo-tagu mèdha dhu lii aad'o sèra. miu madhutu rèngu iia-iia d'ara.

source_text: therefore, i make known to you that no one speaking by the ruach hakodesh of hashem says, al yehoshua ki cherem hu a curse of the ban of destruction is on yehoshua, and no one is able to say, yehoshua hu haadon except by the ruach hakodesh.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo ho miu me'a, na, tatu boe abhu dhèu dhu pa'èki dènge roh mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, dhoo-saseo yesus èèna! aa tatu dhèu dhu pa'èki boe dènge roh mola-mèci ama lamatua peka na, yesus èèna, lamatua ja'a!

source_text: there are different kinds of matanot gifts, but the same ruach hakodesh.
target_text: roh lamatua hia mi dhèu èci-èci ka dènge karunya na, sèna ka èci-èci dènge sasab'a-la'a ra. te ngaa karunya sèra mai nèti roh èci di.

source_text: there are different avodot hakodesh ministries, but the one adonoi.
target_text: dhèu abhu karunya rupa-rupa ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu leo, te ngaa rèngu nanene dhoka lamatua èci di.

source_text: and there are a variety of activities of the ruach hakodesh, but the same g-d working all in all.
target_text: dhèu unu rupa-rupa sasab'a sèna ka pakako sasab'a lamatua, èèna j'aj'i lula ama lamatua di dhu soru-bara rèngu ho ra pakako sasab'a-la'a sèra aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: but to each is given the disclosure of the ruach hakodesh for benefit:
target_text: ama lamatua pad'elo roh na mi mamuri dhèu dènge j'ara dhu baka-leo hua, te ngaa dad'èi na sèna ka aa'i-aa'i ra sama-sama abhu babe'a.

source_text: to one through the ruach hakodesh is given a dvar chochmah a dvar of wisdom; to another, according to the same ruach hakodesh, a dvar da'as word of knowledge;
target_text: lamatua pangèd'u koasa roh na mi dhèu unu na. ka cahag'e abhu koasa, sèna ka ngangee madhera ho nori dhu lèke. cahag'e abhu koasa ho peka paled'a ngaa dhu rèngu re'a dènge be'a.

source_text: to another, by the same ruach hakodesh, emunah faith; to another, by the one ruach hakodesh, matanot harippuy gifts of healing;
target_text: cahag'e hari abhu koasa sèna ka parcaya pa'èra mi ama lamatua, lula rèngu dhu pa'èki pa'èra dènge roh na. cahag'e hari abhu koasa ho puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a.

source_text: to another those of cholel niflaot accomplishing miracles. and to another divrei hanevu'ah words of prophecy, and to another discernings being about to make a nafka mina distinction of ruchot spirits, to another kinds of leshonot tongues, and to another, pitronim interpretations of leshonot tongues.
target_text: cahag'e hari abhu koasa sèna ka tao tadha-tadha malaa dhu pad'elo dadedha ama lamatua. cahag'e hari lole lii moa lamatua mi dhèu unu na. cahag'e abhu koasa sèna ka re'a, roh mia ka mai nèti ama lamatua, aa mia ka dhu aad'o. cahag'e hari, abhu koasa ho bisa padhai lii pake lii leo. aa cahag'e hari, bisa peka sasoa nèti lii sèra.

source_text: all these things are activated by the one and same ruach hakodesh, distributing individually to each one as he determines.
target_text: te ngaa dhodhoka roh èci di dhu bisa tao rèngu, sèna ka bisa pakako sasab'a-la'a ra. nèngu ne'e ka dhu pangèd'u mi dhèu èci-èci, ka rèngu bisa sab'a madhutu dad'èi roh lamatua èèna.

source_text: for even as the body is echad, and has many evarim members, and all the evarim members of the body, though many, are one body, so is moshiach.
target_text: ja'a neo pasoro karunya sèra dènge ngi'u dhèu. ngi'u èci, te ngaa bagian na ae-ae. te ngaa bagian se, pa'èki j'aj'i ngi'u èci di. ne'e nuka sèmi dhèu unu kristus sèra.

source_text: for also in one ruach hakodesh we were all given mikveh tevilah into one body, whether yehudim or yevanim greeks, whether avadim slaves or bnei chorin freedman, and all were given to drink, as it were, from one ruach hakodesh.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti pa'èki dènge roh èci di. nèti èèna ka, lod'o èdhi abhu sarani, èdhi nuka sèmi ca suku. masi ka èdhi dhèu yahudi, do dhèu yahudi boe, ènu do dhèu bebas, ama lamatua pala hia èdhi roh èci di. èèna nuka sèmi tinu èi dhu hia mamuri nèti madha èi èci di.

source_text: for the body is not one, but many evarim members.
target_text: tare'a, ngi'u ne nèti boe ca bagian di. te na j'aj'i nèti bagian ae-ae.

source_text: if the regel foot says, because i am not a yad hand, i am not of the body, that would not make it any less one of the evarim of the body.
target_text: ladhe sèmi haga èu, peka na, ja'a ne, kacui-aai boe. de ja'a j'aj'i boe bagian nèti ngi'u èu. masi ka nèngu peka sèmi èèna, te ngaa nèngu j'aj'i bagian nèti ngi'u èu era. tare'a, si?

source_text: and if the ozen ear says, because i am no ayin eye, i am not of the body, that would not make it any less one of the evarim of the body.
target_text: aa ladhe dhilu èu peka na, ja'a ne, musi madha boe. de ja'a ne j'aj'i boe bagian nèti ngi'u èu. masi ka na peka sèmi èèna, te ngaa nèngu bagian nèti ngi'u èu kahèi.

source_text: if the whole body were an ayin eye, where would be the hearing? if the whole body were hearing, where would be the smelling?
target_text: pangee sèku! ladhe ngi'u èu dhoka musi madha di, tasamia èu bisa tadèngi? aa ladhe ngi'u èu dhoka rèu dhilu di, tasamia ho èu bisa sangèd'u?

source_text: but now hashem set the evarim members, each one of them, in the body according to his ratzon will, as he wanted.
target_text: te ngaa miu me'a le, ama lamatua tao èdhi j'aj'i mi èci sama sèmi ngi'u èci, ka nèngu ator bagian se madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: and if all were all one evar member, where would the body be?
target_text: ladhe ngi'u ne dhoka ca bagian di, ngara na ‘ngi'u' boe, sina ma?

source_text: as it is, though there are many evarim members, there is but one body.
target_text: te dhu lèke ka, ngi'u èdhi ne, dènge bagian ae-ae. se'e ka tao ne j'aj'i ngi'u kateme aae.

source_text: and the ayin eye is not able to say to the yad hand, i do not have need of you. or, again, the rosh head, speaking to the raglayim feet, is not to say, i have no need of you.
target_text: musi madha bisa boe pahahe kacui-aai, dhu peka na, ja'a parluu boe èu! aa kètu bisa boe peka dènge haga na, ja'a dale boe èu!

source_text: just the opposite, the evarim of the body appearing to be weaker are vital.
target_text: dhu lèke mola-mola ka, nuka, abhu bagian nèti ngi'u dhu roe, aa dhu dènge kab'ua ae boe, te ngaa èdhi parluu rèngu kahèi.

source_text: and those evarim of the body which we presume to be dishonorable, on these we clothe with even more honor, and our parts with lesser kibbud respect, honor are treated with greater.
target_text: abhu bagian dhu èdhi pangee, na, rèngu se gaguna ra ae boe, te ngaa èdhi haduli si paie-iie. aa abhu bagian dhu èdhi makae pacèu, ka pahutu pabe'a-be'a.

source_text: whereas, our evarim with greater kibbud have no need of more. however, hashem has so composed the achdus yichudim unit, harmony of unifications of the body, giving the superior kibbud to the inferior,
target_text: te ngaa bagian dhu pamakae boe èdhi, èdhi tao boe si ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa ama lamatua oru nare bagian aa'i-aa'i se ho j'aj'i mi ngi'u èci. ka nèngu ator sèna ka bagian dhu èdhi pangee, na, dhu dènge boe kab'ua, èdhi ladhe-leru si be'a-be'a,

source_text: lest there be schisms in the body. but the evarim should have the same gemilut chasadim deeds of lovingkindness and caring for one another.
target_text: te lamatua d'èi boe ngi'u èdhi pahag'a. dad'èi na sèna ka bagian se èci soru-bara èci.

source_text: and when one evar member has tza'ar pain and suffering, all the evarim members have tza'ar with it; or one evar has the aliyah of kibbud, all the evarim has simcha with it.
target_text: te ladhe bagian èci paraga dènge susa, na, aa'i-aa'i ra susa kahèi. aa ladhe ra pakab'ua èci, na, aa'i-aa'i karej'e kahèi.

source_text: now you are moshiachʼs body and individually evarim of it.
target_text: èci èèna ka dènge miu. te miu sama sèmi ngi'u kristus dhu kateme. dhèu parcaya èci-èci nuka sèmi ca bagian nèti ngi'u kristus.

source_text: now hashem placed some in the adat hamoshiach community of moshiach, in the kehillah, rishon first: shlichim, second, nevi'im, third, morim teachers, then those of cholel nifla'aot accomplishing miracles, then matanot harippuy gifts of healing, then matanot of helps, then manhigut ruchanit spiritual leadership, administration, kinds of leshonot.
target_text: te ètu talora miu dhèu parcaya, ama lamatua hia koasa sèna ka pakako rupa-rupa sasab'a, nuka: partama, lamatua pua-paleha dhèu cahag'e ho lasi lole lii moa na. ka dua, na pake dhèu cahag'e, j'aj'i dhèu rèti lii padhai nèngu. ka tèlu, na hia dhèu cahag'e d'èlu-mèu ho aj'a-nori dhèu leo lula-nèti nèngu. aa na hia koasa mi dhèu cahag'e, sèna ka bisa tao tadha-tadha malaa ho pad'elo dadedha na. cahag'e hari abhu koasa ho puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a. cahag'e hari abhu karunya ho soru-bara dhèu. cahag'e hari abhu karunya sèna ka uri dhèu ho sab'a sama-sama dènge be'a. aa lamatua pangèd'u koasa mi dhèu cahag'e hari, ho bisa padhai pake rupa-rupa lii.

source_text: surely not all are shlichim? surely not all are nevi'im? surely not all are rabbinical morim? surely not all are those cholel nifa'ot accomplishing miracles?
target_text: de ngangee miu tasamia? ama lamatua pua dhèu aa'i-aa'i ho lasi peka-padhai lii moa na, do? aad'o. na hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i mi dhèu rèti lii padhai na, do? aad'o. na hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i d'èlu-mèu ho aj'a-nori, do? aad'o. na hia koasa mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka tao tadha-tadha malaa, do? aad'o.

source_text: surely not all have matanot harippuy gifts of healing? surely not all speak in leshonot? surely not all have the pitron interpretation of leshonot?
target_text: na hia koasa mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèna ka puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a, do? aad'o. na hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ho bisa padhai pake rupa-rupa lii, do? aad'o. na hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i, ho bisa bhoke paled'a sasoa nèti lii se'e, do? aad'o.

source_text: but earnestly desire the greater matanot gifts of the ruach hakodesh. and yet now i show you a more feste derech.
target_text: de miu hud'i bori mema-mema ho sèmi mere aa pake karunya dènge be'a dhu hia gaguna mi dhèu ae. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ja'a neo pad'elo j'ara dhu hua iia risi hia miu.

source_text: if in the leshonot of bnei adam and malachim i speak, but i do not have ahavah, i have become only a sounding gong or a clanging cymbal.
target_text: ladhe sèmi ja'a bisa padhai lii pake lii aa'i-aa'i, nèti dhèu rai-haha do, lii nèti ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga, te ngaa dènge boe sasue ciki sa ètu d'ara ja'a, kolo-karisi na ngaa? lii padhai ja'a sèra mola mèu lao, sama sèmi babha dhu lii cère-cère, do nuka sèmi dere dhu lii dhèru-dhèru di.

source_text: and if i have nevu'ah and have da'as of all sodot and all da'as, and if i have all emunah so as to remove mountains, but ahavah i do not have, i am nothing.
target_text: ladhe sèmi ja'a dènge karunya ho lole peka lii moa lamatua mi dhèu unu na, aa dhu ke'a aa'i rahasia, dènge ke'a aa'i j'ara-j'ara dhu dhèu d'èlu-mèu se re'a, aa ladhe lalèka ja'a èra mi lamatua toke ja'a bisa pahari eele ledhe nèti era na, te ngaa ja'a dènge boe sasue ciki sa, na, gaguna na ngaa? rui-j'aj'èra ja'a guna boe mi ngaa èci sa.

source_text: and if i'm a marbitz tzedaka and give all i possess in gemilut chasadim and if i give my body al kiddush hashem for sereifah death by burning, but ahavah i do not have, i have gained nothing.
target_text: ladhe ja'a pahie eele aa'i mèdha-panyau ja'a, ho sèna ka kab'ua ra panga'a dhèu unu aad'o, do, soro ngi'u ja'a sèna ka j'aj'i mi korban, te ngaa ladhe ja'a dènge boe sasue ciki sa, gaguna na ngaa? ja'a dènge boe j'ara dhu tao ja'a nged'e. te sèra sa parcuma! guna boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: ahavah suffers long; ahavah is kind; ahavah does not have kinah; ahavah does not brag; ahavah is not puffed up in ga'avah conceit, pride;
target_text: te sasue èèna, d'ara taleo. sasue èèna, lii mako. sasue èèna, d'ara kura boe. sasue èèna, padedha boe iisi. sasue èèna, pamone-pabhèni boe.

source_text: ahavah does not behave shamelessly; ahavah does not in anochiyut insist on its own way; ahavah is not touchy and vindictive, keeping a record of wrongs.
target_text: sasue èèna, lii sakaa boe. sasue èèna, neo boe pasegi ngi'u unu na. sasue èèna, nasa malai boe. sasue èèna, tèka boe d'ara.

source_text: ahavah does not find simcha in evil, but rejoices in haemes.
target_text: sasue èèna, karej'e dènge ngaa dhu lèke, aa d'èi boe bia ca bèka.

source_text: ahavah covers all things, believes all things, has tikvah hope, even savlanut, for all things.
target_text: sasue èèna, taha taruu ètu d'ara madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i. sasue èèna, parcaya taruu. sasue èèna, sanao-maena taruu. sasue èèna, ma'ète boe.

source_text: ahavah never fails. however, divrei nevu'ah will be abolished; leshonot will cease; da'as will come to an end.
target_text: sasue dènge boe too-lane. te, ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua peka le, nèbhu-nèbhu parluu heka. aa dhu dhèu padhai pake lii rupa-rupa, bèli-camèd'a parluu heka kahèi. aa ladhe ngaa dhu dhèu d'èlu-mèu sèra re'a, nèbhu-nèbhu guna heka kahèi.

source_text: for we have da'as in part, and we have divrei nevu'ah is part.
target_text: limuri ne dhu te'a dhoka ciki oo'e di. aa ladhe èdhi j'aj'i dhèu tèti lii padhai lamatua, èdhi peka dhoka j'ara dhu dhae tesa mèka.

source_text: but when shleimah completion comes, the teilvaiz partial will disappear.
target_text: te ngaa ropa d'ai ka lod'o na, aa'i-aa'i sèra tesa dhe'i-dhe'i. lod'o èèna j'ara-j'ara dhu tesa mèka, guna heka mi ngaa èci sa.

source_text: when i was a yeled, i used to speak like one, think like one, reason like one. but when i became mevugar mature, i put away kinderyohrn.
target_text: conto sèmi: lod'o ja'a ana iiki era, ja'a padhai lii sama sèmi ana iiki. ngangee ja'a sama sèmi mia dhu ana iiki pangee. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a dhèu ee'a le. nèti èèna ka, tatao ja'a sèmi heka ana iiki.

source_text: for still we see through a mirror indistinctly. but then, distinctly, panim el panim. now i have da'as only in part; then i will have da'as fully, even as also hashem had full da'as of me.
target_text: conto leo: limuri ne, èdhi tèdhi rango-rango era, dhae mèu iia mèka, nuka sèmi èdhi ladhe asa d'ara tèru dhu ahu. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu pe aa'i-aa'i se mèu aadha-aadha, nuka sèmi èdhi ladhe padètu iiki-iiki ètu madha èdhi. ne'e ne, ja'a ke'a dhoka ciki di. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu bisa ke'a aa'i, nuka sèmi ama lamatua ladhe madhore d'ai adhe-usu ja'a.

source_text: but now remain emunah, tikvah, and ahavah, these shalosh three. and the greatest of these is ahavah.
target_text: de limuri ne, abhu tèlu j'ara dhu èdhi hud'i tao, dhu taha taruu. nuka: èdhi hud'i parcaya taruu lamatua; èdhi sanao-maena taruu, na, pe lamatua ator aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i be'a; aa èdhi hud'i pasue taruu. nèti tèlu j'ara se, dhu dedha risi ka, sasue. lula sasue ka dhu hua risi nèti aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: pursue ahavah agape, and eagerly desire the things of the ruach hakodesh matanot haruach hakodesh, and especially that you may speak forth a dvar hanevu'ah word of prophecy.
target_text: tenge j'ara sèna ka pasue ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. te abhu heka j'ara leo dhu dedha risi. aa tenge j'ara kahèi, sèna ka roh lamatua hia miu koasa dènge karunya, ho bisa tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. aa dhu be'a, nuka, ladhe miu abhu karunya sèna ka lole lii moa lamatua.

source_text: for the one speaking in a lashon tongue speaks not to bnei adam but to hashem; for no one grasps with their ears, but the speaker by the ruach hakodesh speaks sodot mysteries.
target_text: te ladhe dhèu dhu abhu karunya ho padhai lii pake lii leo, roh lamatua hia ne koasa sèna ka peka paled'a j'ara dhu mèu iia mèka. te ngaa nèngu padhai lii boe dènge dhèu leo, te padhai lii dhoka dènge lamatua di. dhèu dhu pa'èci dènge ne ètu sèra, abhu boe èci sa dhu re'a lii padhai nèngu.

source_text: however, the one speaking forth divrei nevu'ah words of prophecy speaks to bnei adam for chizzuk strengthening and musar encouragement and nechamah comfort.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu abhu karunya ho lole lii moa lamatua, na, nèngu peka lii moa ne mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu sèra. nèngu pa'èra ku parcaya dhèu mi lamatua, pa'èra d'ara dhèu, aa pakarej'e d'ara dhèu susa.

source_text: the one speaking in a lashon tongue edifies himself; but, the one speaking forth a dvar hanevu'ah word of prophecy edifies kehillah.
target_text: dhèu dhu padhai lii pake lii leo, nèngu pa'èra dhoka ngi'u nèngu mesa na di. te ngaa dhèu dhu padhue-padhai lii moa lamatua èèna, nèngu pa'èra dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pakaboko dènge ne, sèna ka juma'at kateme asa tabha èra.

source_text: now i desire all of you to speak in leshonot tongues, and even more that you may speak forth a dvar hanevu'ah word of prophecy. now greater is the one speaking forth a dvar nevu'ah word of prophecy than the one speaking in leshonot, unless he gives the pitron interpretation of the leshonot tongues, that the kehillah congregation may receive the edification.
target_text: dad'èi ja'a, ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa padhai lii pake lii leo. te ngaa ja'a d'èi risi, ladhe miu bisa lole lii moa lamatua. te dhèu dhu peka lii moa lamatua èèna, guna risi nèti dhèu dhu dhoka padhai pake lii leo di. ladhe padhai pake lii leo, èèna be'a, sad'i abhu dhèu dhu bisa peka paled'a sasoa na. dènge sèmi èèna, lii moa sèra bisa asa pa'èra dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu juma'at, sèna ka re'a mèu.

source_text: but now, achim b'moshiach, if i come to you speaking in leshonot tongues, what will i benefit you unless i speak to you either with a dvar hisgalus a word of revelation or with a dvar da'as or with a dvar nevu'ah or with a dvar hora'ah word of teaching?
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! pangee sèku j'ara ne. ladhe sèmi ja'a dhiu ngad'o miu ho padhai pake lii dhu miu me'a boe sasoa na, miu abhu oto na ngaa? aad'o, si? te ngaa ladhe ja'a padhai lii dènge miu, be'a risi ja'a peka dènge miu dad'èi lamatua. be'a risi ja'a bhoke paled'a j'ara-j'ara dhu uru èèna mèu iia mèka. be'a risi ja'a aj'a-nori miu ho me'a mèu risi hari j'ara sèra. be'a risi ja'a pasanèd'e miu lii holo-nori lamatua. be'a risi aj'a-nori miu. dènge j'ara sèmi sèra, heka miu abhu oto kèna, si?

source_text: so even lifeless things, like the flute or harp, if they do not articulate a distinction in the notes, how will it be known what is being played on the flute or on the harp?
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge alat musiik. se'e se mèdha madhe, te ngaa lii ra rupa-rupa. pake sakino do, sasadhu do, gitar do, ladhe pangèci boe lii na, tatu dhèu re'a boe lii sod'a sèmi ngaa, si?

source_text: indeed, if a shofar gives an unclear trumpet call, who will prepare himself for krav battle?
target_text: ladhe lii tèbhe mèu iia boe, na, tasa mera mia sordad'u bisa re'a, na, rèngu hud'i tao ngaa mi musu ra? bisa boe, si?

source_text: so also unless you by your lashon tongue render an intelligible dvar torah, how will the thing being uttered be known? for you will be merely speaking into the air.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. ladhe miu padhai lii, pake lii dhu dhèu bisa boe re'a mèu, èèna nuka sèmi miu padhai lii dènge lai ngèlu. parcuma, te dhèu bisa boe dhane rare lii padhai èu!

source_text: there are doubtless many kinds of foreign languages in the olam hazeh, and not one is meaningless.
target_text: ètu rai-haha ne abhu lii ae titu kèna. lii se, èci-èci ka dènge sasoa na.

source_text: if, therefore, i do not have da'as of the meaning of the language, i will be to the speaker a foreigner and the speaker will be a foreigner to me.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ja'a ke'a boe lii dhèu leo, bagi ja'a lii ne dènge boe kab'ua. ja'a ke'a boe lii rèngu, aa rèngu re'a boe lii ja'a kahèi. ji'i baga taa, aa j'aj'i sèmi dhèu leo rai kara sa.

source_text: so also you, als since you have a zeal for the matanot of the ruach hakodesh, endeavor to abound in them for the edification of the kehillah congregation.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. miu neo abhu karunya dènge koasa nèti lamatua. èèna be'a. te ngaa be'a risi ladhe miu tenge j'ara ho abhu koasa dènge karunya dhu miu bisa pake sèna ka pa'èra dhèu parcaya sèra!

source_text: therefore, the speaker in a lashon tongue, let him offer tefillos that he may give the pitron interpretation.
target_text: de dhèu dhu padhai pake lii leo, be'a risi nèngu sabaj'a manèngi sèna ka lamatua hia ne karunya kahèi, ho peka sasoa nèti lii leo èèna.

source_text: for if i daven pray in a lashon, my nashamah davens, but my sikhliyut rationality lies shemitah fallow.
target_text: ladhe ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i pake lii leo, ja'a sabaj'a pake d'ara ja'a, te ngaa ja'a ke'a boe ngaa dhu ja'a padhai lii èèna.

source_text: nu? well? i will daven in leshonot with my nashamah, and i will daven also with my seichel; i will sing in leshonot with my nashamah, and i will sing niggunim also with my seichel.
target_text: de babe'a na, ja'a tao tasamia? ja'a pake dua-dua, te ngaa èci-èci ka dènge lod'o na. ja'a neo manèngi-mangaj'i pake d'ara ja'a, aa ja'a neo manèngi-mangaj'i pake lii dhu ke'a mèu kahèi. ja'a neo sod'a pake lii sod'a koa-kio mi lamatua nèti d'ara ja'a. aa ja'a bisa sod'a kahèi, pake lii dhu ja'a ke'a mèu.

source_text: otherwise, if you make a bracha in leshonot with your neshamah, how will the am ha'aretz, who have no idea what you are saying, answer the omein?
target_text: te ladhe èu pake lii leo ho koa-kio ama lamatua nèti d'ara èu, te ngaa abhu dhèu ètu sèra dhu re'a boe lii deo na, tasamia nèngu bisa d'ara èci dènge èu? lod'o èu manèngi makasi mi lamatua pake lii leo, tasamia dhèu èèna bisa nare lii èci dènge èu, ka na peka na, lèke kèna! bisa boe, si? te nèngu ne'a boe lii padhai èu deo na.

source_text: for indeed you make the bracha well enough, but the other is not being edified.
target_text: èu bisa manèngi makasi sèmi èèna kahèi mi lamatua. te ngaa èèna pa'èra boe d'ara dhèu leo.

source_text: modeh ani hashem that i speak in leshonot more than all of you,
target_text: ele boe miu me'a boe, te ngaa ja'a padhai lii pake lii leo risi nèti miu. aa ja'a manèngi makasi mi lamatua, lula nèngu hia ja'a bisa padhai lii sèmi èèna.

source_text: but in kehillah i want to speak five words with my sikhliyut rationality, that also others i may instruct with a dvar hora'ah word of teaching, rather than speak ten thousand words in a lashon tongue.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu parcaya pakaboko, na, be'a risi ja'a padhai lii dhoka lèmi hèb'a dhu bab'a te ngaa re'a mèu, sèna ka aj'a-nori si. te ladhe ja'a padhai lii pamadhera-dhera pake lii leo, dènge pake lii riho-riho hèb'a dhu re'a boe, na, gaguna na aad'o.

source_text: achim b'moshiach, be not yeladim in your machsh'vot thoughts; be infantile in kavvanah ra'ah malice, perhaps, but in your binah, be mature.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ladhe miu neo me'a mèu j'ara-j'ara, na, miu hud'i pangee nuka sèmi dhèu ee'a. mage pangee sèmi ana iiki! te ngaa re j'ara bhelu-katub'a, miu hud'i nuka sèmi ana iiki dhu re'a boe tao bhabhelu, lula d'ara ra dhu mèu aadha-aadha.

source_text: in the torah it stands written, ki bela'agei safah uvelashon acheret yedaber el haam hazeh…v'lo avu shmo'a then with ones of foreign lip and with strange tongue he will speak to this people… but they were not willing to listen, says the l-rd.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, dhu suri peka na, lamatua èdhi peka, aku nèngu na, ‘ja'a neo pake dhèu dhu padhai lii pake lii leo sèra, ho padhai lii dènge dhèu isra'el. masi ka ja'a peka tasamia èèna ka, te ngaa ro'o boe nanene ja'a. '

source_text: so then the leshonot tongues are for an ot miraculous sign, not to the ones believing, the ma'aminim in rebbe, melech hamoshiach, but an ot miraculous sign to the apikorosim; but divrei hanevu'ah words of prophecy are not for the apikorosim, but for the ones believing, the ma'aminim in moshiach.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ladhe miu paraga dènge dhèu dhu padhai lii pake lii leo, èèna j'aj'i mi tadha hia dhèu dhu parcaya mèka lamatua, sèna ka bisa rèdhi koasa lamatua. j'ara ne'e soru-bara boe dhèu dhu parcaya le kristus. te ngaa ladhe dhèu lole lii moa lamatua, na, ne'e ne ka soru-bara rèngu dhu parcaya le kristus. te ngaa soru-bara boe dhèu dhu parcaya mèka kristus.

source_text: if, therefore, the kehillah has a farbrengen gathering and all speak in leshonot tongues, and then in walks the am ha'aretz or the apikorosim, will they not say that you are all meshuggah?
target_text: ladhe sèmi miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu pakaboko, ka miu padhai lii pake lii baka-leo, hèia dhèu dhu parcaya boe, do, dhu ne'a boe j'ara se'e, maso dhiu asa talora aae miu, dhèu se ngee sèmi ngaa sa? tatu ra peka na, dhèu ètu se'e se, huj'u aa'i mèu-mèu!

source_text: however, if all speak forth divrei hanevu'ah words of prophecy, and then in walks some apikorosim or am ha'aretz, such a visitor is brought under conviction by all, he is brought into mishpat judgment by all,
target_text: aa ladhe sèmi miu aa'i-aa'i dhu padhue-padhai ho peka paled'a lii moa lamatua, hèia dhèu dhu parcaya boe, do, dhu ne'a mèu mèka j'ara-j'ara se, maso dhiu asa talora miu. tatu dhèu ne, neo nanene lii padhai miu. de, ngaa dhu miu peka-padhai sèra, pad'elo sasala na, toke neo parisa mamuri na d'ai lutu.

source_text: what is hiding in his lev heart becomes manifest, and, having fallen on his face, he worships hashem, declaring that g-d is among you.
target_text: ka bhabhelu dhu nèngu pahuni ètu d'ara na, èèna na bhoka patalele, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a. ka na patitu kètu urutuu na, ho pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, peka na, ira ii! tare'a-re'a ama lamatua ètu talora aae miu di!

source_text: nu? well? achim b'moshiach, when you come together, each one has a mizmor hymn, psalm, a musar teaching with an ethical point, a dvar hisgalus a dvar of revelation, a lashon tongue, or a pitron interpretation of a lashon tongue; let all things be for edification.
target_text: de a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ladhe miu pakaboko, èci-èci ka dènge karunya na. abhu dhu sod'a koa-kio ama lamatua. abhu dhu aj'a-nori dhèu lula-nèti lamatua. abhu dhu peka paled'a j'ara-j'ara lamatua dhu uru èèna pahuni era. abhu dhu padhai pake lii leo. aa abhu dhu bisa peka sasoa nèti lii leo sèra. j'ara aa'i-aa'i se, rèngu hud'i tao ku ho pa'èra parcaya dhèu leo sèra.

source_text: if anyone speaks in a lashon tongue, let the speakers be shenayim two or at most shloshah three, and by turn, and let one give the pitron interpretation.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhu d'èi padhai lii pake lii leo, èèna be'a. sad'i dua do tèlu dhèu di, baku pa'ae-ae. dhèu èci padhai lii uuru, èle ku heka dhèu leo kèna. aa hud'i abhu ku dhèu dhu peka sasoa na.

source_text: but if there is no one to give the pitron, let the one with the lashon tongue be silent in the kehillah and let him instead speak to himself and to hashem.
target_text: ladhe sèmi abhu boe dhu bisa peka sasoa nèti lii leo èèna, na, baku padhai lii pake lii leo ètu katanga madha dhèu ae-ae. hud'i laa rèngu padhai lii ètu d'ara ra. rèngu bisa padhai lii dènge lamatua sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: and let shenayim or shloshah nevi'im speak and let the other nevi'im be used with discernings of ruchot spirits.
target_text: ladhe miu pakaboko, na, dua do tèlu dhèu di dhu padhai lii, lole lii moa lamatua. dhèu leo hud'i dadoo ku lii padhai nèti dhèu dhu padhai sèra.

source_text: and if a dvar hisgalus a word of revelation is given to a navi sitting by, let the first navi become silent.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe lamatua bhoke ca j'ara dhu uru èèna mèu iia mèka mi ca dhèu dhu madhèdi nanene ètu èèna, na, nèngu hud'i peka paled'a lii moa ne mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhèdi ètu èèna. aa dhèu dhu padhai lii ètu madha, hud'i ae eele nèti lii padhai na, sèna ka hia dhèu dhu heka tadèngi lii moa lamatua, ho na padhai lii.

source_text: for you all are able one by one to speak forth a dvar hanevu'ah word of prophecy, in order that all may learn and receive chizzuk strengthening.
target_text: dhu lèke ka, miu aa'i-aa'i mi bisa lole lii moa lamatua. te ngaa ladhe padhai lii, na, èci uru, ladhe èle heka dhèu leo kèna. dènge j'ara ne, dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa nanene, bisa re'a j'ara, aa bisa pa'èra d'ara ra.

source_text: and the neshamot of nevi'im are subject to the nevi'im.
target_text: sanèd'e, te dhèu dhu lole lii moa lamatua, hud'i ne'a ator ngi'u na. ka èci pamata dènge èci, aa dhèu leo taha uru.

source_text: for hashem is no elohei hamevucha the g-d of confusion, tohu; he is elohei hashalom, and this is so in all the kehillot of the kedoshim.
target_text: te abhu boe maruru ètu ama lamatua, te ngaa mera dènge milu di. ètu mia-mia, ladhe dhèu parcaya pakaboko, hud'i sèmi ne'e ku:

source_text: let the nashim in the kehillot be silent, for it is not permitted for them to blurt out, but let them become submissive, as it says in the torah.
target_text: dhèu bhèni madhèdi mau-mau, bisa boe padhai lii pa'ae. rèngu hud'i nanene kètu juma'at sèra. te atora ama lamatua peka sèmi èèna kahèi, si?

source_text: and if the nashim wish to inquire about something, let them inquire of their own be'alim b'bayis, for it is a bushah shame for an isha to blurt out in the kehillah.
target_text: ladhe abhu bhèni dhu neo karèi j'ara èci, pe d'ai èmu ku heka karèi dhèu èmu na kèna. te ladhe bhèni maruru ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a, sèra sa pamakae iisi ra!

source_text: or from you did the dvar hashem go forth, or to you only did it reach?
target_text: madhutu a'abhu miu, tasamia? te lii holo-nori ama lamatua mai boe nèti miu. aa lii holo-nori na hia boe miu mesa mi ètu kota korintus di! de pangee paie ku!

source_text: if anyone thinks himself to be a navi or a man of the ruach hakodesh, let him have full da'as that the things i wrote to you are a mitzvoh of rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, nèngu bisa lole lii moa lamatua, do pangee na, nèngu abhu koasa nèti roh lamatua, na, nèngu ne'a j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a suri hia miu sèra, atora dhu ja'a tao boe, te ngaa paredha nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: but if anyone does not recognize this, he is not recognized.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu ro'o boe sèmi rare j'ara se, na, miu baku sèmi mere dhèu ne.

source_text: so then, achim b'moshiach of mine, earnestly desire to speak forth a dvar hanevu'ah word of prophecy, and do not forbid speaking in leshonot tongues.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! tenge j'ara sèna ka miu abhu koasa ho bisa peka paled'a lii moa lamatua. aa mage kai dhèu, sèna ka rèngu baku padhai pake lii leo.

source_text: let all things be done b'seder and without bushah shame.
target_text: de ladhe miu pakaboko, na, pakako aa'i-aa'i madhutu mola-mola. tao uuru ku èci, heka dhu leo kèna. pakako aa'i-aa'i dènge be'a, madhutu madha j'ara na. baku dènge maruru.

source_text: now, achim b'moshiach, i draw your attention to the besuras hageulah which i proclaimed to you, which also you received, in which also you stand firm,
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ja'a neo sèna ka miu sanèd'e lii lolo be'a lamatua dhu uru èèna ja'a peka-padhai le dènge miu. miu sèmi mere, hèia tao taruu madhutu lii lolo be'a èèna.

source_text: through which also you are brought to yeshu'at eloheinu, provided you hold fast to the dvar torah which i proclaimed to you, unless you received it in vain.
target_text: te lii lolo be'a èèna ka dhu bisa hia miu mamuri, sad'i miu kèpe pa'èra-èra. te ngaa ladhe miu parcaya taruu boe ama lamatua, na, parcaya miu èèna ele iie d'ara.

source_text: for i transmitted and handed on to you as authoritative torah, rishon first, that which was also transmitted and handed on to me as authoritative torah: that rebbe, melech hamoshiach died on behalf of avoneinuour averos, iniquities, gross wickedness, depravities according to the kitvei hakodesh,
target_text: ja'a aj'a le miu j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai risi eele, dhu uru èèna dhèu aj'a-nori ja'a. nuka: kristus, dhu ama lamatua pua mai èèna, madhe le sèna ka patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi. j'ara ne'e j'aj'i madhutu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua dhu suri tèke karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: and that rebbe, melech hamoshiach was buried in a kevergrave, burial place, and that rebbe, melech hamoshiach was raised in a techiyah from the mesim on yom hashlishi according to the kitvei hakodesh,
target_text: ra padhane ne. ka d'ai camèd'a èèna, lamatua pamamuri hari ne, lèke mola-mola sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua.

source_text: and that rebbe, melech hamoshiach was seen by kefa, then by the sheneym asar,
target_text: èle èèna ka, kristus pad'elo iisi na mi petrus. nèngu pad'elo iisi na mi ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua sèra kahèi.

source_text: afterward rebbe, melech hamoshiach was seen by over five hundred achim b'moshiach at one time, of whom most remain alive until now, though some sleep the sleep of the mesim.
target_text: aa ca tèka, na pad'elo iisi na mi lèmi ngasu risi dhèu parcaya. dhèu aa'i-aa'i se ladhe rèdhi ne dènge musi madha rèngu. nèti rèngu se, ae dhu mamuri era, aa ciki di dhu madhe le.

source_text: afterward, rebbe, melech hamoshiach was seen by ya'akov, then by all the shlichim.
target_text: ka na pad'elo iisi mi yakobis. hèia nèngu pad'elo iisi kahèi, mi dhèu pajuu-paleha na aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and, last of all, even as if to one born not normally, rebbe, melech hamoshiach was seen by me also.
target_text: ja'a dhèu limuri tèka dhu ladhe kèdhi ne. te ja'a ne nuka sèmi ana dhu rara iisi limuri tèka.

source_text: for i am the least of moshiachʼs shlichim, not qualified to be called a shliach, because i brought redifah persecution upon the kehillah of hashem.
target_text: dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua dhu leo sèra kapai risi nèti ja'a ne. madhutu mola-mola, na, ja'a nia boe j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na. te uru èèna, ja'a ka dhu paj'èra dhèu unu lamatua ètu mia-mia.

source_text: but by the chen v'chesed hashem, i am what i am. and the chen v'chesed hashem of rebbe, melech hamoshiach to me was not in vain, but more abundantly than all the moshiachʼs shlichim i labored, yet it was not i, but the chen v'chesed hashem with me.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a. hèia na tao ja'a j'aj'i sèmi ne'e ne. ropa nèngu tao j'ara be'a hia ja'a, na core eele boe lod'o iia d'ara. nèti èèna ka, ne'e ne ja'a sab'a bia risi nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra! ja'a mesa ku boe dhu sab'a, te ngaa d'ara hua iia lamatua ka dhu sab'a ètu mamuri ja'a.

source_text: whether it was i or those others, so we preached as moshiachʼs maggidim, and so you had emunah and became moshiachʼs ma'aminim.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a, do, dhèu pajuu-paleha dhu leo dhu aj'a-nori èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. te a'aj'a ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi èèna dhoka ca j'ara di. ji'i peka-padhai taruu lii lolo be'a lamatua mi dhèu. nèti èèna ka, miu j'aj'i parcaya lii lolo be'a dhu sama èèna.

source_text: and if moshiach is being preached that from the mesim dead ones he has had his techiyah resurrection, how is it that some among you say that there is no techiyas hamesim?
target_text: ji'i tema aj'a-nori, peka na, kristus dhu ama lamatua pua mai èèna, mamuri hari le nèti mamadhe na. de, nga tao ka miu cahag'e peka na, dhèu madhe sèra, mamuri hari boe? ngangee èèna mai nèti mia?

source_text: and if there is no techiyas hamesim, neither then has rebbe, melech hamoshiach been raised.
target_text: te ladhe dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe, sasoa na, kristus mamuri hari boe kahèi!

source_text: and if rebbe, melech hamoshiach has not been raised, then our darshenen to you was in vain and also in vain is your emunah faith.
target_text: aa ladhe kristus mamuri hari boe, na, aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i peka-padhai dènge dhèu, gaguna aad'o. aa lalèka miu mi kristus, parcuma kahèi!

source_text: moreover, we are found also to be edei sheker false witnesses misrepresenting hashem himself, because we gave solemn eduttestimony as in the presence of g-d that hashem raised rebbe, melech hamoshiach - whom, of course, he did not raise if, as you say, the mesim are not bemetzius in fact raised. for if the mesim dead persons have not techiyah, neither has rebbe, melech hamoshiach had a techiyah;
target_text: aa ladhe tare'a dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe, ji'i j'aj'i sakasii kapod'e-kabèli mi ama lamatua. te ji'i tema aj'a-nori, peka na, ama lamatua ka dhu pamamuri hari kristus! mema tare'a dhu ji'i lole sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa ladhe sèmi dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe, sasoa na, ama lamatua pamamuri hari boe kristus kahèi.

source_text: and if rebbe, melech hamoshiach has not already had his techiyah from the mesim, your emunah is futile, you are still in your averos sins,
target_text: pangee sèku j'ara ne: ladhe kristus mamuri hari boe, lalèka miu mi ama lamatua parcuma! aa miu pasae taruu sasala-sasigo miu!

source_text: and even the ones who sleep the sleep of the mesim in rebbe, melech hamoshiach have perished.
target_text: mesa boe èèna di, te dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu uru èèna pa'èki dènge kristus, dhu madhe le, ladhe kristus kèd'i boe nèti mamadhe na, rèngu madhe pacèri nèti ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: listen, if for the olam hazeh only we have tikvateinu in rebbe, melech hamoshiach, we are to be pitied more than kol bnei adam.
target_text: kristus j'aj'i era sarai èdhi, lula te'a, na, nèngu neo tao j'ara hua iia hia èdhi. te ngaa ladhe èdhi sanao-maena ho nèngu neo tao sèmi èèna dhoka ètu rai-haha di, na parcuma! aa èdhi j'aj'i dhèu kasia risi eele nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra!

source_text: but in fact rebbe, melech hamoshiach has had his techiyah! rebbe, melech hamoshiach is the bikkurimfirstfruits, the firstfruits of the ones having fallen asleep in moshiach.
target_text: aa te ngaa aad'o sèmi èèna, si? te dhu lèke mola-mola ka: kristus dhu ama lamatua pua mai èèna, mamuri le nèti mamadhe na! aa mesa boe nèngu di, te èèna na dhèu-dhèu parcaya dhu madhe sèra, bèli-camèd'a mamuri hari kahèi. kristus ne, nuka sèmi hua uru dhu pad'elo, na, rèngu dhu madhe sèra, bèli-camèd'a mamuri hari madhutu nèngu.

source_text: for als since through an adam man came mavet, also through an adam man, moshiach came the techiyas hamesim.
target_text: uru-uru èèna, dhoka dhèu èci di, nuka adam dhu sisu paredha ama lamatua. de hahuku na, nuka mamadhe. hahuku ne noto mi èdhi dhèu rai-haha kahèi. te ngaa limuri ne, abhu ca dhèu hari, nuka kristus, dhu mamuri madhutu paredha ama lamatua. de, lula babe'a nèngu ka dhèu madhe bisa mamuri hari!

source_text: for as in adam all die, so also in moshiach all will be made alive.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sisu paredha lamatua, lèke huku madhe sama sèmi adam kahèi. te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pa'èki dènge kristus, èèna na ama lamatua pamamuri hari si.

source_text: but each one in his own order: the bikkurim, moshiach; afterward, the ones of moshiach at the bias hamoshiach;
target_text: te ngaa èci-èci ka dènge lod'o na. kristus dhèu partama dhu mamuri hari, nuka sèmi hua uru deo na. aa pe na lèpa hari mai asa rai-haha ne, dhèu unu na sèra heka mamuri hari kèna.

source_text: then haketz when moshiach gives over the malchut hashem to g-d, even elohim avinu, after he has abolished all misrah and shilton and gevurah.
target_text: èle ku, heka rai-haha ne èle kèna. lod'o èèna, kristus j'aj'i dhèu aae dhu pa'ele iie koasa aa'i-aa'i, paredha aa'i-aa'i, aa mamèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pamusu dènge lamatua. nèngu j'aj'i kahèi dhèu aae dhu pangèd'u hari hak paredha na mi ama na, nuka ama lamatua.

source_text: for it is necessary for moshiach to reign until hashem puts all his oyvim enemies under his raglayimfeet.
target_text: te ama lamatua hud'i nèd'u paredha taruu, toke na segi aa'i dhu lab'a kristus, sèna ka ra pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: the last oyev enemy to be abolished is mavet.
target_text: abhu ca j'ara dhu pamusu dènge èdhi era, nuka mamadhe. te ngaa d'ai limuri, ka lamatua segi kahèi koasa mamadhe. de lèpa lod'o limuri, dhèu madhe heka.

source_text: for kol hashem put tachat raglav all things he subjected under his feet, but when he says that kol all things have been subjected, it is peshat plain, literal that this does not include the one who put all things in subjection under moshiach.
target_text: ètu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua suri, peka na, lamatua tao dhu na segi aa'i-aa'i sèra, sèna ka ra pahaha iisi mi dhèu dhu lamatua pua mai èèna. de dhu suri, peka na, dhu na segi aa'i-aa'i sèra, sèna ka ra pahaha iisi mi dhèu nèngu, de lèke, ladhe peka na, ama lamatua pahaha boe iisi mi dhèu unu nèngu èèna. lula ama lamatua ka dhu ded'e ne, sèna ka j'aj'i kètu mi ngaa aa'i-aa'i ra.
