source_text: but, when all things are subjected to hashem, then also the zun fun der oybershter himself will be subjected to the one hashem having subjected all things under him moshiach, that in all things g-d may be all.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a ladhe aa'i-aa'i nanene tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, èèna na ana ne pangèd'u aa'i-aa'i hari mi ama na, dhu ded'e ne j'aj'i kètu nèti aa'i-aa'i sèra. èle èèna, ama lamatua paredha taruu ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i, bagi mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: otherwise, what will they do, the ones being given tevilah on behalf of the dead? if the mesim really are not raised, why indeed are they given tevilah on behalf of the mesim?
target_text: abhu dhèu dhu neo sarani ho gati dhèu dhu madhe le dhu dhae sarani mèka. te ngaa ladhe dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe, nga tao ka rèngu neo sarani hia dhèu madhe?

source_text: why also are we putting ourselves at risk and in danger every hour?
target_text: aa nga tao ka ji'i oe madhe pahari-pahari ètu d'ara sasab'a ji'i, ladhe dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe?

source_text: daily i die and that is as true a fact, achim b'moshiach, as it is that i glory over you in moshiach yehoshua adoneinu.
target_text: te bèli-bèli ja'a oe madhe! te ngaa a'ari pasue! ja'a subha, te ja'a pangee, na, ngaa-ngaa tao boe ladhe ja'a madhe. te ja'a bisa boti kètu, lula miu pa'èki taruu dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, dhu ama lamatua pua le mai.

source_text: if it were a mere humanistic matter, my fighting, so to speak, with wild beasts in ephesus, what do i gain? if there is no techiyas hamesim, let us eat and drink, ki machar namut for tomorrow we die.
target_text: ca hari ni, lod'o ja'a ètu kota epesus era, ja'a patao-palaha dènge dhèu sèra nuka sèmi badha hui dhu bhelu. te ngaa ladhe ja'a dhoka patao-palaha, ho bisa segi mesa ku, aa hia boe lamatua, èèna parcuma. guna boe ngaa-ngaa! te ladhe tare'a dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe, hua iia èdhi madhutu dhu dhèu peka, na, mai èdhi pesta rame-rame, aa ta'a-tinu be'a-be'a, te bèli èdhi madhe kèna!

source_text: do not fall under a delusion. bad chavrusashaft association, influence or hashpa'ah corrupts good midos.
target_text: miu baku lèke tipu, ho pangee sèmi èèna! te abhu dhu peka na, ladhe èu pa'èci dènge dhèu bhelu, èèna pakaj'èu èu nèti mamuri dhu mola.

source_text: wake up and come to your senses. start walking in the derech tzaddikim. stop committing averos. some among you have no saving da'as of hashem. i say this to your bushah shame.
target_text: ad'u-ue ia ka bhabhelu-katub'a! rèno ka! ator ngi'u mu! tao dhu lèke di! dhu lèke ka, miu hud'i me'a ku makae, te ètu talora aae miu, abhu era dhèu dhu tadhe mèka ama lamatua.

source_text: but someone will question, how does this techiyas hamesim come about? and in the techiyas hamesim, with what kind of body will they come?
target_text: abhu dhu pakarèi, na, ladhe dhèu madhe mamuri hari, j'ara na tasamia? aa ngi'u aae j'aj'i sèmi ngaa sa?

source_text: yold, what you sow is not made alive unless it dies!
target_text: goa, ee! te ladhe sèle hini, hini ne hud'i roe ètu d'ara rai uuru ku, heka na bisa muri kèna.

source_text: and what is it you sow? not the body that is to be, but something else: a bare zera seed, efsher perhaps of wheat or some other grain.
target_text: aa hini dhu èdhi sèle, rupa na leko-leo nèti dhu muri, èli, heka cèu rèu kèna. te nèngu èèna hini dhu mango-meto, nuka sèmi gandum, do are, do hini dhu leo.

source_text: however, hashem chooses body to give to the seed, and to each kind of zera is given by hashem its own body.
target_text: èci-èci ka madhutu raropa ra, madhutu dad'èi lamatua. lula nèngu ka dhu ator raropa nèti ana aaj'u sèra.

source_text: now basar is not all the same: bnei adam have one kind of basar; animals, another; birds, another; fish, another;
target_text: badha dènge dhèu rai-haha sèmi èèna kahèi. èci-èci ka dènge raropa ra, madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. hèia ngi'u dhèu rai-haha madhutu raropa dhèu rai-haha. ngi'u badha èci-èci ka dènge raropa ra. manu-bhui dènge raropa ra. i'a dènge raropa ra. dhu leo sèra dènge raropa ra.

source_text: and there are gufot bashomayim heavenly bodies, and gufot ba'aretz earthly bodies, but the kavod of the heavenly is of one kind, and the kavod of the earthly of another kind.
target_text: abhu mèdha ètu dedha-liru, aa abhu ètu rai-haha. ètu dedha-liru dènge kolo-karisi na. te ngaa kolo-karisi ne, leko-leo nèti dhu ètu rai-haha. dhu ètu rai-haha abhu kolo-karisi kahèi. te ngaa kolo-karisi se, leko-leo nèti dhu abhu ètu dedha-liru.

source_text: there is one kavod glory of the shemesh sun, and another kavod glory of the levanah moon, and another kavod glory of the kochavim stars, for in kavod glory, kochav differs from kochav.
target_text: ètu dedha-liru kolo-karisi madha lod'o leko-leo; kolo-karisi hèru leko-leo; aa kolo-karisi hua-hètu leko-leo kahèi. èci-èci ka dènge kolo-karisi ra. de aa'i-aa'i ra dènge kolo-karisi, si?

source_text: so also is the techiyas hamesim. that which is sown is of one kind, perishable; that which is raised up is of another kind, imperishable.
target_text: ladhe dhèu madhe mamuri hari, èèna nuka sèmi hini deo na. te ladhe padhane ka dhèu madhe, ngi'u aae na ele iie, si? te ngaa ladhe mamuri hari, ngi'u na sèmi heka uru èèna. te ladhe mamuri hari, bisa heka madhe.

source_text: what is sown without kavod is raised in kavod. what is sown in weakness is raised in ko'ach power.
target_text: ropa èdhi padhane dhèu madhe, èdhi mad'enge ngi'u aae ne. te ngaa ladhe dhèu èèna mamuri hari, na saraga titu kèna! te nèngu j'aj'i mola-mèci! dhèu dhu madhe le bisa heka tao ngaa-ngaa lod'o dhèu padhane ne. te ngaa ropa na mamuri hari, nèngu èra titu kèna!

source_text: what is sown a natural body, is raised a spiritual body. if there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual one.
target_text: ladhe dhèu mamuri era, ne'a dhoka ngee dènge rasa di, si? te ngaa ropa na madhe, ho mamuri hari, na, roh lamatua hia ne mamuri dhu lèke. ka dhèu ne sèmi heka uru èèna.

source_text: so, also, it has been written, vay'hi haadam l'nefesh chayyah and the first man became a living soul; but the adam haacharon last adam became a ruach mechayyeh.
target_text: dhèu rai-haha dhu uru-uru j'ara, dhu sama sèmi èdhi, nuka adam. madhutu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua dhu suri tèke, peka na, nèngu j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha dhu mamuri, dhu ne'a ngee dènge rasa. te ngaa dhèu rai-haha dhu raropa na sama sèmi adam, dhu dedha risi eele, nuka kristus. roh na ka dhu bisa hia dhèu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: but the spiritual body is not harishon, but the natural; then afterward the spiritual.
target_text: raropa dhèu dhu uru-uru j'ara, nuka dhèu dhu ne'a dhoka ngee dènge rasa di, ka bisa madhe. te ngaa dhu mamuri hari, nuka dhèu dhu abhu mamuri dhu lèke nèti roh lamatua.

source_text: the adam harishon is afar min ha'adamah dust from the earth, ground, out of ha'aretz. the adam hasheini the second adam is out of shomayim.
target_text: raropa dhèu dhu uru-uru j'ara ètu rai-haha ne, dhu tao nèti ahu rai. te ngaa raropa ka dua, nuka kristus dhu mai nèti sorga.

source_text: as was the adam of dust, such also are those of the dust; as was the adam of shomayim, such also are those who are of shomayim.
target_text: èdhi dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha ne ca ropa dènge dhèu partama dhu lamatua paj'aj'i nèti ahu rai. te ngaa dhèu dhu pa'èki dènge ama lamatua ètu sorga, ca ropa dènge kristus dhu mai nèti sorga.

source_text: and just as we have borne the demut of the adam min afar ha'adamah from the dust of the earth, so we will bear also the likeness of the heavenly adam man.
target_text: èdhi dhèu limuri ne, ca ropa dènge adam dhu ama lamatua paj'aj'i nèti ahu rai. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, gati dènge raropa hiu, sama sèmi kristus dhu mai nèti sorga.

source_text: now this i say, achim b'moshiach, that basar vadahm cannot inherit the malchut hashem, neither can the perishable inherit the imperishable.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! dhu ja'a neo peka dènge miu, sèmi ne'e: èdhi dhu ca ropa dènge dhèu partama, ngi'u èdhi j'aj'i nèti sisi dènge raa. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi bisa boe abhu pusaka ho j'aj'i ana-ana ama lamatua ètu sorga. bisa boe! te raropa dhèu sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a ngi'u ra ele iie, ka bisa boe sèmi rare ngaa dhu taha nare nèbhu.

source_text: hinei! i speak a sod mystery to you: we will not all sleep the sleep of the mesim, but we will all be changed.
target_text: de nanene paie-iie! te ja'a neo bhoke paled'a rahasia èci. èèna na abhu dhèu parcaya cahag'e dhu madhe boe. te ngaa èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, èèna na gati raropa hiu.

source_text: in a rega moment, in the wink of an eye, at the last shofar blast. for the shofar will sound, the mesim dead ones will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed.
target_text: ropa lii tiu tèbhe limuri tèka, aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i dènge sahèka. malai risi nèti ate musi madha. te ropa tèbhe limuri tèka lii, cag'ag'a laa dhèu madhe mamuri hari. aa ladhe ra mamuri hari, dhèu se madhe heka, aa ele iie heka. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge èdhi dhu mamuri era. èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti abhu raropa hiu.

source_text: for it is necessary for this perishable nature to put on the imperishable, and this mortal nature to put on the immortal. but when this perishable nature puts on the imperishable, and this mortal, the immortal, then the dvar hanevu'ah will come to pass that stands written, he will swallow up death forever in victory.
target_text: te ngi'u aae èdhi dhu bisa ele iie ne'e ne, j'aj'i ngi'u hiu dhu ele iie heka! aa èdhi dhu bisa madhe ne'e ne, neo ub'a j'aj'i raropa hiu dhu madhe heka! èèna madhutu ngaa dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, lamatua palaho eele le koasa mamadhe, aa segi le mamadhe! nèti èèna ka èdhi madhe heka.

source_text: ehi devarecha mavet ehi katavecha sheol? where are your plagues, o death? where is your destruction, o sheol?
target_text: he, mamadhe! koasa èu ètu mia? he, mamadhe! dhudhu èu ètu mia?

source_text: now the sting of death is chet sin and the ko'ach power of chet sin is chukkat hatorah.
target_text: nga tao ka mamadhe nèti rasa pèd'a hia èdhi dhèu rai-haha? lula èdhi ad'u-ue sasala. tasamia ka sasala sèra dènge koasa? lula atora ama lamatua peka na, sasala èdhi, nuka sisu paredha na!

source_text: but baruch hashem, who is giving us the netzach victory through adoneinu rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i leko-leo le! de èdhi hud'i manèngi makasi ae-ae mi ama lamatua. te nèngu ka tao èdhi bisa segi bhabhelu-katub'a lula kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. mema tare'a, te kristus ka dhu segi aa'i!

source_text: so then, chaverim and achim b'moshiach of mine, be steadfast, immovable, abounding always in the avodas kodesh of adoneinu, have da'as that your po'al work is not in vain in hashem.
target_text: de a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! pa'èra d'ara! baku roe! sasab'a miu hia mi ama lamatua hud'i asa be'a, aa asa ae. te miu me'a le, na, sab'a bia hia lamatua èdhi èèna, iia d'ara boe.

source_text: now, concerning the maamadot financial contributions and the pishkeh pushke we are circulating throughout the kehillot for the benefit of the yerushalayim kedoshim, as i directed the kehillot of galatia, so you do also.
target_text: ne'e ne, ja'a suri hia miu lula-nèti doi dhu miu pakaboko hia dhèu unu lamatua ètu yerusalem. ja'a peka le dènge dhèu parcaya ètu propensi galati, j'ara tasamia rèngu hud'i pakaboko doi èèna. miu hud'i tao sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: every yom rishon of each week, each of you by himself make something farnumen set aside, storing up according to his hakhnasah income, so that collections need not be made when i come.
target_text: ladhe hari migu, dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i pa'oru doi ciki nèti rui-j'aj'èra rèngu. baku mate ja'a dhiu ku, heka miu parai-oru kèna.

source_text: and when i arrive, whomever you approve, these i will send with iggrot to carry your matanah to yerushalayim.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a dhiu, miu paj'uj'u dhèu dhu miu lèka, sèna ka rèti doi soru-bara sèra asa dhèu unu lamatua ètu yerusalem. pe ja'a suri sasuri ho patadha rèngu dènge kètu juma'at ètu nèi.

source_text: and if it is fitting for me also to go, they will go with me.
target_text: aa ladhe miu ngee, na, be'a ladhe ja'a madhutu hèi, na, ji'i la'a palere.

source_text: and i will come to you whenever i pass through macedonia, for i will be passing through macedonia.
target_text: ladhe ja'a kako palème le propensi makedonia, ja'a heka dhiu asa miu kèna. de mo'o do mo'o boe, ja'a hud'i laku uuru ku asa makedonia.

source_text: efsher perhaps i will stay with you, or even spend the choref winter that you may help me with a send-off wherever i may go.
target_text: èle èèna, pe ja'a dhiu pea taha dènge miu ako panèbhu ciki; ele boe d'ai èle hèru pacuhi. hèia miu bisa lere ja'a asa era leo hari.

source_text: for i do not want to see you now in passing, for i have the tikvah to remain some time with you, im yirtzeh hashemg-d willing, permitting.
target_text: a'abhu ja'a, na, ja'a dhiu ne ca lod'o boe di. te ja'a neo pea dènge miu ako panèbhu, ladhe lamatua d'èi.

source_text: but, i will remain on in ephesus until shavuos,
target_text: te ngaa ja'a neo pea era ètu kota epesus ne, toke lod'o babe'a pantekosta, nuka lèmi nguru lod'o èle kalela paska.

source_text: for a delet door has opened, great and effective, for me, but there are many mitnaggedim opponents.
target_text: lula ètu ne'e ja'a abhu lod'o taleo ae, ho sab'a taruu, masi ka abhu dhèu ae dhu lab'a sasab'a lamatua.

source_text: now if timotiyos comes, see that he may be with you without fear; for the avodas kodesh of hashem he labors in as i do.
target_text: ladhe timotius j'aj'i dhiu paraga dènge miu, sèmi mere ne dènge be'a, sèna ka baku na ngee rupa-rupa. te nèngu ne dhèu sab'a nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, sama sèmi ja'a ne kahèi.

source_text: therefore, let not anyone despise him. but give him a send-off in shalom that he may come to me; for i am waiting for him with the achim b'moshiach.
target_text: mage soro tèke dhèu laladhe ne dènge hui madha di. soru-bara ne toke na lèpa asa ja'a dènge be'a. te ja'a dènge a'ari dhu leo se, dhu mate tatae ne.

source_text: now, concerning apollos the ach b'moshiach, i strongly exhorted him, that he would come to you with the achim b'moshiach. but he is beshum oifen absolutely unwilling to go at this time, but he will come whenever he has an opportunity.
target_text: ca j'ara era dhu miu hud'i me'a ku. ja'a dhu pamako le angalai èdhi apolos, ho na dhiu pangad'o dènge a'ari dhu leo. te ngaa no'o mèka dhiu. de mi mate, pe na abhu lod'o taleo, heka na dhiu kèna.

source_text: watch, stand firm in the emunah faith, be men, be strong.
target_text: miu hud'i j'aga ngi'u miu paie-iie! miu hud'i pa'èra-èra ho parcaya taruu ama lamatua! mage madha'u! pa'èra iisi!

source_text: let everything you do be done in ahavah agape.
target_text: sad'i miu sab'a ngaa èèna ka, pad'elo la sasue.

source_text: now, i urge you, achim b'moshiach, you have da'as of the bais of stephanas, that it is the bikkurim of achaia, and that they have with devotion and zerizut diligence put themselves in avodas kodesh ministry for the kedoshim.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu me'a, na, stefanus dènge isi èmu na ka dhèu partama dhu parcaya kristus ètu propensi akaya nèi. rèngu sab'a re'a boe j'èra, sèna ka ladhe-leru dhèu parcaya ètu nèi. de ja'a manèngi ho

source_text: become submissive to such as him and to everyone joining in the avodas kodesh and laboring.
target_text: miu nanene dhèu sèmi sèra. nuka rèngu dhu sab'a bia ho sama-sama lalau-lalo'o dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: now, i rejoice at the coming of stephanas and of fortunatus and of achaicus, because these men filled up your absence,
target_text: d'ara ja'a neo dhiu pa'asu-pareo dènge miu. d'ara ja'a karej'e titu kèna, lula mamai stefanus, fortunatus dènge akaikus asa ne'e. dènge j'ara ne, rèngu bisa gati miu.

source_text: for they refreshed my neshamah and yours. give recognition to such men.
target_text: tèlu ra pa'èra d'ara ja'a, sama sèmi ra pa'èra d'ara miu kahèi. miu hud'i pakab'ua dhèu sèmi sèra.

source_text: drishat shalom from the kehillot of moshiach of asia. drishat shalom warmly in adoneinu from aquila and prisca, together with the adat moshiach in their bais.
target_text: juma'at-juma'at ètu propensi asia hia miu lii maho'o. akila dènge dhèu èmu na, priskila, aa dhèu leo dhu tema pakaboko ètu èmu ra, pa'adhu lii maho'o kahèi. rèngu se dhu pa'èki kahèi dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: drishat shalom from all the achim b'moshiach. greet one another with a neshikat hakodesh holy kiss.
target_text: dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i ètu ne'e, pa'adhu lii maho'o kahèi. ladhe miu pakaboko, na, pa'uu èci dènge èci, pake uu dhu nia hia dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: this greeting with my own hand, sha'ul.
target_text: mi laladhe! te ja'a, paulus, suri dènge kacui-aai unu ku: saloom!

source_text: if anyone does not have ahavah love for haadon, alav ki cherem hu a curse of the ban of destruction is on him. marana our l-rd, tha come.
target_text: dhèu cee dhu sue boe kètu èdhi, pe ama lamatua huku ne. ja'a d'èi tabea dhèu madhutu lii aram èdhi dhèu yahudi, dhu peka, marana ta! dhu sasoa na, lamatua! mai ka!

source_text: the chen v'chesed hashem of moshiach adoneinu be with you.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: my ahavah be with you all in moshiach yehoshua.
target_text: ja'a sue miu aa'i-aa'i mi, lula èdhi pa'èki dènge kristus, dhu ama lamatua hia mai. sasuri ja'a sèmi ne'e ka. saloom! nèti ja'a, paulus

source_text: from sha'ul, a shliach of rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua birtzon hashemby the will of g-d, and timotiyos, the ach b'moshiach; to the kehillah congregation of hashem existing in corinth, with all the kedoshim throughout achaia.
target_text: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, paulus. ama lamatua pua-paleha ja'a sèna ka laku lole lula-nèti yesus kristus dènge dhèu asa mia-mia. yesus kristus èèna, dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru-uru ka. ari èdhi timotius ètu ne'e kahèi. na hia lii maho'o. ja'a pa'adhu sasuri ne'e mi dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i dhu biasa pakaboko ètu kota korintus dènge propensi akaya.

source_text: chen v'chesed hashem to you and shalom from elohim avinu and adoneinu rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a mi ama èdhi, nuka ama lamatua, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ja'a manèngi ho rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra dènge miu, sèna ka miu mamuri dame dènge mera-milu.

source_text: baruch hu hashem elohim avi of adoneinu yehoshua hamoshiach, avi harachamim vaelohei kol nechamah comfort,
target_text: dad'èi ji'i ka ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua. te nèngu èèna, ama nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. rasa kasia aa'i-aa'i kapua nèti nèngu, aa nèngu ka dhu pa'èra d'ara èdhi.

source_text: the one giving us chizzuk strengthening with respect to all our tzoros so as to enable us to give chizzuk to the ones experiencing tzoros, and that through the nechamah comfort by which we ourselves are comforted by hashem.
target_text: nèngu ka pamaho'o d'ara èdhi ladhe èdhi ètu d'ara sasusa. nèti èèna ka, èdhi kahèi bisa pamaho'o dhèu leo dhu paraga dènge sasusa. te èdhi bisa pa'èra d'ara rèngu, sama sèmi lamatua pa'èra le d'ara èdhi.

source_text: this is so because as the chevlei moshiach birth pangs of moshiach abound to us, so through moshiach abounds also our nechamah.
target_text: kristus abhu le susa ae-ae hia èdhi. de, lula kristus rasa le susa sèmi èèna, nèti èèna ka ama na pa'èra d'ara èdhi taruu, ladhe èdhi paraga dènge susa.

source_text: now if we are experiencing tzoros, it is for your chizzuk strengthening and yeshu'at eloheinu; or if we are being given nechamah comfort, it is for your nechamah that is producing in you the chozek strength of savlanut patience for the endurance of the tzoros which we also suffer.
target_text: ladhe ji'i ètu ne'e abhu susa, ama lamatua pa'èra d'ara ji'i. aa ladhe ji'i paraga dènge j'aj'èra, hèia taha dènge d'ara taleo, na, miu hud'i me'a kahèi, lamatua pake j'ara sèmi ne'e sèna ka pa'èra d'ara miu, ho patalale miu nèti koasa bhabhelu-katub'a. te ladhe miu abhu sasusa sama sèmi ji'i, lamatua pa'èra d'ara miu, sèna ka miu bisa taha mere dènge d'ara taleo kahèi.

source_text: and our tikvah hope for you is well-founded, for we have da'as that as you have deveykus cleaving to the chevlei moshiach, so also you will have deveykus to the nechamah.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ji'i nge'a mèu, na, miu bisa taha mere dènge èra. te ji'i nge'a, na, ladhe miu abhu j'aj'èra sama sèmi ji'i, lamatua pa'èra d'ara miu, aa nèngu pa'èra d'ara ji'i kahèi.

source_text: for we do not want you to lack da'as, achim b'moshiach, as to the tzoros and tribulation that came upon us in asia, that utterly beyond our strength we were burdened, causing us to come to a feeling of ye'ush despair even of being able to stay alive.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! dad'èi ji'i sèna ka miu me'a mèu sasusa dhu ji'i abhu ètu propensi asia. ji'i rasa bia, risi nèti dhu ji'i bisa pasae, toke ji'i oe ele ngangee, lula ji'i pangee, na, ji'i madhe kèna.

source_text: but we ourselves have had the gezar din verdict of mishpat mavet a death sentence in ourselves so that we should not have emunah faith in ourselves but in hashem, mechayyei mesim who revivest the dead.
target_text: ji'i rasa bia, nuka sèmi dhèu èci ropa tadèngi hakim pama'ète hahuku pamadhe ne. te ngaa aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i, sèna ka ji'i parcaya ama lamatua, aa baku parcaya ngi'u ji'i unu mi. te lamatua èèna ka dhu unu koasa ho pamamuri hari dhèu madhe.

source_text: the same g-d out of so great a mavet delivered us and will continue to deliver us. we have set tikvateinu our hope that he will yet deliver us,
target_text: nèngu ka dhu pakaj'èu le ji'i nèti bhabhelu, lod'o ji'i oe madhe. bèli-camèd'a nèngu neo pakaj'èu ji'i nèti bhabhelu-katub'a kahèi. aa ji'i ma'ète boe sanao, sèna ka na pakaj'èu taruu ji'i nèti bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: as you also labor together for us by techinnah supplication, so that the modeh ani for us will be said by the many for the matanah gift granted us through the tefillos of the many.
target_text: ladhe miu loe boe sabaj'a hia ji'i, èèna ka soru-bara ji'i kahèi, te ama lamatua neo tao j'ara dhu be'a ae-ae hia mi ji'i. nèngu tao j'ara èèna, lula dhèu ae dhu sabaj'a hia ji'i. hèia lod'o dhèu ae sanèd'e ji'i, rèngu manèngi makasi ae-ae mi ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: for our glorying is in this: the edut testimony of our matzpun conscience is that without remiyah guile, fraud, deceit and with lev tahorpure heart, with the sincerity of hashem and not in the chochmah of the basar but in the chen v'chesed of hashem, we conducted ourselves in the olam hazeh, and more especially toward you.
target_text: ji'i bisa koa-kad'iri iisi ji'i, lula ji'i nge'a ètu d'ara iiki ji'i, ngaa dhu ji'i ad'u-ue ètu rai-haha ne, madhutu dad'èi lamatua dhu na pangèd'u mi ji'i. ji'i rai boe nèti sasab'a-la'a ne, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa rèdhi ji'i sab'a dènge d'ara mola. ji'i pakako sasab'a ji'i, pake boe mamèu dhu mai nèti rai-haha ne, te ngaa mamèu dhu kapua na nèti ama lamatua. te lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ji'i. nèti èèna ka, ji'i bisa asa tabha èra ètu d'ara sasab'a-la'a lod'o ji'i bera-bera dènge miu.

source_text: for we write nothing so shver complex to you that you cannot read and have binah understanding, and i have tikvah that you will have da'as shlemah until haketz,
target_text: ja'a suri hia miu dhodhoka j'ara-j'ara dhu miu bisa baca aa bisa me'a mèu. limuri ne miu me'a le naneo ja'a cahag'e. te ngaa ja'a sanao, sèna ka bèli-camèd'a miu bisa me'a mèu risi hari.

source_text: as you have already had da'as of us in part, as also we are your kavod, even as also you are ours in the yom hashem of adoneinu yehoshua.
target_text: ne'e ne, miu me'a ciki era lula-nèti ji'i se. te ngaa èèna na, lod'o kètu èdhi, yesus kristus mai hari ka, ja'a ke'a, na, miu me'a j'ara ae-ae. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu bisa koa-kad'iri ji'i, sama sèmi ji'i koa-kad'iri miu kahèi.

source_text: and with this bitachon confidence i planned previously to come to you, that a second benefit you might have.
target_text: lula ja'a ke'a, na, miu me'a j'ara aa'i-aa'i se, nèti èèna ka ca hari na, ja'a pama'ète kore le, ho dhiu ngad'o hari miu, sèna ka miu bisa abhu mèngi-nale dua hari.

source_text: it was my cheshbon plan to visit you by way of macedonia and again from macedonia to come to you, and by you to be sent on to yehudah judea.
target_text: de uru èèna ja'a dhu pangee, ladhe j'aj'i laku asa propensi makedonia, na, ja'a bisa dhuli ngad'o miu. ho ladhe ja'a lèpa nèti makedonia, ja'a bisa dhuli hari pa'asu-pareo dènge miu. dènge sèmi èèna, miu bisa soru-bara ja'a, ho bisa laku taruu asa propensi yudea.

source_text: this was my matarah aim, goal; surely then i did not act with vacillation? or when i make plans, do i have a cheshbon according to the basar, ready with ken, ken! and then, lo! lo!
target_text: te ngaa tasamia? lod'o-lod'o ja'a peka, neo dhiu pangad'o dènge miu, ele boe mi pangee, na, ja'a uri kore mèka, si? do, miu pangee, na, ja'a dhodhoka pama'ète madhutu dad'èi d'ara ja'a di, sama sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne, si? do, miu pangee, na, ja'a ne dhèu dhu peka leo, tao leo, ho d'èi, peka na, oo. aa te ngaa ja'a ngee ètu d'ara ja'a, na, aad'o! ele boe miu pangee, na, ja'a sèmi èèna ka, si?

source_text: al emunat hashemin the faithfulness of g-d, our dvar to you has not been ken and lo.
target_text: èdhi bisa parcaya ama lamatua, lula nèngu peka ca j'ara, tatu na tao madhutu. nèti èèna ka, ji'i sama sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe ji'i dhaa, peka na, oo, na ji'i pangee boe, na, aad'o.

source_text: for the zun fun der oybershter, rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua, the one having been proclaimed among you by us, by silvanus sila and timotiyos and me, was not a ken and lo; but in him it has always been ken.
target_text: ja'a, silas dènge timotius dhu aj'a le miu lula-nèti yesus kristus, ana ama lamatua. nèngu dhu kapod'e-kabèli boe, peka na, oo, te ngaa a'abhu na, aad'o. nèngu ne ub'a boe, te ladhe na peka na, oo, a'abhu na tare'a-re'a, oo.

source_text: for in moshiach every one of hashemʼs havtachot promises is a ken. for this reason it is b'shem moshiach that we say the omein to the kavod of hashem.
target_text: madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua pajaji tèke, èèna na na paj'aj'i si. nèti èèna ka, ladhe yesus pamoa ca j'ara, peka na, oo, èdhi bisa dhaa, na, tare'a! lèke sèmi èèna! lula ji'i nge'a le ngaa dhu yesus neo tao. ji'i peka j'ara ne, sèna ka pad'elo dadedha ama lamatua.

source_text: but it is hashem who establishes us with you in moshiach and has given us the mishchahanointing,
target_text: lamatua ne'e ka dhu hag'e nare miu dènge ji'i. nèngu ka dhu ded'e nare èdhi, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na. nèngu kahèi dhu tao èdhi taha taruu.

source_text: having put his chotam on us and having given the eravon pledge of the ruach hakodesh in our levavothearts.
target_text: nèngu ka dhu hia roh na, ho uri èdhi, aa pad'elo hia èdhi ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao. èèna nuka sèmi dhèu èci dhu tao tadha mi mèdha èci, sèna ka peka na, mèdha èèna unu nèngu.

source_text: now, i call upon hashem as eidus witness against my nefesh, my neshamah soul, that it was to spare you that i did not come again to corinth.
target_text: ja'a manèngi, sèna ka lamatua mesa na j'aj'i sakasii mi lii padhai ja'a ne. te lamatua ne'a d'ara ja'a. nèngu ne'a, nga tao ka ja'a lake kore mèka dhiu asa korintus. ja'a ko'o boe pamakae miu, nèti èèna ka ja'a dhae dhiu mèka.

source_text: not that we play the gontser macher to domineer over your emunah faith, but we are fellow po'alim for your simcha, for by emunah you stand.
target_text: ji'i ngo'o boe pakapai ngi'u j'aj'i dhèu kapai, ho laka-seti miu, peka na, miu hud'i parcaya mi cee. te ngaa ji'i sab'a sama-sama dènge miu, sèna ka d'ara miu bisa karej'e-karae. te miu bisa taha pa'èra, lula miu lèka ama lamatua.

source_text: for i decided this in myself: not again to come to you in agmat nefesh grief.
target_text: de ja'a unu ku dhu pama'ète, na, ja'a bisa mèka dhiu ngad'o miu, sèna ka baku pabia miu aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: for if i grieve you, then who is the one cheering me except the one i have caused to have agmat nefesh?
target_text: te ladhe ja'a pabia d'ara miu, na, cee hari ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ja'a? dhoka miu di. te ngaa ladhe ja'a dhiu d'ara lai-lai ne, ja'a pabia miu.

source_text: and i wrote the iggeret as i did, so that when i came, i should not have agmat nefesh from those who should have brought me simcha; for i have confidence about you all, that my simcha would be the simcha of all of you.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, sasuri ja'a dhu uru èèna, peka na, ja'a lake kore mèka dhiu asa miu. ja'a tatae era, sèna ka miu pamola mere ku lii langu miu. hèia ropa ja'a dhiu, ja'a rasa bia heka, lula lii langu miu sèra. te dhu lèke mola-mola, na, miu se ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ja'a. ja'a tadhe mèu miu se aa'i-aa'i mi. ka ja'a ke'a mèu ladhe d'ara ja'a karej'e, na, d'ara miu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: for out of much tzoros and of lev heart distress i wrote the iggeret to you with many tears, not that you should have agmat nefesh, but that you may have da'as of the ahavah in hashem which i have more abundantly for all of you.
target_text: lod'o ja'a suri sasuri dhu uru èèna hia miu, ja'a rasa susa dènge d'ara ja'a roe. ja'a pahaa èi madha ae-ae. te ngaa ja'a suri sèmi èèna, sèna ka miu me'a sasue ja'a mi dedha miu. te ja'a suri boe j'ara ne, ho pasusa miu.

source_text: now if anyone has caused agmat nefesh grief, it is not me he has grieved, but to some extent, not to be too severe he has grieved you all.
target_text: ètu talora juma'at miu sèra, abhu ca dhèu dhu pasusa d'ara dhèu ae. d'ara ja'a susa kahèi lula tatao dhèu èèna. masi ka tatao nèngu ne lèke iia boe mi ja'a, te ngaa dhu lèke ae mi miu.

source_text: sufficient to such a man was this onesh penalty by the roiv majority,
target_text: ja'a padhai lii pa'ae heka, te ae ka nèti miu dhu pasanèd'e nèngu le, hèia na ele-ho'a le.

source_text: so that, on the contrary, rather you ought to give selichah forgiveness and chozek strength to him lest efsher perhaps such a one may be swallowed up by overwhelming remorse.
target_text: de limuri ne miu pabhèlu eele ka sasala na, aa padhai lii pabe'a-be'a ka dènge ne. te mage dhoka dhèu ne pakaj'èu iisi.

source_text: therefore i urge you to confirm to him your ahavah love.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu pa'asu-pareo dènge ne, ho pa'èra d'ara na, peka na, miu sue nèngu taruu.

source_text: for i wrote the iggeret to this end, that i may have da'as that you are tested and proven, that in all things you have mishma'at obedience.
target_text: ja'a suri sasuri ja'a dhu uru èèna, ho neo uji miu. te neo ke'a, na, miu tao dhu lèke, dènge tao madhutu aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a paredha mi miu.

source_text: now to anyone whom you give selichah forgiveness of anything, i do as well, for indeed what i have forgiven, if i have forgiven anything, it is for your sake in the presence of moshiach;
target_text: ladhe miu tèka heka d'ara, aa pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu, na, ja'a madhutu kahèi ngaa dhu miu pama'ète mere le. ladhe abhu sasala na dhu ja'a parluu pabhèlu, na, ja'a pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu èèna kahèi. ja'a tao sèmi èèna ka ètu madha kristus, sèna ka j'aj'i conto dhu be'a hia miu.

source_text: lest we should be outsmarted by hasatan; for we do not lack da'as of his kesharim conspiracies.
target_text: te ja'a d'èi boe ladhe dhèu aae nidhu sii nare èdhi, sèna ka segi èdhi. èdhi hud'i te'a ku naneo aapa nèngu. de baku pagoa iisi!

source_text: but having come to troas for the purpose of proclaiming the besuras hageulah of moshiach, and a delet door to me having been opened by adoneinu,
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ja'a ètu kota troas, ho aj'a dhèu lula-nèti lii lolo be'a yesus kristus, lamatua bhoke j'ara hia ja'a.

source_text: i did not have shalom in my neshamah when i was not able to find titos my ach b'moshiach. so i took leave of them and i went on to macedonia.
target_text: te ngaa d'ara ja'a mau boe, lula ja'a paraga boe dènge ari ja'a titus ètu nèi. hèia ja'a palangu lii dènge dhèu parcaya ètu troas sèra, ka pakèd'i asa propensi makedonia.

source_text: but baruch hashem, the one in whom we are given the nitzachon victory, who always leads us in triumph in moshiach and, through us, in every place spreads the fragrance of the da'as of him.
target_text: te ngaa, masi ka ja'a ètu mia èèna ka, ja'a manèngi makasi ae-ae mi ama lamatua. te kristus lab'a le j'ara-j'ara dhu bhelu-katub'a, ka na segi le. aa èdhi pa'èki dènge ne kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua pad'elo taruu, peka na, èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu na. de ropa èdhi peka dènge dhèu lula-nèti kristus, èèna nuka sèmi hèu mèngi èci, dhu dhèu aa'i-aa'i sangèd'u rare.

source_text: for we are the aroma of moshiach to hashem among the ones coming to yeshu'at elokeinu, and among the ones perishing: to the latter ones an odor of mavet unto mavet; but to the former ones a fragrance of chayim life unto chayim. who is sufficient for these things?
target_text: uru-uru sèra, lod'o dhèu yahudi tao korban tunu, sèb'u hèu gèmu na ca'e asa lamatua, ho pakarej'e d'ara na. èdhi èci èèna kahèi dènge hèu mèngi èci, dhu pasanèd'e lamatua lula-nèti kristus. te ngaa bagi mi dhèu cahag'e, èdhi èci èèna ka dènge hèu badha madhe. te ladhe dhèu dhu mamuri pakaj'èu nèti lamatua rèdhi mamuri èdhi, èèna pasanèd'e rèngu, peka na, bèli-camèd'a rèngu madhe, aa cèri eele nèti lamatua. te ngaa mi dhèu cahag'e hari, èdhi èci èèna ka dènge hèu mèngi èci. te ladhe dhèu dhu mamuri mola rèdhi mamuri èdhi, èèna pasanèd'e rèngu tasa mera mia kristus hia mamuri mi èdhi, aa pala-bagi hia rèngu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia. dhèu rai-haha cee ka dhu bisa ad'u-ue j'ara se aa'i-aa'i? aad'o, sina ma?

source_text: for we are not as many, peddling the dvar hashem, but as from sincerity, as from hashem, in the presence of hashem, in rebbe, melech hamoshiach we speak.
target_text: sanèd'e, te ji'i se sama boe dènge dhèu leo dhu aj'a lii holo-nori lamatua, sèna ka abhu oto nuka sèmi pahia-pahèli pake lii holo-nori lamatua. ji'i se sèmi boe èèna! ladhe ji'i padhai lii, dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa ladhe rèdhi iia-iia, peka na, ji'i aj'a-nori dènge d'ara mola. lii padhai ji'i kapua nèti ama lamatua. aa mamuri ji'i pa'èki dènge kristus.

source_text: do we begin again to commend ourselves? or surely we do not need, as some do, iggrot of haskama letters of approval, commendation to you or from you?
target_text: baku pangee, na, ji'i mulai padhai lii padedha iisi. aad'o! tao-tao miu pangee, na, ji'i sama sèmi dhèu leo dhu parluu ngèti sasuri hia miu dhu manèngi, ho miu sèmi ji'i dènge be'a, heka ji'i bisa pakako sasab'a-la'a ji'i, do? do, ji'i parluu manèngi sasuri sèmi èèna kahèi nèti miu, ho ngèti asa dhèu leo? aad'o, si?

source_text: you are our iggeret, written on our levavot, being known and being read by kol bnei adam.
target_text: te sasuri ijin ji'i dhu abhu le. sasuri ijin èèna nuka miu se. te ji'i nge'a j'ara ae-ae nèti mamuri miu. j'ara se dhu tèke le ètu d'ara ji'i. dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa baca mamuri miu; nèti j'ara ne'e ra tadhe hua-hela nèti sasab'a-la'a èdhi.

source_text: and you show that you are an iggeret from rebbe, melech hamoshiach, prepared by us, having been written not with ink but with the ruach hakodesh of the elohim chayim, not on luchot of stone but on luchot of lev basar.
target_text: te dhu lèke le, na, miu nuka sèmi sasuri èci dhu kristus suri nare le. hèia na pangèd'u mi ji'i. kristus pake boe tinta ho na suri sasuri ne, te ngaa na pake roh mola-mèci nèti lamatua dhu mamuri. kristus kahèi dule boe lii lolo be'a na ètu hadhu kabela, nuka sèmi ama lamatua tao hia musa. te ngaa kristus dule ètu d'ara èdhi dhu mamuri.

source_text: such is the bitachon confidence that we have through rebbe, melech hamoshiach toward hashem.
target_text: ji'i bisa parcaya mi ama lamatua, na, j'ara se'e mema lèke tare'a, lula kristus ka dhu pad'elo sèmi èèna.

source_text: not that we are competent from ourselves to claim anything as of ourselves, but our competence is from hashem,
target_text: ladhe dhoka nèti ngi'u ji'i mesa mi, na, ji'i se unu boe koasa ho ad'u-ue ngaa-ngaa. te koasa dènge hak dhu ètu ji'i, kapua na nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: who also made us competent as klei kodesh mesharetim ministers of a brit chadasha - not b'khol chomer hadin not by strict letter of the law, legalism, but of the ruach hakodesh: for kol chomer hadin strict letter of the law kills, but the ruach hakodesh gives chayim -
target_text: lamatua ka dhu ded'e ji'i j'aj'i dhèu sab'a na, dhu lole dènge dhèu lula-nèti lii pajaji hiu na. te ngaa lii pajaji hiu na èèna lula boe madhutu atora rupa-rupa, te ngaa lula-nèti dhèu pa'èki dènge roh mola-mèci. ladhe dhoka tao madhutu iia d'ara di atora sèra, èèna nuka sèmi d'ara rèngu dhu madhe le dènge unu boe mamuri dhu lèke, dhu ma'ète boe èèna. te ngaa ladhe dhèu mamuri pa'èki dènge roh lamatua, nèngu unu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: now if the sherut avodas kodesh ministry of mavet chiseled in letters engraved on luchot of stone came with kavod, so that the bnei yisroel were not able to gaze into the face of moshe because of p'ni moshe ki karonface of moshe rabbeinu that he was radiant because of the kavod of his face, the kavod which is fading,
target_text: uru-uru sèra, ropa ama lamatua dule atora na ètu hadhu kabela sèra, èèna mema be'a seli eele. te ngaa masi ka dhèu madhutu aa'i atora sèra, rèngu pacèri era dènge ama lamatua. ka ropa musa sèmi nare atora se'e, rèhu na kaha'a. nèti èèna ka, dhèu isra'el bisa boe ladhe patae rèhu na. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ka, kaha'a ne ele.

source_text: then how much more will the avodas kodesh ministry of the ruach hakodesh come in kavod glory?
target_text: de ladhe dhu suri tèke ètu hadhu bisa abhu kale'e sèmi èèna, na, tasamia hari dènge ngaa dhu roh lamatua tao tèke le ètu d'ara èdhi? tatu risi hari, si?

source_text: for if there was kavod in the sherut avodas kodesh of harsha'ah condemnation, how much more abounds in kavod the ministry of tzedek,
target_text: de atora ne paj'uj'u, na, èdhi hud'i pasae tare ku huku madhe, ho pacèri nèti lamatua, lula èdhi tao boe madhutu atora aa'i-aa'i sèra. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa atora ne èra taruu era nèti lamatua. te ngaa roh lamatua èra risi eele hari nèti èèna, te nèngu ka pad'elo j'ara sèna ka èdhi pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: for indeed what once had kavod has lost its kavod on account of the surpassing kavod glory.
target_text: de atora dhu uru èèna dhèu pangee, na, dedha titu kèna, limuri ne dadedha na sèmi heka uru èèna, te ne'e ne abhu le dhu dedha risi.

source_text: for if the thing which now is fading away came with kavod, much more has that which remains come in kavod.
target_text: atora se dhu uru èèna, kaha'a nuka sèmi rèhu musa, nèbhu-nèbhu ku heka kaha'a na ele. musa dènge atora se mema dedha tare'a, te ngaa dhu dedha risi hari, nuka dhu taha taruu dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: since, then, we have such a tikvah hope, we act with much boldness.
target_text: ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi nge'a mèu, na, lii pajaji hiu lamatua èèna taha taruu, dhu ma'ète boe ciki sa. nèti èèna ka, ji'i padhai lii mola-mola dhu pa'abhe boe.

source_text: and we are not as moshe, who was putting hamasveh al panavthe veil over his face so that the bnei yisroel might not see the end of the fading kavod.
target_text: ji'i tao boe sama sèmi musa. te nèngu hud'i pa'abhe ku rèhu na dènge bèla, sèna ka dhèu isra'el bisa boe rèdhi rèhu na, ho re'a na, kaha'a èèna ele le, do dhae.

source_text: but their minds were hardened; for until the present day the same veil remains at the kri'at hasefer torah the reading of torah in shul, because the veil is taken away in moshiach.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua tao ngangee dhèu isra'el sèra topo. te toke d'ai sange ne'e, ladhe rèngu baca ètu sasuri lamatua nèti lii pajaji dhu dhui èèna, nuka sèmi bèla èci dhu hutu nare kètu ra, ka ro'o boe nanene aa ro'o boe re'a. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa bhoke d'ara rèngu, sèna ka rèngu bisa re'a mèu. dhodhoka kristus mesa na.

source_text: but even today, whenever moshe is being read, a veil lies on their levavot.
target_text: toke d'ai sange ne'e, ladhe dhèu yahudi baca sasuri musa, rèngu nanene, te ngaa re'a iia boe. ne'e ne j'aj'i lula rèngu nanene pake boe d'ara ra, lula abhu dhu pa'abhe d'ara rèngu.

source_text: but whenever one turns to adoneinu hamasveh is taken away.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu mulai parcaya kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, na, kristus ka dhu bhoke d'ara dhèu èèna, sèna ka nèngu bisa ne'a mèu. èèna sama sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua, peka na, nèngu bhoke eele le bèla dhu pahutu rèhu na.

source_text: now adoneinu is haruach and where haruach adoneinu is, there is cherut freedom.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, lod'o musa padhai lii, peka na, lamatua, sasoa na, roh ama lamatua. ladhe èdhi abhu le roh ne, nèngu tao èdhi j'aj'i mi dhèu bebas.

source_text: now all of us, with unveiled faces, seeing the kavod of adoneinu as if reflected in a mirror, are being transformed into the same demut from kavod to kavod, even as from haadon, haruach.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, na tao èdhi asa tabha èra, sama sèmi nèngu. rèhu èdhi parluu heka pahutu. aa èdhi pangee dhoka dadedha lamatua èdhi, te roh na ka dhu soru-bara èdhi.

source_text: therefore, since it is by the chesed of hashem that we have this sherut avodas kodesh ministry, we are undaunted.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu pad'elo le rasa kasia na mi dedha ji'i. nèti èèna ka, na pua le ji'i ho lole dènge dhèu lula-nèti lii pajaji hiu na. nèti èèna ka, ji'i taha taruu, dhu nge'a boe roe.

source_text: but we renounced the hidden things of bushah shame, not going about with remiyah deceit nor falsifying the dvar hashem. rather by the manifestation of haemes we present ourselves to every manʼs matzpun in the sight of hashem.
target_text: de karèi nèti uru ka ji'i pama'ète ngare le, na: ji'i peka-padhai mola-mola, na, ji'i tao boe j'ara-j'ara bhabhelu-katub'a sama sèmi dhèu leo. dhèu sèra tao pahuni-pahuni sèna ka dhèu baku ladhe rèdhi. aa rèngu dhu re'a boe makae. te ngaa ji'i ngo'o boe kapod'e dhèu. ji'i kahèi padhai lii hèb'a hua boe lula lii holo-nori ama lamatua, te ngaa ji'i aj'a-nori dènge mola-mola madhutu ngaa dhu lèke. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa parisa unu ra lii padhai ji'i ètu madha lamatua, aa nile unu ra, ji'i se dhèu sèmi ngaa sa.

source_text: but if indeed our besuras hageulah is nistar hidden, it is nistar among the ones perishing,
target_text: ladhe dhèu ro'o boe sèmi rare lii lolo be'a lamatua dhu ji'i aj'a sèra, rèngu laho kahèi, lula rèngu cèri eele nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: in whose case the g-d of the olam hazeh blinded the minds of the ones without emunah, so the illumination of the besuras hageulah of the kavod of moshiach, who is the demut of hashem, would not shine on them.
target_text: dhèu aae nidhu, nuka sèmi lamatua èci dhu dhèu lasi sogo-tagu. na ad'u-ue pa'ele iie kahadhu dhèu cahag'e, ka d'ara dhèu se j'aj'i maroga kiu-kiu. rèngu se dhèu dhu parcaya boe ama lamatua èdhi. lula rèngu bèdhu, bisa boe ladhe rèdhi saraa nèti ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka rèngu bisa boe re'a lii lolo be'a lula-nèti kristus. rèngu re'a boe kahèi dadedha kristus. te kristus ne, ca ropa dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: for we preach not ourselves but rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu yehoshua and ourselves as your avadim servants for yehoshuaʼs sake.
target_text: ji'i padhai lii boe padedha iisi ji'i. te ngaa ji'i padhai lii padedha kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. dhu ji'i padhai lula ngi'u ji'i dhodhoka sèmi ne'e di: nuka ji'i tao iisi ji'i nuka sèmi ana pua-paleha, sèna ka laladhe-leru miu lula ji'i j'aj'i dhèu unu yesus.

source_text: because hashem is the one who said, let ohr shine out of choshech who shone in our levavot for an illumination of the da'as of the kavod of hashem in the face of rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua.
target_text: uru-uru sèra ama lamatua dhu peka nèdhi le, na, hud'i dènge ku saraa dhu heo ètu era maroga. hèia na tao saraa na ho pasaraa d'ara èdhi. te nèngu d'èi pala-bagi èdhi saraa na. sasoa na, ropa èdhi pangee lula-nèti kristus, èdhi sanèd'e kahèi dadedha ama lamatua.

source_text: now we have this otzar treasure in earthen vessels that the excellence of the ko'ach may be of hashem and not of us.
target_text: masi ka ji'i se dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa lamatua hia mèdha dhu kab'ua ètu d'ara ji'i. ne'e nuka sèmi dhèu èci tèke mèdha na dhu kab'ua ètu d'ara èru rai. mèdha dhu kab'ua ne, nuka saraa ama lamatua. de dhu lèke ka, koasa dhu kapai dhu ji'i unu, mai boe nèti ji'i, te ngaa kapua na nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: being oppressed on every side but not being crushed, being perplexed but not in ye'ush despair, atzvut,
target_text: de masi ka dhèu ènyi raruri ji'i ètu mia-mia, te ngaa ji'i taha taruu. masi ka ji'i nge'a aa'i boe, te ngaa ji'i ele boe ngangee.

source_text: being persecuted but not forsaken, being cast down but not destroyed,
target_text: masi ka dhèu paj'èra ji'i ae-ae, te ngaa ama lamatua pa'ana-lalu eele boe ji'i. masi ka dhèu dhedhe ji'i, te ngaa rèngu bisa boe palaho ji'i.

source_text: always bearing about the dying of rebbe, melech hamoshiach in my basar that also the chayyim of moshiach in geviyyateinu might be manifested.
target_text: lula ji'i abhu j'aj'èra ae-ae, nèti èèna ka ladhe ji'i ètu mia, ji'i bisa lolo dènge dhèu, peka na, yesus abhu j'aj'èra ae-ae kahèi, lod'o na madhe. te masi ka dhèu paj'èra ji'i rupa-rupa, te ngaa ji'i madhe boe. ne'e ne pasanèd'e dhèu, peka na, yesus mamuri taruu ètu d'ara ji'i.

source_text: for always we, the ones living, are being given over to mavet because of moshiach that also the chayyim of moshiach may be manifested in our mortal basar.
target_text: mema tare'a! ae le mamuri ji'i dhu abhu j'aj'èra oe madhe, lula ji'i j'aj'i dhèu unu yesus. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa re'a, na, yesus pala mamuri dhu lèke mi ji'i, masi ka bèli-camèd'a ji'i madhe.

source_text: so then mavet works in us but chayyim in you.
target_text: de masi ka lèpa limuri ji'i madhe, te ngaa ji'i madha'u boe padhue-padhai lula-nèti kristus. te ji'i sadia madhe sèmi èèna, sèna ka miu abhu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: and having the same ruach hakodesh of emunah that is in accordance with the kitvei hakodesh, he'emaniti ki adaberi believed, therefore i speak, we both believed and therefore we speak,
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua dhu suri, na, lula ja'a parcaya lamatua, nèti èèna ka ja'a padhai lii. ngangee ji'i sama kahèi. lula ji'i lèka lamatua, nèti èèna ka ji'i hud'i lole ku dènge dhèu lula-nèti yesus kristus.

source_text: having da'as that the one who made to stand up alive adoneinu rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua will make us also with yehoshua stand up alive and will present us with you.
target_text: ji'i nge'a, na, ama lamatua ka dhu pamamuri hari kètu èdhi, yesus kristus nèti mamadhe na. èèna na nèngu kahèi ka dhu pamamuri hari èdhi, lula èdhi pa'èki dènge yesus. bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua patitu èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti ètu madha na, sèna ka sèmi nare èdhi.

source_text: for all things are because of you that the chen v'chesed hashem, having increased through the many, may increase the hodayah thanksgiving to the kavod of hashem.
target_text: lamatua tao j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka soru-bara miu. nèngu neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na kahèi mi dhèu dhu asa tabha ae. èèna na lii manèngi makasi rèngu mi lamatua asa tabha ae, aa ra mangaku dadedha na kahèi.

source_text: therefore we are undaunted and do not lose chozek strength. for, indeed, even if our outward man is becoming old and atrophied, yet our inward man is yom yom being renewed.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi taha taruu, aa ele boe ngangee. masi ka ngi'u èdhi asa roe-bhilu, te ngaa ama lamatua asa pa'èra d'ara èdhi nèti ca lod'o asa ca lod'o.

source_text: for our present momentary tzoros is preparing us for an eternal weight of kavod glory utterly beyond measure,
target_text: te madhutu ngangee èdhi, lod'o limuri ne èdhi dhu abhu sasusa rupa-rupa. te ngaa èdhi hud'i sanèd'e ku, bèli-camèd'a lamatua neo ded'e èdhi padedha-dedha. nèti èèna ka èdhi hud'i te'a, na, ngaa dhu j'aj'i se'e dènge boe sasoa!

source_text: while we continue to look not at the visible things but the invisible; for the things visible are zemanniyim temporary but the things invisible are for l'olamim.
target_text: de èdhi hud'i ngee paie-iie ku mi j'ara-j'ara dhu tèdhi mèka. baku pangee dhoka mi dhu ladhe tèdhi di. te j'ara-j'ara dhu ladhe tèdhi, taha boe nare nèbhu. te ngaa j'ara dhu tèdhi mèka sèra ka dhu taha taruu, aa dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: for we have da'as that if the beit mishkaneinu is made churban, we have a bais from hashem, not made with hands, a bais l'olamim b'shomayim.
target_text: te èdhi te'a, na, ngi'u aae ne, èdhi pake taha ètu rai-haha di, nuka sèmi paleo dhu èdhi patitu taha. masi ka ngi'u aae èdhi ele iie, te ngaa èdhi baku pangee, lula ama lamatua dhu sadia tèke le era dhu be'a èci hia èdhi ètu sorga. era ne'e, j'aj'i boe nèti pa'ue-ai dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa j'aj'i nèti pa'ue-ai lamatua. nèti èèna ka, era ne'e taha taruu.

source_text: for indeed in this mishkaneinu we groan, longing for the train of our robe to be our sukkah from shomayim.
target_text: te ngi'u aae èdhi ne roe-bhilu ètu rai-haha ne. ka èdhi neo titu kèna abhu ngi'u hiu dhu èdhi pake ètu sorga.

source_text: if indeed thus clothed we will not be found naked.
target_text: hèia ropa èdhi d'ai era nèi, èdhi sama boe sèmi dhèu dhu dènge boe mèdha-papake ètu ngi'u, te ngaa pake mèdha hiu ètu ua èdhi. te èdhi j'aj'i boe samanga di, te ngaa ètu nèi èdhi abhu ngi'u hiu kahèi.

source_text: for while we are still in this mishkan, we groan under our burden, in as much as we do not want to be unclothed but to be clothed, that the mortal may be swallowed up by chayyim.
target_text: ngi'u aae èdhi dhu ele iie ne, tao èdhi mangeta, lula rasa j'èra. masi ka sèmi èèna, to'o boe madhe, ho tèke eele ngi'u aae ne. aad'o! èdhi neo abhu ngi'u dhu hiu, sèna ka tèke eele ngi'u dhui, gati dènge mamuri hiu dhu lèke.

source_text: now the one having prepared us for this very thing is hashem, the one having given us the eravon pledge of the ruach hakodesh.
target_text: ama lamatua ne'e ka dhu pa'èra èdhi ho sèmi tare mamuri dhu hiu. nèngu kahèi bagi hia èdhi roh na, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha nèti lii pajaji na.

source_text: therefore we always have bitachon since we have da'as that being at home in the basar, we are away from home in adoneinu.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi taha dènge d'ara èra taruu. èdhi te'a, na, lod'o èdhi mamuri era ètu d'ara ngi'u aae ne'e ne, èdhi pakaj'èu nèti lamatua.

source_text: for we walk by emunah faith, not by sight;
target_text: nèti èèna ka èdhi mamuri dènge parcaya mi ama lamatua. èdhi mamuri boe dènge ngaa dhu èdhi ladhe tèdhi ètu rai-haha ne di.

source_text: therefore we have bitachon and are pleased rather to leave home from the basar and to be at home with adoneinu.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi te'a tare'a-re'a kahèi, na, ladhe èdhi madhe tèke eele ngi'u aae ne, ho lati mamuri sama-sama dènge ama lamatua ètu sorga, na, tatu èdhi karej'e risi eele hari.

source_text: therefore, also we are aspiring, whether at home, or away from home, to be well pleasing to hashem,
target_text: masi ka èdhi mamuri taruu ètu rai-haha ne, do madhe ètu ne'e sèna ka mamuri ètu nèi, te ngaa dhu lèke ka, èdhi hud'i pakarej'e ku d'ara lamatua. te dad'èi èdhi kèna.

source_text: since it is necessary for all of us to be revealed/laid bare for an appearance before the kisse din judgment throne, i. e. , moshiachʼs bet din of moshiach, in order that each one of us individually may receive recompense for the things done in the basar, according to his ma'asim, whether tov or rah.
target_text: baku bhèlu. bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i lasi paraga dènge kristus. nèngu ne'e ka dhu pama'ète lii langu madhutu tatao dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha. hèia kristus b'ala dhu pamèci dènge tatao dhu dhèu ad'u-ue. te kristus ne'a, dhèu ne tao be'a do tao dhu karehe.

source_text: therefore, since we have da'as of the yirat moshiach adoneinu, we persuade men, and we have been made manifest to hashem and i have tikvah also that we have been made manifest to your matzpunim.
target_text: lula ji'i nge'a, na, bèli-camèd'a kristus parisa mamuri ji'i, nèti èèna ka ji'i hud'i madha'u, aa pakab'ua ne. ka ji'i sab'a pa'èra-èra ho pamako dhèu, sèna ka ra parcaya kristus. ama lamatua dhu ne'a d'ara mola ji'i. ja'a d'èi kahèi, ladhe miu me'a d'ara mola ji'i se.

source_text: we are not commending ourselves to you again, but are giving an opportunity to you of glorying on behalf of us that you may respond to those who glory in outer appearance and not in lev.
target_text: ji'i padedha boe iisi ji'i ètu madha miu. aad'o! te ngaa ji'i dhoka hia miu j'ara dhu be'a, sèna ka miu bisa pakab'ua ji'i dhu dènge boe makae. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, miu bisa dhaa lii dhèu dhu hèb'a aae. te rèngu dhèu dhu koa iisi lula sasab'a-la'a rèngu dhu dhèu ladhe rèdhi, aa te ngaa d'ara rèngu mola boe.

source_text: for if we have hislayves and dveykes ecstasy, it is for hashem; if we are in our right mind, it is for you.
target_text: ladhe miu pangee, na, ji'i se huj'u, hèia ji'i padhai lii sèmi èèna ho pakako sasab'a lamatua. masi ka miu me'a boe, te ngaa lamatua ne'a. ladhe ji'i padhai lii pake ngangee dhu mola, na, ji'i padhai lii sèmi èèna, ho soru-bara miu.

source_text: for the ahavah love of rebbe, melech hamoshiach controls us, because we have judged this, that one moshiach died on behalf of all and therefore all died.
target_text: kristus sue èdhi titu kèna. ne'e ne ka dhu pa'èra d'ara ji'i, ho pakako sasab'a-la'a ji'i. te ji'i parcaya, na, dhèu èci, nuka kristus, madhe gati dhèu aa'i-aa'i. sasoa na, èèna sama sèmi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti madhe tèke eele mamuri dhui, aa dhu dènge heka hak ngaa-ngaa ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and moshiach died on behalf of all, that the ones living may no longer live to themselves but may live to the one moshiach who both died and has been made to stand up alive in his techiyas hamoshiach for their sakes.
target_text: kristus madhe pala dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha ne, mamuri heka madhutu dad'èi mesa ra. te ngaa rèngu hud'i mamuri madhutu dad'èi kristus, lula nèngu madhe le gati rèngu, hèia na mamuri hari.

source_text: from now on, therefore, we have da'as of no one from a purely human point of view; if indeed we have had da'as of rebbe, melech hamoshiach according to the basar, we now no longer so have da'as of him,
target_text: de karèi nèti deo ne'e, èdhi baku nile dhèu madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha. masi ka uru èèna èdhi nile kristus pake ngangee dhèu biasa. te ngaa limuri ne, ji'i nile heka nèngu sèmi èèna.

source_text: so that if anyone is in moshiach, he is a bria chadashaa new being: the old things passed away; hinei, all has become chadashot.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu dhu pa'èki dènge kristus j'aj'i le dhèu hiu, dhu unu mamuri hiu. dhèu ne sèmi heka uru èèna, lula mamuri dhui na ele le. te limuri ne, dhu hiu abhu le.

source_text: and all things are of hashem, who is the one having granted to us ritztzuy reconciliation to himself through moshiach and has given to us the sherut haritztzuy the ministry of reconciliation,
target_text: aa'i-aa'i se, ama lamatua ka dhu tao. nèngu ka dhu padame, sèna ka èdhi bisa pabe'a hari dènge ne, lula kristus saku eele le sasala-sasigo èdhi. hèia na pangèd'u èdhi sasab'a, ho èdhi pad'elo j'ara sèna ka dhèu leo kahèi bisa padame hari dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: davka specifically, that hashem was in moshiach reconciling the olam to himself, not reckoning their avonot against them and putting in us the dvar haritztzuy message of reconciliation.
target_text: sanèd'e, te lod'o kristus pea ètu rai-haha ne era, ama lamatua dhu pake ne ho lere nèti dhèu padame hari dènge ama lamatua. de nèngu ige heka sasala dhèu, ka rèngu dui heka hahuku nèti sasala. hèia na pua èdhi lati peka dènge dhèu, na, rèngu bisa pabe'a dènge nèngu.

source_text: on behalf of rebbe, melech hamoshiach, therefore, we are emissaries of shalom, as if hashem were entreating through us, we ask on behalf of rebbe, melech hamoshiach: be reconciled to hashem!
target_text: te èdhi j'aj'i duta kristus. de ama lamatua pake èdhi ho tèti dhèu mai, sèna ka padame dènge ne. lula ji'i j'aj'i duta kristus, nèti èèna ka ji'i manèngi miu kahèi, na, lamatua d'èi titu kèna, ladhe miu pabe'a hari dènge ne.

source_text: the one who in his person had no da'as of chataah sin, this one hashem made chataah on our behalf that we might become the tzidkat hashem in moshiach.
target_text: kristus mesa na tao nèdhi boe sala. te ngaa ama lamatua hia ne pasae sasala-sasigo èdhi. lamatua tao j'ara ne hia èdhi, lula mamadhe kristus bhoke j'ara, sèna ka èdhi bisa mamuri dènge d'ara mola, sama sèmi lamatua d'ara mola kahèi.

source_text: as we work together with him, we also urge you not to receive the chen v'chesed hashem in vain.
target_text: lula ji'i sab'a sama-sama dènge lamatua, ji'i pasanèd'e miu sèmi ne'e: ama lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na ae-ae mi dedha miu. de miu baku sèmi mere d'ara hua iia na iia-iia d'ara.

source_text: for he says, in a time acceptable i heard you and in a day of salvation i helped you. hinei, now is the acceptable time; now is the yom yeshu'ah,
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci na dhu suri tèke, peka na, ropa d'ai ka lod'o na, ja'a nanene lii èu. ja'a soru-bara èu kahèi, ropa ja'a pala-bagi mamuri mi dhèu. de nanene pabe'a-be'a! ne'e ne, d'ai lod'o dhu hua iia èèna kèna. te ne'e ne, d'ai lod'o lamatua kèna ho pala-bagi mamuri mi dhèu.

source_text: not giving in anything a cause for michshol, lest the messianic avodas kodesh holy worship, service be blamed;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ji'i j'aga mamuri ji'i pabe'a-be'a sèna ka mamuri mola. te ji'i ngo'o boe bhabhae dhèu dhu neo mai asa j'ara mamuri lamatua. aa ji'i neo padhai mola-mola kahèi, sèna ka dhèu baku pa'ele iie kolongara ji'i.

source_text: but in everything presenting ourselves as klei kodesh of hashem in much savlanut patience, in tzoros, in hardships, in distresses,
target_text: aa aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i sab'a, ji'i tenge j'ara ho pad'elo, na, ji'i dhèu sab'a dhu be'a nèti ama lamatua. de masi ka ji'i abhu susa, do paraga dènge j'aj'èra, do mamuri ètu d'ara talora aae patao-palaha, ji'i taha taruu.

source_text: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in tzomot;
target_text: ji'i taha kahèi ètu d'ara lod'o dhèu gama ji'i, lod'o ra pamaso ji'i asa d'ara bèdho, lod'o ra patao-palaha, lod'o ji'i sab'a bia, lod'o ji'i abhu boe pasaruru musi madha, aa lod'o ji'i manganga.

source_text: in purity, in da'as, in longsuffering, in chesed, in the ruach hakodesh, in ahavah amittit,
target_text: ji'i taha dènge d'ara mola kahèi. ji'i nge'a ae lula-nèti ama lamatua. ji'i taha dènge d'ara taleo. ji'i tao dhu be'a hia dhèu. ji'i soro tèke roh lamatua ator ji'i. sasue ji'i mola-mola mi dedha dhèu.

source_text: in the dvar haemes, in the gevurat hashem, through the weapons of tzedek of the right hand and of the left.
target_text: ladhe ji'i padhai lii, ji'i padhai dhu lèke, dhu nge'a boe monya. ji'i sèmi ngare koasa nèti lamatua kahèi, sèna ka tao dhu be'a. ji'i nuka sèmi sordad'u dhu ngèd'u rèka dhu tesa nèti lamatua, sèna ka lab'a musu, aa segi taruu.

source_text: through honor and dishonor, through ill repute and good repute; as deceivers and yet true,
target_text: ji'i taha kahèi masi ka dhèu pakab'ua, do pahahe ji'i; masi ka dhèu padhai lii pamanahu ji'i, do ra j'aga kolongara ji'i; masi ka dhèu monya, peka na, ji'i kapod'e-kabèli dhèu, do ra peka na, ji'i padhai lii dhu lèke.

source_text: as being unknown and yet being well known, as dying and hinei, we live! as given the mishpat mavet and yet not penalized with death;
target_text: abhu dhu tadhe boe ji'i, te ngaa abhu dhèu ae kahèi dhu re'a ngara ji'i. pèri-pèri hari kèna, ji'i se oe madhe, te ngaa ji'i mamuri era. dhèu huku ji'i bia pèri-pèri hari kèna, te ngaa ji'i madhe boe.

source_text: as having agmat nefesh but always having simcha, as poor but enriching many, as having nothing and yet possessing everything.
target_text: masi ka ji'i rasa bia, te ngaa ji'i karej'e-karae taruu kahèi. masi ka ji'i dènge boe doi-dhari, te ngaa ji'i tao dhèu ae j'aj'i kaja ètu d'ara ra. èèna nuka sèmi ji'i unu boe ngaa-ngaa, te ngaa ji'i unu aa'i mèu-mèu kahèi.

source_text: we have spoken freely with you corinthians, our levavot has been enlarged.
target_text: ji'i padhai lii paled'a-led'a hia miu dhu ètu kota korintus ne. aa ji'i sue miu tare'a-re'a.

source_text: there is no penury in our affections, only in yours.
target_text: ji'i pad'elo le sasue ji'i mi dedha miu dènge d'ara kateme. te ngaa sasue miu mi ji'i kura, lula dènge boe d'ara kateme.

source_text: now - i speak as to yeladim - make a fair exchange and open wide your levavot.
target_text: de ja'a neo holo miu nuka sèmi holo ana-ana ja'a. be'a risi miu sue ji'i dènge d'ara kateme.

source_text: do not become unequally yoked with koferimunbelievers, for what shuttafut partnership has tzedek with lawlessness? or where is the brit covenant between ohr light and choshech darkness?
target_text: baku pakadheb'e dènge dhèu dhu parcaya boe kristus. te miu sama boe dènge rèngu. dhèu parcaya dhu mamuri mola, sama boe dènge dhèu dhu lab'a lamatua, de nia boe ladhe ra tenge j'ara ho sab'a pa'èci. dhèu be'a dènge dhèu be'a boe, pantas boe pa'èci. èèna nuka sèmi saraa bisa boe pa'èci dènge maroga.

source_text: and what harmony does rebbe, melech hamoshiach have with b'liya'al? or what chelek allotment, inheritance has a ma'amin with an apikoros?
target_text: kristus bisa boe d'ara èci dènge dhèu aae nidhu, si? sèmi èèna kahèi, dhèu dhu parcaya ama lamatua abhu pusaka, te ngaa dhèu dhu parcaya boe abhu boe pala.

source_text: and what agreement has the heikhal of hashem with elilim? for we are a heikhal of the elohim chayyim as g-d said, v'hithallachti b'tochchem and i will walk in the midst of you, it will be mishkani alehem dwelling place of me with them, v'hayu li l'am vaani eheyeh lahem lelohim and they will be to me as people and i will be to them as g-d.
target_text: de a'abhu miu, sa mia? ele boe miu pangee, na, miu bisa lami asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a ama lamatua sèna ka pahaha iisi mi nèngu, èle na lami sogo-tagu hari asa èmu sogo-tagu nidhu, do? bisa boe, si? te lamatua èèna, ama lamatua dhu mamuri. nèngu j'aj'i kètu èdhi kahèi. ka èdhi j'aj'i le sama sèmi èmu sabaj'a na, lula nèngu pea ètu d'ara èdhi. te lamatua suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci na, peka na, èmu ja'a ètu talora aae dhèu-dhèu ja'a. ja'a laku-mai nèti talora aae rèngu kahèi. ja'a neo j'aj'i ama lamatua rèngu. rèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a kahèi.

source_text: therefore, suru depart! , come out from the midst of them and be separated, says adoneinu, and a tameh al tigauunclean thing do not touch; ertzeh etchem and i will receive you,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, lamatua suri sèmi ne'e kahèi, na, miu hud'i kalua nèti talora aae rèngu, aa pacèri nèti rèngu, sèna ka miu baku j'aj'i sama sèmi rèngu. d'ara miu hud'i mola-mèci. aa miu hud'i pakaj'èu nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu pakaj'alu d'ara miu, dènge sèmi èèna, ja'a sèmi kore miu dènge be'a.

source_text: and i will be to you an av and you will be to me banim and banot my sons and daughters, says adonoi tzva'ot.
target_text: ja'a neo j'aj'i ama miu; aa miu j'aj'i ana-ana ja'a. se'e se ka dhu kètu èdhi peka tèke, nèngu ka dhu unu koasa risi aa'i.

source_text: therefore, having these havtachot promises, chaverim, let us submit to his tahorah, cleansing ourselves from every defilement of basar and ruach, perfecting kedushah holiness in yirat shomayim.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! lula ama lamatua padhadha tèke le ho pala-bagi èdhi j'ara se aa'i-aa'i, nèti èèna ka èdhi hud'i pamèu ku d'ara dènge mamuri èdhi. baku tèke eele hahera ciki sa hèi ètu mamuri èdhi. te èdhi neo sèna ka mamuri èdhi mola-mèci tare'a-re'a hia mi ama lamatua, sèna ka pad'elo, na, èdhi madha'u dènge pakab'ua nèngu.

source_text: in your levavot make a cheder for us; we wronged no one, we ruined no one, we exploited no one.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! hia ji'i tebho. bhoke d'ara miu ho sèmi mere ji'i dènge be'a. baku soro kabodho mi ji'i. te uru èèna, lod'o ji'i ètu talora aae miu, ji'i tao ngèdhi boe sala ngaa-ngaa mi dhèu èci sa. ji'i dadugu ngèdhi mèka dhèu ho ad'u-ue sasala. ji'i kapod'e-kabèli ngèdhi mèka dhèu, sèna ka abhu oto nèti rèngu kahèi.

source_text: i do not say this to bring you under harsha'ah, for i have said before that you are in our levavot whether to die with you or to live with you.
target_text: lii padhai ja'a ne, neo boe pèci sasala asa dedha miu. te ja'a dhu peka le, na, ji'i sue miu. de tasa mera mia èèna ka, ji'i se dhu pa'èki dènge miu, masi ka ji'i madhe do mamuri.

source_text: i have much ometz lev boldness and confidence toward you. i glory much on your behalf. i have been filled with chozek strength. i am filled to overflowing with simcha at all of our tzoros.
target_text: ne'e ne ja'a parluu heka pangee ae-ae, te ja'a lèka miu. ja'a koa miu, aa miu pa'èra d'ara ja'a kahèi. de masi ka ji'i abhu susa rupa-rupa, te ngaa d'ara ja'a karej'e-karae taruu, lula miu.

source_text: for indeed when we had come into macedonia we had no physical mano'ach rest but we had tzoros everywhere: battles on the outside, fears inside.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ji'i dhiu asa propensi makedonia, ngi'u ji'i roe-bhilu. te ji'i abhu susa nèti g'ana-kariu. ji'i pab'ala d'ara lii dènge dhèu dhu parcaya boe. d'ara ji'i madha'u kahèi.

source_text: but hashem who encourages the lowly, encouraged us by the coming of titos;
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu pa'èra dhèu dhu ele ngangee. hèia nèngu pa'èra d'ara ji'i, ropa na pua titus mai dènge ji'i.

source_text: and not only by the coming of him, but also by the encouragement by which he was encouraged over you, reporting to us your longing, your mourning, your kanous zeal for me, so that it caused me to have even more simcha.
target_text: nèti mamai titus ne'e ka d'ara ji'i èra hari. te nèngu peka na, lod'o nèngu ètu nèi era, miu dhu pa'èra d'ara na. lii lolo nèngu ne'e ka, pa'èra d'ara ji'i. nèngu lolo kahèi, na, miu neo titu kèna mèdhi rèhu ja'a, aa miu manyasa kahèi lula lii langu dhu uru èèna j'aj'i ètu talora aae miu. aa titus peka kahèi, na, miu tenge j'ara ho soru-bara ja'a. nèti èèna ka, d'ara ja'a karej'e-karae.

source_text: because if indeed i caused you agmat nefesh grief by the iggeret, i do not regret it, though i did regret it, but i see that that iggeret grieved you only briefly.
target_text: ja'a ke'a, na, isi sasuri ja'a uru èèna dhu pasanèd'e miu dènge lii sakaa, èèna ka dhu papèd'a d'ara miu. te ngaa ja'a manyasa boe ja'a suri sasuri èèna. aa te ngaa lod'o èèna ja'a ako manyasa, ropa ke'a, na, nèti sasuri ja'a ka d'ara miu pèd'a, masi ka nare boe nèbhu.

source_text: now i have simcha, not that you had agmat nefesh, but that your grief brought you to teshuva, for your agmat nefesh was in hashem, so that by us you suffered in nothing.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, d'ara ja'a karej'e. ja'a karej'e boe lula uru èèna miu ètu d'ara susa. aad'o! ja'a karej'e lula lod'o èèna, sasuri ja'a dhu pamako miu sèna ka ele-ho'a. hèia miu mangaku sasala miu, aa tèke eele j'ara-j'ara dhu karehe, sèna ka kabèli hari ho madhutu j'ara mamuri mola nèti lamatua. te lamatua ka dhu tao miu manyasa. j'ara ne, nèti boe ji'i dhu tao miu j'aj'i maruru.

source_text: for the agmat nefesh that is according to hashem produces teshuva to yeshu'at eloheinu, not to be regretted, but the agmat nefesh of the olam hazeh produces mavet.
target_text: te ladhe èdhi manyasa ètu d'ara èdhi, madhutu dad'èi lamatua, na, èdhi ae eele nèti tao j'ara dhu bhèlu, hèia lèpa hari madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu mola. ne'e ne ka dhu pakaj'èu èdhi nèti hahuku ama lamatua, ka èdhi mamuri heka dènge d'ara manyasa taruu. te ngaa ladhe èdhi dhoka manyasa ètu hèb'a di, sama sèmi dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, èèna na èdhi cèri eele nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: for, hinei, see what zerizut diligence this agmat nefesh of hashem has produced in you, what defense, what indignation, what yirat shomayim, what longing, what kanous zeal, what onesh punishment! at every point you proved yourselves to be without ashma guilt in the matter.
target_text: miu pangee sèku! lod'o miu baca sasuri ja'a, ja'a ke'a na, miu manyasa kahèi. èèna palèke dènge dad'èi lamatua. ne'e ne ka pa'èra miu ho miu core eele bhabhèlu nèti mamuri miu. miu roe-bhilu le ètu d'ara bhabhelu miu. miu madha'u kahèi, mage dhoka manahu hari asa d'ara bhabhelu-katub'a. miu neo mèdhi ja'a, aa pa'èra taruu ho tao j'ara be'a. miu pa'èra kahèi ho neo huku dhèu dhu ad'u-ue sasala. lula miu tao j'ara dhu lèke sèmi èèna, nèti èèna ka miu mola-mèci. dènge j'ara ne'e, abhu boe dhu bisa pèci sasala asa miu.

source_text: then though i wrote an iggeret to you, it was not for the sake of the one having done hara'ah the evil, nor for the sake of the one who was beleidikt offended, but for the sake of your kanous zeal for us becoming manifest to you before hashem.
target_text: de sasuri ja'a uru èèna, hia boe mi dhèu dhu tao bhabhelu, do, mi dhèu dhu lèke j'aj'èra nèti bhabhelu na. te ngaa ja'a suri sasuri èèna hia miu, sèna ka ja'a pad'elo, na, lii padhai miu ètu madha lamatua èèna tare'a-re'a. aa miu tare'a-re'a sue ji'i.

source_text: in this we have chozek strength. but in addition to our encouragement, we had still more simcha at the simcha of titos, because his neshamah has been set at rest by all of you;
target_text: se'e se aa'i-aa'i ra pa'èra d'ara ja'a. miu pa'èra d'ara titus kahèi, sèna ka d'ara na bisa mera-milu. sèra sa, asa pakarej'e d'ara ji'i.

source_text: because if i have been somewhat boastful about you corinthians to titos, i was in this not put to shame, but just as everything we said to you is haemes, so also our boasting to titos has proven true as well.
target_text: ja'a koa-kad'iri miu ètu madha titus, lula tatao miu dhu be'a. ja'a peka kahèi dènge ne, na, miu pamakae mèdhi mèka ja'a. te j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i lolo ngèdhi dènge miu sèra lèke tare'a. aa j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i lolo dènge titus lula-nèti miu lèke tare'a kahèi.

source_text: and his lev heart goes out to you, all the more as he has zikaron of the mishma'at obedience of all of you as you received him b'yirah with fear and bira'dah trembling.
target_text: de lod'o-lod'o na ngee nèdhi tatao dènge lii padhai miu, sasue na mi dedha miu asa tabha. aa nèngu sanèd'e kahèi ropa na dhiu asa miu, ka miu sèmi mere ne dènge be'a, te ngaa isi sasuri ja'a j'aj'i ngangee mi miu.

source_text: i have simcha that in everything i have confidence in you.
target_text: d'ara ja'a karej'e-karae, lula ja'a bisa parcaya miu ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. de d'ara ja'a kabèdhi heka dènge miu!

source_text: now we make known to you, achim b'moshiach, the chen v'chesed hashem that was granted to moshiachʼs kehillot of macedonia,
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! dad'èi ji'i ka ladhe miu me'a mèu d'ara hua iia ama lamatua, dhu na pad'elo mi dedha juma'at-juma'at ètu propensi makedonia.

source_text: that during a great ordeal of tzoros, their abundant simcha and the extreme depth of their oni poverty abounded to the osher riches of their generosity;
target_text: te masi ka rèngu abhu susa ae-ae, te ngaa d'ara rèngu karej'e taruu. nèti èèna ka, masi ka rèngu unu boe ngaa-ngaa, te ngaa ra hia doi ae-ae dènge d'ara mola-mèci, ho soru-bara dhèu parcaya dhu abhu sasusa.

source_text: that according to their ability, i give solemn edut, and ad kdei kach so much even beyond their ability, they gave voluntarily and of their own accord,
target_text: ja'a bisa lole kahèi, na, dhu rèngu hia sèra, hia aa'i nèti dhu rèngu bisa hia. aa ra hia risi nèti sèra sa kahèi. abhu boe dhèu dhu laka-seti si.

source_text: begging us, requesting from us the privilege of participating in giving tzedakah to the messianic jewish ministry of the kedoshim,
target_text: rèngu mesa ra ka dhu tare'a-re'a manèngi, sèna ka ji'i bhoke j'ara hia si. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu bisa abhu bagian ho soru-bara dhèu dhu abhu susa ètu yerusalem.

source_text: and this not merely according to tikvateinu. they gave themselves first to adoneinu and to us birtzon hashemin the will of g-d,
target_text: uru èèna, ji'i sanao sèna ka ra tao sèmi ne'e, te ngaa dhu ra tao èèna, risi nèti dhu ji'i sanao! dhu uru j'ara, rèngu hia mamuri ra asa ama lamatua. hèia ra peka kahèi, na, ji'i neo soro mamuri ji'i, sèna ka lalau-lalo'o miu, lula èèna ka dhu madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: so that it was necessary for us to urge titos that as he began and made a haschala start before, so he should complete among you also this mitzvah of avodas kodesh of the chen v'chesed hashem.
target_text: lula conto nèti juma'at-juma'at ètu makedonia sèmi èèna, nèti èèna ka ji'i manèngi titus lèpa hari asa miu ètu korintus, sèna ka miu soru-bara kahèi dhèu unu lamatua dhu abhu sasusa ètu yerusalem. te uru èèna, nèngu ka dhu mulai pakaboko doi-dhari ho hia si. hèia limuri ne, ji'i manèngi sèna ka nèngu bisa tao pamèci sasab'a-la'a miu ho soru-bara dhèu.

source_text: now just as you abound in everything - in emunah, in torah, in da'as and in all zerizut diligence and in our ahavah love for you - see also that you excel in this chen v'chesed hashem.
target_text: sasab'a miu hia ama lamatua èèna, be'a titu kèna. conto sèmi: parcaya miu èra, lii padhai miu be'a; miu me'a ae j'ara-j'ara lamatua; miu sab'a dènge maj'èni; aa miu sue ji'i d'ai seli. nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo ho miu soru-bara kahèi dhèu unu lamatua dhu abhu sasusa, dènge j'ara hia si doi ae-ae.

source_text: i do not lay this out as a mitzvah, but the sincerity of your ahavah i am testing against the zerizut of others,
target_text: ja'a paredha boe miu ètu korintus, sèna ka hia si doi ae-ae, te ngaa ja'a neo cob'a miu. te juma'at-juma'at ètu makedonia neo le soru-bara dhèu sèra. de dènge j'ara ne'e miu bisa pad'elo, na, miu tare'a-re'a sue dhèu dhu ètu d'ara sasusa kahèi.

source_text: for you have da'as of the chen v'chesed of adoneinu rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua, who, though being rich, for your sakes, he became poor, that you by moshiachʼs oni poverty may become rich.
target_text: te miu me'a, na, kètu èdhi, yesus kristus pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi miu. mema nèngu kaja. te ngaa na pama'ète nare ho tao iisi na j'aj'i dhèu unu boe ngaa-ngaa sèna ka soru-bara miu, ho miu j'aj'i kaja ètu madha j'ara ae-ae.

source_text: and in this i give my etza advice: it is tov me'od that last shanah you were the first not only to give tzedakah but also to be willing to do so.
target_text: ranga-jahi na, miu mulai pakaboko le doi ho hia rèngu. mesa boe miu hia doi-dhari di, te ngaa miu soru-bara nèti d'ara miu kahèi. de madhutu a'abhu ja'a, miu hud'i tao ku sèmi ne'e:

source_text: now also complete what you started! then your readiness in desiring it may be matched by your finishing it from what you have.
target_text: uru èèna, miu pama'ète mere le neo soru-bara dhèu unu lamatua dhu abhu sasusa ètu yerusalem nèi. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka ngaa dhu miu dhae pakaboko mere mèka, na, pa'oru aa'i si ho hia ka. aa ca ngaa dhu miu bisa hia, na, hia laa. dhu lèke ka, hia dènge d'ara kateme.

source_text: for if the readiness is already present, it is acceptable according to whatever one may have - not according to what one does not have.
target_text: te ladhe èdhi hia dènge d'ara kateme madhutu ngaa dhu èdhi bisa hia, èèna be'a kèna. sad'i madhutu dad'èi èdhi. te dhèu baku hia ngaa-ngaa dhu pabia nèngu, lula laka-seti nèti dhèu leo.

source_text: for it is not that there should be relief to others and distress and tzoros to you, but that there should be a balance of equality,
target_text: ja'a d'èi boe pabia miu, sèna ka dhèu leo abhu samaa. te dad'èi ja'a ka, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti tago sama-sama sasusa dhèu se'e.

source_text: during the present time of your abundance for those who lack, and also for your lack there may be their abundance, so also there may be equality,
target_text: te limuri ne, miu dhu unu risi, aa rèngu dhu unu ciki. lod'o limuri, rèngu bisa b'ala kahèi, ladhe miu dhu unu ciki. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi bisa tago sama-sama.

source_text: as it has been written, v'lo he'dif hamarbeh v'hammamit lo hechsirthe one that gathered the much did not have too much and the one that gathered little did not have too little.
target_text: èèna nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, na, dhèu dhu abhu ae, risi boe nèti ngaa dhu rèngu parluu. aa dhèu dhu abhu ciki, kura boe nèti ngaa dhu rèngu parluu.

source_text: but baruch hashem, the one having given the same zerizut diligence for you in the lev heart of titos,
target_text: ja'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, lula nèngu ka dhu pamako titus, sèna ka neo soru-bara miu, sama sèmi ja'a neo soru-bara miu.

source_text: because of the chozek encouragement he received, and having more zerizut on his own accord, he went forth to you.
target_text: mema ji'i manèngi sèna ka nèngu dhiu ngad'o miu. aa te ngaa, èèna madhutu dad'èi nèngu mesa na. nèti èèna ka, nèngu mesa na neo dhiu soru-bara miu, nèti boe lii manèngi ja'a.

source_text: and we sent with him the ach b'moshiach who is bavust famous among all the kehillot for his proclaiming the besuras hageulah,
target_text: te ngaa nèngu dhiu boe mesa na. te ji'i pua le a'ari ji'i ca dhèu, ho kako palere dènge ne. juma'at aa'i-aa'i ètu ne'e tadhe mèu dhèu ne, lula nèngu sab'a bia ho peka-padhai dènge dhèu lii lolo be'a lamatua.

source_text: and not only this but also this ach b'moshiach has been handpicked by the kehillot to travel with us and with this avodas kodesh of chesed being administered by us to the kavod of adoneinu himself and as a gvies eidus testimony to your goodwill.
target_text: kètu juma'at se dhu pili ne kahèi, ho palere-lere dènge ji'i, sèna ka soru-bara ji'i ètu d'ara sasab'a-la'a ji'i dhu hua iia ne. ji'i pakako sasab'a ne, sèna ka pad'elo dadedha lamatua èdhi, aa tao dhu be'a hia dhèu susa sèra ètu yerusalem.

source_text: avoiding also that anyone should murmur about our handling of this liberal matanah gift;
target_text: ji'i tenge j'ara sèna ka tao dhu lèke, ho baku abhu dhèu dhu pasala ji'i, peka na, ji'i sab'a lèke boe lod'o ji'i ngèti doi sèra papala mi dhèu dhu parluu.

source_text: for our tachlis is to do what is tov me'od b'einei elohim v'adam in the eyes of g-d and man.
target_text: te ji'i pangee paie-iie, sèna ka tao dhu lèke nèti d'ara dhu mola-mèci ètu madha ama lamatua, aa ètu madha dhèu ae kahèi.

source_text: and we sent with them our ach b'moshiach whom we have often tested and found having zerizut in much, and now having even more zerizut by his great bitachon in you.
target_text: abhu a'ari èci hari dhu ji'i pua dhiu palere dènge titus si, ho rèti doi sèra. ji'i ladhe paie-iie le mamuri nèngu. aa ji'i nge'a, na, nèngu neo sab'a bia hia miu kahèi. dhèu ne maj'èni, lula ne'a le, na, miu tao dhu lèke.

source_text: as for titos, he is my shutaf and your fellow po'el in your avodas kodesh; as for our achim b'moshiach, they are shlichim of the kehillot, the kavod of moshiach.
