target_text: ladhe dhèu karèi miu lula-nèti titus, peka mi rèngu, na, titus èèna a'ari ja'a dhu sab'a taruu dènge ja'a hia miu. dhèu parcaya ètu era leo kahèi hag'e rare le dhèu rèngu, sèna ka rèngu kahèi rèti doi sèra asa yerusalem. rèngu pakaboko le ho neo dhiu. titus sama-sama dènge rèngu kahèi. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra pad'elo dadedha kristus sèmi èèna.

source_text: therefore, openly before the moshiachʼs kehillot, demonstrate your ahavah and vindicate our glorying about you.
target_text: de miu hud'i pad'elo sasue miu mi dhèu dhu rèti doi sèra. aa pad'elo dènge ra, tasamia ka ji'i koa-kad'iri miu. dènge j'ara èèna, dhèu-dhèu parcaya nèti juma'at ètu mia-mia re'a, na, miu sue rèngu.

source_text: concerning your messianic avodas kodesh sherut for the kedoshim, it is superfluous for me to send you this iggeret.
target_text: dhu lèke, ja'a parluu heka suri hia miu, ho manèngi miu soru-bara dhèu parcaya unu lamatua.

source_text: for i have da'as of your readiness to involve yourself in messianic jewish ministry and this is the subject of my glorying to the macedonians, saying that achaia has been prepared since last shanah and your kanous has been mezarez a spur into action to most of them.
target_text: te ja'a ke'a le, miu d'èi titu kèna soru-bara dhèu sèmi sèra. ja'a d'èi palolo dènge dhèu parcaya ètu makedonia kahèi, lula-nèti babe'a d'ara miu. ja'a palolo le, peka na, miu nèti propensi akaya dhu pa'èra le karèi nèti ranga-jahi ni, ho pa'adhu doi bantuan. ja'a lolo le kahèi, lula-nèti maj'èni miu ka dhu pamako dhèu leo, ho soru-bara dhèu-dhèu susa.

source_text: and i am sending the achim b'moshiach lest our glorying on behalf of you should be made empty in this respect, that you be ready, as i was saying you would be,
target_text: ka ja'a pua le a'ari èdhi, sèna ka ra pad'elo, na, ngaa dhu ji'i palolo lula-nèti miu se, leko-monya boe. ja'a peka sèmi èèna, sèna ka miu pa'èra mema.

source_text: lest perhaps if some macedonians should come with me and they find you unprepared, we should have bushah, to say nothing of you, in this situation.
target_text: te ladhe abhu dhèu makedonia mai palere dènge ja'a, aa miu dhae pa'èra mèka, na, èdhi ta'e makae. mage dhoka lalèka ja'a mi dedha miu dènge boe kolo-kapua.

source_text: therefore, i considered it necessary to encourage the achim b'moshiach, that they should go on ahead to you and, having arranged in advance the bountiful terumah contribution of the havtacha you made previously so that this matanah would be ready so as to be a bracha and not an exaction.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a pangee, na, be'a risi ladhe a'ari èdhi dhiu uuru asa miu, sèna ka miu aa'i-aa'i mi bisa ator uuru ku doi bantuan sèra, madhutu lii pamoa miu uru èèna. miu hud'i hia nèti babe'a d'ara miu, baku hia dènge d'ara cabèka.

source_text: note this: the one sowing sparingly will also reap sparingly, and the one sowing for a bracha of bounty will also reap a bracha of bounty.
target_text: dhu mola-mola, sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu dhu sèle hini ciki, èèna na abhu hua-hela ciki kahèi. aa dhèu dhu sèle hini pa'ae-ae, èèna na abhu hari hua-hela ae-ae kahèi.

source_text: each of you should give as he has decided previously in his lev heart, not giving bedieved begrudgingly nor out of necessity; for hashem loves a cheerful giver.
target_text: ca dhèu-dhèu ka hud'i pama'ète unu na, nèngu neo hia ca ngaa. baku hia dènge d'ara cabèka. baku hia lula dhèu laka-seti. te ama lamatua sue dhèu dhu hia dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: and hashem is able to cause to abound to you all chen v'chesed hashem that in everything, always, having all sufficiency, you may abound to every mitzvah.
target_text: lamatua bisa hia miu mèngi-nale rupa-rupa. nèngu bisa hia miu ae risi eele kahèi, sèna ka miu baku kura ngaa-ngaa. te ladhe miu parluu, èèna na miu abhu risi nèti dhu miu parluu. dènge j'ara ne, miu bisa papala dhu karisi, sèna ka soru-bara sasab'a aa'i-aa'i dhu nèti babe'a.

source_text: as it has been written, pizar natan laevyonim tzidkato omedet la'ad he scattered, he gave to the poor, his righteousness endures forever.
target_text: dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na, ama lamatua d'èi pala-bagi hia dhèu unu aad'o, nèti d'ara hua iia na. nèngu tao dhu lèke taruu, te d'ara mola na èèna, taha taruu.

source_text: now the one supplying zera seed to the sower and lechem for okhel food will supply and will multiply your zera and will increase the p'ri of the tzedek of you;
target_text: lamatua ka dhu hia hini, sèna ka dhèu sab'a sèle oka-tedhe. lamatua ka dhu hia nganga'a, sèna ka èdhi ta'a. lamatua èèna kahèi, ka dhu hia miu mèngi-nale, ho miu bisa tao dhu lèke. èèna sama sèmi miu dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe, hèia lamatua hia miu hini, ho miu sèle. aa hua-hela dhu miu abhu sèra, lamatua hia hari ae-ae, nèti ca lod'o asa ca lod'o.

source_text: you will be enriched in every ma'aseh chesed to all generosity, which produces through us hodayah thanksgiving to hashem;
target_text: te lamatua neo pala-bagi hia miu risi nèti dhu miu parluu, sèna ka miu bisa soru-bara dhèu leo, dènge d'ara be'a miu. de ladhe miu soru-bara le dhèu leo, tatu dhèu se manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: because the avodas kodesh of this tzedakah is not only filling up the things lacking of the kedoshim, but is also abounding through hodayah rabbah much thanksgiving to hashem;
target_text: te bantuan dhu miu hia mi dhèu unu lamatua ètu nèi, tatu pasamaa si. aa dènge j'ara ne'e kahèi, miu manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: through the proof of this messianic jewish sherut you bring kavod to hashem on the basis of your submission to your ani ma'amin hoda'a confession of the besuras hageulah of rebbe, melech hamoshiach and on the basis of the generosity of your terumah contribution to them and to all kol bnei adam;
target_text: te lod'o miu soru-bara dhèu leo sèra, èèna j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, miu parcaya tare'a-re'a. j'ara ne'e kahèi tao dhèu leo sèra koa-kio ama lamatua. te rèngu bisa rèdhi dènge re'a, na, parcaya miu mi lii lolo be'a kristus leko-monya boe. èèna, lula miu tao madhutu lalèka miu. hèia ropa miu hia bantuan dènge d'ara kateme mi rèngu, aa hia mi dhèu leo kahèi, na, èèna ka dhu tao rèngu koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: and, reciprocally, the messianic jews in yerushalayim will daven in intercession for you, having great ahavah in moshiach for you, because of the surpassing chen v'chesed hashem upon you.
target_text: aa dhèu dhu sèmi rare bantuan nèti miu sèra, èèna na ra sabaj'a hia miu. rèngu neo rèdhi miu kahèi, lula ama lamatua dhu pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na ae-ae mi dedha miu.

source_text: baruch hashem for his indescribable matanah!
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu hia iia èdhi hadia èci dhu be'a titu kèna, nuka yesus! kab'ua na risi aa'i ngaa-ngaa! nèti èèna ka, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti sama-sama peka dènge ama lamatua, na, makasi!

source_text: now i myself, sha'ul, appeal to you gently in moshiach and in his anavah humility i who am peh el peh panim el panim, face to face lowly among you but have chutzpah with you when absent.
target_text: ja'a, paulus, ka dhu suri sasuri ne. tatu abhu nèti miu dhu pangee, na, ladhe ja'a sama-sama dènge miu, ja'a makae padhai lii paled'a. te ngaa ladhe miu dènge boe ja'a, na, ja'a bani padhai lii dhu pa'abhe boe. sèmi èèna ka, si? aa te ngaa, ja'a dhu pasanèd'e le miu, na, kristus ne dhu lii mako dènge d'ara hua iia mi dedha miu.

source_text: now i beg of you that when i am present i may not have to show enough chutzpah to oppose certain persons, the ones considering us to act according to the standards of the basar of the olam hazeh.
target_text: te ngaa abhu cahag'e nèti miu dhu ro'o boe nanene lii ja'a. rèngu peka, tatao ji'i beda boe dènge tatao dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne. de ladhe ja'a dhiu, ele boe ja'a padhai lii dènge rèngu pake boe pa'abhe. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka mema dènge miu aa'i-aa'i mi, sèna ka ladhe ja'a d'ai èèna, ja'a tao heka lii taka dènge rèngu.

source_text: for though walking in basar, we war not according to the basar,
target_text: masi ka èdhi se dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa ladhe èdhi pab'ala lii dènge dhèu leo, èdhi pakadhii boe, sèmi dhèu ètu rai-haha ne dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua.

source_text: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the basar, but full of ko'ach through hashem to the overthrowing of strongholds, reasonings,
target_text: ladhe èdhi patao dènge dhèu, baku bhèlu, te rèka èdhi sama boe dènge rèka dhèu rai-haha ne. aa ladhe èdhi patao dènge dhèu kètu hadhu, na, èdhi unu koasa lamatua, dhu bisa palaho ngangee rèngu.

source_text: and every high minded thing rising up against the da'as of hashem, and leading captive every machshavah thought into the mishma'at of rebbe, melech hamoshiach,
target_text: koasa lamatua bisa palaho aa'i ngangee dènge tatao dhu palab'a dènge lamatua, dhu tao dhèu ho ro'o boe tadhe lamatua. koasa nèngu kahèi bisa pad'elo j'ara, ho gati j'ara ngangee èdhi dhu dhui, dènge j'ara ngangee dhu hiu. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi bisa pangee madhutu a'aj'a kristus.

source_text: and prepared to discipline all disobedience whenever your mishma'at obedience is completed.
target_text: ae ka nèti miu mulai d'èi nanene kristus, aa tao madhutu dad'èi na aa'i-aa'i. te ngaa abhu cahag'e nèti miu dhu ro'o boe nanene ne. de ji'i dhu pa'èra le ho huku si.

source_text: you look at things according to outward appearance. if anyone has persuaded himself that he belongs to moshiach, have zikaron recollection of this: as he is of moshiach, so also are we.
target_text: miu d'èi laladhe ngaa dhu ladhe mèdhi ètu li'u di. te ngaa miu hud'i ladhe ku d'ara dhèu. de ladhe dhèu pangee, na, nèngu dhèu pajuu-paleha kristus, sanèd'e paie-iie, te ji'i se dhèu pajuu-paleha kristus kahèi, sèmi nèngu.

source_text: now even if i should glory a little too much in our samchut authority as shlichim of moshiach which rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu gave for building you up and not for tearing you down, i will make good my claim.
target_text: ele boe miu pangee, na, ja'a padhai lii ae risi eele lula-nèti koasa dhu ji'i abhu nèti lamatua. sèmi èèna ka, si? aad'o! te lamatua hia koasa èèna ho pa'èra miu, aa pa'ele iie boe miu. de ja'a soro tèke eele boe dhèu dhu pamakae ja'a, lula rèngu pa'ele iie sasab'a-la'a ja'a.

source_text: i did not intend to seem as if my iggrot were meant to frighten you.
target_text: ja'a neo boe pamadha'u miu dènge sasuri ja'a sèra.

source_text: for they say, his iggrot indeed are weighty and strong but his physical presence is weak and his shprach diction, as far as rhetoric is concerned, is despicable.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sèra peka, na, baku pusi-pahae dènge paulus. te masi ka isi sasuri na bia dènge sakaa, te ngaa ladhe patoo madha, nèngu roe aala-aala, aa lii padhai dhu dènge boe koasa.

source_text: let such a one consider this: that the dvar we speak through iggrot when absent will become action we will very well do when present!
target_text: te ngaa sèna ka dhèu dhu padhai lii omo koso sèra re'a, na, ngaa dhu ji'i suri ètu d'ara sasuri nèti kaj'èu, beda boe dènge ngaa dhu ji'i peka-padhai, ladhe ji'i ètu talora aae miu.

source_text: for we dare not to make a geder classification for ourselves or to compare ourselves with some of the ones commending themselves, but when they measure themselves by the standard of one another or compare themselves with one another, they do not show seichel.
target_text: dhèu sèra sa d'èi padedha iisi, peka na, rèngu ka dhèu pajuu-paleha dhu kapai nèti kristus. ji'i bani boe pasoro ngi'u ji'i dènge dhèu sèmi sèra. me'a, sina ma? ele boe ji'i se èra boe sama sèmi rèngu! dhèu sèmi sèra sa, dhodhoka tenge dhèu dhu sama sèmi rèngu di. sèna ka rèngu pa'èra èci dènge èci, lula rèngu se ca ropa! gagoa ra sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: but we will not boast out of our depth, but will be shomer to keep within the sadeh fieldhashem has apportioned to us which reached out even as far as you.
target_text: aa te ngaa ji'i padedha boe iisi, ladhe dènge boe kolo-kapua na. ji'i dhoka padhai lii sèmi èèna lula-nèti sasab'a dhu lamatua pangèd'u mi ji'i. ngaa dhu ji'i tao hia miu sèra, dhoka tao madhutu ngaa dhu lamatua pua ji'i sab'a. te ji'i sab'a boe dhu leo nèti èèna.

source_text: for we were not getting out of our depth when we reached even as far as you. we were the chalutzim pioneers who came with the besuras hageulah of rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: dhu lèke ka, ji'i se padhai lii karisi boe, lod'o ji'i koa-kad'iri miu. te ji'i ka dhu mai lole lii lolo be'a kristus hia miu. ka miu sèmi mere lii padhai ji'i kahèi. ladhe lamatua pua boe ji'i, te ngaa ji'i koa-kad'iri miu, na, èèna mema lèke boe.

source_text: we do not boast out of our depth, that is, in the labor of others; but tikvateinu is that, as your emunah grows, our sphere of shlichus divine mission among you will also be enlarged,
target_text: ladhe dhèu leo ka dhu sab'a, na, ji'i padedha boe iisi, peka na, èèna rui-j'aj'èra ji'i na. te madhutu mola-mola na, parcaya miu hud'i asa tabha èra. dènge j'ara ne'e, rui-j'aj'èra ji'i ètu dedha miu karèi nèti uru ka asa tabha taruu.

source_text: so that we may abundantly proclaim the besuras hageulah to the regions beyond you, without boasting in someone elseʼs messianic chalutz accomplishments.
target_text: hèia ji'i bisa la'a peka-padhai lii lolo be'a kristus asa era-era dhu pakaj'èu nèti era miu, dhu abhu mèka dhèu sab'a ètu era sèra. dènge j'ara ne'e, sasab'a ji'i patogo boe dènge sasab'a dhèu dhu ra pakako le ètu èèna.

source_text: but hammit hallelyit hallel the one boasting let him boast in the l-rd;
target_text: te abhu ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, dhu suri, na, ladhe dhèu neo padedha iisi, na, hud'i padedha iisi dhoka lula-nèti kètu èdhi, ama lamatua di.

source_text: for it is not the one commending himself that has the haskama approval, but it is the one to whom moshiach adoneinu gives the haskama.
target_text: ladhe abhu ca dhèu dhu padhai lii dedha lula-nèti mamuri nèngu unu na, èèna sasoa na hèb'a-hua. te ngaa ladhe lamatua ka dhu koa-kad'iri dhèu ne'e, heka lèke kèna!

source_text: i would that you might bear with me in a little tipshus foolery. do bear with me!
target_text: ja'a neo padhai lii sama sèmi dhèu goa. de miu nanene sèku! lii ja'a sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: for i have kinah for you, a kinat hashem, for, as a shadkhan marriage broker, i betrothed you to one ish husband to present you as a chaste betulah to rebbe, melech hamoshiach;
target_text: ja'a nuka sèmi ama miu, aa miu nuka sèmi ana bhèni ja'a dhu dhèu lii d'ai le. dhèu dhu lii d'ai miu èèna, nuka kristus. ka ja'a ate sale boe miu, sèna ka ladhe d'ai lod'o miu kab'i, miu kalora iisi era. hèia ja'a j'aga miu, sèna ka dhèu leo baku gagai miu, ho pa'ele iie parcaya miu.

source_text: but i fear lest somehow as the nachash deceived chavah by his cunning, your machshavot should be led astray from a simple and pure deveykus to moshiach.
target_text: ne'e ne miu madhutu j'ara mamuri kristus dènge d'ara mola. te ngaa ja'a madha'u, mage dhoka dhèu tipu rare, miu sèna ka miu piku eele nèti j'ara mola èèna, nuka sèmi uru èèna mege tipu nare hawa. mege ne bisa tipu sèmi èèna, lula nèngu baki nèti kapod'e-kabèli!

source_text: for if a darshan shows up and preaches another moshiach, another yehoshua yeshua other than the one in our drashot, or if you receive a different ruach hakodesh from the one you received or a different besuras hageulah from the one regarding which you were mekabel, you put up with that well enough.
target_text: ladhe lod'o-lod'o miu paraga dènge dhèu sèmi sèra sa, ho ra aj'a-nori miu lula-nèti yesus ropa leo dhu sama boe dènge yesus dhu ji'i aj'a-nori miu, na, tasamia ka miu lèka lii padhai ra? uru èèna, miu bhoke le d'ara miu ho sèmi mere roh mola-mèci lamatua, sèna ka na ator miu. te ngaa tasamia ka limuri ne, miu neo hari sèmi mere roh ropa leo èci? uru èèna, miu lèka lii lolo be'a kristus dhu ji'i aj'a miu. te ngaa tasamia ka limuri ne miu parcaya hari a'aj'a ropa leo?

source_text: for i consider to have come behind the most groise eminent shlichim in absolutely nothing.
target_text: dhèu se padedha iisi ra, peka na, rèngu ka dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua dhu kapai risi. madhutu ngangee miu, hak rèngu se risi nèti hak ja'a, do? aad'o! ja'a pake boe ngangee sèmi sèra.

source_text: but if indeed i am unskilled in lashon yet i am not in da'as knowledge, but in all ways and all things i have made this abundantly clear to you.
target_text: masi ka ja'a d'èlu-mèu boe ètu d'ara lii padhai pake lii dedha, te ngaa ke'a mèu sasoa nèti ngaa dhu ja'a padhue-padhai. miu dhu me'a le j'ara se'e, lula ja'a peka pahari-pahari le dènge miu.

source_text: or - anshuldiks! pardon! - did i commit averos by humbling myself that you might be exalted, because i proclaimed hashemʼs besuras hageulah to you free of charge?
target_text: lod'o ja'a aj'a miu lii holo-nori ama lamatua, ja'a manèngi boe miu ogo-oru hia ja'a. ja'a tao iisi nuka sèmi ana iiki sa, sèna ka bisa ded'e padedha miu. teko-teko nèti j'ara ne'e ka miu neo pasala ja'a, do?

source_text: i robbed other of moshiachʼs kehillot, did i, in taking wages from them for the avodas kodesh work i did for you?
target_text: te dhèu parcaya nèti juma'at era leo sèra ka dhu tago ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa ladhe-leru miu. ne'e èci èèna ka dènge ja'a kore nèti rèngu ho soru-bara miu.

source_text: and when i was present with you and i had lack, i did not burden anyone, for my lack was made up by the achim b'moshiach who came from macedonia. so i was shomer not to make myself a burden to you and in that i will remain shomer.
target_text: lod'o ja'a bera-bera dènge miu, ladhe ja'a parluu ngaa-ngaa, na, ja'a manèngi boe miu, aa pabia boe miu. a'ari èdhi dhu mai nèti propensi makedonia ka dhu soru-bara ja'a. te ngaa ja'a pabia kèdhi mèka miu, aa bèli-camèd'a ja'a pabia boe miu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: as haemes of moshiach is in me, that particular boasting of mine will not be silenced in the regions of achaia!
target_text: lii holo-nori kristus ne lèke tare'a-re'a. ja'a lèka mèu, na, lii padhai ja'a lèke kahèi, lula ja'a pa'èki dènge kristus. abhu boe ca dhèu sa ètu propensi akaya dhu bisa kutu hèb'a ja'a, aa kai ja'a sèna ka baku padhai lii padedha, peka na, ja'a pabia boe miu sèmi èèna.

source_text: why? because i do not have ahavah for you? hashem knows that i do!
target_text: nga tao ka ja'a peka sèmi ne'e? ele boe, lula ja'a sue boe miu, do? masi ka miu pangee sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua ne'a, na, ja'a sue miu.

source_text: but what i do i will also continue to do in order to deny an opening to those who are looking for an opening by their ravrevan braggart boasting to be recognized as equals with us.
target_text: j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a tao kèdhi le, ja'a tao taruu. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu dhu tema padedha iisi, peka na, tatao rèngu sèra èci èèna ka dènge tatao ji'i, na, padhai lii rèngu dènge boe kolo-kapua.

source_text: for such ones are shlichei sheker, deceitful po'alim, transforming themselves in a masquerade as shlichim of moshiach.
target_text: rèngu peka, na, lamatua ka dhu pajuu-paleha rèngu. rèngu se, dhèu sab'a dhu d'èi leko-monya dhèu! dhèu se tao iisi ra nuka sèmi dhèu pajuu-paleha dhu lèke nèti kristus. aa te ngaa rèngu se dhoka padhai lii hèb'a-hua!

source_text: and no wonder! for even hasatan transforms himself into a malach ohr an angel of light;
target_text: miu baku cag'ag'a! te dhèu aae nidhu kahèi tao iisi na sama sèmi ana-ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga dhu nèti saraa aa d'ara be'a.

source_text: it is no big megillah, therefore, if also hasatanʼs ministers transform themselves as ministers of tzedek. their end will be according to their ma'asim.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu baku malaa ladhe dhèu sab'a na neo tao iisi ra nuka sèmi dhèu dhu sab'a dènge d'ara mola. sanèd'e, te èèna na ama lamatua b'ala bhabhelu-katub'a rèngu.

source_text: listen here, let no one think me a tipesh idiot. but if you do think me a yold fool, then receive me as a yold that i, too, may boast ki hu zeh a small amount.
target_text: ladhe mo'o, na, ja'a padhai lii hari ciki sama sèmi dhèu goa. te ja'a neo padhai lii padedha iisi ciki.

source_text: what i speak in this bitachon of boasting, i speak not according to moshiach adoneinu, but as a yold.
target_text: dhu ja'a suri padedha iisi ne, dhoka neo padhai lii sama sèmi dhèu goa sa. te lii padhai ja'a ne kapua na nèti boe lamatua èdhi.

source_text: als since many boast according to the basar, i also will boast.
target_text: abhu dhèu ae dhu d'èi ded'e padedha ngi'u ra madhutu tatao dhèu rai-haha ne. de ja'a neo padhai lii padedha iisi kahèi sama sèmi rèngu.

source_text: for magnanimously you put up with fools, being such talmidei chachamim yourselves!
target_text: te miu dhu pangee, na, ngangee miu mola ladhe paraga dènge ca dhèu dhu kahadhu bia, na, miu soro tèke ne, si?

source_text: for you put up with it quite well, if anyone trades you into slavery, if anyone turns you into their supper, if anyone lifts your wallet, if anyone exalts himself into your gontser macher, if anyone gives you a klop in the ponem.
target_text: ladhe dhèu leo tao miu madhutu dad'èi rèngu, na, miu soro tèke si. nuka sèmi: ladhe dhèu tao miu sèmi ènu sa, miu soro tèke ne, do? ladhe abhu dhu mana'u mèdha miu, miu soro tèke ne, do? ladhe abhu dhèu tipu miu, miu soro tèke ne, do? ladhe dhèu tao iisi nuka sèmi dhèu kapai, aa pahahe miu nuka sèmi ana iiki sa, na, miu soro tèke ne, do? sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tèb'e miu, na, miu soro tèke ne sène.

source_text: to my bushah, i say that we were too weak for that! but, nevertheless, in whatever way anyone may have chutzpah in foolishness, i also will speak with chutzpah.
target_text: te ngaa baku nasa! te ja'a makae, lula ji'i roe aala-aala. te ji'i lake ngare boe tao sèmi èèna, sama sèmi dhèu sèra tao mi dedha miu. te ngaa ladhe rèngu neo padedha iisi lula ngaa sa, ja'a bani padedha iisi sèmi èèna kahèi. te ngaa baku bhèlu, te ja'a padhai lii sèmi dhèu goa na!

source_text: are they ivrim? so am i. are they yisroelim? so am i. are they zera avraham? so am i.
target_text: rèngu se dhèu ibrani tare'a-re'a, do? oo! ja'a kahèi dhèu ibrani. rèngu dhèu isra'el, do? oo! ja'a kahèi. rèngu sèra ana-èpu abraham, do? oo! ja'a kahèi.

source_text: are they mesharetei hamoshiach? - i am talking like someone who is meshuggah - i can outdo them: in labors more abundantly, in imprisonments more frequently, in beatings more by far, and often near death.
target_text: rèngu sèra dhèu sab'a hia kristus, do? oo! ja'a kahèi sèmi èèna. baku bhèlu, te ja'a padhai lii paleko ne! mema, ja'a peka na, ja'a sama sèmi rèngu. aa te ngaa ja'a risi nèti rèngu. te ja'a sab'a bia risi. ra bèdho ja'a ae risi. ra game ja'a ae risi. ja'a kahèi oe madhe pahari-pahari ae risi nèti rèngu.

source_text: by yehudim chamash pe'amim i had the arba'im lashes minus one!
target_text: ètu d'ara adhe-aai dhèu ja'a, dhèu yahudi, ra hake paparu ja'a lèmi hari. lod'o-lod'o ra hake paparu ja'a, na, ra hake tèlu nguru ceo hari pake gui.

source_text: shloshah pe'amim i was beaten with rods, pa'am achat i was stoned, shloshah pe'amim i was shipwrecked, spending a lailah and a yom in the open sea;
target_text: tèlu hari, dhèu hake ja'a pake aj'u. ca tèka dhèu pèci neo pamadhe ja'a. ja'a molo dènge kapa tèlu hari. d'ara ca mèu ca mèda, ja'a leb'o-leb'o ètu d'ara dhasi.

source_text: in journeys often, in sakanot mavet mortal danger from rivers, in sakanot mavet from robbers, in sakanot mavet from my own people, in sakanot mavet from goyim, in sakanot mavet in the shtetl, in sakanot mavet in the country, in sakanot mavet in the sea, in sakanot mavet among achei sheker false brothers;
target_text: ja'a laku kaj'èu asa mia-mia pahari-pahari. ètu d'ara kakako ne, ja'a paraga dènge j'aj'èra rupa-rupa, dhu tao ja'a oe madhe. nuka sèmi: nèti èi aae lala ètu d'ara loko aae, nèti parapo, nèti dhèu ja'a dhèu yahudi, nèti dhèu yahudi boe, aa nèti dhèu dhu tao ngi'u ra sama sèmi a'ari dhèu parcaya, aa te ngaa rèngu leko-monya. ja'a oe madhe kahèi ètu talora lèu, ètu d'ara kota, dènge era dhèu pea boe.

source_text: in labor and toil, in watchings, often in famine and thirst, in tzomot often, in cold and nakedness;
target_text: ja'a sab'a bia, aa paraga dènge sasusa ae-ae. lod'o ae ka dhu ja'a bisa boe bhèj'i. ja'a manganga dènge koko-kamango kahèi. pahari-pahari ku'a boe ngaa-ngaa. abhu kahèi lod'o dhu ja'a unu boe mèdha-papake, ka maringi oe madhe.

source_text: beside the things from without, there is the pressure on me yom yom, the care of all of moshiachʼs kehillot.
target_text: aa ladhe mo'o boe ige j'ara se'e, na, ige sèmi ne'e ka: te bèli-bèli ja'a j'aj'i ngangee kapai, lula ngee kèdhi a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya dhu pakaboko ètu mia-mia.

source_text: who is weak and i am not weak? who is caused to fall into chet sin, and i do not burn?
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu rasa roe-bhilu dhu bisa boe sab'a ngaa-ngaa, na, sanèd'e ja'a. te ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu dadugu dhèu-dhèu parcaya sèna ka tao j'ara karehe sama-sama dènge rèngu, na, ja'a makae, aa nasa.

source_text: if it is necessary for me to boast, then i will boast of my weaknesses.
target_text: ladhe ja'a neo padedha iisi, na, be'a risi ja'a padedha iisi lula-nèti j'ara-j'ara dhu pad'elo raroe ja'a. tare'a!

source_text: hashem, elohim haav of hamoshiach yehoshua knows hamevorach l'olmei olamim! that i am not speaking sheker.
target_text: kètu èdhi yesus, dènge ama na, ama lamatua re'a, na, ja'a monya boe. dhu lèke, ladhe dhèu koa-kio ne toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: in damascus the ethnarch under king aretas was guarding the city of damascus to arrest me,
target_text: conto nuka sèmi, uru èèna ètu kota damsik, gubernur nèti dhèu aae aretas pua dhèu mate ho kèpe ja'a ètu hèb'a tedhe kota.

source_text: and i was let down through the wall through a window in a basket, and escaped his hands.
target_text: te ngaa angalai ja'a pamaso ja'a asa d'ara karogo èci. ka ra dulu ja'a dènge dhari re li'u tembok kota. hèia gubernur kèpe nare boe ja'a. de sanèd'e, ladhe ja'a mesa-mesa ku, tatu bisa boe, si?

source_text: it is necessary for me to boast, nothing gained by it, yet i now come to marot visions and chazonot revelations of adoneinu.
target_text: ladhe miu mo'o, na, ja'a padedha iisi hari ciki, masi ka gaguna aad'o. te ngaa ja'a neo peka dènge miu j'ara-j'ara dhu lamatua èdhi pad'elo le dènge ja'a ètu d'ara tanila.

source_text: i have da'as of a man in moshiach arba esreh shanah fourteen years before, whether in or out of the basar i do not have da'as, hashem knows - such a man was snatched up and raptured to the raki'a hashlishi of shomayim. and i have da'as that such a man, whether in or out of the basar i do not have da'as, hashem knows, that he was caught away into gan-eden and heard inexpressible devarim which to utter such words bnei adam have no heter permit.
target_text: ja'a tadhe ca dhèu unu kristus. canguru èpa tèu dhu la'e, abhu dhu ded'e ne asa dedha-liru dhu dedha aae. te ngaa ja'a ke'a boe, na ca'e dènge ngi'u aae, do dhoka roh nèngu di. dhodhoka lamatua di ne'a. ja'a ke'a kahèi, na, ropa ded'e ne asa era hua iia lamatua èèna, nèngu tadèngi lii padhai dhu be'a titu kèna, dhu dhèu rai-haha bisa boe peka-padhai.

source_text: on behalf of such a one i will boast, but on behalf of myself i will not boast, except in my weaknesses.
target_text: de mi dhèu sèmi èèna, ja'a neo padhai lii padedha. te ngaa ja'a ko'o boe padedha iisi lula-nèti ngi'u ja'a unu ku. ja'a ded'e dhoka raroe-bhilu ja'a, aa j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a bisa boe tao kore.

source_text: but if i desire to boast, i will not be a yold fool for i will speak haemes; but i spare you, lest anyone gives me credit beyond what he sees in me or hears in me.
target_text: ladhe ja'a neo padedha iisi, na, ja'a parluu boe monya, te ja'a dhu dènge j'ara ae dhu lèke, dhu ja'a bisa peka-padhai. te ngaa ja'a mau-mau, sèna ka dhèu baku pangee, na, ja'a dènge kolo-karisi nèti ngaa dhu rèngu tadèngi aa ladhe rèdhi nèti ja'a.

source_text: therefore, lest i should be too exalted especially by the excess of my chazonot, there was given to me a kotz thorn, splinter in my basar, a malach of hasatan, for the purpose of using his fists on me, lest i should be too exalted.
target_text: risi-risi hari, lamatua dhu pad'elo le dènge ja'a j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai titu kèna. te ngaa ja'a abhu susa kahèi, sèna ka ja'a baku pamone. te dhèu aae nidhu pua ana pajuu na èci, ho mai kakèj'i taruu ja'a, nuka sèmi dhudhu dhu pakèj'i ètu d'ara isi ja'a ne. waa! ja'a j'èra titu kèna!

source_text: i davened shalosh pe'amim, calling upon adoneinu that it might depart from me.
target_text: tèlu hari kèna, ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pakaj'èu eele j'aj'èra ne nèti ja'a.

source_text: and haadon said to me, my chesed is ad kahn sufficient for the purpose, enough for you, for my ko'ach power is perfected in weakness. with lev samei'ach therefore will i boast in my weaknesses that the gevurah of moshiach might be a shelter over me.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua peka na, ja'a pad'elo le d'ara hua iia ja'a mi èu, de èèna d'ai le, sèna ka èu me'a, na, nèti d'ara raroe ka koasa ja'a asa tabha. nèti èèna ka ja'a d'èi padedha iisi ètu d'ara raroe ja'a, sèna ka ja'a ke'a, na, koasa kristus ètu d'ara mamuri ja'a.

source_text: therefore, i take pleasure in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in tzoros on behalf of moshiach; for whenever i am weak, then the gibbor strong man am i!
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ladhe a'èra ja'a mesa ku bisa boe sab'a ngaa èci sa, na, d'ara ja'a mau-mau sène. de ropa dhèu pahahe ja'a, do pasusa ja'a, do paj'èra ja'a, do game ja'a, lula ja'a j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus, na, d'ara ja'a mau-mau sène. te ladhe ja'a mesa ku bisa boe, na, ja'a abhu koasa nèti kristus, ho bisa èra tao j'ara sèra.

source_text: i have been a yold! you forced me. for i ought to be commended by you, for in nothing i was behind the most groise eminent shlichim, even if i am nothing.
target_text: miu mamuri nuka sèmi me'a boe, na, lamatua pua nèdhi mèka ja'a dhiu peka-padhai dènge miu. nèti èèna ka, mo'o do mo'o boe, ja'a ako padhai lii ciki sèmi dhèu goa. madhutu iia-iia na, miu se'e ka dhu padhai lii padedha ja'a. ja'a ne mema dènge boe kab'ua, te ngaa ladhe pasoro ja'a dènge dhèu kapai sèra dhu peka na, lamatua pua-paleha rèngu, na, rèngu sèra risi boe ja'a.

source_text: indeed the otot signs of the shliach of moshiach were brought about among you in all savlanut patience, both by otot and moftim and gevurot.
target_text: ladhe lamatua pua dhèu ho lole lula-nèti nèngu, dhèu ne tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa pake koasa, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, na, lamatua ka dhu pua-paleha nèngu. te ngaa baku bhèlu, te lod'o ja'a ètu talora aae miu, ja'a tao tadha malaa kahèi sèmi sèra. aa ja'a sab'a mau-mau.

source_text: for in what have you been short-changed compared to the rest of moshiachʼs kehillot, except that i myself was not a burden on you? do pardon me this slight!
target_text: te ngaa baku nasa! dhodhoka ca j'ara di, dhu ja'a tao boe ètu talora miu, dhu dhèu leo tao ètu juma'at leo. nuka ja'a manèngi boe miu ogo ja'a.

source_text: hinei, this is the pa'am shlishit i am ready to come to you, and i will not be a burden; for i seek not yours but you, for yeladim ought not to lay up for their horim parents, but horim for their yeladim.
target_text: sèmi ne'e! ja'a dhu tèlu hari kèna pa'èra kore le ho dhiu ngad'o miu. ja'a parluu boe miu ogo mamuri ja'a. ja'a ko'o boe mèdha-panyau miu kahèi. te madhutu ad'a èdhi, lèke boe ladhe ana iiki tèka mèdha-panyau hia ina-ama ra. dhu lèke nuka ina-ama ka dhu sadia tèke mèdha-panyau hia ana niki ra. de ja'a parluu boe ladhe miu sadia tèke mèdha-panyau hia ja'a, te miu se sama sèmi ana-ana ja'a! dhu ja'a parluu, dhoka mamuri dènge sasue miu.

source_text: but with simcha i will expend and be utterly expended for the nefashot souls of you. if more abundantly i have ahavah for you, are you to have less ahavah for me?
target_text: ja'a d'èi hèli mèdha hia miu. ja'a d'èi sab'a bia kahèi, sèna ka miu bisa mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua. ladhe ja'a sue miu d'ai seli, na, miu hud'i sue ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi. nga tao ka miu papènyi sasue miu? lèke boe, sina ma?

source_text: but let the matter of my being a burden on you be as it may, some say, crafty jack that i am, i took you by ormah cunning.
target_text: ètu talora miu, abhu dhu peka na, ja'a pabia boe miu. te ngaa abhu kahèi dhu peka na, ja'a dhèu dhu mèu pakapod'e miu, sèna ka miu madhutu dad'èi ja'a.

source_text: now i didn't take advantage of any of you through anyone i sent to you, did i?
target_text: de tasamia? ele boe dhèu dhu ja'a pua dhiu asa miu sèra, tipu rare miu, do? aad'o!

source_text: i urged titos to go, and i sent with him the ach b'moshiach; titos didn't take advantage of you, did he? did we not walk our derech by the same ruach hakodesh? we did not march out of step, did titos and i?
target_text: te ja'a dhu pamako titus ho dhiu asa miu. ja'a pua a'ari dhèu parcaya èci sèna ka dhiu palere dènge titus kahèi. titus pakapod'e miu, do? aad'o, si? te titus dènge ja'a ne, ca ropa. ji'i sab'a j'ara dhu sama, te ngangee ji'i dua mi sama kahèi.

source_text: all along have you been thinking that we are making a hitstaddekut defense, apology before you? no, before hashem in moshiach we speak! everything we do, chaverim, is for the sake of your chozek strength and edification!
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue! tao-tao miu dhu pangee, na, ji'i siri iisi ji'i ètu madha miu, do? aad'o! te aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i peka-padhai se, ama lamatua dhu ne'a le. de ji'i bisa boe pahuni ngaa-ngaa nèti nèngu. ji'i pa'èki kahèi dènge kristus. lula ji'i sue miu, nèti èèna ka aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i tao sèra, sèna ka bisa pa'èra miu.

source_text: for i fear lest efsher perhaps when i come i may not find you as i wish and that you may not find me as you wish; i fear lest efsher there be merivah strife, kinah jealousy, ka'as anger, machalokot divisions, lashon hora evil speech, ga'avah conceit, commotions;
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, ladhe ja'a j'aj'i dhiu ngad'o miu, ja'a pangee mage dhoka miu j'aj'i boe sama sèmi dad'èi ja'a. te mage dhoka abhu dhu patao-palaha, d'èi boe dhèu karisi nèngu, tèka d'ara, abhu dhu pangee dhoka mamuri nèngu mesa na, abhu dhu pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu, abhu dhu padhai-kakoli dhèu, abhu dhu padedha iisi, aa abhu dhu maruru jahu lulu-lulu. mage dhoka ja'a kahèi j'aj'i boe sama sèmi dad'èi miu.

source_text: lest when i come again hashem elohai may make me anav humble before you, and i should have agmat nefesh over many of the ones who committed averos before, and have not made teshuva from the tumah uncleanness and zenut fornication and debauchery which they practiced.
target_text: ladhe ja'a dhiu ka asa miu, ja'a j'aj'i ngangee, lula tatao-tatao miu. mage dhoka ama lamatua neo pamakae ja'a ètu madha miu. mage dhoka ja'a pabia dhèu, lula, nèti miu abhu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara bhelu-katub'a era, te ngaa ele-ho'a boe, sèna ka madhutu j'ara mola nèti lamatua. rèngu se dhèu kaj'alu! te abhu dhu ad'u j'ara makae dènge mone do bhèni dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe. ra ad'u-ue j'ara makae rupa-rupa dhu re'a heka makae d'ara.

source_text: this is the pa'am hashlishit i am coming to you; by the pi shnayim shloshah edimby the mouth of two or three witnesses, every dvar shall be established.
target_text: de ne'e ne kali ka tèlu kèna ja'a neo dhiu ngad'o miu. ladhe abhu dhu neo galaa dhèu, na, baku bhèlu atora na. te sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua dhu suri, peka na, ladhe abhu dhu neo galaa dhèu èci, hud'i dènge ku dua do tèlu sakasii dhu lii èci, heka sèmi mere kèna. te ladhe abhu boe lii èci sèmi èèna, baku sèmi mere lii galaa èèna.

source_text: i warned those who committed averos before and all the rest, and, now absent, i warn them again, as i did when i made pakad visit the pa'am hashenit, that if i come again, i will not spare, i will not be lenient,
target_text: lod'o dhu ja'a dhiu kali ka dua asa miu uru èèna, ja'a pasanèd'e le dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara bhabhelu-katub'a sèra. limuri ne, ja'a pasanèd'e hari rèngu sama-sama dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu d'ara bhelu-katub'a sèra. nuka sèmi uru èèna, dhu ja'a peka kore le, na, ladhe ja'a j'aj'i mai hari, ja'a soro tèke boe rèngu sèra.

source_text: als since you seek to test if moshiach is speaking in me. moshiach is not weak toward you, but is gibbor in you.
target_text: miu tenge bukti, dhu peka na, kristus padhai lii re ja'a. ladhe kristus neo ator miu, na tao dènge koasa kapai ètu talora aae miu. te nèngu sab'a boe dènge roe.

source_text: for indeed he was talui al haetzbeing hanged on the tree out of weakness, but moshiach lives by the gevurat hashem. likewise, we are weak in him, yet we will live with him by the gevurat hashemthe power of g-d toward you.
target_text: lod'o dhèu pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, mema na roe aala-aala, lula na patalale eele koasa na. te ngaa ama lamatua pangèd'u le kristus koasa, hèia na mamuri hari le. ka masi ka ji'i j'aj'i dhèu unu na, dhu rasa na, ji'i ètu d'ara raroe era, te ngaa ama lamatua hia le ji'i mamuri hiu. nèti èèna ka, ji'i bisa ladhe-leru miu pake koasa nèngu.

source_text: perform a bedikah examination on yourselves to see if you are in the emunah faith. test and prove yourselves. or do you yourselves not have da'as that moshiach is in you? unless you are reprobate and unapproved.
target_text: parisa d'ara miu unu mi dhu peka na, miu parcaya tare'a mi kristus, do aad'o. koasa na bisa tèdhi ètu d'ara mamuri miu, do aad'o? uji mamuri miu sèmi èèna. te ladhe kristus pa'èki boe dènge miu, miu j'aj'i boe dhèu unu na.

source_text: but i have tikvah that you will have da'as that we are not unapproved.
target_text: ladhe miu parisa ji'i, na, miu bisa ladhe mèdhi koasa kristus ètu d'ara mamuri ji'i. dènge j'ara ne'e, ji'i lolos.

source_text: now we daven pray to hashem that you do not do any rah evil, not that we shlichim may appear to have stood the test, but that you may do hatov the good, though we may seem to have failed.
target_text: ji'i sabaj'a kahèi manèngi ama lamatua, sèna ka miu baku manahu asa d'ara sasala ngaa-ngaa. ji'i pusi-pahae boe dhèu d'èi, do d'èi boe, nèti sasab'a-la'a ji'i. te ngaa ji'i d'èi ladhe miu tao dhu lèke, masi ka dhèu cahag'e tule eele ji'i. masi ka dhèu tule eele ji'i sèmi èèna, ngaa-ngaa tao boe.

source_text: for we are not able to do anything against haemes, but only for haemes.
target_text: te ji'i bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa, ho lab'a j'ara dhu lèke. ji'i nge'a dhoka tao dhu lèke di.

source_text: for we have lev same'ach when we are megareia weakened and you are strong, for this also we daven pray, that is, for your shelemut perfection, your tikkun restoration repair.
target_text: ladhe miu j'aj'i èra, aa ji'i j'aj'i roe èèna ka, ji'i karej'e-karae. te ji'i sabaj'a, ho manèngi lamatua tao pamèci miu.

source_text: therefore, while i am absent i write this iggeret so that when i am present i may not treat you with severity, according to the samchut authority which rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu gave me for your chozek strength and not for your churban.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, masi ka ja'a pakaj'èu dènge miu, ja'a suri tèke le j'ara se'e se, ho ladhe d'ai ka lod'o ja'a dhiu, ja'a tao heka lii sakaa dènge miu. ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua èdhi. te ngaa na pangèd'u hak dènge koasa mi ja'a, sèna ka pa'ele iie boe miu, te ngaa pa'èra miu.

source_text: for the rest, achim b'moshiach, rejoice with simcha. come to order and chazzak be strong! have achdus unity in your machshavot thoughts. live in shalom. and the g-d of ahavah and shalom will be with you.
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue aa'i-aa'i! lii ja'a dhu limuri tèka ne, dhoka lii maho'o di. pamola j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. nanene paie-iie lii holo-nori ja'a. mamuri d'ara èci. miu èci dènge èci hud'i pabe'a-be'a. kapua sasue nèti ama lamatua. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua bera-bera taruu dènge miu, aa na soru-bara miu, ho miu mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: greet one another with a neshikat hakodesh.
target_text: miu hud'i pamaho'o aa pa'uu dhu pantas dènge dhèu mola-mèci unu ama lamatua. dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua ètu se'e, pa'adhu lii maho'o kahèi hia miu.

source_text: all the kedoshim say, shalom!
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu. ja'a manèngi ho ama lamatua pad'elo sasue na mi dedha miu. ja'a manèngi kahèi sèna ka roh mola-mèci lamatua pad'elo d'ara be'a na, ho hud'i laa miu mamuri d'ara èci. sange ne'e ka, paulus

source_text: from sha'ul, a shliach, not from bnei adam, nor through bnei adam, but through rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua and hashem, elohim avinu, the one of whom we say mechayyei mesim atah thou revivest the dead, even the moshiach, and from all the achim b'moshiach with me; to the kehillot of galatia.
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a, paulus. ja'a pa'adhu sasuri ne asa a'ari aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus kristus ètu juma'at-juma'at ètu propensi galati. a'ari dhu sama-sama dènge ja'a ètu ne'e, pa'adhu lii maho'o kahèi hia miu. ja'a pasanèd'e miu, na, ama lamatua dènge yesus kristus ka dhu pua-paleha ja'a. nèti boe dhèu rai-haha ne. yesus kristus èèna, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua pua mai le. kristus madhe, te ngaa lamatua pamamuri hari ne. hèia ra pua-paleha ja'a, ho laku peka-padhai lii lolo be'a dènge dhèu-dhèu.

source_text: chen v'chesed hashem to you and shalom hashem from elohim avinu and rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua adoneinu,
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a mi ama èdhi, ama lamatua, aa kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ja'a manèngi ho rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi miu, sèna ka miu mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: the one having made a matnat elohim of himself, on behalf of chattoteynu our sins, so that he might rescue us out of the olam hazeh yom tzarah, this age, this present evil age, according to the ratzon hashemwill of g-d, even avinu,
target_text: kristus madhe, sèna ka saku eele aa'i sasala èdhi aa pakaj'èu èdhi nèti bhabhelu-katub'a rai-haha ne. aa'i-aa'i dhu kristus ad'u-ue sèra, madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: lo hakavod l'olmei olamim. omein.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i koa-kio ne taruu! dhu lèke kèna!

source_text: i am shocked that so quickly you are being turned from the one who granted you the kri'ah calling, summoning you by the chen v'chesed hashem of moshiach. i am shocked that so quickly you are being turned from this to a different besuras hageulah.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a ke'a heka tao miu sa mia! ama lamatua hag'e nare le miu, lula na neo ho miu me'a d'ara hua iia na. te ngaa tasamia ka miu malai titu kèna lami madhutu lii lolo leo

source_text: not that there is another, mind you! except that there are some individuals disturbing and troubling you, desiring to twist and pervert the besuras hageulah of moshiach.
target_text: dhu lèke boe? uuru èèna, ja'a aj'a le dhu mola-mola lii lolo be'a nèti yesus kristus. te ngaa limuri ne, dhèu kapod'e-kabèli sèra mai pakapod'e lii lolo be'a èèna, toke miu malaa-maloha.

source_text: but even if we or a malach from shomayim should pose as maggidim for moshiach and make a hachrazah proclamation to you of a besuras hageulah other than that besuras hageulah which we preached to you, let such a one be arur haishcursed is the man and set under cherem ban of destruction and onesh gehinnom damnation.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! te bèli-camèd'a lamatua huku dhèu dhu aj'a lii lolo be'a dhu sama boe dènge dhu ji'i aj'a-nori uru èèna. masi ka dhèu nèti ji'i do, ana pajuu nèti sorga do, hud'i laa lamatua hia ne mamadhe-mamopo!

source_text: as we have previously said, and now again i say, if any one preaches a besuras hageulah to you other than that which you received, let him be arur haish and be consigned to onesh gehinnom.
target_text: ji'i dhu peka le karèi nèti uru ka. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a neo hari pasanèd'e sèmi ne'e: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu aj'a leo nèti lii lolo be'a dhu miu abhu le uru èèna, hud'i laa lamatua hia ne mamadhe-mamopo.

source_text: am i now seeking the ishshur approval of bnei adam? or the haskama approval of hashem? or am i seeking to be a man-pleaser? if and this is not the case i were still pleasing bnei adam, i would not have been the eved of moshiach.
target_text: ja'a bani peka sèmi èèna, lula ja'a neo pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua, neo boe pakarej'e dhèu rai-haha ne. miu ngee, na, ja'a tenge kolongara nèti dhèu rai-haha, do? aad'o! te ladhe ja'a tao sèmi èèna, ja'a pantas boe j'aj'i ana pua-paleha nèti kristus.

source_text: for i mefarsem make known to you, achim b'moshiach, the besuras hageulah having been preached by me, that it is not according to bnei adam;
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a peka paled'a dènge miu, na, lii lolo be'a dhu ja'a aj'a-nori miu, nèti boe tatao dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: for neither did i receive it from bnei adam nor was i taught it, but no, it was through a chazon revelation of moshiach yehoshua.
target_text: ja'a abhu boe nèti dhèu rai-haha, aa abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu aj'a-nori ja'a. te yesus kristus mesa na ka dhu bhoke sasoa na mi ja'a.

source_text: for you heard of my derech, my halakhah, my hitnahagut conduct in earlier times in yahadut judaism, how i was to an extraordinary degree bringing redifah persecution upon the kehillah of hashem and was making havoc of it,
target_text: tatu miu tadèngi le lii lolo nèti j'ara mamuri ja'a, lod'o ja'a madhutu agama yahudi era, si? lod'o èèna, ja'a paj'èra titu kèna dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua, aa neo pa'ele iie aa'i si.

source_text: and i was shtaig working my way up, advancing, progressing in yahadut judaism beyond many of my landsmen, being more abundantly machmir and a kannai zealot bekius for the minhagim, the masorot haavot, the kabbalah oral tradition, the torah sheb'al peh, the halakhah of my avot.
target_text: aa lod'o èèna kahèi, d'ara ja'a neo titu kèna aj'a j'ara-j'ara agama yahudi, risi nèti dhèu yahudi dhu leo dhu ca dadena dènge ja'a. aa ja'a ne maj'èni risi pakako ad'a bèi-baki èdhi dènge atora agama aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: but when hashem was pleased, when it was the ratzon hashem, hashem being the one who separated me as kodesh kera'ani mime'ei immihe called me from the womb of my mother and granted me the kri'ah calling, summoning me through the chen v'chesed of hashem, to reveal his zun fun der oybershter in me, that i might preach him among the goyim, immediately, then, i did not consult with basar vadahm flesh and blood,
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, ama lamatua dhu pama'ète nare le ho patadhe ana na mi ja'a. ina ku dhae nara iisi mèka ja'a, te nèngu dhu hag'e mema le ja'a, lula na neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a. nèngu kahèi pua ja'a ho laku peka-padhai dènge dhèu yahudi boe sèra. lod'o na pua ja'a èèna, laku boe manèngi a'abhu nèti dhèu leo.

source_text: nor did i go up to yerushalayim to those who were moshiachʼs shlichim before me, but i went away hitbodedut into arabia and again i returned to damascus.
target_text: aa laku boe paraga dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka kristen dhu j'aj'i mema le dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus ètu kota yerusalem. te ngaa laku dènge ka asa rai arab. èle ka, ja'a lèpa hari asa kota damsik.

source_text: then, after shalosh shanim three years, i went up to yerushalayim to get acquainted with kefa, and i stayed with him chamishah asar yamim fifteen days.
target_text: hèia lalu eele tèlu tèu ku, heka laku paraga dènge petrus ètu yerusalem, ho pakarèi j'ara-j'ara nèti nèngu. ka ja'a manubha taha canguru lèmi lod'o ètu nèi.

source_text: but other of the moshiachʼs shlichim i did not see except ya'akov achi rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ja'a paraga kahèi dènge yakobis, ari d'èlu lamatua yesus. te ngaa ja'a paraga boe dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua dhu leo sèra. dhoka dua ra di.

source_text: now, what things i write to you, hinei, before hashem i do not speak sheker.
target_text: ngaa dhu ja'a suri ne, mema tare'a sèmi èèna! ja'a kapod'e boe! lamatua ne'a aa'i!

source_text: next i went into the regions of syria and of cilicia,
target_text: èle èèna, hèia ja'a laku asa propensi siria dènge propensi kilikia.

source_text: but i was unknown panim el panim by the kehillot of moshiach in yehudah;
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu-dhèu unu kristus ètu propensi yudea, dhae tadhe mèka ja'a.

source_text: only they were hearing that the one once bringing redifah persecution upon us is now preaching the emunah which once he was pillaging.
target_text: dhèu se'e dhoka tadèngi lii palolo, dhu peka na, dhèu dhu uru èèna paj'èra èdhi, limuri ne nuka aj'a lii lolo be'a kristus. nèngu ka dhu uru èèna, neo pa'ele iie aa'i èdhi.

source_text: and they were glorifying hashem in me.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, aa'i-aa'i ra koa-kio ama lamatua, lula ja'a parcaya le yesus kristus.

source_text: then, after arbah esrey shanim fourteen years, again i went up to yerushalayim with bar-nabba, having taken with me also titos.
target_text: d'ai èle canguru èpa tèu, hèia ja'a lèpa asa kota yerusalem sama-sama dènge barnabas. aa ji'i ngèti dènge titus, ca dhèu parcaya dhu yahudi boe.

source_text: yet i went up according to a chazon revelation, and i laid before them the besuras hageulah which i proclaim among the goyim, but i did this privately to the men of repute, lest i should run, or should prove to have run, l'tohu in vain.
target_text: ja'a laku asa nèi, lula lii paredha ama lamatua. d'ai nèi, ka ja'a lole mi dhèu heka-dhèu heka kristen, lii lolo be'a dhu ja'a aj'a-nori le mi dhèu yahudi boe sèra. lod'o èèna, ja'a peka unu ku mi rèngu se, ho ra parisa pabe'a-be'a ngaa dhu ja'a aj'a le sèra, lèke do aad'o. te ladhe ra pama'ète, peka na, a'aj'a ja'a èèna sala, na, dhèu bisa ngee, na, ja'a sab'a iia d'ara di!

source_text: but titos, the one with me, a yevani greek, was not compelled to undergo bris milah.
target_text: ropa dhèu se'e tadèngi rare lii ja'a sèmi èèna, hèia ra sèmi rare dènge be'a. aa ra d'èi sèmi rare titus dènge be'a kahèi. masi ka titus dhèu yahudi boe, te ngaa ra laka-seti boe sèna ka na suna.

source_text: but because of the achei sheker false brothers b'moshiach, the ones secretly brought in, the ones who crept in to spy out our derorfreedom which we have in moshiach yehoshua al menat in order that they might enslave us.
target_text: te ngaa lod'o èèna, abhu a'ari dhèu pèri dhu d'èi boe a'aj'a ja'a, lula rèngu se aj'a dhu leo. rèngu se, dhèu kristen kapod'e-kabèli. ka rèngu mau-mau mai laka-seti dhèu unu kristus sèra dhu dhèu yahudi boe, ho madhutu aa'i atora agama yahudi. te ngaa, lula yesus kristus patalale eele le èdhi, nèti èèna ka atora sèra èki heka èdhi, sèmi ènu sa.

source_text: to these enslavers not for one hour did we yield in subjection, that haemes of the besuras hageulah might continue and remain with you.
target_text: masi ka ra laka-seti sèmi èèna, te ngaa ciki sa ji'i ngo'o boe sèmi ngare. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu bisa parcaya taruu lii lolo be'a dhu ja'a nori le. te dhu mola-mola na kèna!

source_text: but from the men of repute whatever they once were matters nothing to me, ki ein masso panim im hashemfor there is no respect of persons with g-d, no partiality, for to me these men of repute added nothing.
target_text: dhèu heka-dhèu heka se sèmi rare lii a'aj'a ja'a ne, aa ra patabha heka ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa ama lamatua hag'e boe dhèu. de masi ka rèngu dhèu kapai do ana iiki, ngaa-ngaa tao boe.

source_text: but, on the contrary, having seen that i have been entrusted with the besuras hageulah for those without the bris milah, just as kefa was for those with the bris milah,
target_text: te dhu lèke, nuka: rèngu re'a, na, ama lamatua pili nare le ja'a, ho kèti lii lolo be'a mi dhèu-dhèu yahudi boe. nuka sèmi dhu na paredha mi petrus kahèi, sèna ka nèti lii lolo be'a asa dhèu yahudi.

source_text: for the one having worked in kefa for a shlichus to those with the bris milah also worked in me for a shlichus to the goyim.
target_text: te ama lamatua pangèd'u koasa mi petrus ho j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha mi dhèu yahudi. sèmi èèna kahèi, na hia ja'a koasa sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha mi dhèu-dhèu dhu yahudi boe.

source_text: and realizing the chen v'chesed hashem having been given to me, ya'akov and kefa and yochanan, the men of repute, the ones seeming to be ammudei hakehillah pillars of the kehillah, extended to me and to bar-nabba the yad yeminam right hands as a sign of achavah b'moshiach brotherhood in moshiach, that we should be for those of the goyim, but they for those of the bris milah,
target_text: lod'o èèna, madhutu ngangee dhèu sèra, yakobis, petrus, dènge yohanis, dhu j'aj'i le ama-ama gareja. ropa rèngu tèlu ra re'a, na, ama lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a, hèia ra kèd'i paj'ola ai dènge ja'a, aa dènge barnabas, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi d'ara èci le. rèngu ro'o kahèi, ji'i ngèti lii lolo be'a asa dhèu yahudi boe, aa rèngu rèti asa dhèu yahudi.

source_text: only that we should remember the aniyim the poor, the very thing which i was also eager to do.
target_text: dhoka ca j'ara di, dhu ra pasanèd'e ji'i, nuka ji'i baku bhèlu soru-bara dhèu dhu unu aad'o sèra. mema j'ara ne'e ka dhu ja'a neo tao.

source_text: but when kefa came to antioch, i stood against him to his face, because there was found in him a dvar ashmah a thing of guilt, condemnation.
target_text: ka ca tèka, petrus mai asa kota antiokia. hèia ja'a kai ne patoo madha dènge madha, lula nèngu tao sala.

source_text: for, before certain ones came from ya'akov, kefa was as a matter of course sitting at tish at betzi'at halechem breaking of bread at the seudos moshiach with the goyim; but, when they came, kefa drew back and was separating himself, fearing the ones of the bris milah.
target_text: lod'o na heka mai, nèngu karèj'e madhèdi na'a dènge dhèu-dhèu unu kristus dhu dhèu yahudi boe. te ngaa ropa angalai yakobis dhèu yahudi sèra mai, hèia petrus mulai pakaj'èu nèti a'ari dhèu yahudi boe, ka na na'a pa'èci heka dènge rèngu. te lula na madha'u dènge a'aj'a nèti dhèu yahudi dhu peka na, dhèu unu kristus hud'i kèpe pa'èra-èra atora agama yahudi aa'i-aa'i, aa hud'i pakaj'èu ku dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu yahudi boe.

source_text: and the rest of the yehudim who were ma'aminim b'moshiach joined with kefa in this dissembling, so that even bar-nabba was carried away with their tzevi'ut hypocrisy.
target_text: ropa rèdhi tatao petrus ne, ka dhèu yahudi dhu leo sèra tao madhutu kahèi. toke barnabas kahèi madhutu tatao ra dhu peka leo, tao leo.

source_text: but when i saw that their halichah, their hitnahagut conduct was not the derech hayashar straight way with respect to haemes of habesuras hageulah, i said to kefa before all, if you, being a yehudi, have a hitnahagut that is according to the derech goyim and not the derech yehudim, how do you compel the goyim to live as the yehudim?
target_text: te ngaa ropa ja'a patigi kèdhi, rèngu madhutu be'a heka dad'èi lii lolo be'a, hèia ja'a kai dènge ka petrus ètu katanga madha rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, peka na, eee, petrus! èu ne, mema dhèu yahudi. te ngaa ama lamatua bhoke le j'ara, ho dhèu dhu parcaya yesus kristus pa'èki heka madhutu atora agama yahudi sèra. aa èu dhu sèmi more le j'ara ne'e, nga tasamia ka, èu laka-seti dhèu yahudi boe, sèna ka tao iisi ra sama sèmi dhèu yahudi?

source_text: we ourselves are yehudim by birth and not goyishe chote'im sinners.
target_text: ja'a kai petrus sèmi èèna, lula ji'i dua mi dhèu yahudi. suku ji'i dua mi se dhèu yahudi, sama boe dènge suku leo sèra, lula suku ji'i dhu nèbhu le tadhe ama lamatua.

source_text: yet we have da'as that a man cannot be yitzdak im hashembe justified with g-d by depending on the ma'asim of gezetz law, but through emunah in rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua. and we have come to have bitachon in rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua, that we can be yitzdak im hashembe justified with g-d by emunah in moshiach and not by ma'asim, because by taryag mitzvot kol chai lo yitzdakall living shall not be justified.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, ji'i nge'a kahèi, na, lamatua sèmi nare boe ca dhèu sa j'aj'i mi dhèu mola, lula nèngu tao madhutu atora agama dènge be'a. te ngaa lamatua sèmi nare dhèu, ladhe nèngu parcaya yesus kristus, lula boe nèti nèngu madhutu atora agama. sèmi èèna ku, heka lamatua peka na, dhèu ne dènge heka sasala-sasigo.

source_text: now, if, by seeking to be yitzdak im hashem in moshiach, we ourselves were found also to be chote'im sinners, then in that case is moshiach a kohen for iniquity, a minister serving sin? chas v'shalom g-d forbid!
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ji'i aj'a, na, lamatua sèmi nare dhèu j'aj'i mi dhèu mola, lula na parcaya yesus kristus. te ngaa abhu dhèu yahudi dhu pasala ji'i. ra peka na, ji'i parcaya yesus kristus, te ngaa kèpe heka atora agama yahudi. miu neo pèci sasala sèmi èèna mi ji'i kahèi, do?

source_text: for if what i destroyed, these things i again rebuild, i display myself to be a poshei'a transgressor.
target_text: te ladhe ja'a kèpe kore hari atora agama dhu ja'a patabuli eele le, èèna heka peka na ja'a sala kèna!

source_text: for i, through the torah, died in relation to the gezetz, so that i might live to hashem. with moshiach i have been talui al haetzhanging on the tree. but it is no longer anochi i who lives, but moshiach who lives in me, and the chayyim i now live in the basar, i live by emunah, emunah in the zun fun der oybershter, the one having ahavah agape for me and having given himself over, on my behalf.
target_text: mema uru èèna, ja'a tenge j'ara ho madhutu dènge be'a atora agama yahudi, sèna ka ja'a pabe'a dènge lamatua. te ngaa bisa boe kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ja'a tèke eele le atora agama sèra, ho mamuri pa'èki dènge kristus. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, heka ama lamatua sèmi nare ja'a j'aj'i mi dhèu mola. peka sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a madhe lèke paku ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha sama-sama dènge kristus. de limuri ne, ja'a boe ka dhu mamuri, te ngaa kristus ka dhu mamuri ètu d'ara ngi'u ja'a. ja'a abhu mamuri dhu hiu ne, lula parcaya ana nèti lamatua. te nèngu sue ja'a titu kèna, toke na madhe gati ja'a.

source_text: i do not set aside the chen v'chesed hashem; for if the mah how an enosh man is to be yitzdak im hashem is found through gezetz chumra, then moshiach died for nothing and l'tohu in vain.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua sèmi nare ja'a, lula d'ara hua iia na, lula boe nèti ja'a madhutu atora agama sèra. te ladhe dhèu bisa pabe'a dènge lamatua lula madhutu atora agama, èèna sasoa na, mamadhe kristus iia-iia d'ara di. sèra sa ka dhu ja'a peka dènge petrus si ètu antiokia.

source_text: o senseless galatians, who bewitched you? it was before your eyes that rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua was publicly shown forth as having been talui al haetzhanging on the tree.
target_text: heh! dhèu galati sèra! uru èèna, ja'a unu ku lole dènge miu patoo madha dènge madha, lula-nèti mamadhe yesus kristus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. te ngaa limuri ne dhèu monya miu mamadha iia-iia! miu se, goa titu kèna!

source_text: this one thing only i want to learn from you: did you receive the ruach hakodesh by means of ma'asim of gezetz works of law or by means of the hearing of emunah?
target_text: ja'a neo dhoka karèi ca j'ara di. miu sèmi mere le roh lamatua èèna, lula miu madhutu atora agama, do? aad'o, si! roh na mai asa miu, lula miu lèka lii lolo be'a dhu miu nanene èèna.

source_text: you lack seichel; having begun in the ruach hakodesh, will you now be perfected in the basar?
target_text: de, nga tao ka miu goa sèmi èèna, ee? uru èèna, miu mamuri le madhutu dad'èi roh mola-mèci. te ngaa limuri ne, miu kabèli hari, mamuri madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: did you suffer so many things lashav in vain? - if it really was lashav.
target_text: lod'o hiu-hiu dhu miu parcaya kristus èèna, miu abhu j'aj'èra ae titu kèna. mage dhoka j'ara sèra ele iia d'ara di! te ngaa madhutu mola-mola na, parcaya mi kristus ele boe iia d'ara.

source_text: so then, hashem who is supplying to you the ruach hakodesh and producing nifla'ot miracles among you, by what means does he do it, by ma'asim of gezetz or by the hearing of emunah?
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua hia roh na, aa pad'elo rupa-rupa tadha malaa ètu madha miu, miu ngee, na, lamatua tao sèmi èèna, lula miu madhutu atora agama, do? aad'o, si! na tao sèmi èèna, lula miu lèka lii lolo be'a dhu miu nanene èèna.

source_text: - just as avraham avinu he'emin b'hashem v'yachsheveha lo tzedakahbelieved hashem and it his faith was accounted to him for righteousness.
target_text: sanèd'e mèdhi era sina ma, bèi-baki dhèu yahudi, nuka abraham. te sasuri mola-mèci lamatua suri, peka na, lula na parcaya ama lamatua, ka lamatua sèmi nare ne j'aj'i mi dhèu mola.

source_text: know then, that the bnei haemunah, these ones are the bnei avraham avinu!
target_text: de miu hud'i me'a pabe'a-be'a ku j'ara ne'e! dhèu dhu parcaya sama sèmi abraham, rèngu j'aj'i mi dhèu unu ama lamatua dhu tare'a-re'a.

source_text: and the kitvei hakodesh, having foreseen that hashem would yatzdik justify the goyim by emunah, preached the besuras hageulah beforehand to avraham avinu, saying, v'nivrechu vo kol goyei ha'aretzall the peoples of the earth will be blessed in you.
target_text: lamatua dhu peka tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci na, peka na, nèngu sèmi nare kahèi dhèu nèti suku leo j'aj'i mi dhèu mola, ladhe ra parcaya ne. te uru èèna, na peka mema le mi abraham lii lolo be'a, na, bèli-camèd'a suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, abhu mèngi-nale lula èu ne.

source_text: for this reason, the ones of emunah receive the bracha blessing with avraham avinu hama'amin the believer.
target_text: lula lii moa ama lamatua èèna, ka na papuru kahèi berkat mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ne, nuka sèmi dhu na hia mi abraham.

source_text: for as many as are seeking yitzdak im hashem by ma'asim of gezetz are under a kelalah curse; for it has been written, arur asher lo yakim es divrei hatorah hazot la'asot otamcursed is everyone who does not uphold, abide by all the words of this torah to do them.
target_text: dhèu dhu madhutu atora agama, sèna ka lamatua sèmi nare ne j'aj'i mi dhèu mola, nèngu hud'i pasae nare ku babia nèti atora sèra aa'i-aa'i, nuka sèmi nèngu lèke le dhoo. te dhu suri ètu sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, dhèu dhu madhutu boe taruu atora agama d'ai lutu, nèngu lèke le dhoo èèna!

source_text: now it is clear that not one person is yitzdak im hashem justified with g-d by gezetz, because v'tzaddik be'emunato yicheyehthe righteous by his faith will live.
target_text: te ngaa te'a, na, ama lamatua sèmi nare boe ca dhèu sa, lula na madhutu atora agama. te dhu suri tèke, peka na, dhèu hud'i parcaya ku ja'a, heka sèmi kore ne j'aj'i mi dhèu mola, ho na abhu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: but the gezetz is not of emunah, but the man ya'aseh otam vachaiwho does these things will live by them.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu neo mamuri madhutu dad'èi atora agama, nèngu hud'i tao madhutu ku aa'i-aa'i toke lutu! te lamatua dhu peka mema le ètu sasuri mola-mèci, na, dhèu dhu neo mamuri madhutu atora, èèna na nèngu bhute dhoka dènge atora sèra di.

source_text: moshiach redeemed us from the kelalah curse of the torah, having become a kelalah curse on behalf of us, because it has been written, kilelat hashem is on nivlato talui al haetzcurse of g-d is on the nevelah body, corpse being hanged on the tree,
target_text: te ngaa kristus b'ae pama'ète le, ho patabuli èdhi nèti atora agama dhu èki èdhi. uru èèna, èdhi mamuri oe madhe, dènge pasae babia atora agama, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu lèke dhoo. te ngaa limuri ne lamatua yesus ded'e eele le babia èèna nèti èdhi. te dhu suri tèke ètu sasuri mola-mèci, na, ladhe dhèu madhe lèke kadhoe ètu agarii, sasoa na, nèngu madhe aapa.

source_text: in order that to the goyim the bracha of avraham avinu might come by moshiach yehoshua, that the havtachah promise of the ruach hakodesh we might receive through emunah.
target_text: ropa yesus kristus madhe, sèna ka pala-bagi mamuri mi èdhi, berkat èèna ka dhu ama lamatua pangèd'u mi abraham, aa hia kahèi mi suku leo. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya kristus, bisa abhu roh ama lamatua dhu na jaji le.

source_text: achim b'moshiach, i speak according to human dimyon analogy. even a brit covenant having been confirmed by bnei adam no one sets aside or adds to it.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! doe ne'e ja'a neo kore pakasame nèti mamuri èdhi bèli-mai bèli-mai. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu suri sasuri lii padhadha nèti pusaka, ka dhu ènyi le ngara na ètu sasuri ne, sasoa na, sasuri ne lèke tare'a. dhèu leo bisa boe ère eele ngaa dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri èèna, aa bisa boe suri tabha hari ngaa-ngaa asa d'ara sasuri èèna.

source_text: now to avraham avinu were spoken the havtachot promises and to his zeraseed. he does not say v'lizeraechah and to your seeds, as concerning many, but as concerning one, and to the zera of you, and that zera is moshiach.
target_text: sama sèmi èèna kahèi, lod'o ama lamatua patari lii padhadha dènge abraham, aa dènge ana-èpu na. ama lamatua peka boe, na, ja'a patari lii padhadha ne dènge ana-èpu èu sèra, lula na padhadha boe dènge dhèu ae-ae. te ngaa na padhadha dhoka dènge ana-èpu abraham ca dhèu di, nuka kristus.

source_text: and this i say: a brit covenant, which was previously confirmed by hashem, cannot be annulled so as to abolish the havtachah promise by the mattan torah - which was given arba me'ot usheloshim shanah four hundred and thirty years later.
target_text: a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ama lamatua paj'ari uru lii padhadha dènge abraham. hèia èpa ngasu tèlu nguru tèu ku, heka na papuru atora agama hia dhèu yahudi kèna, re baki ra musa. te ngaa masi ka sèmi èèna, lamatua ère heka lii padhadha dhu na tao uru èèna.

source_text: for if the nachalah inheritance is based on gezetz, it is no longer based on havtachah promise; but hashem has given the nachalah to avraham avinu by havtachah promise.
target_text: te lamatua hia boe mèngi-nale mi abraham, lula na tao madhutu atora ne. te ngaa lamatua hia berkat lula na moa tèke le, karèi nèti uru ka, ho hia hadia mi abraham. èèna nuka sèmi ana ca dhèu abhu pusaka nèti ama na. ana ne abhu pusaka na, lula ama na dhu padhadha uru le, lula boe nèti ana ne tao madhutu atora.

source_text: why then the mattan torah giving of the torah? the torah was added because of peysha'im, until the zera moshiach should come to whom the havtachah had been made. now the torah was administered through malachim by the hand of a metavech.
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: ladhe ama lamatua sèmi nare abraham j'aj'i mi dhèu mola lula lalèka na, nga tao ka lamatua tabha hari atora agama re musa? lamatua tabha atora agama sèra, sèna ka aj'a dhèu rai-haha lula-nèti sasala-sasigo ra. dad'èi na sèna ka dhèu rai-haha mamuri madhutu dad'èi atora sèra, toke ana-èpu abraham ca dhèu mai. hèia ladhe dhèu ne mai ka, nuka kristus èèna, na, atora ne parluu heka. lod'o lamatua papuru atora agama yahudi, nèngu j'ole mema boe mi dhèu yahudi sèra. te ngaa na hia re ana pajuu na nèti sorga, mai pangèd'u mi adhe-aai musa, heka musa hia asa dhèu yahudi kèna. dènge j'ara ne'e, musa j'aj'i nuka sèmi kalete sa nèti lamatua dènge dhèu-dhèu unu na.

source_text: now the metavech is not for only one, but elohim hu echad.
target_text: te ngaa ropa ama lamatua tao lii pajaji dènge abraham, na pake boe kalete. te lamatua peka unu na dènge abraham! dènge sèmi èèna, èdhi te'a, na, lii pajaji lamatua ne kab'ua risi eele nèti atora sèra.

source_text: is the torah, mimeila consequently, as a result, against the havtachot promises of hashem? chas v'shalom g-d forbid! for if gezetz had been given that had the ko'ach power to affect hitkhadshut regeneration, then to be yitzdak im hashem justified with g-d would indeed have been based on ma'asim of gezetz.
target_text: lod'o lamatua hia atora agama asa musa èèna, pasala dènge lii-lii pajaji na, do? aad'o! te ladhe abhu atora dhu dhèu rai-haha bisa tao madhutu ne, ho lamatua sèmi nare ne sèna ka na bisa mamuri, tatu atora dhèu yahudi bisa tao sèmi èèna kahèi. madhutu iia-iia na, abhu boe atora èci sa dhu dhèu bisa tao madhutu ne, sèna ka cuhi d'ara lamatua ho lamatua sèmi nare ne j'aj'i mi dhèu mola.

source_text: but the kitvei hakodesh consigned all things under hachet sin, that the havtachah promise might be given by emunah in rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua to the ma'aminim.
target_text: te ètu sasuri lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna, suri peka na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra pa'èki madhe dènge rupa-rupa sasala ra. nèti èèna ka, dhodhoka dhèu dhu parcaya yesus kristus di, bisa abhu ngaa dhu ama lamatua moa tèke èèna.

source_text: but before emunah came, we were being held in custody, being confined and guarded for the about-to-be-revealed emunah.
target_text: lod'o kristus dhae mai mèka, ji'i dhèu yahudi pa'èki madhe dènge atora sèra, toke bisa boe kalau. te ngaa ropa d'ai lod'o na, lamatua bhoke j'ara ho ji'i kalua nèti atora sèra, ladhe ji'i parcaya kristus.

source_text: this is the result: the gezetz functioned as our omenet governess unto moshiach, that by emunah we might be yitzdak im hashem. but emunah having come, we are no longer under an omenet governess.
target_text: de atora agama sèra, sama sèmi dhèu madhenge dhu aj'a paie-iie èdhi toke kristus mai. te ngaa ropa na mai ku, heka èdhi bisa parcaya ne, sèna ka èdhi mamuri pabe'a dènge ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne èdhi parluu heka dhèu madhenge èèna.

source_text: for through emunah in rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua, you are all yeladim of elohim.
target_text: limuri ne, miu j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua, lula miu parcaya yesus kristus.

source_text: for as many as have had a tevilah into moshiach have clothed yourselves with moshiach.
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu sarani èle le, ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na dhu pa'èki madhe dènge ne.

source_text: there is not yehudi nor yevani greek, there is not eved servant nor ben chorin freedman, there is not zachar male nor nekevah female, for you are all echad in moshiach yehoshua.
target_text: dhèu dhu lèka kristus, aa'i-aa'i ra èci èèna ka, beda boe. de masi ka miu dhèu yahudi, do dhèu yahudi boe, ènu do ènu boe, dhèu mone do dhèu bhèni, aa'i-aa'i mi dhu pa'èki le dènge yesus kristus, ca ropa èèna ka.

source_text: and, if you belong to moshiach, then you are of the zera of avraham avinu, you are yoreshim heirs according to the havtachah promise.
target_text: kristus ne, ana-èpu abraham dhu ama lamatua padhadha karèi nèti uru ka. lula miu pa'èki le dènge kristus, nèti èèna ka miu j'aj'i le tare'a-re'a ana-èpu abraham. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, miu bisa kahèi abhu berkat dhu ama lamatua moa tèke le mi abraham.

source_text: now i say this: for however much time as the yoresh heir has not attained his majority the state or time of being of full legal age, or his religious majority, his bar mitzvah, he differs nothing from an eved, though being ba'al bayit of all the nachalah inheritance.
target_text: ja'a pakasame dhu leo hari. ca dhèu ana dhu dènge hak ho abhu pusaka nèti ama na, ladhe ama na madhe. te ngaa ladhe ana ne ana iiki ae era, nèngu bisa mèka abhu pusaka èèna, masi ka èèna na aa'i-aa'i se unu nèngu. lula nèngu d'ai mèka umur, nèngu ne nuka sèmi ènu dhu dènge boe hak, sèna ka nare mèdha-panyau lamatua na.

source_text: and he is under shomrim guardians and omnot governesses until the time previously appointed by the ba'al bayit.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, hud'i dènge ku dhèu dhu pa'uri ana ne dènge pusaka na. ana ne hud'i madhutu ku dad'èi nèti dhèu madhenge nèngu, toke d'ai lod'o dhu ama na pama'ète nare èèna, heka na sèmi nare pusaka na kèna.

source_text: so also we, when we were immature, had been enslaved under the yesodot rudiments of the olam hazeh.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge èdhi. lod'o yesus kristus dhae mai mèka, èdhi nuka sèmi ana iiki èèna. te èdhi dhu pa'èki madhe dènge dad'èi rai-haha, nuka sèmi ènu ca dhèu.

source_text: but when the fullness of time had come, hashem sent forth his zun fun der oybershter, born of an isha, born under gezetz law, that moshiach might bring the geulah redemption to the ones under gezetz law, that we might receive the ma'amad habanim the standing as sons, the bechirah adoption.
target_text: te ngaa ropa d'ai lod'o na, ama lamatua pua mai ana d'èlu na dhu j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha èèna, sèna ka dhèu rai-haha bisa kahèi j'aj'i dhèu dhu ama lamatua ded'e nare j'aj'i ana-ana na. ana d'èlu na èèna mamuri madhutu atora agama dhèu yahudi, sèna ka nèngu bisa patabuli dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu uru èèna pa'èki dènge atora se.

source_text: and because you are banim, hashem sent forth the ruach of his zun fun der oybershter into your levavot, crying abba, avinu!
target_text: lula miu j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka na hia le roh ana na mai asa d'ara miu. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu dènge hak paroa ama lamatua, na, ama pasue.

source_text: so you are no longer an eved but a ben; and if a ben, also a yoresh through hashem.
target_text: de limuri ne miu j'aj'i heka ènu dhu dènge boe hak ho abhu pusaka. te ngaa miu j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua dhu dènge hak, sèna ka abhu pusaka aa'i-aa'i dhu na pajaji tèke le.

source_text: but, formerly, when you did not have da'as knowledge of hashem, you were avadim serving that which is by nature not hael ha'amiti the true g-d.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o miu tadhe mèka ama lamatua, miu tao iisi mi j'aj'i ènu, ho sogo-tagu ngaa-ngaa dhu lèke boe.

source_text: but, now, having known hashem, or rather having been known by hashem, how is it that you are returning to the weak and beggarly yesodot rudiments of the olam hazeh to which again you want to renew your service as avadim?
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, miu tadhe le ama lamatua. be'a risi, ja'a peka, na, ama lamatua ka dhu tadhe miu. de tasamia ka miu neo lèpa hari asa sogo-tagu ngaa dhu guna boe, aa dhu dènge boe koasa ngaa-ngaa sèra? miu neo tao iisi mi pa'èki dènge j'ara-j'ara sèra, sèna ka j'aj'i hari ènu ra, do?

source_text: you observe yamim days and chodashim months, new moons and mo'adim fixed times, festivals and shanim.
target_text: ja'a tadèngi, na, miu kèpe atora ho pakab'ua risi lod'o-lod'o hua iia madhutu lod'o, hèru, èj'i lai, hèru hadhu, dènge tèu, ho neo pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua.

source_text: i fear for you, lest somehow efsher perhaps i have labored for you lashav in vain.
target_text: ne'e ne ka dhu pa'ele iie ngangee ja'a! mage dhoka j'aj'èra ja'a aj'a-nori miu nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ele iie d'ara di.

source_text: become as i am, because i also became as you are, achim b'moshiach. i implore you. you did me no wrong.
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue! ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu mamuri pa'èki ia ka dènge madha j'ara sèra, sèmi ja'a ne. te mamuri ja'a ne pa'èki heka le dènge atora agama, èci èèna ka dènge miu dhèu yahudi boe. uru èèna, lod'o èdhi bera-bera era, miu pasusa boe ja'a.

source_text: and you know that it was due to chulshat habasar weakness of the flesh, sickness that i first preached the besuras hageulah to you,
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, na, ca hari ni, lod'o ja'a mai hiu-hiu èèna, ho peka-padhai lii lolo be'a dènge miu, ngi'u aae ja'a ne roe-bhilu.

source_text: and your nisayon trial in my basar you did not despise nor did you loathe, but as a malach hashem you received me, as rebbe melech hamoshiach yehoshua himself.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu tule eele boe ja'a, lula miu sèmi mere ja'a nuka sèmi ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga. risi-risi hari, miu sèmi mere ja'a ne, nuka sèmi yesus kristus mesa na.

source_text: where then is your birkat shomayim? for i testify to you that if possible, having torn out your eynayeem eyes, you would have made a mattanah gift of them to me.
target_text: lod'o èèna, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti karej'e titu kèna. te ngaa, nga tao ka limuri ne, sèmi heka èèna? uru èèna, miu sue ja'a titu kèna, ka miu toke neo ed'o eele ana madha miu ho hia ja'a.

source_text: so, then, have i become your oyev enemy by telling you haemes?
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, miu ngee, na, ja'a j'aj'i le musu miu, lula ja'a padhai dhu mola dènge miu, do?

source_text: they the mohalim hagoyim are zealously courting you, but not in a good way; rather, they desire to cut you off and shut you out, in order that you may be zealous for them.
target_text: dhèu kapod'e-kabèli sèra, ro'o boe ja'a pa'angalai dènge miu, ka ra dadugu miu ho madhutu aa'i atora agama yahudi. dad'èi d'ara ra, sèna ka miu bhute madhutu dad'èi rèngu di.

source_text: now it is tov ma'od to be zealous in a good thing all the time, and not only during my presence with you.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu maj'èni tao j'ara dhu be'a, èèna be'a kahèi! masi ka ja'a sama-sama dènge miu, do aad'o, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. sad'i miu tao j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: my yeladim, for whom again i suffer chevlei leydah birth pains until moshiach is formed in you,
target_text: ana-ana pasue! ne'e ne, ja'a sab'a bia risi hari hia miu, nuka sèmi bhèni dhu kabake pèd'a neo nara iisi. te ja'a ae kora boe ciki sa nèti sasab'a, toke d'ara miu èci èèna ka dènge d'ara kristus.

source_text: would that i were present with you just now and could change my tone, because i am baffled by you.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a ke'a heka neo tao miu tasamia hari! ja'a d'èi titu kèna, dhiu padhai lii patoo madha dènge miu, sèna ka ja'a baku padhai lii taka sèmi ne'e ne.

source_text: tell me, you goyim who wish to be under gezetz, do you not possess shema hearing of the torah?
target_text: ladhe miu neo mamuri madhutu atora agama dhèu yahudi, be'a risi miu me'a uuru ku dad'èi nèti atora sèra.

source_text: for the torah says that avraham avinu had shnei banim two sons, one of shifchah the slave woman and one of the gevirah.
target_text: ètu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua abhu lii lolo dhu lole, peka na, ana mone abraham, dhèu dua. nèngu abhu ana ca dhèu nèti bhèni dhu ènu na, aa ca dhèu hari nèti dhèu èmu-kamali na, dhu ènu boe.

source_text: but the one of the slave woman has been born according to the basar, and the one of the free woman has been born through the havtachah promise.
target_text: ènu ne nara iisi ana na, lula madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa dhèu èmu abraham nara iisi ana na, lula madhutu lii moa dhu ama lamatua peka mema le.

source_text: now these things can be taken derech mashal figuratively; for these are two beritotcovenants, one from mount sinai bearing banim for avdut slavery, bondage: this is hagar.
target_text: bhèni dhèu dua se, nuka sèmi tadha dhu pad'elo dua lii pajaji dhu ama lamatua padhadha dènge dhèu rai-haha. lii pajaji èci, lamatua pangèd'u mi musa ètu ledhe sinai, lod'o nèngu papuru atora agama dhèu yahudi. dhèu dhu pa'èki dènge atora agama sèra, rèngu j'aj'i ènu sama sèmi hagar kahèi.

source_text: now, hagar is the mount sinai in arabia; and corresponds to the yerushalayim of the present, for she is in avdut with her banim.
target_text: era ètu ledhe sinai ètu rae arab èèna, nuka sèmi hagar ne kahèi. dhèu yerusalem aa'i-aa'i lod'o limuri ne, dhu pa'èki era dènge atora agama yahudi, rèngu sèra ènu kahèi nuka sèmi hagar.

source_text: but the yerushalayim above is a bat chorin daughter of freedom, the imma lechulanu the mother of us all.
target_text: te ngaa lii pajaji dhu leo hari, paj'uj'u asa kota yerusalem dhu leo èci ètu sorga. ana-ana unu ama lamatua dhu pea ètu èèna, ènu boe. te rèngu dhèu bebas dhu pa'èki boe dènge atora agama èèna. nèti èèna ka, rèngu se èci èèna ka dènge ina ji'i sara, dhèu èmu abraham.

source_text: for it has been written, ranni akarah lo yaladah pitzchi rinnah v'tzahali lo chalah ki rabbim benei shomemah mib'nei ve'ulah sing, rejoice, o barren, the one not giving birth, break forth into song and shout for joy, the one not suffering birth pains; because more are the children of the desolate woman than the one having the husband.
