source_text: only one thing: conduct in practice your torat haezrakhutcitizenship worthily of the besuras hageulah of rebbe, melech hamoshiach. then, whether i come and see you or am absent, i may hear concerning you that you are standing like a ma'oz fortress, bastion in one ruach, with one neshamah, contending for the emunah of the besuras hageulah. and, i might add, not having pachad fear, terror in reaction to anything as far as the mitnaggedim the ones opposing are concerned, which is a proof to them of their churban destruction, but of your yeshu'ahsalvation, and this from hashem.
target_text: masi ka tasa mera mia, mamuri miu hud'i lèke ku, te miu dhèu unu lamatua. de miu hud'i mamuri dhu mèci ku, aa tao madhutu lii lolo be'a yesus kristus dhu peka le dènge miu. aa ladhe bèli-camèd'a ja'a lèpa hari dhiu pangad'o dènge miu, do tadèngi dhoka lii nèti dhèu di, peka na, miu mamuri mola, na, d'ara ja'a karej'e. te ja'a bisa ke'a, na, miu dhu mamuri d'ara èci, lula pa'èki dènge roh èci di. aa bisa ke'a, na, miu pa'èra ho pakako sama-sama lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus, sèna ka dhèu leo parcaya kahèi. aa miu me'a boe madha'u kahèi, masi ka abhu dhèu dhu lab'a miu. ne'e ne j'aj'i mi tadha hia musu, na, ama lamatua neo lalèta eele si. te ngaa ama lamatua hia miu mamuri, ho bèli-camèd'a miu mamuri taruu dènge nèngu.

source_text: for to you it was given on behalf of rebbe, melech hamoshiach, not only to have emunah in him but also on behalf of him to be laden with the burden of messianic yissurimsufferings,
target_text: te, lula ama lamatua d'ara hua iia risi, nèti èèna ka na bhoke le j'ara, sèna ka miu bisa parcaya kristus, aa j'aj'i dhèu unu na. mesa boe parcaya di, te ngaa lamatua soro tèke miu abhu sasusa kahèi, lula miu madhutu nèngu.

source_text: with you having the same struggle, which you saw in me and now hear to be in me.
target_text: te dhu ja'a tadèngi, abhu dhèu ètu sèra dhu lab'a miu, lula miu pakako lii lolo be'a kristus. sanèd'e, te ca hari ni rèngu lab'a le ja'a kahèi, toke d'ai doe ne'e ne.

source_text: if, therefore, there is any idud encouragement in moshiach, if any nechamah comfort of ahavah love, if any deveykus attachment to g-d in the messianic chavrusashaft association of the ruach hakodesh, if any warmth of affection and rachamanut compassion, mercy,
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i, unu yesus kristus! na pangèd'u le miu j'ara be'a ae-ae. de miu bisa pa'èra d'ara èci dènge èci. miu bisa holo dhu mai nèti sasue miu. miu bisa mamuri pabe'a èci dènge èci, lula roh lamatua dhu sab'a ètu talora aae miu. aa miu bisa pad'elo rasa kasia miu dènge d'ara be'a èci dènge èci.

source_text: then make my simcha joy shleimah complete by having the same lev, the same ahavah, being an agudah association with one neshamah, thinking the same machshavot thoughts,
target_text: ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, na, d'ara ja'a karej'e kea rae-rae. risi-risi hari, ladhe miu pasue dènge d'ara èci, mamuri ètu ca j'ara, aa mere lii èci ètu d'ara sasab'a-la'a.

source_text: doing nothing according to anochiyutselfishness nor according to empty ga'avah conceit, haughtiness, arrogance, but in anavah humility, fergin graciously grant each other esteem above yourselves.
target_text: baku tao ngaa-ngaa dhu tenge dhoka pa'oto ngi'u èu risi nèti dhèu leo. aa baku pangee, na, èu risi nèti dhèu leo. te pamone do pabhèni èu èèna, dènge boe kolo-kapua. te ngaa èdhi hud'i pahaha iisi ku, sèna ka te'a, na, dhèu leo risi nèti èdhi.

source_text: let each of you talmidim look after not only your own interests, but also the best interests of others.
target_text: aa baku dhoka uri mamuri miu mesa-mesa mi. te ngaa èdhi hud'i ladhe kahèi, ngaa dhu dhèu leo parluu.

source_text: let this mind be in you which was also in rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua,
target_text: te d'ara èdhi hud'i sama ku sèmi d'ara yesus kristus.

source_text: who, though existing in the demut of the mode of being of elohim, nevertheless moshiach did not regard being equal with g-d as a thing to be seized,
target_text: masi ka nèngu ca ropa dènge ama lamatua, aa nèngu kètu èdhi kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge ama lamatua, te ngaa na tèke eele hak na, aa pake boe dadedha dènge kapai na.

source_text: but poured out and emptied himself, taking the demut of the mode of being of an eved, and was born in the likeness of bnei adam, and having been found in appearance as an adam,
target_text: hèia na puru mai asa rai-haha ne, ca ropa dènge dhèu rai-haha. na tèke eele hak na aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka tao iisi na j'aj'i nuka sèmi ènu sa.

source_text: rebbe, melech hamoshiach humbled himself and took the path of shiflut lowliness, unto mishma'atobedience even unto death, and that, a death on haetz.
target_text: mesa boe j'aj'i dhèu haha d'ai seli di, te ngaa na tao ngi'u na j'aj'i dhèu dhu laku-laku boe kahèi, sèna ka tao madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. masi ka ra pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, na sèmi nare kahèi, aa madhe, nuka sèmi dhèu bhelu.

source_text: therefore, also hashem exalted rebbe, melech hamoshiach, and gave to him hashem above every name,
target_text: lula nèngu pahaha iisi sèmi èèna, nèti èèna ka ama lamatua ded'e ne padedha-dedha. aa pangèd'u ne ngara dhu kapai aae. te abhu boe ngara èci sa dhu kapai aae risi nèti nèngu.

source_text: that at hashem of yehoshua, kol berech every knee will bow, of beings b'shomayim and ba'aretz and mitachat la'aretz in the world below,
target_text: ama lamatua ded'e padedha-dedha ngara na èèna, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i pakab'ua ne. nuka: dhèu ètu dedha-liru, dènge dhèu ètu rai-haha ne. dhèu mamuri dènge dhèu madhe. bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i patitu kètu urutuu, ho pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: and kol lashonevery tongue shall make hoda'ah confession with an ani ma'amin that is an open and public admission that rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua yeshua is adoneinu, to the kavod of elohim avinu.
target_text: aa bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i peka na, yesus kristus èèna, tare'a-re'a lamatua! dènge sèmi èèna, rèngu koa-kio ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: therefore, chaverim, just as you have always had mishma'atobedience concerning me, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own yeshu'ah salvation b'yir'ah with fear and bira'dah with trembling.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! nanene paie-iie! uru èèna, lod'o ja'a pea ètu kota pilipi era, miu nanene lii padhai ja'a, ka miu madhutu j'ara mola ama lamatua. limuri ne, èdhi pahag'a, te ngaa ja'a manèngi ho miu titu èra ètu d'ara mamuri mola. sanèd'e, te ladhe miu nanene boe nèngu, bèli-camèd'a pe mèdhi unu mi! lula nèngu ka dhu patalale miu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo mi. hèia miu mamuri dhu mèci, te miu j'aj'i le dhèu unu na.

source_text: for hashem is the one working in you, both to will and to work according to his chafetz good pleasure of his will.
target_text: te ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu sab'a ètu d'ara miu. nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara, sèna ka miu neo nanene ne. aa nèngu ka dhu hia koasa kahèi, ho miu d'èi sab'a pakarej'e d'ara na.

source_text: do all things without murmurings and madon,
target_text: de ladhe sad'i miu tao ngaa èèna ka, na, baku ka'uu-kamuki, aa baku pasibha d'ara lii.

source_text: that you may be innocent and without michshol of blame, bnei haelohim tamim u'mumunblemished and unspotted in the midst of a dor ikkesh ufetaltol warped and crooked generation, among whom you shine as the zohar in the olam hazeh,
target_text: tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka miu j'aj'i dhèu dhu d'ara mola-mèci, aa dhèu dhu dènge boe sasala. miu mamuri ètu d'ara talora aae dhèu bhelu dènge dhèu kapod'e-kabèli. te ngaa baku madhutu si! te mamuri miu hud'i mola-mèci ku, lula miu ana-ana lamatua. hèia mamuri miu hud'i heo ku, ho pad'elo j'ara hia rèngu, nuka sèmi hua-hètu dhu pasaraa ètu d'ara maroga.

source_text: holding fast the dvar hachayyim. this is so that i will have reason for glorying on the yom hamoshiach, that i neither ran nor labored l'tohu in vain.
target_text: hèia miu mamuri mola dènge pakako lii holo-nori lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a miu tao d'ara ja'a kea rae-rae, lod'o yesus kristus lèpa hari mai. aa rui-j'aj'èra ja'a core eele boe iia d'ara, te ngaa dènge kab'ua.

source_text: and, indeed, if my neshamah is to be poured out as a nesekh libation wine offering upon the korban sacrifice of the avodas kodesh kohenʼs service, ministry of your emunah, i have simcha, rejoicing together with you all. and in the same way also you have simcha, rejoicing together with me.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe sèmi ja'a dutu pa'èle aa'i mèu-mèu mamuri ja'a, ho j'aj'i nuka sèmi korban èi anggor, sèna ka miu bisa parcaya asa èra, aa pakako sasab'a lamatua, ja'a sèmi kore mamadhe dènge karej'e. èèna nuka sèmi ama agama tiko èi anggor ètu mei korban, ho pahaha iisi mi lamatua. dènge j'ara ne, èdhi bisa sama-sama karej'e, lula korban ne, iia d'ara boe.

source_text: i have tikvah b'adoneinu yehoshua to send timotiyos to you soon, that i also may be cheered up in the da'as of the things concerning you.
target_text: ja'a sanao, nèbhu heka, lamatua yesus bhoke j'ara, ho ja'a pua timotius dhiu, sèna ka na pa'èra d'ara miu. èle èèna, na lèpa hari mai sa ne'e, ho na lolo dènge ja'a kakako miu, aa pakarej'e d'ara ja'a.

source_text: for i have no one like-minded who will emesdik genuinely care for your spiritual welfare.
target_text: ja'a pua boe dhèu leo, dhoka timotius di, lula nèngu ne d'ara èci dènge ja'a. aa na sue tare'a-re'a miu.

source_text: all of them are seeking their own interest, not those of rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua.
target_text: nèngu ne, sama boe dènge a'ari dhu leo sèra. te rèngu sèra pangee dhoka ngi'u rèngu unu ra, te ngaa uri boe ngaa-ngaa dhu pamèci hia yesus kristus.

source_text: but of the proven mamashus real worth of timotiyos you have da'as, because as a ben with his abba, timotiyos served with me in the besuras hageulah.
target_text: te ngaa miu me'a le, na, timotius sab'a d'ai madhe, pakako sasab'a ama lamatua. na sab'a dènge ja'a nuka sèmi ana dhu sab'a hia ama na. ji'i dua mi la'a peka-padhai lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus ètu mia-mia.

source_text: therefore, i have tikvah to send him, as soon as i see how things will go with me.
target_text: ladhe rèngu pama'ète rare ku lii langu ja'a, ja'a heka pua timotius dhiu asa miu kèna.

source_text: but i have bitachon in hashem that indeed i will come quickly.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, lamatua pa'èra d'ara ja'a, na, nèbhu heka ja'a bisa dhiu paraga dènge miu.

source_text: but i considered it necessary to send to you epaphroditus, the ach b'moshiach and fellow po'el worker and fellow chaiyal soldier of mine, but your shliach and keli kodesh minister of my need.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ja'a ètu d'ara j'aj'èra era, miu pua a'ari èdhi epaproditus mai ladhe-leru ja'a. na pakako sasab'a lamatua sama-sama dènge ja'a, nuka sèmi ca dhèu sordad'u dhu maj'èni madhutu paredha komedhaa na. te ngaa ne'e ne, ja'a neo pua na lèpa hari asa miu.

source_text: i am sending him to you, because he was yearning after you all and was under zeiyar extremely great stress, because you heard that he was ill.
target_text: te d'ara na neo ae le nèdhi miu. aa na ngee miu, lula ne'a, na, miu tadèngi le nèngu dhu pèd'a.

source_text: for indeed he was ill, coming near to death, but hashem had mercy on him not on him only but also on me, lest i should have agmat nefesh upon agmat nefesh.
target_text: mema lèke tare'a. ca hari ni, na pèd'a aae oe madhe. te ngaa ama lamatua sue ne, aa lamatua sue ja'a kahèi, ka na puri-pa'èle epaproditus, sèna ka ja'a baku asa susa.

source_text: therefore, i am all the more eager to dispatch him to you, in order that when you have seen him again, you may have simcha and i may have less agmat nefesh.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo pua hari na lèpa, ho bisa paraga hari dènge miu dènge d'ara karej'e-karae. ladhe sèmi èèna, d'ara ja'a heka mau kèna.

source_text: therefore, receive him in adoneinu with all simcha and hold esteem for such klei kodesh ministers, because he came near to death on account of the avodas kodesh of moshiach, performing an act of messianic mesirat nefesh whole-hearted devotion having risked his life, that he might make up for the ministry to me that you could not give.
target_text: de miu hud'i sèmi mere ne dènge be'a, te nèngu ne dhèu unu lamatua. aa miu hud'i pakab'ua ku dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra dhu ca ropa dènge ne. te nèngu pakako sasab'a kristus, toke oe madhe. aa nèngu hari boe kabodho ciki sa, lula na neo soru-bara ja'a, gati miu. de sèmi mere hari ne dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: as to the rest, achim b'moshiach of mine, have simcha in adoneinu. to keep writing the zelba thing to you is not an irksome bother to me, but for you it is a te'udat bitachon safeguard.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! nanene paie-iie! d'ara miu hud'i karej'e ku, lula miu pa'èki dènge kristus. masi ka ja'a suri pahari-pahari, te ngaa ja'a roca boe pasanèd'e miu sèna ka baku lèke tipu!

source_text: be shomer and on your guard and watch out for those kelevim dogs, watch out for the evil po'alim workers, watch out for the circummutilators.
target_text: baku pamud'e dènge dhèu kapod'e-kabèli, dhu laka-seti dhèu, peka na, miu hud'i suna ku, ho j'aj'i tadha, na, miu se dhèu unu lamatua. madhutu iia-iia na, lamatua paredha boe sèmi èèna! rèngu sala le èèna! te ngaa masi ka sèmi èèna, ra bata-magèla dhèu nuka sèmi busa pakadhi sa.

source_text: for we are the bnei hamilah, the ones whose avodas kodesh is by the ruach hakodesh and whose kavod is in moshiach yehoshua and who take no bitachon in the basar,
target_text: te rèngu peka, na, lamatua sèmi nare dhèu lula rèngu suna. te ngaa èèna sala! èdhi te'a le, na, lamatua sèmi nare dhèu lula ra parcaya yesus. ka dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a unu lamatua, nuka èdhi dhu parcaya yesus! èdhi dhu pahaha iisi mi nèngu, madhutu roh na dhu mola-mèci. èdhi ka dhu ded'e padedha-dedha yesus kristus, lula na bhoke nare le j'ara, ho èdhi bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua. te èdhi bisa boe abhu mamuri, lula madhutu tatao dhèu rai-haha di.

source_text: even though i could be having bitachon also in the basar. if any other person thinks he has grounds to have bitachon in the basar, i have more:
target_text: uru èèna, ja'a pangee dhu èci èèna ka dènge rèngu kahèi, peka na, dhèu bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua, sad'i ra suna. madhutu iia-iia na, sèra sa sasab'a dhèu rai-haha di! ladhe neo padhue sasab'a dhèu rai-haha, na, ja'a bisa padhai lii padedha iisi risi nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i, lula uru èèna sasab'a ja'a lèke mola-mola dènge atora agama dhèu yahudi aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: bris milah on the eighth day; from bnei yisroel by birth; of the tribe of binyamin; a speaker of lashon hakodesh, ivrit of ivrit-speaking horim, a hebrew of hebrews; with regard to the torah, from the kat haperushim; with regard to kin'a zealousness, persecuting the adat hamoshiach; with regard to tzidkat hatorah, i was medakdekim bmitzvot unreproachable.
target_text: madhutu atora agama, ina-ama ja'a suna ja'a, ropa ja'a d'ai aru lod'o. ja'a ne dhèu yahudi tare'a-re'a, lula j'aj'aj'i ja'a nèti suku benyamin, ana-èpu nèti baki isra'el. ja'a maj'èni titu kèna, madhutu mola-mola atora aa'i-aa'i nèti partei agama parisi, toke abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa pasala ja'a. risi-risi hari, ja'a d'èi titu kèna, paj'èra dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu kristus, lula madhutu a'abhu ja'a, na, dhèu se rai eele le atora agama èdhi.

source_text: but what things were revach gain, profit to me, these things i considered loss, on account of rebbe, melech hamoshiach. but even more so, i consider all to be loss on account of the excellency of the da'as of rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua adoneinu, on account of whom i suffered the loss of all things and i consider them as nothing, in comparison, that i may gain moshiach,
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, ka ngangee ja'a kabèli, ropa ja'a madhutu kristus. de limuri ne, ja'a padedha heka iisi dènge j'ara mamuri dhu uru sèra, lula dènge heka sasoa ngaa-ngaa hia mi mamuri ja'a. madhutu a'abhu ja'a, na, dhu dedha risi nuka: ja'a tadhe kristus, kètu ja'a èèna. j'ara leo aa'i-aa'i ra, nuka sèmi mamumu di.

source_text: and be found in him, not having my own tzidkot self-achieved righteousness, by definition a self-righteousness based on chumra stringency from gezetz, but the tzedek through emunah in rebbe, melech hamoshiach, the tzidkat hashem based upon emunah.
target_text: ja'a neo mamuri pa'èki dènge yesus kristus. te masi ka ja'a madhutu aa'i atora agama yahudi, tatu mèka ama lamatua sèmi nare ja'a. aa masi ka ja'a pangee, na, ngi'u ja'a mola, tatu boe lamatua sèmi nare ja'a kahèi. te ngaa ja'a hud'i parcaya ku kristus, heka ama lamatua sèmi nare ja'a kèna, peka na, lula kristus saku eele le sasala èu, nèti èèna ka èu j'aj'i mola-mèci.

source_text: i want to have da'as of rebbe, melech hamoshiach, and of the gevurah power of the techiyas hamoshiach and the deveykus attachment to g-d of moshiachʼs yissurim sufferings, being formed into the mode of being of moshiachʼs death,
target_text: ka dad'èi ja'a sèmi ne'e: ja'a neo tadhe pamèu-mèu kristus. ja'a neo ke'a mèu kahèi koasa ama lamatua dhu na pake ho pamamuri hari yesus kristus nèti mamadhe na. ladhe sèmi abhu dhèu dhu neo paj'èra ja'a, lula ja'a madhutu kristus, na, hud'i nèngu sène. te dhèu paj'èra kristus kahèi. aa ladhe abhu dhèu neo pamadhe ja'a, lula ja'a lalau-lalo'o dhèu leo, na, ja'a sèmi kore kahèi. te kristus madhe hia ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: if somehow i may attain to the techiyas hamesim.
target_text: aa ladhe ja'a madhe, pe nèngu pamamuri hari ja'a kahèi.

source_text: not that already i obtained or already have been made shleimut, but i pursue this tachlis final end, aim that i may lay hold of that for which i was laid hold of by rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua. achim b'moshiach, i do not consider myself to have laid hold; but one zach thing i do, forgetting the things behind, and stretching forward to the things ahead,
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a neo titu kèna madhutu j'ara mamuri kristus dènge dad'èi na aa'i-aa'i. te ngaa ladhe peka dhu mola-mola, ja'a tao lèke mèka sèmi èèna. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pa'èra ngi'u, lula yesus kristus hag'e nare le ja'a ho madhutu ne. ja'a nuka sèmi dhèu dhu rai pa'èra-èra, sèna ka bisa d'ai lane. de ja'a rai mola-mola asa madha, dhu kabib'a boe kabodho, ho ngee j'ara uru sèra. ja'a pabhèlu eele aa'i si.

source_text: according to the tachlis i pursue the prize of the shomayim aliyah ascent of hashem, the upward k'riah call of hashem b'rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a rai pamèdhu-mèdhu toke d'ai lane, sèna ka abhu piala. hadia ja'a èèna nuka: bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua sèmi nare ja'a ètu sorga, lula ja'a parcaya yesus kristus.

source_text: therefore, as many as would be shleimut, let us think like this: and if in anything your machshavot thoughts are different, even this hashem will reveal to you.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi ho miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu mamuri sega dènge amo dhu èra ètu d'ara kristus, bisa d'ara èci dènge j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhu ngee leo, na, hud'i laa ama lamatua paj'uj'u j'ara dhu hua iia hia nèngu.

source_text: fort nevertheless, let us march in line with what we have attained, let us hold to the same.
target_text: te ngaa masi ka sèmi èèna, èdhi hud'i kèpe pa'èra-èra ku, aa tao palèke j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua aj'a le èdhi.

source_text: achim b'moshiach, together be imitators of me. take note of the ones walking as you have a mofet in us.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu hud'i laladhe ku j'ara mamuri ja'a sèna ka tao madhutu. miu cahag'e ètu sèra, j'ara mamuri èci èèna ka dènge ja'a. te ngaa miu dhu leo bisa laladhe nèti rèngu, sèna ka tao madhutu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: for many, of whom i was often telling you, and now also i say with weeping, walk as oyvim enemies of moshiachʼs etz.
target_text: baku pamud'e dènge dhèu ae dhu lab'a kristus aa dhu sèmi boe dènge be'a mamadhe na ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. j'ara mamuri unu ra ka dhu peka na, rèngu lab'a kristus. ja'a peka kèdhi le miu lula-nèti dhèu dhu ca ropa dènge rèngu, te ngaa limuri ne ja'a pasanèd'e hari miu dènge pahaa èi madha.

source_text: their destined end is churban destruction, gehinnom. their g-d is their appetite, and their kavod, what they glory in, is their bushah shame. their machshavot are set on the olam hazeh.
target_text: te bèli-camèd'a lamatua tule eele si, hèia pèci si asa d'ara ai naraka, lula d'ara rèngu dhu pa'èki boe dènge ne. rèngu mamuri dhoka ètu d'ara bhabhelu-katub'a di, aa tenge j'ara sèna ka pakasee d'ara iisi unu ra, toke ra padedha iisi dènge bhabhelu rèngu sèra. dhèu sèra dhu re'a heka makae. ngangee rèngu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu tadhe boe lamatua.

source_text: but the torat haezrakhutcitizenship we conduct exists in shomayim, from where also we eagerly await a moshi'a savior, a go'el, adoneinu rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua,
target_text: miu baku madhutu si, te ngaa madhutu la ji'i. lula èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua, dhu dènge hak j'aj'i ana-ana kabarai sorga. limuri ne èdhi tatae kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. te bèli-camèd'a na lèpa hari mai nèti sorga, ho pakaj'èu èdhi nèti nanasa ama lamatua.

source_text: who will transfigure the basar of our humiliation into the demut of the mode of being of the guf kavod of moshiach, according to the pe'ulahaction, work of his ko'ach power, even to the subjecting of all things to himself.
target_text: èèna na, kristus ub'a ngi'u èdhi dhu roe dhu bisa madhe ne, j'aj'i mi ngi'u hiu dhu madhe boe nuka sèmi ngi'u na dhu èra aae èèna. na ub'a ngi'u aae èdhi ne, pake koasa na dhu kapai seli eele èèna. aa na pake kahèi koasa èèna, sèna ka tao aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu mia-mia, ho madhutu paredha na.

source_text: so then, my achim ahuvim whom i have a tshuka longing for, my simcha and crown, stand firm in rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! nèti se'e se, ka ja'a manèngi ho miu mamuri mola taruu, aa baku koe-kapengo. ja'a neo taruu kèdhi miu. te miu se ka dhu j'aj'i parcaya nèti rui-j'aj'èra ja'a. miu pamaho'o dènge pakarej'e d'ara ja'a. aa ja'a bisa boti kètu, lula miu.

source_text: i appeal to euodias and i appeal to syntyche, think the same thing in adoneinu.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka bhèni dhèu dua sèra, nuka yodia dènge sinteke, ho loe eele ka nèti patao-palaha. rèngu hud'i padame ku, ho pabe'a èci dènge èci. lula lamatua rèngu èci di, nèti èèna ka pa'èki rèngu èci dènge èci.

source_text: yes, i ask also you, true yoke-fellow, assist these women who contended alongside me in the besuras hageulah with both clement and the rest of the fellow po'alim workers of mine, whose names are in the sefer hachayyim.
target_text: angalai, ee! ja'a manèngi ho èu uri ku ana hèni èdhi bhèni dhèu dua sèra, toke ra pabe'a hari. te uru èèna, rèngu sab'a rèdhi le, ho soru-bara ja'a ètu peka-padhue dènge dhèu lii lolo be'a lamatua. rèngu sab'a rèdhi sèmi èèna kahèi sama-sama dènge klemens, dènge angalai dhu leo. ngara rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra suri le ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua dhu suri ngara-ngara dhèu dhu bèli-camèd'a mamuri sama-sama dènge ne ètu sorga.

source_text: have simcha in adoneinu always; again i will say it: rejoice!
target_text: lula miu j'aj'i le dhèu unu lamatua, nèti èèna ka d'ara miu hud'i karej'e ku mèda-mèu. ja'a peka hari catèka: pakarej'e taruu d'ara miu!

source_text: let your chassidus piety and sobriety be known to kol bnei adam; moshiach adoneinu is near.
target_text: d'ara miu hud'i maho'o kahèi dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra. aa baku bhèlu, peka na, lamatua yesus nèbhu heka mai hari.

source_text: be anxious in nothing, but in everything by tefillah and by techinnah supplication with hodayah thanksgiving, let your requests be made known before hashem,
target_text: ladhe miu paraga dènge j'aj'èra, na, baku d'ara miu roe dènge ngaa èci sa. te ngaa sabaj'a ho manèngi ama lamatua soru-bara miu ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. aa aa'i-aa'i dhu miu manèngi se, baku bhèlu manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: and the shalom hashem, surpassing all binah understanding, will guard your levavot and your machshavot thoughts in rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua.
target_text: ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, pe lamatua pamau d'ara miu. mema dhèu rai-haha ne, re'a mèu mèka d'ara dhu mau, dhu èdhi abhu nèti lamatua. te ngaa, lula miu parcaya yesus kristus, lamatua dhu pamau d'ara miu, neo j'aga miu sèna ka d'ara dènge ngangee miu baku kajari.

source_text: as to the rest, achim b'moshiach, whatever things are emes truth, nichbad noble, yashar straight, tahor clean, male no'am full of pleasantness and tiferet beauty, whatever things are commendable, if there is any virtue, if any praise, think about these things.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! j'ara na sèmi ne'e ka: baku ngee dhu rupa-rupa. te ngaa j'aga ngangee miu, sèna ka ngee j'ara-j'ara dhu pamèci dènge d'ara lamatua, aa ngee j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, dhu pakarej'e d'ara dhèu leo. miu hud'i ngee dhu mola dènge dhu mola-mèci. ngee j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke, dènge dhu hua iia. tenge j'ara ho ra pakab'ua dhèu leo kahèi. tenge j'ara ho pad'elo j'ara-j'ara dhu hua iia. aa baku loe pangee nèti j'ara dhu be'a se aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and that which you learned and you received and you heard and you saw in me, practice these and elohei hashalom will be with you.
target_text: ja'a aj'a-nori le miu madhutu j'ara mamuri lamatua. mamuri miu kahèi hud'i madhutu j'ara mamuri ja'a, aa tao madhutu aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a padhue-padhai aa dhu tao kèdhi le. ladhe miu madhutu sèmi èèna, na, ama lamatua pa'èra d'ara miu, sèna ka d'ara miu karej'e-karae, aa bisa mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: i had much simcha in adoneinu that now at last you blossomed anew so as to think of me, for indeed you were thinking of me, but were lacking opportunity.
target_text: ja'a manèngi makasi dènge koa-kio ama lamatua, lula miu bhèlu boe ja'a. ja'a ke'a, na, uru èèna miu dhu sanèd'e taruu ja'a, te ngaa abhu mèka lod'o ho bara ja'a.

source_text: not that i refer to lack, for i have learned, in whatever circumstances i am, to be tzufrieden content.
target_text: ja'a pangee boe manèngi miu ngaa-ngaa. te ja'a kura kèdhi mèka ngaa-ngaa èci sa, lula ja'a dhu tema le mamuri dènge ngaa dhu ja'a unu.

source_text: i have da'as both to be humbled in anavah and i have da'as how to abound in everything. and in all things i have learned what is nistar concealed, hidden, unseen, i have learned the secret of being filled and having hunger, of abounding and having lack.
target_text: ja'a mamuri kèdhi le dènge boe ngaa-ngaa. ja'a mamuri kèdhi le kahèi dènge katei-kabheca. ja'a paraga le dènge kabake manganga, dènge kabake bècu. ètu d'ara ngaa èèna ka, ja'a dhu ke'a kore le rasia na ho bisa taha mamuri.

source_text: i can do all things in the one giving me ko'ach.
target_text: te ja'a bisa tago kore aa'i j'ara sèra, lula kristus ka dhu pa'èra ja'a!

source_text: fort nevertheless, you did well in entering into deveykus communing with hashem through sharing in my messianic yissurim sufferings with me.
target_text: masi ka tasa mera mia èèna, ja'a manèngi makasi, lula miu pad'elo le d'ara be'a miu, aa soru-bara ja'a ètu d'ara j'aj'èra.

source_text: and also you philippians have da'as, that in the beginning of the besuras hageulah, when i went out from macedonia, not one kehillah shared with me in an accounting of expenditures and receipts except you only.
target_text: uru èèna, ropa ja'a kèd'i eele nèti propensi makedonia, ho laku pakako lii lolo be'a lamatua asa era leo, dhodhoka miu di nèti kota pilipi dhu ogo-oru ja'a. juma'at leo sèra, aad'o. te ngaa miu dhu me'a le lii lolo èèna.

source_text: indeed in thessalonika both once and again you sent to my machsor shortage.
target_text: lod'o dhu ja'a ètu kota tesalonika èèna, miu pa'adhu doi catèka-dua hari, ho soru-bara ja'a.

source_text: not that i seek the matanah gift, but i seek the p'ri increasing to your account.
target_text: limuri ne, baku pangee, na, ja'a neo manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti miu. te ja'a neo sèna ka lamatua pala-bagi miu mèngi-nale, lula miu d'ara be'a dènge ja'a.

source_text: but i have all things and i abound; i have been filled, having received from epaphroditus the things from you, a re'ach hannichoach a pleasant aroma, an acceptable, sacrifice well-pleasing to hashem.
target_text: ja'a sèmi kore le nèti epaproditus, aa'i-aa'i dhu miu pa'adhu mai bara ja'a. se'e se j'aj'i mi berkat hia ja'a, toke d'ai sange ne'e, ja'a kura boe ngaa-ngaa. se'e se j'aj'i nuka sèmi korban tunu dhu hèu mèngi, ho pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua. aa lamatua sèmi nare korban èèna, lula pakarej'e d'ara nèngu.

source_text: and my g-d will fill every machsor shortage, want of yours according to his osher riches in kavod in moshiach yehoshua.
target_text: ama lamatua dhu ja'a pahaha iisi èèna, kaja seli eele. aa ne'a mèu ngaa dhu miu parluu. de na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, aa pala hia miu mèngi-nale dhu risi eele, lula miu dhu pa'èki tèke le dènge yesus kristus.

source_text: l'elohim avinu hakavod l'olemei olamim. omein. to g-d and our father be glory forever and ever. amen.
target_text: de hud'i laa èdhi ded'e padedha-dedha taruu kolongara ama lamatua toke d'ai mia-mia la'e. ne'e ne ka dhu lèke mola-mola!

source_text: drishat shalom kind regards to every kadosh in moshiach yehoshua; the achim b'moshiach here with me send drishat shalom.
target_text: ja'a pa'adhu lii maho'o ja'a hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu yesus kristus ètu kota pilipi. angalai ja'a ètu se'e se, hia miu lii maho'o kahèi.

source_text: all the kedoshim send shalom greetings, especially the kedoshim in caesarʼs household.
target_text: dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i ètu kota roma ne, hia lii maho'o kahèi. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge a'ari sèra dhu sab'a ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae kapai ne. ra pa'adhu lii maho'o hia miu kahèi.

source_text: the chen v'chesed of adoneinu rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua be with your neshamah.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu aa'i-aa'i mi. sasuri ja'a tèja mi ne'e ka, paulus

source_text: sha'ul a shliach of rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua through the ratzon hashem and timotiyos the ach b'moshiach;
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a, paulus. ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu hag'e nare ja'a, ho j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. ètu ne'e, abhu kahèi a'ari èdhi timotius dhu pa'adhu lii maho'o hia miu.

source_text: to the kedoshim in colossae, the achim b'moshiach, the achim hane'emanim. chen v'chesed hashem to you and shalom from elohim avinu.
target_text: ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu, dhèu unu ama lamatua ètu kota kolose, dhu tao madhutu taruu j'ara mamuri yesus kristus. ji'i manèngi sèna ka ama èdhi, ama lamatua, pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu aa'i-aa'i mi, ho miu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: hodinu l'hashemwe give thanks to hashem elohim haav of adoneinu rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua, davening always concerning you,
target_text: lod'o-lod'o dhu ji'i sabaj'a hia miu, ji'i manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua dhu j'aj'i ama nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: having heard of your emunah in rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua and the ahavah which you have for all the kedoshim,
target_text: te ji'i tadèngi ae le, nèti parcaya miu mi yesus kristus, aa nèti sasue dènge d'ara hua iia miu mi dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: on account of the tikvah hope being laid up for you in shomayim, the tikvah which you heard of before in the dvar haemes, the besuras hageulah
target_text: miu tao sèmi èèna, lula miu me'a mèu madha j'ara dhu be'a dhu tao tèke le hia miu ètu sorga. j'ara-j'ara sèra, miu tadèngi mèdhi le nèti lii holo-nori dhu lèke, nuka lii lolo be'a lamatua,

source_text: that has come to you, as also in all the olam hazeh it is bearing p'ri and growing, so also in you, from the day you heard it and began to have saving da'as of the chen v'chesed hashem in actuality.
target_text: dhu dhèu peka le dènge miu karèi nèti uru ka. lii lolo be'a ne, pale-lème le buli mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne, aa abhu hua-hela dhu be'a, lula lii ne ub'a mamuri dhèu j'aj'i be'a. mamuri miu j'aj'i be'a sèmi èèna kahèi, karèi nèti hiu-hiu èèna miu tadèngi lii lolo be'a, dènge me'a mèu d'ara hua iia ama lamatua.

source_text: this you learned from epaphras, our chaver and fellow eved, who is ne'eman faithful, who is a trusted keli kodesh minister of rebbe, melech hamoshiach for you.
target_text: miu se abhu le a'aj'a ne'e nèti epapras, angalai d'ara sasab'a ji'i dhu ji'i sue. te nèngu maj'èni pakako taruu sasab'a yesus ètu talora aae miu.

source_text: epaphras also revealed to us your ahavah in the ruach hakodesh.
target_text: na lolo hia ji'i ètu ne'e lula-nèti sasue miu dhu roh lamatua pala-bagi hia miu.

source_text: therefore, we also, from the day that we heard, do not cease davening for you and offering tefillos that you be filled with da'as of the ratzon hashem in all chochmah and binah in the ruach hakodesh.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, karèi nèti lod'o hiu-hiu ji'i tadèngi j'ara mamuri miu, ji'i loe boe sabaj'a hia miu. ji'i manèngi ama lamatua, ho miu bisa me'a mèu dad'èi na, aa bisa me'a madha j'ara ae-ae, madhutu ngaa dhu roh na aj'a miu.

source_text: and this is the purpose: that you walk in hitnahagut conduct worthy of adoneinu in every way pleasing to him in every mitzvoh bearing p'ri in the da'as of hashem,
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, miu bisa mamuri dhu lèke, dènge mèti kolongara hua iia ama lamatua. aa miu bisa pakarej'e d'ara lamatua ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra kahèi. ladhe miu pad'elo d'ara be'a mi dhèu, pe lamatua hia miu hua-hela dhu be'a. dènge sèmi èèna, miu asa tadhe mèu lamatua.

source_text: with all ko'ach being empowered according to the gevurah power of his kavod for all savlanut patience and orech ruach longsuffering with lev same'ach glad heart, giving todot to elohim haav. elohim haav is the one who has qualified you for the share of the allotted nachalahinheritance of the kedoshim in ohr light; elohim haav is the one who rescued nafsheinu our souls from the memshalet dominion of choshech and transferred us into the malchut of the zun fun der oybershter of his ahavah,
target_text: ji'i manèngi-mangaj'i kahèi mi ama lamatua, sèna ka nèngu hia miu koasa na dhu dedha risi èèna, ho miu bisa tago j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra dènge taha d'ara. ji'i manèngi ho d'ara miu dènge karej'e-karae, sèna ka miu manèngi makasi taruu mi ama lamatua. te na bhoke le j'ara, sèna ka miu sèmi mere pusaka pala miu ètu sorga. pusaka èèna ka dhu na pala-bagi mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra dhu parcaya yesus kristus. te na patabuli eele le èdhi nèti koasa maroga, hèia na pamaso èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu yesus kristus sèna ka pea ètu d'ara saraa. ama lamatua ka dhu ded'e yesus kristus j'aj'i dhèu aae èdhi. yesus ne, ana pasue ama lamatua.

source_text: in whom we have the pedut redemption, geulah release on payment of ransom through the kapporah dahm of moshiach the selicha forgiveness of chatoteinu our sins.
target_text: te ama lamatua hia ana na, sèna ka sui nare èdhi, dènge saku eele sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: rebbe, melech hamoshiach is the demut of the invisible g-d, the bechor, the yoresh heir of kol hanivrah all creation,
target_text: kristus ne, ca ropa dènge ama lamatua, dhu dhèu rai-haha bisa boe ladhe rèdhi. nèngu dhu mema le, uru nèti aa'i-aa'i, aa nèngu j'aj'i kètu nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua paj'aj'i.

source_text: because in him were created all things in shomayim and on ha'aretz, the visible and the nistar hidden, whether thrones or dominions, whether rulers or authorities, all things through him and for him have been created.
target_text: te ama lamatua pake ne, ho paj'aj'i aa'i isi nèti dedha-liru dènge rai-haha. na paj'aj'i j'ara-j'ara dhu dhèu rai-haha bisa ladhe rèdhi, dènge dhu bisa boe ladhe rèdhi. nuka, rèngu dhu rèd'u paredha, rèngu dhu rèd'u koasa, dhèu aae-dhèu aae, dènge dhèu kapai-dhèu kapai sèra. aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua neo tao sèra, na tao hia mi yesus kristus, aa yesus dhu sab'a sèra aa'i-aa'i kahèi.

source_text: and moshiach is before all things, and all things in moshiach have been held together;
target_text: lod'o aa'i-aa'i se dhae j'aj'i mèka, te nèngu ka dhu mema-mema le. aa'i-aa'i se pa'èki dènge ne. aa nèngu ka dhu uri si.

source_text: and moshiach is the rosh of the geviyah body, and the geviyahnevilah is moshiachʼs brit chadasha kehillah; moshiach is its reshit, the bechor from the mesim, that moshiach might be in everything pre-eminent,
target_text: nèngu ka dhu j'aj'i kètu mi dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i. aa dhèu parcaya sèra, nuka sèmi ngi'u na. te nèngu ka dhu pakako aa'i-aa'i si. nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu madhe, hèia mamuri hari, nèngu ka dhu kapai risi, ho sèna ka nèngu ka dhu dedha risi aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: because hashem was pleased that all his fullness have its mishkan tabernacle in moshiach,
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu d'ara ama lamatua, abhu kahèi ètu d'ara kristus, aa èèna ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua.

source_text: and through moshiach to bring ritztzuy reconciliation, cessation of enmity, hostility between a wrathful holy g-d and sinful bnei adam between all things and himself, having made shalom through the dahm of the kapporah of haetz hamoshiach, whether the things on haaretz or the things in hashomayim.
target_text: ama lamatua pake yesus kristus, ho padame dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu na paj'aj'i le. na hia ana na, ho j'aj'i korban dhu pasuti raa na, aa madhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, sèna ka aa'i-aa'i ètu dedha-liru, aa aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, bisa padame hari dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: and you, once having been alienated and oyvim enemies in the mind by ma'asim hara'im evil deeds,
target_text: uru èèna, miu mamuri ètu li'u, pakaj'èu nèti ama lamatua. miu pamusu dènge ne, ka mamuri pacèri nèti nèngu, lula d'ara miu karehe dènge tatao dhu bhelu èèna ka, miu lab'a taruu ne.

source_text: yet now moshiach reconciled in the guf body of his basar through moshiachʼs histalkus to present you, kedoshim holy and without mumdefect and without reproach before him,
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa limuri ne nèngu ka dhu bhoke le j'ara, ho èdhi bisa padame hari dènge ne. te nèngu ka dhu pua ana na, ho j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha. aa nèngu ka dhu hia ana na èèna j'aj'i mi korban, aa madhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, sèna ka èdhi bisa padame hari dènge ne. yesus kristus tao j'ara ne'e, ho bisa lere nèti èdhi lati titu ètu katanga madha ama lamatua, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu mola-mèci dènge d'ara mola, dhu dènge heka sasala ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: provided you remain in the emunah, having been founded in it and securely established and not moving away from the tikvah hope of the besuras hageulah which you heard, the besuras hageulah which has been proclaimed in kol hanivrah all creation under shomayim, the besuras hageulah of which i, rav sha'ul, became a keli kodesh minister.
target_text: sad'i miu taha taruu dènge lalèka miu. kèpe pa'èra-èra, sèna ka baku kalau! baku pakaj'èu nèti lii lolo be'a èèna, dhu miu sèmi mere ropa miu nanene hiu-hiu lii èèna. te lii lolo be'a èèna j'aj'i mi era sarai miu. dhèu lasi palolo lème le lii lolo be'a èèna ètu mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne. aa lamatua ka pua ja'a, paulus, sèna ka laku lole lii lolo be'a ne kahèi.

source_text: now with lev same'ach glad heart and chedvah rejoicing i rejoice in my suffering tzoros on behalf of you. and i am mashlim supply what is deficient the things lacking of the chevlei moshiach in my basar on behalf of the basar of moshiach which is the brit chadasha kehillah,
target_text: lod'o kristus mamuri ètu rai-haha ne, na dui j'aj'èra ae d'ai seli. aa limuri ne, ja'a pasae rupa-rupa j'aj'èra kahèi. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa d'ara ja'a karej'e taruu. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu hud'i abhu ku j'aj'èra, na, hud'i laa ja'a dui j'aj'èra èèna sama-sama dènge ra, nuka sèmi kristus pasae nare j'aj'èra nèti dhèu-dhèu unu na. te dhèu unu na, j'aj'i sama sèmi ngi'u nèngu.

source_text: of which i became a keli kodesh according to the pekudat hashemstewardship of g-d, his shlichus commission which was given to me for you, to carry to shleimut wholeness, completion the dvar hashem,
target_text: ama lamatua hia ja'a sasab'a na kahèi, ho ladhe-leru dhèu-dhèu unu na. nèti èèna ka, ja'a aj'a lii holo-nori na, toke lutu-sela hia miu.

source_text: the raz mystery having been hidden from olamim and from dor v'dor, but now made manifest to the kedoshim of moshiach, to whom hashem wanted to make hisgalus of what is the spiritual osher of the kavod of this raz among the non-jews: moshiach in you, the tikvah of kavod.
target_text: dhèu tadèngi lii holo-nori lamatua karèi nèti uru ka. te ngaa dhae re'a mèu mèka naneo nèti lii holo-nori se'e dènge be'a, te naneo na dhu pahuni era. te ngaa limuri ne, lamatua bhoke le naneo ne hia dhèu unu na. aa naneo na èèna, lii dhu kapai titu kèna pala mi suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. lii babe'a dhu kapai risi èèna, nuka: kristus mamuri ètu d'ara miu! èèna na ka dhu tao miu parcaya taruu, peka na, bèli-camèd'a nèngu tao j'ara dhu hua iia risi hia miu ètu sorga. ne'e ne ka dhu èdhi dhèu rai-haha ne mate tae-tae karèi nèti uru-uru j'ara ka.

source_text: it is moshiach who is the subject of our hattafah preaching, warning every man and teaching every man in all chochmah, that we may present every man bnei chayil mature in moshiach.
target_text: de ji'i peka dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti kristus. ji'i aj'a-nori dènge pasanèd'e dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, pake ngangee lii padhai dhu ama lamatua hia mi ji'i. ji'i tao j'ara se'e, ho pa'èra dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu kristus, sèna ka bèli-camèd'a rèngu bisa titu ètu madha na, dhu dènge boe makae, lula ra mamuri mola taruu.

source_text: for this also i toil, striving according to the hitlahavut inspiration, enthusiasm of him working in me with gevurah.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a titu pa'èra, aa sab'a j'èra titu kèna hia miu. ja'a bisa taha sab'a bia sèmi èèna, lula koasa kristus ka pa'èra ja'a. aa koasa na èèna, kapai titu kèna!

source_text: for i want you to have da'as of how great a ma'avak struggle i have for you and the ones in laodicea, and as many as have not seen me panim el panim directly, in person,
target_text: miu dhu pea ètu kota kolose, aa miu ètu kota laodikia, dènge rèngu dhu paraga rèdhi mèka dènge ja'a. nanene paie-iie! ja'a d'èi sèna ka miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a mèu sasab'a ja'a dhu bia ne hia miu, aa hia mi rèngu kahèi.

source_text: that their levavot may be given chozek strength, having been made an aguda of ahavah and all osher wealth of the full assurance of binah, resulting in the da'as of the raz of hashem, namely moshiach,
target_text: dad'èi ja'a ka, neo pa'èra d'ara rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka rèngu bisa pa'èki j'aj'i mi èci, lula ra mamuri pasue. hèia ra j'aj'i re'a mèu, lula rèngu re'a tare'a, na, uru èèna naneo lamatua pahuni era. dhu pahuni èèna, nuka kristus!

source_text: in whom is nistar hidden all the otzarot treasures of chochmah and da'as.
target_text: ladhe miu pa'èki j'aj'i d'ara èci dènge kristus, heka na hia miu d'èlu-mèu dhu miu parluu, aa aj'a miu pake mamèu se, sèna ka tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. mamèu se'e se, nuka sèmi mèdha-panyau dhu kab'ua.

source_text: this i say so that no one may delude you with the sleight of hand of the ba'al melitzot rhetorician.
target_text: ja'a peka dènge miu j'ara se aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka mage dhoka dhèu mai kapod'e-kabèli miu dènge hèb'a mènyi.

source_text: for, though absent in basar, but present with you in the ruach hakodesh, with lev same'ach glad heart i am seeing your order and the firmness of your emunah in moshiach.
target_text: ja'a mema kaj'èu nèti miu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ja'a bhèlu boe miu, lula d'ara ja'a dhu pa'èki le dènge miu. aa ja'a karej'e, lula ke'a, na, miu mamuri dhu lèke, aa miu dhu kèpe pa'èra parcaya miu mi kristus era.

source_text: therefore, as you became mekabel moshiach and received moshiach adoneinu yehoshua, so let your halichah be in him,
target_text: lula uru èèna miu sèmi mere le yesus kristus j'aj'i kètu miu, nèti èèna ka limuri ne, miu hud'i nanene ne taruu. aa nèngu èèna j'aj'i kètu miu era.

source_text: having been rooted and built up in moshiach and being firmly founded in the emunah as you were given messianic lernen study, abounding in hodayah.
target_text: ladhe miu pa'èki taruu dènge ne sèmi èèna, miu nuka sèmi ana aaj'u dhu asa tabha èra, lula amo la'e asa marèma aae. aa miu nuka sèmi èmu dhu èra, lula dhu patitu ètu fanderen dhu èra. miu pa'èra taruu ètu d'ara lalèka miu, sama sèmi a'aj'a dhu miu abhu mèdhi le. hud'i laa, sèna ka d'ara miu pasoa-pasoka ètu d'ara manèngi makasi, lula j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra dhu ama lamatua tao tèke le hia miu.

source_text: beware lest there be anyone of you taken captive through philosophical tevunah wisdom and empty deceit according to the kabbalah oral tradition of mere bnei adam, according to the ikkarim basic principles of the olam hazeh and not according to moshiach;
target_text: j'aga paie-iie, sèna ka baku madhutu dhèu leo dhu pake d'èlu-mèu dhèu rai-haha, ho ère rèti miu nèti j'ara mola. aa mage madhutu a'aj'a dhèu rai-haha dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. te a'aj'a rèngu sèra dhoka mai nèti d'èlu-mèu dhèu rai-haha di, aa nèti atora-atora rai-haha ne. te ngaa a'aj'a sèra mai boe nèti kristus.

source_text: because in moshiach kol melo elohim all the plentitude of g-d finds its bodily maon lashechinah dwelling place for the shekhinah glory, in the hitgashmut.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu d'ara ama lamatua, abhu kahèi ètu d'ara kristus. aa kristus kahèi j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha, èci èèna ka dènge èdhi.

source_text: and you have been granted melo plentitude in moshiach, who is the rosh of all rule and authority.
target_text: lula miu pa'èki le dènge kristus, aa j'aj'i dhèu unu na, nèti èèna ka, na tao pamèci miu. te nèngu dedha risi eele nèti koasa aa'i-aa'i dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu rèd'u paredha, masi ka dhu be'a do dhu bhelu.

source_text: in moshiach also you were circumcised with a bris milah not made with human hands, a bris milah of the surgically removing of the body of the basar old fallen and unregenerate nature in the bris milah of moshiach,
target_text: lod'o suna dhèu yahudi, ra j'ue eele ka'uri dhu karisi nèti era makae ra, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha, na, rèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. lod'o miu maso j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus, miu suna kahèi. sasoa na sèmi ne'e ka: suna ne, lula boe nèti dhèu j'ue eele ka'uri nèti ngi'u aae ne, te ngaa kristus j'ue eele j'ara-j'ara bhabhelu-katub'a nèti d'ara èdhi. nuka j'ara-j'ara bhabhelu dhu èdhi d'èi ad'u-ue, lula èdhi dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: having been buried in the ohel of rebbe, melech hamoshiachʼs tevilah with him, with whom also you were made to stand up spiritually in the techiyah together through your emunah and bitachon in the ma'aseh of hashem who made moshiach stand up from the mesim.
target_text: lod'o ra sarani miu pake èi, èèna nuka sèmi padhane miu, sama-sama dènge kristus. hèia miu abhu mamuri dhu hiu, sèmi nèngu unu mamuri hiu kahèi. miu abhu sèmi èèna, lula miu parcaya, peka na, ama lamatua pake koasa na dhu kapai aae èèna, ho pamamuri hari yesus kristus nèti mamadhe na. lamatua pake kahèi koasa ne'e ho sab'a ètu d'ara miu.

source_text: and you being dead in your peysha'im and your orlat basar uncircumcision of flesh he made alive together, you together with moshiach, having granted you selicha for all your peysha'im;
target_text: uru èèna, miu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu madhe le, lula miu dhu tao sasala rupa-rupa, aa miu dhae j'aj'i mèka dhèu unu ama lamatua. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa na saku eele aa'i-aa'i sasala-sasigo miu, aa bagi hia miu mamuri hiu, sama sèmi na pamamuri hari yesus kristus.

source_text: having erased the hand-signed sefer of guilt choiv debt, the heavenly indictment against us in the maleh chukat hatorah full statute requirement of the torah, which was against us. moshiach has done away with this opposing record, having nailed it to moshiachʼs etz.
target_text: dhu mola-mola ka, èdhi hud'i abhu ku huku, lula èdhi sisu le atora-atora ama lamatua. te ngaa na saku eele le hahuku se'e ropa ra paku yesus kristus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: having disarmed the rulers and the authorities, he made a public spectacle of them, having triumphed over them by moshiachʼs etz.
target_text: ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha ne, na segi aa'i le koasa maroga, aa aa'i-aa'i dhu paredha dènge bhabhelu. ka na pamakae si ètu madha dhèu ae-ae. aa'i-aa'i se, nuka sèmi sordad'u dhu segi musu, dhu lèpa kako palème rae dènge lii sod'a, sèna ka pad'elo sasegi ra aa pamakae musu ra.

source_text: therefore, let no one judge you goyim in eating and in drinking or in respect to a yom tov yontev or a rosh chodesh or shabbos;
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu neo pamanahu miu, nèti j'ara-j'ara ta'a-tinu, mage mi pusi-pahae si. aa ladhe dhèu neo tao lii dènge miu, nèti j'ara-j'ara lod'o be'a, do tao pesta hèru hiu, do atora lod'o ae sasab'a, na, baku pusi-pahae si.

source_text: which are a shadow of the things to come in the olam habah; but the reality, the substance, is moshiach.
target_text: j'ara sèmi sèra sa, guna boe! te sèra sa nuka sèmi mamaho di, dhu èèna na ele. te ngaa kristus ne ka dhu asli. nèngu ne ele boe aa taa-taa.

source_text: let no one deprive you of the prize by delighting in his mystical asceticism and his veneration of malachim and delving into his chazonot visions and being vainly puffed up by the machshavot thoughts of his basar old nature unrenewed and unregenerated by the ruach hakodesh,
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo pamanahu miu, lula miu mo'o boe madhutu atora dhu rèngu tao unu ra, baku nanene si. te ladhe miu nanene si, miu bisa heka abhu j'ara-j'ara hua iia dhu ama lamatua neo hia miu. de mage-mage! te mema abhu dhèu dhu d'èi tenge j'ara ho pamanahu miu. dad'èi ra, ladhe miu pahaha iisi miu, aa sogo-tagu ana pajuu lamatua ètu sorga, lula ra pangee, na, abhu tanila dhu peka sèmi èèna. rèngu tao iisi ra be'a risi nèti dhèu leo aa'i-aa'i ra. madhutu iia-iia na, sèmi boe èèna. te ngangee ra sama sèmi dhèu rai-haha biasa di.

source_text: and not holding on to the rosh, out of whom all the moshiachʼs guf, being fully supplied and being be'ichud united together through the joints and ligaments, grows with the growth of hashem.
target_text: kristus èèna kètu, te ngaa rèngu ro'o boe pa'èki dènge ne. aa dhèu unu kristus, nuka sèmi ngi'u na dhu na ator si. na tao dhèu unu na asa tabha èra, pake koasa ama lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu j'aj'i nuka sèmi kalua dènge rui dhu pa'èki pa'èra-èra, sèna ka èci bara èci, toke ngi'u dhu kateme bisa sab'a dènge be'a.

source_text: als since you died with rebbe, melech hamoshiach to the ikkarim basic principles of the olam hazeh, why, as though you still belonged to the keyam existence of the olam hazeh, do you goyim chain yourself to chumra legalisms?
target_text: miu madhe le sama-sama dènge kristus. hèia miu pa'èki heka dènge koasa-koasa maroga ètu rai-haha ne. de nga tao ka miu loe boe madhutu rupa-rupa atora rai-haha? rèngu peka sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: do not touch; do not taste; do not handle.
target_text: mage kèpe ne'e; baku mi'e èèna, mage goi ne'e.

source_text: the things referred to are all destined to deterioration with use, according to the humanly contrived mitzvot and the humanly contrived chukim laws of mere bnei adam,
target_text: te ngaa atora sèra, dhoka pa'ue-ai nèti dhèu rai-haha, ho ra aj'a mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. madhutu iia-iia na, atora sèra dhodhoka uri j'ara-j'ara dhu èèna na ele iia d'ara di!

source_text: which things have a superficial appearance of chochmah in self-imposed religion and mystical asceticism and severe physical mortification, but are of no value against the indulgence of the yetzer the so-called basar unrenewed and unregenerated by the ruach hakodesh.
target_text: ladhe sèmi dhèu bisa tao madhutu atora sèra, ra pangee, na, bèli-camèd'a dhèu pakab'ua si, aa peka na, rèngu se d'èlu-mèu titu kèna; dhèu dhu tao iisi ra sèmi dhèu kèpe pa'èra atora agama; dhèu dhu d'ara mako; dhèu dhu paj'èra ngi'u unu ra, dènge dhèu dhu maj'èni sogo-tagu. madhutu iia-iia na, aad'o! atora sèra bisa boe pamèu ngangee dhèu rai-haha, dènge d'ara dhu d'èi ad'u-ue bhabhelu!

source_text: if therefore you were made to stand up alive in hitkhadshut with rebbe, melech hamoshiach, seek the things above, where moshiach is, li'min elohim, sitting at the right hand of hashem.
target_text: ama lamatua hia le miu mamuri hiu, nuka sèmi nèngu pamamuri hari miu sama-sama dènge kristus. limuri ne, kristus madhèdi le ètu era dhu kab'ua risi ètu baboa g'ana ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pangee dhoka j'ara-j'ara dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua.

source_text: place your machshavot thoughts above in shomayim, not on the things of the olam hazeh.
target_text: pangee dhoka j'ara-j'ara dhu lamatua d'èi. baku pusi-pahae dènge j'ara dhu dhodhoka pakarej'e d'ara dhèu rai-haha di.

source_text: for you died and the chayyim of you has become nistarhidden with moshiach in hashem.
target_text: te miu madhe kahèi, ropa kristus madhe. hèia mamuri hiu miu èèna kalau boe, lula miu pa'èki le dènge kristus, dhu bera-bera dènge ama lamatua ètu sorga.

source_text: when rebbe, melech hamoshiach who is chayyeinu our life is made manifest in hisgalus revelation, then also you with him will be made manifest in hisgalus in kavod.
target_text: kristus mamuri ètu d'ara miu, aa na pabe'a mamuri miu. bèli-camèd'a, ropa na lèpa hari mai, miu cèu palere-lere dènge ne kahèi ètu d'ara dadedha dènge kapai na!

source_text: therefore, put to death your evarim members in the olam hazeh: zenut fornication, debauchery, sensuality, zimmah licentiousness, and chamdanut covetousness, which is avodah zarah idolatry.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pèci eele ku dad'èi d'ara dhu neo tao bhabhelu-katub'a. nuka sèmi: d'ara d'èi tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali èu; d'ara d'èi tao j'ara-j'ara kaj'alu; d'ara d'èi dhu neo tao madhutu dad'èi d'ara di; d'ara d'èi tao bhabhelu rupa-rupa, aa manga'a dhu d'èi dhoka aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i unu èu di madhutu iia-iia na, sèra sa nuka sèmi èu sogo-tagu, lula èu ded'e padedha-dedha j'ara leo dhu seti eele lamatua.

source_text: because of such things as these the charon af hashem habah the coming burning wrath of hashem is on the way.
target_text: j'ara se'e se ka dhu tao ama lamatua nasa titu kèna, toke na neo huku dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ro'o boe nanene ne.

source_text: such was your derech to fier zich comport oneself, the derech resha'im formerly, when you were living in these things.
target_text: uru èèna, miu mamuri sèmi èèna ka, lula d'ara miu pa'èki dènge j'ara bhelu sèra.

source_text: but now you also put away all these things: ka'as anger, rage, kavvanah ra'ah malice, and chillul hashem. put away loshon hora from your mouth.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, miu hud'i pèci eele ku dad'èi d'ara dhu neo ad'u-ue bhabhelu aa'i-aa'i. nuka sèmi: d'èi nasa; d'ara pana-mag'oro; tèka d'ara dènge dhèu; padhai lii pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu; dènge padhai lii kaj'alu.

source_text: do not speak sheker to one another, having disrobed from the adam hakadmoni old humanity with his ma'asim works, and instead enrobe with the adam hachadash, the one being renewed in da'as in accordance with the demut of the one having created him.
target_text: aa miu èci dènge èci baku kapod'e-kabèli. lula miu core eele le dad'èi d'ara dhu neo tao bhelu, aa tèke eele j'ara mamuri dhui sèra. aa limuri ne, miu gati dènge d'ara dhu hiu. èèna nuka sèmi dhèu core eele le mèdha-papake dhui dhu kaj'alu, sèna ka silu mèdha hiu dhu mèu. ama lamatua ka dhu paj'aj'i miu. aa limuri ne, na tao miu asa tadhe pabe'a-be'a nèngu, aa tao miu j'aj'i ca ropa dènge ne.

source_text: here there is neither yevani nor yehudi, there is neither those who are or are not of the bris milah, there is no uncultured non-greek speaker, there is no scythian, eved, or ben chorin, but rather moshiach is all in all.
target_text: ètu d'ara mamuri hiu ne, èdhi hag'e boe, na, rèngu sèra dhèu yahudi, do dhèu yahudi boe; dhèu dhu madhutu suna, do dhèu dhu suna boe; dhèu leo rai kara, do dhèu dhu ad'a aad'o; dhèu ènu, do ènu boe. se'e se kolo-karisi na, aad'o! te ngaa dhu lèke ka, ladhe rèngu pa'èki dènge kristus, aa nèngu mamuri ètu d'ara ra.

source_text: therefore, as bechirim chosen ones of hashem, kedoshim and ahuvim, enrobe yourselves in tender feelings of rachmei shomayim heavenly compassion, mercy, chesed lovingkindness, anavah humility, shiflut lowliness, and savlanut longsuffering,
target_text: ama lamatua hag'e nare le miu, lula na sue miu. dad'èi na sèna ka miu j'aj'i dhèu mola-mèci na dhu leko-leo nèti dhèu rai-haha leo sèra. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i j'aj'i ku dhèu d'ara hua iia, d'ara be'a, pahaha iisi, lii mako, dènge taha mere d'ara.

source_text: being soivel bearing with one another and extending selicha forgiveness to each other, if it should be that one is murmuring his complaint against another; just as adoneinu extended selicha to you, so also you should extend selicha.
target_text: miu hud'i taha mere d'ara, aa èci tadhe mèu èci. ladhe nèti miu, abhu dhu tenge lii langu dènge angalai na, na, baku tèka d'ara dènge ne. te ngaa miu hud'i pabhèlu eele sasala na, aa abho ne, nuka sèmi lamatua dhu pabhèlu eele le sasala miu.

source_text: and to all these things add ahavah, which is the agudah of tamimim.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee. te sasue èèna risi aa'i nèti ngaa-ngaa. de miu hud'i pake sasue ne ètu d'ara miu, nuka sèmi mèdha-papake ètu ua. te sasue èèna, nuka sèmi loa hèngu dhu èdhi manènu, sèna ka j'aj'i sig'i dhu saraga titu kèna. ne'e ne ka dhu pa'èki èdhi j'aj'i mi èci.

source_text: and let the shalom of moshiach arbitrate in your levavot. you were called to this shalom in one guf. let there be todah in your levavot.
target_text: èdhi bisa padame dènge ama lamatua, lula kristus. de miu hud'i soro tèke kahèi dadame kristus ne, uri d'ara miu. te lamatua d'èi ka, miu aa'i-aa'i mi mamuri mera-milu èci dènge èci, lula miu pa'èki j'aj'i ngi'u èci. aa d'ara miu hud'i me'a manèngi makasi, lula lamatua unu na ka hag'e nare miu.

source_text: let the dvar of rebbe, melech hamoshiach make its mishkan in you richly, in all chochmah and in all moshiachʼs pnimiyus hatorah innermost torah teaching and words of chizzuk, ministering to one another with tehillim, shirim, and neshamah niggunim miruach hakodesh soul melodies from the ruach hakodesh with gratitude, singing in your levavot to hashem.
target_text: hud'i laa lii holo-nori kristus uri d'ara miu dènge mamuri miu kahèi. lii holo-nori se'e, nuka sèmi mèdha-panyau dhu kab'ua, dhu na pangèd'u mi miu. lii se'e pad'elo j'ara ho miu bisa me'a madha j'ara ae-ae, madhutu ngangee lamatua. ka miu bisa pake lii se'e, sèna ka aj'a-nori, aa pasanèd'e miu èci dènge èci. ladhe nori dhèu-dhèu miu, mage dènge sakaa, te ngaa pake lii dènge d'ara dhu taleo moro-moro dhu pènu dènge rasa makasi. pake lii sod'a koa-kio, lii sod'a dhu miu abhu nèti roh mola-mèci lamatua, aa lii sod'a dhu miu mesa mi suri ho koa-kio ama lamatua.

source_text: and whatever thing you do, whether in dvar or in ma'aseh, do all things b'shem adoneinu yehoshua, giving todot to elohim haav through him.
target_text: miu j'aj'i le ai g'ana nèti yesus kristus. de sanèd'e, te aa'i-aa'i dhu miu padhue-padhai sèra, mèti kolongara lamatua. aa aa'i-aa'i dhu miu tao sèra mèti kolongara lamatua kahèi. de baku bhèlu tao aa'i-aa'i dènge kolongara kètu miu, yesus kristus. aa manèngi makasi taruu mi ama na, ama lamatua.

source_text: nashim wives, make yourselves accountable to your ba'alim husbands, as is proper in adoneinu.
target_text: bhèni dhu dènge dhèu èmu! miu hud'i mamuri nanene ku dhèu èmu miu, lula èèna ka dhu lèke mi dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu yesus kristus.

source_text: ba'alim, have ahavah for your nashim and do not be bitter against them.
target_text: mone dhu dènge dhèu èmu! miu hud'i sue ku dhèu èmu miu, aa baku sakaa dènge ne, ka papèd'a d'ara na.

source_text: yeladim, obey your horim parents in all things, for this is well pleasing in adoneinu.
target_text: ana-ana aa'i-aa'i! miu hud'i nanene ina-ama miu, ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra, te èèna ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua.

source_text: avot, do not provoke your yeladim, lest they be disheartened.
target_text: ina-ama aa'i-aa'i! miu baku ènyi aa lii taka leli mi ana-ana miu, te aad'o na, ra nasa ka ra parui. mage-mage d'ara ra ta'u'a dènge miu.

source_text: avadim servants, each of you obey in all things your adon according to the basar, not with eye service as pleasers of bnei adam, but with tom lev, with yirat shomayim.
target_text: dhèu sab'a sèra! ètu rai-haha ne miu hud'i tao ku madhutu dad'èi lamatua miu ètu d'ara sasab'a aa'i-aa'i ra. mage dhoka mere d'ara di, lod'o dhu lamatua miu ètu madha miu. te ngaa tenge la j'ara, ho pakarej'e taruu d'ara ra. sab'a dènge be'a, lula miu dhu me'a, na, ama lamatua dhu ladhe patae miu.

source_text: whatever you do, be po'alim workers who with their neshamah work facing adoneinu and not bnei adam, having da'as that from adoneinu you will receive the sachar of the nachalahalloted inheritance. serve adoneinu rebbe, melech hamoshiach.
target_text: miu sad'i sab'a ngaa èèna ka, na, sab'a la mola-mola. miu hud'i sab'a sasab'a miu dènge d'ara kateme hia lamatua miu ètu rai-haha ne, nuka sèmi miu sab'a hia kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. de miu lalau-lalo'o ne, te nèngu ka dhu b'ala rui-j'aj'èra miu, dènge hia miu pusaka.

source_text: for the one doing wrong will be repaid for his wrong, ki ein masso panim im hashemfor there is no respect of persons with g-d, no partiality.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu sab'a lèke boe j'ara, bèli-camèd'a na huku miu. lula nèngu èèna dhu bia boe cabèka, aa ladhe boe rèhu dhèu.

source_text: adonim, treat your avadim in a manner that is yashar and even-handed, with the da'as that you also have an adon in shomayim.
target_text: miu lamatua sèra! miu hud'i uri ku dhèu dhu sab'a hia miu sèra dènge mola, aa bia boe cabèka. sanèd'e ee, te miu dènge lamatua ètu sorga dhu uri miu kahèi.

source_text: persevere in your tefillos, keeping watch while davening with todot thanksgiving,
target_text: miu hud'i maj'èni sabaj'a. aa miu hud'i mase'a ku dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu miu padhai dènge ama lamatua, aa manèngi-mangaj'i dhu pènu dènge d'ara makasi.

source_text: davening together also concerning us, that g-d may open for us a delet for the besuras hageulah, to speak the raz of moshiach, on account of which also i have been bound with sharsherot chains.
target_text: baku bhèlu sabaj'a hia ji'i, aa manèngi ho ama lamatua bhoke j'ara, sèna ka ji'i bisa lole dènge dhèu, j'ara-j'ara dhu uru èèna pahuni lula-nèti kristus. sanèd'e, te ja'a ètu d'ara bui ne, lula ja'a padhue-padhai kristus mi dhèu.

source_text: offer this tefillah: that i make known the besuras hageulah as it is necessary for me to speak.
target_text: sabaj'a sèna ka ja'a bisa lole paled'a lii lolo be'a ne, sèna ka dhèu bisa re'a mèu.

source_text: walk in chochmah toward outsiders, redeeming the time.
target_text: mamuri dènge mola ètu talora aae dhèu dhu parcaya mèka kristus. pake paie-iie lod'o dhu taleo dhu ama lamatua hia miu.

source_text: may your lashon always be with the chen v'chesed hashem, seasoned with melach salt, so that you may have da'as how it is necessary for you to answer each one.
target_text: ladhe miu padhai lii, padhai dènge lii mako, dhu palèke dènge d'ara dhèu. mage padhai dhu paroca dhèu. pake lii-lii dhu lèke, sèna ka miu bisa dhaa hari dènge be'a, ladhe abhu dhèu pakarèi dènge miu.

source_text: tychicus will tell you all the news about me; he is a beloved ach b'moshiach and a keli kodesh who is ne'eman faithful, a chaver and fellow eved in adoneinu.
target_text: pe tikikus dhiu lole dènge miu, j'ara mamuri ja'a. nèngu ne a'ari pasue èdhi dhu ladhe-leru dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua dhu ne'a boe roca. uru èèna, nèngu pakako sasab'a lamatua sama-sama dènge ja'a kahèi.

source_text: tychicus i sent to you for this very reason, that you might have da'as of everything concerning us and he might impart chizzuk strengthening, encouragement to your levavot.
target_text: ja'a pua na dhiu, sèna ka pa'èra d'ara miu, aa lole dènge miu j'ara mamuri ji'i ètu ne'e.

source_text: with onesimus, the ach b'moshiach, ne'eman and a beloved chaver, one of your kehillah, tychicus will make known the things here.
target_text: ja'a pua onesimus kahèi lèpa palere dènge ne. onesimus ne a'ari pasue dhu sab'a ne'a boe roca kahèi. nèngu ne, dhèu miu. dua ra, pe lole dènge miu j'ara-j'ara dhu j'aj'i le ètu ne'e.

source_text: aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, sends you drishat shalom. also markos, cousin of bar-nabba. you have received word klapei concerning markos. if he should come to you, give him a kabbalat panim reception and be mekarev befriend him.
target_text: aristarkus hia lii maho'o kahèi hia miu. ra taha ne ètu d'ara bui sama-sama dènge ja'a. markus, a'ari nèti barnabas, hia lii maho'o kahèi. uru èèna, ja'a moa mema le dènge miu, na, ladhe markus dhiu pangad'o dènge miu, na, sèmi mere ne dènge be'a.

source_text: also yehoshua, the one being called justus. these are the only messianic jews among my fellow po'alim workers in the malchut hashem. they became to me an encouragement.
target_text: yesus, dhu èdhi pangare ne, yustus hia lii maho'o kahèi mi miu. nèti angalai aa'i-aa'i dhu sama-sama pakako sasab'a ama lamatua, dhoka rèngu tèlu ra se'e ka dhu j'aj'i dhèu sarani nèti suku yahudi. aa rèngu se'e ka dhu pa'èra d'ara ja'a.

source_text: epaphras sends you drishat shalom. he has also been mishtatef your kehillah, an eved of rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua, always davening, always agonizing for you in his tefillos, that you might stand bnei chayil mature and be fully assured in all the ratzon hashem.
target_text: angalai miu epapras ètu ne'e, aa na hia miu lii maho'o kahèi. nèngu ne dhèu sab'a hia yesus kristus. nèngu ne ka dhu loe boe sabaj'a hia miu dènge a'èra na, aa na manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pa'èra dènge tao pamèci miu, aa tao miu j'aj'i me'a mèu dad'èi na.

source_text: for i give solemn eidus for him that he has toiled much for you and for the ones in laodicea and for the ones in hierapolis.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e mema miu, na, epapras ne, dhu sab'a bia hia miu dènge dhèu-dhèu kristen ètu kota laodikia dènge kota herapolis.

source_text: lukas, the beloved physician, sends you drishat shalom, and demas.
target_text: abhu lii maho'o kahèi nèti demas dènge dote lukas dhu èdhi sue.

source_text: drishat shalom to the achim b'moshiach in laodicea and to nymphas and the brit chadasha kehillah at her bais.
target_text: ja'a hia lii maho'o mi a'ari dhèu parcaya ètu kota laodikia. baku bhèlu hia lii maho'o ja'a mi mama nimfa dènge dhèu-dhèu parcaya dhu tema pakaboko ètu d'ara èmu na.

source_text: and whenever this iggeret hakodesh holy epistle is read before you, make sure also that it is read in the moshiachʼs brit chadasha kehillah of the laodiceans, and also you should read the iggeret hakodesh of the laodiceans.
target_text: pe, ladhe miu aa'i-aa'i mi ètu kota kolose baca mere sasuri ne, na, mi pa'adhu hia dhèu-dhèu parcaya ètu kota laodikia, sèna ka rèngu baca kahèi. aa miu hud'i baca kahèi sasuri dhu ja'a pa'adhu kèdhi hia rèngu uru sèra.

source_text: and say to archippus, give attention to the avodas kodesh ministry which you received in adoneinu, that you fulfill it.
target_text: pasanèd'e arkipus, peka na, èu baku bhèlu pakako toke pa'èle, sasab'a dhu èu sèmi more nèti lamatua.

source_text: this is my hand-signed drishat shalom greeting, sha'ul. remember my sharsherot prison chains. chen v'chesed hashem be with you.
target_text: baku bhèlu, peka na, ra taha ja'a ètu d'ara bui ne era. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu. sasuri ne, ja'a ènyi ai pake kacui-aai ja'a unu ku. salam nèti ja'a, paulus

source_text: from sha'ul and silvanus sila and timotiyos. to the kehillah of the inhabitants of the city of thessalonika, the kehillah in hashem, in elohim haav and in rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu yehoshua. chen v'chesed hashem and shalom hashem to you.
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a paulus, dènge angalai ja'a silas dènge timotius. sasuri ne, ji'i pa'adhu hia miu dhèu sarani aa'i-aa'i mi ètu kota tesalonika. miu ka dhu pama'ète mere le, ho madhutu ama lamatua èdhi, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ji'i manèngi, sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na hia miu, ho miu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: hodinu l'hashemwe give thanks to hashem always for all of you, with zikaron remembrance during our davening, without ceasing
target_text: ji'i loe boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, lula parcaya miu. mèu-mèda ji'i sabaj'a hia miu aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: in our tefillos recalling before our g-d and avinu your work of emunah, your labor of ahavah agape, and your perseverance of tikvah in moshiach adoneinu yeshoshua,
target_text: ji'i sanèd'e sasab'a dhu miu sab'a, lula miu parcaya ama lamatua, aa sue ne. miu loe boe nèti j'ara èèna, lula era sarai miu ka lamatua yesus. ji'i loe boe kahèi ngèti j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i asa katanga madha ama lamatua.

source_text: knowing, achim b'moshiach ahuvei hashembrothers in moshiach beloved of g-d, your bechirah election.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ji'i nge'a ama lamatua sue miu. nèti èèna ka, na hag'e nare miu j'aj'i dhèu nèngu.

source_text: for our besuras hageulah did not come to you in mere locution but indeed in gevurah miraculous power and in the ruach hakodesh and in full bitachon confidence, just as you have da'as what sort of men we were among you for your sake.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ji'i dhiu asa tesalonika, ji'i peka-padhai dènge miu lii lolo be'a ama lamatua. lod'o èèna, miu pasa dhilu paie-iie ho nanene lii padhai lii ji'i. miu mesa boe dhoka nanene lii ji'i di, te ngaa miu mèdhi unu mi kahèi koasa ama lamatua nèti roh na dhu mola-mèci èèna. j'ara èèna ka dhu tao miu tare'a-re'a sèmi mere lii lolo be'a èèna. lod'o èèna, miu mèdhi unu mi j'ara mamuri ji'i dhu tasa mera mia, sèna ka me'a tare'a-re'a, j'ara-j'ara lamatua.

source_text: and you became imitators of us and of adoneinu, having received the dvar hashemthe word of the l-rd in much redifah persecution with the simcha of the ruach hakodesh,
target_text: lula miu pama'ète mere le ho madhutu dad'èi lamatua, nèti èèna ka miu mamuri madhutu tatao ji'i, aa madhutu j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus kahèi. te ngaa lod'o miu heka sèmi mere lii lolo be'a èèna, abhu dhèu dhu pasusa miu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa d'ara miu kalau boe-karèto boe, lula roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci pakarej'e d'ara miu.

source_text: with the result that you became a mofet portent, even a role model for all the ma'aminim believers in the territory of macedonia and in achaia.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, miu pad'elo j'ara hia dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i ètu propensi makedonia dènge propensi akaya.

source_text: for from you the dvar hashem has resounded not only in macedonia and in achaia, but also in every place to which your emunah in hashem has gone forth, with the result that we have no need to say anything.
target_text: mesa boe ètu sèi di. te lii lolo be'a lamatua dhu pale-lème le tesalonika nèti miu se'e ka toke mia-mia. de ji'i peka ngaa hari, lula dhèu aa'i-aa'i tadèngi le lalèka miu mi lamatua.

source_text: for they themselves the ma'aminim b'moshiach in macedonia and achaia are reporting about us, what sort of initial reception we had with you, and how you made teshuva, turning to hashem from elilim idols, from avodah zarah idol worship, turning to worship the elohim chayyim and elohei emes the living g-d and the true g-d,
target_text: ètu mia-mia dhèu palolo, peka na, miu uru na sèmi mere ji'i dènge d'ara kateme. ka miu core eele mèdha-mèdha sogo-tagu mi, hèia mai madhutu lamatua dhu tare'a-re'a. te miu me'a le, na, lamatua èèna nuka ama lamatua dhu mamuri. nèti èèna ka, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti madhutu ne.

source_text: and to expect zun fun der oybershter from shomayim whom hashem made to stand up in the techiyas hamoshiach from the mesim yehoshua moshieinu our deliverer from the charon af habah the wrath to come.
target_text: rèngu palolo kahèi, na, miu tatae mamai ana ama lamatua nèti sorga, nuka yesus. uru èèna dhèu pamadhe ne, te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu pamamuri hari ne. lod'o ama lamatua huku dhèu rai-haha ne, na, lamatua yesus ka dhu pakaj'èu èdhi nèti nanasa ama lamatua.

source_text: but you yourselves know, chaverim b'moshiach, that our initial reception with you was not empty of result.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a le lod'o ji'i dhiu sab'a ètu tesalonika, èi kabhèsu ji'i suti boe iia d'ara.

source_text: on the contrary, having suffered before and having been shamefully persecuted as you know in philippi, we had the chozek b'eloheinu strength in our g-d to speak to you the besuras hageulah of hashem in the face of tzorrim rabbim great and oppressive enemy opposition.
target_text: miu sanèd'e kahèi lod'o ji'i dhiu mèka asa tesalonika, dhèu nèti kota pilipi dhu tao le pasusa dènge paj'èra ji'i. te ngaa lula lamatua pa'èra d'ara ji'i, ka ji'i bani lole lii lolo be'a lamatua dènge miu, masi ka dhèu ae dhu pamusu dènge ji'i.

source_text: for our appeal, our eidus witness of testimony, does not spring from toyus error or meshuga delusion or from tum'a uncleanness or from remiyah guile, deceit.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ji'i ngèti lii lolo be'a hia miu asa tesalonika, ngèti boe lii aj'a-nori dhu koe-kapengo. te ji'i dhiu tao boe pagoa dènge pakapod'e-kabèli miu.

source_text: on the contrary, in this way we speak: as persons examined and approved by g-d to be entrusted with the besuras hageulah of hashem, as striving to please not men but hashem who tests, who examines, our levavot.
target_text: aad'o! uru èèna ji'i dhiu dènge d'ara mola. ama lamatua mesa na dhu paj'uj'u ji'i, ho ngèti lii lolo be'a na asa miu. ji'i se neo boe pakarej'e d'ara dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa pakarej'e d'ara lamatua, te nèngu ka dhu patigi nèdhi d'ara ji'i, sèna ka ne'a, mola do koe.

source_text: nor did we ever come with divrei chanuppah words of flattery, as you know, nor with pretext for chamdanut greed - der oybershter is mine eidus! g-d is my witness!
target_text: miu me'a kahèi, na, ji'i se hèb'a mènyi boe, ngaa hari tenge leto ca doi sa nèti miu. ama lamatua dhu ne'a d'ara ji'i.

source_text: nor seeking kavod from men, neither from you nor from others.
target_text: sasab'a ji'i ne tenge boe lii koa-kad'iri nèti dhèu rai-haha, do nèti miu, aa nèti dhèu leo kara kahèi.

source_text: even though we had the samchut to be able to throw our weight around as shlichim emissaries of moshiach, yet we became anav humble and eidel gentle among you, as a nursing imma mother might take care of her own yeladim.
target_text: ji'i se dhèu pajuu-paleha kristus. ji'i dènge hak kahèi, tao ngi'u sama sèmi dhèu aae-dhèu kapai, te ngaa ji'i ngo'o boe padedha iisi sèmi èèna. lod'o sèra, ji'i tao ngi'u ji'i èci èèna ka dènge ana iiki ètu talora aae miu. ji'i pad'elo sasue mi dedha miu kahèi, nuka sèmi ina dhu pasusu ana na.

source_text: thus having a tshuka yearning for you, it was our good pleasure to share with you not only the besuras hageulah of hashem, but also our very lives, because you became beloved chaverim to us.
target_text: ji'i dhiu ho mesa boe dhoka ngèti lii lolo be'a hia miu di, te ngaa ji'i soro iisi kateme aae kahèi, lula ji'i sue miu seli eele.

source_text: for remember, achim b'moshiach, our labor and toil yomam valailah working for the purpose of not weighing down any one of you while we maggidim for moshiach made the hachrazah proclamation, kerygma to you of the besuras hageulah of hashem.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ele boe miu sanèd'e era, ji'i sab'a dhu nge'a boe j'èra mèu-mèda, ho abhu unu mi nganga'a-nganginu. te ji'i d'èi boe paj'èra miu lod'o ngèti lii lolo be'a asa miu.

source_text: you were edim witnesses and so is hashem, with what kedushah and tzedek and tamim manner of shomer masoret we acted toward you ma'aminim b'moshiach,
target_text: miu mèdhi unu mi, sèmi èèna kahèi ama lamatua, ropa dhu ji'i bera-bera dènge miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu parcaya le, ji'i mamuri dènge d'ara mola, dhu tao boe sala ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: for you know how we treated you, as an abba treats his own yeladim,
target_text: miu me'a kahèi, ji'i lalau-lalo'o miu, èci èèna ka dènge ama matana ladhe-leru ana-ana na,

source_text: exhorting you with divrei chizzuk and comforting you, addressing you with solemn edut testimony that you let your derech way of life, your hitnahagut conduct, be to fier zich comport oneself in a manner worthy of hashem, who summons you to his own malchut and kavod.
target_text: nuka sèmi: pa'èra d'ara miu aa'i-aa'i mi, pasanèd'e dènge pamako miu sèna ka mamuri dhu mèci, ho pakarej'e d'ara lamatua. te nèngu ka j'aj'i dhèu aae, dhu paroa le miu sèna ka j'aj'i ana kabarai na, aa abhu pakab'ua bera-bera dènge nèngu.

source_text: and for this reason also we constantly offer hodayah to hashem that when you received as ani maamin authoritative teaching the dvar hashem, the word of hachrazah proclamation, kerygma from us, you received it not as the dvar habnei adam but, as it actually is, the dvar hashem, which also is at work in you who have emunah.
target_text: ji'i ma'ète boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, lula lod'o miu tadèngi lii lolo nèti ji'i, miu sèmi mere boe lii holo-nori nèti dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa lii holo-nori èèna kapua na nèti ama lamatua. nèngu unu na ka dhu sab'a ètu d'ara miu dhèu parcaya.

source_text: for you became imitators, chaverim, of the kehillot hashem in moshiach yehoshua which are in yehudah, because you also were similarly persecuted by your own landslait, just as also they were by the ones in yehudah,
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu heka madhutu j'ara lamatua kèna, te ngaa dhèu-dhèu miu pasusa le miu. de miu se abhu j'aj'èra èci èèna ka dènge dhèu parcaya ètu propensi yudea, dhu dhèu yahudi rèngu mesa ra paj'èra rèngu lula ra lèka yesus kristus.

source_text: even the ones who caused the histalkus of moshiach adoneinu yehoshua and killed the nevi'im and persecuted us severely. indeed, they are not pleasing hashem and are hostile to kol bnei adam,
target_text: abhu dhèu yahudi dhu pusi-pahae boe dad'èi ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, ropa ama lamatua pua dhèu rèti lii padhai na mai asa rèngu, ka rèngu paj'èra dènge hake pamadhe si. ra pamadhe lamatua yesus dènge j'ara sèmi èèna kahèi. limuri ne, ra tenge j'ara ho babèga eele ji'i kahèi. rèngu pamusu dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, ka ama lamatua d'èi boe rèngu.

source_text: by hindering us from speaking to the goyim in order that the goyim might find yeshu'at eloheinu. thus they always make complete their peysha'im. so the charon af, the burning wrath, the furious retribution of hashem has overtaken them at last.
target_text: ngaa hari, ra tenge j'ara ae-ae sèna ka ji'i pakako ia ka lii lolo be'a hia dhèu leo. dhèu yahudi se ro'o boe ho lamatua pala-bagi mamuri hia dhèu leo kara kahèi. dènge j'ara èèna ka, sasala rèngu sèmi tao udhu sa. hèia ama lamatua nasa, ka huku si.

source_text: but you, achim b'moshiach, while we were separated from you for a short time panim el panim, not b'lev, we made all the more effort in much desire to see your penemer faces.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! masi ka èdhi pakaj'èu, te ngaa pakaj'èu boe ètu d'ara. ji'i tenge-tenge j'ara, ho ladhe abhu lod'o dhu taleo, ji'i dhiu hari pa'asu-pareo dènge miu, te d'ara ji'i neo ae le.

source_text: for we wanted to come to you. indeed i, rav sha'ul, did again and again; but hasatan hindered us.
target_text: ja'a mesa ku neo ae le kahèi dhiu pangad'o dènge miu, te ngaa dhèu aae nidhu loe boe bhabhae ja'a.

source_text: for who is our tikvah or simcha or crown to glory in before adoneinu yehoshua at his parousia, at the bias moshiach - is it not you?
