target_text: miu me'a, nga tao ka ji'i neo dhiu paraga dènge miu, sina ma? lula ji'i maena miu. miu ka dhu pakarej'e dènge pa'adhu d'ara ji'i. ladhe miu aad'o, cee hari ka dhu kèpe pa'èra kolongara lamatua yesus! ladhe lamatua lèpa hari mai, d'ara ji'i taleo, lula miu se'e ka.

source_text: for you are our kavod and simcha.
target_text: mema tare'a! miu se'e se ka dhu pakab'ua sasab'a ji'i aa pataleo d'ara ji'i.

source_text: therefore, when we could no longer endure it, we resolved to be left behind alone in athens. also we sent timotiyos, acheinu and fellow po'el of hashem in the besuras hageulah of moshiach. we sent timotiyos in order to give you chozek strength and to speak divrei chizzuk to you on behalf of our emunah.
target_text: sèna ka miu me'a, ca hari ni ji'i kako tèke eele miu èèna, madhutu boe dad'èi ji'i. ji'i neo ae le dhiu paraga dènge miu, te ngaa bisa mèka. lula ji'i ngo'o heka mate panèbhu, hèia ji'i pama'ète le ho pua timotius dhiu. te ngaa ja'a dènge silas pea ètu kota atena. timotius ne a'ari ji'i. nèngu ne angalai ji'i ètu d'ara sasab'a-la'a, dhu bera-bera pakako lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus. ji'i pua na dhiu, ho na aj'a miu aa pa'èra d'ara miu, sèna ka miu asa parcaya èra ama lamatua.

source_text: this was for the tachlis that no one be unsettled because of es tzarah. for you yourselves have da'as that we have a divine calendar date with es tzarah.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, ladhe miu paraga dènge sasusa, d'ara miu roe boe. kèpe pa'èra-èra lalèka miu. te miu me'a le, dhèu cee dhu parcaya kristus, tatu na paraga dènge j'aj'èra.

source_text: for, hinei, when we were with you, we kept telling you beforehand that we were going to suffer redifah, just as also it came to pass, of which you have da'as.
target_text: ca hari ni, lod'o ji'i dènge miu era, ji'i pasanèd'e le miu, peka na, dhèu cee dhu parcaya lamatua yesus, bèli-camèd'a paraga dènge rupa-rupa sasusa. limuri ne j'aj'i le, si!

source_text: for this reason, when i could no longer endure it, i sent in order to know your emunah, lest somehow hasatan samma'el the tempter hamenasseh had ensnared you by nissayon and our labor should be for nothing.
target_text: lula ja'a susa titu kèna nèti j'aj'èra miu se'e ka, nèti èèna ka ja'a pua timotius dhiu asa tesalonika, ho ji'i nge'a mèu kèna, miu parcaya era lamatua, do aad'o. te ja'a mage-mage, dhèu aae nidhu dadugu miu, ho miu soro kabodho mi lamatua. ladhe j'aj'i ka sèmi èèna, sasab'a ji'i uru sèra, ele iie d'ara!

source_text: but, just now, when timotiyos has come to us from you and has brought us good news of your emunah and your ahavah and that you always have zochrim tovim good memories of us, yearning to see us, just as we yearn to see you.
target_text: lai-lai ne, timotius lèpa hari mai nèti tesalonika. ka nèti lii dhu pakarej'e d'ara ji'i. na lolo, na, miu parcaya kristus era, aa miu èci pasue dènge èci. na peka kahèi, na, miu ngee ji'i sèmi mia dhu ji'i sanèd'e miu kahèi.

source_text: for this reason, achim b'moshiach, in all our tzoros and redifah, we received chozek because of you through your emunah. for now we have chayyim if you have a firm standing and remain ne'emanot faithful in hashem.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! masi ka ètu ne'e ji'i ako rasa bia, lula abhu susa ae nèti mia-mia, te ngaa ropa tadèngi lii lolo timotius, ka d'ara ji'i tare'a-re'a abhu karej'e. lula limuri ne ji'i nge'a le miu parcaya lamatua era.

source_text: for what hodayah are we able to return to hashem concerning you because of all the simcha with which we rejoice on account of you before eloheinu,
target_text: de ji'i manèngi makasi ae-ae mi lamatua dènge d'ara dhu karej'e titu kèna, lula miu madhutu ne taruu.

source_text: as, yomam valailah, we are davening with all retzinut earnestness in order to see your penemer faces and to bring to shleimut what is lacking in your emunah?
target_text: mèu-mèda ji'i loe boe sabaj'a sèna ka catèka sa èdhi paraga hari. ji'i neo aj'a miu sèna ka pamèci d'ara miu ètu j'ara mamuri lamatua.

source_text: and may eloheinu and avinu, may hashem himself and adoneinu yehoshua direct our way to you.
target_text: ji'i sanao sèna ka ama lamatua èdhi, aa kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, bhoke j'ara sèna ka ji'i dhiu paraga hari dènge miu.

source_text: and may hashem cause you to grow and to overflow and abound in ahavah agape for one another and for kol bnei adam, just as also we have ahavah agape for you,
target_text: ji'i manèngi sèna ka lamatua hia miu asa pasue risi eele hari. nuka sèmi èèna kahèi miu dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra asa pasue, sèmi dhu ji'i sue miu.

source_text: with this tachlis purpose: to establish your levavot faultless in kedushah holiness in the presence of hashem and avinu at the bi'as moshiach coming of moshiach of adoneinu yehoshua with all his kedoshim. omein.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna lamatua pa'èra d'ara miu, ho mamuri mola dènge mera-milu, toke bèli-camèd'a lamatua yesus lèpa hari mai dènge dhèu unu na, miu bisa titu kahèi ètu katanga madha ama lamatua èdhi, dènge dui heka sasala-sasigo.

source_text: lemaskana finally, achim b'moshiach, we ask and exhort you in adoneinu yehoshua, in order that, just as from us moshiachʼs shlichim you received as authoritative halachic tradition, as the messianic teaching to be followed how it is necessary for you to be fier zich comport oneself in your derech way of life and to please hashem just as you in fact are doing, so you should abound more and more.
target_text: de a'ari, sèmi ne'e ka! ji'i pamako miu sèna ka miu mamuri pamaho'o d'ara ama lamatua, sèmi dhu ji'i aj'a le miu. mema mamuri miu madhutu le j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i, te ngaa lula èdhi j'aj'i le dhèu unu lamatua yesus, ka ji'i manèngi miu ho tenge j'ara dhu be'a risi hari.

source_text: for you have da'as what mitzvot commandments we gave you through moshiach adoneinu yehoshua.
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a le ngaa dhu ji'i aj'a miu, pake koasa nèti lamatua yesus.

source_text: for this is the ratzon hashemthe will of g-d, your kedushah holiness, your consecration, that you abstain from zenut fornication,
target_text: dad'èi ama lamatua nuka: mamuri mola-mèci! baku mamuri kaj'alu ètu d'ara pa'èci bhèni-mone.

source_text: that each one of you have da'as of how to control your own k'li vessel in kedushah and kavod,
target_text: miu hud'i me'a lalau ngi'u miu unu mi, sèna ka mamuri mola-mèci ho dhèu pakab'ua miu.

source_text: not in the passion of ta'avah evil desire, lust like goyim who do not have da'as of hashem;
target_text: baku mamuri madhutu dad'èi d'ara mi, sèmi dhèu dhu dhae tadhe mèka ama lamatua.

source_text: that no man commit peysha and take advantage of one of his achim b'moshiach in this sexual matter, because hashem is the nokem avenger concerning all these things, just as also we told you before and warned you.
target_text: mage abhu dhèu dhu neo tao karehe, aa neo tenge oto dhu risi nèti dhèu dhu sama-sama parcaya ama lamatua. te ama lamatua ka, kètu dhu èèna na b'ala bhabhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i sèra. j'ara se'e, ji'i peka le dènge miu pèri-pèri hari, aa pasanèd'e le miu karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: for as far as our bechirah election is concerned, hashem did not summon us for tu'ma uncleanness but in kedushah holiness.
target_text: te ama lamatua paroa nare le èdhi sèna ka j'aj'i mi dhèu unu na. madhutu dad'èi na, èdhi hud'i mamuri dènge mola-mèci, baku dènge kaj'alu, sèmi dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae. baku sèmi èèna!

source_text: therefore, the one rejecting this mitzvah commandment does not reject bnei adam but hashem who gives to you his ruach hakodesh.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu cee ka dhu madhutu boe lii holo-nori ne, nèngu èèna sèmi boe ji'i, aa tule eele ama lamatua kahèi dhu hia le miu roh na dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: concerning the matter of ahavah shel achvah brotherly love, you have no need that we write you, for you yourselves are limudei elohim taught of g-d to have ahavah agape one for another.
target_text: madhutu ngangee ja'a, suri hari ia ka hia miu j'ara-j'ara pasue a'ari dènge a'ari, lula ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu peka le, na, miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci.

source_text: for indeed this you do toward all the achim b'moshiach in all of macedonia. but in this we exhort you, chaverim, to abound more and more.
target_text: ji'i tadèngi le, miu sue a'ari aa'i-aa'i ètu propensi makedonia nèi. te ngaa a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ji'i manèngi sèna ka miu sue dhèu leo risi eele hari.

source_text: and have as your ambition to lead a quiet life of shalom bayis, and to mind your own business, and to have a parnasah, working with your own hands, according to the mitzvot commandments we gave you.
target_text: tenge j'ara sèna ka miu mamuri dènge mera-milu. baku soro iisi sa d'ara lii langu dhèu leo, te ngaa èci-èci ka laladhe mamuri na. miu hud'i sab'a tenge nganga'a-nganginu dènge kacui-aai miu mesa mi. baku maena dhèu leo. se'e se ji'i pasanèd'e le miu, karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: the tachlis purpose is that the way you fier zich comport oneself in your derech way of life be conducted properly toward outsiders and that you might not be nitzrach needy.
target_text: ladhe miu mamuri sèmi èèna, miu pabia boe dhèu leo. ladhe dhèu dhu lèka boe kristus rèdhi miu mamuri sèmi èèna, tatu ra peka na, waa! dhèu dhu madhutu lamatua yesus sèra, mamuri ra mola tare'a, nga!

source_text: we do not want you to lack da'as, chaverim, concerning those who have fallen asleep. the purpose is that you not have agmat nefesh grief like the rest, who do not have tikvah hope.
target_text: a'ari! limuri ne, ja'a neo peka ngaa èci, sèna ka miu me'a mèu, j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti dhèu madhe. èdhi te'a, na, dhèu dhu madhe le, bèli-camèd'a, na mamuri hari. de ladhe nèti dhèu unu lamatua èci madhe, miu baku tao ngi'u mi j'èra nuka sèmi dhèu leo dhu re'a boe j'ara èèna.

source_text: for, if we have an ani ma'amin belief that yehoshua had his histalkus and then stood up alive again in the techiyas hamoshiach from hamesim, even so, hashem will bring with him those who have fallen asleep through yehoshua.
target_text: te èdhi te'a, na, yesus dhu madhe le, ka ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. de ladhe sèmi èèna, tatu ama lamatua pamamuri hari kahèi dhèu parcaya dhu madhe sèra, aa oru nare si aa'i-aa'i ra bera-bera dènge lamatua yesus.

source_text: for this we say to you by the dvar hashem, that we who are alive and have been left behind until the bi'as coming, parousia of moshiach adoneinu, may in no way be kodem preceding those who have fallen asleep. for adoneinu himself, at the signal, at the bat kol of the sar hamalachim the archangel, and at the shofar blast of hashem, shall come down from shomayim, and the mesim in moshiach shall stand up alive in the techiyas hamesim first. then, we who are alive and who have been left behind simultaneously with them shall be snatched up in the ananim clouds to meet adoneinu in the air. and so always with adoneinu we shall be.
target_text: de ladhe lamatua yesus mai hari, na puru nèti sorga asa rai-haha ne, èèna na dènge paredha dhu lii mèdhu aae. ka kètu kapai nèti ana-ana pajuu ètu sorga hia paredha ho tiu tèbhe. hèia dhèu unu lamatua dhu madhe sèra, mamuri hari. ka rèngu dènge èdhi dhu mamuri era, lèke ded'e asa ra'i-liru, ho aa'i-aa'i ti soru mamai lamatua yesus. èle èèna na, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti mamuri pa'èci dènge ne taa-taa. mi nanene pabe'a-be'a, lula ngaa dhu ji'i peka ne, lamatua unu na ka dhu peka-padhai.

source_text: therefore, give chozek strength and speak divrei chizzuk words of encouragement, comforting one another with these words.
target_text: de ladhe sèmi èèna, miu hud'i pa'èki lii aj'a-nori ne, sèna ka pa'èra d'ara miu èci dènge èci.

source_text: but concerning the ittim times and the zmanim seasons, chaverim, you have no need for you to have anything in writing.
target_text: de a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ji'i suri ia ka laa, peka na, mamai lamatua lèke hake pèri, do tanggal pèri.

source_text: for you yourselves know very well that the yom hashem comes like a ganav balailah thief in the night.
target_text: lula miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, na, mamai na dènge sahèka, sèmi dhèu mana'u dhu mai re mèda.

source_text: whenever they say, shalom and bitachon! then sudden churban destruction will come upon them like the chevlei leydah birth pangs of the isha with a baby in her womb. and they can certainly not escape.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae dhu madhèdi mau-mau, te ngaa cag'ag'a laa paraga dènge j'aj'èra. mamai na sama kahèi dènge dhèu bhèni dhu cag'ag'a laa kabake pèd'a neo nara iisi. ladhe paraga le j'ara ne'e, èdhi pakaj'èu iisi tasamia hari! èci èèna ka dènge mamai lamatua.

source_text: but you, achim b'moshiach, are not in choshech that the yom should overtake you like a ganav. for all of you are bnei ohr and bnei yom; we are not of the lailah nor of the choshech. therefore, let us not sleep as the rest, but let us keep awake with zililut da'as sober-mindedness.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! mage dhoka mamai na nuka sèmi dhèu mana'u dhu mai re talora mèda, lèke dènge miu dhu bhèj'i luu. mage lèke miu sèmi èèna kahèi! èdhi mamuri heka ètu d'ara maroga, sèmi dhèu leo dhu bhèj'i luu era. de èdhi dhu lèka le lamatua yesus, mamuri le ètu d'ara saraa, ti pa'èra soru mamai ne, aa j'aga paie mamuri èdhi. j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i miu me'a le!

source_text: for the ones sleeping sleep balailah, and the ones indulging in shichrut drunkenness indulge in shichrut balailah.
target_text: te dhèu dhu bhèj'i, na, bhèj'i re mèda. aa dhèu dhu mahu, na, mahu re mèda.

source_text: but we, being bnei yom, let us be bnei zililut da'as sons of sober-mindedness, having clothed ourselves with the choshen breastplate of emunah and ahavah agape and as a kovahhelmet the tikvah of yeshu'at eloheynu.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku sèmi èèna, lula èdhi dhu mamuri le ètu d'ara saraa. miu hud'i j'aga paie mamuri miu. ladhe miu parcaya taruu lamatua aa mamuri pasue, èèna sama sèmi sordad'u dhu pake kodho bèsi dhu pa'abhe kakara. aa ladhe miu maena taruu mi lamatua yesus dhu hia miu pakaj'èu nèti nanasa ama lamatua, èci èèna ka dènge sordad'u dhu pa'abhe kètu na dènge solo bèsi.

source_text: because hashem did not appoint us to charon af the burning wrath but to the attainment of yeshu'at eloheinu through adoneinu, moshiach yehoshua.
target_text: ama lamatua hag'e boe èdhi ho na huku ti. te ngaa na hag'e èdhi sèna ka abhu mamuri, sad'i èdhi lèka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: he is the one who made his histalkus and died on our behalf in order that whether we are living and awake or passed away and sleeping, we may live together with moshiach.
target_text: te na madhe le gati èdhi. de ladhe na lèpa hari mai, èdhi mamuri taa-taa dènge ne, masi ka èdhi madhe le, do mamuri era.

source_text: therefore, give chozek strength and encouragement, building up one another, as indeed you are doing.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, pake lii-lii ja'a se'e, sèna ka hia karej'e dènge pa'èra èci dènge èci, sèmi dhu miu tao le karèi nèti uru èèna ka.

source_text: now we ask you, achim b'moshiach, to have discerning binah understanding and discern the ones laboring among you who are your mashgichim ruchaniyim spiritual overseers in adoneinu. i'm referring to the ones who admonish and warn you.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! sanèd'e ho pakab'ua ina-ama dhu j'aj'i kètu ètu juma'at. te rèngu sèra sab'a dhu re'a boe j'èra hia miu, aa pasanèd'e miu, sèna ka miu baku manahu asa d'ara sasala.

source_text: and esteem them most exceedingly in ahavah agape, because of their avodas kodesh work. let there be shalom bayis family peace also in the kehillah.
target_text: pad'elo sasue miu dènge ra, sèna ka re'a, na, miu pakab'ua si, lula rèngu sab'a bia hia miu. mamuri dame èci dènge èci.

source_text: and we exhort you, achim b'moshiach, warn the batlanim unemployed or lazy loafers, idlers, comfort the congregant who is pachdan fainthearted, those who are weak take an interest in, have savlanut patience with all.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! abhu pèri-pèri j'ara era dhu ji'i neo pasanèd'e miu: dhèu dhu bai-eed'a sèra, peka si sèna ka ra sab'a dènge d'ara maj'èni. dhu d'ara roe, pa'èra si. dhu haha, sarimu mere si. taha d'ara aa lii mako mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: see that no one returns ra'ah for ra'ah, but always pursue hatov both for one another and for all.
target_text: sanèd'e, bhabhelu baku b'ala dènge bhabhelu. te ngaa tenge j'ara sèna ka tao be'a dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra. baku tao be'a dhoka dènge dhèu èdhi di, te ngaa dènge dhèu leo kara kahèi.

source_text: have simcha always.
target_text: pakarej'e d'ara taruu.

source_text: daven unceasingly.
target_text: sabaj'a mèu-mèda.

source_text: in everything offer hodayah, for this is the ratzon hashem in moshiach yehoshua for you.
target_text: sad'i paraga dènge ngaa èèna ka, j'aj'èra, do karej'e-karae, manèngi makasi mi lamatua. te ama lamatua d'èi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu yesus kristus tao sèmi èèna.

source_text: do not quench the ruach hakodesh.
target_text: baku magee sasab'a roh lamatua.

source_text: do not reject nevu'ot prophecies.
target_text: ladhe abhu ca dhèu nèti talora dhèu parcaya dhu peka na, nèngu abhu le lii moa nèti ama lamatua, mage miu pusi-pahae boe lii padhai na!

source_text: but test kol davar everything; hold fast to hatov.
target_text: te ngaa miu hud'i kanucu ku paie-iie lii èèna mai tare'a nèti lamatua, do aad'o. ladhe tare'a, na, madhutu.

source_text: abstain from every appearance of ra'ah evil.
target_text: te ngaa pakaj'èu nèti ngaa-ngaa dhu karehe.

source_text: and now elohei hashalom wholly set you apart as kedoshim and may your whole ruach and nefesh and basar be preserved without blame at the bi'as hamoshiach adoneinu yehoshua. ne'eman faithful is the one who summons you to your kri'ah calling. he will do it.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a manèngi ama lamatua ho pamèu d'ara dènge mamuri miu aa'i-aa'i mi. nèngu èèna ka dhu uri ho èdhi bisa mamuri dame èci dènge èci. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, ladhe d'ai lod'o mamai hari lamatua èdhi, yesus kristus, miu bisa titu ètu katanga madha na dènge ngi'u aae miu, d'ara miu, dènge samanga miu dhu dènge boe sasala ngaa-ngaa. j'ara na sèmi èèna ka! te lamatua yesus dhu paroa miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, dhu monya boe. ngaa dhu na peka, na tao madhutu sama sèmi èèna ka. de èèna na, na lere nèti miu dènge mola-mèci asa katanga madha ama lamatua.

source_text: achim b'moshiach, offer tefillos also concerning us.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! baku bhèlu manèngi-mangaj'i hia ji'i ètu ne'e.

source_text: say drishat shalom to all the achim b'moshiach with a neshikat kedoshah.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu hia lii maho'o ji'i kahèi mi dhèu sarani aa'i-aa'i ètu sèra!

source_text: by adoneinu, i solemnly give you the directive that this iggeret hakodesh has to be read to all the achim b'moshiach.
target_text: ja'a manèngi dènge kolongara lamatua yesus, ho miu baca hia juma'at aa'i-aa'i ra isi sasuri ja'a ne.

source_text: the chen v'chesed of adoneinu, rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua, be with you.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka. saloom, paulus

source_text: from sha'ul and silvanus sila and timotiyos. to the kehillah of the inhabitants of the city of thessalonika, the kehillah in hashem, in elohim avinu and rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua adoneinu,
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a paulus, aa angalai ja'a, silas dènge timotius. sasuri ne'e, ji'i pa'adhu hia miu dhèu sarani aa'i-aa'i ètu kota tesalonika. miu ka dhu pama'ète mere le, ho madhutu ama lamatua èdhi, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: chen v'chesed hashem to you and shalom from elohim avinu and rebbe melech hamoshiach yehoshua adoneinu.
target_text: ji'i manèngi sèna ka rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra hia miu, ho miu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: with continuous hodayah thanksgiving we ought to make brachot to hashem concerning you, achim b'moshiach, as is fitting, because your emunah is increasing abundantly and the ahavah agape every one of you has for the other is growing.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! dhu lèke, ladhe èdhi loe boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, lula miu asa parcaya ne, aa asa pasue èci dènge èci.

source_text: therefore, we ourselves glory in you in all the kehillot of hashem for your zitzfleisch patience and emunah in all the redifot persecutions and the tzoros you are enduring.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ji'i palolo dènge dhèu sarani ètu mia-mia, lula-nèti mamuri miu. ji'i palolo, peka na, masi ka dhèu leo paj'èra miu, te ngaa miu rai boe nèti parcaya mi.

source_text: this is kluhr obvious that here is a manifest siman sign, indication of the yashar mishpat righteous judgment of hashem intended for you to be deemed worthy of the malchut hashem, on behalf of which also you undergo yissurim.
target_text: se'e se peka na, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua j'ue lii langu miu dènge mola. te j'aj'èra dhu miu pasae èèna ka, hia miu nia j'aj'i mi dhèu unu na. aa nèngu èèna, dhèu aae miu.

source_text: indeed it is tzaddik a thing examined and found to be right for hashem to repay with tzarah tribulation those who bring tzarah tribulation on you,
target_text: baku madha'u, te lamatua pama'ète lii langu dènge boe bia cabèka. mi ladhe, ee! bèli-camèd'a na b'ala mi dhèu dhu paj'èra miu.

source_text: and to recompense you, the ones suffering tzarah tribulation, with revachah relief along with us at the apocalypse of moshiach yehoshua adoneinu from shomayim with the malachim of his oz power
target_text: aa nèngu hia miu ae mere d'ara nèti j'aj'èra dhu mi pasae kahèi. sèmi èèna mi dedha ji'i kahèi. se'e se j'aj'i, lod'o lamatua yesus puru mai nèti sorga, palere-lere dènge ana pajuu na sèra dhu èra titu kèna.

source_text: belahavei eishin flaming fire, giving onesh to the ones not knowing hashem and to the ones not obeying the besuras hageulah of moshiach yehoshua adoneinu.
target_text: rèngu puru mai dènge ai dhu heo robhe-robhe. hèia na b'ala mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ro'o boe tadhe ama lamatua, aa dhu madhutu boe lii lolo be'a nèti lamatua yesus.

source_text: these are the ones who will pay an onesh of avaddon olam eternal destruction away from the shekhinah of hashem umehadar ge'onoand from the splendor of his majesty,
target_text: na hia huku dhu bia titu kèna mi rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, ka palaho si taa-taa. na babège si nèti katanga madha na, ka ra rasa heka koasa lamatua dhu kapai.

source_text: when he comes to be glorified among his kedoshim and to be marveled at among all the ma'aminim in yom hahuthat day, because our martyrʼs eidus to you was believed.
target_text: lod'o na mai èèna, dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i ra paca'e padedha-dedha kolongara na, aa ra pakab'ua ne. bèli-camèd'a miu ètu talora aae dhèu-dhèu parcaya sèra kahèi, lula miu sèmi mere le lii lolo be'a dhu uru èèna ji'i peka le dènge miu.

source_text: to this end also we make tefillos always concerning you that eloheinu may count you worthy of the kri'ah calling and by his gevurah may fulfill every chafetz hatov good desire and ma'aseh haemunah work of faith,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mèu-mèda ji'i ma'ète boe manèngi-mangaj'i hia miu, sèna ka madhutu a'abhu ama lamatua, na, miu nia j'aj'i dhèu unu na. ji'i manèngi sèna ka na hia koasa na mi miu kahèi, ho miu bisa tao madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a madhutu ngaa dhu miu parcaya, aa madhutu ngaa dhu miu neo tao.

source_text: in order that ha-shem the name of moshiach adoneinu yehoshua may be glorified in you, and you, in him, according to the unmerited chen v'chesed of eloheinu and moshiach yehoshua adoneinu.
target_text: ladhe miu mamuri dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, dhèu ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua yesus. aa miu abhu koa-kad'iri kahèi, lula miu madhutu ne. se'e aa'i-aa'i ra, mai nèti babe'a d'ara ama lamatua èdhi, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: we ask you, achim b'moshiach, concerning the bias hamoshiach the arrival, coming of moshiach yehoshua adoneinu and our being gathered together to him,
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ne'e ne ji'i neo peka dènge miu pèri lod'o kètu èdhi, yesus kristus puru mai, aa dènge j'ara tasamia èdhi bisa pa'èci dènge ne.

source_text: that you not become too hastily disturbed from your spiritual composure nor frightened either by a ruach or by a dibur saying, utterance or by an iggeret letter, as if from us, saying that the yom hashemday of the l-rd has come.
target_text: dhèu baku pagoa miu ho mi ele ngangee ropa tadèngi dhèu peka, na, lamatua dhu mai hari le. masi ka ra peka, na, rèngu tadèngi nèti roh lamatua, do nèti dhèu, do abhu sasuri nèti ji'i, mage miu lèka kahèi. te sèra sa ra leko-monya!

source_text: let no one in any way lead you astray, because, unless the merid rebellion, revolt, the shmad betrayal defection of apostasy, the azivah abandonment desertion comes rishonah first, and the apocalypse of the ish hamufkarut man of lawlessness, the ish hachatta'ah ben haavaddon man of sin, son of destruction anti-moshiach is unveiled…
target_text: baku soro tèka dhèu pagoa miu. te bèli-camèd'a ca dhèu dhu bhelu-katub'a cèu uuru mai, heka lamatua yesus lèpa hari kèna. dhèu ne'e ne, palab'a dènge lamatua, toke dhèu ae madhutu ne ho palab'a dènge lamatua kahèi. dhèu ne'e ne mema seli-kolane! nèti èèna ka, nèngu hud'i maso ku asa d'ara naraka.

source_text: i'm referring to the one setting himself against and exalting himself al kol elabove every g-d, above all that is given the appellation g-d or object of worship, with the result that in the beis hamikdash heikhal he sits down on the moshav elohimthrone of g-d, proclaiming that he himself is elohim…
target_text: na padedha iisi na risi nèti dewa aa'i-aa'i ra, aa palab'a aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu sogo-tagu. toke na maso asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, ka na padedha iisi, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, lamatua!

source_text: do you not recall that when i was still with you i was telling you these things?
target_text: miu sanèd'e, do aad'o? uru èèna ja'a dhu peka le dènge miu, lula dhèu èèna, lod'o dhu ja'a bera-bera dènge miu era, si?

source_text: yet you have da'as of what is holding back and restraining now, so that he may be unveiled and revealed in his own time.
target_text: limuri ne, d'ai mèka lod'o ho dhèu bhelu-katub'a èèna pacèu iisi na, lula abhu dhu pahèb'e ne era. aa miu me'a kahèi ngaa ka dhu pahèb'e ne!

source_text: for the sod hamufkarut mystery of lawlessness is already working; only he who holds back and restrains just now will do so until he is out of the way.
target_text: limuri ne dhèu bhelu èèna sab'a pahuni-pahuni era, lula abhu dhu pahèb'e ne. te ngaa ladhe bèli-camèd'a dhu pahèb'e na, patabuli ka ai na,

source_text: and then the ish hamufkarut the man of lawlessness will be revealed, whom haadon will destroy by the ruach of his mouth and will wipe out at the appearance of his bi'as hamoshiach, his parousia, coming.
target_text: hèia dhèu bhelu ne cèu mai dènge pahuni heka sasab'a na. te ngaa lèke dènge lod'o kapai mamai lamatua yesus, ka na palaho dhèu bhelu-katub'a ne dènge pake lii ca hèb'a doko di.

source_text: the bi'as anti-moshiach coming, parousia, of anti-moshiach is according to the working of hasatan with all false ko'ach power and otot signs and pseudo moftim wonders,
target_text: te ngaa lod'o lamatua yesus dhae d'ai mèka, dhèu aae nidhu hia koasa kapai hia mi dhèu bhelu ne, sèna ka bisa na tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa, hèia dhèu pangee, na, nèngu ne pake koasa nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: and with all deception of resha wickedness for those who are perishing, because they were not being mekabel receiving the ahavas haemes love of the truth so that they have the geulah deliverance.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu ae ka dhu lèke tipu nèti dhèu bhelu-katub'a ne. rèngu se'e ka dhu d'èi palaho iisi ra. ama lamatua dhu bhoke j'ara hia si mamuri, te ngaa ro'o boe sèmi dad'èi na dhu hua iia èèna, aa ro'o boe parcaya ngaa dhu lèke.

source_text: and for this reason hashem sends to them a powerful madduchei shav false enticement, delusion in order that they believe what is sheker.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua pabèdhu d'ara ra nèti ngaa dhu lèke, sèna ka hud'i laa ra parcaya mi kapod'e-kabèli sèra.

source_text: this is for the tachlis purpose of condemning to onesh all the ones who have no emunah in haemes, but instead have had delight in resha.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e ka, ama lamatua hia si huku dhu bia, lula rèngu lèka boe ngaa dhu tare'a. te rèngu d'èi risi tao dhu karehe.

source_text: but we ought always to offer hodayah thanksgiving and make brachot to hashem concerning you, achim b'moshiach, ahuvei hashem, because hashem chose you as bikkurim first fruits for the geulah through mekudash b'ruach hakodesh being set apart as holy in the ruach hakodesh and through emunah in haemes.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ji'i loe boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, lula na sue miu. te lod'o na paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, nèngu pama'ète nare le, sèna ka hia miu mamuri. ka na hia roh na ho pamèu miu, lula miu parcaya ngaa dhu tare'a.

source_text: this is haemes to which hashem called you through our besuras hageulah to the obtaining of the kavod of rebbe melech hamoshiach adoneinu yehoshua.
target_text: lod'o ji'i lole lii lolo be'a dènge miu, ama lamatua pake lii lolo be'a na ho ère miu, sèna ka miu me'a dadedha dènge kapai nèti lamatua yesus kristus.

source_text: so then, achim b'moshiach, stand fast and hold fast to the emunah, the moshiachʼs pnimiyus hatorah that was handed over and transmitted to you, which you were taught, whether by divrei pinu words of our mouth or by our iggeret hakodesh.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! taha d'ara dènge kèpe pa'ère-ère lii holo-nori dhu ji'i peka le dènge miu. sanèd'e kahèi aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ji'i.

source_text: now may hamelech hamoshiach yehoshua adoneinu himself and elohim avinu, who has regarded us with ahavah agape, and has granted us nechamat olam eternal consolation and tikvah tovah good hope by the unmerited chesed of hashem, may he give chozek strength and encouragement to you in every mitzvah good deed you do and in every dibur utterance you speak.
target_text: ji'i manèngi-mangaj'i taruu mi ama lamatua èdhi, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ji'i manèngi sèna ka rèngu pa'èra d'ara miu, ho miu bisa tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. ji'i manèngi sèmi èèna, lula ji'i nge'a ama lamatua sue titu kèna mi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. lula d'ara na hua iia, nèti èèna ka nèngu loe boe pa'èra d'ara èdhi. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi bisa sanao-maena taruu mi nèngu.

source_text: lemaskana finally, achim b'moshiach, daven for us, that the dvar hashem will run on and be lifted up in kavod, just as it is also with you,
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! baku bhèlu sabaj'a hia ji'i. sabaj'a sèna ka lii lolo be'a lamatua, pale-palème asa mia-mia dènge malai, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa pakab'ua lii lolo be'a èèna, sèmi dhu lod'o miu abhu lii lolo be'a ca hari ni.

source_text: and that we may be delivered from anshei resha men of wickedness, for not all possess the messianic emunah.
target_text: sabaj'a sèna ka ji'i pakaj'èu nèti dhèu-dhèu dhu tao kaco, aa nèti dhèu bhelu leo sèra, te dhèu aa'i boe dhu parcaya lii lolo be'a èèna.

source_text: but ne'eman faithful is hashem who gives you chozek strength and is shomer over you, guarding you from the evil one.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua kèpe pa'ère lii padhai na. nèngu tao pa'èra miu, aa na bhiri miu nèti dhu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: and we have bitachon in hashem concerning you, that you are doing and will continue to do what we have directed.
target_text: aa ji'i nge'a tare'a kahèi, na, lamatua yesus hia miu madhutu ngaa dhu ji'i lole le dènge miu. ka tatu miu tao madhutu le sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: now may hashem direct your levavot in the ahavas hashem and into the savlanut of moshiach.
target_text: ji'i sanao ho lamatua yesus sanoro miu, sèna ka asa me'a, na, ama lamatua sue miu, ka miu èra ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, nuka sèmi kristus uru èèna taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra na.

source_text: now we charge you, achim b'moshiach, b'shem adoneinu rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua, to shun chavrusashaft association with every one of the achim b'moshiach who follows the derech habatlanim way of idlers and walks not according to moshiachʼs pnimiyus hatorah that was handed over and transmitted to you and which you received from us.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a peka mema miu dènge ale ngara lamatua yesus kristus! baku lami pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu bai-eed'a dhu re'a dhoka rodha di. te rèngu sèra madhutu boe èdhi dhu maj'èni sab'a bia.

source_text: for you yourselves have da'as how it is necessary to imitate us as a mofet, a role model, because we were not batlanim idlers among you.
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, na, miu hud'i laladhe ku j'ara mamuri ji'i, lod'o ji'i pea ètu talora aae miu. miu mèdhi unu mi. ji'i ngo'o boe core eele lod'o iia d'ara.

source_text: nor did we eat lechem food from anyone gratis, but in labor and exertion lailah v'yomam night and day we were working for the tachlis purpose of not weighing down and burdening any one of you;
target_text: ji'i sab'a bia mèu-mèda, sèna ka ji'i baku pabia miu. ji'i sèmi boe iia d'ara, nganga'a-nganginu nèti dhèu.

source_text: not because we do not have the zchus right, but in order that we impart ourselves as a mofet role model to you that you might imitate us.
target_text: ji'i se dhèu sab'a nèti lamatua. de ji'i dènge hak kahèi manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti miu. te ngaa ji'i ngo'o boe tao sèmi èèna. ji'i neo pad'elo j'ara dhu be'a sèna ka miu madhutu.

source_text: for even when we were with you, this we used to direct you: that if anyone will not be a po'el worker, neither let him be an ochel eater.
target_text: uru èèna, ji'i hia le kahèi atora dhu peka na, dhèu cee dhu ro'o boe sab'a, baku hia ra'a-rinu.

source_text: for we hear that some among you are leading the life of a batlan loafer, not being busy with a parnasah, but being busybodies with hitarevut meddlesomeness.
target_text: ji'i tadèngi lii, peka na, nèti talora aae miu abhu dhèu dhu bai-eed'a, ro'o boe sab'a. rèngu sèra re'a dhoka bhute dènge soro iisi ra asa d'ara lii langu dhèu leo.

source_text: now such persons we are directing and exhort in rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua adoneinu to work with quietness that they may eat their own lechem.
target_text: ji'i pasanèd'e dhèu sèmi sèra, dènge kolongara lamatua yesus kristus, sèna ka rèngu ele-ho'a. be'a risi rèngu sab'a tenge nganga'a-nganginu dènge èi kabhèsu unu ra.

source_text: but you, achim b'moshiach, do not lose chozek in well-doing.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu baku roca tao j'ara dhu be'a!

source_text: but if anyone does not obey the gzeira injunction in this iggeret hakodesh holy letter, take special notice of that one; do not have chavrusashaft association with him, for the tachlis purpose of stirring him with a sense of bushah shame.
target_text: miu patadhe paie-iie dhèu-dhèu dhu ro'o boe madhutu ngaa dhu ji'i suri ètu d'ara sasuri ne. hud'i rèngu sène, sèna ka ra'e makae.

source_text: and do not consider him an oyev enemy but warn him as an ach b'moshiach.
target_text: sad'i miu baku tao si nuka sèmi musu miu. te ngaa kai si dènge be'a, sèmi miu kai a'ari miu mesa mi.

source_text: now may elohei hashalom himself grant you shalom in every way. hashem be with you all.
target_text: lamatua èèna, dhèu aae mera-milu. ja'a manèngi ho na hia miu mera-milu ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. ja'a maena, sèna ka lamatua bera-bera dènge miu.

source_text: i, rav sha'ul, send drishat shalom greetings in my own handwriting, which is the distinctive siman sign in every iggeret hakodesh; this is the way i write.
target_text: ja'a pa'èle sasuri ne dènge kacui-aai ja'a unu ku, sèna ka miu me'a, na, sasuri ne tare'a-re'a nèti ja'a. lii limuri tèka, oe pa'èle sasuri leo aa'i-aa'i sèra, ja'a ka dhu suri kahèi.

source_text: the unmerited chen v'chesed hashem of rebbe, melech hamoshiach adoneinu yehoshua be with you all.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka d'ara hua iia lamatua yesus kristus rai eele boe nèti miu aa'i-aa'i mi. sasuri ne d'ai sange ne'e ka, paulus

source_text: from sha'ul, a shliach of rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua according to the authoritative command of the dvar hashem, that is, hashem moshieinu and rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua tikvateynu. to timotiyos, a trueborn ben baemunah son in the faith. chesed hashem, rachamim hashem, and shalom hashem from elohim avinu and rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua adoneinu.
target_text: timotius dhu be'a. lii maho'o nèti ja'a, paulus. ama lamatua ded'e le ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. aa lamatua yesus, era sanao-maena dhu hia èdhi mamuri taa-taa dènge nèngu, lula ama lamatua pakaj'èu èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo. timotius! èu ne, nuka sèmi ana matana ja'a, lula ja'a ka dhu pad'elo j'ara ka èu parcaya kristus. ja'a sabaj'a sèna ka ama lamatua èdhi, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia rèngu, aa hia èu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: even as i urged you to remain in ephesus while i was going into macedonia so that you might enjoin the gzeira authoritative command on certain persons not to teach heterodoxy,
target_text: uru èèna, dua ti ètu kota epesus. lod'o ja'a neo laku asa propensi makedonia, ja'a manèngi èu ho pea ètu epesus. te lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu dhu pab'ingu dhèu sarani sèra dènge aj'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka èu lamu kai si, ho ra loe eele ka.

source_text: nor to focus on aggadah and endless toldot genealogies which give rise to useless speculations in contrast to hashemʼs imun training in emunah.
target_text: aa dhèu sèra core eele lod'o iia d'ara kahèi lasi palolo nanuku, pab'ala lii dènge kapod'e-kabèli nèti bèi-baki toke lai ana lai èpu. j'ara sèmi sèra, dhoka hia dhèu patao-palaha, aa hia boe ra mamuri dènge parcaya mi ama lamatua.

source_text: but the tachlis purpose of the gzeira is ahavah love out of a lev tahor pure heart and a clear matzpun conscience and emunah faith without tzevi'ut hypocrisy.
target_text: ja'a holo èu, sèna ka èu aj'a dhèu parcaya sèra ho mamuri pasue èci dènge èci kahèi. sasue ra hud'i mai nèti d'ara dhu mèu, nèti ngangee dhu mola, aa nèti parcaya dhu koe-kapengo boe.

source_text: some people have missed the mark and deviated from these things to hevel vanity, to divrei havohu words of emptiness.
target_text: te ngaa abhu mese cahag'e dhu kako sala le j'ara, ra tèke eele lii holo-nori. hèia lasi core eele lod'o iia d'ara dènge padhue-padhai j'ara-j'ara dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua.

source_text: wanting to teach torah as rabbonim, they have binah neither of what they are talking about nor of the things about which they so confidently make assertions.
target_text: rèngu padedha iisi ra, peka na, rèngu mese dhu aj'a madhutu atora musa. ra tao iisi ra sèmi mese aae, te ngaa re'a boe ngaa dhu rèngu aj'a-nori èèna.

source_text: but we know that the torah is beneficial if anyoneʼs use of torah is torah-true.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti te'a, huku musa èèna be'a, sad'i èdhi pake ne madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: this means one must have da'as that the torah is not intended for the anshei tzedek men of righteousness but for the bnei belial and the poshei'im the ones transgressing, rebelling, those without yirat shomayim and the chote'im sinners, osei to'eva doers of abomination, profane people, killers of their own av va'em father and mother, and rotzeachim murderers,
target_text: atora sèra suri boe hia mi dhèu dhu mamuri mola le. te ngaa pala mi dhèu palab'a, dhu d'èi boe nanene paredha, dhu mamuri pakaj'èu nèti lamatua, dhu d'èi ad'u-ue bhelu-katub'a, dhu pusi-pahae boe lamatua, dhu pamud'e j'ara-j'ara dhu hua iia, dhu tuka pamadhe dhèu, dènge dhu pamadhe ina dènge ama ra.

source_text: zannayim fornicators, shochvim es zachar homosexuals, gonvei nefeshkidnapper, slave dealers, shakranim liars, nishba'im lasheker perjurers and whatever else is keneged against sound orthodox torah,
target_text: atora sèra suri kahèi hia dhèu kajeo dènge bhèni do dènge mone, aa mone dhu tao j'ara makae dènge mone, dhu rai rèti dhèu ho sui dènge doi-dhari, dhèu dhu kapod'e-kabèli, dhu j'aj'i sakasii omo koso, aa hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu d'èi palab'a lii aj'a dhu lèke.

source_text: according to the besuras hageulah kavod haelohim ham'vorach the good news of redemption of the glory of the blessed g-d with which i was entrusted.
target_text: a'aj'a dhu lèke sèra, mai nèti lii lolo be'a ama lamatua dhu na pangèd'u mi ja'a. aa lamatua èèna, ama lamatua dhu kapai risi eele. nèti èèna ka, dhèu ded'e ne padedha-dedha.

source_text: modeh ani i give thanks to the one having empowered me, rebbe melech hamoshiach yehoshua adoneinu, because he considered me ne'eman faithful, having appointed me to the rabbanut of moshiach.
target_text: ja'a manèngi makasi ae-ae mi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, lula na lèka ja'a, ka na hia ja'a bisa pakako sasab'a na.

source_text: previously being one guilty of chillul hashem gidduf blasphemy, redifah persecution, and religious terrorism, fort nevertheless, i received rachamim mercy, because i acted in ignorance in the absence of emunah. and the chen vachesed adoneinu super-abounded with emunah and ahavah in rebbe melech hamoshiach yehoshua.
target_text: masi ka uru èèna, ja'a d'èi padhai pa'ele iie kolongara yesus, aa paj'èra dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri na. ja'a d'èi ènyi raruri si. bhabhelu ja'a sèmi èèna, lula uru èèna, ja'a ke'a boe ngaa dhu ja'a tao, aa parcaya mèka yesus kristus. te ngaa ama lamatua core eele boe ja'a. ka na pad'elo sasue na mi ja'a. mia hari kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, loe boe pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a! nèngu hia mèngi-nale dhu ae hia ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa parcaya ne, aa ja'a bisa sue dhèu leo kahèi nuka sèmi nèngu sue ja'a.

source_text: trustworthy is the dvar emes and worthy of all mekabel acceptance, that rebbe, melech, hamoshiach yehoshua came into the olam hazeh to rescue chote'im, of whom i am the foremost.
target_text: èdhi biasa tadèngi le, peka na, yesus kristus mai le asa rai-haha, ho pala-bagi mamuri mi dhèu dhu ad'u-ue sasala. mema tare'a sèmi èèna! nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra dhu ad'u-ue sasala, ja'a ka dhu bhelu risi eele.

source_text: but because of this, i received rachamim that in me, the foremost, rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua might display all savlanut longsuffering, patience, making me a mofet model to the ones about to have bitachon trust and emunah in moshiach, resulting in chayyei olam.
target_text: masi ka ja'a bhelu sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua huku boe ja'a. te nare ja'a j'aj'i mi tadha sena ka pad'elo sasue yesus kristus mi dhèu dhu bhelu risi eele, nuka sèmi ja'a ne'e ne. dènge j'ara ne'e ka, dhèu leo dhu tao sala sèra bisa parcaya ne kahèi, ka ra abhu mamuri taa-taa dènge ne.

source_text: now to hamelech haolamim, the one who is ein sof without end, whom no eye has seen, adonoi echad, lo hakavod v'hatiferet mayhaolam v'ad haolam to him be honor and glory from forever to forever. omein.
target_text: koa-kio kolongara lamatua! lula dhoka nèngu di, ama lamatua; dhu leo aad'o! nèngu ne, dhèu aae dhu paredha taa-taa. mamuri na dènge boe too-lane. mamadhe aad'o ètu nèngu. dhèu bisa boe rèdhi ne dènge musi madha. pakab'ua dènge koa-kio aa'i-aa'i hia mi nèngu di! tare'a-re'a sèmi èèna.

source_text: this gzeira i commit to you, beni timotiyos, according to hanevu'otthe prophecies made previously about you, that by them you might war the good warfare,
target_text: ana timotius dhu be'a! ja'a neo peka dènge èu ngaa dhu hud'i èu tao ku ètu d'ara sasab'a-la'a èu. aa'i-aa'i se, madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua peka tèke le lula-nèti èu ne. ladhe èu madhutu lii se'e dènge mola-mola, èu sèmi ca dhèu sordad'u dhu bisa pamusu dènge be'a, ho lab'a bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: holding emunah and a clear matzpun conscience, which some persons, because they pushed aside a clear matzpun, have suffered shipwreck in the emunah.
target_text: kèpe pa'èra-èra lalèka èu mi yesus kristus. aa j'aga paie, sèna ka d'ara èu mola taruu. te abhu kahèi dhèu leo dhu ro'o heka nanene d'ara iiki ra, dhu pa'ele iie parcaya rèngu, nuka sèmi kapa rage nare hadhu aae.

source_text: among these are hymenaeus and alexander, whom i handed over to hasatan, that they might be taught not to commit chillul hashem gidduf.
target_text: himeneus dènge aleksander si, ra sèmi èèna ka! nèti èèna ka, ja'a soro le rèngu asa dhèu aae nidhu. ja'a tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka aj'a si loe eele pakarehe kolongara lamatua,

source_text: i urge, therefore, of first importance, davening, techinnah supplication, tefillah prayer, bakkashot petitions, and hodayah thanksgiving be made on behalf of kol bnei adam all mankind,
target_text: dhu uru tèka miu tao: ja'a manèngi miu sabaj'a hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i. ladhe miu mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, manèngi sèna ka na ladhe-leru dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara j'aj'èra. aa manèngi makasi, lula na tao le babe'a mi rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: on behalf of malchei eretz kings and on behalf of all the ones in authority, that we may lead a life of chayyei menuchah life of rest in all chasidus piety and yirat shomayim reverence.
target_text: sabaj'a sèmi èèna kahèi hia dhèu aae-dhèu aae, dènge dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha. dènge j'ara ne'e èdhi bisa mamuri mera-milu, dènge dame, madhutu dad'èi lamatua, mamuri pamèci dènge dhèu dhu pahaha iisi mi lamatua.

source_text: this is good and acceptable before hashem moshieinu,
target_text: manèngi-mangaj'i sèmi èèna ka dhu be'a. j'ara ne'e ne ka pakarej'e d'ara lamatua, dhu hia èdhi mamuri.

source_text: who wants kol bnei adam to have yeshu'at eloheynu the salvation of our g-d and to come to da'as haemes knowledge of the truth.
target_text: dad'èi lamatua ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra abhu mamuri, aa re'a mia ka dhu lèke. nuka sèmi:

source_text: for adonoi echad hu there is one g-d and there is also metavekh echadone melitz, one between hashem and kol bnei adam, the man rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua,
target_text: ama lamatua èèna, dhoka èci di. aa kalete dhoka èci di dhu padame èdhi dhèu rai-haha dènge ama lamatua, nuka, yesus kristus. aa yesus tare'a-re'a dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: the one who gave his nefesh as a kofer ransom, on behalf of all. the edut testimony of this was given at the right time.
target_text: na soro iisi na, ho sui èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti nèti sasala-sasigo èdhi. lèke dènge lod'o na, ka ama lamatua bhoke le pasaraa lii lolo be'a èèna hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and for this edut i was given the s'michah ordination of hashem as a karoz herald, a maggid, a shliach moshiachʼs emissary - i speak emes, i do not speak sheker - and a rabbinic moreh teacher for the nations in emunah and emes.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua hag'e nare ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na, sèna ka laku peka-padhai dènge dhèu yahudi boe ètu mia-mia, aa nori si sèna ka ra parcaya lamatua yesus, dènge mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke. ngaa dhu ja'a peka ne, tare'a-re'a sèmi èèna. ja'a leko-monya boe.

source_text: i want, therefore, kol bnei adam to daven in every shul, lifting up yadayim kodesh holy hands without ka'as anger and madon strife.
target_text: dad'èi ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe ètu mia-mia miu pakaboko ho manèngi-mangaj'i, hud'i dènge ku d'ara dhu mola-mèci. baku panasa. baku patao-palaha. ladhe sabaj'a, bisa ded'e kacui-aai asa ama lamatua, ho j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, d'ara miu mola-mèci tare'a-re'a.

source_text: similarly also nashim women should adorn themselves with respectable comportment and tznius modesty, piety in appearance and with decency and propriety, not with coiffures and gold or pearls or costly clothing, but with what is proper for nashim professing yirat shomayim, that is, by means of ma'asim tovim good works.
target_text: dad'èi ja'a kahèi ladhe dhèu-dhèu bhèni re'a lalau iisi ra pake mèdha-papake dhu pantas. dhu tao bhèni j'aj'i bhèni iia, lula boe nèti pasaraga rèu kètu, do pake mèdha-papake dhu kab'ua aae dhu nèti makae, do pake risi eele mèdha hualaa, doi pudhi dènge mutiara. te dhu tao bhèni sèra j'aj'i bhèni iia, nuka d'ara dhu hua iia, aa rèngu tao dhoka j'ara dhu be'a. èèna ka pamèci dènge dhèu bhèni dhu pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: let the isha wife learn in silence in all submission.
target_text: ladhe dhèu sarani pakaboko ho nanene lii holo-nori, na, bhèni sa kahèi madhutu atora, sèna ka pasa dhilu ra be'a-be'a ho nanene lii holo-nori dènge d'ara kateme. baku pagagai sèna ka tao maruru.

source_text: i do not allow an isha wife either to have teaching authority over or to have hishtaltut domination, taking control over her man, but to be in silence.
target_text: madhutu ngangee ja'a, lèke boe ladhe dhèu bhèni ded'e ngi'u ra ho paredha aa aj'a dhèu mone. be'a risi bhèni sèra taha d'ara.

source_text: for adam was formed rishonah first, then chavah.
target_text: te ama lamatua paj'aj'i uuru adam, heka hawa kèna.

source_text: and adam was not deceived, but the isha, having been deceived, has come to be in averah transgression.
target_text: aa adam dhu uru boe lèke ag'o nèti dhèu aae nidhu, te ngaa dhèu bhèni. karèi nèti lod'o èèna, dhèu rai-haha mulai lab'a paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: but womankind will be saved through her childbearing if nashim remain in emunah and ahavah and kedushah with tznius.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa dhèu bhèni abhu mamuri lula rèngu rara iisi ana. sad'i rèngu parcaya tare'a-re'a mi kristus, mamuri pasue, mamuri dènge d'ara mola-mèci, aa mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: trustworthy is the dvar emes: if anyone aspires to the congregational office of mashgiach ruchani spiritual overseer over the adat hashemcongregation of g-d, he desires a good task.
target_text: mema tare'a sèmi lii dhèu, dhu peka na, dhèu dhu neo j'aj'i kètu juma'at, nèngu hag'e nare le sasab'a èci dhu hua iia titu kèna.

source_text: it is necessary, therefore, for the congregational mashgiach ruchani to be without reproach, ba'al isha echat a one woman man/master, drug-free and clear-headed, a man of seichel, practiced in derech eretz and hachnosas orchim hospitality, skillful as a rabbinic moreh yeshiva teacher,
target_text: kètu juma'at èèna, hud'i dhèu dhu kolongara be'a. nèngu hud'i satia dènge dhèu èmu na ca dhèu di. nèngu hud'i taha nare d'ara na, dhèu dhu patao-palaha boe, dhu dhèu pakab'ua ne, dhu d'èi bhoke babèdho èmu ho dhèu lasi pangad'o dènge ne, aa bisa aj'a-nori dhèu leo.

source_text: not a shikkor drunkard indulging in much wine, not violent but forbearing and eidel gentle, courteous, not a ba'al machlokes quarrelsome person, not a gelt-loving kamtzan miser.
target_text: baku dhèu dhu tema mahu, baku dhèu dhu nasa dènge kacui-aai malai. dhu lèke ka, dhèu dhu d'ara hua iia, dhu d'èi tenge dame, aa dhu manga'a boe doi-dhari.

source_text: he must be a ba'al bayit who can manage his own household well, having his banim children in submission with all respect.
target_text: nèngu hud'i ne'a uri d'ara èmu na dènge be'a. ana-ana na re'a pakab'ua dènge d'èi nanene ne.

source_text: now if anyone does not have da'as of how to manage his own bais, how will he be a menahel ruchani spiritual administrator who can give oversight to the kehillah of hashem?
target_text: te ladhe dhèu èèna ne'a boe lalau-lalo'o d'ara èmu na, na, tasa mera mia nèngu bisa ladhe-leru juma'at lamatua.

source_text: he must not be a neophyte in the emunah of moshiach, lest, having become a ba'al gaavah a haughty person, he might fall into the din hasatan the judgment or verdict of the adversary, the accuser.
target_text: be'a risi, pili dhèu dhu mamuri palèke dènge dad'èi kristus. de baku ded'e kètu juma'at nèti dhèu dhu parcaya nèbhu mèka mi yesus. te èèna na, rèngu sèra bisa padedha iisi malai. mage dhoka lamatua huku si, sama sèmi lamatua huku dhèu aae nidhu.

source_text: now it is necessary also for him to have a keter shem tov good name with the outsiders, lest he might fall into reproach and a pakh pitfall, trap of hasatan.
target_text: dhèu dhu j'aj'i kètu juma'at sèra hud'i dhèu dhu rai lesa re'a pakab'ua ne kahèi. dènge sèmi èèna nèngu makae boe. aa dhèu aae nidhu bisa boe pabèbhe ne kahèi.

source_text: messianic shammashim similarly must be respectable men of derech eretz, not double-tongued, the shammash not a shikkor drunkard indulging in much wine, not a lover of dishonest gain,
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu soru-bara kètu juma'at. rèngu sèra hud'i dhèu dhu dènge kolongara be'a, dhèu dhu he'o kajari boe, dhu tema boe rinu mahu, aa dhu d'èi boe ra'e a'oto ae-ae.

source_text: keeping the sod haemunah the mystery of the faith with a clear matzpunconscience.
target_text: d'ara rèngu hud'i mola-mèci, aa rèngu hud'i kèpe pa'èra ku lii holo-nori dhu lamatua bhoke pasaraa hia èdhi, dhèu parcaya se'e.

source_text: and let these messianic shammashim also be tested before holding office and then, if they prove unreprovable, let them have the avodas hakodesh sherut ministry of messianic shammashim.
target_text: ladhe paie-iie mamuri dènge sasab'a ra. ladhe abhu boe sasala si, heka ded'e si ho soru-bara kètu juma'at sèra.

source_text: nashimwomen serving as shammashim similarly must be tzidkaniyot righteous women, respectable, not yentas with mouths of lashon hora and rekhilus gossip, but nashim who are temperate and faithful in all things.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu èmu ra. rèngu sèra hud'i bhèni dhu mamuri madhutu madha j'ara dènge tatao dhu be'a. mage dhèu dhu tema padhai-kakoli pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu leo. rèngu hud'i dhèu dhu re'a taha rare d'ara, aa dhèu lèka si kahèi.

source_text: let the shammashim be ba'alei isha achat one wife husbands, managing well their banim and their own batim households.
target_text: aa dhu soru-bara kètu juma'at sèra hud'i mone dhu satia dènge dhèu èmu na ca dhèu di. nèngu èèna hud'i ne'a uri d'ara èmu na, aa uri ana-ana na dènge be'a.

source_text: for the ones having served well in the avodas hakodesh of messianic shammashim acquire for themselves a good standing and much bitachon in emunah in rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua.
target_text: rèngu dhu lalau-lalo'o dhèu sarani dènge be'a, tatu dhèu asa pakab'ua si. aa rèngu asa bani, dènge boe madha'u lole parcaya rèngu mi yesus kristus.

source_text: i have the tikvah to come to you soon, but i am writing these directives so that, if i delay, you may have da'as of the halachah in the beis hashem, which is the adat hael chai the community of the living g-d, the ammud pillar and yesod foundation of haemes.
target_text: timotius! ja'a sanao sèna ka nèbhu boe ja'a dhiu ngad'o èu. ladhe ja'a pakai, do ako nena ciki, na, ele boe sasuri ne d'ai uuru èu. sasuri ne ja'a suri ho peka dènge èu, na, dhèu unu lamatua sèra hud'i ra mamuri tasa mera mia ku. baku bhèlu, peka na, lamatua èèna, ama lamatua dhu mamuri. dhèu unu na nuka sèmi èmu dhu dènge era padhèdi, aa dènge agarii talora dhu èra. èmu sèmi èèna ka dhu titu èra, sama sèmi dhèu unu lamatua dhu kèpe pa'èra lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu tare'a, aa rèngu bisa bara ho pakako dènge be'a.

source_text: and confessedly great is the sod of chasidus: elokim was manifested in basar, was vindicated by the ruach hakodesh, was seen by malachim, was proclaimed among the nations, was believed on in the world, was taken up in kavod.
target_text: lamatua pasabhoka le rahasia dhu kapai nèti lalèka èdhi. kapua na sèmi ne'e ka: kristus èèna, ca dhèu dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le karèi nèti uru ka. aa kristus èèna mai le asa rai-haha ne, pake rupa dhèu rai-haha sèmi èdhi. roh lamatua ka dhu j'aj'i sakasii, peka na, yesus èèna, nuka kristus. aa ana pajuu lamatua ètu sorga sèra rèdhi na kahèi. ama lamatua dhu ded'e nèti le asa sorga, ka nedhe padedha-dedha ne. lii lolo na pale-lème le suku-suku ètu rai-haha ne. ètu mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne, dhèu aa'i-aa'i parcaya le nèngu. kapua lalèka èdhi sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: now the ruach hakodesh says befeirush explicitly that in the acharit hayamim some will become meshummad apostate from the emunah, giving heed to deceitful ruchotspirits and teachings of shedim,
target_text: te ngaa ne'e ne, roh ama lamatua dhu peka paled'a le, na, bèli-camèd'a dhèu sarani cahag'e patalale eele ngaa dhu èdhi parcaya. ho lasi madhutu roh-roh dhu sala aa dhu leko-monya, aa lasi madhutu lii holo-nori nidhu bhelu sèra.

source_text: through the tzevi'ut hypocrisy of ones speaking sheker, the matzpun of whom is seared as with a branding iron.
target_text: dhèu dhu mai nori sèmi sèra, padhai lii leo, tao leo. dhèu sèra mema dhèu dhu kapod'e-kabèli! dhèu sèra sa, d'ara iiki ra dhu bèdhu le.

source_text: such will forbid nisu'im marriage, commanding an issur prohibition against that ma'akhal which hashem created for partaking with hodayah by the ma'aminim in moshiach and by the ones who have da'as of haemes,
target_text: ra aj'a dhèu, baku paleo èmu. aa ra aj'a dhèu luri rupa-rupa nganga'a. te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu tao nganga'a-nganginu sèra, ho ladhe dhèu parcaya ra'a, rèngu manèngi makasi mi nèngu. te rèngu re'a mia dhu lèke.

source_text: because the whole bri'ah creation that hashem has created is tov and nothing is to be rejected that is received with hodayah.
target_text: ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua tao sèra, tare'a-re'a be'a. de baku luri rupa-rupa. dhèu hud'i sèmi rare aa'i-aa'i sèra dènge manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: for it is being set apart as kodesh through the dvar hashem and tefillos and brachot.
target_text: te èdhi te'a, na, lii holo-nori ama lamatua dènge lii manèngi-mangaj'i èdhi sèra ka pamèu si.

source_text: by presenting these things to the achim you will be a good k'li kodesh minister of rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua, you will be one nourished with the divrei haemunah and the torah yeshara good, straight orthodox jewish teaching which you have followed.
target_text: timotius! pasanèd'e j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i mi a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya sèra. ladhe èu tao madhutu sèmi èèna, èu j'aj'i dhèu sab'a dhu be'a nèti yesus kristus. lii holo-nori ama lamatua sèra ka dhu tao èu parcaya ne, aa hia me'a mèu, mia ka lii holo-nori dhu lèke. èu kèpe pa'èra-èra le lii holo-nori lamatua sèra! sèra nuka sèmi nganga'a dhu pa'èra ngi'u èu.

source_text: but the worldly aggadot and bubbemeises old wives tales, refuse. rather, train yourself for chasidus.
target_text: baku core eele lod'o iia d'ara dènge palolo omo koso dhu lèke boe dènge dad'èi ama lamatua. baku pusi-pahae dènge lii lolo bhèni heka dhu nèti laluri rupa-rupa. be'a risi pa'èra taruu ngi'u dènge d'ara èu pabe'a-be'a, sèna ka mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: for hitammelut bodily exercise or training is kedai profitable a bissle, but chasidus is profitable in every way, holding havtachah promise of chayyim now in the olam hazeh, and, later, of olam habah.
target_text: olaraga pa'èra ngi'u na, be'a. masi ka babe'a na ciki oo'e di. te ngaa pa'èra ngi'u dènge d'ara ho mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua ètu j'ara aa'i-aa'i sèra, babe'a na ae seli eele. babe'a na mesa boe mamuri ètu rai-haha deo ne'e di, te ngaa mamuri lèpa limuri kahèi.

source_text: this dvar torah is trustworthy and worthy of all acceptance.
target_text: lii se'e se, lèke tare'a-re'a! de tèke paie mi d'ara, ho baku bhèlu eele.

source_text: for to this end we labor and strive at the melachah task, because we have set tikvateynu in the el chai who is moshi'a savior of kol bnei adam, that is, the ma'aminim.
target_text: èdhi tao era maena mi ama lamatua dhu mamuri. nèngu na ka dhu hia mamuri mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i, risi-risi mi èdhi dhu parcaya na. nèti èèna ka, èdhi sab'a dènge d'ara kateme.

source_text: on these things insist and say shiurim.
target_text: nori lii se'e aa'i-aa'i. aa pua dhèu sèra ho madhutu lii holo-nori sèra.

source_text: let no one regard with contempt your tza'irut youth, but become a mofet example for the ma'aminim in loshon speech, in hitnahagut conduct, in ahavah, in emunah, and in lev tahor.
target_text: baku soro tèka dhèu sèra pahae boe èu, lula èu ana ngèru era. èu hud'i j'aj'i conto hia dhèu parcaya sèra, nèti lii padhai èu, nèti kakako èu, nèti d'ara sasue èu mi dedha dhèu, nèti parcaya èu mi yesus kristus, dènge mamuri èu dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: until i come, attend to the kri'ah betzibbur congregational public reading of the kitvei hakodesh, attend to the messianic hatafah preaching and to the messianic hora'ah instruction, teaching.
target_text: ètu d'ara miu tatae mamai ja'a, baku bhèlu baca lii holo-nori lamatua hia mi dhèu parcaya sèra. pa'èra d'ara si, aa nori si paie-iie.

source_text: do not neglect the matanah gift in you which was given to you by means of dvar hanevu'ah prophecy with the s'michah administered by the ziknei hakehillah.
target_text: pake pabe'a-be'a karunya dhu lamatua pangèd'u le mi èu, dhu èu sèmi lod'o kètu-kètu juma'at sabaj'a dènge tao kacui-aai mi dedha kètu èu. lod'o èèna, rèngu peka lii moa lamatua kahèi lula-nèti j'ara mamuri dènge sab'a-la'a èu. de baku soro tèke karunya dhu èu abhu èèna.

source_text: put these things into practice, that your progress in shomer masoret religious devotion may be manifest to all.
target_text: pakako dènge maj'èni j'ara sèra. sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra ladhe rèdhi mamuri dènge sab'a-la'a èu asa be'a.

source_text: be shomer both toward yourself and toward your messianic hora'ah instruction, and be arain getun engrossed, torud completely absorbed and involved in them. for by so doing this, you will come to yeshu'at eloheynu, and this means not only you yourself but also those who hear your hatafah.
target_text: j'aga sèna ka èu mamuri dènge mola. aa j'aga sèna ka èu loe boe aj'a dhu lèke j'ara. ladhe èu pa'èra dènge j'ara sèra, pe lamatua bhoke j'ara hia èu, dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu nanene lii padhai èu, sèna ka miu pakaj'èu nèti bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: to a zaken do not speak harsh rebuke. rather entreat him as an abba. treat the bochrim as achim brothers.
target_text: baku tao lii sakaa dènge dhèu mone dhu heka risi nèti èu. te ngaa dènge lii mako, nuka sèmi èu padhai lii dènge ama mu. aa mi dhèu dhu ngèru risi, pa'èra d'ara si, tao nuka sèmi ari mu.

source_text: elderly nashim treat as imahot mothers; younger nashim as achayot sisters in all hatohar moral purity.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi mi dhèu bhèni dhu heka risi sèra. padhai lii dènge rèngu, nuka sèmi èu padhai lii dènge ina mu. aa ladhe padhai lii dènge ana bhèni ngèru, tao si nuka sèmi ana hèni èu. d'ara èu hud'i mola dènge si.

source_text: honor with support almanot widows that are really almanot. but if any almanah has banim or bnei banim, let the banim or bnei banim learn first to show yirat shomayim vis-a-vis their own bais and to render recompense to the horim parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of hashem. now the true almanah, left alone, has set her tikvah on hashem and continues in her techinnah and her tefillos yomam valailah.
target_text: dhèu sarani hud'i soru-bara bhèni balu dhu dènge heka a'ari sèna ka ladhe-leru si. te ngaa bhèni balu dhu ana-èpu era, na, rèngu ka dhu hud'i ladhe-leru ne. aj'a si, sèna ka re'a b'ala sasue ina ra dhu rèngu abhu sèra. dènge sèmi èèna ka, rèngu sab'a hia ama lamatua, ho pakarej'e d'ara na. te ngaa bhèni balu dhu tare'a-re'a mamuri mesa di, nèngu dènge boe ca dhèu sa dhu ladhe-leru ne. nèngu dhoka maena mi ama lamatua di. mèu-mèda na manèngi sasue ama lamatua. dhèu sarani hud'i ladhe-leru ku bhèni balu sèmi sèra sa.

source_text: but the one living in ahavat ta'anugot hedonism has died while living.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni balu dhu d'èi dhoka mamuri na karej'e-karae di, masi ka na mamuri era, te ngaa dènge heka kab'ua, sama sèmi dhèu dhu madhe le.

source_text: and insist on these things, that the almanot be irreproachable.
target_text: pasanèd'e j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i mi dhèu sarani sèra, sèna ka dhèu leo baku pa'ele iie kolongara rèngu.

source_text: but if anyone does not get a parnasah to provide for his own mishpochah and especially his own bais, he has denied the emunah and is worse than an apikoros skeptic, unbeliever.
target_text: aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu ro'o boe ladhe-leru a'ari na, risi-risi hari isi èmu na, èèna sama sèmi nèngu pèci eele lalèka nèngu mi lamatua. nèngu bhelu risi nèti dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua.

source_text: let an almanah be enrolled on the list if she is not less than sixty years old, nesu'ah l'ish echad a one man woman,
target_text: ladhe neo ded'e bhèni balu ho soru-bara kètu juma'at, j'ara na sèmi ne'e ka: umur nèngu bisa boe kura nèti 60 tèu; uru na nèngu satia dènge dhèu èmu na ca dhèu di;

source_text: being commended by ma'asim tovim, having brought up banim, having showed hachnosas orchim, having washed the feet of the kedoshim, having given nechamah comfort to the oppressed, having devoted herself to every ma'aseh tov.
target_text: dhèu re'a, na, nèngu ca dhèu dhu tema tao babe'a mi dhèu; dhu ladhe-leru ana-ana na dènge be'a; dhu bhoke tèke kacui-aai ho leru dhèu leo; dhu soru-bara dhèu parcaya sèra ètu d'ara sasab'a, masi ka dhu samaa èèna ka; dhu d'èi soru dhèu ètu d'ara sasusa; aa dhu bhori mema ho soru-bara ètu madha j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: but younger almanot refuse, for, when they have ta'avah lust, in disregard of moshiach they want nissu'in marriage,
target_text: baku pili bhèni balu dhu ngèru era, ho sab'a ètu d'ara juma'at. te mage dhoka cèu ètu d'ara na, ho neo hari leo-èmu. ladhe sèmi èèna, rèngu se abhu heka lod'o dhu taleo, ho lalau dhèu sarani dènge be'a.

source_text: having harsha'ah condemnation, conviction, because their first havtachah promise, pledge to ministry they annulled.
target_text: te ladhe lod'o dhu rèngu pake hia juma'at èèna kura, èci èèna ka dènge rèngu pa'ele iie lii pajaji rèngu ètu katanga madha lamatua. èèna na, dhèu pasala si.

source_text: and at the same time also they learn atzlut, going around house to house, and not only idle but also platke machers gossipy intriguers and busybodies, speaking things they ought not.
target_text: mage dhoka rèngu bai-eed'a, aa maso-kalua èmu dhèu, padhai-kaked'u pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu. aa dhu karehe risi eele hari, rèngu soro iisi asa d'ara lii langu dhèu leo, dènge padhai dhu lèke boe.

source_text: therefore, i counsel younger almanot to proceed with nissu'in marriage, to bear banim, to manage the bais, giving no occasion to the mitnagged opponent, antagonist to reproach us.
target_text: be'a risi eele, bhèni balu dhu ngèru era leo hari èmu, sèna ka rara iisi, aa ladhe-leru d'ara èmu rèngu. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu dhu pamusu dènge èdhi abhu boe j'ara ho pa'ele iie kolongara èdhi.

source_text: for already some almanot have turned aside to follow hasatan.
target_text: abhu bhèni balu ngèru cahag'e dhu kako sala j'ara. rèngu se madhutu j'ara dhèu aae nidhu.

source_text: if any ma'aminah believing woman has in her mishpochah family almanot, let her assist her almanot and let not moshiachʼs kehillah be burdened, that indeed moshiachʼs kehillah may assist the ones who are true almanot.
target_text: ladhe abhu bhèni dhu parcaya lamatua, dhu a'ari ra j'aj'i le bhèni balu, na, bhèni ne hud'i ladhe-leru ku bhèni balu èèna. baku soro tèke hia juma'at ladhe-leru. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna juma'at bisa ladhe-leru bhèni balu dhu leo, dhu tare'a-re'a dènge heka a'ari.

source_text: let the zekenimelders who have ruled well be considered worthy of double kavod, especially the zekenim laboring in messianic hatafah preaching and messianic hora'ah teaching.
target_text: dhèu dhu ladhe-leru juma'at dènge be'a, miu hud'i pakab'ua risi ne, aa b'ae gaji dènge be'a. risi-risi rèngu dhu sab'a dènge d'ara kateme, ho lole pataraa lii holo-nori lamatua, aa aj'a j'ara mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: for the kitvei hakodesh says, lo tachsom shor bedisho you shall not muzzle the ox while he is treading out the grain, and worthy is the workman of his wages.
target_text: te dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na, ladhe pake sapi j'èli puru are nèti huri, mage mi kape hèb'a na kahèi, sèna ka bisa na'a. aa dhu suri kahèi, peka na, cee ka dhu sab'a, na, nèngu hud'i abhu gaji ku.

source_text: do not receive an accusation against a zaken elder, unless on the pi shni edim o al pi shlosha edim testimony of two or three witnesses.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu galaa kètu juma'at, baku sad'i sèmi mere di! hud'i abhu ku dua do tèlu sakasii dhu lii èci, heka mi sèmi mere ho parisa ne.

source_text: the zekenim that are sinning, expose before all, that the rest also may have yirat shomayim.
target_text: ladhe miu kai ne, te ngaa na mamuri taruu madhutu d'ara sasala èèna, kai hari ne ètu madha juma'at. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, dhèu leo bani boe madhutu tatao èèna.

source_text: i charge you before hashem and moshiach yehoshua and the malachim habechirim chosen angels that these directives you keep without discrimination, doing nothing on the mekor basis of masoh panim partiality.
target_text: pakako aa'i atora se'e mi juma'at dhu hag'e boe, aa baku bia cabèka. ja'a pangèd'u sasab'a ne'e mi d'ara kacui-aai èu, ètu katanga madha ama lamatua dènge yesus kristus. ana pajuu dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare ètu sorga, j'aj'i sakasii kahèi!

source_text: give s'michah quickly to no one nor participate in the chatta'im sins of others; keep yourself tahor.
target_text: baku pamèri ded'e dhèu j'aj'i kètu juma'at. ladhe uuru ku paie-iie ne. te ladhe miu ded'e sad'i ngara di, hèia dhèu ne tao sala, na, miu pasae sasala èèna kahèi, lula tatao na. j'aga paie ngi'u èu sèna ka mamuri mola taruu.

source_text: no longer drink only mayim, but use a little yayin because of your stomach and your frequent illnesses.
target_text: ja'a tadèngi èu kabake pèd'a taruu. be'a risi nèti deo ne'e, èu pab'ali èi dènge anggor ciki tao sèmi èi na'i. baku minu dhoka èi iia di.

source_text: with some, their chatta'im are obvious, going before them to mishpat, but with others, some chatta'im indeed follow after them.
target_text: ladhe paie-iie! abhu sasala dhèu dhu cèu mema. rèngu d'ai mèka madha hakim, te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu re'a le èèna. te ngaa abhu dhèu leo kahèi dhu nèbhu-nèbhu ku, heka sasala ra cèu kèna.

source_text: likewise, also ma'asim tovim are borur obvious, but even when they are not, they cannot be hidden.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu tao be'a sèra. abhu mema dhu led'a. te ngaa cahag'e pahuni-pahuni tao dhu be'a. te ngaa masi ka sèmi èèna, ngaa dhu rèngu tao sèra, nèbhu-nèbhu cèu asa li'u kahèi. bisa boe pahuni tatao dhu be'a.

source_text: as many avadim as are under the ol yoke of slavery let them consider their own adonim as worthy of all kavod, lest the name of hashem and torateynu our teaching suffer chillul hashem gidduf.
target_text: abhu lamatua dhu ènu na parcaya lamatua yesus. rèngu hud'i pakab'ua lamatua ra, sèna ka dhèu leo abhu boe j'ara ho padhai lii pamanahu kolongara ama lamatua, aa pamud'e dènge lii aj'a-nori èdhi.

source_text: and let the ma'aminim that have adonim not disrespect their masters because their adonim are achim, but let them all the more render service to them because the ones receiving benefit from their sherut hatov are ma'aminim in moshiach and ahuvim. say shiurim on these things and exhort them.
target_text: abhu ènu dhu lamatua na parcaya le lamatua yesus. ènu ne bisa boe pahaha lamatua na, lula lamatua na dhu parcaya lamatua yesus. masi ka tasamia èèna ka, rèngu hud'i lalau ku pabe'a risi hari lamatua ra, lula rèngu dènge rèngu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, dhèu parcaya dhu hud'i mamuri pasue ku. timotius! aj'a aa'i-aa'i se, aa pa'èra d'ara dhèu sarani sèra, sèna ka tao madhutu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: if anyone teaches heterodoxy a doctrine that has a chiluk or difference and does not agree with the orthodox jewish teaching of yehoshua the moshiach adoneinu and with torah conforming to chasidus,
target_text: lii aj'a-nori èdhi dhu lèke èèna, j'aj'i kapua nèti d'ara mamuri èdhi dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu nori leo nèti lii aj'a se'e, dhèu sèra dhu core eele le lii lamatua yesus kristus dhu lèke.

source_text: he has succombed to gaa'vah conceit, having binah of nothing, but having a morbid craving for controversies and disputes over devarim out of which comes kinah envy, madon strife, lashon hora evil speaking, chashadot merusha'im evil suspicions,
target_text: dhèu sèmi èèna, padedha iisi, te ngaa goa. papèd'a rèngu ka d'èi dhoka tenge lii langu, aa pab'ala d'ara lii. j'ara se'e se ka dhu tao dhèu ho: tèka d'ara, patao-palaha, pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu leo, aa pangee dhu lèke boe mi dhèu leo.

source_text: and constant friction between men corrupted in their minds and having become bereft of haemes, thinking chasidus to be a means of financial revach.
target_text: dhèu sèmi se'e, loe boe patao-palaha. ngangee ra karehe bia. re'a heka mia ka dhu be'a. rèngu ngee, ladhe rèngu maj'èni dènge j'ara-j'ara agama, rèngu bisa j'aj'i dhèu kaja-su'i.

source_text: but chasidus with tzufriedenkait contentment is great revach gain, profit.
target_text: mema, agama bisa hia a'oto mi dhèu. te mamuri dènge lamatua èèna ka dhu hia dhèu karej'e nèti ngaa dhu rèngu unu. èèna, heka agama dhu lèke kèna.

source_text: for we brought nothing into the olam hazeh, neither are we able to carry anything out of it,
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! lod'o rara iisi èdhi, èdhi tèti boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa asa rai-haha ne. aa ladhe lod'o madhe, tèti boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa kahèi nèti rai-haha ne.

source_text: but having okhel food and begadim clothes, with these we will be satisfied.
target_text: de sad'i dènge nganga'a, mèdha-papake sèra sa nia le!

source_text: but the ones desiring to be oishirim rich men fall into nisayon temptation and into a pakh trap and into many foolish and destructive ta'avot lusts which plunge men into cherem and avaddon destruction.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu neo kaja, mud'a titu kèna lèke dadugu-rariu rupa-rupa, aa lèke sasii g'ana-kariu, lula rèngu pangee dhoka mèdha-panyau di. j'ara se'e se ka dhu pa'ele iie mamuri rèngu.

source_text: for the ahavas hakesef love of money is the shoresh root of kol hara'ot all evils, which some, craving, were thereby led away from the emunah and pierced themselves with many machovim sorrows.
target_text: te sue doi-dhari, èèna j'aj'i mi amo nèti rupa-rupa bhabhelu. abhu dhèu cahag'e magèle dhoka doi-dhari di, toke ra pakaj'èu nèti parcaya ra dhu lèke. hèia rèngu mesa ra pa'ele iie mamuri ra.

source_text: but you, ish haelohim man of g-d, flee these things. pursue tzedek, chasidus, emunah, ahavah, savlanut, and anavah.
target_text: timotius! èu ne, dhèu unu ama lamatua. de pakaj'èu iisi nèti bhabhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i. mamuri mola-mèci. mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. parcaya taruu mi yesus kristus. sue dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra. pa'èra ètu d'ara j'aj'èra. mamuri d'ara be'a dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: fight the good fight of emunah; lay hold of the chayyei olam to which you were called when you made the hoda'ah yafah good confession before edim rabbim many witnesses.
target_text: sab'a pa'èra-èra dènge d'ara kateme, sèna ka pakako lii holo-nori aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi parcaya. lamatua paroa le èu, ho abhu mamuri taa-taa. de liku pa'èra-èra mamuri èèna, baku patalale eele. aa èu dhu peka le ètu madha dhèu ae, lula-nèti parcaya èu mi lamatua yesus.

source_text: i charge you before hashem, the one giving chayyim to all things, and before rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua, the one having testified the hoda'ah yafah good confession before pontius pilate, i charge you to be shomer over the mitzvoh spotlessly, irreproachably, until the appearing of moshiach adoneinu yehoshua,
target_text: de nèti deo ne'e, ja'a manèngi èu pa'èki lii pajaji sèmi ne'e: tao madhutu lii paredha aa'i-aa'i nèti lamatua yesus. baku sisu èci sa hèi, sèna ka dhèu baku rèdhi sasala èu. tao madhutu aa'i-aa'i ra dènge mola-mola toke lod'o mamai hari kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ja'a manèngi èu jaji sèmi èèna ètu madha ama lamatua. nèngu ka dhu hia le samanga mi dhu mamuri aa'i-aa'i ra. ja'a manèngi kahèi èu jaji sèmi èèna ètu madha yesus kristus. nèngu dhu peka paled'a le, lula-nèti ngi'u nèngu, ètu madha gubernur pontius pilatus.

source_text: which he will make manifest at the right time - hamvorach, haribbon hayachid, melech hamelachim and adon haadonim.
target_text: lamatua yesus dhu kapai risi, nèngu ka dhu nèd'u koasa! nèngu èèna, dhèu aae kapai nèti dhèu aae aa'i-aa'i ra. aa nèngu èèna, lamatua kapai nèti lamatua aa'i-aa'i ra. ropa d'ai lod'o na, lamatua paled'a aa'i-aa'i si.

source_text: to the one who is alone haalmavet immortal, dwelling in ohr unapproachable, whom no man among bnei adam saw, neither is able to see, lo hakavod v'hagevurah l'olam va'ed. omein.
target_text: dhoka nèngu mesa na di, dhu madhe boe. nèngu mamuri ètu d'ara saraa dhu dhèu rai-haha taha boe laladhe. abhu boe dhèu èci sa ladhe rèdhi ne. lii-lii pakab'ua dhodhoka mi nèngu di! koasa aa'i-aa'i, ètu kacui-aai na, toke d'ai mia-mia! d'ai sange ne'e ka! tare'a!

source_text: charge the oishirim in the olam hazeh not to walk in gaa'vah pride and high-mindedness, neither to put their tikvah hope in the uncertainty of their osher but in hashem who richly grants us all things for enjoyment.
target_text: peka mi dhèu kaja ètu rai-haha ne, ho rèngu baku padedha iisi, aa baku dhoka maena mèdha-panyau rèngu di. te mèdha-panyau sèra, bèli-camèd'a èla aa'i. de dhu lèke ka, maena dhoka mi ama lamatua dhu mamuri di. te nèngu ka dhu pala-bagi èdhi ngaa-ngaa dhu èdhi parluu, sèna ka èdhi mamuri dènge karej'e.

source_text: charge the oishirim to do hatov, to be rich in ma'asim tovim, to demonstrate rochav lev generosity and willingness to do gemilus chesed,
target_text: peka dènge ra, ho pake kakaja sèra sèna ka tao dhu be'a. rèngu hud'i maj'èni tao dhu be'a. rèngu hud'i bhoke kacui-aai ho soru-bara dhèu leo, aa d'èi pala-bagi mèngi-nale dhu rèngu abhu nèti lamatua.

source_text: treasuring up for themselves a yesod tov good foundation for olam habah that they may lay hold of hachayyim haamittiyim.
target_text: hèia ra pakaboko mèdha-panyau ho j'aj'i mi kapua dhu èra, hia mamuri ra bèli-camèd'a. ka rèngu unu mamuri dhu dènge kab'ua.

source_text: o timotiyos, the pikkadon deposit entrusted to you be shomer over, turning away from the profane empty utterances and oppositions of the falsely named da'asknowledge,
target_text: timotius! j'aga paie aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua pangèd'u le mi èu. baku lamu padhai lii dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. baku padhai lii kaj'alu dhu pakab'ua boe ama lamatua. sanèd'e, ee! te abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, rèngu dhèu d'èlu-mèu. te ngaa ‘mamèu' rèngu sèra dhu hèb'a hua. baku lamu pab'ala lii padhai dènge ra.

source_text: by which, some, professing, missed the mark concerning the emunah. chen v'chesed hashem be with you.
target_text: abhu dhèu cahag'e lèka lii aj'a-nori dhu kapod'e-kabèli sèra, toke ra sero eele nèti parcaya ra dhu lèke mi ama lamatua. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha èu dènge angalai mu si aa'i-aa'i ra. saloom, paulus

source_text: sha'ul, a shliach of rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua birtzon hashemby the will of g-d, according to the havtachah hachayyim promise of life in moshiach yehoshua. to timotiyos, beni haahuv my beloved son. chesed hashem, rachamim hashem and shalom hashem from elohim avinu and rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua adoneinu.
target_text: timotius dhu be'a! sasuri ne nèti ja'a, paulus, dhu ama lamatua mesa na hag'e nare j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. ra pua ja'a ho laku lole nèti mamuri dhu lèke, dhu lamatua moa le hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus kristus. timotius! èu dhu j'aj'i le sèmi ana ja'a. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, sue èu, pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi èu, aa hia èu mamuri dènge mera-milu.
