source_text: modeh ani i give thanks to hashem whom i offer avodas hakodesh service with a clear matzpun - as did the avot of me - when i remember you constantly in my tefillos.
target_text: mèu-mèda ja'a sabaj'a hia èu. ja'a manèngi taruu makasi mi ama lamatua, lula èu madhutu taruu ne. èu me'a! ja'a sab'a hia nèngu dènge d'ara mola-mèci, èci èèna ka dhu bèi-baki èdhi sèra sab'a hia ne.

source_text: as i remember your weeping, i want to see you, that i may be filled with simcha.
target_text: ja'a sanèd'e lod'o èdhi pacèri uru èèna, èu pahaa èi madha. nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo titu kèna paraga hari dènge èu, sèna ka d'ara ja'a karej'e.

source_text: i remember your genuine emunah, which dwelt first in lois your savtah grandmother, bobe and in your em, eunice, and i have been persuaded dwells also in you.
target_text: ja'a ngee kèdhi uru èèna, lod'o èu heka parcaya tare'a lamatua yesus. parcaya sèmi èèna na dhu amo le ètu d'ara bèi mu luisa dènge ina mu yunike. aa ja'a ke'a mèu, na, parcaya sèmi èèna muri le ètu d'ara èu kahèi.

source_text: for which reason i remind you to meorer rekindle the matnat elohim, the gift of hashem which is in you through my conferring of s'michah ordination.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o dhu ja'a bane ai ètu kètu èu aa sabaj'a hia èu, lod'o èèna kahèi lamatua hia karunya mi èu, sèna ka èu bisa sab'a hia ne. de ne'e ne, ja'a manèngi sèna ka èu pakaroo hari karunya èu dhu nuka sèmi ai dhu oe madhe sa.

source_text: for hashem did not bestow upon us a ruach of pachad terror, but of gevurah miraculous power and of ahavah love and of sound havchanah judgment.
target_text: te roh ama lamatua tao boe èdhi j'aj'i dhèu madha'u. te ngaa na tao, sèna ka èdhi j'aj'i dhèu dhu d'ara èra, dhu te'a pasue, aa te'a taha tare d'ara.

source_text: do not, therefore, be ashamed of the eidus of adoneinu nor of me, his asir prisoner, but suffer together with me for the besuras hageulah in the ko'ach of hashem,
target_text: de baku makae peka-padhai j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti lamatua èdhi. aa baku makae lula ja'a ne ana bèdho. te ja'a maso bui lula ja'a pakako sasab'a na. de ladhe lamu lole lii lolo be'a, èu hud'i pa'èra ku iisi, ho dui j'aj'èra nuka sèmi ji'i dui. ladhe èu paraga dènge j'aj'èra sèmi èèna, èèna na lamatua pa'èra d'ara èu.

source_text: the one having granted us yeshu'at eloheinu and having called us with a kri'ah kedoshah holy calling, not according to the ma'asim of us but according to his own tachlis purpose and chesed having been given to us in rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua before yamim haolam, but having been manifested now through the appearing of moshieinu moshiach yehoshua, who nullified death and also brought chayyim and alkillayon incorruptibility to light through the besuras hageulah,
target_text: lula lamatua ka dhu patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi. aa na hag'e nare èdhi ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na dhu mola-mèci. na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi, lula na sue èdhi, masi ka èdhi tao boe ngaa-ngaa ho nia sèmi babe'a na. lod'o lamatua paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, te ngaa pama'ète nare le ho hia yesus kristus mai, sèna ka na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, aa pala mamuri hia èdhi. ka yesus kristus mai le, aa bhoke paled'a ngaa dhu uru èèna ama lamatua nelu tao, aa pad'elo d'ara hua iia nèngu mi èdhi. na palaho le koasa mamadhe! ne'e ka dhu j'aj'i lii lolo be'a! de cee dhu parcaya lamatua yesus, madhe heka taa-taa, te ngaa mamuri manèro toke d'ai mia-mia dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: for which i was appointed a karoz herald, a maggid darshan, preacher, a shliach and a rabbi teacher.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua ded'e nare ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus, sèna ka ja'a lole lii lolo be'a na, aa aj'a-nori dhèu ètu mia-mia.

source_text: it is because of these things also that i suffer. but i am not ashamed, for i know whom i have believed and i have been persuaded that he is able to stand shomer, guarding until hayom hahu the pikkadon deposit entrusted to him by me.
target_text: sèra sa ka dhu paj'èra ja'a ètu d'ara èmu bèdho ne. te ngaa ja'a makae boe! lula ja'a ke'a le cee ka dhu ja'a parcaya, nuka lamatua yesus. aa ja'a ke'a kahèi, peka na, nèngu ka dhu pangèd'u sasab'a ne'e mi adhe-aai ja'a, nèngu ka dhu bisa j'aga sasab'a ne'e, aa nèngu ka dhu pa'èra ja'a sèna ka pakako sasab'a ne'e, toke nèngu mai hari.

source_text: follow the pattern of sound orthodox jewish devarim which you heard from me, in emunah and ahavah in rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua.
target_text: de madhutu ka, j'ara mamuri nèti a'aj'a dhu lèke dhu ja'a pad'elo le dènge èu. ladhe èu parcaya taruu, aa sue dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèmi èèna, ne'e peka na, èu j'aj'i le èci dènge yesus kristus.

source_text: stand shomer over the orthodox jewish pikkadon entrusted to you through the ruach hakodesh dwelling in us.
target_text: ama lamatua pangèd'u le ètu d'ara adhe-aai èu kakaja èci dhu kab'ua, nuka a'aj'a dhu lèke. de ladhe-leru pabe'a kakaja èèna! pake roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci dhu ètu d'ara èdhi, sèna ka hud'i laa na pa'èra èu ho ladhe-leru kakaja èèna paie-iie.

source_text: of this you have da'as: all the ones in asia, of whom are phygelus and hermogenes, turned away from me.
target_text: ele boe èu tadèngi le, na, figelus, hermogenes dènge dhèu leo nèti propensi asia sèra, pusi-pahae heka ja'a.

source_text: may hashem grant rachamim to the bais of onesiphorus, because often he refreshed me and he was not ashamed of my sharsherot. for, when he was in rome, he sought me with zerizut and found me. may adoneinu grant to him to find rachamim from hashem in hayom hahu. also, while in ephesus in how many ways he did avodas hakodesh you know very well.
target_text: te ngaa onesiforus leko-leo nèti rèngu. na pakaj'èu boe nèti ja'a. èu mesa mu me'a, lod'o ja'a ètu kota epesus era, nèngu ka dhu ladhe-leru ja'a. limuri ne, na pea ètu kota roma ne'e. ropa na d'ai ne'e, na patangi-tenge ja'a ètu mia-mia. ka na abhu ja'a ètu d'ara èmu bèdho ne. te ngaa na makae boe. na mai taruu ngad'o ja'a ho pa'èra d'ara ja'a. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi onesiforus dènge a'ari na aa'i-aa'i ra. ladhe lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu rai-haha, ja'a sanao ho lamatua pama'ète dhu be'a hia mi onesiforus si.

source_text: you, therefore, beni, be empowered in the chen v'chesed which is in rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua.
target_text: ana timotius dhu ja'a sue! yesus kristus d'ara hua iia titu kèna. limuri ne, èu èci le dènge nèngu. na pa'èra èu. de èu me'a dhoka sèmi more di!

source_text: and what things you heard from me through edim rabbim, these things commit to anashim ne'emanim faithful men of zrizus reliability who will be qualified rabbinic morim to teach others also.
target_text: uru èèna, ja'a aj'a le èu ètu madha dhèu ae lula-nèti j'ara mamuri lamatua dhu mola. de limuri ne ja'a manèngi èu, ho aa'i-aa'i dhu èu tadèngi nèti ja'a, lamu aj'a hari hia dhèu dhu èu bisa lèka si. dhèu sèra hud'i bisa lasi aj'a hari sèmi èèna kahèi mi dhèu leo.

source_text: take your place in suffering as a chaiyal tov good soldier of rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, nuka sèmi sordad'u yesus kristus. de èdhi pasae j'aj'èra sèmi nèngu kahèi. lula èu ne sordad'u dhu be'a, èu hud'i pasae more ku pala unu mu.

source_text: no one on duty as a chaiyal is entangled with the everyday chiloni secular affairs of inactive duty, in order that he may please the one who has enlisted him.
target_text: sordad'u dhu pakako sasab'a bisa boe sab'a pab'ali dènge sasab'a dhu leo. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, nèngu ne'a pakarej'e d'ara komedhaa na.

source_text: and no participant in an athletic tacharut competition is crowned unless he competes according to the rules.
target_text: tare conto leo sèmi olaraga. ladhe madhutu lomba, hud'i madhutu ku atora na. te ladhe aad'o, na, kalua! bisa boe abhu juara. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe neo pakako sasab'a lamatua, madhutu ku atora na.

source_text: it is the hard working ikkar farmer who ought to have the rishonah mipri ha'adamah the first share from the harvest of the earth.
target_text: ladhe kahèi dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe. na sab'a dènge tèku rui na ètu d'ara oka na. de nèngu ka dhu uru tèka abhu hua-hela.

source_text: let your hitbonenut be on what i say, for hashem will give to you binah in all things.
target_text: pangee paie-iie conto sèra. pe ama lamatua hia me'a mèu j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: remember rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua, of the zera dovid, and remember the techiyas hamoshiach, according to my besuras hageulah,
target_text: pangee pabe'a-be'a mi yesus kristus. nèngu èèna ana-èpu dhèu aae daud. na madhe, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri ne. èèna ka j'aj'i lii lolo be'a dhu ja'a laku peka-padhai ètu mia-mia.

source_text: for which i suffer as if i were an evil-doer, even to the point of the bais hasoharʼs bonds, but the dvar hashem has no bonds.
target_text: lula ja'a lole lii lolo be'a, èèna ka ja'a j'èra sèmi ne'e ne. risi-risi hari ra èki-karadhe ja'a dènge rate, tao ja'a sèmi dhèu bhelu-katub'a sa. te ngaa rèngu taha rare boe lii lolo be'a ama lamatua.

source_text: therefore, i endure all things for the sake of the bechirim the chosen ones, in order that they also may obtain the yeshu'at haeloheinu in rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua with kavod olamim.
target_text: de ja'a sadia pasae rupa-rupa j'aj'èra. sad'i dhèu unu lamatua dhu na hag'e nare sèra abhu mamuri. pe ama lamatua ded'e si padedha-dedha, lula rèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu yesus kristus.

source_text: trustworthy is hashem, for if we died with him, also we will live with him.
target_text: aa lii se'e mema lèke tare'a: ladhe èdhi mangaku, na, kristus madhe ho gati èdhi, èci èèna ka èdhi madhe tèke eele mamuri dhui, hèia èdhi kahèi mamuri bera-bera dènge ne.

source_text: if we endure, we also will reign with him; if we will deny him, he also will deny us.
target_text: ladhe èdhi taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, èdhi tèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge nèngu kahèi. te ngaa ladhe èdhi pasili ne, nèngu pasili èdhi kahèi.

source_text: if we are not ne'emanim faithful, he remains ne'eman faithful, for to deny himself, he is not able.
target_text: masi ka d'ara èdhi satia boe, te ngaa nèngu satia taa-taa, lula nèngu bisa boe leko-monya. ngaa dhu na peka, èèna ka dhu na tao.

source_text: remind them of these things, solemnly warning them in the presence of hashem not to be engaged in disputes over devarim, which is not beneficial, but only ruins the hearers.
target_text: pasanèd'e dhèu parcaya, sèna ka rèngu baku bhèlu j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i ra. kai si dènge kolongara ama lamatua, ho ra loe eele ka nèti pa'uji lii padhai lii. te aa'i-aa'i sèra guna boe ngaa-ngaa. dhodhoka pa'ele iie ngangee nèti dhèu dhu nanene.

source_text: do your best to shtel zich apply yourself, to present yourself to hashem as one approved, a po'el workman without bushah shame, keeping on a derech yashar the dvar haemes.
target_text: tenge j'ara dhu be'a, sèna ka tao iisi èu nuka sèmi dhèu sab'a dhu nia abhu koa nèti ama lamatua. dhèu sèmi èèna parluu boe makae, lula nèngu èèna sab'a sasab'a na dènge be'a. èu hud'i j'aj'i dhèu dhu aj'a dènge mola lii holo-nori lamatua mi dhèu, aa baku dènge koe-kapengo. lula lii holo-nori na, mola!

source_text: but profane chatter bereft of kedushah, avoid, for such will advance that which is frai irreligious.
target_text: pakaj'èu nèti lii padhue dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua, aa nèti lii padhai dhu pakab'ua boe lamatua. te sèra sa dhoka tao dhèu asa bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: their lashon hora will spread like gangrene, as in the case of hymenaeus and philetus,
target_text: lii padhai dhu bhelu-katub'a sèra paj'ala sèmi èi papèd'a kangker. lii padhai himeneus dènge filetus sèmi sèra ka!

source_text: who concerning haemes missed the mark, teaching that the techiyas hamesim has already occurred. they are overthrowing the emunah of some.
target_text: dua ra aj'a sala, peka na, dhèu madhe mamuri aa'i hari le. te ngaa èèna lèke boe! dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, rèngu se piku eele nèti ngaa dhu lèke. ngaa dhu rèngu aj'a se'e, pa'ele iie parcaya nèti dhèu cahag'e.

source_text: al kol panim nevertheless, the solid yesod of hashem stands firm and zicher certain, having this seal: v'yoda' hashem es asher lohashem knows the ones who are his; and let everyone who names the name of hashem depart from avel iniquity, gross injustice.
target_text: te ngaa kapua dhu ama lamatua padhèdi nare èèna, kalau-karèto boe. ètu kapua èèna, dhu suri peka na, lamatua tadhe mèu dhèu unu na, aa, dhèu cee dhu pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, hud'i pakaj'èu ku nèti bhelu-katub'a. kapua èèna, dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: in a bais gadol, there are not only k'lei vessels of gold and silver but also those wooden ones and earthen ones: some, for honorable use; others, for dishonorable use. if anyone makes himself tahor from these things he will be a k'li vessel for honorable use, having been set aside as kodesh, useful to haadon, ready for every ma'aseh tov.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu dhèu kaja, abhu rupa-rupa mèdha-panyau. abhu dhu tao nèti hualaa iia dènge hualaa pudhi. te ngaa abhu kahèi dhu tao nèti aj'u dènge rai kalili. mèdha dhu kab'ua, lamatua èmu na d'èi pake ètu d'ara iia-aala. te ngaa mèdha dhu biasa sèra, lamatua èmu makae pake ètu madha dhèu. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu rai-haha. ladhe abhu dhu pakaj'èu iisi ra nèti bhelu-katub'a, nèngu èci èèna ka dènge mèdha-panyau dhu kab'ua sèra. lamatua èmu d'èi pake ne, lula nèngu dènge gaguna sèna ka tao rupa-rupa sasab'a dhu be'a.

source_text: but flee from the ta'avot hane'urim lusts of youth and pursue tzedek, emunah, ahavah, and shalom with the ones calling on adoneinu out of a lev tahor.
target_text: ana ngèru sèra manahu malai lula madhutu dad'èi ra. te ngaa èu, timotius, hud'i j'aga ngi'u mu paie-iie, ho baku madhutu dad'èi d'ara sèmi èèna. tenge j'ara ho tao dhu be'a taruu. parcaya taruu lamatua. mamuri pasue aa padame dènge dhèu leo. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya lamatua, dhu mamuri dènge d'ara mola-mèci, rèngu d'èi dhoka tao j'ara dhu be'a. de èu, timotius, hud'i mamuri ku sama sèmi rèngu sèra!

source_text: but speculations characterized by narrishkait and lacking da'as - such refuse, knowing that they produce fights.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e hari èu ca tèka! baku lamu soro iisi asa d'ara lii langu dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. te sèra sa dhodhoka tao dhèu ho patao-palaha di.

source_text: and an eved hashem ought not be a ba'al machlokes quarrelsome person, but ought to be eidel gentle, courteous to all, a skilled rabbinic moreh, savlan patient,
target_text: dhèu dhu sab'a hia lamatua nia boe j'aj'i dhèu dhu tenge lii langu, sina ma? te ngaa rèngu sèra hud'i d'ara be'a dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, dhu d'èlu-mèu aj'a-nori dhèu, dhu taha rare d'ara ropa paraga dènge dhèu dhu tema tenge lii langu.

source_text: correcting the mitnaggedim opponents in anavat ruach a spirit of meekness, in the tikvah that hashem may efsher perhaps grant them teshuva, resulting in da'as haemes,
target_text: rèngu hud'i holo paie-iie dhèu dhu palab'a sèra. dènge sèmi èèna, ele boe lamatua hia si ele-ho'a, hèia ra sèmi rare ngaa dhu lèke.

source_text: and that they may come to their senses, escaping the pakh trap of hasatan, after having been captured by him to do his will.
target_text: hèia ra mase'a, ka ra rai nèti kacui-aai dhèu aae nidhu, dhu uru èèna èki si ho madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: but of this have da'as, that in the acharit hayamim there will be terrible times,
target_text: timotius! ladhe dètu dènge lod'o èle rai-haha ne, j'aj'èra na ae titu kèna. ja'a peka mema dènge èu sèmi èèna.

source_text: for bnei adam will be in love with self, ohavei kesef lovers of money, ga'avtanim proud boasters, speakers of lashon hora, disobedient to horim parents, without hakarat todah gratitude, without kedushah,
target_text: dhèu dhoka sue ngi'u ra, aa manga'a doi-dhari. rèngu padedha iisi, aa d'èi pahaha dhèu leo, d'èi pakarehe kolongara lamatua, d'èi boe nanene ina-ama ra, re'a boe manèngi makasi, kètu hadhu, d'èi boe madha j'ara lamatua,

source_text: without ahavah, unforgiving and irreconcilable, without shlitah atzmi self-control, bestial, son'ei hatov haters of the good,
target_text: re'a boe sue dhèu, d'èi boe mamuri padame, d'èi pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu, taha rare boe iisi ra, bhelu-katub'a dhu risi eele, d'èi boe dhu be'a,

source_text: treacherous, reckless, conceited, ohavei ta'anugot lovers of pleasures rather than ohavei hashem,
target_text: d'èi pahie mone aanga-angalai ra, ngangee bab'a, aa tao ngi'u ra d'èlu-mèu risi, madhutu dhoka dad'èi d'ara risi nèti dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: having an outward form of chasidus but the ko'ach having denied. turn away from these.
target_text: rèngu tao iisi ra dhèu d'èlu-mèu, te ngaa dhu mola-mèu lao. koasa lamatua abhu boe ètu d'ara ra. baku padètu dènge dhèu sèmi sèra kahèi!

source_text: for of such are the morim entering into homes and capturing weak-willed nashim laden with chatta'im, led away by various ta'avot,
target_text: rèngu maso asa d'ara èmu dhèu dènge rèhu mare, ho lasi kakèj'i d'ara dhèu bhèni dhu èra boe, aa mud'a lèke god'a. dhèu bhèni sèmi sèra sa, mamuri ètu d'ara sasala-sasigo dhu udhu sobhu-sobhu, aa madhutu dhoka rupa-rupa dad'èi d'ara ra.

source_text: always learning but never being able to come to da'as haemes.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi mese hiu mai nori j'ara dhu hiu, na, rèngu madhutu rii. te ngaa re'a boe hag'e mia ka dhu lèke, aa mia dhu sale.

source_text: as jannes and jambres opposed moshe rabbeinu, so also these oppose haemes. these men have been corrupted in their mind and are failures with respect to the emunah,
target_text: èu sanèd'e era lii lolo yanes dènge yamres, si? lod'o èèna, dua ra palab'a dènge musa. mese taa limuri se'e, tatao ra èci èèna ka. rèngu palab'a dènge lii holo-nori dhu be'a. ngangee ra ele iie le, aa parcaya rèngu lèke boe.

source_text: but they will not proceed very far, for the sichlut folly, stupidity of them will likewise become conspicuous to all.
target_text: mese dhu lèke boe sèmi sèra sa, bisa boe taha rare nèbhu. nèbhu-nèbhu dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a gagoa rèngu! nuka sèmi uru èèna dhèu re'a kapod'e-kabèli lula-nèti yanes dènge yamres.

source_text: but you closely followed my torah, my halichah, my tachlis, my emunah, my savlanut patience, my ahavah, my endurance,
target_text: timotius! èu me'a aa'i le mamuri ja'a. èu me'a aa'i ngaa dhu ja'a aj'a. èu me'a j'ara mamuri ja'a. èu me'a d'ara dad'èi ja'a. èu me'a ngaa dhu ja'a parcaya. èu mèdhi unu mu le, ja'a taha kore d'ara, aa sasue ja'a mi dhèu. aa èu me'a tasamia ja'a taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra dènge be'a.

source_text: the redifot persecutions and messianic yissurim sufferings which happened to me in antioch, in iconium, in lystra, what kind of redifot i endured. and out of all adoneinu rescued me.
target_text: èu me'a kahèi ra hake-paparu ja'a, aa dui rupa-rupa j'aj'èra. ja'a abhu j'aj'èra sèmi èèna ètu kota antiokia, ikonium, dènge listra. te ngaa ama lamatua patalale eele ja'a nèti j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: also all the ones wanting to live as chasidim in rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua will be persecuted,
target_text: mema dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus kristus, aa neo mamuri mola-mèci madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, tatu dhèu paj'èra rèngu.

source_text: but anashim ra'im and impostors will progress to their abysmal worst, misleading and being misled.
target_text: ngaa hari, dhèu bhelu dènge dhèu kapod'e-kabèli sèra, asa tabha bhelu. rèngu kapod'e-kabhèli ho pamanahu dhèu leo, te ngaa rèngu sèra lèke kapod'e kahèi.

source_text: but, you, remain in the shiurim you learned, and the things you were convinced of, knowing under which rabbi you sat,
target_text: te ngaa èu hud'i kèpe pa'èra-èra lii holo-nori dhu èu abhu le. aa ngaa dhu èu parcaya èèna, madhutu taruu. te èèna ka dhu lèke! èu me'a mèu cee ka dhu aj'a aa'i-aa'i sèra mi èu! èu bisa lèka si!

source_text: and that from infancy you have known the kitvei hakodesh, which are able to make you chacham with a view to yeshu'at eloheynu through emunah in rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua.
target_text: karèi nèti èu ana iiki era, èu abhu a'aj'a le isi nèti sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua. nèti sasuri se'e, èu me'a rahasia mamuri dhu lèke, dhu tao èu me'a mèu j'ara mamuri. nèti èèna ka, èu parcaya yesus kristus.

source_text: the entire kitvei hakodesh is hashem-breathed and useful for hora'ah teaching, for reproof, for correction, for training in tzedek,
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu ra suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, mema ama lamatua ka dhu uri ho dhèu suri sèra. gaguna sasuri èèna, nuka: aj'a dhèu ngaa dhu lèke, pad'elo sasala dhèu, ère hari dhèu asa j'ara dhu mola, aa nori dhèu ho bèli-bèli mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: that the ish haelohim may be proficient, having been equipped for every one of the ma'asim tovim.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, sasuri mola-mèci èèna bisa tao pamèci dhèu unu lamatua sèra, sèna ka rèngu re'a sasab'a dhu be'a aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: i solemnly charge you before hashem and moshiach yehoshua, the imminent shofet of the living and dead, and by the bi'as hamoshiach and his malchut: attend to the hatafah preaching of the dvar hashem. be ready in season, out of season, expose, rebuke, encourage, with all long suffering and hora'ah teaching.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a yesus kristus mai hari asa rai-haha ne, ho nèd'u paredha nuka sèmi dhèu aae. masi ka dhèu dhu mamuri era, do dhèu dhu madhe le, aa'i-aa'i ra lasi asa katanga madha na, sèna ka na pama'ète lii langu ra èci-èci. nèti èèna ka, ètu madha ama lamatua dènge yesus kristus, ja'a manèngi mi èu ho lamu peka-padhai dènge dhèu-dhèu, lii holo-nori ama lamatua. èu pa'èra taruu! baku pangee, na, lod'o dhu be'a, do aad'o. pad'elo sasala dhèu, te ngaa kai si pabe'a-be'a dènge lii mako. pa'èra d'ara dhèu pake lii holo-nori dhu lèke.

source_text: for there will be a time when sound charedi orthodox hora'ah they will not tolerate, but according to their ta'avot they will accumulate morim to tickle their ears.
target_text: te bèli-camèd'a, dhèu ro'o heka nanene lii holo-nori dhu lèke. pe ra kaboko rare mese-mese dhu d'èlu-mèu padhue-padhai madhutu dad'èi ra, sèna ka pabe'a ro'a dhilu ra.

source_text: and from haemes of hashem they will turn their ear away shmad and to aggadah they will be turned aside.
target_text: ra hutu dhilu ra ho tule eele lii holo-nori dhu lèke. te ngaa pasa dhilu ra, ho nanene lii lolo nanuku dhu leko-monya sèra!

source_text: but, you, exercise shlitah atzmi self-control in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of a mevaser of the besuras hageulah, fully carry out your avodas kodesh ministry of kiruv rechokim bringing near the far away ones.
target_text: masi ka tasamia èèna ka, èu hud'i taha d'ara. pa'èra ètu d'ara j'aj'èra. lamu lole lii lolo be'a, sèna ka dhèu sèmi rare yesus kristus. soru-bara dhèu dènge d'ara kateme, toke pa'èle sasab'a. baku dènge d'ara cabèka.

source_text: for already i am being poured out, and the time of my avekfor departure, has come.
target_text: baku pusi dènge ngi'u ja'a ne, te lod'o mamadhe ja'a dètu le. èci èèna ka dènge galaa dhu isi na oe èle kèna.

source_text: the milchemet tzedek war of righteousness i have fought, the course i have finished, the emunah i have been shomer over.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a segi le ètu d'ara pa'uji èèna dènge be'a. ja'a rai d'ai le lane. ja'a madhutu taruu le yesus kristus dènge be'a.

source_text: henceforth, there is laid up for me the keter hatzedakah crown of righteousness which adoneinu, the shofet tzedek, will give to me in hayom hahu, and not only to me, but also to all the ones who are ohavei bi'as hamoshiach.
target_text: de ne'e ne, di èci ka dhu ja'a tatae. nuka piala juara dhu lamatua tao tèke le hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri mola. lamatua èdhi èèna, nuka dhèu pama'ète lii langu dhu mola. dhu ne'a boe bia cabèka. ladhe d'ai ka lod'o na, na pangèd'u mi ja'a piala juara èèna. te ngaa mesa boe ja'a di. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sue ne, aa dhu mate mamai na, rèngu sèra abhu piala sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: have zerizut diligence to come to me quickly.
target_text: timotius! mai ka lai-lai ngad'o ja'a!

source_text: for demas deserted me. having loved the olam hazeh, he departed for thessalonika; crescens, to galatia; titos, to dalmatia.
target_text: te limuri ne ja'a kaliu bia. krekes la'e le asa propensi galati. aa titus la'e le asa rai dalmatia. aa demas sue risi j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe ètu rai-haha ne, la'e le sa kota tesalonika.

source_text: lukas alone is with me. get markos and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for avodas hakodesh.
target_text: dhodhoka lukas di dhu pea dènge ja'a ètu ne'e. tenge more markus sèna ka dua mi mai palere-lere. te nèngu èèna bisa ladhe-leru ja'a ètu ne'e.

source_text: now tychicus i sent to ephesus.
target_text: ja'a hia le tikikus la'e asa kota epesus.

source_text: when you come, bring the cloak which i left behind in troas with carpus, and the megillos, especially the parchments.
target_text: ladhe èu mai, baku bhèlu mèti kodho pana ja'a dhu tèke eele ètu èmu karpus ètu kota troas. aa baku bhèlu mèti dènge sasuri ja'a sèra, risi-risi dhu ja'a suri ètu ka'uri badha.

source_text: alexander the coppersmith did ra'ot rabbot much evil to me; adonoi will repay him l'ish k'ma'aseihu to each as his deeds.
target_text: aleksander, tuka tabaga èèna, tao bhelu dhu ciki boe mi dedha ja'a. hud'i nèngu sène, te bèli-camèd'a, lamatua ka dhu b'ala ne, sèmi dhu nèngu tao mi dedha ja'a.

source_text: you also watch out for him, because he greatly opposed our message.
target_text: èu hud'i mage-mage ku dènge dhèu èèna, lula nèngu na d'èi palab'a lii-lii dhu èdhi aj'a-nori.

source_text: at my first hitstaddekut defense, no one came to be with me, but all forsook me. may it not be counted against them.
target_text: lod'o hiu-hiu ja'a titu ètu madha hakim ho siri iisi ja'a, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu re ja'a. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra kako tèke eele ja'a mesa ku. te ngaa hud'i rèngu sène! pe lamatua pabhèlu eele sasala ra.

source_text: but adoneinu stood with me, and empowered me, that through me the hachrazah proclamation, kerygma of the besuras hageulah might be fully preached and all the nations might hear it. and i was rescued out of the mouth of the lion.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua tèke eele boe ja'a. na pa'èra ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa peka-padhai lii lolo be'a na dhu pakura boe ciki sa. ja'a lolo sèmi èèna ka mi dhèu yahudi boe, ho ra nanene lii lolo be'a. aa pakaj'èu le nèti mamadhe-mamopo.

source_text: hashem will rescue me from every evil work and thus will bring me safely into his malchut hashomayim. lo hakavod l'olam va'ed. omein.
target_text: aa èèna na ama lamatua pakaj'èu ja'a nèti bhabhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i ra. aa lere nèti ja'a dènge sod'a-mole laku asa sorga. ètu era nèi, nèngu ka dhu nèd'u paredha. lamatua èèna, kapai seli eele! ja'a koa-kio ded'e padedha-dedha ne, dhu ma'ète boe! tare'a sèmi èèna.

source_text: drishat shalom to prisca and aquila and the bais of onesiphorus.
target_text: baku bhelu mèti lii maho'o ja'a mi ina priskila dènge dhèu èmu na akila. sèmi èèna kahèi, mi a'ari onesiforus.

source_text: erastus remained in corinth, but trophimus, ailing, i left behind in miletus.
target_text: erastus pea ètu kota korintus. ca hari ni, ja'a tèke eele trofimus ètu kota miletus, lula na pèd'a aae.

source_text: make haste to come before winter. drishat shalom to you from eubulus and pudens and linus, claudia, and all the achim b'moshiach.
target_text: tenge j'ara sèna ka lod'o d'ai mèka hèru pacuhi, èu dhu d'ai le ne'e. angalai ètu se'e se, nuka: ebolus, pudes, linus dènge ina klaudia pa'adhu lii maho'o hia miu. sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge a'ari dhèu kristen dhu leo sèra.

source_text: hashem be with your neshamah. chen v'chesed hashem be with you.
target_text: ja'a sanao sèna ka ama lamatua sama-sama dènge èu taruu. sèna ka lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka, paulus

source_text: sha'ul an eved of hashem and a shliach of rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua, for the furtherance of the emunah of the bechirei hashemchosen ones of g-d and of da'as haemes knowledge of the truth as pertains to chasidus. the mekor basis of this is a tikvah of chayyei olam which hashem who cannot speak sheker promised before the yamim haolam days of eternity, but revealed at the proper time hashemʼs dvar in the hachrazah proclamation, kerygma, with which i was entrusted, according to the mitzvat hashem moshieinu. to titos, beni ha'amitti baemunah my true son in the faith, the emunah shared in common. chen v'chesed hashem and shalom from elohim haav and moshiach yehoshua moshieinu.
target_text: ana titus dhu be'a! sasuri ne'e nèti ja'a, paulus, ana pua-paleha ama lamatua, aa dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. na pua ja'a sèna ka pa'èra parcaya dhèu dhu na hag'e nare sèra. na pua ja'a ho pad'elo j'ara mola kahèi, sèna ka ra mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu unu ama lamatua re'a, na, bèli-camèd'a rèngu mamuri taa-taa dènge ne. lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, te ngaa na moa mema, bèli-camèd'a dhèu unu na mamuri taa-taa dènge ne. nèngu ne'a boe leko-monya. d'ai lod'o na, ka ama lamatua peka paled'a, na, nèngu saku eele sasala-sigo dhèu, sèna ka ra mamuri taa-taa dènge ne. aa na paredha ja'a ho laku peka lii lolo be'a hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu mia-mia. titus! èu ne nuka sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a sa, lula èu dènge ja'a ne sama-sama parcaya kristus. de ja'a sabaj'a mi ama lamatua dènge yesus kristus dhu hia mamuri mi èdhi, sèna ka ra pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi èu, ho èu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: for this reason i left you in crete that you should set beseder according to acceptable order what remains and give messianic s'michah to zekenim city by city, as i directed you.
target_text: ca hari ni, ja'a pama'ète kore le, ho èu pea ètu pulu kreta, sèna ka uri pèri-pèri j'ara dhu èdhi parluu era ètu èèna. aa hud'i laa èu ded'e dhèu dhu re'a lalau-lalo'o juma'at ètu d'ara rae-rae. baku bhèlu atora dhu ja'a peka le dènge èu, lula-nèti dhèu dhu j'aj'i kètu juma'at. peka na:

source_text: if anyone is without reproach, a ba'al isha echat a one woman man/master, his banim being ma'aminim in moshiach, and not under accusation of debauchery and zenut or sorrut rebelliousness, insubordination,
target_text: ladhe neo ded'e dhèu ho j'aj'i kètu juma'at, nèngu hud'i mamuri ku dènge boe sasala. nèngu hud'i satia dènge dhèu èmu na ca dhèu di. ana-ana na parcaya kahèi yesus kristus. mage dhoka dhèu peka, na, rèngu sèra ana-ana dhu tenge patao-palaha di, aa palab'a dènge dhèu.

source_text: for it is necessary for the congregational mashgiach ruchani to be without reproach as hashemʼs mefake'ach al beis hashemsteward or supervisor of the house of g-d, not a ba'al gaavah a haughty person, not quick in ka'as anger, not a shikkor drunkard given to much wine, not violent, not a gelt-loving kamtzan miser.
target_text: lula kètu juma'at sèra pakako sasab'a lamatua, de rèngu hud'i mamuri dènge mola, aa dènge kolongara hua iia. baku ded'e dhèu dhu d'èi padedha iisi; dhu nasa malai, d'èi mahu, dhu d'èi pagama, aa dhu manga'a doi-dhari.

source_text: rather, the mashgiach ruchani must be one who practices hachnosas orchim hospitality, an ohev es hatov a lover of the good, having seichel, a tzaddik, kadosh holy, with shlitah atzmi self-control,
target_text: dhèu dhu j'aj'i kètu juma'at sèra hud'i d'èi sèmi rare dhèu asa d'ara èmu ra. dhu d'èi j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, dhu taha rare d'ara, dhu bia boe cabèka, dhu d'ara mola-mèci, aa dhu re'a taha rare ngi'u.

source_text: devoted to the faithful hatafah preaching of the besuras hageulah, adequate for hora'ah teaching that exhorts to orthodox jewish doctrine and for refuting and exposing with conviction the ones speaking against it.
target_text: rèngu hud'i kèpe pa'èra-èra ku lii holo-nori ama lamatua, dhu uru èèna èdhi nori si. dènge sèmi èèna, rèngu pad'elo j'ara lamatua dhu mola hia dhèu leo, aa bisa pamola lii lolo dhu lèke boe j'ara sèra.

source_text: for there are indeed many mitnaggedim opponents, idle talkers and deceivers, especially the ones of the party of the mohalim hagoyim false teacher circumcisers of gentiles,
target_text: te abhu dhèu ae dhu d'èi palab'a a'aj'a dhu lèke. abhu dhu peka-padhai dènge boe kolo-kapua. aa abhu kahèi dhu d'èi kapod'e-kabèli. risi-risi dhèu yahudi dhu peka, na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu neo abhu mamuri hud'i suna ku.

source_text: whose mouths it is necessary to stop, who are subverting entire mishpochot families by teaching what they ought not, for the sake of dishonest gelt.
target_text: ra pake a'aj'a rèngu dhu sala ho nuni rèti a'ari èdhi pakaj'èu nèti lii holo-nori lamatua dhu lèke. rèngu sèra d'èi dhoka tenge doi-dhari dènge j'ara kapod'e-kabèli di! kai dhèu sèmi sèra sa, sèna ka ra loe nèti aj'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe.

source_text: a certain one of them, a navi of their own number, said, cretans are always meshakkrim liars, wicked beasts, lazy trombeniks gluttons.
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu èci nèti pulu kreta, dhu tema padhai pake lii hini, lole dhèu nèngu unu na, aku nèngu na, dhèu pulu kreta d'èi dhoka padhai lii hèb'a hua di, dhu manga'a, nuka sèmi badha hui dhu re'a boe atora, aa bai-eed'a mèje adhe!

source_text: this eidus testimony is true, for which cause rebuke them sharply, that they may be orthodox jewish in emunah,
target_text: mamuri dhèu sèra mema sèmi èèna ka! de èu hud'i lamu ère more hari dhèu dhu lèke kapod'e-kabèli sèra, ho pa'èra hari parcaya ra mi lamatua.

source_text: not paying attention to jewish aggadot and to mitzvot d'rabbanan precepts imposed by the rabbis, becoming meshummad apostate from haemes.
target_text: èle èèna, ra nanene ia ka nanuku nèti dhèu yahudi sèra, aa rèngu hud'i ae eele ku nèti lii paredha dhèu-dhèu dhu tule eele lii holo-nori dhu lèke.

source_text: all things are tahor to hatehorim; but, to the ones having been defiled and taking the side of the apikoros, nothing is tahor, but has been made tameh, both lev and matzpun.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! bagi dhèu dhu d'ara mola-mèci, aa'i-aa'i mola-mèci. te ngaa bagi dhu d'ara kaj'alu aa dhu parcaya boe lamatua, abhu boe ngaa èci sa dhu mola-mèci. lula d'ara dènge ngangee rèngu dhu kaj'alu mema le.

source_text: hashem they profess to know, but by their ma'asim they deny him, being disqualified and being without mishma'at obedience, and, as to every one of the ma'asim tovim, unpalatably unkosher unfit.
target_text: rèngu mangaku tadhe ama lamatua. te ngaa mamuri ra nuka sèmi dhèu dhu tadhe boe ne. rèngu padhai lii leo, tao leo. rèngu mema tare'a-re'a dhèu karehe di! rèngu ro'o boe madhutu dad'èi lamatua. baku maena dhèu sèmi sèra re'a tao dhu be'a!

source_text: but you, speak the things which are suitable to moshiachʼs orthodox jewish doctrine.
target_text: te ngaa èu ne, titus, baku j'aj'i sèmi rèngu kahèi! èu hud'i pa'èra d'ara dhèu, sèna ka ra mamuri madhutu lii holo-nori lamatua dhu lèke.

source_text: zekenim need to be temperate, respectable, men of seichel, being orthodox in the emunah, in ahavah, in savlanut longsuffering.
target_text: peka dènge ama-ama dhèu heka sèra ho mamuri madhutu atora, j'aga paie kolongara, aa taha rare d'ara. rèngu hud'i kèpe pa'èra aa taha taruu madhutu lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu lèke. aa rèngu hud'i sue dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: similarly the senior women, the zekanot, in hitnahagut conduct as befits kedushah, not yentas of lashon hora nor slaves of wine, but melamedot es hatov teachers of the good,
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ina-ina dhu heka sèra. peka dènge ra j'aga paie kakako dènge lii padhai ra, aa mamuri taruu madhutu dad'èi lamatua. baku padhai-kakoli kolongara dhèu. baku j'aj'i ènu dhua ara-dhua pèd'u. te ngaa rèngu hud'i aj'a dhèu, sèna ka ra mamuri dènge mola.

source_text: that they may encourage the young nashim to have ahavah for their ba'alim and their banim,
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, rèngu j'aj'i dhèu pad'elo j'ara mi ina-ina dhu ngèru era, sèna ka ra sue dhèu èmu-kamali dènge ana-ana ra.

source_text: to have seichel, tehorot in tznius, managers of the bayit, being tovot, being submissive to their ba'alim, lest chillul hashem come to the dvar haelohim.
target_text: rèngu hud'i aj'a kahèi dhèu ho ra mamuri dènge taha rare d'ara, mola-mèci, re'a lalau d'ara èmu, re'a pahae dhèu èmu ra, aa d'èi nanene lii dhèu èmu ra. ladhe mamuri rèngu sèmi èèna, dhèu bisa heka padhai lii pahaha lii holo-nori ama lamatua.

source_text: the bochrim, similarly, you exhort to have seichel
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, holo mone ngèru sèra, sèna ka ra mamuri dènge taha rare d'ara.

source_text: about all things, showing yourself a mofet of ma'asim tovim. in the hora'ah, show integrity, seriousness,
target_text: titus! èu ne hud'i mamuri dènge be'a ku, ho bisa j'aj'i dhèu pad'elo j'ara mi dhèu leo. sad'i èu tao ngaa èci sa, sab'a dènge be'a, sama sèmi dhu èu aj'a dhèu sèra. ladhe èu aj'a ngaa sa èci, na, tao madhutu ngaa dhu èu aj'a sèra. mage pamud'e dènge sasab'a èu.

source_text: along with dibur speech that is orthodox and beyond reproach, that the mitnagged may be brought to bushah shame, having no lashon hora to say against you.
target_text: ladhe èu nori dhèu, pake lii holo-nori dhu lèke, sèna ka dhèu abhu boe j'ara ho pamanahu èu. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, dhèu-dhèu dhu lab'a èdhi ra'e makae, lula rèngu abhu boe j'ara ho segi èdhi.

source_text: avadim slaves need to be submissive to their own adonim in everything, to be acceptable, not talking back,
target_text: aj'a ènu sèra ho ra nanene lamatua rèngu ètu j'ara ngaa èèna ka, aa pakarej'e d'ara lamatua ra. baku ra pab'ala lii padhai dènge lamatua ra.

source_text: not pilfering, but showing all good reliability, that they may adorn the hora'ah teaching of hashem moshieinu in all things.
target_text: rèngu baku mana'u mèdha-panyau lamatua ra. rèngu hud'i pad'elo ku dhu peka, na, lamatua ra bisa parcaya rèngu tare'a-re'a. rèngu sèra hud'i j'aj'i dhèu dhu be'a aa satia. ladhe dhèu leo neo pakasame mamuri ènu rèngu dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi aj'a, tatu ra dhaa, peka na, lii a'aj'a èdhi be'a titu kèna. te a'aj'a èdhi se'e, madhutu j'ara-j'ara ama lamatua dhu hia le mamuri mi èdhi.

source_text: for the chen v'chesed of hashem has appeared, bringing yeshu'at eloheynu to kol bnei adam,
target_text: te ama lamatua pad'elo le babe'a d'ara na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, aa bhoke j'ara ho patabuli dhèu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: instructing us to deny all that is frai irreligious and not of chasidus and all that is ta'avanut, and to live with seichel and tzidkat hashem and yirat shomayim in the olam hazeh,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mamuri dhu pamèci boe, aa dad'èi dhu karehe, ti core eele si. èdhi mamuri ètu rai-haha ne, hud'i te'a taha tare d'ara, mamuri dènge mola-mèci, aa satia dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: awaiting the tikvah hameashsheret the blessed hope, the appearing of the kavod haeloheinu hagadol and moshieinu rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua,
target_text: limuri ne èdhi sanao-maena mamai hari yesus kristus dhu kapai risi eele! èèna j'aj'i mèngi-nale mi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. nèngu èèna, lamatua èdhi dhu kapai risi dhu pala-bagi le mamuri mi èdhi.

source_text: who gave his nefesh on behalf of us, that for us he might bring in the geulah, redeeming us mi kol avonotav from all israelʼs sins, making tahor am li segulah a people for my possession, zealous for ma'asim tovim.
target_text: nèngu hia le ngi'u aae na j'aj'i mi korban, sèna ka patabuli eele èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, sèna ka tao èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu na dhu mamuri mola-mèci, dhu d'èi dhoka tao j'ara hua iia di.

source_text: preach these things, with words that give chizzuk strengthening and reprove with all authority. let no one write you off.
target_text: de titus, aj'a aa'i-aa'i se mi dhèu sarani sèra. pa'èra d'ara si, sèna ka madhutu a'aj'a sèra. dhèu cee dhu tao sala, na, pad'elo j'ara be'a hia ne. dhèu bisa boe pahaha èu, lula èu dènge hak ho tao paie rèngu.

source_text: remind them to be v'nishma obedient, and we will obey! to sarim rulers, to shiltonim authorities, to be submissive, to be obedient, ready for every ma'aseh tov.
target_text: pasanèd'e dhèu sarani sèra, ho nanene dhèu paredha aa dhèu-dhèu dhu rèd'u koasa. rèngu hud'i madhutu ku atora sèra. aa rèngu hud'i pa'èra tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: speak lashon hora of no one, be not ohev riv quarrelsome. be eidel gentle, displaying anavah meekness to kol bnei adam.
target_text: baku lasi padhai pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu. baku d'èi pasibha d'ara lii. be'a risi, mamuri mola, dènge d'ara hua iia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: for all of us were once without da'as, sorrarim disobedient, being led astray, avadim slaves of ta'avot and to various ta'anugot pleasures of the olam hazeh, spending our lives in eyvahenmity and kina jealousy, hated, and hating one another.
target_text: te uru èèna, lod'o èdhi tadhe mèka lamatua yesus, èdhi te'a boe ngaa-ngaa, aa dènge mud'a lèke tipu. èdhi to'o boe nanene dhèu leo. èdhi dhoka mamuri madhutu d'ara bhelu di, ka èki ngi'u èdhi dènge rupa-rupa dad'èi d'ara ti. èdhi d'ara karehe dènge dhèu leo. èdhi mamuri dhoka dènge jeluus. èdhi d'èi tèka d'ara mi dhèu leo, hèia ra kab'èli tèka d'ara dènge èdhi.

source_text: but when the chen v'chesed and the ahavas hashem moshieinu appeared to bnei adam,
target_text: masi ka mamuri èdhi ne ele iie le, te ngaa ama lamatua dhu hia mamuri mi èdhi, pad'elo le sasue dènge d'ara hua iia na mi dedha èdhi.

source_text: not by tzidkateynu our righteousness in ma'asim tovim which is to our zchus merit, but according to his rachamim, he granted us yeshu'at eloheynu through the mikveh mayim ruchani of rebirth and hitchadshut of the ruach hakodesh,
target_text: na hia èdhi mamuri lula boe nèti tatao èdhi dhu be'a, te ngaa lula sasue na mi èdhi. nèngu rase pamèu-mèu sasala èdhi sèra pake roh na dhu mola-mèci, sèna ka pahiu mamuri èdhi, nuka sèmi rara iisi hari èdhi.

source_text: which hashem poured out on us richly through rebbe, melech hamoshiach yehoshua moshieinu,
target_text: lula yesus kristus madhe le ho pakaj'èu èdhi nèti koasa sasala sèra, nèti èèna ka ama lamatua hia dènge boe too-lane roh na dhu mola-mèci mi èdhi.

source_text: that, having been made yitzdak im hashem by the chen v'chesed of hashem, we might become yoreshim heirs in the tikvah hachayyei olam.
target_text: lula d'ara hua iia yesus, ka na pabe'a pa'èci èdhi dènge ama lamatua, nuka sèmi ana na. hèia èdhi te'a, na, bèli-camèd'a èdhi mamuri taa-taa dènge ne. se'e se j'aj'i mi pusaka èdhi!

source_text: this dvar emes is trustworthy. and i counsel you to strongly affirm the divrei torah i am handing on to you, that those who have become ma'aminim in hashem may be shomer for ma'asim tovim. these things to bnei adam are good, tov me'od.
target_text: dhu ja'a peka ne, lèke tare'a. ngaa dhu ja'a aj'a ne, dènge kab'ua hia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, èu hud'i pasanèd'e dhèu ho madhutu lii aj'a dhu mola. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya lamatua, loe boe tenge j'ara sèna ka tao j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: but pilpul minutiae controversies and toldot and quarrels and fights about the torah, avoid, for they are unprofitable hevel.
target_text: baku soro iisi asa d'ara lii langu dhu leko-monya, nuka sèmi: pasibha d'ara lii langu dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua, patao iia d'ara dènge dhèu leo, patula-pajuku nèti j'aj'aj'i mia dhu dedha risi, aa patao nèti atora ad'a yahudi. tao ngaa? sèra sa aa'i-aa'i, èci sa gaguna na aad'o. pèci eele lod'o iia d'ara!

source_text: an ish hacholek a man of division, a divisive man after one or two warnings, avoid,
target_text: lamu holo dhèu dhu tema pamae juma'at sèra. ladhe nèngu tao taruu, kai ne. aa ladhe na loe boe, soro tèke ne sène.

source_text: having da'as that such a man is perverted and sinful, bringing harsha'ah condemnation upon himself.

source_text: kol shatah tachat raglav putting everything under his feet. now while hashem subjected all things to him, he left nothing unsubjected to him, though now we do not yet see all things having been subjected to him.
target_text: ho ra paredha aa'i dhu lamatua paj'aj'i. de madhutu sasuri daud, ama lamatua ded'e dhèu rai-haha j'aj'i kètu, sèna ka ra uri aa'i-aa'i dhu na paj'aj'i. te ngaa èdhi tèdhi mèka na, dhèu rai-haha èci sa dhu paredha aa'i-aa'i sèmi èèna.

source_text: but this is what we do see: yehoshua, for a short time having been made lower than the angels, has, because of the yissurim suffering of mavet death, been crowned with kavod v'hadar glory and splendor in order that by the chen v'chesed hashem on behalf of all he might taste the histalkus of mavet.
target_text: te ngaa abhu ca dhèu dhu bisa paredha aa'i-aa'i se. nèngu èèna, nuka yesus. na mai pea taha ètu rai-haha ne, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha dhu pasae j'aj'èra, ka na madhe hia mi èdhi. nèti mamadhe na, ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu rai-haha. èle èèna ka, ama lamatua koa-kad'iri ne, aa ded'e ne padedha-dedha, sèna ka na paredha aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua paj'aj'i nare sèra.

source_text: for it was bekavod fitting, proper for him, for whom are all things and through whom are all things, in bringing banim rabbim many sons to kavod, to bring to shleimut perfection, completion the rosh head and mekhonen founder of their yeshu'at hashem through yissurim suffering.
target_text: de lèke, ladhe ama lamatua hia yesus pasae j'aj'èra, ho yesus bisa bhoke j'ara mamuri pala mi dhèu rai-haha. te ama lamatua neo sèna ka dhèu ae bisa mamuri bera-bera dènge nèngu ètu sorga. ama lamatua ka dhu paj'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu. aa aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, mamuri lula nèngu ka.

source_text: for both hakadosh who makes holy and kedoshim who are being made holy all have haav echad. it is for this reason rebbe, melech hamoshiach is not ashamed to call them achim,
target_text: ama lamatua tatu sèmi nare si dènge be'a dhèu dhu yesus tao mola-mèci, ho j'aj'i ana-ana na. ama lamatua èèna, ama nèti yesus. dènge sèmi èèna, yesus dènge rèngu, ca ama. nèti èèna ka, yesus makae boe paroa mi dhèu se'e, na, miu se, a'ari ja'a.

source_text: saying, i will declare your name to my brothers, within the congregation i will praise you.
target_text: te yesus peka le dènge ama na, ja'a neo peka dènge a'ari ja'a, lula-nèti babe'a ama! ja'a neo sod'a ètu talora aae rèngu, lula-nèti dadedha ama!

source_text: and again, i put my bitachon in him and again hinei anochi v'hayeladim asher natan li hashem here i am and the yeladim whom hashem gave to me.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, ja'a sarai-maena mi ama lamatua toke d'ai mia-mia. hèia yesus peka hari, na, ladhe ku! ja'a ka ne'e, sama-sama dènge ana-ana ama lamatua, dhu na pangèd'u le mi ja'a, ho uri si.

source_text: therefore, als since the yeladim share in the basar vadahm and rebbe, melech hamoshiach likewise shared in the same things, that through the histalkus of his mavet he might destroy the one having power over mavet, that is, hasatan,
target_text: lula ana-ana lamatua se, dhèu rai-haha biasa, nèti èèna ka yesus hud'i j'aj'i ku dhèu rai-haha sama sèmi rèngu kahèi. te nèngu hud'i j'aj'i uuru ku dhèu rai-haha, heka na bisa madhe. ho nèti mamadhe na, heka nèngu bisa parame nare koasa nèti dhèu aae nidhu. te dhèu aae bhabhelu-katub'a ne'e ka dhu nèd'u koasa, ho uri j'ara-j'ara dhu pa'èki dènge mamadhe.

source_text: and he might release these, as many as through eymat hamavet terror of death were subjected to avdut slavery all the days of their existence.
target_text: aa nèngu kahèi tao dhèu rai-haha madha'u dènge mamadhe, toke ra madhutu dad'èi na, nuka sèmi ènu sa. te ngaa limuri ne, yesus bisa patalale le dhèu rai-haha nèti d'ara madha'u.

source_text: for surely it was not malachim that concerned him, but the zera avraham avinu.
target_text: te dhu lèke, nuka yesus mai boe ho soru-bara ana-ana pajuu ètu sorga. te ngaa na mai sèna ka soru nare èdhi, nuka ana-èpu abraham.

source_text: and for this reason, rebbe, melech hamoshiach was obliged to become like the achim b'moshiach in every respect, that he might become a kohen gadol rachaman v'ne'eman before hashem in order to make kapporah for the chatta'im of haam.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yesus j'aj'i sama sèmi èdhi, dhu j'aj'i le a'ari na. dènge j'ara ne'e nèngu j'aj'i mi kètu agama èdhi dhu kapai risi eele, ho soru-bara èdhi sèna ka madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. yesus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na kahèi mi èdhi. aa ladhe na peka ngaa, na tao madhutu sèmi èèna kahèi. uru èèna, bèi-baki èdhi manèngi kètu kapai risi agama yahudi, sèna ka tao korban, ho lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo rèngu. limuri ne, yesus mesa na ka dhu j'aj'i korban, sèna ka lamatua saku eele sasala èdhi.

source_text: for, because rebbe, melech hamoshiach himself has endured, being tested in the yissurim sufferings of his nefesh, he is able to come to the ezrah aid of the ones being tested.
target_text: lod'o yesus mamuri ètu rai-haha ne, na abhu j'aj'èra ae-ae. abhu kahèi dhu dadugu ne, sèna ka ad'u-ue sasala. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa nèngu manahu boe. nèti èèna ka, ladhe abhu dhu dadugu-rariu èdhi, sèna ka tao sasala, yesus ka dhu bisa soru-bara èdhi ho baku manahu.

source_text: for this reason, achai hakedoshim b'moshiach, chaverim and chavrusa partners in a kri'at marom high himel calling, consider carefully the shliach and kohen gadol of the hachrazah proclamation of our emunah, yehoshua, yeshua.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e, a'ari! ama lamatua hag'e nare le miu, aa cap miu dhèu d'ara mola, sèna ka èèna na miu mamuri bera-bera dènge ne ètu sorga. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pangee ku pabe'a-be'a lula-nèti yesus ne. te èdhi dhu mangaku le, na, nèngu ne dhèu pajuu-paleha ama lamatua, aa nèngu kahèi kètu kapai risi agama èdhi.

source_text: he being ne'eman faithful to the one having given him s'michah as also moshe rabbeinu was ne'eman faithful in kol beis hashem.
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua pua yesus mai, yesus tao madhutu aa'i dad'èi lamatua. dènge j'ara ne, nèngu nuka sèmi musa. te musa tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua kahèi, lod'o na ladhe-leru bèi-baki èdhi uru sèra.

source_text: yet rebbe, melech hamoshiach is considered worthy of more kavod than moshe rabbeinu, because more kavod has the boneh builder of the beis than the beis itself.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa yesus kapai risi nèti musa. te yesus sama sèmi lamatua èmu. aa mema lèke, lula lamatua èmu kapai risi nèti ana pua-paleha ètu d'ara èmu.

source_text: for every beis is built by someone, but the one having built everything is hashem.
target_text: dhèu èci-èci ka pa'uri d'ara èmu na. te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu uri aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: now moshe rabbeinu was ne'eman in kol beis hashem as an eved, for a solemn edut of the things which were to be spoken afterward.
target_text: de musa tao madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, lod'o na j'aj'i ana pua-paleha nèti isi èmu lamatua. te lod'o èèna, na peka mema le ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua neo tao.

source_text: but rebbe, melech hamoshiach was ne'eman as haben over the beis hashem, whose beis we are, if indeed the bitachon and the tikvah in which we glory we keep hold of to haketz.
target_text: masi ka yesus madhutu kahèi dad'èi ama lamatua, te ngaa nèngu ana pua-paleha dhu sama boe sèmi musa. lula nèngu ne, kristus, ana ama lamatua dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le karèi nèti uru ka, sèna ka pua mai asa rai-haha ne. aa kristus ne'a mèu uri isi èmu ama na. de ladhe èdhi kèpe pa'èra-èra lalèka èdhi, aa ma'ète boe sanao-maena èdhi mi kristus, èdhi bisa j'aj'i isi èmu na kahèi.

source_text: therefore, just as the ruach hakodesh says, hayom im bekolo tishmau today, if you hear his voice;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pasa dhilu paie-iie, ho nanene pabe'a ngaa dhu roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci peka, na, doe ne'e, ropa miu tadèngi lii ama lamatua,

source_text: al takshu levavchem kimrivah k'yom massah bamidbar do not harden your heart as you did at meribah, as you did that day at massah in the desert,
target_text: mage miu kètu hadhu, sama sèmi dhèu sèra, dhu lasi-mai èpa nguru tèu ètu pad'a sod'a. te rèngu ro'o heka puai-pahae musa, toke ama lamatua mesa na oe taha nare heka d'ara na.

source_text: asher nissuni avoteichem bekhanuni gam ra'u po'oli arba'im shanah where your fathers tested me and tried me though they saw my deeds forty years. therefore akut bedor vaomar am to'ey levav hem v'hem lo yad'u derakhai i was angry with that generation and i said they are a straying-of-heart people and they have not had da'as of my ways;
target_text: pangee ku laa! èpa nguru tèu kateme ja'a tao rupa-rupa tadha malaa ètu katanga madha ra! te ngaa ra loe boe sèku ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a nasa dènge ra, peka na, ‘miu se, seli-kolane! te miu soro kabodho tèke eele j'ara ja'a, ho madhutu j'ara miu dhu koe-kapengo! '

source_text: asher nishba'eti v'apey im yevo'un el menukhati therefore i declared on oath in my anger, never shall they enter into my rest, home, abode, place of tranquility.
target_text: ropa kèdhi bhabhelu miu, ja'a ru'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a dhoo miu, peka na, ‘miu bisa boe mai ho ae mere d'ara mi, sama-sama dènge ja'a. '

source_text: beware, achim b'moshiach, lest there will be in any one of you a lev rah evil heart without emunah, that turns away shmad from elohim chayyim.
target_text: de a'ari aa'i-aa'i! mage nèti miu abhu ca dhèu dhu tao bhelu, toke nèngu parcaya heka, hèia na soro kabodho mi ama lamatua dhu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: instead, give one another chozek strength each and every day, as long as it is still called hayom, today lest some of you may fall into keshi stubbornness, hardness and be stubbornly hardened by the nechalim deceitfulness of chet.
target_text: be'a risi bèli-bèli miu pa'èra d'ara, èci dènge èci. baku pamata ia ka! lula miu dhu malai lèke tipu ka tao sasala, toke miu kètu hadhu aa pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua.

source_text: we have become chavrusa partners of moshiach if only our bitachon confidence we had initially we hold firm until haketz;
target_text: èdhi bisa pa'angalai dènge yesus kristus, sad'i baku pama'ète sanao mi nèngu, nuka sèmi ropa èdhi heka parcaya nèngu.

source_text: as it is said, hayom im bekolo tishmau al takshu levavchem today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your heart as in the meribah mered rebellion.
target_text: te roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci, peka le kahèi, na, doe ne'e, ladhe miu tadèngi lii ama lamatua, miu baku kètu hadhu sama sèmi dhèu se'e se, dhu lasi-mai toke èpa nguru tèu ètu pad'a sod'a, te rèngu lab'a musa.

source_text: now who were they who heard and yet rebelled? was it not all the ones having had litzi'at mitzrayim going out from egypt under moshe rabbeinu?
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: cee ka dhu uru èèna nanene musa, hèia ra pusi-pahae heka ne? dhèu sèra nuka bèi-baki èdhi dhu musa lere si nèti rai masir.

source_text: and with whom was hashem angry arba'im shanah? was it not with the ones having sinned, whose pegarim corpses lay where they had fallen bamidbar in the desert?
target_text: aa dhèu cee ka dhu tao d'ara ama lamatua pana magoro d'ai èpa nguru tèu èèna? dhèu sèra nuka bèi-baki èdhi. te mamuri ra koe-kapengo ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a, toke ra madhe, ka padhane si ètu nèi.

source_text: and to whom did he swear that they would not enter into the menuchah resting place of him? was it not to the ones without mishma'at obedience?
target_text: aa cee ka dhu lèke kutuk nèti ama lamatua, toke bisa boe maso asa rai èèna, sèna ka ae rare d'ara ra sama-sama dènge lamatua? dhèu sèra nuka bèi-baki èdhi. te rèngu se ro'o boe nanene ama lamatua.

source_text: and so we see that they were not able to enter because of lack of emunah.
target_text: de me'a le, si? bèi-baki èdhi bisa boe maso asa d'ara rai èèna, ho ae rare d'ara ra sama-sama dènge ama lamatua, lula ra parcaya boe ne.

source_text: therefore, let us walk in yir'at shomayim, for fear that, while the havtachah promise of entering the menuchah of hashem is still open, anyone of you should seem to have fallen short of it.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi hud'i pangee madhera ku, lula lamatua dhu pajaji era, na, dhèu unu na bisa ae rare d'ara ra sama-sama dènge nèngu. de mage dhoka abhu nèti miu dhu tule eele lii pajaji lamatua ne.

source_text: for indeed we have had besuras hageulah preached to us, just as they did also; but the dvar hashem preached did not make that generation benefit, because hearing did not form an agudah with emunah.
target_text: te èdhi dhu tadèngi le lii lolo be'a, sama sèmi bèi-baki èdhi uru sèra tadèngi. te ngaa, lula rèngu lèka boe lii èèna, rèngu abhu boe oto ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: for we ma'aminim enter into that menuchah, just as hashem has said, asher nishba'ti v'api im yevo'un el menuchatias i vowed in my fury, they shall never enter into my rest, although the ma'asim works of hashem were finished from the hivvased tevel foundation of the world.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi parcaya, èdhi bisa ae tare d'ara bera-bera dènge ama lamatua. te uru èèna, nèngu dhu pajaji le dènge bèi-baki èdhi, te ngaa lula na nasa, hèia na peka dènge ra, na, ja'a taha heka ladhe kèdhi tatao bhabhelu miu ne. nèti èèna ka, ja'a dhoo miu, peka na, ‘miu bisa boe maso, ho ae mere d'ara sama-sama dènge ja'a. ' aa te ngaa èdhi te'a le, na, lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i liru dènge rai-haha, nèngu ator nare le, sèna ka dhèu-dhèu unu na bisa ae rare d'ara, ho mamuri bera-bera dènge ne.

source_text: for concerning shabbos, the yom hashevi'i, hashem has said somewhere, vayishbot elohim bayom hashevi'i mikol melakhto and he rested on the seventh day from all his work.
target_text: ètu lii lolo nèti ama lamatua paj'aj'i liru dènge rai-haha, dhu suri, ama lamatua ae nare d'ara, peka na, lamatua sab'a nare aa'i le, hèia asa bèli èèna, lèke dènge lod'o ka pidhu, na ae nare d'ara.

source_text: and again in this mekor passage, citation, im yevo'un el menuchatinever shall they enter into my rest.
target_text: aa dhu suri ètu era leo hari, ama lamatua peka dènge bèi-baki èdhi, na, miu bisa heka maso, ho ae mere d'ara mi sama-sama dènge ja'a.

source_text: therefore, als since it remains for some to enter it, and the ones, who formerly had the besuras hageulah preached to them, did not enter, because they were koferim unbelievers,
target_text: de dad'èi ama lamatua ka, dhèu unu na ae rare d'ara ra sèna ka mamuri sama-sama dènge ne. te ngaa bèi-baki èdhi dhu tadèngi uuru lii lolo be'a ne, rèngu bisa boe maso, lula rèngu tao boe madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: so then again hashem sets a certain day, hayomtoday in one of the tehillim of dovid, much later, in that quoted above, hayom im bekolo tishmau al takshu levavchemtoday, if you hear his voice, do not harden your heart.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, lamatua hag'e nare lod'o èci, sèna ka dhèu unu na bisa ae rare d'ara ra sama-sama dènge nèngu. te na pake daud ho padhai lii, peka na, doe ne'e, ladhe miu tadèngi lii ama lamatua, mage miu tao d'ara mi adhu sèmi hadhu, te ngaa nanene paie-iie.

source_text: for if yehoshua had brought them to a place of menuchah rest, hashem would not have spoken of another yom after that.
target_text: lod'o daud peka na, doe ne'e, nèngu paj'uj'u boe asa lod'o dhu yosua lere ana-èpu nèti bèi-baki se asa rai kana'an. te lod'o daud padhai lii ne, rèngu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhe nèbhu le.

source_text: therefore, there remains a shabbos menuchah for the am hashem.
target_text: nèti èèna ka èdhi te'a, na, lamatua ator le lod'o dhu leo èci, sèna ka dhèu-dhèu unu na bisa ae rare d'ara ra, ho mamuri pa'èci dènge ne.

source_text: for whoever has entered into the menuchah of hashem has also rested from his ma'asim, just as hashem rested from his.
target_text: aa dhèu dhu maso le sèna ka ae nare d'ara na sama-sama dènge ama lamatua, nèngu dhu ae nare le nèti sasab'a-la'a na, sama sèmi lamatua kahèi ae nèti sasab'a-la'a na, lèke dènge lod'o ka pidhu.

source_text: therefore, let us have zerizut diligence to enter into that menuchah, for fear that anyone fall through following be'ikvot in the footsteps of their same lack of mishma'at obedience.
target_text: de bori pa'èra ho miu bisa maso ae mere d'ara, sèna ka mamuri sama-sama dènge ama lamatua. mage dhoka abhu dhu j'aj'i boe maso, lula nèngu nanene boe lii holo-nori lamatua, cakaraa bèi-baki èdhi sèra.

source_text: for the dvar hashem is chai living and chazak strong, sharper than every double-edged cherev and penetrating as far as the division of nefesh and ruach, of both joints and marrow, and able to judge the machshavot and deliberations of the kavanat halev the inner directedness of the heart.
target_text: te lii holo-nori ama lamatua ka dhu paj'uj'u j'ara mamuri dhu lèke. lii se'e dhu dènge koasa ho maso asa d'ara èdhi, sèna ka pasoro ngangee dènge dad'èi èdhi aa'i-aa'i. te lii holo-nori se, dhu madèka titu kèna, risi nèti hela madèka dhu bisa sabhi eele isi, aa j'ue eele kalua dènge sèg'i rui, sèna ka pasabhoka aa'i.

source_text: and there is not nivra anything created nistar hidden from his sight, but all things are laid bare and exposed to the eynayim eyes of him to whom we must render an account.
target_text: ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha, abhu boe èci sa dhu pahuni nèti ama lamatua, te nèngu bisa nèdhi aa'i mèu-mèu. aa bèli-camèd'a èdhi hud'i lati asa katanga madha na, sèna ka ti dhaa aa'i, ngaa dhu èdhi ad'u-ue.

source_text: therefore, als since we have a great kohen gadol who has made his passing through shomayim, yehoshua zun fun der oybershter, let us hold firmly to the hoda'ah confession of the hachrazah proclamation of our emunah.
target_text: èdhi hud'i kèpe ku pa'èra-èra lalèka èdhi, lula ana ama lamatua, yesus, dhu j'aj'i le kètu kapai risi agama èdhi. te nèngu ètu le madha ama lamatua ètu sorga, sèna ka sarii èdhi.

source_text: for we do not have a kohen gadol who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but one who has been tempted in every way as we are, yet without chet.
target_text: na bisa sarii èdhi dènge be'a, lula ne'a, èdhi dhèu rai-haha biasa. ladhe abhu dhu dadugu-rariu èdhi ho tao sala, na, èdhi manahu malai. yesus abhu dadugu-rariu kahèi sama sèmi èdhi, te ngaa na manahu nèdhi boe.

source_text: therefore, let us approach with bitachon the kisse of chesed, that we may receive rachamim and may find chesed for timely ezrah aid.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mai ti pabani d'ara ho ara lati asa madha ama lamatua dhu ètu kadera paredha na. te nèngu ne, d'ara hua iia. de ladhe èdhi sabaj'a mi nèngu, tatu na neo pad'elo rasa kasia na, ho soru-bara èdhi lèke dènge lod'o na.

source_text: for every kohen gadol taken from among bnei adam is ordained for men for the avodas kodesh of hashem, that he may offer both minchot gifts and zevakhim sacrifices for chatta'im sins.
target_text: dhèu dhu ded'e rare j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama, sasab'a na, hud'i soru-bara dhèu, sèna ka rèngu pabe'a dènge ama lamatua. nèngu hud'i sèmi nare ku mèdha persembahan dènge badha korban, ho saraka asa lamatua. nèngu kahèi hia badha korban, sèna ka lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu.

source_text: the kohen gadol is able to deal gently with the am ha'aretz and wayward, als since he himself is subject to helpless human frailty;
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu re'a boe j'ara mamuri dhu lèke, do dhèu dhu rai eele nèti j'ara èèna, kètu agama ne pasusa boe rèngu. nèti d'ara hua iia na, nèngu lii mako dènge ra, lula nèngu kahèi dhèu rai-haha dhu mud'a manahu, sama sèmi rèngu.

source_text: and therefore he is obligated to offer zevakhim not only for the averos of the am berit but also for his own averos.
target_text: lula nèngu kahèi dhèu rai-haha sama sèmi rèngu, nèti èèna ka kètu agama ne hud'i hia badha korban, ho lamatua saku pamèu sasala nèngu mesa na.

source_text: and one does not presume to take the kavod of the office of kohen gadol upon oneself, but one must have the bechirah choice, election of hashem, just as aharon did.
target_text: dhèu bisa boe ded'e iisi na, sèna ka j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama. te dhoka ama lamatua di dhu dènge hak, sèna ka hag'e nare dhèu sèmi èèna, nuka sèmi uru-uru sèra na ded'e harun, a'a musa.

source_text: so also rebbe, melech hamoshiach did not seize kavod for himself to become a kohen gadol, but the one having said to him, beni atah, ani hayom yelidticha, my son you are; today i have become your father.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge kristus. na ded'e boe iisi na, ho j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama. te uru èèna, ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu ded'e ne, peka na, èu ne, ana ja'a, doe ne'e, ja'a ded'e èu ho mèd'u paredha.

source_text: says also in another passage, atah kohen l'olam al divrati malki-tzedek you are a kohen forever according to the order of malki-tzedek.
target_text: ètu era leo nèti sasuri lamatua dhu mola-mèci, dhu suri kahèi, peka na, èu j'aj'i kètu agama dhu ca ropa dènge ca dhèu dhu mamuri uru èèna, nuka melkisedek, te ngaa èu j'aj'i kètu agama toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: rebbe, melech hamoshiach, in the days of his earthly life, offered with a raised voice and tears both tefillos and techinnah prayers of supplication to the one who was able to deliver him from mavet, and hashem heard him because of his chasidus.
target_text: ètu lod'o oe èle mamuri yesus ètu rai-haha ne, na loe boe sabaj'a dènge tangi d'ara pèd'a, manèngi ama lamatua sèna ka hia ne a'èra. te ne'a, na, koasa lamatua bisa hia ne mamuri. hèia ama lamatua sèmi nare lii manèngi yesus, lula na madhutu mola-mola dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: although he was haben, rebbi, melech hamoshiach learned mishma'at from his yissurim.
target_text: te yesus ne, ana ama lamatua. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa nèngu hud'i pasae ku j'aj'èra, ho ne'a madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: and having been made shalem complete, to all those with mishma'at toward rebbe, melech hamoshiach, he became the source of yeshu'at eloheinu olamim,
target_text: èle èèna ka, na tao madhutu mola-mola dad'èi lamatua aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, nèngu j'aj'i le kapua mamuri bagi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ne, ho mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: having been designated by hashem as kohen gadol al divrati malki-tzedek.
target_text: te lamatua ded'e nare le yesus j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama, ca ropa dènge melkisedek, dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama uru sèra.

source_text: we have much to say about this for which it is difficult to make a midrash, als since you have become spiritually hard-of-hearing.
target_text: j'ara ae era dhu ja'a neo lole dènge miu lula-nèti kristus dènge melkisedek, te ngaa ako carui paled'a j'ara se'e, lula miu nuka sèmi ana iiki dhu me'a mèu mèka dènge be'a.

source_text: for indeed by this time you ought to be morim saying shiurim, but instead you have need again to be taught the orthodox jewish basic ikarim principles, essentials of the divrei hashem, and you have become one having need of cholov and not solid okhel.
target_text: aa te ngaa, miu dhu parcaya nèbhu le. madhutu iia-iia na, miu j'aj'i le mese ho aj'a-nori dhèu leo. te ngaa te'a boe na, miu cakaraa ana rara iisi hiu, dhu ne'a mèka na'a, te ne'a dhoka ninu susu di. miu parluu dhèu era ho aj'a miu lula-nèti j'ara-j'ara dhu carui mèka nèti sasuri lamatua dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: for everyone partaking of cholov is unacquainted with hadivrei tzedek, for he is an olel infant.
target_text: ja'a pakasame miu dènge ana rara iisi hiu, lula miu me'a mèka j'ara-j'ara dhu carui boe nèti kristus, sèna ka miu bisa mamuri mola.

source_text: but solid okhel is for the mevugarim mature ones, adults, the ones whose keilim faculties have been trained by practice for distinguishing both hatov and harah.
target_text: te ngaa lod'o ana iiki ne kapai, nèngu ninu heka susu, te ngaa na'a nganga'a dhu sakaa. èèna èci èèna ka, dènge dhèu aj'a ne toke ne'a mèu a'aj'a lamatua, sèna ka ne'a mia ka dhu be'a, aa mia ka dhu karehe.

source_text: therefore, let us leave behind the stam elementary ikarim essentials of the devarim hahora'ah words of teaching about rebbe, melech hamoshiach, and let us move ahead to hitbagrut maturity, not laying again a foundation of teshuva from ma'asim metim dead works and emunah toward hashem,
target_text: de miu hud'i aj'a paie-iie ku a'aj'a dhu carui risi, lula miu dhu aj'a nèbhu ae le a'aj'a dhu carui mèka lula-nèti kristus. nèti èèna ka limuri ne, baku dhoka aj'a pahari-pahari a'aj'a dhu carui mèka sèra, nuka sèmi: dhèu hud'i tèke eele ku sasala rèngu aa'i-aa'i; a'aj'a lula-nèti dhèu hud'i parcaya ku ama lamatua;

source_text: of divrei torah on tevilot and tohorah and s'michat yadayim and of the techiyas hamesim and of the mishpat olam.
target_text: a'aj'a lula-nèti sarani; a'aj'a lula-nèti bane ai mi dhèu sèna ka dhèu èèna sèmi nare roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci; a'aj'a lula-nèti ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu nèti mamadhe ra; aa a'aj'a dhu èèna na dhèu lasi asa katanga madha lamatua, ho sèmi rare lii pama'ète, dhu peka na, cee ka dhu bisa mamuri taa-taa dènge ne, aa cee ka dhu bisa boe.

source_text: and this we shall do, im yirtzeh hashemif the l-rd wills.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe lamatua hia ijin, na, èdhi j'aj'i heka ana iiki dhu te'a dhoka tinu susu di. te ja'a neo aj'a j'ara-j'ara dhu carui risi hari.

source_text: for it is impossible for those who once received the ohr hashem, having tasted of the matanah of shomayim and having become chavrusa partners of the ruach hakodesh, and having tasted the goodness of the dvar hashem and the nifla'ot of the olam habah, and then, having fallen away, and become shmad - it is impossible to renew them again to teshuva, because they have pierced to themselves the zun fun der oybershter on haetz hakelalat hashem and have again held him up to contempt and open bushah shame.
target_text: aa te ngaa, abhu le dhèu dhu re'a mèu lii a'aj'a kristus, aa dhu rasa le d'ara hua iia lamatua kahèi, toke na hia si roh na dhu mola-mèci. rèngu re'a le lii holo-nori lamatua, aa rasa le koasa na dhu na neo pake lod'o èle rai-haha ne. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa dhèu se tèke eele le parcaya ra, aa ra soro kabodho mi kristus. nèti èèna ka, bisa heka abhu j'ara ho rèngu bisa lèpa hari manèngi abho, sèna ka mamuri pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua. te ladhe dhèu ro'o boe ele-ho'a, èèna sama sèmi rèngu ka dhu paku pamadhe hari ana ama lamatua ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, hèia ra nyanyèi ne ètu madha dhèu ae-ae.

source_text: for the adamah mud, which drinks the geshem rain that often falls upon it, and brings forth esevplants suitable for those for whom it is cultivated, receives a bracha from hashem;
target_text: dhèu sèmi sèra, èci èèna ka dènge rai dhu hèu mèngi boe, nèti èèna ka abhu boe hua-hela dhu be'a. te ngaa ladhe abhu ka èj'i, rai dhu hèu mèngi bisa hia hua-hela dhu dènge guna mi lamatua oka. hèia ama lamatua papuru mamèngi-nale, sèna ka hua-hela nèti rai ne asa tabha ae.

source_text: but if adamah mud is producing kotz v'dardarthorns and thistles, it is worthless and near to being arurahcursed, whose ketz end is for burning in eish.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu soro kabodho mi kristus, nuka sèmi rai dhu pènu dènge dhudhu dènge sete di. aa dhudhu-sete se guna boe mi ngaa-ngaa èci sa. nèbhu boe, ama lamatua mai ho huku rai èèna. hèia na labhu pakèpu aa'i dhudhu dènge sete se, dhu gaguna ra aad'o.

source_text: however, chaverim, even though we speak in this way, we have been convinced of better things concerning you and of things belonging to yeshu'at eloheinu.
target_text: a'ari pasue! masi ka ja'a ako padhai lii bia ciki, te ngaa ja'a ke'a kahèi, na, miu rai eele boe kristus. te miu parcaya ne kahèi, aa mamuri miu kahèi abhu hua-hela dhu be'a.

source_text: for hashem is not unjust so as to forget your po'al work and the ahavah which you have shown toward ha-shem of him, having rendered avodas kodesh ministry service to the kedoshim, ken, and you are still serving them.
target_text: de sanèd'e, te d'ara ama lamatua mola, aa na bhèlu boe èi kabhèsu miu. te miu sab'a bia le, sèna ka soru-bara dhèu unu na sèra, aa mi sue si. mema karèi nèti uru ka, miu pakako le sasab'a na. aa miu pakako taruu sasab'a na era.

source_text: and we desire that each one of you show the same zerizut diligence so as to realize the full bitachon of the tikvah hope until haketz,
target_text: te limuri ne, ja'a d'èi ladhe miu sab'a èra risi hari, sèna ka tao madhutu taruu toke pa'èle. dènge sèmi èèna, miu bèli-camèd'a sèmi mere babe'a aa'i-aa'i dhu miu sanao nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: that you not become atzlanit sluggards but imitators of the ones who through emunah and savlanut patience inherit the havtachot promises.
target_text: sad'i miu baku bai-eed'a! miu hud'i laladhe nèti dhèu dhu parcaya nèbhu le mi ama lamatua. te rèngu tino sanao-maena mi nèngu, toke ra sèmi rare aa'i dhu lamatua pajaji le.

source_text: for when hashem gave the havtachah promise to avraham avinu, als sincehashem had no one greater by which to make a shevu'ah oath, hashem made a shevu'ah by himself saying, surely blessing i will bless you and multiplying i will multiply you. and thus, having waited with savlanut, avraham avinu obtained the havtachah promise. for bnei adam make a shevu'ah by someone greater than themselves, and a shevu'ah given as confirmation, settles every matter decisively.
target_text: conto nuka sèmi abraham. uru èèna, ama lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dènge ne pake lii subha. ladhe dhèu rai-haha ded'e subha, nèngu tema pake kolongara ama lamatua, sèna ka lamatua j'aj'i sakasii na, lula lamatua risi nèti nèngu. aa ladhe paraga dènge lii langu, dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a, na, lii dhu dhèu ne peka èèna lèke tare'a, lula na subha pake kolongara ama lamatua. èèna mema j'ara dhèu rai-haha kèna. te ngaa lod'o ama lamatua ded'e subha dènge abraham, lamatua pake kolongara nèngu unu na, lula abhu boe dhu risi nèti nèngu. na jaji, peka na, èèna na, ja'a hia mèngi-nale ae-ae, mi èu dènge ana-èpu mu, bèli-camèd'a rèngu bèba-kacanga, toke dhèu bisa boe ige rare si. ama lamatua padadha nare sèmi èèna, hèia abraham parcaya, aa sanao-maena taruu mi lamatua, masi ka d'ai nèbhu ae ku, heka sèmi nare ngaa dhu lamatua pajaji sèra.

source_text: similarly, when hashem wanted to demonstrate even more emphatically to the yoreshim heirs of the havtachah promise the unchangeableness of his willed tachlis purpose, hashem guaranteed it with a shevu'ah,
target_text: dènge j'ara ne, èdhi te'a, ladhe lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dènge dhèu unu na, nèngu pa'èki lii pajaji ne pake subha, ho j'aj'i mi tate'a, ngaa dhu na moa èèna, mema lèke aa ub'a boe.

source_text: in order that by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for hashem to speak sheker, we may have chozek strength and great encouragement, we who say that he is my makhsehrefuge, shelter, and have taken hold of the tikvah hope set before us.
target_text: te abhu dua j'ara dhu bisa boe ub'a. ka èci, nuka lii pajaji ama lamatua. aa èci hari, nuka lii subha lamatua, dhu na pake j'aj'i mi tate'a nèti lii pajaji na. de ladhe ama lamatua dhu moa le j'ara èci, tatu na tao madhutu, lula nèngu bisa boe omo koso. nèti èèna ka, èdhi baku pangee rupa-rupa dènge lii pajaji na. èdhi dhu rai lati le, sèna ka tenge mamuri nèti nèngu, de limuri ne, èdhi dhoka mate di, ho sanao dhoka mi nèngu di.

source_text: this tikvah we have as an ogen anchor for the neshamah, a tikvah both firm and secure, which enters inside the parokhet,
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, d'ara èdhi taleo nuka sèmi koha dhu rai eele nèti d'ara rii, ho la'e panahu ètu hèb'a-namo. te era maena èdhi dhoka kristus di, dhu j'aj'i le kètu kapai risi agama èdhi. uru èèna, lèke dènge lod'o kalela dhèu yahudi, kètu kapai risi agama rèngu maso asa kama luri mola-mèci re bèla gorden, sèna ka paraga dènge ama lamatua ètu èèna.

source_text: where yehoshua has entered as a metatron forerunner on behalf of us, having become a kohen l'olam al divrati malki-tzedekkohen forever according to the order of malki-tzedek.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, yesus dhu la'e uuru le, ho bhoke j'ara hia èdhi. te nèngu kètu kapai risi agama kahèi, dhu ca ropa dènge melkisedek, dhu uru èèna. te ngaa yesus kapai risi nèti kètu agama uru èèna, lula na ae nèdhi boe pakako sasab'a-la'a na.

source_text: for this malki-tzedek melech shalem kohen l'el elyon, is the one having met avraham avinu acharei shuvo after returning from the slaughter of the kings and having blessed him, with whom also avraham avinu apportioned ma'aser mikol a tithe of everything. as for his name, it is rendered king of tzedek righteousness and then also melech of shalom. without av, without em, without yichus, having neither a techillah beginning leyamim to days of him nor a ketz hachayyim, but resembling the zun fun der oybershter, he remains a kohen perpetually.
target_text: uru èèna, melkisedek j'aj'i dhèu aae kota salem. nèngu kahèi kètu agama nèti dhèu-dhèu dhu pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele èèna. ngara melkisedek ne, sasoa na, dhèu aae d'ara mola. aa dhèu aae salem, sasoa na, dhèu aae dame. èci sa re'a boe j'aj'aj'i melkisedek ne nèti mia. èci sa re'a boe kahèi ina dènge ama na, aa bèi-baki na. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu re'a lod'o rara iisi na, aa lod'o mamadhe na. dhèu re'a dhoka, nèngu dhèu aae kota salem, aa kètu agama nèti ama lamatua. te ngaa nèngu ne, nuka sèmi ana ama lamatua, lula nèngu ama agama dhu pakako taruu sasab'a na kahèi. ca tèka, pèri-pèri dhèu aae dènge sordad'u ra mai parame rèti mèdha-panyau angalai abraham. ka abraham dènge angalai na lasi pamusu dènge dhèu aae se, toke abraham segi si. hèia mèdha-panyau nèti angalai na sèra, abraham nèti aa'i hari. ropa abraham lèpa asa rai na, hèia melkisedek kalua nèti kota salem, ho la'e soru ne. ka na hia abraham berkat, peka na, hud'i laa ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele èèna, hia èu mèngi-nale. èle ka abraham hia melkisedek ca pala nèti canguru pala, nèti mèdha aa'i-aa'i dhu na parame nare hari sèra. abraham pabagi hia ne, lula melkisedek ne kètu agama nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele.

source_text: now consider how great among the gedolim this one was to whom also avraham avinu gave from his booty a ma'aser tithe.
target_text: de pangee paie-iie melkisedek ne! abraham bagi hia ne ca pala nèti canguru pala, nèti mèdha aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a risi dhu na parame nare hari. de dhu lèke, nuka melkisedek ne dhèu kapai.

source_text: and the ones of the bnei levi have received the kehunah priesthood and they have a mitzvah to collect the ma'aser tithe from the am brit, and they have this mitzvah according to the torah, that is, to collect from their achim, though these also are descended from the loins of avraham avinu.
target_text: aa te ngaa lod'o sèra, ama lamatua ded'e mèka dhèu j'aj'i ama agama. toke d'ai ku lod'o lewi, ana-èpu èci nèti abraham, heka ama lamatua ded'e ne dènge ana-èpu na, sèna ka j'aj'i ama agama hia mi ana-èpu abraham aa'i-aa'i ra. èle èèna ka, ama lamatua papuru atora na dhu peka na, dhèu nèti suku lewi dènge hak ho abhu ca pala nèti canguru pala nèti rui-j'aj'èra a'ari ra suku leo sèra ètu isra'el.

source_text: but, this man, though not tracing his descent from them, has received ma'aser tithe from avraham avinu and has given a bracha to the one having the havtachot promises.
target_text: te ngaa melkisedek ne, ana-èpu boe nèti lewi. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abraham bagi hia ne ca pala nèti canguru pala, lula na pangee, na, melkisedek ne dhèu kapai. lod'o èèna abraham dhu sèmi nare le lii pajaji nèti ama lamatua ho hia ne berkat. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa melkisedek peka kahèi, na, hud'i laa ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele èèna, hia èu mèngi-nale.

source_text: now it is beyond all argument that the greater gives a bracha to the lesser.
target_text: ne'e ne ka j'aj'i mi tadha, na, melkisedek ne, dhèu kapai. lula dhèu dhu hia berkat tatu kapai risi nèti dhèu dhu sèmi nare berkat.
